KUZOHLOMULA nentsha efuna ukuqala amabhizinisi ohlelweni loxhaso, olwenziwa yinhlangano kaNgqongqoshe woMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha uMnuz Senzo Mchunu ayisungule nomkakhe. Bangaphezu kuka-60 osomabhizinisi abebeyingxenye yomdlalo wegalofu eMount Edgecombe eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu, obuhlelwe yinhlangano iSenzo & Thembeka Mchunu Foundation. Inhloso yalo mdlalo ukuqokelela isikhwama esizosiza intsha eswele efuna ukuqhubeka nezifundo. UMchunu oke waba ngundunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal nongqongqoshe wezemfundo, uthe ngesikhathi ekulezi zikhundla wabona indlela intsha ethwele kanzima ngayo ngenxa yemali. Wabonisana nomkakhe babona kungcono basungule le nhlangano ukuze bafake isandla ekusizeni intsha, ikakhulukazi kwezemfundo. “Ngesikhathi ngiwungqongqoshe wezemfundo ngaba nethuba lokubona izinselelo ezibhekene nentsha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Nangesikhathi ngingundunankulu kwakunophiko iYouth Desk, olwangenza ngabona ukuthi intsha iyazimisela uma inikwe ithuba. Ngifundile nokuthi ukuxhasa akudingi ube ngusomabhizinisi kodwa noma ngubani angalwenza ushintsho, yingakho nami ngisungule le nhlangano,” kuchaza uMchunu. Uthe ngesikhathi ekwezemfundo bekumphatha kabi ukubona izingane ziphasa ngamalengiso kodwa ziswele imali yokufunda. Uveze ukuthi ubenxenxa osomabhizinisi nezinkampani ezizimele ukuthi zibaxhase. “Sihlale phansi nomkami ngoba sobabili sasingothisha, sabheka ukuthi singasiza kanjani,” kusho uMchunu. Uthe kule nhlangano abazokhetha intsha yalesi sifundazwe kuphela kodwa nakuzwelonke. UMchunu uthe kunebhodi lenhlangano okuyilona elizokhetha intsha edinga usizo. Uthe uzobheka nalabo asebeyeke ukufunda ngoba beswele imali nentsha efuna ukuqala amabhizinisi. Kulo mdlalo uMchunu ubehamba nomkakhe naye obedlala igalofu. UMchunu utshele Isolezwe ukuthi akakabi ngungoti osezingeni likaTiger Woods kulo mdlalo, uthe uyathanda ukudlala igalofu uma engekho emsebenzini. Uhlabe ikhwelo kubo bonke osomabhizinisi ukuthi basize noma yikuphi lapho bengalekelela khona ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile entsheni. Emuva komdlalo uMchunu nosomabhizinisi babe nesidlo, naso ebesiyingxenye yokuqokelela imali yokusiza intsha. Inhlangano wayisungula ngo-2014 kodwa ike yangasebenza kahle njengoba isiqala izinhlelo zokusiza abafundi.
UMSAKAZI uMo Flava ujabuliswa ukusiza intsha ngemifundaze UMSAKAZI uMo Flava ujabuliswa ukusiza intsha ngemifundaze Lo msakazi owethula ngokuhlanganyela uhlelo lwantambama noMasechaba Ndlovu oluthi The Drive, ukhipha le mifundaze ngokubambisana nesikhungo semfundo ephakeme iBoston Media House. Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uMo Flava uthe umkhankaso wakhe wokunikezela ngemifundaze uzoqala ophikweni lalesi sikhungo oluseThekwini ngoMgqibelo. Echaza ngokusungula lo mfundaze, lo msakazi uthe ukhuthazwe ukukhula kanzima. “Nami ngafunda khona eBoston, kungekho lula ngenxa yokuthi imali beyingekho. Okwacishe ngangiphoqa ukuthi ngishiye phansi. Nangesikhathi sengisebenza bengihlangabezana nentsha engibuza ngokuthi ingenza njani ukuze yenze lo msebenzi engiwenzayo. Bengithi uma ngiyitshela ukuthi kufanele iyofunda, ikhale ngokweswela imali. Yingakho-ke ngathi angisungule lo mfundaze ukuze ngiyisize ifeze amaphupho ayo.” Uthe abantu abahlinzeka ngalo mfundaze yilabo abathole imiphumela emihle nyakenye noma ngo 2017 futhi abaphuma emindenini engamile kahle ngasemnothweni. “Umuntu ofuna lo mfundaze ungithumelela imiphumela yakhe ka-matric kuWhatsApp (0812687518). Ngibe sengimfonela ngimbuza ukuthi uphuma emndenini onjani futhi sengimazisa nokuthi sizohlangana kuphi naye.” UMo Flava uthe uzoqala eDurban Campus ngoJanuwari 19, adlulele eSandton Campus ngoJanuwari 26 bese egcina ePretoria Campus ngoFebhuwari 2. Ucele abafundi ukuba baqale bazi ukuthi bafuna ukwenza muphi umsebenzi uma sebephothule izifundo zabo. “Akuve kungiphatha kabuhlungu ukuzwa umfundi esethi uyahluleka ukwenza izifundo azikhethile, manje usefuna ukuzishintsha. Abanye bafunde baqede kodwa bahlulwe yimisebenzi abayikhethile. Umuntu ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo somfundaze akenze isiqiniseko sokuthi useyazi ukuthi ufuna ukufundela muphi umsebenzi,” kusho uMo Flava.Uthe kudingeka abafundi abazimisele ngokwenza izifundo eziphathele nomsakazo, ukukhiqizwa komculo, ukudijeya, Animation neGraphic Design. Sekungunyaka wesishiyagalolunye uMo Flava efundisa intsha mahhala.
ABEFUNDISI besifazane nabazalwane bamahlelo ehlukene ezenkolo eThekwini abebebambe isithangami nabezindaba eCity Hall mayelana nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane emabandleni, kusukela kwesobunxele uNkk Susi Mathibela, uNkk Mapule Ngobese, uNkk Ziningi Jali, uNksz Ndoni Hadebe noNkk Nosipho Mthembu ABEFUNDISI besifazane nabazalwane bamahlelo ehlukene ezenkolo eThekwini abebebambe isithangami nabezindaba eCity Hall mayelana nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane emabandleni, kusukela kwesobunxele uNkk Susi Mathibela, uNkk Mapule Ngobese, uNkk Ziningi Jali, uNksz Ndoni Hadebe noNkk Nosipho Mthembu ABEFUNDISI besifazane bamahlelo ahlukene ezenkolo eThekwini banxuse abesifazane abahlukunyezwayo emabandleni ukuthi baphumele obala ukuze kuliwe nalesi sihlava. Esithangamini nabezindaba eCity Hall eThekwini izolo, uNobhala wabefundisi besifazane uNkk Ziningi Jali okunguye obefunda isitatimende, uthe sekwanele ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane, wengeza ngokuthi bafuna ukuthi bonke abagila imikhuba babhadle ejele. “Siyakuqaphela ukuthi sekunabefundisi abaningi abagila imikhuba egameni lenkonzo okuyinto ethunaza umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu,” kusho uNkk Jali. Uthe abantu besifazane abahlukunyezwayo kufanele bangathuli ukuze unqandwe lo mkhuba odla lubi “Abantu besifazane ikakhulukazi izingane zamantombazane zisatshiswa ngokuthi zizoqalekiswa zilandelwe ngamadimoni uma zibika ngokuhlukunyezwa, umuntu ongakakhuli ngokomoya angasaba ngempela uma ezwa lokho angabe esakhuluma ngokuhlukunyezwa kwakhe,” kusho uNkk Jali. Uthe abefundisi abagila imikhuba basebenzela ubumnyama.“Iningi labo lisungula amabandla ngoba lifuna ukwenza imali liphinde lithokozise imizwa yabo ngokuhlukumeza abesifazane,” kusho uNkk Jali. Uthe bengabafundisi besifazane bayameseka uNksz Cheryl Zondi ongufakazi wokuqala emacaleni okudlwengula abhekene noMfundisi Tim Omotoso waseNigeria. “Ubufakazi obethulwe nguNksz Zondi sebungamyisa * -Omotoso ejele,” kusho uNkk Jali. Kulesi sithangami sabezindaba kukhona nomunye umzalwane ocele ukuthi angadalulwa ophumele obala wathi naye ubehlukunyezwa ngumyeni wakhe ongumfundisi, waze waphuma emshadweni. “Ngize ngaphoqeleka ukuthi ngiphume nasebandleni ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa obekwenziwa kumina,” kusho lo mzalwane. Kuphele isithangami sabezindaba kwabe sekuba nenkonzo ngaphandle kwaseCity Hall.
Iziqengqe uSakhile Njoko noNoxolo Manyoni abangabanye babafundi abaklonyeliswe wuMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, abakhuliswe abazali abangabazali Iziqengqe uSakhile Njoko noNoxolo Manyoni abangabanye babafundi abaklonyeliswe wuMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, abakhuliswe abazali abangabazali KUVUKE umunyu kwamanzi amaduku yizinyembezi kubazali ngesikhathi kwethulwa ubufakazi babafundi abakhuliswe abazali abangabazali, izolo abebeklonyeliswa wuMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal. Laba bafundi abebefunda * -matric nyakenye, bangaphansi kohlelo lomnyango lokufunela izingane eziyizintandane abazozikhulisa, zihole nemali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni. Abafundi abathathu abethule ubufakazi bagcizelele ukuthi basizwe wukuhlonipha bonke abantu abadala ngisho bazi ukuthi abanabazali. Laba bafundi baklonyeliswe ngama-laptop nezikhwama. USakhile Njoko (18) waseSandlwana eNquthu obefunda eSiyanda High wathola o-A abayisikhombisa uthe wakhuliswa umzala wakhe, yena nabafowabo abathathu nodadewabo oyedwa. Washonelwa abazali esamncane. Uyise washona eneminyaka emithathu unina washona enemihlanu. Umzala kaSakhile umkhulisile wamfundisa waze waqeda isikole benodadewabo osenguthisha nabafowabo abesezigabeni ezahlukene zokufundela izifundo zobudokotela enyuvesi, omunye wabo useCuba. USakhile uthe: “Into engikholelwa kuyo yinhlonipho. Iyona ebalulekile kakhulu kangangokuthi noma ngabe kuthiwa ushonelwe abazali, lokho akusho ukuthi ungahloniphi emphakathini. Wonke umuntu okhona mthathe njengomzali wakho.” USakhile owenza unyaka wokuqala ezifundweni ze-Acturial Science enyuvesi yaseWits, eGoli, uthe ayikho imfihlo etheni eyenze waphumelela. Uthe uma ufuna ukuphumelela kumele uzilungiselele, nokuzibekela izinto ofisa ukuphumelela kuzo. Omunye wabafundi ophumelele kahle uNoxolo Manyoni (18) waseMbazwana obefunda esikoleni iNkosi Moses Zikhali High owathola o-A abayisithupha uthe washonelwa yibo bobabili abazali bakhe esemncane. Uthe wakhuliswa uninalume benodadewabo nezinye izingane eziningi eziyizihlobo. UNoxolo uthe: “Bengifuna ukuba yinto enkulu, ngikwazi nokuzimela”. Echaza ngendawo aphuma kuyo uthe amantombazane angangaye ajwayele ukuqeda * -matric bese eyakipita kodwa yena ufuna ukuhluka. Ukhethe ukwenza izifundo zeChemical Engineering ngoba ebona isimo sesomiso izwe elibhekene naso, ufisa ukuba ngomunye wabantu abazosixazulula. UNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Weziwe Thusi, uthe bajwayela ukuba nalo mcimbi kodwa bekungokokuqala ukuthi ube kuleli zinga. Ubonge abazali abakhulise laba bafundi abebeklonyeliswa ngokwenza okufanele ngoba abanye abazali bayayidla imali ekhishwa wumnyango wakhe ukuthi bafundise ngayo izingane. Uthe uNkk Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ubezozigqaja ngalaba bafundi ikakhulukazi abesifazane ngoba bekuyisifiso sakhe ukuthi izingane zamantombazane zifunde.
UKHOMBISE indlela yokuzihlola amabele ekhaya uNkk Janice Benecke wenhlangano iPink Drive no-Olwethu Leshabane obephethe uhlelo, ohlezi phansi nguNkk Dany Ribbink ophila nomdlavuza webele UKHOMBISE indlela yokuzihlola amabele ekhaya uNkk Janice Benecke wenhlangano iPink Drive no-Olwethu Leshabane obephethe uhlelo, ohlezi phansi nguNkk Dany Ribbink ophila nomdlavuza webele KUTHIWA abamnyama basenomqondo wokuthi umdlavuza ngowabelungu, okwenza bangazihluphi ngokuwuhlolela. Lokhu kuvele izolo emcimbini wokuqwashisa ngomdlavuza webele, iBreakfast for Boobies obuhlelwe inhlangano elwa nalesi sifo, iPink Drive eThekwini. UNkk Janice Benecke olawula igatsha lePink Drive esifundazweni, uthe kusewumqansa ukuthi abantu bawuqonde kahle umdlavuza. Uthe ezindaweni zasemakhaya banenkinga yokuthi abantu abakholwa ukuthi nabo bangangenwa umdlavuza. “Kuningi okuyizinkolelo eziyize njengokuthi abanye bacabanga ukuthi uma uhlolela umdlavuza ngo-Okthoba usemathubeni amaningi okuwuthola ngoba yinyanga yokuqwashisa ngawo. Abantu kumele bazi ukuthi umdlavuza awukhethi ngisho iminyaka. Sike saba nengane eneminyaka emibili etholakale inomdlavuza webele,” kuchaza uNkk Benecke. Uthe bayazama ukuqwashisa ngisho ezindaweni ezisemakhaya nasezikoleni. Ukhale ngokuthi abasebenzisa izibhedlela zikahulumeni bathatha isikhathi ukwelashwa ngenxa yokugcwala, yingakho behamba zonke izindawo ukuyohlolela umdlavuza. UNkk Dany Ribbink (42) ongomunye wabaphila nomdlavuza webele uxoxe ngobunzima abhekane nabo eqala ukuthola ngawo. Uthe waqala ukuhlinzwa ngoMashi enesigaxa ebeleni. Uveze ukuthi unina naye wathola ukuthi unomdlavuza eneminyaka engu-39. “Ngangisaba kakhulu emuva kwesonto ngihlinziwe ngoba kwaba noshintsho nasempilweni yami. Ingono yami yaphenduka yaba mnyama nesikhumba sashintsha. Ngilindele ukuyohlizwa futhi ngesonto elizayo kodwa sengamukele, nomyeni wami uyangeseka kakhulu,” kusho yena. Ukhuthaze abesifazane ukuthi bathole umbono wesibili kadokotela ukuqinisekisa isimo sempilo yabo. Uthe lokhu kusiza nangokuthi uzinike isikhathi sokwamukela, uthole nodokotela ozokwelapha ngendlela efanele. UNkk Sarah Walters oyiGenetic Counsellor, ukhulume ngokubaluleka kokuhlola emndenini wonke uma kukhona onomdlavuza. Uveze nokuthi kumele ngisho engekho onomdlavuza abantu bazijwayeze ukuhlolelwa ama-genes ukuze babone uma kukhona osengcupheni yokuwuthola. Kulo mcimbi kuvele ukuthi imali isayinkinga kakhulu kwabanomdlavuza ngoba ukwelashwa kumba eqolo. Lokhu kufakazelwe nanguNkk Ribbink othe akuwona unyaka omuhle emndenini wakhe ngenxa yezindleko zokwelashwa. Abesifazane bahlolelwe umdlavuza bafundiswa nendlela yokuzihlola amabele emakhaya. Uhlelo beluphethwe * -Olwethu Leshabane owaziwa emnncintiswaneni kaMrs South Africa nasohlelweni lwethelevishini iReal Housewives.
SEKUMI ngomumo ngombukiso wamabhizinisi eFranchising ozoba KwaZulu-Natal okokuqala, uNksz Pearl Bengu oyisikhulu esiphezulu seThala othi uzovulela amathuba osomabhizinisi abancane Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE SEKUMI ngomumo ngombukiso wamabhizinisi eFranchising ozoba KwaZulu-Natal okokuqala, uNksz Pearl Bengu oyisikhulu esiphezulu seThala othi uzovulela amathuba osomabhizinisi abancane Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE LIKHULU isasasa ngombukiso omkhulu wamabhizinisi ozoba KwaZulu-Natal okokuqala ngenyanga ezayo. Kulindeleke ukuthi ihehe osomabhizinisi abaningi i-International Franchise and Entrepreneur Expo eyethulwa Ithala ngokuhlanganyela neFranchise Association of South Africa (Fasa). Kuzobe kuwunyaka ka-21 kwenziwa lo mbukiso ohlose ukunika ithuba osomabhizinisi abancane nemifelandowonye ukuhweba emabhizinisini eFranchising. Oyisikhulu esiphezulu se-Ithala Development Finance Corporation uNksz Pearl Bengu, uthe ukulethwa kwalo mbukiso KwaZulu-Natal kuyingxenye yemizamo yabo yokuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi abancane. “Sacela kwiFasa ukuletha lo mbukiso ukuze sivulele osomabhizinisi bethu amathuba. Lokhu kuyingxenye yokukhulisa nesikhwama sethu iFranchise Fund. Sifuna osomabhizinisi bangathengi nje kuphela amabhizinisi amaFranchise kodwa baguqule ngisho awabo abe yiwona,” echaza. Uthe lo mbukiso uhambisana nemigomo yabo kwezokuthuthukiswa komnotho nokwakha amathuba omsebenzi nokuletha abatshali zimali esifundazweni. UNkk Vera Valasis onguMqondisi oMkhulu kwaFasa, uthe sekuneminyaka engu-20 lo mbukiso wenziwa eGoli. “Ukulethwa kwalo mbukiso KwaZulu-Natal kukhombisa ukuthi uyasabalala. Siyajabula ukuthi osomabhizisi bazothola ithuba lokuhlangana nosondonzima kumaFranchise, bathole nokuchushiswa ngaleli bhizinisi.” Lo mbukiso uzudonsa izinsuku ezimbili kusukela ngoMashi 8 eDurban Exhibition Centre. Bangaphezu kuka-40 osomabhizinisi okulindeleke ukuthi babe yingxenye yalo mbukiso abasemikhakheni ehlukene okubalwa owezobuhle, ubuchwepheshe, ezokuvakasha neminye. Kulezi zinsuku ezimbili kuzoba nezikhulumi ezahlukene ukuchushisa osomabhizinisi abancane kulo mkhakha. Umkhakha weFranchising ubalwa neminye ekhulisa umnotho kuleli. Ngokombiko wangonyaka odlule weFasa kuvela ukuthi lo mkhakha ufaka * -15.7% emnothweni wakuleli. Kuthiwa angaphezu kuka-850 amaFranchise kuleli ezitolo ezingaphezu kuka-41 000. Ngemininingwane yokubhalisela ukungena kulo mbukiso kungenwa kwi-website ethi: www.ife.co.za kanti kubiza uR50 ukungena ngosuku embukisweni. Uma uthenga ithikithi emnyango uR100. Izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kuka-16 zingena mahhala. Eminye imininingwane iyatholakala kwi-website ethi:www.ithala.co.za noma ku-031 907 8911.
KUBHUNTSHE umngcwabo abamakhaza begoloza nesidumbu befuna imali okuthiwa bebengavumelananga ngayo nomndeni kamufi. Umndeni wakwaMohlakwana eMzongwane, eMatatiele, ukhala ezimathonsi ngezindleko othi ufakwe kuzo yinkampani yabangcwabi iHambakahle Funeral Parlour ekwaV eMlaza, kulandela ukunqaba nesidumbu sikaNksz Buhle Mohlakwana (35) okuthiwa ushonele esibhedlela iKing George eThekwini ngesonto eledlule. Isidumbu bekulindeleke ukuthi sifike eMatatiele ngoLwesihlanu. Kuthiwa bese kwenziwe zonke izinhlelo zokuthi afihlwe ngoMgqibelo. UNkk Mavundle Khoza waseMatatiele ethintwa yiSolezwe uthe bezwe ubuhlungu obukhulu ngesikhathi bethintwa ngocingo wudadewabo kamufi uNksz Busisiwe Mohlakwana, ebazisa ukuthi abamakhaza abebeke kuwo udadewabo, bayanqaba nesidumbu. “Sihlale kwaze kwasa silindile ukuthi isidumbu kuzothiwa siyeza, hleze abamakhaza bashintshe umqondo kodwa lutho. Omakhelwane abebezosikhalisa kudingeke ukuthi babuyele emakhaya. Sifile ngezindleko esingene kuzo kulungiselelwa umngcwabo ebesazi ukuthi uzoba ngoMgqibelo,” kusho uNkk Khoza. UNksz Mohlakwana uthe usola ambize ngomnikazi wenkampani yabangcwabi uMnuz Ndabezinhle Manzi ngokubalutha ethi uzobagcinela isidumbu emakhazeni ngemali encane okuthe uma sebesayinile washayela ucingo amalungu omndeni wafuna imali enkulu. “Ngesikhathi ngithola ucingo lokuthi udadewethu ushonile, ngiphuthume esibhedlela. Osebenza emakhazeni kahulumeni othe ungowakwaKhanyile, usitshele ukuthi kubiza kakhulu ukugcina umuntu emakhazeni kahulumeni ngakho kungakuhle sithole awethu amakhaza lapha sizomgcina khona,” kusho uNksz Mohlakwana. Uthe bacele umsebenzi ukuthi abaxhumanise nenkampani yabangcwabi engabasiza njengoba bengenayo imali eyisamba yokukhokhela amakhaza, wabe esebaxhumanisa noManzi. Uthe ufike kubo wathembisa ukuthi uzobenzela konke bese bona bemkhokhela imali abanayo ngohlelo lwesitolimende. Uveze ukuthi bavumelane ngoR11 000 kuhlanganisa ibhokisi nemali yokuhambisa isidumbu eMatatiele. “Sekumele kuthathwe isidumbu, uManzi ufune uR17 000, wasinqabela nokuthi sibone isidumbu ethi sikhona emakhazeni kodwa sizosibona uma sesikhokhile.” Kuthintwa uManzi, uthe umndeni yiwona ozikhethele uhlobo lokungcwaba olubiza uR17 000. “Bakhethe ibhokisi oluwuhlobo olubizayo ngoba udadewabo kamufi ubethenjiswe abaqashi bakhe ukuthi bazomnika imali enguR10 000. Uthe omunye uR10 000 uzowuthola kusonhlalakahle obelandela udaba lokugula kukamufi,” kusho uManzi. Ukhale ngezindleko athe ungene kuzo eya ezihlotsheni zikamufi, ehla enyuka ngemoto yomsebenzi eyobanxusa ukuthi bakhokhe ngenxa yokuthi bebengasamthinti kwaze kwaphela izinsuku ezintathu kungaxhunyanwa. Emuva kokungenelela kweSolezwe namaphoyisa asesiteshini saseMlaza umndeni ogcine ubike kuwo, uManzi uthe bavumelene nomndeni ngokuthi isidumbu uzosihambisa namuhla. UNksz Mohlokwana ukuqinisekisile ukuthi bavumelene noManzi, ngokukhokha imali enguR7 500. Uthe babikele amaphoyisa aseMlaza agcine esebaphelezela ukuyoxoxa noManzi.
IPHITHENE amakhanda imindeni yabesifazane abathathu baseThekwini ababoshwe ngezinsolo zokushushumbisa izidakamizwa e-United States. Ababoshiwe ngoNksz Londiwe Shange (27), Wandile Mhlongo (29), Thembeka Sokhulu (36) baseThekwini noNksz Viwe Tshaka (23) ongowaseLusikisiki e-Eastern Cape. Baboshwe ngoNovemba 17 emkhumbini abebesebenza kuwo weMSC. Bavela enkantolo yeMantshi yaseFlorida eMiami ngoMsombuluko. Ngokwemibiko e-US babanjwe necocaine ka7kg. Uma betholwa benecala bangase bagwetshwe iminyaka eyishumi kuya kudilika jele. UNtokozo Mlambo, ongumzala kaWandile Mhlongo, uthe ube ngowokuqala emndeni ukwaziswa ngokuboshwa kwakhe kanti nguye okudingeke ukuthi atshele umndeni ngalezi zindaba. Uthe uNksz Mhlongo ubesekwinkontileka yakhe yesithathu esebenza kulo mkhumbi. “Unina zimuphathe kabi lezi zindaba. Uyazama ukuziqinisa kodwa uyambona uma uhlezi naye ukuthi umqondo wakhe ukwenye indawo,” kusho uNtokozo. Uthe umndeni uyahluleka ukuqonda ukuthi uzibandakanye kanjani nezidakamizwa. “Besingakaze sizitshele ukuthi angazibandakanya nezidakamizwa. UMASIPALA waKwaDukuza uthele phansi imijondolo othi yakhiwe ngokungemthetho eTete, izolo kwaboshwa abayisithupha abebakhe ngokungemthetho Isithombe: Sithunyelwe UMASIPALA waKwaDukuza uthele phansi imijondolo othi yakhiwe ngokungemthetho eTete, izolo kwaboshwa abayisithupha abebakhe ngokungemthetho Isithombe: Sithunyelwe KUNGAKAPHOLI maseko inkantolo ihoxise icala lokungena emhlabeni ngaphandle kwemvume ebelibhekene namalungu omphakathi angu-17 aseTete, KwaDukuza, amalunga alo mphakathi asephinde aboshwa ngecala elifanayo. Ngenyanga edlule amalungu awu-17 omphakathi wakule ndawo, aphuma ejabula enkantolo yeMantshi yaKwaDukuza, ngemuva kokuhoxiswa kwecala lawo, izolo abayisithupha babo babuye baboshwa ngemuva kokuthi bephinde bakha imijondolo kule ndawo. UMnuz Khulekani Mkhize osekomitini labakhe kule ndawo, uthe le ndawo bayicela enkosini yaKwaMagwaza yikho bebuyele kuyo bayokwakha ngemuva kokuhoxiswa kwecala kodwa okhulumela uMasipala waKwaDukuza, uMnuz Sipho Mkhize uthe banalo uhla lwabantu abavumelekile ukuhlala kule ndawo, ababoshiwe abekho kulo. “Njengomasipala sinemigomo elawula izakhiwo ezakhiwe ngokungemthetho. Izolo ithimba likamasipala lifice kunemijondolo eseyakhiwe ngaphandle kwemvume yabanikazi bomhlaba, eminye yawo beyingenalutho ngaphakathi. Ebingenalutho idiliziwe, ebinezimpahla sibophe zona izimpahla ukuze abanikazi bezofika bazochaza ukuthi ubani obanike imvume yokwakha.” Uthe abantu ababafica kule mijondolo akekho othi wanikezwa imvume yinkosi futhi kunzima ukukuqinisekisa lokho ngoba inkosi isanda kukhothama. “Okunye okwenza ukuthi kube nzima ukuthi akekho umuntu ophuma emkhandlwini wobukhosi bakwaMagwaza esamnikwa umndeni ohlala emkhandlwini, asazi ukuthi ngobani laba abathi bayazi ukuthi inkosi yasikela abathile iziza ngaphambi kokuthi ishone. Asikwazi ukudedela abantu bakhe bengenayo imvume yabanikazi bomhlaba,” kusho yena. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, uthe kuboshwe abantu abayisithupha ngecala lokungena emhlabeni ngaphandle kwemvume. Uthe umasipala uyidilizile imijondolo ebeyakhiwe ngokungemthetho kulo mhlaba. Ababoshiwe uthe kulindeleke ukuthi bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMhlali namhlanje.
IPHOYISA liphethe isibhamu okukholakala ukuthi isona esibulele abantu abathathu, abahlanu balimala efulethini elisenkabeni yedolobha eThekwini izolo IPHOYISA liphethe isibhamu okukholakala ukuthi isona esibulele abantu abathathu, abahlanu balimala efulethini elisenkabeni yedolobha eThekwini izolo USIZWE wukuphuma ngewindi owesilisa osindile esigamekweni okushone kuso abantu abathathu, abahlanu balimala kanzima efulethini elisenkabeni yedolobha iTheku emgwaqweni uBurger izolo emini. Lona wesilisa osindile kuthiwa uthole imihuzukwana okukholakala ukuthi idalwe ukuwa esuka esitezi sokuqala phezulu ewela phansi kuleli fulethi eliseduze neNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngaseMtateni. Abathathu abashonile kuthiwa bashonele endaweni yesigameko, kwathi labo abalimele baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela isimo sabo sisibi. Amaphoyisa athi asola ingxabano njengembangela eholele kulesi sehlakalo. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi omunye wabantu abayisishiyagalolunye, abebekhona endlini uyiphoyisa loMkhandlu weTheku. Kodwa okwamanje akucaci ukuthi umsolwa ngubani kuleli cala. Ngesikhathi ithimba leSolezwe lifika kule ndawo emini, abantu bebemi izixongololo kugcwele namaphoyisa, indawo yesehlakalo isihenqwe ngentambo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa oMkhandlu weTheku, uSenior Superintendent Parbhoo Sewpersad uthe amaphoyisa omkhandlu abikelwe ngalesi sigameko, kwathiwa kunokuqhuma kwezibhamu efulethini elisemgwaqweni uYusuf Dadoo. “Uma amaphoyisa efika kuleli fulethi athole ukuthi bekunabantu abayisishiyagalolunye endlini, abathathu bashonile, abahlanu balimele, oyedwa usindile,” kusho uSewpersad. FUNDA: Kufe abathathu kuxabana abangani eflethini eThekwini Uthe okwamanje imbangela yalokhu kudubula ibingakaziwa kodwa bakholwa ukuthi ingxabano eholele kulesi sehlakalo. “Amalungu omphakathi abekwenye indlu asitshele ukuthi kube nengxabano kule ndlu okwenzeke kuyo isigameko, abe esezwa ukuqhuma kwesibhamu,” kusho uSewpersad. Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi omunye wabantu abebephakathi kule ndlu uyiphoyisa lomkhandlu weTheku. “Omunye wabantu abebekhona endlini bekuyiphoyisa ebelingekho emsebenzini,” kusho uSewpersad. Uthe okwamanje ngeke baze bakuqinisekise ukuthi ngubani umsolwa kuleli cala. Kodwa amalungu omphakathi akhulume neSolezwe nacele ukuthi angadalulwa athe, ezwe kuthiwa umuntu odubule abantu uyiphoyisa. “Engathi leli phoyisa lixabane nowesifazane labe selidubula abantu abebesendlini, nalo labe seliyazidubula,” kusho ilungu lo mphakathi. Lithe ukhona owesilisa osindile kulesi sehlakalo. “Sizwe kuthiwa isibhamu okusolakala ukuthi isona esisetshenziswe kulesi sehlakalo sitholakale emagcekeni aseNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini lapho kupakwa khona izimoto, silahlwe khona,” kuqhuba leli lungu lo mphakathi. Elinye ilungu lo mphakathi nalo elicele ukuthi lingadalulwa lithe, lizwe kuthiwa omunye wesilisa olimele, udubuleke emqaleni. “Uma sizwa kuthiwa bekuphuzwa lapha endlini kwabe sekuyaxatshanwa nokuholele ekutheni kugcine sekuqhuma isibhamu,” kusho leli lungu lomphakathi. Umakhelwane uthe leli phoyisa belithanda ukuvakashelwa endlini yalo liphuzise abantu utshwala. “Kodwa belinenhliziyo encane uma selidakiwe,” kusho umakhelwane.

UMETHULI wohlelo we-Utatakho kuMzansi Magic uNimrod Nkosi. UMETHULI wohlelo we-Utatakho kuMzansi Magic uNimrod Nkosi. MHLELI: Ngivumele ngibeke umbono wami mayelana nohlelo oluvezwa kumabonakude olubizwa ngoTatakho, lapho kusuke kufunwa ikakhulukazi ubaba wangempela wengane. Zikhona izingane ezihlezi nobaba abangazizali kodwa abaziphethe kahle njengezingane abazizalayo, bese kuba khona izingane ezifika nomama emendweni kungezona ezasemshadweni. Kuphinde kube nezingane ezihlezi kahle zondliwa futhi zifundiswa ngobaba abangazizali kodwa futhi uthole ukuthi kwayona ingane yazi lo baba njengobaba wayo wangempela. Wonke umuntu uyadinga ukwazi ubaba wakhe, noma ngabe usashona noma ngabe usaphila. Kunezingane namuhla ezakhuliswa ngobaba abangazizali okunamuhla ziphila kamnandi ngoba zakhuliswa kahle. Kunezingane ezihlukunyezwayo kumanje okuthiwa, "Wena kawusiyena owalapha ekhaya, hamba kini!" Uthole ukuthi ingane kayilazi elinye ikubo yazi lapha, kanti umndeni usuyibukisisile, wazanelisa ukuthi kakusiyona eyalapha ekhaya. Kwesinye isikhathi izithandani ziyavumelana ngokuba nemfihlo lapho indoda izothatha unina nengane yakhe, bavumelane ngokuthi lolu daba kuzokuba ngolwabo bobabili. Ngesinye isikhathi uma ingane ikhula iye ifune usiko lwakubo. Yilapho ke iye igule noma kube khona izinto ezingahambi kahle kuyona, igcine isiya kulaba okuthiwa bayabona, abanye ke kuye kuthiwe bayabona kanti kababoni. Iqala lapho ke inkinga, ufike umntwana atshelwe lokho namuhla kusasa atshelwe okuhlukile, ekugcineni bese ehlasela umama wakhe. Umama uhlaselelwa ukuthi kungani engalikhulumi iqiniso achazele ingane ukuthi ingeyakwabani? Uthole abanye sebeludlulisela udaba kuTatakho! Yilapho ke ingane ithola amahlazo kamama wayo ukuthi walala namadoda amangaka, kanti futhi akayazi okuyiyona eyamkhulelisa. Nakhona lapho kuyenzeka amadoda awakhumbulayo umama ukuthi waya nawo ocansini abe mathathu, nakhona lapho uthole ukuthi imiphumela iyawaphika la madoda amathathu. Kwesinye isikhathi omama bezingane bayalala namadoda ahlukene bese kuthi uma esekhulelwe abheke indoda engakwazi ukondla ingane bese ethi iyona ke ubaba wengane. Abesifazane bajwayele uma kuzikhulunyelwa nje bese bethi bayamazi bona ubaba wengane, kodwa uma ulandela uhlelo uTatakho ugcina sewutholile ukuthi lokho akusilona iqiniso. Uma ke imiphumela yamadoda amabili noma amathathu iyilandula ingane, ibe ibihlala futhi yazi ukuthi ubaba wayo yilona oshade nomama wayo, ishona kephi? Umama wayo ushona kephi? Ubudlelwane bengane nonina buba kuliphi izinga? Kuhle ukuthola iqiniso kodwa elingeke futhi lakushiya nomlilo osuyokusha inguna-phakade! Uma singalandela ukuthi labo abaphikwe yimiphumela okusho ukuthi kumanje ababazi abobaba babo, baphila kanjani ke kumanje? Sizothola ukuthi isimo sibi kakhulu kunakuqala udaba lungakayi kuTatakho. Kuyingozi ukufunwa kukababa yingane, kungcono kune ngubaba wengane oyifunayo. Nakhona futhi lapho, ake sicabange, sekuthiwa mina noma wena, kunobaba othi mina ngiyingane yakhe ngoba balala nomama wami, nomama avume ukuthi walala naleyo ndoda! Umama osekuvela ukuthi walala namadoda athize ekubeni eseshadile, angeke esahlala kahle emzini. Mhlawumbe nje selokhu lolu hlelo lwaqala baningi omama asebethuthile emizini yabo bahamba, ngoba vese bakhombise ukungathembeki. Kuyihlazo kakhulu ukuthi kwaziwe ukuthi ingane kamasibanibani akayazi ukuthi ingekabani!

Lesi siteleka esiqale ngoMsombuluko siphazamise ukusebenza kulezi zindawo, okushaye isikhathi sokuloba izolo kusaqhubeka izingxoxo kubaqashi nabasebenzi. Izolo, okhulumela abakwaToyota South Africa Motors (TSAM), uMnuz Clynton Yon, uthe bazimisele ukuxoxa nabasebenzi ukuze kuqhamukwe nesixazululo ezinkingeni ababhekene nazo. UYon ugxeke isitatimende esenziwe yiNumsa sokuthi inkampani ayifuni ukuxoxisana nenyunyana. Lesi sitatimende besishiwo nguNkk Phakamile Hlubi-Majola. Njengezwe sizame ngayo yonke indlela ngemikhankaso yokudala amathuba emisebenzi futhi iTheku liphambili kulo mkhankaso. Abaqashi nabasebenzi kumele bagweme izimo ezingaholela esitelekeni ngoba kuthunazeka nesithunzi sezwe.” UNkk Gumede ucele nokuthi izinkampani ezizimele sibambisane nohulumeni ukuguqula isimo nokuqeda ukungalingani emnothweni.

IMantshi uBusisiwe Mkhulisi imnqabelile uShange ibheyili ngoba ithi wahluleka ukunikeza inkantolo izizathu ezinqala zokuthi kungani kufanele anikezwe ibheyili futhi waqamba amanga. Ngemuva kokuchitha isicelo sebheyili, uShange uqale wafaka phansi ikhanda ngaphambi kokuthandaza isikhathi eside. Uthe esuka lapho wagqolozela uMshushisi uSbongile Ngcobo isikhathi eside futhi engacwayizi. UShange ubuke uNksz Ngcobo waze wayosithela emgodini, elokhu emgqolozele. Abazalwane bavele basikhihla isililo futhi abanye bathandaza. Kukhona intokazi esencane ebigqoke izibuko yona evele yazigingqa phansi. Abesifazane abadala bathwale kanzima bethulisa amantombazane abegqoke izikibha ezinobuso bukamfundisi. Kulokhu uShange ungene enkantolo eswenke ngesudi ephuzi nehembe eliyisikotshi. Inkantolo beyigcwele phama abazalwane abebezoseka uShange. Isicelo sebheyili saqala sachithwa ngumphenyi wecala uSergeant Nomathemba Khwela owaveza ukuthi uShange uzophazamisa uphenyo futhi nempilo yakhe isengcupheni. Nomshushisi uhambe emazwini kaSergeant Khwela futhi wathi kuzodingeka uShange aqhamuke nento ephathekayo engenza anikwe ibheyili. Ngemuva kwesinqumo uNksz Ngcobo uphume ngomnyango ongemuva njengoba amakholwa abelokhu emkhombe njalo ngeminwe, emsola ngokuthi nguye obecindezela uShange. UShange ubemelwe wumnikazi wenkampani yabameli uMnuz Sandile Shoba weShoba Sandile Attorneys. Leli cala like laphenduka umantuntanendishi njengoba liqale enkantolo enguG, lagcina seliku-E ngenxa yokushisa nokungasebenzi komshini oqopha amazwi.

Njengoba sekuzovulwa nasemanyuvesi uthe usebenza nezinhlangano ezahlukene ukusiza abafundi abafuna ulwazi ngezinye izikhungo nemfundo ephakeme. Isithombe: THOKOZANI NDLOVU UMCULI weKwaito uMshoza ubhalele uBabes Wodumo incwadi yokumeseka kulesi sikhathi njengoba kusanda kuvela izinsolo zokuthi ubehlukunyezwa owayeyisoka lakhe, uMampintsha. NgoLwesihlanu olwedlule abantu abaningi kuleli basale beshaqekile ngezinsolo ezivele kwiMetro FM, ohlelweni iThe Drive olwenziwa uMo Flava noMasechaba Ndlovu, lapho uMasechaba aveze ukuthi uyazi ngokuhlukunyezwa kukaBabes Wodumo, athi bekwenziwa uMampintsha. Lo mculi wasekwa abantu abaningi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngemuva kokuvela kwalolu daba, abanye babhekisa intukuthelo yabo kuMampintsha, obengumphathi wakhe nasesitebeleni abeqopha kuso iWest Ink. UMshoza, naye obhekene nodaba olucishe lufane njengamanje, ube ngomunye wosaziwayo abathumelele lo mculi amazwi enduduzo nokumeseka kulesi sikhathi. “Amanxeba abuhlungu ngaphakathi kodwa ngaphandle sishaya sengathi konke kuhamba kahle. Ngesikhathi ngizwa ngesimo obhekene naso izolo ebusuku ngihlulekile ukulala! Bengilokhe ngizibuza ukuyhi senzeni olubi? Sizophendukela kubani?” kubhala uMshoza encwadini ayibhekise kuBabes. Lo mculi uqhube waveza ukuthi akukho lula ukukhuluma ngokuhlukumezeka nokuthi uyafisa ukuba seduzane noBabes kodwa uvinjwa ukuthi usekubhaceni. “Njengoba ngikubhalela le ncwadi ngisekubhaceni, ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa. Lo muntu wesilisa uzame ukungiphuca isithunzi sami, kodwa ngikwazile ukuthola amandla ngaphuma. Ngiyathemba ukuthi nawe ngelinye ilanga uzowathola amandla okuthi sekwanele!” kuqhuba yena. UMshoza uthe uBabes akaqine kulesi sikhathi wamazisa nokuthi akekho yedwa. Uthe amanxeba azophola futhi bazoyilwa ndawonye impi yokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane. “Ngelinye ilanga lezi zinyembezi zizophenduka zibe yinjabulo,” kusho uMshoza. Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana sekwenziwe nehlaya lencwadi esabalalisiwe, okuthiwa ibhalwe abazali bebhalela othisha benxenxa ukuthi zivulwe izikole. Yize lokhu kwenziwa ihlaya, bakhona ngempela abazali abangazi ukuthi bazokwenza kanjani ukuthi izingane zingabi nesithukuthezi emakhaya. Uma amaholidi ezingane engahlelelwe, zigcina ziganga, zenze nezinto ezizozixabanisa nabazali. OyiMarketing Manager yakwaBudget Insurance, uNkk Susan Steward, uthe okuningi kokujabulisa izingane kudinga imali. Uthe ikhona indlela yokugwema ukuchitha imali eningi kodwa uphinde ujabulise izingane. Uveza ukuthi kubalulekile ukuhlela amaholidi okuvalwa ezikole, kubekwe nemali. Nazi ezinye zezinto ezingamasu okujabulisa izingane. Akudingeki uchithe imali uyisa izingane ema-cinema, nawo asemba eqolo. Ungaboleka amaDVD ahlabahlosile ziwabuke ekhaya. Ungazenzela * -popcorn ekhaya, ziwuthokozele zibuka amaDVD. Imidlalo efana nama-puzzle noma amakhadi, ungayenza ukuthi izingane zichithe ngayo isizungu. Kukhona nezincwadi ezixoxa indaba ngezithombe. Ungasiza izingane ukuthi zihlobise lezi zithombe. Lesi yisikhathi sokuthi izingane zifunde nokwenza imisebenzi yasendlini. Ungazifundisa ukubhaka nokupheka noma ukulungisa ingadi. Izingane ziyakujabulela ukuba sepaki ngoba inkulu nendawo yokudlala. Phatha amathoyizi nebhola ukuze zikwazi ukuchitha isizungu epaki. Ungakhohlwa ukuthi ziyakuthanda nokushutha izithombe.
AZIKATHOLAKALI izihlobo zowesilisa okuthiwa udutshulwe washona ngonogada ngoMsombuluko emuva kokuhlasela umuzi wesalukazi ezokweba eMhlali. Kuthiwa lo msolwa ubevele ehlupha ngokuhlasela izaguga kule ndawo njengoba esigamekweni sokugcina ebebamba inkunzi isalukazi esineminyaka engu-73. Lo wesilisa imininingwane yakhe engakatholakali njengoba engaziwa, kuthiwa ubesenezinye izigameko abefunelwa zona ezihlobene nokuhlasela izaguga. Kuthiwa isalukazi sivuswe umsindo ekuseni, okuthe uma siyobheka emnyango, umsolwa wasikhombisa isibhamu wafuna izimpahla. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant-Colonel Thulani Zwane uthe azikatholakali izihlobo zikamsolwa futhi akwaziwa nokuthi ubehlalaphi. Uveze ukuthi isalukazi besisalele emzini waso eSalt Rock ngesikhathi sivuswa umsindo egcekeni. Kuthiwa umsolwa ubesehambile endlini yesalukazi ngesikhathi ethungathwa onogada abazimele emuva kokubikelwa ngalesi sigameko. UZwane uthe umsolwa ubesolwa ngamanye amacala amabili nawo ahlobene nokuphanga emizini ekuyona le ndawo. “Umsolwa usabise isalukazi ngesibhamu maqede wathatha iselula, imali nezinye izimpahla. Isalukazi sishayele inkampani yonogada, yathungatha umsolwa obesaseduze nendawo yesigameko. Onogada bebezama ukumbamba, wadubula kuqala onogada baphindisela kwashona umsolwa,” kusho uZwane. Umufi kuthiwa utholakale nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni okusolakala ukuthi yisona abekhombe ngaso isalukazi. “Kuvulwe icala lokuphanga kuhlonyiwe, kwavulwa nedokodo lokufa komuntu eliphenywa amaphoyisa aseMhlali. Kusolwa ukuthi isibhamu esitholakale kumufi sasintshontshwe komunye umuzi ngesikhathi kuphangwa ngoMeyi nonyaka,” kusho uZwane. UZwane uthe isalukazi asilimalanga kulesi sigameko ngoba umsolwa uphume nezimpahla kuphela.

MHLELI: Kwelingashayi eceleni ake ngiphawule ngemikhuba eyenziwa abantu abaya ezinkonzweni zemingcwabo. Uma kuqala kungena inkonzo yomngcwabo kuyaye kube nomphathi wohlelo oqala ngokuzethula asho ukuthi ungubani wakwabani. Uma esezethulile ungena ohlelweni. Baye benze izinto ezingefani-ke ngoba omunye ubiza lonke uhlu lwezikhulumi nezihloko ezizokhuluma ngaphansi kwazo, omunye avele aqale uhlelo. Kunento engiphatha kabi eyenziwa abasuke besenkonzweni. Bahlala kungaphumi noyedwa uma kusaqhubeka uhlelo zize ziphele izikhulumi, kuthi uma ophethe uhlelo eselubuyisela kobaba abazosikhonza ngeZwi leNkosi ubone sebephuma abantu. Uma ubafica phandle ubathola sebezixoxela abanye sebebhema. Kwabangwani neZwi leNkosi ngoba lingukuphila? Enkonzweni ngaphakathi kusala omama abaningi nedlanzana labesilisa. Uma ubheka emnyango ubona kumiwe sekuyizixongololo, ungaphika ukuthi kusemngcwabeni ungathi kusephathini. Uma kunethaveni eduze abanye bazithengela utshwala baphuze. Ishumayela inceku yeNkosi ize ijuluke ishumayeza izihlalo zasehholo. Ubani kanti osuke eshunyayezwa phakathi kosedlulile emhlabeni nathi esiphilayo? Abantu okumele bezwe iZwi yithina esisaphila hhayi ongasekho ngoba yena usewuqedile owakhe umsebenzi, indaba isisele nathi. Imisiko yasemishadweni isigqokwa emingcwabeni, angazi noma kwenziwa wukuthi imishado inqabile yini. Ukudla baze baphinde amapuleti sengathi umuntu usedlela ukulala.

Okhulumela le nyuvesi, uNksz Normah Zondo, uthe kumiswe izivivinyo nokufunda izolo kulolu phiko kuphela. UNXUSA abantu ukuthi babekezele ngoba kuzothatha isikhathi ukulungisa isimo sezwe uNksz Phumzile Langeni osethimbeni eliqokwe nguMengameli wezwe ukuheha abatshali bezimali UNXUSA abantu ukuthi babekezele ngoba kuzothatha isikhathi ukulungisa isimo sezwe uNksz Phumzile Langeni osethimbeni eliqokwe nguMengameli wezwe ukuheha abatshali bezimali OMUNYE wabaqokwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuheha abatshali bezimali uthi abantu kumele babekezele ngoba kusazothatha isikhathi ukuguqula isimo sezwe. UNksz Phumzile Langeni, oyiPresidential Investor Emissary, ubekhuluma nosomabhizinisi izolo esithangamini senhlangano iBusiness Leadership South Africa (BLSA) eThekwini. Uqokwe ngo-Ephreli nabanye abathathu ukuthi bazame izindlela zokungenisa ezweni li * $1 billion eminyakeni eyisihlanu. Utshele osomabhizinisi ukuthi umkhankaso kamengameli obizwa ngeThuma Mina, ngeke uphumelele uma engalekelelwa. Uvumile ukuthi isimo ezweni simanzonzo kuzo zonke izinhlangothi, ikakhulukazi kwezomnotho. “Abantu balahlekelwe yithemba, kubonakala ngokwanda kwemibhikisho nsuku zonke. Awulula umsebenzi esinikwe wona kodwa okuhle wukuthi umengameli uhambe phambili wadlulisa umyalezo. Kuzothatha isikhathi ukuthola izindlela zokuheha abatshali bezimali nokudayisa kahle izwe lethu. Emazweni angaphandle uma ufika khona babuza ngesimo sezepolitiki esingesihle nenkohlakalo. Lezi ngezinye izinto ezixosha abatshali bezimali,” kusho uNksz Langeni. Yize ethe kuzothatha isikhathi ukulungisa isimo, uNksz Langeni uthe kukhona okuthembisayo osekwenzekile selokhu kuthathe umengameli omusha. Phakathi kwakho ubale ukuqokwa kukandunankulu omusha eNorth West emuva kwezinkinga nokungalawuleki kwesifundazwe. Unxuse osomabhizinisi ukuthi basizane nohulumeni ukushintsha isimo, wathembisa ukuthi bazohlangana nabo ezifundazweni zonke ukuzwa umbono wabo. Ugcizelele nokuthi balekelele ukudala amathuba omsebenzi ngoba uhulumeni ngeke akwazi eyedwa. UMnuz Bonang Mohale oyisikhulu seBLSA, uthe osomabhizinisi bahlalelwe wumsebenzi omkhulu wokubuyisa isithunzi sezwe. Uthe inkinga yamazwe ase-Afrika akukona ukuthi ahlwempu kodwa ukuthi awalawulwa ngendlela efanele. “Inkinga yisekutheni sikhetha abaholi abangafanelekile kodwa sinayo ingcebo. Umsebenzi esibhekene nawo manje wukubheka ukuthi silwa kanjani nokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana. Kumele sibheke nokuthi sizozinciphisa kanjani izindleko zikahulumeni nengqalasizinda ebizayo engadingeki,” kusho uMohale. Uthe osomabhizinisi kumele babe phambili ekusizeni umengameli emkhankasweni wokuthunywa. Njengoba bezohambela zonke izifundazwe bebonisana nosomabhizinisi, kumele basho ukuthi kungani bengafuni ukutshala izimali kuleli. Abanye osomabhizinisi izolo bakhale ngezinga lokwehla kwemfundo abathe linomthelela ekungaqashweni kwentsha.
OSOMABHIZINISI abanezinkontileka zokuqoqa udoti eThekwini basaphaze udoti emgwaqweni uM4 bekhala ngokungaholelwa. Isithombe: TUMI PAKKIES/ANA OSOMABHIZINISI abanezinkontileka zokuqoqa udoti eThekwini basaphaze udoti emgwaqweni uM4 bekhala ngokungaholelwa. Isithombe: TUMI PAKKIES/ANA Bavuke umbhejazane osomabhizinisi abanezinkontileka zokuqoqa udoti eThekwini bachitha udoti emgwaqweni uM4 edolobheni bekhala ngokungakhokhelwa. Baqale ngokuqoqana ngaphandle kwaseMoses Mabhida Stadium lapho bekulindeleke ukuthi imenenja kamasipala, uMnuz Sipho Nzuza, ibe khona ukuze bayinike uhlu lwezikhalo zabo njengoba bethi sekuyophela izinyanga ezintathu bengaholelwe. Umbhikisho ubuhlanganisa izinhlangano zosomabhizinisi ezehlukene okubalwa kuzo Isandlwana, Kojo, MKVA, Umlazi Business Forum neDelangokubona. Osomabhizinisi basuke eMoses Mabhida baya kobhikisha emgwaqweni uM4 basakaza udoti emgwaqweni. UMnuz Mandla Mhlongo, onguSihlalo weMlazi Business Forum, uthe sebesaba nokuphuma ezindlini zabo ngenxa yokwesaba abantu ababasebenzelayo ngoba sekuyophela izinyanga ezintathu bengabaholele wathi abakwazi ukuholela abasebenzi babo ngoba nabo abaholelwe. Uthe kuyabathusa ukuthi imenenja yedolobha ayifikanga ukuzozwa izikhalo zabo ngoba iMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, yayithe uma benezikhalo mabazisiye kwimenenja yedolobha. Omunye wosonkontileka obekhona uthe bazoya ezindaweni ezinemigwaqo emikhulu eThekwini bachithe udoti kuzona. “Ngeke siphinde siwuchithe udoti eMlaza sesizowuchitha edolobheni ngoba izikhalo zethu azizwakali uma udoti siwuchitha eMlaza. Sizoya naseMhlanga uma bengazilaleli izikhalo zethu." IPhini lenhloko yezokuxhumana eThekwini, uMnuz Mandla Nsele, lithe osonkontileka abane abengamele umsebenzi wokuqoqwa kukadoti abaqashwe ngumasipala bakhokhelwe. Uthe osonkontileka abancane abaqashwe abakhulu abangeni ngaphansi kukamasipala, banobudlelwane babo bodwa. UNsele uthe bayaxolisa ngokuphazamiseka okukhona ngenxa yokungaqoqwa kukadoti. “Kwezinye izindawo kunokuphazamiseka kokuqoqwa kukadoti okwenziwa uphiko lwangaphakathi. EMlaza awuqoqwa udoti ngenxa yesimo esingesihle esidalwa wukuthi abasebenzi bethu bavalelwa emahhovisi eGarden Refuse kwa-V. Enye iloli lethu lashaywa ngamatshe ngoJuni 12. Sibe nenkinga efanayo ezindaweni ezisenyakatho lapho abasebenzi bethu abathathu balimala besemsebenzini nezimoto zethu zashaywa ngamatshe,” kusho uNsele. Uthe ngokulekelelwa amaphoyisa akwaSAPS nawakwaMetro bazoqala ukuthutha udoti eMlaza wathi bacela imiphakathi ibambisane nabo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa akwaMetro, uSenior Superintendent Parboo Sewpersad, uthe kube nokuphazamiseka kokuhamba kwezimoto ngemuva kokuthi kusaphazwe udoti emgwaqweni kodwa bekunezinhlelo zokuthi kube khona abazowuqoqa.

Isithombe: Sigciniwe UMMANGALELWA ecaleni lokubulawa kwesitshudeni saseMangosuthu University of Technology uthi isibhamu abulala ngaso lesi sitshudeni kwakungesaso isitshudeni. UMnuz Thabani Mzolo ubhekene necala lokubulala uNksz Zolile Khumalo isidumbu sakhe esatholwa endaweni ehlala izitshudeni eLonsdale ngoMeyi 1 kulo nyaka. Ummangalelwa waboshwa esendaweni yesigameko, wagcinwa esitokisini njengoba enqatshelwe ibheyili. Inkantolo isola ukuthi ummangalelzwa wayecasulwe ukwaliwa njengoba kuvela ukuthi ubeke amsabise. UMzolo uveza ukuthi isibhamu esikamufi futhi phambilini umufi ubeke wamkhomba ngaso. Ufakazi kuleli cala uNksz Nosipho Bengu noMnuz Simiso Buthelezi abebesendlini ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sehlakalo, bathi ummangalelwa wakhipha isibhamu wadubula umufi. Ummangalelwa uyakugcizelela ukuthi wayengahlomile ngesikhathi engena endlini ngalobo busuku, uthi umufi wayehleli esihlalweni isibhamu esibeke phakathi kwamathanga akhe. Uthe kwakungasikhona okokuqala ebona umufi ephethe isibhamu. “Ngesikhathi ngibona isibhamu zimbili izinto ezafika emqondweni wami ngaphambi kokuthi kufike ukuthi ngizame ukumphuca sona,” kusho uMzolo. Uthe ubeseke wambona ephethe isibhamu esifanayo ngesikhathi beseMhlanga emzini kadokotela nomkakhe, okuyilapho ummangalelwa abejwayele ukuvakashela khona obekuthi uma laba bashadikazi bengekho umufi afike amvakashele. Ummangalelwa uthi ngesikhathi egijima ezilolonga khona eMhlanga, wabona owesifazane owayemi ngasesangweni lomuzi walapho yena owayevakashele khona, wamtshela ukuthi ufuna umsebenzi. “Ngamtshela ukuthi abanikazi bomuzi abekho ngase ngithi akashiye inombolo ukuze bamthinte uma kwenzeka bedinga isisebenzi sasendlini. Ngesikhathi ngizama ukufaka inamba yalona wesifazane kwiselula, ngabona uZolile (umufi) engikhombe ngesibhamu engisola ngokuthi ngimkhulelisile kodwa ngikhuluma nomuntu wesifazane phambi kwakhe,” kusho uMzolo. Uthe wagxuma wamphuca isibhamu. Uthe bese kungokwesibili ngesikhathi ebona umufi efake isithombe sakhe kwiWhatsApp ephethe isibhamu. Ngesikhathi umshushisi * -Advocate Nadira Moosa embuza ukuthi ngesikhathi ehlwitha umufi isibhamu eMhlanga sabe sinazo izinhlamvu? Ummangalelwa uthe sabe singenalutho. “Ngambuyisela ngoba kwabe kuyisibhamu sakhe. Impilo yabuyela esimeni esejwayelekile emuva kokuthi sesikhulumile ngokwenzekile,” kusho uMzolo. Uthe akazi noma umufi wayenayo yini imvume yokuphatha isibhamu? Umshushisi uthe akukho lula ukuthi umuntu abuyisele isibhamu kumuntu obezama ukumdubula. Icala liyaqhubeka.

Isithombe: Sithunyelwe UNKSZ Nompumelelo Shangase otholwe ebulewe esimobeni emzini wakhe eGqugquma, KwaSwayimane. Isithombe: Sithunyelwe ITHOLAKALE ibulewe yaphonswa esimobeni esiseduze kwasemzini wayo ingoduso ebihlale ihlukunyezwa umnyeni wayo. UNksz Nompumelelo Shangase (46) waseMontebello eNdwedwe ogane eGqugquma, KwaSwayimane utholakale ngeSonto eshonile esimobeni esiseduze komuzi wakhe engenalo inxeba kodwa evuvukele ebusweni, kubonakala sengathi ubeshaywa. Uyise kamufi, uMnuz Nicholas Shangase uthe, washayelwa ucingo umkhwenyana wakwakhe ngeSonto ekuseni ebuza ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ayikaze ifike yini kubo ngoba iduke ngayizolo? “Uthe ushiye amagwinya emafutheni waphuma akamazi ukuthi uyephi usebheke waze wadela, akamtholi. Akuphelanga isikhathi eside wasishayela, wathi utholakale esimobeni esisekupheleni kwegceke emzini wakubo abahlala kuwo,” kusho uShangase. Uthe bafike isidumbu singakathathwa babona ukuthi uma usegcekeni izinyawo zikamufi ziyabonakala emobeni neduku lakhe lasekhanda beliwele khona. “Iyangixaka le nto, kwenziwe yini ukuthi abasemzini womntanami bangamboni umuntu obesobala kangaka? Isidumbu sakhe kubonakala sengathi uqale washaywa, wase waklinywa futhi kubonakala sengathi uphonswe esimobeni eseshonile ngoba akukho okukhombisa ukuthi kuke kwashuduziswana.” Uthe indodakazi yakhe nyakenye ike yalimala kanzima ishaywe umkhwenyana wayo. “Ubehlale eshaywa nguye umyeni wakhe kodwa ebekezele. Incazelo engitshelwa yona ngabasemzini nayo ayingenelisi. Bathi wayepheke amagwinya ngoMgqibelo ebusuku waphuma, wangasho ukuthi uyaphi wangabe esabuya. Bathi akekho ayexabene naye futhi akuzange kube khona ukuhilizisana noma ukulwa nomkhwenyana wakhe. Kuyangixaka lokhu, umuntu onjani ongashiya ibhodwe linamagwinya angasho lutho kumuntu ahleli naye ekubeni amagwinywa kuyinto esheshe ivuthwe noma ngabe ubeya ethoyilethi? Nakuba engeke esavuka umntanami kodwa ngiyafisa ukwazi ukuthi ubulelwe ngubani?" kusho uShangase. UNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza, ukhathazekile ngokubulawa komunye umuntu wesifazane. Uqhube wathi: "Nakuba kungakatholakali ukuthi uNksz Shangase ubulewe ngubani kodwa siyazi ukuthi izigameko ezinjengalezi kujwayelekile ukuthi zenziwe ngabantu abasuke bethenjwa kakhulu ngabashonile. Siyethemba ukuthi amaphoyisa azombopha umenzi noma abenzi bokubi masinyane.” UCaptain Nqobile Gwala, okhulumela amaphoyisa, uthe amaphoyisa aseHarburg aphenya icala ngesidumbu sowesifazane esitholakale esimobeni kwaGqugquma, KwaSwayimane ngeSonto. Uthe kusolwa ukuthi lo wesifazane uklinyiwe wabulawa.

UTHUKUTHELE uyaveva uNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha nokuPhepha KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Ntuli, emuva kwesigameko sokubulawa kwephoyisa, elinye lalimala ngesikhathi kade eyofuna izigebengu ezithinteka emacaleni okubulawa kosomatekisi eNsuze. Amaphoyisa amabili asebenza ophikweni lwezobuNhloli KwaZulu-Natal, uwarrant officer no-captain, abelandela umkhondo ethungatha abantu abasembonini yama-metered taxis abathinteka emacaleni okubulawa kosomatekisi endaweni ngesikhathi edutshulwa kade elalelwe unyedle yiqulu labantu ebelihlomile. Isolezwe selibike kaningana mayelana nombango osudlule nemiphefumulo oqhubeka phakathi kwabantu bama-metered taxi nosomatekisi kule ndawo njengoba kubangwa indaba yokuthutha abagibeli. Uthe bayathemba ukuthi amaphoyisa azobabamba khona maduze abasolwa abathinteka kuleli cala lokuhlaselwa kwawo. UNtuli uthe sebejube ithimba elivela emnyangweni wakhe ukuba liyohlola isimo endaweni lenze nesiqiniseko sokuthi isimo sibuyiselwa kwesijwayelekile. Uthe sebeqinise namathimba abo amaphoyisa ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abasolwa abathinteka emacaleni okubulawa kwabantu eNsuze bayaboshwa. “Abantu ababulala amaphoyisa abanandawo emphakathini, siyayinxusa imiphakathi ukuba iwavikele amaphoyisa,” kusho uNtuli. Uthe ngeke baze baphumule abahlaseli bamaphoyisa bengakabanjwa. UNtuli uphinde wadlulisa namazwi enduduzo emndenini wephoyisa elishonile.

UMncwango, obhale nakuFacebook ngokwebiwa kwetekisi, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ibigcine ukubonakala ngezithuba zabo 12 ebusuku. Uthe yebiwe lapho kuhlala khona umshayeli wayo eMorningside. “Siyacabangela ukuthi yebiwe entathakusa ngoba umshayeli ubeyibonile isegcekeni ngabo 12 ebusuku. Sisizwe ukufaka udaba kuFacebook ukuze isheshe itholakale,” kuchaza yena. Uthe bathintwe ngowesilisa izolo obatshele ukuthi imoto uyibone ipake emagcekeni amanye amafulethi eNewlands. “Sithinte amaphoyisa siwatshela ukuthi imoto ibonakele eNewlands kodwa asichitha athi kungenzeka ukuthi siyaluthwa. Kudingeke siziyele mathupha sahlangana egaraji nowesifazane osikhombise lapho eyibone khona. Siyithole isicekelwe phansi bakhipha i-tracker,” kusho uMncwango. Uthe ngeke asho ukuthi kukhona abakusolayo ngokwebiwa kwale moto kodwa kungenzeka ukuthi ubugebengu obujwayelekile. Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi livuliwe icala lokwebiwa kwemoto kodwa yatholakala izolo.
BUKHETHIWE ubuholi engqungqutheleni ka-8th ye-ANC KwaZulu-Natal izolo ebiseDUT eThekwini. Kusuka kwesokudla nguSihlalo uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, iPhini lakhe uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhul, uNobhala uMnuz Mdumseni Ntuli, iPhini lakhe uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka noNkk Nomusa Dube Ncube onguMgcinimafa Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO BUKHETHIWE ubuholi engqungqutheleni ka-8th ye-ANC KwaZulu-Natal izolo ebiseDUT eThekwini. Kusuka kwesokudla nguSihlalo uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, iPhini lakhe uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhul, uNobhala uMnuz Mdumseni Ntuli, iPhini lakhe uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka noNkk Nomusa Dube Ncube onguMgcinimafa Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO UMENGAMELI we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa udonse ngendlebe amalungu enhlangano ngokuthi akalindele muntu ozogijima aye enkantolo eyophosela inselelo ingqungquthela nobuholi obusha KwaZulu-Natal. URamaphosa ubekhuluma emuva kokumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho lwezikhundla zobuholi obusha KwaZulu-Natal engqungqutheleni yesishiyagalombili ebihleli eDurban University of Technology izolo. Le ngqungquthela eke yaphonselwa inselelo enkantolo, iqale ngoLwesine yasongwa izolo. Amalungu enhlangano agijime aya eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ngoLwesine eyomisa ingqungquthela kodwa afike achithwa. URamaphosa utshele izithunywa ezingu-1 700 ukuthi kufanele kusetshenzelwe ubumbano hhayi ukuklwebhana futhi kuhlukanwe nezinkantolo. Uthe uyazi ukuthi kuningi ukungezwani enhlanganweni wathi kukhona ngisho abangakhulumisani nokuyinto athe kufanele iphele. Ebuholini obusha kwesikaSihlalo kukhethwe uMnuz Sihle Zikalala okhethwe ngaphandle kokuphikiswa, iPhini lakhe uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu othole amavoti angu-912 equmba phansi uMnuz Willies Mchunu (obuye abe nguNdunankulu wesifundazwe) ovotelwe abangu-816. KwesikaNobhala wesifundazwe ebesinombango obushisa phansi kunqobe uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli evotelwa abangu-951 ehlula uMnuz Super Zuma othole angu-701. KwesePhini likaNobhala kunqobe uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka oqumbe phansi uNkk Bongi- Sithole-Moloi (obuye abe nguNgqongqoshe wezobuCiko namaSiko) noMnuz Mluleki Ndobe (obuye abe yimeya yaseHarry Gwala) ngamavoti angu-834. EsikaMgcinimafa sibuyele kuNkk Nomusa Dube Ncube (obuye abe nguNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu) okhethwe ngaphandle kokuphoselwa inselelo. Okuqaphelekile ukuthi i-ANCYL esifundazweni ibe nezwi ekukhethweni kwabanye abaholi okunguHlomuka kwesePhini likaNobhala noNtuli kwesikaNobhala njengoba bebephakanyiswe yilo lolu phiko. Belilokhu lubelesele ukuthi kudingeka ushintsho kungene abantu abasha ezikhundleni kuxutshwe. Usihlalo omusha uZikakala naye uhambe emazwini kaRamaphosa wathi sekuyisikhathi sokulwela ubumbano. “Asizele ubuqembuqembu nezikhundla la, kufanele sazi ukuthi ukhetho luyinqubo yentando yeningi nje kuphela. “Akekho umuntu ohluliwe nonqobile kodwa kunqobe i-ANC,’’ kusho uZikalala. Khonamanjalo i-ANC eGauteng ikhethe ubuholi engqungqutheleni yayo ebise-Irene, eTshwane. KwesikaSihlalo kubuyiselwe uNdunankulu wakulesi sifundazwe uMnuz David Makhura. IPhini lakhe kwaba uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi, uNobhala kwaba nguMnuz Jacob Khawe, iPhini likaNobhala kwaba nguNkk Nomantu Nkomo-Ralehoko, kwathi uMgcinimafa kwaba nguMnuz Parks Tau.
Amalungu e-ANC abegxoba itoyitoyi eMargate Hotel lapho bekuhlangene khona abathi azingahlali izingqungquthela ze-ANC zingakalungiswa izinkinga Isithombe:GCINA NDWALANE Amalungu e-ANC abegxoba itoyitoyi eMargate Hotel lapho bekuhlangene khona abathi azingahlali izingqungquthela ze-ANC zingakalungiswa izinkinga Isithombe:GCINA NDWALANE ASABISA ngokuya enkantolo amalungu e-ANC KwaZulu-Natal angahambisani nokuthi kuhlale izingqungquthela zezifunda neyesifundazwe. Esithangamini nabezindaba eMargate Hotel ngasePort Shepstone izolo, uMnuz Howard Msomi ongunobhala kwisifunda esincane se-ANC eMzumbe, uthe bazoyilandela yonke imigudu yangaphakathi enhlanganweni lapho bezobe bezwakalisa izikhalo zabo ngokuhlala kwezingqungquthela kodwa uma bengakutholi ukujabula bazophoqeleka ukuthi baye enkantolo. UMsomi uthe kunezifunda ezine iLower South Coast, Moses Mabhida, Harry Gwala nabaQulusi ezinezinkinga okungamele izingqungquthela kuzo ziqhubeke. “Thina sithi izingqungquthela akumele zihlale ngoba isimo esikhona ezifundeni asikho kahle, sifuna kuxazululwe zonke izinkinga ezikhona ngaphambi kokuthi kuhlale izingqungquthela,” kusho uMsomi. Uthe banezikhalo ezaziwayo asebezidlulisile zokunqatshelwa kwamaqabane ubulungu benhlangano nokukhishwa kwamanye amalungu emiqulwini yamalungu. UMsomi uthe bayaphikisana nalokho okushiwo yisigungu esiphezulu senhlangano ebhekelele ukusebenza kwansukuzonke iNational Working Committe (NWC) ukuthi amagatsha esifundazwe asekulungele ukuhlalisa izingqungquthela. I-NWC ihambele izifunda zezifundazwe yathola ukuthi eziningi zazo sezikulungele ukusingatha izingqungquthela ngaphandle kwezintathu iLower South Coast, Moses Mabhida neHarry Gwala. UMnuz Siyabonga Hlongwa onguNobhala wegatsha le-ANC eMoses Mabhida uthe abakwazi ukuthi bangaya ezingqungqutheleni kusabulawa abaholi benhlangano. “Sikhuluma nje sihlangane lapha eLower South Coast sekubulewe abaholi ababili benhlangano, lokho kunika isithombe sokuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ngaleyo ndlela akukuhle ukuthi kungahlala izingqungquthela,” kusho uHlongwa. UMnuz Bheki Nzimande oyilungu lesigungu esihola iHarry Gwala ukuchithile ukuthi baphakamisa ukuthi izingqungquthela zingahlali ngoba besaba izimbangi zabo ukuthi zizobathela ngehlazo. “Asesabi ukuya ezingqungqutheleni kodwa sithi sifuna kuyiwe enkundleni ziyozwana amandla sekuxazululwe zonke izinkinga, ngeke siye ezingqungqutheleni zezifunda namagatsha antshontshiwe,” kusho uNzimande. UMNUZ Howard Msomi waseMzumbe ekhulumela amalungu e-ANC athi azingahlali izingqungquthela zingakalungiswa izinkinga Uthe esifundeni sabo iHarry Gwala kunemihlangano yamagatsha ebihlaliswa ngoSihlalo be-ANCYL emagatsheni aseThekwini okuyinto ephambene nomthethosisekelo. “Kukhona futhi eminye imihlangano yamagatsha ebihlaliswa ngosihlalo benhlangano yosomatekisi iSouth African National Taxi Council (Santaco),” kusho uNzimande. UMnuz Sifiso Dlamini waseThekwini uthe izimbangi zabo kumele zingakhohlwa ukuthi bazifaka enkantolo mayelana nomphumela wengqungquthela yesifundazwe ka-2015. “Kumele basilalele, uma bengafuni sizohlangana nabo enkantolo,” kusho uDlamini. Ingqungquthela yokuqala yezifunda yokulungiselela ingqungquthela yesifundazwe isihlalile esifundeni iGreater KwaDukuza. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uMxhumanisi we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, uthe sekumi ngumumo ngamalungiselelo ezingqungquthela ezine okumele zihlale kule mpelasonto. UZikalala uthe bazozihlalisa izingqungquthela eyaseMalahleni, Far North, Nkosi Bhambatha naseMusa Dladla ukuze kukhethwe ubuholi obusha. “Zonke izinhlelo zokulungiselela lezi zingqungquthela zihambe kahle futhi sinethemba lokuthi zonke izingqungquthela zizoqhubeka njengoba kuhleliwe,” kusho uZikalala.
ABAHOLI bezenkolo basabisa ngokuthi bazonxenxa amalungu amabandla abo ukuthi angayivoteli i-ANC okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo uma kuze kufika isikhathi sokhetho umhlaba ungakabuyiselwa kubanikazi bawo. Isithombe: Nhlanhla Phillips/African News Agency/ANA ABAHOLI bezenkolo basabisa ngokuthi bazonxenxa amalungu amabandla abo ukuthi angayivoteli i-ANC okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo uma kuze kufika isikhathi sokhetho umhlaba ungakabuyiselwa kubanikazi bawo. Isithombe: Nhlanhla Phillips/African News Agency/ANA Esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo, uMbhishobhi Bheki Ngcobo webandla laseZayoni oyingxenye yabaholi bezenkolo nosomabhizinisi abaseka lowo obengumengameli wakuleli uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uthe sebethathe isinqumo esithi alikho ivoti eliya kuKhongolose uma umhlaba ungakabuyiswa. “Kuzomele futhi ubuholi be-ANC obukhona buyeke ukuhlukumeza uZuma bulokhu bumkhandela amacala ngoba indlela yokunqoba ukhetho incike kuyena uZuma,” kusho uNgcobo. Uthe bazoqhubeka nokumeseka uZuma kuze kufike ekugcineni. “UZuma uyena kuphela umuntu obezokwazi ukuxazulula indaba yomhlaba njengoba esekhishiwe esikhundleni mancane amathuba okuthi umhlaba ubuye,” kusho uNgcobo. Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi bethula izinhlelo zabo mayelana namalungiselelo omlindelo kaZuma njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo ngoLwesihlanu ngamacala enkohlakalo athinta udaba lokuthengwa kwezikhali. Ebuza ukuthi bayithathaphi imali yokuqhuba imikhankaso yokweseka uZuma, uNgcobo uthe bacela kosomabhizinisi baphinde basebenzise izinsiza zamabandla abo. “Asizuzi lutho ngokweseka uZuma lokhu esikwenzayo sikwenza ngoba simthanda,” kusho uNgcobo. Umkhulumeli weMKMVA kuzwelonke, uMnuz Carl Niehaus, uthe amalungu omakadebona boMkhonto weSizwe azophuma ngobuningi bawo ezokwesaka uZuma owayenguKhomanda weMK. Uthe uzoza ecaleni likaZuma efake umfaniswano we-ANC. “Ubuholi besigungu esiphezulu senhlangano bashaya isikhala ngokuthi buthi akuvunyelwe ukugqoka izikibha zenhlangano emibuthanweni yokuseka uZuma esenkantolo,” kusho uNiehaus. Umholi weBLF, uMnuz Andile Mngxitama, uthe uZuma ushushiswa ngoba nakho elwela abantu abampofu. “SiyiBLF sithi akayekwe phansi uZuma akuboshwe owayengumengameli wakuleli ngesikhathi sobandlululo uMnuz FW de Klerk ngamacala okuhlukumeza abantu,” kusho uMngxitama. UMnuz Nkosentsha Shezi weNafupa SA uthe bathenjiswa ukuthi izwe lizophumelela kwezomnotho uma kuphuma uZuma kodwa isimo siba sibi kakhulu kunakuqala. Uthe kusukela ephumile uZuma abantu sebekhokha intela ephezulu. Induna yamabutho uMnuz Innocent Mkhize uthe nabo bazobe bekhona bezoseka uZuma ngoba uyingxenye yamabutho. Uthe imvume yokweseka uZuma abazange bayithole koNgangezwe lakhe kodwa bameseka ngoba nakhu eyingxenye yamabutho. Umlindelo uzoqalwa ngokuthi kube nojenga lwezimoto ngoLwesine emini bese kuthi ntambama kube nomlindelo ozoqala ngehora lesithupha ntambama uphele ngehora lesithupha ekuseni ngoLwesihlanu. NgoLwesihlanu kuzoba nemashi ezosuka kuBotha iphele enkantolo.
U-Ajay no-Atul Gupta File. Isithombe: Independent Media U-Ajay no-Atul Gupta File. Isithombe: Independent Media ZINGAPHEZU kuka-12 izikhulu eziqaphe izinto kuhulumeni nalabo ababheke ukugcinwa komthetho abazungeza izinkampani nosomabhizinisi abasebenzisana nomndeni wakwaGupta kufunwa uR50 billion owaluthwa ezinkampanini zikahulumeni. I-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA), Asset Forfeiture Unit (AFU), Specialised Commercial Crime Unit, aboMnyango weziMali, iFinancial Intelligence Centre, iCompanies and Intellectual Property Commission noKlebe bayasebenzisana kulo mzamo. Inhloko esabambile ye-AFU, u-Adv Knox Molelle, ithe basathumela amasamanisi kwabakwaGupta ophenyweni olusaqhubeka ngalabo abathinteka embikweni woMvikeli woMphakathi wokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. UMolelle uthe i-AFU ibheka amacala awu-17 kodwa ayisithupha asefakwe enkantolo. “Siyathemba sizothola incwadi yasenkantolo emasontweni ambalwa ezayo ezosigunyaza ukuthi sishaqe impahla. Kuseyisiqalo lesi,” kusho uMolelle. Uthe uyathemba ukuthi imali eningi izotholakala kungakapheli unyaka wezimali olandelayo. Sebethole incwadi ebagunyaza ukuthi bashaqe impahla ka-R1.6 billion ezinkampanini ezisebenzisana nomndeni wakwaGupta, iMcKinsey neTrillian. U-Adv Malini Govender oyiNhloko yeNPA Specialised Crime Unit (SCCU) uthe baqale ukucubungula ubufakazi ngonyaka odlule nethimba labantu abaningi abakwiNPA, SCCU, aboMnyango wezeziMali, AFU nabanye. Uthe baphenya izihloko eziyisikhombisa ezivela embikweni wokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana, olulodwa oluthinta i-Estina, inkampani ehlanganiswa nomdeni wakwaGupta eFree State. Umkhulumeli weMcKinsey ozinze e-United Kingdom, uMnuz Steve John, uthe bayayemukela yonke imizamo ezobasiza ukuthi bakhokhe imali ngoba kade bezama ukuyikhokha kusukela ngo-Okthoba.
KUBHALWE emehlweni ukukhathazeka kubantu baseDududu abaxakwe yizingulube zehlathi njengoba uMnuz Leonard Nzimande oyisakhamuzi echaza isimo abangaphansi kwaso kule ndawo Izithombe : NQOBILE MBONAMBI KUBHALWE emehlweni ukukhathazeka kubantu baseDududu abaxakwe yizingulube zehlathi njengoba uMnuz Leonard Nzimande oyisakhamuzi echaza isimo abangaphansi kwaso kule ndawo Izithombe : NQOBILE MBONAMBI UHLELI lubhojozi umphakathi waseNgodini, eDududu, ngenxa yezingulube zehlathi okuthiwa ziyacanasa kule ndawo ziqeda ukudla emasimini zibhincisele nxanye nabantu bale ndawo. Leli phephandaba linikele kule ndawo ngenhloso yokuzwa usizi lwabantu bakhona asebehlala ngokwethuka izanya ngenxa yalezi zilwane eziyingozi. Izakhamizi zale ndawo zithi azisakwazi ukudla okulinywa emakhaya njengoba lezi zingulube zishaya ziqothule emasimini. Kuthiwa ziphuma zibe wumhlambi ebusuku ikakhulukazi uma imvula ina zicanase naphakathi kwezindlu zifuna ukudla. UMnuz Joseph “Ngculaza” Gumede uthe yena ulima udedangendlale wensimu athembele kuyo ukuze aphile kodwa useze wayeka ngenxa yokulimela izingulube. "Mina bengivuka ebusuku ngo-2 ngilime insimu yami enkulu ngoba yiyona engondlayo. Zivele zifike zimbe ngaphansi kocingo zingene zishaye zivale zishiye kube ngathi kade kushanelwa ensimini," kusho uGumede ngokukhathazeka. Esinye isakhamuzi uMnuz Leonard Nzimande uthe naye usesimeni esifanayo wathi kukhona nekhehla lendawo elihola impesheni eselihamba lixhuga emuva kokuhlaselwa yingulube yamlimaza emlenzeni. UMnuz Pius Lukhozi naye oyisakhamuzi kule ndawo uthe yena seyake yamgagazisa ingulube eya ekhweni lakhe ewela umfula yathushuka khona. Okhulumela iKZN Wildlife KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Musa Mtambo uthe bake bathintwa ngenkinga yezingulube endaweni esogwini olusenhla nesifundazwe bazama ukuyisukumela. "Sike saya ngomunye unyaka sazidubula izingulube kodwa kwakusewuhlelo nje lokuhlola ukuthi luyasebenza yini, sathi sizwa futhi zabe sezibuyile. Ngeke sikwazi ukuyozidubula kodwa singathumela umuntu ayofundisa umphakathi kabanzi ngazo," kusho uMtambo. INduna yesinye sezigodi kule ndawo uMnuz Thulisani Madiba uthe indodana yakhe isike yanqwamana mahlanze nenye yezingulube yamkhombisa naye, ukhale ngokuthi zinkulu kakhulu futhi ziyalwa kunzima ukuyibulala. "Sidinga usizo lwabantu abanamathuluzi afanele okubulala lezi zilwane ngoba ziyingozi ngeke sizame thina ukuzibulala. Ziningi zihamba ziyinqwaba zibe yishumi nangaphezulu ziyaqhubeka ziyazalana futhi. Sesabela nempilo yethu asisakwazi nokulima sisaphumi ebusuku emagcekeni kunzima," kubalisa uMnuz Madiba.
KUKHALWA nxazonke ngokubulawa kukaNksz Cacisile Gumede obesebenza emtholampilo eCato Ridge, odutshulwe wabulawa umakhi, naye obuye wazidubula washona KUKHALWA nxazonke ngokubulawa kukaNksz Cacisile Gumede obesebenza emtholampilo eCato Ridge, odutshulwe wabulawa umakhi, naye obuye wazidubula washona KUKHALWA nxazonke ngowesifazane waseCato Ridge okusolwa ukuthi udutshulwe wabulawa umakhi bebanga imali abeyikweleta. UNksz Cacisile Gumede (34), obengumabhalane eMsunduzi Clinic, eCato Ridge ophinde abe yilungu lesigungu esiphezulu egatsheni le-ANC kuwadi 1 kule ndawo, kusolwa ukuthi udutshulwe nguMnuz Sdu Sitole, odabuka eMozambique obemakhela indlu, ngoMgqibelo, ebusuku. USitole umangaze umphakathi ngesikhathi ezingqokloza ngesibhamu kubuka umphakathi emarobhothini kwaV, eMlaza, ngesonto ekuseni. Kuthiwa kutholakale imali, egcwele igazi isaphazeke emzini kaNksz Gumede. UNksz Gumede ochazwa ngozakwabo emtholampilo njengomuntu obewuthanda umsebenzi wakhe, ezithobile obekulula ukusebenza naye kodwa obengenqeni ukukukhalima uma ebona ukuthi usuphume endleleni. UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kulesi sifundazwe uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo uthe: “Lesi sigameko senzeka ngesikhathi uNdunankulu wesifundazwe sethu, uMnuz Willies Mchunu eseqale umkhankaso wokuthi kube nemikhuleko, yokukhulekela isihlava semikhuba emibi eyenzeka esifundazweni sethu. Njengoba kuyinyanga yamadoda kunesidingo esikhulu sokuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa nokunqanda izenzo zokuhlukumeza ezenziwa ngamadoda kwabesifazane. Sizwelana kakhulu nomndeni ngalesi sigameko,” UMnuz Sihle Zikalala ilungu lobuholi besikhashana be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uthe uNksz Gumede ubewuthanda umsebenzi wakhe we-ANC futhi ubekuqonda ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukusebenzela ukwenza ngcono impilo yabantu. “Besisalindele lukhulu kuNksz Gumede, sisebenza kanzima ekwenzeni isiqiniseko sokuthi sakha abaholi bakusasa, okulindeleke ukuthi ababambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni isizwe sethu. Siyakholwa ukuthi amaphoyisa azokwenza umsebenzi wawo. Sinxusa nomphakathi ukuthi ubambe iqhaza emkhankasweni wokunqandwa kwezigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane kulesi sifundazwe,” kusho yena. FUNDA: Kusolwa isikweletu ngozingqokloze eMlaza UDkt Dhlomo kulindeleke ukuthi ayohlanganisa amehlo nomndeni kaNksz Gumede namhlanje. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe uLt Col Thulani Zwane uthe amaphoyisa asesiteshini samaphoyisa eMsunduzi aphenya icala lokubulawa kowesifazane oneminyaka ewu-34 odutshulwe wabulawa, ekhaya lakhe ,kaMhali, ngakolunye uhlangothi awaseMlaza avule idokodo lophenyo ngokuzibulala kukaSitole. “Kusolwa ukuthi owesilisa ozidubule emarobhothini kwaV, eMlaza uyathinteka kulesi gameko,” kusho uZwane.
ISITHOMBE ESIGCINIWE: LEBOHANG MASHILOANE ISITHOMBE ESIGCINIWE: LEBOHANG MASHILOANE IDINGA ukubukwa ngeso elibanzi indaba yenqubomgomo ehlongozwa wuMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, okuhloswe ngayo ukufundisa abafundi abenza uGrade 3 kuya kaGrade 5 ngokukhishwa kwezisu kwabakhulelwe bengahlosile nokuvikela ukukhulelwa, ngokuthi badle amaphilisi athile emuva kokuya ocansini. Inzima le nkinga ebhekene nohulumeni. Kuthiwa babalelwa ku-15 000 ezweni abafundi abakhulelwe. Isikhathi uhulumeni asinikeze umphakathi ukuba uphawule, sincane. Kuthiwe ukuphawula kuzophela ekupheleni kwezayo. Indaba yokukhulelwa kwabafundi kangaka ezweni elidume ngokuba neningi elingamakholwa, isho lukhulu. Sibona ukuthi bekuzoba ngcono ukube uhulumeni usungule ithimba elimukela izincomo ngokuthi kwenziweni, kunokuthi aqale ngokwenza ezakhe izincomo umphakathi ungakasho lutho. Siyayidinga inqubomgomo esuselwe ebantwini emazingeni aphansi futhi kungabi nohlangothi oluzibona lubukelwe phansi ekubunjweni kwayo. UMntwana waKwaPhindangene, ongumholi we-IFP, wake wathi abanye abaholi ababesethimbeni elabumba inqubomgomo sekukhululeke izwe, bathi uma bebuka emuva, bangayikholwa eminye yemithetho eshaywe yibona uqobo. Kungenzeke yini namanje kuphinde leso? Sekukhona abathi kuhamba phambili abaziyo ukuthi izingane zabo azithinteki lapho.

UNKK Patricia de Lille ngesikhathi epakisha okungokwakhe ehhovisini leMeya eKapa okuyisikhundla asule kuso ngeledlule. Isithombe: Ayanda Ndmane/African News Agency UNKK Patricia de Lille ngesikhathi epakisha okungokwakhe ehhovisini leMeya eKapa okuyisikhundla asule kuso ngeledlule. Isithombe: Ayanda Ndmane/African News Agency ANGASE asungule iqembu lakhe lezepolitiki uNkk Patricia De Lille osule kwiDA ngesonto eledlule ngesikhathi esephuma esikhundleni sakhe sokuba yiMeya kaMasipala waseCape Town. UNkk De Lille uthe uzocacisa kuleli sonto ngezinhlelo zekusasa lakhe kodwa kunamahlebezi aqinile okuthi uzosungula iqembu lakhe namakhansela asule kwiDA ngesonto eledlule. Ngesikhathi esula kwiDA, uNkk De Lille uthe uzizwa ekhululekile kwingcindezelo akade engaphansi kwayo ngoba ubengakwazi ukusiza abantu ngempilo engcono. “Ngikhululekile ekugcineni, indlela engizizwa ngayo ifana naleya yokuvota okokuqala ngo-1994 emuva kokuthi sithole inkululeko. Bengingakwazi ukuletha impilo engcono kubantu ngenxa yobandlululo oludla lubi kwiDA. Baningi abathi angizongena emaqenjini abo epolitiki kodwa ngisazocabanga kahle ngekusasa lami. Sisabonisana namakhansela asulile ukuthi sizokwenzenjani,” kusho uNkk De Lille. UMnuz Shaun August obewuSotswebhu kuMasipala waseCape Town uthe yena namakhansela asulile bayabonisana ngekusasa labo futhi baxoxisana nabantu abaningi. “Sixoxa nabaxhasi, abaholi bomphakathi nabo bonke abantu baseCape Town ngezinto ezahlukene ngoba asikazi okwamanje noma sizosungula inhlangano yepolitiki noma sizokwenzani. Engingakusho nje wukuthi iDA isakhathalele abamhlophe kakhulu ngoba abantu baseGugulethu, Khayelitsha naseMitchells Plain abanakiwe,” kusho * -August. Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki uMnuz Thabani Khumalo uthe uNkk De Lille angase avuse i-Independent Democrats okuzokwenza kube nokwehlukana kwezepolitiki ngoba inhlangano yakhe izobonakala njengekhaya lamaKhaladi okusho ukuthi kuzohamba abantu abaningi akade sebevotela iDA. “UNkk De Lille uyathandwa wumphakathi wamaKhaladi azibona sengathi awanakiwe, ngimbona ewushisa umbango eWestern Cape. I-DA ngeke inqobe ngamavoti amaningi. Emuva kokhetho luka-2019 kungase kube nohulumeni wokubambisana engingazi-ke ukuthi uzoholwa yiDA noma yi-ANC kodwa engingakuqinisekisa wukuthi uNkk De Lille uyobe ekhona uma eseneqembu lepolitiki,” kusho uKhumalo.
KUSUKE umsindo phakathi kwamakhansela e-ANC neDA emhlanganweni we-Exco eThekwini izolo mayelana nohambo lukaR2 million oluya emadolobheni amabili aseSouth America, lwezikhulu ophikweni lwezokuthutha kumasipala, osomatekisi nabanikazi bamabhasi. Ithimba labantu abangu-54, elisuka eThekwini, lizoya eSao Paulo eBrazil naseBogota eColombia liyofunda kabanzi ngohlelo lokuphucula ezokuthutha olwaziwa ngeGo Durban. Usuku lohambo lusazohlelwa. Amakhansela eDA ashaya amakhala athi inkulu le mali ezokhishwa wumkhandlu ngalolu hambo. Usihlalo wekhokhasi yeDA eThekwini, uNkk Nicole Graham, uthe bona abahambisani nalolu hambo ngoba luzomosha imali. UNkk Graham uthe uphiko lwezokuthutha eMkhandlwini weTheku ludume kabi ngokuqhuba izinhlelo ezingaphumeleli. “Lolu phiko ayikho futhi into olwake lwayiqala lwayiqeda,” kusho uNkk Graham. Elinye ikhansela leDA, uMnuz Heinz de Boer, lithe noma ngabe kuthiwa le mali ivela kuphi kodwa ngeyabakhokhi bentela. “Kumele kube khona indlela okuzokwenziwa ngayo ukuze kuncishiswe le mali. Abantu abangu-54 baningi kakhulu kungakuhle isibalo sabantu abahambayo sincishiswe,” kusho uDe Boer. Uthe uhulumeni we-ANC uhlala ukhuluma ngokuthi usezinhlelweni zokonga imali kodwa eThekwini iyaxhashazwa. Nomholi wekhokhasi ye-IFP, uMnuz Mdu Nkosi, uhambe emazwini kaDe Boer wathi kumele sincishiswe isibalo sabahambayo. USotswebhu wamakhansela e-ANC eThekwini, uNkk Nelly Nyaniso, uthe bayalweseka lolu hambo ngoba lubalulekile. “Imboni yamatekisi yilona lodwa ibhizinisi labamnyama abazibambele kulona mathupha futhi abaziqalela lona. Leli bhizinisi libambe iqhaza elikhulu emnothweni wezwe. Ngalezo zizathu-ke asisoze sayeka ukuleseka,” kusho uNkk Nyaniso. USomlomo eMkhandlwini weTheku, uMnuz William Mapena, uthe imali ezosetshenziswa iphuma esikhwameni esifanele. UMgcinimafa eThekwini, uMnuz Krish Kumar, uthe uphiko lwabo lwezokuthutha kumele luze kwi-Exco luzocacisa kabanzi ngohlelo lwalo. Uthe uhambo lubalulekile ngoba amazwe avakashelwayo analo uhlelo olufana nolweGo Durban abafuna ukuluqala.
UMnuz Simingaye Oscar Hlatshwayo wadutshulwa wabulawa ehamba ngale moto eMnambithi UMnuz Simingaye Oscar Hlatshwayo wadutshulwa wabulawa ehamba ngale moto eMnambithi ISIKHULU sikamasipala esidutshulwe sabulawa sihamba ngemoto yaso edolobheni eMnambithi, kuthiwa siyalele abasibhekele imfuyo yaso ukuthi bayifake kahle uphawu ukuze umndeni waso ungahlupheki uma kwenzeka sishona. UMnuz Simingaye Oscar Hlatshwayo (38) obeyi-Excutive Director oPhikweni loKwakhiwa kweNgqalasizinda kuMasipala i-Alfred Duma, kuthiwa bekungakapheli isikhathi eside eyalele omunye wabangani bakhe ukuthi enze isiqiniseko sokuthi imfuyo yakhe inophawu. Umfowabo, uMnuz Sizwe Hlatshwayo abehlala naye, uthe umfowabo ubengakukhonzile ukukhuluma, ubethula noma kukhona into emphethe kabi kodwa uzwe kuthiwa ubeke wayaleza ukuthi imfuyo yakhe ayiphawulwe kahle. “Umfowethu bekungumuntu ozithandela umsebenzi, uma kunento emphethe kabi ubethula nayo, ubeze akhulume uma kunomsebenzi okumele umenzele wona. Sithemba ukuthi amaphoyisa azoqhamuka nomkhondo ngoba okwamanje sisadidekile, akukho esikwaziyo,” kusho yena. USELUDLULISELE phambili udaba lokudilizelwa isitolo sakhe usomabhizinisi waseNtuzuma, amaphoyisa akwaMasipala weTheku athi besingekho emthethweni Isithombe:SITHUNYELWE USELUDLULISELE phambili udaba lokudilizelwa isitolo sakhe usomabhizinisi waseNtuzuma, amaphoyisa akwaMasipala weTheku athi besingekho emthethweni Isithombe:SITHUNYELWE LUYASHUBA udaba lukasomabhizinisi waseNtuzuma odilizelwe isitolo ngabasebenzi bakaMasipala weTheku namaphoyisa awo ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule, osethole ummeli ozolungisa udaba lwakhe, wavula necala. UMnuz Nduduzo Magwaza (37) obengumnikazi weYoung Minds Tuck Shop, usamile ekutheni isitolo sakhe besisebenza ngokusemthethweni kodwa yilungu elithize lomphakathi elibikele uMasipala amanga ngaye. UMagwaza ubesedayise iminyaka engu-11 kulesi sitolo esiyikhonteyna. Uthe ufuna umasipala umbuyisele endaweni yakhe futhi umkhokhele nezimpahla ezicekelwe phansi ngesikhathi edilizelwa isitolo. Kuthiwa abasebenzi bakaMasipala namaphoyisa baklabhe ikhonteyna emuva kokuba kukhishwe incwadi yesexwayiso yokuthi uMagwaza kumele ayisuse. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuMasipala uSuperintendent Parboo Sewpersad, uthe isitolo sikaMagwaza besingabekiwe endaweni efanele ngoba besiphazamisa nokuhamba kwezimoto nomphakathi. FUNDA: Usola umona odilizelwe isitolo “Ubesexwayisiwe ukuthi akayisuse ikhonteyna kodwa wangakwenza lokho. Sithole izikhalo zokuthi kuyagcwala kakhulu esitolo sakhe, kuphuzwe notshwala futhi sinama-video awubufakazi. Kusolwa nokuthi kusetshenziswa nezidakamizwa futhi umnikazi wesitolo ubechitha ngisho indle kuyona le ndawo. Sinqume ukuthi sithumele amaphoyisa ngoba uMagwaza ubengasilalelanga isexwayiso,” kusho uSewpersad. Uveze nokuthi sebeyazi ngecala elivulelwe amaphoyisa kamasipala, athe lingamanga futhi bazolilandela. “Wanikwa isexwayiso esanele kodwa wakhombisa ukudelela umthetho ngoba esekwa yikhansela elihlangene naye. Useke wahlawuliswa uR4 300 ngenxa yokuphula umthetho nokungabi nayo imvume. Kumele aye eNkantolo eNtuzuma ngoDisemba 7 ukuyokhuluma ngendaba yenhlawulo. Sithole nokuthi incwadi ayisayinise umphakathi uthathe nabantu abangahlali kuleya ndawo,” kusho yena. Mayelana nezinsolo zezidakamizwa nokugcwala ngaphandle kwesitolo uMagwaza uthe akukho okubi obekwenziwa. “Kuyo uyonke indawo enesitolo kujwayele ukugcwala abantu ngaphandle, obekuyizingane ezingomakhelwane. Kule ndawo kudonsa noWiFi yamahhala obekwenza ukuthi abantu bagcwale bezosebenzisa yona. Abefika kaningi amaphoyisa nekhansela bezosesha kodwa bathole ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle,” kuchaza uMagwaza. UMnuz Thomas Ntshangase oyikhansela uthe naye umangele ukuthi kungani sidiliziwe isitolo ngoba konke bekuhamba kahle.

AKUGCWALI ngisho isigubhu samanzi uma kukhiwa emfuleni osekuthembelwe kuwo emphakathini wakwaLembe, uNkk Nokuthula Mdlalose othathwe econgolozela Isithombe:SITHUNYELWE AKUGCWALI ngisho isigubhu samanzi uma kukhiwa emfuleni osekuthembelwe kuwo emphakathini wakwaLembe, uNkk Nokuthula Mdlalose othathwe econgolozela Isithombe:SITHUNYELWE BAKHALA ngezimoto zamanzi okuphela amasonto zingafiki emphakathini wakwaLembe ngaphansi kukaMasipala uMdoni, okuthiwa umphakathi usukha emfuleni oshiswe yisomiso. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kusukela ngoJuni inkinga yamanzi ibisivele iqalile kule ndawo, obuthembela ezimotweni ezilethwa wuMasipala Ugu. UNkk Nokuthula Mdlalose oyilungu lomphakathi, uthe selokhu kwathi nhlo bakha emfuleni iMandlalathi. Uthe inkinga yamanzi iqale ngesikhathi kusha umfula, okudalwe yisomiso. “Izimoto zikamasipala bezisilethela amathangi amanzi kube ngconywana. Inkinga manje sekuphela amasonto noma inyanga izimoto zingafiki. Kumanje sagcina ngenyanga edlule ukulethelwa amanzi. Uma sishaya ucingo siwacela, sitshelwa ukuthi kunenkinga yokushoda kwezimoto kumasipala,” kuchaza yena. Uthe sebesaba nokuthi bazogula ngoba akuphephile ukusebenzisa amanzi kulo mfula. UNkk Mdlalose uthe uma bezosebenzisa amanzi bayawabilisa. “Okuyinkinga kakhulu ukuwasha ngawo ngoba izimpahla ziyagqwala. Kuba ngcono uma kufike imoto yamanzi ngoba siyacabangelana. Siye sihlukaniselane izigubhu ngasikhombisa emzini ngamunye,” echaza. UMnuz Zakhele Hlongwa oyikhansela, uthe ibaxakile impela inkinga yamanzi futhi ingaphezu kwamandla. Uvumile ukuthi uma izimoto zingafikanga, umphakathi awunalo elinye isu lokuthola amanzi. “Ngicabanga ukuthi izimoto zamanzi zagcina ukufika emasontweni amabili edlule kuleya ndawo. Nokho kuyenzeka kuphele ngisho inyanga zingafikanga. Sithole ukuthi kunenkinga yokushoda kwezimoto kuMasipala Ugu,” kusho uHlongwa. Uthe wahlangana nezikhulu zikamasipala ukudlulisa izikhalo. Uveze ukuthi nomphakathi bawuchazelile inkinga ababhekene nayo. UHlongwa uthe sebefake isicelo sokuthi umphakathi ufakelwe ompompi kodwa angazi ukuthi kuzokwenzeka nini ngoba umasipala ukhale ngezinkinga zemali. Uthe kuba ngcono uma linile ngoba umphakathi ukhongozela amanzi emvuleni. Okhulumela uMasipala Ugu uMnuz Frans Nzama, uthe kubekwe ikomiti okuyilona elilawula indaba yokulethwa kwamanzi. Uthe ngenxa yokuthi ziningi izindawo eziswele amanzi, izimoto azikwazi ukufika nsuku zonke kodwa ziyawaletha amanzi. UNzama uthe kunohlelo olubhalwe phansi okuyilona olulawula ukuthi izimoto ziwayise kuphi amanzi.
