Siyazi ukuthi uCele akamusha kulo mkhakha. Useke wasebenza njengokhomishana, isipiliyoni sakhe asithola ngokudlula sizomsiza ukungena athi khaxa asebenze kushunqe uthuli. “Okukuqala okufanele akwenze wukudiliza inqwaba yezikhulu kuzwelonke nasezifundazweni, aphinde aqinisekise ukuthi anele amaphoyisa eziteshini,’’ kusho uMamabolo Akumangazi ukubonakala kwezithombe zikaCele nama-video edansa abantu bejabuliswa yisinqumo sikaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa. Eqokwe ngayizolo uCele, ufike lazwakala izwi lakhe njengoba ekade ehambele inkonzo yesikhumbuzo samaphoyisa aseNgcobo. “Akumele nife niphethe izibhamu,” waphinde watshela amaphoyisa la mazwi ake wawasho phambilini ukuthi amaphoyisa kumele ashaye enyameni kwizigilamkhuba. I-DA ikhuze umhlolo ngokubuyiswa kukaCele yathi kuyichilo eliphindiwe. UMnuz Zakhele Mbhele obhekele ezamaphoyisa uthe akasiboni isidingo sokubuyiswa kukaCele emaphoyiseni. “Kuyethusa ukuthi umuntu owake watshela amaphoyisa ukuthi awadubule enyameni ezigebengwini usebuyisiwe. Sihlala sigcizelela ukuthi umbutho wamaphoyisa udinga ukuphathwa abantu abafanele,’’ kusho uMbhele. Kunenkolelo yokuthi uCele uyaziswacisa izigebengu ngamazwi nangemiyalelo ayinika amaphoyisa. Nokho akhona amaphutha nogcobho ababonwa yilabo abangaphakathi emaphoyiseni, abakholwa wukuthi umuntu okulesi sikhundla kumele kube wumuntu osemnkantshubomvu emaphoyiseni. Kwamanye amaphutha akhonjwa kuCele, kubalwa udaba okukholakala ukuthi lwamxoshisa ekubeni wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, kubalwa udaba lokuthengwa kwesakhiwo samaphoyisa, nalapho owayenguMvikeli woMphakathi, * -Advocate Thuli Madonsela athi ingcabha yayikuCele ngalolu daba. Okunye okumdalele amazinyo abushelelezi yizinkulumo zakhe. Kuzona kubalwa ayenza ngesikhathi kuphenywa kabanzi icala lokubulawa kuka-Annie Dewani nokwakusolwa umyeni wakhe uShrien ngokumbulalela kuleli. Lolu daba lwagcina ukunakwa kusekhona uCele ngemuva kwalokho kwathuleka ngalo kwagcinwa kuboshwe uXoli Mngeni noMziwadoda Qwabe kwathi owayesolwa phambili uDewani waphunyula. UCele wabiza umsolwa ngenkawu esuke ezweni layo yazogila ubugebengu lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu akwehlanga kahle kwabaningi. Kwaphoqa ukuthi agcine ehlele ngezansi axolise ngenkulumo yakhe. Enye inkulumo ngeyokugqugquzela amaphoyisa ukuba adubule ashaye enyameni ezigebengwini, abuze emva kwendaba. Olunye udaba kube ngolombutho owaziwa ngeleTRT (amabherete) ake asolwa ngobuge-bengu nokungaziphathi kahle. Indlela abesebenza ngayo ibishiya imibuzo nezinsolo zokunga-hambisi kahle. Ubudle-lwano obuqinile phakathi kukaCele bubonakale ngisho esephumile esikhundle-ni sokuba ngukhomi-shana njengoba ake wakho-mbisa ukuweseka amanye awo ngesikhathi evela eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini eyoqula icala. Lokhu kukhombise ngokusobala ukuthi nakuba kwake kwakhona umsindo wokuthi akakaze abe yiphoyisa njengoba aye ngumkhuzi wawo, kodwa ukusebenza ngokuzimisela nokuba ngumuntu okwazi ukuxhu-mana nalo mbutho, kwenze waba ngumuntu ogcina ethenjwa yiwo. Phezu kwakho konke lokhu iningi labantu lithi uCele ubenza okufanele futhi unguMesiya ozokhipha umphakathi wakuleli ebugqileni obudalwa wukudlanga kobugebengu. Ubufakazi wukuthi ngesikhathi engukhomishana wamaphoyisa wenze umphakathi waphila ngokuphepha ngenxa yokuthi ubugebengu bubonakale behla. UCele waziwa ngokuzibambela mathupha efika endaweni yesigameko azibophezele ekuxazululeni inkinga nokuhambela imiphakathi abheke ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ebhekene nazo. Nakuba nabanye bekwenza kodwa okukaCele kuyadlulela nokungenye yezinto emenze wathandwa ngabantu. Akekho ongakhohlwa ukuthi uCele uphinde abe nendaba nendlela amaphoyisa abukeka ngayo. Lokhu kubonakale ngesikhathi egqugquzela ukuthi awajime futhi akhece imikhaba, kugqame isifuba. Phakathi kobugebengu obebudla lubi kulezi zinsuku kubalwa ukuqolwa kwezimoto ezithwala imali. Nakuba kungakapheli ngisho isonto kodwa uCele usephawulile ngalokhu wathi ngesikhathi sakhe waqeda ngalolu hlobo lobugebengu. Uthe uzibophezele ukuqeda nya ngabo nangobunye obuphilisa lubhojozi umphakathi. Ukubuya kwakhe azohlenga isizwe yinto osekunesikhathi ikhaleleka. Lokhu kubonakale ngemikhankaso ethi #BringBhekiCele ne-#BringNdosiBack ebishisa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Kwayena ubelibeka ngembaba elokuthi uyakhumbula futhi usawulobizela lo msebenzi. Ngamanye amazwi inkulumo ayenza emngcwabeni wowayengumsakazi uNat “Cool Kat” Gumbi, lapho athi ukhathele wukujahana namaklabishi, ufuna ukujaha izigebengu, lifezekile.
URULANI Mokwena oyiphini lomqeqeshi kwi-Orlando Pirates uveze ukuthi ziningi izinguquko ezizoba khona eqenjini ngesizini ezayo Isithombe: BACKPAGEPIX URULANI Mokwena oyiphini lomqeqeshi kwi-Orlando Pirates uveze ukuthi ziningi izinguquko ezizoba khona eqenjini ngesizini ezayo Isithombe: BACKPAGEPIX IPHINI lomqeqeshi we-Orlando Pirates, uRulani Mokwena, liqininisekisa eyezinguquko ezinqala ezizokwenzeka eqenjini ngaphambi kokuqala kwesizini ka-2018/2019. IPirates iqede isizini ka-2017/2018 isendaweni yesibili kwi-log ye-Absa Premiership. Icindeze ompetha iMamelodi Sundowns kwaze kwaba sekugcineni. Ithimba labaqeqeshi bePirates belizivalele esifubeni izifiso zalo ngoba belilokhu lithi lisazama ukwakha iqembu. Umqeqeshi, uMilutin “Micho”Sredojevic, uphumele obala sekuzophela isizini ngokuthi iqembu lesifinyelele ezingeni lokunqoba izindebe ngoba sebesakhile isisekelo esiqinile. EZimnyama zizohambisana neSundowns emqhudelwaneni iCAF Champions League ngesizini ezayo. UMokwena uthe zinkulu izinguquko ezizokwenzeka ngaphambi kokuthatha inyathuko yeCAF. Kunenqwaba yabadlali asebevele bakhonjwa kwiPirates okukhona kubo uLinda Mntambo, no-Abel Mabaso abebekwiChippa United. UMeshack Maphangule weBlack Leopards kuthiwa usevumelene nePirates. Kubadlali okuthiwa bayashiya kukhona uThamsanqa Gabuza, Ayanda Gcaba, Thamsanqa Sangweni nabanye. “Isikwati sizoqina kakhulu. Sizoligcina iningi labadlali kodwa sizoqina kakhulu ngesizini ezayo. IChampions League iyeza ngakho kufanele sengeze abadlali, sithole nabanye abasezingeni eliphezulu. Sidinga ukwengeza okungenani zonke izindawo. Nasethimbeni labaqeqeshi kuzoba khona izinguquko,” kusho uMokwena. Maphakathi nesizini kusabalale amahlebezi okuthi uSimo Dladla, umqeqeshi weKings yaKwaZulu-Natal edlala kwiNational First Division (NFD), uzojoyina ithimba labaqeqeshi kwiPirates. Kumanje iphini lesibili likaMicho nguBenson Mhlongo owayengumdlali wePirates. Abadlali bePirates abebekade beqokelwe imiklomelo yePremie Soccer League (PSL) babuye belambatha. U-Innocent Maela ukhale ngaphansi kuSiyanda Xulu kowe-Absa Premiership Defender of The Season, kwathi uMusa Nyatama wahlulwa nguSiphesihle Ndlovu weMaritzburg United kowe-Absa Premiership Midfielder of The Season. UMicho ubengakufihlanga ukuthi uNyatama uyena okufanele akhale emuke nomklomelo womdlali ovelele, i-PSL Footballer of The Season, ogcine ugoduke noPercy Tau weSundowns. “Okubalulekile wukuqokwa kule miklomelo. Kodwa-ke abantu okubafanele ukuwina bawinile. Lokhu kuzosigqugquzela ukuthi sisebenze kanzima,” kuphetha uMokwena.
ISIMISIWE emsebenzini iMenenja kamasipala waseJozini ngemuva kokukhala kwamakhansela ngo-R11 million osebenze kwakhiwa umgwaqo oyikhilomitha elilodwa eMkhuze nezigidi ezintathu zokulungisa amahhovisi omkhandlu. UMnuz Kuhle Khumalo umiswe ngoMsombuluko ebusuku ngo-9 ngemuva komhlangano wamakhansela obusemini. Umiswa nje bese kuqalwe uphenyo olwenziwa yiMunicipal Public Account Committee (MPAC) oluqalwe ngesonto eledlule. UKhumalo utshele Isolezwe izolo ukuthi akukho okuningi azokusho ngoba usaxhumana nabameli bakhe. “Ngithole i-SMS ngo-9 ebusuku ngoMsombuluko ebingazisa ukuthi sengimisiwe emsebenzini ngakho ngizocela imibuzo uyibhekise kwimeya ngoba mina ngimatasa ngixhumana nabameli bami ngalesi simo,” kusho uKhumalo. Ngesonto eledlule Isolezwe libike ngenkombankombane yaseJozini ephakathi kwamakhansela noKhumalo ngokusebenza kwezigidi zabakhokhi bentela. Amakhansela kaKhongolose nawe-IFP abeshaya amakhala ngemali yokwakha umgwaqo waseMkhuze abasola ukuthi imali yasetshenziswa budedengu. Amakhansela abuye asole uKhumalo ngokuthi “wadla” u-R3 million wokwakha amahhovisi kamasipala. Kuthiwa wanikeza usonkontileka imali umsebenzi ungakakhangiswa. Kuthe uma umsebenzi sekufanele uqale kwavela ukuthi usonkontileka akasakwazi ukuqhubeka ngoba imali idliwe uSars. UKhumalo ngakolunye uhlangothi uyacacisa ukuthi isinqumo sokwakha umgwaqo ngo-R11 million sathathwa emhlanganweni womkhandlu owawungomhla ka-12 Meyi 2017 lapho iMeya, uDelani Mabika, yasayina ukuba kwengezwe u-R3 million ku-R8 million okwakufanele wakhe umgwaqo. UKhumalo usola ukuthi umiselwe ukulwa nenkohlakalo eJozini. FUNDA: Umsindo ngekhilomitha lomgwaqo elibize uR11 million Uveze ngesonto eledlule ukuthi wavula icala koKlebe ukuze baphenye amanye amakhansela ngokunyamalala kuka-R5 million okwakuhlelwe ukuba kwakhiwe izakhiwo ezithile zomphakathi. Le mali kuthiwa yasayinelwa njengesebenzile kodwa izakhiwo azikaze zibe khona. IMeya yaseJozini uMnuz Delani Mabika ithintwa iqale yaba namancoko yathi ivukwa wumoya ngalolu daba. “Ngicela ungithinte emuva kwemizuzwana ngoba ngibheke eHluhluwe emhlanganweni ophuthumayo. Uma ungangithintanga kuqala nami ngizobuyela kuwe,” kusho uMabika. Kuthe ngemuva kwemizuzwana abeyibekile wathintwa kodwa ucingo lwakhe belumatasa. Ngemuva kwalokho beseluvaliwe kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engatholakali. Kwenzeka lokhu nje Isolezwe lithunyelwe umyalezo okhomba ukuthi ubuvela kuKhumalo ewuthumele kubaholi abathile bezombusazwe ebalisa ngesimo abhekene naso. Umyalezo uKhumalo uyawuphika uthi akawazi futhi akekho umholi amthumelele. Kulo myalezo kubhalwe ukuthi: “Laba bantu bafuna ukungimisa emsebenzini bangesulela ngezinto engingazazi. Bagxambukela nasemsebenzini wami. Bafuna kubenabasebenzi engibaxoshayo noma ngibehlise ezikhundleni ukuze kungene abafunwa yibo.”UKhumalo uthe akawazi lo myalezo kanti uqale ukusabalala emasontweni amabili edlule.
JACOB ZUMA JACOB ZUMA ISINQUMO sakamuva senhloko yeNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA) uMnuz Shaun Abrahams sokuvusa amacala angu 16 abhekiswe kulowo obengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma sesisuse inkulumo mpikiswano. Phakathi kwemibuzo evukayo yilena: Kungani u-Abrahams ethathe lesi sinqumo? Kungani isinqumo esifana nalesi sithathwe uZuma esanda kushiya ekubeni ngumengameli wezwe? Sisho ukuthini lesi sinqumo? Ukuphendula umbuzo wokuqala, omunye uzothi u-Abrahams wenza ubulungiswa. Abanalombono bawubheka njengokhombisa ukuzimisela ngomsebenzi wakhe. Kimina zimbili izizathu ezenze u-Abrahams wathatha lesi sinqumo. Esokuqala yingcindezi akade ebhekene nayo esuka emaqenjini aphikisayo, amalungu e-ANC nezakhamuzi zezwe, nalabo abazimisele ngokubethela isipikili sokugcina kuZuma. Isizathu sesibili ukuthi kwayena u-Abrahams uhleli ngesinqe esisodwa njengoba isikhundla sakhe sizulelwa ngamanqe. Ngaleyo ndlela uzama ukuzivikela yena uqobo. Maqondana nombuzo wesibili kunabazothi kuqondene nokuthi ubufakazi okade bufunwa buvele ngesikhathi uZuma esezophuma esihlalweni kanti vele iNPA isizokhipha isinqumo sayo. Kungenzeka kube khona okubambekayo kulo mbono. Ngokubona kwami isizathu esimqoka ukuthi kunababona ukuthi njengoba uZuma engaseyena umengameli we-ANC nowezwe, amandla akhe asemancane. Okwesibili ukuthi abantu abaningi ababehambisana noZuma ngo 2007-2009 manje bacula elinye iculo. Okwesithathu, u-Abrahams nabanye bayamesaba uRamaphosa kanti futhi abanye bezama ukuthi abethembe. Umbuzo wesithathu yiwona engizogxila kuwo. Ukubuyiswa noma ukuvuswa kwalamacala kusho izinto eziningi. Phakathi kokunye singabala lokhu okulandelayo: -Ukusebenza ngokungenzeleli kwengalo yomthetho; -Ukukhombisa ukuthi ingalo yomthetho yinde; -Ukulalela izimvo zabantu; -Yimiphumela yokusebenza kwamaqembu aphikisayo ephalamende, ikakhulu i-DA; -Ukunikeza uMnu. Zuma ithuba lokuhlanza igama lakhe; -Ukucindezela uZuma nokumlulaza esizweni nakumazwe omhlaba; -Ukuqeda ukuqagela ngokuthi ingabe lezi zinsolo ziyiqiniso yini noma cha. Kuyiqiniso elingephikwe ukuthi zonke lezi zizathu zinakho okuphathekayo. Kodwa ngizozigoqa ngezimpendulo ezimbili. Eyokuqala ukuthi lokhu kusho injabulo kulabo okukade babefuna ukuthi uZuma ashushiswe, hhayi ngoba befuna kwenzeke ubulungiswa kodwa ukuze kufezeke izinhloso zabo zepolitiki. Okwesibili, lokhu kusho ukudumala nokucasuka kulabo abezwelana noZuma obelokhu elandelwe ngabezindaba. Kulabo abajabulayo, kungenzeka ukuthi basheshe bahleka kwasho ingoma kaDonny. Amalungiselelo alokhu kushushiswa azothatha isikhathi eside. Kwalona icala liyodonsa iminyaka. Kulabo abahambisana noZuma, sekucacile ukuthi ukugwema inkantolo ngalolu daba akusekho. Kodwa-ke lokho akusho ukuthi impi iphelile. Eqinisweni uZuma udinga uxhaso kakhulu manje kunango 2007-2009 ngoba usephendukelwe ngisho ngamanye amalungu eqembu lakhe - osomathuba! Mangigcine ngokusho ukuthi ubulungiswa ekuqulweni kwaleli cala yikhona okuzosho ukuthi isimo siyazinza yini ezweni noma kusuka uthuli lwezichwe. Ngamafuphi, ijaji elizosingatha lolu daba kanye nabasizi balo kuzodingeka kube ngabantu abawazi kahle umsebenzi wabo nabangathengeki kalula. Ofakazi kuzodingeka kube ngabantu abayaziyo into abayikhulumayo. Kuyoba kuhle uma kwenziwa ubulungiswa ngaleli cala. Kodwa uma kudlalwa ipolitiki, kuyoba yihlazo kubona bonke abathintekayo kuloludaba. *USolwazi Bheki R. Mngomezulu usophikweni lwezifundo zepolitiki e-University of Western Cape.
ZIFINYELELE kwangqingetshe izingxoxo zamaholo kwa-Eskom njengoba izinyunyana zicele ukuthi kungenelele uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali. Isithome: Ian Landsberg/African News Agency (ANA) ZIFINYELELE kwangqingetshe izingxoxo zamaholo kwa-Eskom njengoba izinyunyana zicele ukuthi kungenelele uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali. Isithome: Ian Landsberg/African News Agency (ANA) ZIFINYELELE kwangqingetshe izingxoxo zamaholo kwa-Eskom njengoba izinyunyana zicele ukuthi kungenelele uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Nhlanhla Nene nebhodi lakwa-Eskom ezingxoxweni zamaholo. Izolo iNational Union of Mineworkers (NUM), iNational Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa) neSolidarity ithe ngeke ikwazi ukuphawula kabanzi ngesiphakamiso sakamuva se-Eskom ngoba izingxoxo zisesigabeni esibucayi. UMnuz Livhuwani Mammburu, okhulumela iNUM kuzwelonke, uthe: “Izingxoxo zamaholo zisesigabeni esibucayi. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi izinyunyana zicele umhlangano noNgqongqoshe wezeziMali kodwa besingakaziswa ukuthi uzoba nini. Asikwazi ukukhuluma nabezindaba okwamanje.”Uthe bazoxoxisana namalungu abo ngesikhathi besalinde umhlangano noNene ngoba yiwona amalungu okufanele asho ukuthi ayasamukela isiphakamiso noma afuna uchatha. “Izinyunyana zithemba ukuthi umhlangano noNene uzozisiza ukuthi zifinyelele esivumelwaneni ne-Eskom. Okwamanje zizoxoxisana nabasebenzi ukuzwa uvo lwabo,” kusho uMammburu. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi i-Eskom ibibeke phansi u-7% ngoLwesibili kanti izinyunyana sezifuna u-8%. Ekuqaleni kwesiteleka izinyunyana bezifuna abasebenzi banyuselwe amaholo ngo-15%, kube nesibonelelo sezindlu sika-R2 000, kumiswe ama-labour brokers nokuthi kuqashwe ngokuphelele onogada. Bebefuna nokuthi bakhokhelwe izinyanga eziyisithupha uma bethatha ikhefu lokubeletha nabesilisa bathathe inyanga eyodwa ezokhokhelwa uma abalingani babo besanda kubeletha.
BAPHILA ngokubamba amatoho abafundi osekuphele iminyaka emine belinde imiphumela yabo yezivivinyo zika-matric. Abafundi baseMashiyamahle High eNdwedwe bathi abanalo igugu lemiphumela yokuchibiyela kwabo kwango-2015, umnyango oyikhiphe ngoMsombuluko ngoba sebelahlekelwe yisikhathi esiningi lolu daba lusenkantolo. Bathi imiphumela yabo bafisa ukuyithola kummeli wabo okunguye abamqoka ukuthi abamele kulolu daba hhayi emnyangweni. UMthobisi Ntetha (23) uthe ubhuquza ekhaya ngemuva kokulahlekelwa umsebenzi wokuwasha izimoto eVerulam abewenza nyakenye. Uthe akakayi kobheka le miphumela okuthiwa abayilande ngoba ngokwazi kwakhe akuyona le abayifunayo. “Thina saya enkantolo ngoba singagculisekile ngokuthi umnyango usola ukuthi sakopela kodwa abukho ubufakazi obubambekayo. Esakuzwa ukuthi umnyango wathi washayelwa ucingo watshelwa ukuthi sikopelile. Sasifuna ukuthi inkantolo iphoqe umnyango ukuthi usinike leyo miphumela, le abayikhiphayo yokuchibiyela ilungile ngoba isinika ithuba elingcono lokuzikhethela kodwa akuyona le ebesiyilwela yonke le minyaka emine, yingakho ngingayanga koyilanda,” kusho uNtetha. Uthe ukungayitholi imiphumela yakhe kumenze walahlekelwa yisikhathi sakhe okungabe wasisebenzisa wayofundela i-Electrical Engineering ayezimisele ukuyifunda. “Njengamanje nginengane engingakwazi ukuyondla ngendlela ngoba imisebenzi eminingi ifuna umuntu ono-matric mina anginawo. Angikwazi nokuqhubeka ngiyofunda ngoba kufuneka sona isitifiketi sakwa-matric noma imiphumela, anginako kokubili,” kusho uNtetha. UBhekani Ngcobo (24), naye obeselinde imiphumela iminyaka emine, uthe uzwile ngaleyo miphumela kodwa akayilandanga ngoba akuyona abeyilindele. UNgcobo uthe ugcine esephoqeleka ukuthi afundele ukuthunga okuyinto abengayithandi ngoba ubengenabo ubufakazi bokuthi wawufunda u-matric. “Ngangifuna ukwenza iHuman Resource Management kodwa angikwazanga ngenxa yemiphumela yami eyabanjwa ngo-2014. Kubuhlungu okwenzeka kithi ngoba ababefunda ngemuva kwethu bayaqeda ukufunda emanyuvesi, ngisho nabaselamayo nabo abafunda kuso lesi sikole ngemuva kwethu ababanga nankinga, thina sibambekile kuthiwa sakopela kodwa abukho ubufakazi esitshelwa bona bokuthi sakopela,” kusho yena. UNtetha noNgcobo bangabanye ababafundi baka-matric ngo-2014 ababanjelwa imiphumelaya yabo. Uthishanhloko walesi sikole, uMnuz Zacharia Ntanzi, wamiswa kulesi sikole ngo-Agasti esolwa ngokugovuza abafundi abase bevala amasango ezikole zakule ndawo ngawo * -Agasti. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, ukuvumile ukuthi uNtanzi washintshelwa kwesinye isikole ngempoqo njengoba umnyango usaqhubeka nokumphenya ngezinsolo zokuthi wasiza abafundi ukuthi bakopele.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa eKZN uLt-General Khombinkosi Jula (kwesokunxele), uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuThutha, ukuPhepha nokuXhumanisa uMphakathi uMnuz Bheki Ntuli nenhloko yomnyango uMnuz Themba Mavundla esithangamini ebekwethulwa kuso izinhlelo zokuphepha ngamaholidi kaKhisimusi Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa eKZN uLt-General Khombinkosi Jula (kwesokunxele), uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuThutha, ukuPhepha nokuXhumanisa uMphakathi uMnuz Bheki Ntuli nenhloko yomnyango uMnuz Themba Mavundla esithangamini ebekwethulwa kuso izinhlelo zokuphepha ngamaholidi kaKhisimusi Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE UNGQONGQOSHE wezokuThutha, ukuPhepha nokuXhumanisa uMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Ntuli uthi kuzobe kuqhaqhazela utsotsi ngendlela ezizobe ziqiniswe ngayo ezokuphepha KwaZulu-Natal ngala maholidi kaKhisimusi. Ukusho lokhu emhlanganweni obuyizolo ejele iWestville obekubhungwa ngamasu okuqinisa ezokuphepha ngesikhathi samaholidi kaKhisimusi futhi kwethulwa nesiqubulo esizobe sisetsheniswa esithi: Repositioning KwaZulu-Natal as a Zero Tolerance province. UNtuli uthe bajube amaphoyisa ukuthi avale zonke izindawo ezidayisa utshwala ezingekho emthethweni futhi kuhlolwe nalezo ezinamalayisensi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zihweba ngendlela esemthethweni. “Kuyasikhathaza ukwanda kwezindawo zokucima ukoma ikakhulukazi lezo ezivulwa eduze kwezikole nasemasontweni. Siyajabula ukusho ukuthi abeLicence Liquor Board sebenalo uhlu lwawo wonke ama-tarven aseduze kwezikole namasonto. Okunye okukhathazayo wukuthi izigameko eziningi zobugebengu zenzeka ebusuku nangezimpelasonto. Abantu banesibindi esixakile futhi abanendaba nempilo yomunye umuntu okuyinto ephambene noMthethosisekelo wezwe,” kusho uNtuli. UNtuli ufuna amaphoyisa avale nemibhiyozo yabafundi abaqeda ukubhala izivivinyo eyaziwa ngama-pens down ngoba uma ingaqashiwe kugcina sekubulawa abantu iningi labo elisuke ligwaziwe. “Siyakhathaza isibalo esiphezulu sokubulawa kwabantu emalokishini ngakho kumele kube khona okwenziwayo ngokushesha. Eminyakeni embalwa edlule iziteshi zethu zamaphoyisa bezilokhu zizihola phezulu ohlwini lukazwelonke. Inanda, KwaMashu, eMlaza nePlessislair ezinye zazo. Asiwasusile amehlo ethu emahostela aseThekwini ikakhlukazi iGlebelands naKwaMashu. Sizophinde siqinise ezokuphepha eMthunzini, eMpangeni, Pinetown naseHillcrest enezigameko eziningi zokugqekezwa kwemizi, kuphangwe amabhizinisi nokudunwa kwezimoto,” kusho uNtuli. Bekukhona noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLt-General Khombinkosi Jula nenhloko yomnyango kaNtuli uMnuz Themba Mavundla. UNtuli uthe kuyaziwa ngalesi sikhathi sonyaka ukuthi KwaZulu-Natal samukela izinkumbi zabavakashi ngakho izinhlaka zezomthetho kumele zisebenze ngokubambisana ukulwa nobugebengu nezingozi zomgwaqo eKZN. “Ubugebengu nezingozi zomgwaqo kumele sikuthathe njengesitha sethu okumele silwe naso ngokubambisana. Inkinga yezokuphepha emiphakathini nasemigwaqweni iletha inselelo edinga ukuba siphendule isimo esibhekene naso njengamanje,” kusho uNtuli. Unxenxe abezomthetho ukuba benze umsebenzi wabo ngobuqotho futhi banikele isikhathi sabo ekwenzeni umsebenzi wokuvikela umphakathi. Uthe bahlele izivimbamgwaqo ezibalelwa ku-2 040 KwaZulu-Natal njengoba bezojuba inhlanganisela yamaphoyisa angu-24 325 azoqinisa ezokuphepha ngesikhathi samaholidi okuphela konyaka nangemumva kwawo.

Angihambisani nesiphakamiso seCOSAS sokuziphindisela kodwa ngicabanga ukuthi kuzomele ilekelele abazali ekuvuleni amacala ezinkantolo nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abenzi bokubi bayaboshwa. Ngisuswa wudaba olwaphuma kwiSolezwe langomhla ka-29 June 2018 lapho kwavela udaba lomfundi (9) waseMfume ofunda esikoleni iBaniyena Primary School olaliswe esibhedlela eyohlinzwa isandla ngenxa yokulinyazwa uthisha ngoba wayedlala eshaya amafoli, kwathinteka isicabha sekotishi likathisha. Wubulwane njena lobu mawulandela kahle isizathu sokushaywa kwezingane. Okufike kucike wukuhudula izinyawo kwamaphoyisa ekebopheni uthisha ebe eshaye ingane wayilimaza emini kabha bese beloku bethi basaphenya. Baphenya ini ngoba izingane zashaywa. Lingathanda kanjani lona lelo phoyisa eliphenyayo uma ingane yalo ibuye esikoleni seyiphuke ithambo lesandla sekumele iyohlinzwa ngoba ishayelwe ukudlala kwathinteka isicabha sekotishi likathisha? Ungathola ukuthi lelo phoyisa eliwumphenyi yilona eseliphenduke umxhumanisi linxenxa umzali ukuthi asule icala ngoba selifunjathisiwe. Benze njalo siyabazi. Singajabula iphepha lethu esilithembayo lisazise ngokuthi sekuhambe kwafikaphi ngalolu daba. Ngeke sikubekezelele ukubunjwa kwesizwe esinodlame okwenziwa othisha abamnyama ezinganeni ezimnyama. Ingane ekhule ngesihluku senduku nayo uma seyikhulile yenza loko emndenini wayo noma ebantwini bangaphandle. Bhekani Ngwane
UMFUNDISI uKing Prophet Saziso Ndwandwe ekakwe yizingoduso zakhe ezilamanayo okunguTho (wengubo eluhlaza) noNondu Mdluli Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE UMFUNDISI uKing Prophet Saziso Ndwandwe ekakwe yizingoduso zakhe ezilamanayo okunguTho (wengubo eluhlaza) noNondu Mdluli Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE SEKUPHINDE kwaqubuka umsindo ebandleni lomfundisi waKwaNongoma, uKing Prophet Saziso Ndwandwe, iHealing Hour Emmanuel Prophetic Global Ministry ngemuva kokulobola ngosuku olulodwa izelamani zakwaMdluli eBhambayi eNanda. Ngokusho komthombo ongaphakathi egatsheni laleli bandla elikhonzela enkabeni yedolobha laseThekwini, kunabazalwane abangayizwa indaba yakhe yokuqonywa yizelamani uNondu noTho. Umthombo uthe uNdwandwe (36), obuye asakaze kwiNanda 84.0 FM ngamaSonto, waqala wathandana noNondu baze batholisana ingane. “Bahlukana noNondu engakabelethi. Uthe esuka wayegxumela kudadewabo omncane (uTho) wamphuca ubuntombi bakhe. Uthe esethi uyomlobola, abakubo kwakhe bathi akasale esebathatha kanyekanye noNondu. Yingakho-ke ephoqeleka ukuthi abalobole kanyekanye ngoR8 000 (okusho ukuthi uR4 000 umuntu ngamunye),” kusho umthombo. Uqhuba uthe okucasule abanye abazalwane futhi abaze bambizela emhlanganweni uNdwandwe ukuthi kunohide lwamantombazane obekwaziwa ukuthi ujola nawo futhi awathembise umshado. “Umfundisi useyaganga ngempela ngoba kunentombazane esimbekezelele kakhulu uSne Mgobhozi, sonke ebesesazi ukuthi uzoyithatha. Kunenye futhi eneminyaka engu-18 esisanda kuzwa ukuthi uyigqekeze wayishiya. Kukhona nenye efunda eMangosuthu University of Technology kodwa edabuka KwaHlabisa nayo ayigqekezile,” kuphetha lo mthombo. Enye yala mantombazane okuthiwa uyigqekezile, iziqinisekisile lezi zinkulumo kwiSolezwe ngoMgqibelo. Kodwa icele ukungagagulwa ngoba yesabela ukuthi unina usayazi iyintombi. “Umfundisi wakhuluma nomama ukuthi ufuna ukungenza enye yamakhosikazi akhe kodwa umama wanqaba. “Ngelinye ilanga sagcina silalile naye umfundisi kodwa ngathi angifuni ukushada ngoba ngisafuna ukuqhuba izifundo zami,” kusho le ntokazi eno-18. USne uvumile ukuthi uyathandana nomfundisi kodwa wenqaba ukuphawula ukuthi kumphathe kanjani ukulobola kwakhe izelamani. Imizamo yokuthola izelamani noNdwandwe ayiphumelelanga futhi kwahluleka ngisho sebethunyelelwa nemiyalezo. UNdwandwe uthe okwamanje ngeke akwazi ukuphawula kahle ngalolu daba ngoba kukhona okusamenze wamatasa, kodwa uzobuye akhulume naleli phephandaba. Phambilini watshela leli phephandaba ukuthi unoxhaxha lwezintombi enkonzweni ayiholayo. Wathi uyakholelwa kakhulu esithenjini, nasekuqonyweni futhi uyakholelwa kukhona. Wathi zonke izintombi namakhosikazi akhe, ubaboniswa wuNkulunkulu. Ngo-2005 washadelwa nguVelile uMaDladla kwathi ngonyaka olandelayo walandelisa ngoThando uMaNgcobo ngaphambi kokubalamanisa ngezingoduso okungoNksz Ntombifuthi Mfekayi (24) waseMtubatuba, uNksz Sinothile Ntshangase (24) waseNewcastle noNonhle Ntuli (22) waKwaNongoma. Wathi akagcinile kodwa usazokwengeza ngabanye ababili ukuze agcine enesithembu samakhosikazi ayisikhombisa, ngokomyalelo kaNkulunkulu. Wathi yena wasindiswa ngo-2007 futhi unamandla alingana nawomsunguli webandla lakwaShembe, uMqaliwendlela. UNdwandwe uqale ukuzakhela udumo ngokuzishaya isifuba ngokuthi welapha isandulela-ngculazi futhi atholele abantu imisebenzi ngamatshe.

UMHOLI we-IFP iNkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi. Isithombe esigciniwe: Motshwari Mofokeng African News Agency (ANA) UMHOLI we-IFP iNkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi. Isithombe esigciniwe: Motshwari Mofokeng African News Agency (ANA) MHLELI: Ngizwakalisa umuzwa wami ngengqungquthela ye-IFP KZN ebisoLundi ngempelasonto mhla ka-29 Juni. Ngiyilungu le-IFP ebeliyingxenye yengqungquthela futhi ebelinelungelo lokuvota. Ngizwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngenkulumo kaMnuz Xolani Dube ongumhlaziyi wezepolitiki, ayisho ohlelweni lwezindaba kuKhozi FM ngoJulayi 1. UDube uthe uMnuz AT Ntuli ukhonjiwe nekomiti akhethwe nalo. Lapho umhlaziyi ubekhomba ngenjumbane umholi wethu, uMntwana waKwaPhindangene ukuthi ukhombe uNtuli ukuthi abe ngusihlalo waseKZN. UNtuli uphakanyiswe amaziko ukuba angenele ukhetho. UMntwana uyilungu le-IFP elivela ezikweni, kuyilungelo lakhe ukuba nombono njengoba nomthethosisekelo weqembu lethu usho njalo. Ngiyazi uDube akawazi umthethosisekelo wethu. Kuyakhathaza okwenziwa uDube ukuthi njalo bahlasela uMntwana ngokuthi akahambisani nentando yeningi. UDube uze wabala nabaholi abaningi athi sebahamba eNkatheni ngenxa kaShenge. Ihlaya nje ubala ubaba uJiyane. UJiyane wazesulela eqenjini, izwe liyakwazi lokho. Usho kanjani ukuthi umuntu ukhonjiwe esikhundleni kodwa ewine ngamavoti? UNtuli uwine ngamavoti ehlula akababa uYengwa. Asicacise nokuthi zonke izikhundla, kukhethwe ngenqubo yentando yeningi, kwaba khona abaphakanyiswayo kepha bazihoxela bona, okuyilungelo labo nalokho. Uma uMntwana ephawula ukuthi njengelungu le-IFP uyakweseka ukuphakanyiswa kweMeya yaseNkandla, yikuphi la umthethosisekelo ungamvumeli ukuba abeke umbono wakhe? Uma lokho kusho ukukhomba ngentshebe, cha ukuhlaziya kukaDube kunomkhuhlane. Abahlaziyi abayeke ukulokhu behlasela uShenge, kade zingenzeki izingqungquthela begxeka uShenge, inkinga isemazikweni abengakulungele. Asikwamukele ukuthi bekuyingqungquthela yokukhetha le, vele imibono ibihlukene kodwa asingahlaseli umholi ngamampunge ngoba bekuvotwa ngohlelo lwevoti eliyimfihlo, kwabalwa zavuna uMphemba izibalo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikucacise lokhu ngoba kuzosiza obengekho emhlanganweni alazi iqiniso. Siyazi abanye kuselukhuni ukwamukela imiphumela, bese bebeka izaba ngokuthi umholi wathi weseka uNtuli, baze bathi akulula ukumphonsela inselelo. Uma kungelula ukuphonsela umbono womholi inselelo pho bamphakamisa kanjani? Bakwazi kanjani ukucula izingoma ezeseka uYengwa emhlanganweni umholi aye kuwo baze bangunga izimonto ahamba ngazo? Ngifisa abahlaziyi banike iNkatha isikhathi sayo sokwenza izinto zayo, bese behlaziya ngeqiniso, bangachemi nabantu abangafuni ukwamukela imiphumela. Siyabonga kubaba uYengwa nekomiti lonke eliphumile kulokho abasenzele khona. Asinike uMphemba nekomiti elisha ithuba lokuyisa iNkatha phambili sibeseke egameni leqembu. Ngiyathokoza mhleli, ukungivumela ngisebenzise ilungelo njengomfundi waleli phephandaba lansuku zonke. Thokozani Ntombela ENKANDLA
UPastor Tim Omotoso ufuna kuhoxiswe amacala asolwa ngawo athina ukuhlukumeza amantombazane nokushushumbisa abantu. Isithombe: TOGA/FACEBOOK UPastor Tim Omotoso ufuna kuhoxiswe amacala asolwa ngawo athina ukuhlukumeza amantombazane nokushushumbisa abantu. Isithombe: TOGA/FACEBOOK UFUNA ahoxiswe amacala abekwe wona umfundisi osolwa ngezenzo zokuhlukumeza amantombazane ebandla lakhe nokushushumbisa abantu, uPastor Tim Omotoso, odabuka eNigeria. Icala lika-Omotoso nabesifazane ababili asolwa nabo liyaqhubeka njengamanje eNkantolo eNkulu yasePort Elizabeth. U-Omotoso weJesus Dominion International Church ezinze eThekwini, ubhekene namacala angaphezulu kuka-60, okubalwa kuwo ukuphula umthetho i-Sexual Offences Act, okukhona phakathi kwawo amabili okudlwengula. Abesifazane asolwa nabo baboshwa ngoNovemba nyakenye kanti bangaphandle ngebheyili kaR2 000. U-Omotoso uboshwe oKlebe esikhumulweni sezindiza iPort Elizabeth International Airport ngo-Ephreli ngonyaka odlule. Abameli bakhe bazise inkantolo ukuthi uyawachitha onke amacala abhekene nawo. Baveze nokuthi abaneme ngokuthi ubufakazi obuningi obethulelwe inkantolo abuvezi ukuthi asolwa ngakho u-Omotoso wakwenza ngaluphi usuku. Baphinde bacela nokuthi uJaji Mandela Makaula ukuthi angabe esaluhlehlisa lolu daba ngoba umsolwa usehlale ejele unyaka wonke. Ngaphandle kwenkantolo abalandeli balo mfundisi bebeze ngobuningi bezomeseka bethi umsulwa. UMakaula uthe uzokhipha isinqumo ngo 3 ntambama.
UNKOSINATHI Thusi obengumfundi wase-Allenridge Secondary eTembisa, eMidrand, okubikwa ukuthi uzilengise emuva kwezinsolo zokuthi udlwengulile UNKOSINATHI Thusi obengumfundi wase-Allenridge Secondary eTembisa, eMidrand, okubikwa ukuthi uzilengise emuva kwezinsolo zokuthi udlwengulile UZILENGISILE umfundi wesilisa okuthiwa ubezama ukuqabula omunye umfundi wesifazane abafunda naye ekilasini, wazama nokumdlwengula. Kubikwa ukuthi uNkosinathi Thusi (17) obekade enza uGrade 9 e-Allenridge Secondary eTembisa, uzame ukuqabula omunye umfundi wesifazane abafunda naye, umphathi wesikole wamsola ngokuthi udlwengulile, okuyinto okubikwa ukuthi iholele ekutheni umfundi osolwayo agcine esezibulele. Uyise walo mfundi ufuna izimpendulo ngokuzilengisa kwengane yakhe njengoba ethi isikole asifuni ukuphumela obala ngokwenzekile. Ngokusho kukayise kaNkosinathi, uMnuz Richard Thusi, indodana yakhe izilengisele kwenye indlu kwakhe ngentambo eyibophele emapulangweni asophahleni lwendlu ebingakaqedwa ukufulelwa. Ngokusho kukaThusi, bathole emuva kokuzilengisa kwendodana yakhe ukuthi kunencwadi eyayiyinikezwe esikoleni, yokuthi ibuye nomzali njengoba isolwa ngokuqabula omunye umfundi nangokumdlwengula. Kule ncwadi ebukeka eyifomu, kubhalwe ukuthi ‘ukuhlukumeza ngokocansi’, nokuthi ‘ukudlwengula’. Kuphinde kwabhalwa ukuthi lo mfundi uzame ukuphoqa ukuthi agibele phezu kwalo mfundi, okuyinto okuthiwa ubeseyenza okwesibili. UThusi uthe bathole le mininingwane emuva kokuthi indodana yakhe isizilengisile, ukuthi kunencwadi ebinikezwe yona nguthishanhloko walesi sikole, echaza ngesenzo okuthiwa isenzile. Ngaphandle kwencwadi ebivela esikoleni etholakale ezincwadini zendodana yakhe, uthe uphinde wathola enye incwadi ebhalwe yashiywa yindodana yakhe ngokuzibulala kwayo. “Uthishanhloko uvumile ukuthi nguyena owanika uNkosinathi incwadi. Okungixakayo wukuthi ayisayiniwe futhi ayinaso isigxivizo sesikole,” kusho uThusi. Uthe uma ebuza uthishanhloko ngalokhu akayitholi impendulo ecacile. “Ngiphinde ngabuza omunye wothisha, wangitshela ukuthi akaboni ukuthi wayengakwenza kanjani ukuzama ukuqabula omunye umfundi aphinde agibele phezu kwakhe ekubeni yena wayekhona ekilasini,” kuchaza uThusi. NgokukaThusi, akekho okhuluma into ezwakalayo nebambekayo kulesi sikole uma ebuza ngalolu daba. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo eGauteng uMnuz Steve Mabona, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lolu daba bayalwazi. “Abahloli yibona abaphenya lolu daba futhi bayaxhumana nomndeni kamufi ukuze kucace ngokwenzekile,” kusho uMabona. Uthe umphumela wophenyo yiwona ozokusho ukuthi yisiphi isinyathelo okumele basithathe, wakucacisa ukuthi ophule inqubomgomo yokusebenza komthetho olawula ezemfundo, bazobhekana naye ngqo. “Ngeke sikubekezelele ukungaziphathi kahle ezikoleni”. Uthe bayazwelana nomndeni ngokwenzekile. Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseGauteng, uCaptain Mavela Masondo, uthe amaphoyisa akule ndawo aphenya ngokufa komfundi. “Sisazolindela kuqala umphumela wokuhlinzwa kwesidumbu ukuze sithole ukuthi ngempela kwenzekeni,” kusho uMasondo.
VELAPHI 'VVO' MKHIZE VELAPHI 'VVO' MKHIZE ABAMHLOPHE bafika ezwenikazi i-Afrika bathola abamnyama benamasiko abo. Nakuba babaphuca okuningi kodwa kukhona abangabanga namandla okubaphuca khona. Kokunye abangakwazanga ukukuphuca khona abampisholo yilo isiko nesintu sabo. Bafaka inkolo ngenhloso yokumdunga umqondo umuntu omnyama. Kuyadabukisa ukuthi kuthe uma sekuphatha umuntu omnyama, waphuca umuntu wakubo isiko nesintu sakhe. Namhlanje sinobugcwelegcwele izwelonke uhulumeni wakha imali ngabo, namhlanje sinezingane ezihlala emigwaqweni ezijika zibe yizigebengu, ezigcina sezibizwa ngamaphara. Ngo-1996 kwaqhanyukwa noMthethosisekelo wezwe owanconywa kwathiwa muhle kunayo yonke emhlabeni. Lihle iqiniso, lokho kwaba yingcwaba lokugcina kumuntu omnyama. Umuntu omnyama kuqale lapho ukuthi kuthiwe akenze izinto eziphambene nesiko nesintu sakhe, okugcine kumngcwaba okokugcina. Uma ingane izalwa emandulo bekwaziwa ukuthi uma uyise nonina bengashadile leyo ngane ingumlanjwana, iyohlale ingeyakoninalume. Namhlanje uma ingane izalwa esibhedlela akubuzwa nakubuzwa kuvele kuthiwe ayibhalwe ngesibongo sikayise, lawo maphepha ayogcina eseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, nakhona ingane igxivizwe ngesibongo sikayise. Unina ngokungazi isiko njengalokhu selamuka nezinkolo avume kugcine isibongo esisebenzayo kungesikayise wengane. Uma makhathaleni ingane isinezinkinga, kugcina sekufanele kuhlehlelwe emuva ingane ilungise iphutha elenzeka ngesikhathi izalwa sekuthiwa ayihambe iyofuna izincwadi ezifungelwe kokunye kuthathwe igazi. Uma uyise wengane nonina sebexabana kuqala inkinga. Akubhekwa ukuthi iphutha leli elenzeka emuva esibhedlela, lilungiswe kalula ngoba kwaziwa ukuthi isiko nesintu kuthini. Namhlanje la maphara esikhala ngawo amaqanda azalwe nguMthethosisekelo wethu owakhiwe omnyama kubusa omnyama, amachwane achanyiselwa yilokhu kuhlupheka esikubona kubhebhetheka imihla namalanga enganeni yomuntu omnyama. Siqamba amanga sithi kunezinkumbi zezingane ezingayitholi imisebenzi ngoba sifuna ukwanelisa izifiso zepolitiki sibe sazi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi akulula ukuthola umsebenzi kuphambene esibongweni. Uma ingane iphuma iyofuna umsebenzi iphuma naliphi ithongo? Lokhu ongqongqoshe abaphethe kowezaseKhaya bakwazi kahle kamhlophe, ezabo izingane ngeke bavume ukuthi zibizwe ngesibongo abaziyo ukuthi akusona. Kufana ncamashi nokuthi ezemindeni yabo ezakhona izingane bazifaka ezibhedlela ezingcono, nasezikoleni ezingcono bese bethi bahola umphakathi wona oyiswa ezikoleni nasezibhedlela abathi ezikahulumeni. Liphi iqiniso eliyophephisa lisindise liphinde liphilise umuntu omnyama oholwa omnyama na? Namhlanje sekuyinsakavukela umchilo wesidwaba ukuthi yonke ingane ezalwayo uyise nonina abashadile, noma beshadile kodwa akuzange kwagcagcwa njengalokhu sekwalahleka isintu namasiko. Namhlanje sekuyinto enzima ukuthi uma uganwa ungaganwa umuntu ongenayo ingane. Iningi labesifazane linezingane, kanjalo nebesilisa. Ukuyeka imikhuba efana nokusoma nokuhlolwa kwabesimame nokufundiswa kwabafana entabeni yikhona okuchamisele le nkinga yokuthi wonke umuntu usethatha isinqumo sokuganwa enomuntu onengane yomunye. Kukabili-ke le ngane ayithole engakashadi owesimame uzohamba nayo uyoyibiza ngesibongo salapho eganele khona, kokunye uzwe bona abadala obathembile okuthi bazi isintu abazizalukazi namakhehla bethi hamba uyobiza isibongo sakini khona ungayohlupheka. Kulapho-ke kuqala khona izinkinga. Kulapho uqala khona ukuba nezinkinga zasemsamo usuhlangabezana nale nkinga yaseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, sekuthiwa thola izincwadi ezifungelwe, kumbe kuthathwe igazi ukuthola ukuthi bayakuzala ngempela yini laba bantu ngoba uthi uzama ukuguqula isibongo kube ngesilungile. Abantu abaningi abaya kohlola ezangomeni namhlanje bazi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi yisibongo esonakele. Uyozwa nohlolayo ethi thatha isibongo sikayihlo into engelona nakancane isiko, belekelelwa amanye amabandla akhona athi ancike esintwini kodwa ebe ekhuthaza into ephambene nesintu. Lithi-ke elami uma uhulumeni engakalungisi ezibhedlela lapho kuzalelwa khona izingane kanjalo nasemnyangweni, abantu bakithi abathi beyokulungisa batshelwe lokhu nalokhu, usekude umuntu omnyama ukukhulukeka nokuthi umnotho ube sezandleni zakhe.

Ugcine exolisile uKwesta ku-Anele nasethimbeni asebenzisana nalo. Lesi sitatimende seSABC sithe * -Anele nethimba lakhe babelandela imiyalelo. Wathi sebezame bahluleka.

IMEYA yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede oyaelelwe ukuthi akaqhubeke ahlale ekhaya kyze kube ayaphothulwa amacala abhekene nawo enkantolo. Isithombe: Doctor Ngcobo/African News Agency(ANA) IMEYA yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede oyaelelwe ukuthi akaqhubeke ahlale ekhaya kyze kube ayaphothulwa amacala abhekene nawo enkantolo. Isithombe: Doctor Ngcobo/African News Agency(ANA) ABALANDELI beMeya yoMkhandlu weTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, bathi kabahambisani nokuthi umholi wabo aqhubeke nokuhlala ekhaya ibe ikhefu abenikwe lona lenyanga yi-ANC seliphelile. UNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, izolo utshele abezindaba ukuthi uNkk Gumede, iMeya yaseNewcastle, uDkt Ntuthuko Mahlaba, nekhansela laseThekwini, uMnuz Mondli Mthembu, bazoqhubeka nokuhlala ekhaya kuze kube bathatha isinqumo ngabo okulindeleke ukuthi basikhiphe esontweni lokuqala ku-Agasti. “Ubuholi besifundazwe bathatha isinqumo sokuthi iMeya yaseThekwini, eyaseNewcastle nekhansela uMthembu ukuba baye ekhefini lenyanga. Lesi sinqumo sisamile ngoba isinqumo ngekusasa labo besingakasithathi. Silindele ukuthi sisikhiphe esontweni lokuqala ku-Agasti emuva kokuthola umbiko esizobe siwunikwe yisigungu esibhekelele ukusebenza kwesifundazwe,” kusho uNtuli. Uthe balindele ukuthi amaqabane ahloniphe isinqumo esathathwa wubuholi besifundazwe ngokuthi angabuyeli emsebenzini. UNtuli uthe bakhathazekile ngokungabi khona kozinzo eMkhandlwini weTheku osekuholele ekutheni babe nemihlangano namagatsha enhlangano nemibutho yeqembu, okubalwa kuyo nowabesifazane. Okhulumela abalandeli baNkk Gumede, uMnuz Mzo Dube, uthe bona abakaze bahambisane nesinqumo sokuthi imeya inikwe ikhefu. “Esikushoyo manje wukuthi njengoba isikhathi sekhefu sesiphelile silindele ukuthi imeya ibuyele emsebenzini iqhubeke nomsebenzi wayo ngoba kwasekuqaleni kwaba yiphutha ukuba kuthathwe isinqumo sokuthi inikwe ikhefu ngoba awukwazi ukuthatha isinqumo ngohlelo ongazi ukuthi luzophetha kanjani,” kusho uDube. Uthe isinqumo sekhefu lenyanga kwaba yisinqumo sepolitiki. “Isicelo sokuhlaba ikhefu sifakwa emsebenzini. Umasipala wuhlaka oluzimele ngakho kasiluqondi uhlelo lwakhona ukuthi luhamba kanjani uma kuphoqeka ukuthi uqhubeke nekhefu,” kusho uDube. Amanye amakhansela asondelene noNkk Gumede kodwa angagunyaziwe ukuthi akhulume nabezindaba acele ukuthi angadalulwa athe amagatsha awaneme ngokuthi imeya kusamele iqhubeke nokuhlala ekhaya. “Adiniwe amaqabane, asazi ngempela ukuthi kuzokwenzekani,” kusho ikhansela. Abalandeli bakaNkk Gumede siye koshicilela izolo kulindeleke ukuthi babe nomkhuleko wokuzila. UDube uthe bazoqhubeka nomkhuleko wabo njengoba behlelile. Elinye ikhansela le-ANC lithe bekuhlelwe ukuthi kuphume amabhasi amabili kwi-zone ngayinye kuma-zone awu-17, eThekwini. Abalandeli bakaNkk Gumede bathe abakwamukeli ukuthi aqhubeka nokuhlala ekhaya. UNkk Gumede ungaphandle ngebheyili kaR50 000, emuva kokuboshwa mayelana namacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa athinta ithenda yezigidi yokuqoqwa kukadoti eThekwini.

Uthathwe noNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo eKZN uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo obemfisela uhambo oluhle UZIMISELE ngokubamba iqhaza ekulweleni amalungelo abantu besifazane umfundi ka-matric (17) ophila nebala elimhlophe ozomela iNingizimu Afrika engqungqutheleni ezobhunga ngezinkinga zabesifazane. UGoldgirl Phakathi ofunda eNqabakazulu Comprehensive High KwaMashu uthe ufisa sengathi abantu besifazane bangafunda ukuzethemba kukho konke abakwenzayo bazi ukuthi ukuba ngabantu besifazane akubenzi babe ngaphansi kwabesilisa. UGoldgirl ungomunye wabafundi abahambele ingqungquthela ezobe iseNew York, iCommission on the Status of Women 2018 ehlelwe yi-United Nations. Lo mfundi, ohambe izolo, kulindeleke ukuthi abe kule ngqungquthela kusukela ngoMashi 12 kuya ku-23 nonyaka. Uthe njengoba ephila nebala elimhlophe uzithole ecwaswa ezindaweni ezithile okubalwa kuzo nasesikoleni ngenxa yokuthi abanye abafundi bebengaqondi ngabantu abaphila nebala elimhlophe. Lo mfundi uthe okumqinisa idolo wukuthi umphakathi aphuma kuwona KwaMashu kwa-J awuzange umcwase. Uthe lokhu kumenze wakhula engazizwa enesici futhi engenza noma yini eyenziwa ngabantu abalingana naye. Uthe ufisa sengathi nabantu besifazane bangafunda kulokhu bazi ukuthi noma kungaba khona abazobacwasa kodwa lokhu akusho ukuthi ngeke besakwazi ukwenza noma yini abafisa ukuyenza. Njengoba esengqungqutheleni kulindeleke ukuthi akhulume ngezingqinamba ezicindezela abesifazane namantombazane asezindaweni ezisemakhaya. “Abantu besifazane basemakhaya nabaselokishini bacishe babhekane nezingqinamba ezifanayo kodwa laba abasemakhaya kuba nzima kakhulu kubona. Kimina, enye yezinto eziyinkinga kakhulu okufanele kuliwe nayo wukukhulelwa kwezingane zisafunda, wukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa nokungalingani phakathi kwabantu besifazane nabesilisa. Ngisho kungathiwa yiselokishini noma yisemakhaya abantu besifazane nabesilisa abanikwa amathuba afanayo - lokhu kufanele kushintshe ukuze kuthuthukiswe abesifazane,” kusho uGoldgirl. Uthe abanye bakholwa ukuthi akubalulekile ukulwela amalungelo abesifazane ngoba bethi ngeke kushintshe lutho kodwa yena akakholwa yilokho. UGoldgirl, othole leli thuba ngokuba yingxenye yohlelo olucija abesifazane olwaziwa ngeWomen’s Leadership and Training Programme, uthe uzimisele ngokusebenzisa lonke ulwazi azoluthola ukufukula abesifazane. UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo usanda kuhambela esikoleni salo mfundi eyomhalalisela ngokuqokwa kwakhe emfisela nendlela enhle ohambeni lwakhe.
ISAA engenye yezinkampani zikahulumeni ezidinga usizo lwezimali ISAA engenye yezinkampani zikahulumeni ezidinga usizo lwezimali IZIKHULU zamabhange ezingamalungu eBanking Association of South Africa (Basa) zithi zizimisele ukutakula izinkampani zikahulumeni ezinenkinga yezimali ukuze zingacwili kakhulu ezikweletini. Lesi simemezelo senziwe yisikhulu esiphezulu seBasa, uMnuz Cas Coovadia oveze ukuthi ngoLwesibili kaJuni 19 babenomhlangano noNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Nhlanhla Nene, owamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uMnuz Pravin Gordhan nePhini likaNene, uMnuz Mondli Gungubele. “Emhlanganweni sachazelwa ngesimo sezinkampani zikahulumeni nezingqinamba zezimali ezibhekene nazo. Sihambile sayokhuluma namalungu ethu siwachazela ukuthi uhulumeni udinga sisize izinkampani zakhe ukuze zikwazi ukukhokha izikweletu. Kuyoba yishwa uma lezi zinkampani zingase zeqiwe yizinyanga ezikweletini zazo. Amalungu ethu okungamabhange avumile ukusiza ngoba awafuni kube nabantu abaphelelwa wumsebenzi nokuthi umnotho wethu uwe,” kusho uCoovadia. Uthembise ukuthi bengamabhange bazokwenza konke okusemandleni ukusiza izinkampani zikahulumeni ezifana ne-Eskom ukukhokha izikweletu zazo nokuthi zibuyelwe wuzinzo uma kukhulunywa ngokuphathwa kwezimali. “Uhulumeni uvumile ukuthi uzozilalela iziphakamiso ezenziwayo zokuthi izinkampani zakhe zenze imali. Uphinde wazibophezela ukuthi uyena ozobhekana nesikweletu uma izinkampani zihluleka wukukhokha. Izingxoxo zethu nohulumeni ziyaqhubeka ngoba sifuna indlela yokuthuthukisa umnotho wezwe,” kusho uCoovadia. Isazi somnotho nezomthetho, uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa, sithe kufanele ishayelwe izandla iBasa ngesimemezelo sayo yize simbaxambili. “Isitatimende seBasa sihle uma kuwukuthi inkohlakalo efake izinkampani zikahulumeni kulesi simo esikuzo izokhucululwa ngoba abantu abadayisa amalahle kwa-Eskom bayawabizisa. Uthe isikhulu sakwa-Eskom uMnuz Phakamani Hadebe uyasithemba ngoba singumuntu owuhloniphayo umthetho kodwa akazi noma sizophumelela yini ukukhuculula inkohlakalo yeminyaka. “Ukuze i-Eskom ikwazi ukusebenza kahle, yenze nemali ngathi kungaqalwa phansi kuqashwe kabusha izinkampani eziwudayisela amalahle. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi kudala i-Eskom yayinezikhulu ezingu-81 kodwa manje zingaphezu kuka-500 ,” kusho uDumisa. Uthe ngisho kwaSAA kunoSihlalo weBhodi othembekile futhi okwaziyo ukuvusa izinkampani eziwayo uMnuz Johannes Bhekumuzi Magwaza kodwa akazi ukuthi kuzomthatha iminyaka emingaki ukukhuculula inkohlakalo yeminyaka.

Leli phephandaba ligcina ukukhuluma nowesifazane owaphucwa isidumbu uNksz Sandile Ndlovu wathi akukho asafisa ukukwenza ngesidumbu ngoba usemzilele umyeni wakhe uyawukhulula lo mndeni ukuthi umngcwabe ngaphandle kwakhe. Kuthiwa kwaba nempi ngesikhathi umndeni wakwaMsane uyolanda isidumbu sawo eMgungundlovu sekunomlindelo. Kuthiwa kwakushayanwa ngamatshe kwagcina kubhuntshe nomngcwabo, umndeni kaMsane usuthathe isidumbu sawo.

SEKUPHINDE kwangena esinye isikhalo ngengqungquthela ye-IFP Youth Brigade okuwuphiko lwentsha yeNkatha ebihleli oLundi ngempelasonto. Iziko Imbabazane elibuye lizibize ngoMtshezi, kuthiwa seliphumele obala lithi kuningi okungahambanga kahle ngengqungquthela ekhethe uMnuz Mthokozisi Nxumalo kwesikaSihalo wophiko. UNobhala walo uNksz Nobuhle Ngubane unqabile ukuphawula ngencwadi okuthiwa ithunyelwe esigungwini esiphezulu seqembu . Akafunanga ngisho ukukhuluma ngesikhalo okuthiwa basifakile uvele wavala ucingo. Umthombo opotshozele leli phephandaba, uthe abaningi bayesaba ukuphumela obala ngoba kuba sengathi bavukela iqembu. Umthombo uthi isigungu esiphezulu siyitholile incwadi evela kuleli ziko. “Awu kuyaziwa nje ukuthi izinto zihamba kanjani eqenjini abantu bakhalaza emakhoneni ngoba abaningi bayesaba. Uvele uthathwe njengomuntu ongahloniphi odicilela phansi iqembu uma uveza izikhalo,” kusho umthombo. Elinye ilungu elingathandanga ukuveza igama lalo lithi kufanele kukhethwe kabusha kulungiswe wonke amaphutha enzeka engqungqutheleni. “Kwakungena noma wubani lapha engqungqutheleni nezigqebhezana zokungena zakhwabaniswa. Wake wayibonaphi ingqungquthela eyenzelwa etendeni ngoba akhona amahholo oLundi. Baningi kakhulu abantu abangagculisekile ngendlela okuqhutshwa ngayo izingqungquthela ze-IFP,” kuchaza ilungu elikhathazekile. Lesi sikhalazo selama eduze esinye esavela ngosuku lokusongwa kwengqungquthela lapho indoda eyazethula ngoNgcobo isibongo, yasukuma yaphikisa imiphumela. Le ndoda ize yazibophezela ngokuthi izolulandela lolu daba kuze kube sekugcineni. Akuqali ukuthi kube nomsindo njengoba kuke kwabangwa imiphumela yokhetho lobuholi besifundazwe KwaZulu-Natal. Owayehola umkhankaso wezikhalo uMnuz Simphiwe Zungu wamiswa eqenjini emuva kwezinsukwana nje ephumele obala ngokungenami kwakhe. Okhulumela iqembu uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa ukuqinisekisile ukuthi incwadi ifikile futhi iyacutshungulwa indaba yayo kodwa wathi ngeke iphindwe ingqungquthela. “Sikholwa wukuthi kwahamba kahle konke engqungqutheleni yeqembu. Siyafuna futhi ukuxwayisa amalungu ethu agijima aye kwabezindaba ukuthi lokhu akufuneki. Wudaba lwangaphakathi lolu kufanele iqembu linikwe ithuba lilulungise,” kusho uHlengwa.

ULungelo Shandu (31) oseneminyaka emibili ephume ngoshwele ejele, ubhale incwadi ethi Success and Wealth Through The Bible. Le ncwadi wayibhala ejele yaphuma ngo-2015 esaboshiwe njengoba ehlale iminyaka emine ngaphakathi. “Ngaboshelwa ukubulala ngoba umzala wami ngamfica elele nentombi yami. Ngabashaya bobabili ngezandla ngingaphethe sikhali, umzala waphunyuka wabaleka. Intombi yashona, ngaboshwa ngagwetshwa iminyaka engu-10 kwalengiswa emibili. Ngalivuma icala enkantolo, ngabhalela nomndeni wentombi ngixolisa ngesenzo sami,” echaza. Uthe ngaphambi kwalesi sigameko wake wayikhuza intombi yakhe ngezenzo zayo ezimbi, wathembisa nokuthi ngelinye ilanga uyoyishaya ayibulale. Lokhu kwamfundisa ukuthi izenzo zomuntu zisukela emicabangweni yakhe njengoba nakuyena kwenzeke kanjalo. UShandu uthe ngaphambi kokuboshwa wayephuza kakhulu utshwala edla nezidakamizwa. Waqhubeka nalokhu engaphakathi ejele, washintsha eminyakeni emibili yokugcina ayihlale khona. “Ukuba sejele kwanginikeza isikhathi esiningi sokufunda. Ngaphuma sengifunde izincwadi ezingu-100, ngafunda ngisho iBhayibheli. Yize ngizisola ngesenzo sami kodwa ukuhlala ejele akuyimoshanga impilo, kunalokho kwayilungisa. Ngesikathi ngingaphakathi ngafunda ukuhweba, ngafunda nolimi iSpanish nomdlalo iHigh Jump.” Uthe walucela uxolo emdenini kamufi, wacela osonhlalakahle bamhlanganise nawo ngesikhathi esejele. Kule ncwadi ufundisa abantu ngokunaka imicabango yabo ukuze bathathe izinqumo eziphusile. Uthe incwadi yakhe isishintshe abaningi abafakazayo ukuthi isibasizile ukubhekana nezinselelo zempilo. Incwadi ifundisa nokuthi abantu baphola kanjani ebuhlungwini benhliziyo nokuthi baphile impilo enokuthula. Iyatholakala ezitolo zakwa-Adams and Griggs nakwi-internet. Ngaphandle kwencwadi uShandu uhambela imiphakathi nezikole enikeza izinkulumo ezakhayo. Lokhu wakuqala engaphakathi ejele, ephumela emiphakathini ukuyoqwashisa nangezidakamizwa. Uke wasebenza neMeya yaseMgungundlovu uMnuz Themba Njilo emikhankasweni yokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Uke waba nohlelo lwezinkulumo ezakhayo kwiMbokodo FM wabuye wahamba noMnyango wezokuBuciko, amaSiko nezeMidlalo KwaZulu-Natal.

IMEYA yoMkhandlu weTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede ithi imibiko yabezindaba ethi izoboshwa mayelana nezinsolo zenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa umkhankaso yokuyinyundela nokungcolisa igama layo IMEYA yoMkhandlu weTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede ithi imibiko yabezindaba ethi izoboshwa mayelana nezinsolo zenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa umkhankaso yokuyinyundela nokungcolisa igama layo IMEYA yoMkhandlu weTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede ithi imibiko yabezindaba mayelana nokuthi izoboshwa maduze ngezinsolo zenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa wumkhankaso wokuyinyundela nokungcolisa igama layo. Esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba, uNkk Gumede uthe le mibiko ikhishwe ngesikhathi lapho kuqhubeka khona uhlelo lokuhlanganiswa kohlu lwamagama abaholi abangathunywa ezikhundleni nangesikhathi somkhankaso wokhetho lwangonyaka ozayo. “Kunenhlese yezepolitiki ngalezi zinsolo eqhutshwa ngabantu abathile abafuna ukufeza izinhloso zabo. Kuyishwa ukuthi izintatheli zivumela ukusetshenziswa kulo mdlalo wepolitiki,” kusho uNkk Gumede. Uthe indlela lezi zindaba ezingekho ezibhalwa ngayo ziphinde zibe nomthelela omubi edolobheni laseThekwini. “Zonke lezi zinto engisolwa ngazo azinasisekelo, njengoba kukhulunywa ngethenda okuthiwa akuzange kulandelwe imigudu ngesikhathi ikhishwa. Leyo thenda okukhulunywa ngayo yakhishwa mina ngingakabi ngisho imeya,” kusho uNkk Gumede. Uthe kule mibiko yabezindaba akuveli ukuthi kwaba iliphi iqhaza lakhe ekukhishweni kwale thenda okukhulunywa ngayo. “Ngabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekusungulweni kophiko oluphenya amacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa emkhandlwini, iCity Integrity and Investigation Unit nokuthi lunikezwe amandla. Imina osekhaleni empini ebhekiswe enkohlakalweni ngaphandle kokwesaba nokwenzelela,” kusho uNkk Gumede. Uthe uzoqhubeka nokusebenzela idolobha futhi ngeke asabe ukuvikela ukwethembeka nesithunzi sakhe. “Nginxusa abezindaba ukuba bayeke ukuvuma ukusetshenziswa ukubhebhethekisa izindaba ezingekho,” kusho uNkk Gumede. Uthe kulemibiko yabezindaba akukho lapho lowo okhulumela amaphoyisa ebala khona igama lakhe ukuthi ungomunye wabantu okuhlelwa ukuba baboshwe khona maduze. Okhulumela oKlebe kuzwelonke, uBrigadier Hangwani Mulaudzi uthe kukhona uphenyo abalwenzayo mayelana nezinsolo zenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa emkhandlwini weTheku kodwa wangawadalula amagama abantu ababaphenyayo. Isithombe: GCIS ISIKHULU esiphezulu saseNedbank, uMnuz Mike Brown, siveze ukuthi owayengungqongqoshe wezokuMbiwaphansi, uMnuz Mosebenzi Zwane, wayecindeza ibhange ukuthi lithathe ama-akhawunti omndeni wakwaGupta ukuze kuvikelwe imisebenzi. UBrown utshele ikhomishini yeJaji Raymond Zondo izolo ukuthi uZwane wacela umhlangano nezikhulu zakwaNedbank ukuze kuxoxwe ngodaba lokuhlengwa kwemisebenzi yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngoMeyi ka-2016. Uthe ngesikhathi uZwane eqala umhlangano wathi amanye amabhange anqabile ukuhlangana nekomiti longqongqoshe waphinde wasabisa ngokuthi ikomiti linamandla amakhulu. “Ngamtshela uZwane ukuthi ngeke sikhulume ngezindaba zamakhasimende ebhange kodwa yena wayelokhu efuna ukukhuluma ngodaba lwabantu bakwaGupta. Wasicela ukuthi sisebenzisane nabakwaGupta emuva kokuthi amanye amabhange evale ama-akhawunti amabhizinisi abo. Yize sasitshelwe ukuthi sizohlangana nongqongqoshe abahlukene kodwa sagcina sesibonana noZwane kuphela,” kusho uBrown. Uthe bavala ama-akhawunti omndeni wakwaGupta nezinkampani zawo, okubalwa kuzo i-Oakbay Investments, Islandsite, Confident Concept, Sahara Computers neVR Lazer emuva kokusola ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi. “Sahlangana ngo-Ephreli 6 siyikomiti lasebhange eNedbank, sasifunde imibiko yokuthi iFNB ne-Absa isiwavalile ama-akhawunti akwaGupta. Sabona ukuthi sisengozini uma singawavali ngoba sasibonile ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi kuwo. Sinelungelo lokuqeda ubudlelwane bethu nezaphula mthetho,” kusho uBrown. Uthe banikeza abakwaGupta izinsuku eziwu-30 bebazisa ukuthi bazovala ama-akhawunti abo. Njengoba izikhulu zakwamanye amabhange ziveze ukuthi zabizwa emhlanganweni oseLuthuli House, uBrown uthe neNedbank nayo yabizelwa kulo mhlangano. “Kwakukhona owayenguNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, uNkk Jessie Duarte, owayeyiPhini lakhe noMnuz Enock Godogwana, obhekelele ezomnotho kwi-ANC. Abazange basisabise kodwa bathi bafuna ukuqonda ukuthi kungani amabhange ekhethe ukuvala amabhange omndeni wakwaGupta nokuthi lesi sinyathelo sizoba namthelela muni kubatshalizimali,” kusho uBrown. Uthe bachazela amalungu e-ANC ngemithetho yokusebenza kwamabhange nomthelela oba khona uma kunabaphula imithetho yezezimali. Ibhange i-Absa lithi lona lasatshiswa ngokuthi izonqanyulwa inkontileka yalo uma liqhubeka nokuvala ama-akhawunti womndeni wakwaGupta.

Le nto iphambene nomthetho futhi thina sifuna ukubambisana namaphoyisa hhayi ngoba silwa nawo. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi yini le efihlwayo eziteshini abangafuni siyibone,’’ kusho uMaimane enanelwa yihlombe labalandeli beDA. Uthe amaphoyisa awakwazi ukuzenzela umathanda engagadwe muntu futhi amalungu eSishayamthetho abekelwe lokho ukugada ukusebenza kwezikhungo zomphakathi. “Ngingama kanjani nje ePhalamende ngitshele izwe ukuthi angikwazi ukuyohlola isimo esiteshini esithile? Bazothini abantu uma bezwa leyo nto njengoba bethembele kithina. Uke ufike esiteshini ubone ukuthi amaphoyisa awazi lutho kuduma upotiyane uma uwabuza,’’ kusho uMaimane. USASHAQEKILE umndeni womfundi (17) waseNtshisekelo High, eNanda okuthiwa ugwazwe, wabulawa omunye umfundi ngoLwesibili eya esikoleni emuva kokuthi kubangwe iphepha elalibhalwe abangawenzile umsebenzi wesikole. Kusenzima emndenini kaSikhumbuzo Gumede waseWolawola eMatikwe obenza uGrade 10 eNtshisekelo High, eNanda ukwamukela ukuthi akasekho emhlabeni. Kuthiwa ugwazwe eduze kwasesikoleni wawela ngaphandle kwesango lesikole, washonela emtholampilo. Umfowabo, uSiyanda Gumede owenza uGrade 12 kulesi sikole uthe akazi ukuthi uzoqhubeka kanjani aphile impilo ejwayelekile emuva kokwenzeke kumfowabo abebesondelene kakhulu naye. Uthe ubesesikoleni ngesikhathi ebizwa ngomunye wothisha emtshela ukuthi akeze esangweni lapho umfowabo ebeselele khona engakhombisi mpilo. Uthe lesi sigameko senzeke emuva kokuthi umfowabo exabene nalo mfundi afunda naye ekilasini ngoLwesihlanu oludlule. Ngokusho kwakhe umfowabo wacelwa uthisha ukuthi ayobiza abantu ababengawenzanga umsebenzi wesikole ababebhalwe epheshaneni okwakufanele lifundwe ekilasini. Uthe wanika umfundi okunguye oyi-prefect ukuthi enze lokhu. Kuthe uma lo mfundi ememeza amagama kwakhona umfundi omphuca iphepha walidabula. Uthe abanye abafundi babiza umfowabo bembikela lokhu. Ngesikhathi ebuza lona omunye umfundi ukuthi wenzani kuthiwa lo mfundi ubhoke ngolaka embuza ukuthi uzomenzani base belwa. Lona omunye umfundi kuthiwa uhluliwe wase esongela uSikhumbuzo. Kukholakala ukuthi lo mfundi ulalele uSikhumbuzo unyendle ngesikhathi eya esikoleni ngoLwesibili wamgwaza esifubeni ngommese. Uyise kaSikhumbuzo, uMnuz Jabulani Dludla (57) obesashaqekile ngesigameko sokubulawa kwendodana yakhe uthe umoya wakhe uphukile ngokwenzekile. Uthe indodana yakhe beyigubha usuku lwayo kokuzalwa ngoLwesine oludlule. Uveze nokuthi unina kaSikhumbuzo washona ngale nyanga, emuva kosuku embelethile. Konke lokhu kubavusela iminjunju njengomndeni. Ukhale nangokuthi baye emndenini womfana osolwa kulesi sigameko kodwa kwangabonakala sengathi bayazwelana nabo ngokwenzekile. Uthe bazoyekela umthetho usebenze. Elinye lamalungu omphakathi elithe linengane efunda uGrade 10 kulesiya sikole lithe selicabanga nokukhipha ingane yalo ngenxa yezigameko ezenzeka khona elithe likholwa ukuthi zidalwa ukungahloniphi kwezingane ezifunda khona. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa uthe sibaphathe kabi lesi sigameko. Uthe bathumele abeluleki bengqondo bomnyango ukuthi bayoluleka izingane ebezikhona kushona lo mfundi. UCaptain Nqobile Gwala, okhulumela amaphoyisa eKZN uthe amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubulala, akukaboshwa muntu.
ILAHLWE yicala yafakwa ohlwini lwabahlukumeza ngokocansi indoda yaseScotland okuthiwa isibaqedile abesifazane ilala nabo kodwa ibe ingenawo umphambili, ibalutha ngokuthi inawo bese ibadlokodla ngento ethize esikhundleni somphambili. Kuthiwa uMnuz Carlos Delacruz (35) ubebathatha abesifazane abayise endlini yakhe, afike acime ugesi bese ethatha le nto yakhe engaziwa abadlokodle ngayo. Kuthiwa emuva kocansi owesifazane ubesala nobuhlungu obungabekezeleleki aze agule. Kuthiwa babili abesifazane abaphumele obala ngalezi zinhlungu emuva kokuba beye enkonzweni yasekamelweni nalo mlisa. Kuthiwa lo mlisa wayenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abesifazane abamboni enqunu ngoba wayehlala ewucimile ugesi. Kuthiwa abesifazane bathuke bacishe bashayeka phansi sebethola ukuthi lo mlisa akanawo umphambili ubebashaya ngemfe iphindiwe. Kuthiwa kuvele ngesikhathi ebhadle esitokisini esehlolwa udokotela kwatholakala ukuthi awukho nhlobo umphambili. Omunye owesifazane ake athandana naye phambilini kuthiwa wambamba lo mlisa ukuthi akanawo umphambili kodwa uyambawulisa, usebenzisa induku thizeni. Kuvele ukuthi uzivumele phambi kwenkantolo ukuthi empeleni akanawo umphambili ubesebenzisa amaqhinga akhe. - The Daily Mail

Owayengungqongqoshe wezokuVakasha kuleli uMnuz Derek Hanekom izolo ovume ukuhlangana nabe-EFF. Isithombe: Courtney Africa/African News Agency (ANA). UMHLAZIYI wepolitiki uMnuz Xolani Dube weXubera Institute for Research, uthe ukusebenzisana komholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema nalowo owayenguNgqongqoshe wezokuVakasha uMnuz Derek Hanekom nePhini likaNobhala Jikelele weSACP uMnuz Solly Mapaila ukuze bakhiphe lowo owayenguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma kwaba wukungathembeki kwezinga eliphezulu. UDube uthe ukuvela kwalezi zinsolo kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi iSACP ayithembekile kumbimbi lwayo ne-ANC futhi ikulolu mbimbi ukufeza izinhloso zayo. “Babengakheli i-ANC yodwa uzungu kodwa babakhela nomengameli wezwe uzungu, kusobala ukuthi abekho kulolu mbimbi ngoba bengabaholi abaqotho kodwa bafuna ukufeza izinhloso zabo. Ngeke uthi bafuna ukulekelela i-ANC, kuyakhathaza lokhu abakwenzayo,” kusho uDube. Uthe kuyacaca ukuthi oMapaila noHanekom babengasebenzi bodwa kodwa babeholwa ngothile. Wathi kuzokhathaza uma kuwukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wayelwazi lolu daba ngoba lokhu kusho ukuthi akayibhekelele i-ANC kodwa ubhekelele okunye. ISACP imvikelile uMapaila ithi wayethunyiwe ukuba ayimele ezinhlelweni zokukhipha uZuma. “I-SACP yayiwuseka umkhankaso wokususa umholi owayengazibhekeleli izidingo zabantu futhi ayizisoli ngalokho. Kwakuwumkhankaso osobala owawucacisa ukuthi idinga umholi ozonakekela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Siyakugxeka ukuthathwa kwalo mkhankaso sengathi kwakuyinto efihliwe noma uzungu lokuhlasela abathile ngoba konke kwakusobala,” kusho uMnuz Alex Mashilo okhulumela iSACP. Khonamanjalo, owayengungqongqoshe uHanekom uvumile ukuthi wahlangana nabaholi be-EFF ngesikhathi befuna ukukhipha uZuma. UHanekom ubephendula ezinsolweni ezenziwe wuMholi we-EFF uMalema othe uHanekom wasebenzisana ne-EFF wase wayinika uhlu lwamalungu e-ANC ayezovota namaqembu aphikisayo ukuze kukhishwe uZuma esikhundleni. Yize ekuvumile ukuhlangana nabe-EFF uHanekom ukuchithile ukuthi wanikeza i-EFF uhlu lwamalungu asePhalamende ayezovota ne-EFF. Uthe akufihliwe ukuthi wake wahlangana namalungu e-EFF ngesikhathi i-ANC ifuna ukukhipha uZuma esikhundleni. “Ngaphuza ikhofi noMnuz Godrich Gardee (onguNobhala-jikelele we-EFF) kabili eMugg and Bean ose-Eastgate. Mhlawumbe sahlangana kathathu futhi. Angikaze ngimnike uhlu lwamagama abantu be-ANC,” kusho uHanekom ebhalela iSABC ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.
File Image: IOL File Image: IOL Ukufika kwe-internet kule minyaka kuyishintshe kakhulu impilo. Kwafika neselula okwenza kwaba lula ukuxhumana. Yize ukufika kweselula kwathuthukisa indlela yokuphila, ushintsho lwangempela lubonakale lapho kufika lawa abizwa ngama-smart phone okwasho ukuthi amaselula asene-internet. Lokhu kwasho ukuthi sesikwazi ukuthola nokuthumela imiqulu (documents), imali, izithombe, umculo nokunye okuningi. Ngisho abantu abangenawo ama-akhawunti asebhange namhlanje bayakwazi ukuthola imali besebenzisa wona belu amaselula ane-internet. Kuningi okushintshile nasezimbonini ngenxa yobuchwepheshe be-internet namakhompyutha. Eqinisweni luningi ushintsho oluzayo njengoba kudlondlobala i-artificial intelligence efundisa amarobhothi ubuhlakani obusezingeni labantu nagaphezulu. Kasisho amarobhothi asemgaqweni lapha, kepha sisho la marobhothi asebenza ezimbonini enza imisebenzi efana nokupenda izimoto, ukuthutha izimpahla nokunye. Okujabhisayo wukuthi lobu buchwepheshe buzonciphisa imisebenzi. Yingakho kufanele sicabange ngamathuba amabhizinisi eza nabo. Kuyimanje baningi abantu abacabanga ukwakha amabhulokisi okwakha ngesikhathi sekwenzeka ukuthi wakhe udonga lwendlu ngosuku olulodwa usebenzisa i-3D printer. Kuningi-ke okwenziwa yila ma-3D printer, ayakwazi ukwenza amathuluzi, izimpahla, amathambo ngisho namalungu omzimba. Lobu buchwepheshe sebuyasebenza kwamanye amazwe nakwezinye izimboni lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Okufanele sikwenze wukuthi sizijube sifune lolu lwazi ngoba umnotho wakusasa uzodinga bona ubuchwepheshe lobu. Maduze nje i-virtual tourism izoba undabuzekwayo lapho abantu bezovakashela amanye amazwe ngaphandle kokushiya amakhaya abo. Lokhu sekuyenzeka ngenxa ye-virtual reality (VR) ekuthatha ikubeke ezindaweni ezikude yize ungakaze usuke ekhaya. Eminyakeni ezayo izimoto zizobe zizishayela zona, zisebenzisa ugesi, okuyosho ukuphela kwamagaraji kaphethroli. Obunye ubuchwepheshe obunzulu butholakala kwezolimo. Ukudla esikuthenga ezitolo kukhiqizwa ngobuchwepheshe obuqinisekisa ukuthi kwanele futhi kuphephile. Ukunisela izitshalo emasimini kuncike ekutheni angakanani amanzi adingekayo ngokutshelwa ngubuxhakaxhaka bemishiin efakwe emhlabathini. Ama-drones, okungamabhanoyi amancanyana azindizelayo, asetshenziswa ukwelusa imfuyo nokuchelela izitshalo ngemithi. Bonke lobu buchwepheshe buzoba yisisekelo somnotho wakusasa kanti ithuba lokuhlomula yilo leli iningi lisalibele. Amanye amazwe ahamba phambili ngobuchwepheshe kanti la ezweni ezinye izinhlanga zingaphambili kwethu ndlu emnyama. Cabanga nje kuthiwa sinikwa ithuba lokumba igolide noma insimbi ezimayini ezabelwe thina. Singakwazi nje ukusuka ekuqaleni kungekho lutho sakhe imayini eqhudelana nezinye emhlabeni? Sinalo ulwazi oluphelele lobuchwepheshe obudingekayo? Wonke umnotho uphethwe noma uzophathwa yilobu buchwepheshe. Nakho ukutshalwa kwemali akusele ngaphandle kulolu shintsho oluza nobuchwepheshe. Kunenqwaba yama-Apps umhlaba wonke okuhweba amasheya nokukhetha izinkampani ongatshala kuzona imali. Ngaphandle kobuhlakani be-internet namakhompyutha bekungaba nzima ukukhetha amasheya azodla umhlanganiso. Ngisho yona imali ye-internet efana ne-bitcoin isebenza ngabo ubuchwepheshe. Kusobala-ke ukuthi ukuze ube namathuba okwenza kahle ekutshaleni imali, kufanele wazi ngalobu bucwepheshe. Kungenjalo siyogcina ngokuthola imvuthu ngoba singenazo izikhali zokulwa lempi yomnotho. Yize obunye balobu buchwepheshe sebukhona empilweni yethu, ushintsho oluningi lulindeleke kule minayaka engu-20 kuya kwengu-30 ezayo. Akulula ukubona kude kangaka kodwa iyona indlela yokusungula amabhizinisi ayizikhondlakhondla. Uma kungenzeki kithina kufanele kwenzeke ebantwaneni bethu. Ngeke kusisize ngalutho ukubeka izaba, izingane zethu kufanele ziqhubeke nalokho esesikuqaleli. Cishe iningi lethu angeke lisakwazi ukufunda umongo walobu buchwepheshe kodwa singafunda ngemisebenzi yakho ukuze sizibeke emathubeni okuhlomula ngokomnotho. Ngaleso sikhathi singakhuthaza izingane zethu ukuthi zifunde kabanzi ngobuchwepheshe ukuze zincintisane nezinye izinhlanga emhlabeni jikelele. Uma siqhubeka singazihluphi ngolwazi lobuchwepheshe siyosala sinkemile ziqhubeke ezinye izinhlanga zigibele emakhanda ethu. Sishayele ku-031 829 5820. UMNDENI wesitshudeni saseDUT esahlaselwa sabanjwa inkunzi khona enyuvesi uSandile Ndhlovu uthathwe uphuma enkantolo yaseMgungundlovu kuleli sonto njengoba umbulali uMsizi Mbutho egwetshwe udilikajele Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng/ (ANA) UMNDENI wesitshudeni saseDUT esahlaselwa sabanjwa inkunzi khona enyuvesi uSandile Ndhlovu uthathwe uphuma enkantolo yaseMgungundlovu kuleli sonto njengoba umbulali uMsizi Mbutho egwetshwe udilikajele Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng/ (ANA) UGWETSHWE udilikajele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu owesilisa ona-29 owayefunda eDurban University of Technology (DUT) owashiya izifundo wayoba yisigebengu. UMsizi Mbutho ugwetshwe ngecala lokubulala isitshudeni uSandile Ndhlovu (18), obenza unyaka wokuqala kwi-Industrial Engineering kusona lesi sikhungo. Umufi wayefunda ophikweni lwaseSteve Biko, eThekwini ngoSepthemba 9, lapho ashaywa khona ekhanda ngesando ngaphambi kokuthi abanjwe inkunzi. Likhipha isigwebo, iJaji uKhosi Hadebe, lithe akusaphephile kunoma yisiphi isikhungo semfundo “kusuka esikoleni samabanga aphansi kuze kufike emanyuvesi”. Ekhuluma ngaphandle kwenkantolo sekukhishwe isigwebo, uyise kamufi, uMnuz Sibusiso Ndhlovu (45) uthe bachitha izinsuku ezingu-10 eceleni kombhede kaSandile e-ICU bethandazela isimangaliso. “Satshelwa ngoSepthemba 10, ukuthi ingqondo yakhe ngeke isaphinde isebenze futhi salulekwa ukuba simkhiphe emishinini emgcine ephila. Sacela isikhathi esengeziwe futhi sathandazela ukuthi alulame ekulimaleni ekhanda. Ngangingakholwa ukuthi ukuphela kwengane esasinayo ayisekho. Manje ngibona sengathi akukho okungikhuthaza ukuthi ngiye emsebenzini ngoba ngisebenze kanzima ukuqinisekisa ikusasa eliqhakazile kuye,” kusho uNdhlovu. Into eyayinzima kakhulu kuye kwakuyilapho indodana yakhe ingasabizwa ngegama layo kodwa ikhonjwa ngenombolo, idluliswa isuka kwamanye amakhaza iyiswa kwamanye. “Usuku lo mame, usuku lobaba noKhisimusi ngeke kusaphinde kufane ngaphandle kwakhe.” Lo mndeni, odabuka eMpumalanga, kaweneme ngalesi sigwebo, ngoba uthi ngeke siyibuyise indodana. Yize kunjalo kodwa ukhululekile ngokuthi icala lifinyelele emaphethelweni. UMbutho, odabuka eClermont, obephume ngoshwele ejele ngamacala okugqekeza izindlu ngo-2014, waya eDUT wahlasela umufi kabili ngesando weba iselula yakhe ne-laptop. Inkantolo izwe ukuthi wake waba ngumfundi oqavile, owaqeda * -matric ngamalengiso, waya eDUT ukuyokwenza izifundo zeSocial Science kodwa wazishiya ngemuva kokuba sengozini yemoto lapho aphuka imilenze yomibili. Walulama ngokuphelele, yilapho-ke aqala khona ubugebengu Ngeledlule uMbutho uvume icala lokubulala uSandile. Encwadini yokuvuma icala, efundwe ngummeli wakhe * -Irshad Khan, uMbutho uthe waya eDUT eyontshontsha “noma yiziphi izinto ezikhala kahle”. “Ngikwenze lokhu ngenxa yokuphelelwa yithemba ngoba ngingasebenzi, ngingenamali futhi ngingenamathemba omsebenzi ongangingenisela imali,” kusho incwadi yakhe. UKhan ucele inkantolo icubungule isimo sikaMbutho, ibheke ukushonelwa uyise esafunda kanti unina washona ngonyaka wakhe wokuqala efunda eDUT. Ummeli woMbuso, uMnuz Bonginkosi Mbokazi, ukuchithile lokhu wathi uMbutho wanikezwa ithuba lesibili empilweni ngenkathi enikwa ushwele emuva kokugwetshwa ngaphambilini. “Uneminyaka engu-29, ufundile futhi uhlakaniphile. Kwakufanele azi kangcono. Irekhodi lakhe lezemfundo likhombisa ukuthi uhlakaniphile ngokwanele ukuthi azi ukuthi lokho akwenzile bekungalungile.” Uthe isenzo sikaMbutho asithetheleleki futhi akekho umzali okufanele adlule kulokhu abazali bakaSandile abadlule kukho. UMnuz Alan Khan, okhulumela iDUT, uthe bakhululekile ukuthi ubulungiswa benziwe nokuthi uMbutho utholwe enecala lokuhlasela okunobudlova ngakwenza kuSandile. “Yize sazi ukuthi lokhu ngeke kumbuyise uSandile, siyethemba ukuthi umndeni wakhe, abangani nalabo abefunda nabo bazoduduzwa wulwazi lokuthi umsolwa ubanjiwe, wagwetshwa ngempumelelo futhi wagwetshwa ngokufanele ngokuhlasela okunonya. Sengathi umphefumulo kaSandile ungaphumula ngokuthula,” kusho uKhan.
UMEMULO ubalulekile nawo emcimbini eyenzelwa izintombi, lapha uSibahle Mpisane ngenkathi enzelwe umemulo UMEMULO ubalulekile nawo emcimbini eyenzelwa izintombi, lapha uSibahle Mpisane ngenkathi enzelwe umemulo NJENGOBA namhlanje kuqala inyanga yokuqhakambisa amagugu eNingizimu Afrika, ongoti bathi sekuyisikhathi sokuthi abantu bakuleli abagcina amasiko athile bawenze ngendlela efanele, basiyeke kancane isilungu esesidla lubi uma kwenziwa le micimbi. Bathi kuningi nokubhimbiswa kwezinto osekubonakala, okwenza ukuthi abasuke begcinelwa leyo midanti babe nezinkinga ngoba isiko lingagcinwanga kahle. Ungoti wamasiko KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Nomagugu Ngobese, uthe abantu ake bayeke ukusebenzisa imali eningi benza imicimbi yesintu bayihlanganise nesilungu. “Imicimbi yesintu akumele yenziwe njengeyesilungu ngoba abantu bedlalisa imali. Kunemcimbi okungamele intombazane ize ikhule ingenzelwanga yona ekhaya. Umhlonyane, umemulo, umkhehlo nokugcagca ngezinye zezinto okumele zenziwe ngendlela ukuze izinto zilunge. Nokho le eqondene nomendo bangeke benzele wonke amantombazane ekhaya ngoba awagani wonke,”kusho uDkt Ngobese. Eqhuba uthe kuyihlazo ukuthi kunemizi egcina ixuba umemulo nephathi. Lezi zinto uthe azihlangani nhlobo. “Kuyenzeka eminye imizi ithenge notshwala, umuntu anikezwe nokhiye kade emula emini. “Ihlazo lelo. Iphathi nokhiye yisiko labelungu. Akumele lihlanganiswe nomemulo. Uma umzali ethanda nokwenza iphathi akakhethe olunye usuku,”kusho uDkt Nomagugu. Nazi ezinye izinto uDkt Ngobese athi abantu kumele bazenze ngendlela okuyiyo: : -Lesi yisigaba sokuqala ngqa sengane yentombazane esuke isithombile. Ihlatshelwa imbuzo, igongqe uma iqala ukuya esikhathini. Kulowo mgongqo isuke inikwa iziyalo ngoshintsho olusuke luzoba khona ngomzimba wayo njengoba isithombile nje. Ngenxa yokuthi yonke into idinga imali, kuyenzeka ukuthi abazali bangakwazi ukuyenzela ngaleso sikhathi ikade iqala ukuya esikhathini. Uma sekwenziwa umcimbi, intombazane ihlala nontanga bayo begcobe ibomvu, okuwuphawu lokugongqa. Abafana abavunyelwe ukusondela kulowo mgongqo. -Umemulo kusuke sekuyisigaba sesibili lapho ingane yentombazane seyikhulile yahamba phezu kweziyalo eyazinikwa ngabazali ngesikhathi yenzelwe umhlonyane. Uyise wayo usuke esebonga ukuziphatha kahle kwayo eyikhulisa phambi kwabantu. Endulo ngenxa yokuthi bekungafundwa kungasetshenzwa, owesifazane ubethi uma enzelwa lo mcimbi kube yindlela yokumnika imvume yokuthi usengakhethwa yinsizwa ayiqome noma agane. -Intombi isuke seyidlulile kulezi zigaba ezingenhla yaze yaqoma yagana. Uyise usuke eseyikhehlisa ngoba isuke isilungela ukuyogana komunye umuzi. Endulo lokhu bekwenziwa nangokuthi owesifazane enziwe uhlobo oluthile lwesitayela sasekhanda, esihlobe ngezinto ezahlukene. Lo mhlobiso wasekhanda ubuwenziwa abesifazane ababizwa ngokuthi yizinyanga zekhanda ebezikwazi ukwenza isitayela sasekhanda esihlukanisa owesifazane oseganile ezintombini. Esikhathini samanje lokhu sekwenziwa ngezicholo zesimanje ezihlobe ngezimpaphe, ubuhlalu nezinkinobho. -Usuke usulandela konke lokhu okungenhla, lapho intombi isuke isiphuma ekhaya seyiyohlala emzini ngokusemthethweni. Esikhathini samanje kwenziwa ngendlela ehlukile neyakudala njengoba sekuthengwa nezimpahla zasendlini nezitsha nemiswenko ngenxa yezinga lempilo esiphilwa.

Lo wesifazane oneminyaka engu-32 uthe uthole iqiniso ngalo mdlalo ngemuva kokuba indodana yakhe eneminyaka eyisikhombisa imtshele ukuthi inukubezwe ngokocansi ngabafana emgwaqweni ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule. Uthe kwakuwu-Okthoba 4, indodana yakhe nabangani bayo bedlala ekhaya ngesikhathi edalula le mfihlo. “Umfana wami wathi abafana abathathu bamthatha emgwaqweni bamyisa kubo komfana omdala lapho bamgingqela khona embhedeni bamkhombisa izithombe zabantu abenza imikhuba etafuleni,” kusho umama. “Wafaka i-lipstick kuye futhi wanikezwa amakhekhe netiye kanye nabanye abafana ababili, base bedlwengula indodana yami, kunomunye umfana wesine owayebukela. Abaphenyi basathungatha abagilwa abangakawabikeli amaphoyisa ngokubehlele,” kusho uRwexana. -ANA
INDAWO okuthiwa uMnuz Michael Chikura waseZimbabwe watholakala elenga kuyo ngeSonto, okusolwa ukuthi ubenonkhwantalala emuva kokuthunjwa ngoNcibijane INDAWO okuthiwa uMnuz Michael Chikura waseZimbabwe watholakala elenga kuyo ngeSonto, okusolwa ukuthi ubenonkhwantalala emuva kokuthunjwa ngoNcibijane KUSOLWA ukuthi uzikhunge ngenxa yokhwantalala oludalwe ukubanjwa inkunzi nokuthunjwa owesilisa waseZimbabwe otholakale elenga emgwaqweni omkhulu eVerulam ngeSonto. UMnuz Michael Chikura (24) kuthiwa bekusaphele isonto esinde esehlakalweni sokuthunjwa, waphucwa noR600 ngamadoda angaziwa. Isitatimende esithunyelwe yinkampani yabezimo eziphuthumayo, iReaction Unit South Africa (RUSA), siveza ukuthi uChikura obehlala eWaterloo, watholakala elenga esihlahleni emgwaqweni uR102 eduze kwebhuloho eVerulam. Ngokusho kukamfowabo, uChikura ubeseneminyaka emithathu ehlala kuleli. Uthe ngoNcibijane umufi wathathwa ngamadoda angaziwa amshaya, amfaka ebhuthini yemoto aze ayombeka eNorth Beach. Kuthiwa washaywa amahora ayisihlanu, abahlaseli bamshiya becabanga ukuthi useshonile. Kuvela ukuthi waphucwa iPassport nemali. “Watholwa amaphoyisa wayiswa esibhedlela kwavulwa necala lokuthunjwa nokuzama ukubulala. Kusukela kwenzeke lesi sehlakalo akazange aphinde abe sesimeni esikahle ngoba ubesaba ukuthi abahlaseli bangabuya bazomqedela. Kungenzeka ukuthi yikona lokhu okudale ukuthi azilengise,” kusho isitatimende. Umndeni ucela noma ubani onolwazi ngokuthunjwa kukamufi ukuthi axhumane namaphoyisa noma iRUSA ku-086 1234 333. Imizamo yokuthola umndeni wakhe yephunzile njengoba kuthiwe usuyolungiselela umngcwabo eZimbabwe. Isidumbu siChikura sabonwa amalungu omphakathi ayedlula emgwaqweni ngezithuba zabo-6 ekuseni. Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni uColonel Thembeka Mbele uthe kuvulwe idokodo lokufa komuntu eliphenywa amaphoyisa aseVerulam. Uthe amaphoyisa ayaphenya.
UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu- Natal uNkk Weziwe Thusi. Isithombe: Nqobile Mbonambi/African News Agency(ANA) UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu- Natal uNkk Weziwe Thusi. Isithombe: Nqobile Mbonambi/African News Agency(ANA) MHLELI: Sidinga ukushayelwa ihlombe isimemezelo sikaNgqongqoshe woMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu- Natal uNkk Weziwe Thusi. Ngokombiko weSolezwe ngo-Okthoba 8, 2018 ungqongqoshe ugqugquzele abantu ukuthi bahlele imindeni enkulumeni okuthiwa ayethule ngeWorld Population Day. Empeleni kufanele ngabe bonke abaholi yivangeli abalishumayela ngokukhulu ukukhuthala leli lokukhuthaza abantu ukuhlela umndeni. Ivangeli lokuhlelwa komndeni yinto esiyidinga cishe ukudlula zonke izinto esizolokhu sicefezelwa ngazo njengoba kuza imikhankaso yokhetho maduzane nje. Kuliqiniso elaziwayo ukuthi ububha okuhlasele abantu abamnyama kubuye kubangelwe nayikho ukuzalwa kwezingane kungaziwa nokuthi zizokondleka kanjani. Akusavamisile ukuzwa abantu bekhuluma inkulumo ebaluleke njengalena eyethulwe nguNkk Thusi. Eminyakeni edlule ihhovisi likaNdunankulu wesifundazwe saKwaZulu Natal lamemezela ukuthi linemali eyizigidi elizoyisebenzisa ukulwa nama-blesser. Kuyadabukisa ukusho ukuthi leyo mali kwagcina kungacacanga kahle ukuthi yabe izosetshenziswa kanjani ukuze ihlenge eyabe iphume egameni labo. Mhlawumbe bekungakuhle leyo mali uma kungukuthi isakhona iphinde isetshenziswe ukuphusha imikhankaso yokuqwashisa mayelana nokuhlela umndeni.Yize indaba yokuhlela umndeni ithinta wonke umuntu kodwa kungaba ngumqondo omuhle ukuthi imikhankaso enjalo igxiliswe kakhulu entsheni ikakhulu ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasemijondolo. Ucwaningo lwami lukhomba ukuthi abesilisa nabesifazane abasebasha bathola izingane besafunda isikole. Baqeda isikole noma bashiye phakathi bayosebenza emadolobheni amakhulu bafike bahlale ezindaweni eziyimijondolo nasemahostela baqhubeke nokuthola izingane ngaphandle kokuqondisisa kahle isimo sabo sezomnotho. Nezingane ezisuke zizalelwe ezindaweni ezingahlelekile nazo ziyakhula ziqhubeke nokuzalela khona lapho zikhulele khona. Izingane abazithola edolobheni bazihambisa emakhaya lapho bevela khona. Nakhona emakhaya kusuke kunezingane abazishiye khona abazithola besafunda isikole. Abanye bazigcina khona emadolobheni zikhulele emijondolo ngezizathu ezahlukene. Yize izingane ezizalwe zakhulela emalokishini zizalisana kodwa kuvamise ukuthi emva kokuthola ingane eyodwa zingabe zisaqhubeka nokuzala kuze kube yisikhathi esifanele. Kungalezi zizathu ngithi ukugqugquzelwa kokuhlela umndeni kufanele kuhanjiswe nakakhulu ezindaweni engizibalule ngenhla. Mhlawumbe namabandla amahlelo ahlukene kungakuhle abambisane nezinhlaka zikahulumeni ukuphusha lo mkhankaso. Ngokombiko we-United Nations eminyakeni engu 50 ezayo isibalo sabantu emhlabeni kulindeleke senyukele ku-9 billion. Ngokwe-United Nations kumele kuqhanyukwe nezindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ukudla ukuze abantu bezoba nokudla okwanele emhlabeni jikelele.Umbiko we-United Nations usitshela ukuthi ukwanda kwabantu kumele kuhambisane nokubakhona kokudla. Impela kuzofanele siyisukumele sonke le ndaba ngoba iKZN ihlala ihamba phambili uma kukhulunywa ngezinto ezinomthelela omubi kwinhlalakahle yomphakathi. Eugene Biyela
