UNkk Sylvia Dladla owake waba ngumholi we-IFP Women’s Brigade ovakashelwe ngumholi weqembu inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi kade engena umuzi nomuzi eMlaza izolo ngoSuku lwamaLungelo aBantu UNkk Sylvia Dladla owake waba ngumholi we-IFP Women’s Brigade ovakashelwe ngumholi weqembu inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi kade engena umuzi nomuzi eMlaza izolo ngoSuku lwamaLungelo aBantu UMENGAMELI we-IFP, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi uxwayisa uhulumeni we-ANC ngokuthi kumele uluphathise okwezikhali zamaNtungwa udaba lokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, ukugwema ukuthi izwe lingagcini selifana neZimbabwe. Ekhuluma emcimbini wokugubha uSuku lwamaLungelo aBantu eKing Zwelithini Stadium eMlaza izolo, uButhelezi uthe udaba lomhlaba lujulile akumele lusingathwe noma yikanjani. “Ngikhuluma nje abantu baseZimbabwe bagcwele lapha eNingizimu Afrika ngoba bebalekela ukuhlupheka okukhona ezweni labo kusukela kwathathwa umhlaba kwabamhlophe. Nathi vele siyazihluphekela njengoba iningi lisaphila ngaphansi kwendlala. Umbuzo wami uthi sifuna ukuhlupheka phezu kwalokho esinakho?” Kubuza uButhelezi. Uthe umnotho waseZimbabwe ubuqinile ulandela owaseNingizimu Afrika kodwa manje usudonsa kanzima. “Obengumengameli waseZimbabwe, uMnuz Robert Mugabe ulibulele izwe lakhe ngokusingatha budlabha udaba lokuthathwa komhlaba. Kuhle ngoba leli zwe lingomakhelwane bethu. Kumele ngabe kukhona esikufundile khona,” kusho uButhelezi. Uthe bayamuzwa uMengameli we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ethi umhlaba uzothathwa kodwa kumele kwenziwe isiqiniseko sokuthi umkhiqizo wokudla awuphazamiseki. “Sithule silindele ukubona ukuthi kuzokwenzakani,” kusho uButhelezi. Uthe i-IFP ayikanqumi ukuthi imi kuphi odabeni lokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Njengoba uqina umkhankaso we-ANC wokuthi kubuyiswe umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, sekukhona amazwe asentshonalanga asesabise ngokuthi azolinswinywa leli uma like lawuqhuba lo mkhankaso. Uphinde waxwayiswa ngesiphakamiso sokuthi kufakwe izimayini nokunye ngaphansi kukahulumeni. “Thina sikhulele khona kwi-ANC. Into ebikhulunywa wukuthi kufakwe izinto ngaphansi kukahulumeni. Nami ngaze ngahamba ngayohlangana nowayengumengameli waseTanzania ongasekho, uMnuz Julius Nyerere okunguye owayethathwa njengobaba wase-Afrika, ephusha indaba yokufakwa kwezinto ngaphansi kukahulumeni. Yena futhi uNyerere wabuye washintsha wasixwayisa ngokuthi udaba lokufaka izinto ngaphansi kukahulumeni lulibulele izwe lakhe,” kusho uButhelezi. Uthe ngesikhathi umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema efike kuyena ezoxolisa ngemuva kokumdelela, wamxwayisa ngodaba lokufakwa kwezimayini ngaphansi kukahulumeni. “Kuyabokalala ukuthi uMalema akazange angilalele njengoba esaqhubeka nalolu daba. Kodwa isisho sesiZulu siyasho ukuthi isalakutshelwa sibona ngomopho,” kusho uButhelezi. Uphinde wasola uMalema ngokukhomba ngomunwe isihlalo seSilo Samabandla uGoodwill Zwelithini, ngokuthi athi akuthathwe kungaphansi kwaso. Uthe inkulumo kaMalema ethi iSilo akumele sisatshwe kodwa kumele sihlonishwe, ayizange yehle kahle. “Kade kwasa ngithukwa ngodaba lomhlaba. Ukuba izinhlamba ziyahlala ebusweni ngabe angisabonakali,” kusho uButhelezi. Wengeze ngokuthi wathatha isinqumo sokuthi achibiyele umthetho iNgonyama Trust ngo-1994 ngoba wayefuna ukuvikela amanenjana omhlaba ayesesele kowase uthathwe ngabamhlophe. UButhelezi uphinde wakhala ngokuthi yize leli selibe ngaphansi kwentando yeningi iminyaka engu-24 kodwa iningi labantu lisaphila ngaphansi kobubha. Uthe isikhumbuzo somgubho wamalungelo abasikhumbuli ngokuzila kodwa ngokuqinisekisa ekuvikelwa kwamalungelo abantu.
KUTHIWA abesifazane akumele balwe bodwa uma bebanga indoda kodwa kumele balwisane nayo njengomqali wendaba KUTHIWA abesifazane akumele balwe bodwa uma bebanga indoda kodwa kumele balwisane nayo njengomqali wendaba KUPHELA ngisho ubungani kwabesifazabe uma kubangwa indoda, bagcina sebelwa bodwa. Akujwayelekile ukuthi uma abesifazane sebethole ukuthi indoda ibabhangqile balwe nayo kodwa baklwebhana bodwa. Lo mkhuba kade waqala njengoba nasezikoleni bekunomkhuba odume ngokuthi ipero, lapho abesifazane babelindana sekuphume isikole belwela ukuthi bajola nomfana oyedwa. Yize nabesilisa belwa bebanga intombi, uNksz Zola Dudeni oyiPsychologist uthi abafana kuyenzeka badlulise uma bebanga intombi kusajolwa nje. Kwehlukile lokhu kwabesifazane athe ngisho bekade bengabangani uma kuke kwabangwa indoda kuphela konke. Uthe yindlela abadalwe ngayo abesifazane eyenza ukuthi bebodwa bangasekani futhi bangaziboni bebalulekile. Uthe isikhathi esiningi abakwenzayo ukujabulisa owesilisa abazi ukuthi yilona joka abanalo. “Owesifazane wadalelwa ukujabulisa owesilisa ngoba ngisho intombazane ingakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yasendlini, abadala bayibuza ukuthi iyokwenzenjani endodeni. Lokhu kwenza owesifazane akhule azi ukuthi kumele ajabulise indoda kukho konke akwenzayo. Uma owesifazane ethole ukuthi babanga indoda eyodwa nomunye, ulwisa umnakwabo hhayi indoda." Uveze ukuthi kumele ngabe yindoda okuliwa nayo ngoba iyona eshelayo kodwa akwenzeki lokho. “Kuke kwaduma indaba yokubizana ngo-star kwabesifazane ababanga indoda. Lelo gama alipheli ngisho indoda ingasathandani nabo. Uma abesifazane beke babanga indoda abaphinde bazwane. Abafana kwesinye isikhathi uma bebanga intombi bagcina bezwana bodwa, babone owesifazane kunguye onephutha bambize nangamagama alumelayo." Umbhali uNksz Nancy Roxanne waseKenya, esihlokweni esikhuluma ngombango wamadoda kwi-website, i-Eve Woman uthe kuwubuwula ukuthi abesifazane balwe bodwa. Uthe kumele balwise indoda bobabili. Uthe indoda emthanda ngempela owesifazane ngeke imbeke esimeni sokuthi kumele ancintisane nomunye othandweni. “Kuyihlazo futhi kwehlisa isithunzi ukubona abesifazane abahle bechitha isikhathi ngokubanga indoda. Abanye bathukana ngisho ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bebanga indoda yona esuke iziphumulele. Uma ujola kumele wazi ukuthi asikho isiqiniseko sokuthi indoda izothembeka kuwena." Ukhuthaza ukuthi uma owesifazane ebamba ukuthi indoda imbhangqile, ungalinge ulwise umnakwenu, ilwa nendoda. Uthe abanye baze baqhoshelane ngokuthi ubani oyintombi yangempela neshende kodwa iqiniso ukuthi bobabili basuke benziwe izilima yindoda. “Asikho isicoco sokulwela indoda. Kunalokho indoda inibona nobabili ngingaphusile ukuthi ningalwa nodwa nibanga yona.”

Bangaphezu kuka-10 abafundi okuthiwa bakhishwe ephepheni sebezobhala kwathiwa ukuze bakwazi ukubhala izivivinyo zokuchibiyela ngonyaka ozayo, abalande izincwadi zodokotela ukuze kube sengathi babegula yingakho bengakwazanga ukubhala. Ingane imtshele ukuthi akuyona yodwa kodwa baningi nabanye abafundi abanqatshelwe bakhishwa sebebhala. “Ibuhlungu le nto ngoba ingane yami kwi-timetable yayo kubhalwe ukuthi izozibhala zonke izifundo. Ilibhalile iphepha lokuqala leMaths ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule, elesibili akhishwe kulona,” kusho umzali. Uthe akazi uzoyithathaph imali yencwadi kadokotela ngoba akanayo. “Ingane yami yadudulelwa kwa-matric kodwa bengazi ukuthi izibhala zonke izifundo,” kusho umzali. Uthe uma umfundi eduduliwe kumele atshelwe ukuthi nazi izifundo azozibhala ezinye azibhale ngonyaka olandelayo. “Akukwazi ukuthi angakhishwa esezobhala ngoba kwa-timetable yakhe bekumele ifike inezifundo ezimbalwa azozibhala. Sifuna ukwazi emnyangweni ukuthi ngabe kuvumelekile yini ukuthi izingane zethu zikhishwe ephepheni zingabhali kuthiwe asilande incwadi kadokotela,” kusho umzali. Omunye umzali naye ocele ukungavezwa, uthe ingane yakhe ayizange ibhale iphepha lesibili leMaths ikhishwe isizobhala. Uthe udidekile ngoba ingane ibuye yamtshela ukuthi esinye isizathu esenze bakhishwe nezinye izingane ngukuthi abazange babekhona ngesikhathi kubuyekezwa isifundo. “Ingane yami yaphasa kahle kwaGrade 11 yayingadudulwanga. Ne-timetable yayo iyasho ukuthi izibhala zonke izifundo okubalwa kuzo iMaths iphepha lokuqala nelesibili obekumele ilibhale ngoMsombuluko kodwa eyakhishwa yangalibhala,” kusho umzali. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, uthe akekho uthisha okumele anqabele umfundi ukuthi abhale izivivinyo. Sizobe sesithatha izinyathelo ezifanele.” Ngonyaka ozayo abafundi bazobhala kanye izivivinyo ngoJuni njengoba zingasekho ezokuchibiyela ebezibhalwa ngoMashi.

Isithombe: Dimpho Maja / African News Agency (ANA) UMVIKELI woMphakathi u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane uthe bazohlangana enkantolo noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngodaba lomnikelo awuthola enkampanini iBosasa njengoba elwenze ngendlela uphenyo lwakhe. Usho lokhu nje kulandela isinqumo sikaRamaphosa sokuthi uzoya enkantolo eyophikisana nombiko ka-Advocate Mkhwebane lapho ethe wakhohlisa iPhalamende ngodaba lwalo mnikelo kaR500 000 wokuxhasa umkhankaso wakhe wokuba nguMengameli we-ANC ngo-2017. “Nginabo bonke ubufakazi ngalolu daba sizoveza yonke into enkantolo. Udaba ngiludlulisele ophikweni lwezokushushisa ukuze kube yilona oluzophenya udaba lwalo mnikelo nokuthi kwabakhona ukushushumbiswa kwemali,” kusho u-Advocate Mkhwebane. Usole uRamaphosa ngokuthi washesha ukuphendula umbuzo weDA ngalolu daba ePhalamende engenalo ulwazi olugcwele. “Kwakumele alinde aze athole umbiko ogcwele, angasheshi aphendule. Kwakungewona umbuzo wokuqala kodwa kwakuwumbuzo olandelayo yingakho sasingekho isidingo sokuthi asheshe aphendule,” kusho u -Advocate Mkhwebane. Uthe uze waphenya udaba lwalo mnikelo ngoba kwafakwa isikhalazo yiDA. “Uma nabanye ababengenele umbango wokuhola i-ANC kuthiwa asibaphenye ngiyokwenza nalokho. URamaphosa ngimphenye ngoba kufakwe isikhalazo abanye asikaze sifakwe isikhalazo ngabo,” kusho uAdv Mkhwebane. Ukuchithile ukuthi ungumuntu kalowo owayenguMengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngoba nguyena owasayina incwadi yokumqasha. “UZuma waqoka uMengameli wamaJaji, owayenguMvikeli woMphakathi u-Advocate Thuli Madonsela waqokwa nguZuma ngakho ungathi bonke labo abantu baZuma? Mina ngaphakanyiswa iPhalamende emuva kokufakwa imibuzo nabanye ababegaqele lesi sikhundla kubuka wonke umuntu wakuleli,” kusho yena. Khonamanjalo, iDA ifuna iPhalamende lisheshise uhlelo lokukhipha esikhundleni u-Advocate Mkhwebane emuva kokuba iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo imchithile yathi waqamba amanga odabeni oluthinta uphenyo lweBhange loMbuso. Inkantolo enkulu yachitha isinqumo sakhe sokuthi ibhange i-Absa kumele libuyise uR1.1 billion kwibhange lombuso ngoba latakulwa leli bhange ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi angazithola esekhokha imali ecela kuR900 000 ephaketheni lakhe wezindleko zecala. Inkantolo ithole ukuthi akazange ahambise ngendlela uma enza uphenyo futhi waqamba amanga, wangalandela imigomo yehhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi.

UButhelezi unxuse amakhosi ukuthi ayibheke kahle indaba yokuvotela i-ANC ngoba sekucacile ukuthi ayiyingeni indaba yawo. Uthe umhlaba kumele uvikelwe njengoba kwenza okhokho babo belwa nabamhlophe ngesikhathi beqola umhlaba. IPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezaBasebenzi, Inkosi Phathekile Holomisa, lithe umhlaba ngowamakhosi lathi kumele awuvikele kunoma ngubani ofuna ukuwaphuca. “Uma kufika umuntu ezothatha umhlaba amadoda endawo kumele asukume alwe, amaphoyisa kumele afike sekukhona okwenzekile,” kusho uHolomisa. USihlalo weNgonyama Trust, iJaji Jerome Ngwenya ukhulume kabanzi ngodaba lwamatayitela wathi abantu bafunzwa imfundisoze ngawo ukuze babone kunesidingo sokuthi amakhosi aphucwe umhlaba. “Abantu batshelwa ukuthi izindawo zamakhosi azinamatayitela lokho okusho ukuthi akuzona izindawo zabo lezi abahlezi kuzona okuyinto engesilo iqiniso,” kusho uNgwenya. Uthe imfundiso yaseNtshonalanga efakwe kubantu kuthiwe amatayitela abalulekile wathi ingakho abantu kuthiwa ababambise ngezindlu zabo uma beboleka imali emabhange.

Ngokwempendulo kangqongqoshe wezeMfundo kulesi sifundazwe, uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane, abalelwa ku-33 amacala okunukubeza ngokocansi avuliwe ngo-2017/18. Uthe kumele kube nendlela yokuqopha bonke othisha abatholwa benecala lokunukubeza ngokocansi ukuze bengakwazi ukubalekela kwezinye izifundazwe.

UMENGAMELI we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ebingelela izinkumbi zabalandeli bale nhlangano ngesikhathi efika enkundleni yemidlalo iMoses Mabhida, eThekwini ngoMgqibelo njengoba ebethula umhlamhlandlela wokhetho njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi kube nokhetho ngoMeyi nonyaka UMENGAMELI we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ebingelela izinkumbi zabalandeli bale nhlangano ngesikhathi efika enkundleni yemidlalo iMoses Mabhida, eThekwini ngoMgqibelo njengoba ebethula umhlamhlandlela wokhetho njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi kube nokhetho ngoMeyi nonyaka Isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal sibaluleke kakhulu emlandweni nasekusimameni kwe-ANC. Lo mlando wacishe washabalala ngeminyaka yawo-1990 lapho khona osomathuba bakha isithombe okungesona bethi i-ANC ngeyamaXhosa, i-IFP ngeyamaZulu. Isinqumo sobuholi be-ANC sokubamba ingqungquthela yohlu lwabazongena ephalamende likazwelonke nawezifundazwe, inkulumo yaminyaka yonke eyaziwa ngeJanuary 8 Statement nokwethulwa kwemigomo yokhetho yeqembu eThekwini sikhumbuza iNingizimu Afrika ngokubaluleka kwalesi sifundazwe kwi-ANC. Kungani iKwaZulu-Natal ibalulekile kwi-ANC? Lapha ngizobalula izizathu ezimbalwa. Esokuqala ukuthi umholi wokuqala we-ANC owakhethwa engekho kwingqungquthela eyabanjelwa eBloemfontein kwaba nguDkt John Langalibalele Mafukuzela Dube. Abanye abahola i-ANC besuka kulesi sifundazwe singabala uMnuz JT Gumede, uDkt Pixley kaSeme, iNkosi Albert Luthuli noMnuz Jacob Zuma. INkosi uLuthuli yaqokwa ngo-1952 ukuthi ihole i-ANC ezikhathini ezinzima kulandela ukwamukelwa kwe-Apartheid njengohlelo lukahulumeni kaDkt DF Malan. Wasebenza ngokuzikhandla waze wazuza indondo yokuthula, iNobel Peace Prize, ngoDisemba wonyaka ka-1961. Isizathu sesibili ukuthi uDkt Nelson Mandela wethula inkulumo yakhe yokugcina KwaZulu-Natal. Waphinde waboshelwa khona (eHowick) eqhuba umsebenzi wakhe njengomholi we-ANC. Ekuphumeni kwakhe ejele emva kweminyaka engu-27 wabuyela KwaZulu-Natal eyobikela abaholi bakhe abafana noDube ukuthi inkululeko ababeyilwela yabe isisemnyango ngoba izwe labe selilungisela ukhetho lokuqala lwentando yeningi. Okubaluleke kakhulu futhi ukuthi uMandela wavotela kusona lesi sifundazwe, hhayi eMthatha lapho ayedabuka khona. Isizathu sesithathu ukuthi i-KZN yisifundazwe esikhulu kunazo zonke ngokwezibalo zamalungu e-ANC. Muva nje i-Eastern Cape isuswe yiMpumalanga endaweni yesibili kodwa iKZN yalokhu imile izihola phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iKZN iwumgogodla we-ANC. Isizathu sesine ukuthi kube neziwombe ezinzima kwi-ANC nombimbi lapho esibone khona kuchitheka igazi umkhonto ugwaza ekhaya. Lokhu kwenze lwangabikho uzinzo kwi-ANC nombimbi. I-SACP ize yesabisa ngokuthi izongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela. Lesi yisimo esafaka amanzi emadolweni esizweni sonkana. Ngenhlanhla iSACP igcine isishintshile lesinqumo sayo. Isizathu sesihlanu nokungesokugcina ukuthi udaba lukaZuma obengumengameli we-ANC nowezwe alusingathwanga ngobunono. Kunalokho ubuholi beqembu namanye amalungu e-ANC asebenzisa imizwa, inzondo nokuba ngosomathuba angasicabangela isithunzi seqembu nekusasa lezwe. Lobu budedengu badala isimo esimanzonzo i-ANC yahlukana phakathi. Ukungenzi kahle kweqembu okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2016 lwenza isimo saba sibi kakhulu. Isipikili sokugcina kwaba ukuphoqwa kukaZuma wubuholi beqembu ukuba esule njengomengameli wezwe. Lesi sinqumo sanyakazisa izwe lonke kodwa ikakhulu isifundazwe iKZN. Ngenxa yalezi zizathu bekufanele ukuthi ubuholi be-ANC bucabange bujule ngeqhaza le KZN bese buthatha izinqumo eziphusile. Ukubanjwa kwale micimbi esengiyibalile eKZN kuzuze izinto eziningi. Phakathi kokunye singabala ukubhula umlilo odalwe yizinqumo ezinobudedengu ezathathwa ubuholi beqembu. Okwesibili nokufanele kushayelwe ihlombe ukukhumbuza isizwe ngokubaluleka kweKZN emlandweni we-ANC. Okokugcina ukuqinisa amathuba e-ANC okuthi iphumelele ukhetho luka zwelonke oluzayo. IKZN iyinsika ye-ANC.

Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng/African News Agency(ANA) ABALANDELI beMeya yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede basabisa ngokuthatha izinyathelo uma ingabuyiselwa emsebenzini njengoba inikwe ikhefu ngemuva kwamacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa athinta ithenda yezigidi yokuqoqwa kukadoti. Abalandeli bakaNkk Gumede izolo bebebhikisha edolobheni bezwakalisa ilaka labo ngemuva kokuthi i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal yelule isikhathi ikhefu lakhe kuze kube yenza isimemezelo ekuqaleni kuka-Agasti. Abalandeli bagasele emahhovisi kamasipala eCity Hall bakhipha abasebenzi. NgoLwesithathu babe nomlindelo bekhulekela umholi wabo. Ngaphandle kwaseCity Hall kusuke esinamathambo amaphoyisa abeqaphe isimo ededela isibhaxu kubalandeli bemeya kubalwa nezintatheli. Amaphoyisa abonakale ebamba ngesidlozane intatheli ye-Independent Media, uMnuz Sihle Mavuso oze waboshwa kodwa wabuye wadedelwa. Bayisikhombisa abantu ababoshiwe kubalwa nabaholi bemashi. Kuthiwa bathathu abalimele ngemuva kokudutshulwa ngezinhlamvu zenjoloba. Ababhikishi basuke eCity Hall baya eGugu Dlamini Park maqede baphikelela emahhovisi e-ANC. EGugu Dlamini baphakelwe ukudla ukuthiba iphango. Emahhovisi e-ANC akekho okhulume nabo basuka khona baya esiteshini samaphoyisa beyophoqa ukuthi kudedelwe abaholi ababoshiwe. Abazange bangene esiteshini eDurban Central ngoba amaphoyisa abesebalinde ngaphandle abahlakaza ngokudubula emoyeni, efutha nesisi esikhalisa unyembezi. Omunye okhulumela abalandeli bemeya, uMnuz Sduduzo Magwaza, usabise ngokuthi sebezothatha izinyathelo zomthetho uma ingabuyiselwa emsebenzi. “Into esilethe lapha wukuthi sizophoqa ukuthi imeya ivunyelwe iqhubeke nomsebenzi wayo,” kusho uMagwaza. Uthe banezinyathelo eziningi abangazithatha ukulungisa lolu daba. “Sizoqhubeka nokufaka ingcindezi sixoxe nobuholi besifundazwe ngoba thina singabantu abawuqondayo umbutho, uma singanelisekile ngesikunikwa wubuholi besifundazwe sizodlulela ebuholini bukazwelonke nalapho uma singagciliseki sizophoqeleka ukuthi sisebenzise umthetho, ngoba siyakholelwa ekutheni isinqumo sesifundazwe asikho emthethweni,” kusho uMagwaza. Izolo isimo besishubile eThekwini njengoba kuphazamiseke nokuhamba kwezimoto ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umbhikisho. Ngaphandle kwasesiteshini iDurban Central abalandeli bakaGumede bacishe babambana ngezandla namaphoyisa ngemuva kokuthi edubule emoyeni, bewasola ngokusebenzisa izindlela zamaphoyisa obandlululo. Khona izolo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umbhikisho, kusabalale nemibiko ethi imenenja yoMkhandlu uMnuz Sipho Nzuza isisulile emsebenzini. UNzuza ungufakazi woMbuso ecaleni elithinta imeya. Okhulumela uMkhandlu weTheku uMnuz Msawakhe Mayisela uthe amanga aluhlaza ukuthi uNzuza usulile. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Thembeka Mbele uthe bayisikhombisa abantu ababoshiwe mayelana namacala okudala uthuthuva emphakathini. Uthe kukhona nentatheli eboshiwe kodwa yabuye yadedelwa. “Kunecala lokushaya nokudicilela phansi isithunzi eliphenywayo elibekwe intatheli,” kusho uMbele.
IZAZI zomnotho zidonse ngendlebe abantu ukuthi babophe izifociya ngoba kuzoshuba njengoba sekuzozwakala ukunyuka kwentengo ekhokhwa uma uthenga impahla, iValue Added Tax (VAT) enyuke ngo-1% isuka ku-14% yaya ku-15%. UMnuz Jason Urbach oyisazi somnotho kwiFree Market Foundation, uthe ukunyuka kweVAT kuzoshubisa ngoba kuzozwela kuwo wonke umuntu. “Abantu kufanele babophe izifociya ngoba intela izobaphilisa kabuhlungu. Abampofu bazoyikhokha iVAT ngoba akudliwa impuphu kuphela kodwa bayayidla inyama nokunye okuningi. Bazokhokha kakhulu noma begibela ngoba ukunyuka kwentela kaphethroli kusho ukuthi osomatekisi bazonyusa imali yokugibela, ukuze benze inzuzo,” kusho u-Urbach. UNobhala weCosatu KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Edwin Mkhize, uthe namhlanje bazoqhinqa ngaphandle kwamahhovisi oMnyango wezeziMali eMgungundlovu, emgwaqweni uChief Albert Luthuli ngoba bafuna yehliswe iVAT. “Silindele ukuthi uhulumeni wethu njengoba ehlale ethi uyabalalela abantu, asilalele ayehlise iVAT ngoba ihlukumeza wonke umuntu. Yebo kukhona ukudla okuthiwa uma ukuthenga ngeke uyikhokhe iVAT kodwa lokhu akuwususi umthwalo emahlombe abantu. Sifuna uhulumeni ayehlise iVAT,” kusho uMkhize. Uthe banethemba lokuthi uhulumeni uzoyehlisa iVAT ngoba umkhankaso wabo wokuthi yehle uyaqhubeka. UMengameli weCosatu, uMnuz Sdumo Dlamini uthe baxoxe nobuholi be-ANC ngodaba lweVAT kodwa bebengakaxoxi noMnyango wezeziMali. Uthe sebeqalile ukumasha ngoba bafuna ukuthumela umyalezo ocacile wokuthi abahambisani nokunyuka kweVAT. Khona manjalo inkampani ekhiqiza ukudla iWillowton Group, iveze ukuthi ngeke iyinyuse iVAT ngo-Ephreli, Meyi nangoJuni ukuze ivikele abathengi. Isikhulu esiphezulu seWillowton Group, uMnuz Zubeir Moosa sithe bayazi ukuthi iVAT izoshubisela abathengi yingakho bekhethe ukungayinyusi kuyo yonke imikhiqizo yabo okungenani izinyanga ezintathu. “Sicela nezinye izinkampani zingayinyusi iVAT izinyanga ezimbalwa, ukuze abathengi bangathwali kanzima,” kunxusa uMoosa.

Isithombe: NQOBILE MBONAMBI/INLSA ZISABISA ngokuphinda zivale umgwaqo kusasa izitshudeni zase-University of South Africa (UNISA), eThekwini uma zingayitholi incazelo ecacile mayelana nokuxhaswa kwazo yisikhwama sezimali iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme, iNSFAS. Lezi zitshudeni zikusho lokhu ngesikhathi zizokweseka ozakwabo oSamukelisiwe Ndlovu, Nompumelelo Nduli noMlekeleli Shandu abebevele enkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini izolo ngecala lokususa udlame emphakathini. Izitshudeni ziphume ngebheyili kaR500 umuntu emunye. UXolo Magutshwe, uMengameli weSASCO kule nyuvesi uthe ukuboshwa kwalazi zitshudeni kungenye yezindlela zamaphoyisa zokubasabisa ukuthi zingaqhubeki nokulwela imfundo yamahhala ezithenjisiwe. Omunye wezitshudeni ongathandanga ukudalulwa, obeyingxenye yabebezokweseka ababoshiwe uthe: “Amaphoyisa ehluleka izigebengu zigwaze isitshudeni amanxeba awu-10. Lesi sitshudeni sisesimeni esibucayi esibhedlela. Azobopha abantu abalwela imfundo? Ngeke siyeke ukulwela ilungelo lethu lokufunda, uma izikhulu zakwaNSFAS zingacacisi ukuthi sizokhokhelwa nini. Sizovala umgwaqo omkhulu eThekwini uWest Street (Dkt Pixley kaSeme). Sifuna imfundo yamahhala esithenjiswe yona. Njengamanje asibhalisiwe silinde wona uNSFAS esingazi ukuthi kungani ungasikhokheli. Izitshudeni ziboshwe ngoLwesibili ngesikhathi zibhikishela ukuthi lesi sikhwama asikhokhile okwenza ukuthi zingabhaliswa. Lesi sikhungo sivaliwe, sizovulwa kusasa njengoba kuzoba nomhlangano nezikhulu zakwaNSFAS nezitshudeni, ozocacisa ngokukhokhelwa kwazo. IMantshi elingatholakalanga igama layo ithe akwamukelekile ukuthi uma izitshudeni zinezikhalo ngento ethile bese zivala imigwaqo. “Ukulwa nabantu bomthetho kuyicala elibi futhi izehlakalo ezinjengalesi sezivamisile. Ngenxa yalokhu ngizonishaya ngoswazi oluncane ngebheyili kaR500.”

Lezi zithangami zihambisana nomkhankaso obizwa nge#WearYou, ohlose ukutshala ukuzethemba kwabesifazane. “Kubalu-lekile ukuthi singabe-sifazane sicathulisane, sithuthu-kisane ukuze kwakheke isizwe esiqotho. Ukuzethemba kowesifazane kuyikho konke ngoba uma umuhle uzethemba kakhulu. Uma uzinakelela nangendlela obukeka ngayo uba semathubeni angcono, “ kusho uNkk Masango. Uthe uma unaka indlela obukeka ngayo kuba lula nokuthi abantu bakwethembe. Ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokuzihlonipha nokuzethemba athe kuvula yonke iminyango. Uthe abanye abantu bahlaziya ibhizinisi lakho ngendlela obukeka ngayo yingakho abesifazane kumele babe bahle kusuka ekhanda kuya onyaweni. Abahleli balo mkhankaso nezithangami bathe bakhethe abesifazane abasemikhakheni ehlukene yempilo ukukhuthaza nabanye. Isithangami sokuqala sizogxila ekuzithuthukiseni kwabesifazane kwezezimali. Ngaphandle kokucwala izinwele, abesifazane kuthiwa bangenza lukhulu kwezamabhizinisi. UNKK Nthati Mthembu uthi iLive Connected App izosiza omama abamatasa UNKK Nthati Mthembu uthi iLive Connected App izosiza omama abamatasa UKUBA wumama omatasa okudingeka alande izingane esikoleni, aziyise kwezemidlalo kwenze uNkk Nthati Mthembu asungule i-app ebizwa nge-Live Connected ezomkhumbuza konke okufanele akwenze. UNkk Mthembu ohlala eSandton, eGoli, ongungoti wezobuchwepheshe, uthe, i-app wayisungula ngo-2016 emuva kokubona ukuthi izingane zakhe sezidlala imidlalo ehlukene, udinga ukukhumbula ukuyozilanda. “Uma uwumama osebenzayo kuba nzima ukuhlela ukuthi izingane zakho ziya kanjani esikoleni, ikakhulukazi uma zibuye zidlale imidlalo ehlukene. Kwakulula ngesikhathi zisafunda enkulisa kodwa njengoba sezikhulile kufanele ngihlele umalume ozozilanda, ozoziyisa kwezemidlalo kanjalo aqiniseke ukuthi zibuyela endlini ziphephile,” kusho uNkk Mthembu. Uthe ngo-2016 uqale ukuyivivinya i-app yakhe ngokumema izihlobo ukuthi ziyisebenzise, wabona ukuthi izoxazulula izinkinga zabantu abaningi. “Ngithathe isinqumo sokuthi ngishiye emsebenzini ngigxile ebhizinisi lokwakha leLive Connected App ngoba izosiza abantu. Ufike uyifake efonini yakho ene-android bese ufaka abantu oxhumana nabo ukuze bakwazi ukukhumbula konke odinga bakwenzele kona. Isibonelo uma sekuyisikhathi sokulanda ingane iLive Connected App izokhumbuza umalume noma ugogo ukuthi alande ingane esikoleni,” kusho uNkk Mthembu. Uthe unezingane ezimbili kanti iLive Connected App iyamsiza ukuxhumana nababheka izingane, ogogo nabashayeli. Uthe iyasiza nokuthi ubone umnyakazo wengane yakho ngoba umuntu omfake kule a-app kuyavela ukuthi usefikile esikoleni sengane, usekuphi. “Abazali babuye bakhathazeke ngokuphepha kwezingane zabo, le App izobasiza ukuthi bazi ukuthi zikuphi ngokuveza imininingwane yokuthi abazigadayo noma abazilandayo bakuphi. Uyakwazi ukumbona umuntu esuka aze ayofika lapho eya khona,” kusho uNkk Mthembu. Uthe okwamanje le App inabantu abangu-200 kodwa isibalo siyakhula usuku nosuku ngoba omama bafuna ukuhlela kahle usuku lwabo. “Uma ungathandi ukufonela abantu ngomzuzu wokugcina ngoba usukhohliwe ukulanda ingane esikoleni noma uvelelwe yinkinga ethile, iLive Connected izokusiza ukuxazulula lezo zinkinga. Wenza izinhlelo zakho ngesikhathi bese yona ikhumbuza bonke abantu odinga bakusize,” kusho uNkk Mthembu.

Imoto yamaphoyisa okuthiwa isetshenzisiwe kulobu bugebengu kuthiwa itholwe ipakwe esiteshini samaphoyisa kanti enye imoto ebisetshenziswa ithathiwe ukuze kuphenywe. Amaphoyisa aseqale uhlelo lwangaphakathi lokuqondisa amaphoyisa ubugwegwe. Isitatimende sithi amaphoyisa angaxoshwa noma ukuqulwa kwecala kungakaphothulwa enkantolo. Amaphoyisa ancome amalungu omphakathi ngokuwabikela ngokungaziphathi kahle kwamaphoyisa ase enxusa abantu ukuthi bawabike ukuze abhekane nengalo yomthetho.

UMPHAKATHI waseMpophomeni ububhodla umlilo ngaphandle kwasenkantolo yeMantshi eHowick uthi umfuna ngaphandle osolwa ngokudlwengula abulale isalukazi (107) Umsolwa ngesikhathi ebuzwa ukuthi ukhetha ukusebenzisa yiphi inhlobo yommeli uvele wathi uzozimela yena ngoba ufuna ukusho konke okwenzeka ngelanga lesehlakalo. IMantshi ibe isithetha ithi ayizile ukuzobuza ukuthi kwenzekalani ngelanga lesigameko kodwa ibuza ukuthi ukhetha yiphi inhlobo yommeli, ukuze ezokwazi ukukhuluma konke afuna ukukusho kummeli wakhe. Umsolwa ube eseqoka ukumelwa wummeli woMbuso. Ngesikhathi iMantshi ibuza ngesicelo sebheyili ukuthi uyafuna yini ukusifaka, uvele walandula wathi kungcono ejele kunangaphandle usaba ukwenzakaliswa wumphakathi. IMantshi ibe isilihlehlisela uFebhuwari 9 nonyaka icala. Enkantolo bekugcwele abaholi bomphakathi, abomndeni nomphakathi. Ngaphandle kwenkantolo umphakathi ubuphethe izingqwembe ezigxeka ababulali nabadlwenguli. Lo mphakathi ubukhala ngokusebenza kwesiteshi samaphoyisa saseMpophomeni njengoba kuthiwa umsolwa wake wafika emzini walesi salukazi ngaphambi kokuba sibulawe. Indodana yalesi salukazi, uMnuz Enock Maphumulo (68), ebisenkantolo ithe ukuba amaphoyisa aluphakamela lolu daba mhlawumbe unina ngabe usaphila. “Umsolwa ufike cishe izikhawu ezine ekhaya ebuza umama ukuthi unayo yini indoda nokuthi wake wadlwengulwa yini. Lokhu kwabikwa emaphoyiseni kodwa kwangenziwa lutho. Umama ubemdala engasakwazi ukuzenzela lutho, ubesesizwa njengengane encane. Kubuhlungu kakhulu ukuba abulawe ngale ndlela,” kusho uMaphumulo. Lesi salukazi besihlala nabazukulu abafundayo abaneminyaka eko-20. Ngelanga lesigameko omunye umzukulu wayelele kwelinye ikamelo, yena waklinywa waquleka. Kuthiwa umsolwa wabe esedlwengula isalukazi, wasiklinya ngeSonto ebusuku. Ngesikhathi umndeni ungena enkantolo owesifazane ongumzukulu uze wabanjwa ekhihla isililo. Umndeni walo wesifazane uthe ukubulawa kwakhe ngale ndlela kubahlukumeze kakhulu.
AMAPHOYISA kaMasipala weTheku azoqhubeka nezivimbamgwaqo njengoba sekuboshwe abacela ku-300 selokhu kuqale amaholidi kaKhisimusi AMAPHOYISA kaMasipala weTheku azoqhubeka nezivimbamgwaqo njengoba sekuboshwe abacela ku-300 selokhu kuqale amaholidi kaKhisimusi SESICELA ku-300 isibalo sababoshelwe amacala ehlukene eThekwini selokhu kuqale amaholidi kaKhisimusi. Lokhu kushiwo uSenior Superintendent Parboo Sewpersard okhulumela amaphoyisa kuMasipala weTheku, othe bayaqhubeka nezivimbamgwaqo nsuku zonke. Uthe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi abantu babonakala bengawuhloniphi umthetho njengoba beqhubeka nokwenza amacala phezu kokuba amaphoyisa etshalwe nxazonke. Kwababoshwe ngempelasonto uSewpersad uthe kubalwa nowesilisa ogwaze abesifazane ababili ngasebhishi eBlue Lagoon. “Owesilisa utholakale nobhushu nommese waboshwa. Unecala lokuphatha izikhali eziyingozi nelokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza,” kusho yena. Uthe bangaphezu kuka-65 ababoshelwe ukushayela bephuzile ngempelasonto, abangu-13 baboshelwa izidakamizwa eWentworth nasePhoenix batholakala nezinhlobo ezehlukene zezidakamizwa. Ubuye wathi amaphoyisa azoqhubeka nokubonakala emabhishi, ezinxanxatheleni zezitolo nasezindaweni zomphakathi ukuqinisa ezokuphepha. Kwesinye isigameko esenzeke eGreytown ngoMgqibelo kuboshwe owesilisa obeshayela iMitsubishi emhlope okuthiwa ubephuze ngokweqile. Kuthiwa isikalo sotshwala egazini besiphindwe ka-11 kunesamukelekile. Uphinde wabekwa icala lokuba nelayisensi yemoto esiphelelwe yisikhathi. Okhulumela abeRoad Traffic Inspectorate esifundazweni, uNksz Zinhle Mngomezulu ukuqinisekisile ukuboshwa kwakhe.
OMAMA basehostela eThokoza nabanye abahlali basemahostela aseThekwini abaphikisana nesinqumo sikaMasipala weTheku sokuhlukanisa izingane nonina Isithombe: ZANELE ZULU/ANA OMAMA basehostela eThokoza nabanye abahlali basemahostela aseThekwini abaphikisana nesinqumo sikaMasipala weTheku sokuhlukanisa izingane nonina Isithombe: ZANELE ZULU/ANA SELUZONGENELELWA uMnyango wezeMpilo nowezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal udaba lokuhlala kwezingane ehostela labesifazane, uMasipala weTheku othi lokhu kuphambene nesimo sempilo yazo. Izolo iNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini itshele abameli bezinhlangothi zombili ezithinteka kulolu daba ukuthi bathintane nale minyango ukuze iphenye ngesimo senhlalo yezingane kuleli ehostela elibizwa ngeThokoza. Umasipala ukhala ngokuthi leli hostela alilungele ukuhlala izingane futhi ligcwele. Abesifazane abahlala kulo, izolo bathe bancamela ukuhlala nezingane zabo ngaphandle kwaleli hostela elisemgwaqweni uYusuf Dadoo eThekwini, uma inkantolo igcina ibalahla. Ijaji lithe yize lizizwa izikhalo zomama abangafuni ukuhlukaniswa nezingane zabo, azikulungele ukuhlala kuleli hostela. “Nisho ukuthi ingane yomfana eneminyaka engu-16 kuhle ukuthi isebenzise indlu yokugeza nabesifazane nezinye izingane zamantombazane?” kubuza ijaji. Lithe ngeke kulunge nokuthi kuvunyelwe kuphela izingane zamantombazane ukuhlala nonina ngoba kuzobe kuncisha ilungelo ezabafana. Liyalele abameli ukuthi namuhla babuyele kulona ukuzobhunga ukuthi bazoyimisa kanjani eyokufaka iminyango kulolu daba. Liphakamise nokuthi le minyango inikezwe okungenani izinyanga ezimbili ukuze iphenye ngesimo sasehostela. Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngoLwesihlanu. U-Advocate Sarah Jane Linscott omele abahlali, ukwamukele ukuthi kuthintwe iminyango kodwa wakhala ngokuthi sekuyisikhathi eside umasipala ungenazinhlelo ngalolu daba njengoba lwangena enkantolo ngo-2015. Omama bebephume ngobuningi, abanye bebehamba nezingane zabo. Bekukhona nabahlali bamanye amahostela abazwelana nomama baseThokoza. UNksz Phumzile Mpontshane usehlale eThokoza kusukela ngo-2002, unezingane ezimbili eneminyaka ewu-10 neno-2. Uthe ngeke akwazi ukuhlukana nezingane zakhe njengoba sekwande ukuhlukunyezwa kwazo. Uthe angenza noma yini ukuze avunyelwe ukuhlala nezingane zakhe. UNksz Zakhona Radebe onamadodakazi amabili eno-4 no-12, uthe akazimisele ukuya ndawo futhi uzohlala nezingane zakhe. Uthe uma umasipala ubakhipha awubafunele izindlu abazohlala kuzo nemindeni. Udaba lombango wezingane kuleli hostela lwangena enkantolo ngo-2015. Omama bebekhala ngokuthi bayazishushumbisa ngenxa yokuthi azivunyelwe ukuhlala.
BACELA usizo ngenyoka ebahlalise lubhojozi eMathinini, eRidgeview, njengoba kuthiwa iyacanasa ivimbe nabantu bangakwazi ukuhamba. BACELA usizo ngenyoka ebahlalise lubhojozi eMathinini, eRidgeview, njengoba kuthiwa iyacanasa ivimbe nabantu bangakwazi ukuhamba. BATHUKA izanya abantu abahlala kolindela baseMathinini, eRigdeview, eThekwini, njengoba bekhala ngohalakasha lwenyoka abathi luyacanasa endaweni abahlala kuyona, sebesaba nokuhamba. Izindlu abahlala kuzona babekwa ngenhloso yokuthi balindele izindlu zomxhaso. Ithimba leSolezwe ngeSonto linikele khona kule ndawo emuva kwezikhalo zabantu bakhona. Yindawo esehlathini elinezihlahla ezizungeze izindlu. Kuhlalwa khona nezingane ezisencane ezizidlalela zize zifike eduze kwezihlahla okuthiwa kuhlala khona uhalakasha lwenhlwathi. Abahlala khona bathi ihlala ibonakala icanasa kuthiwa inkulu ngendlela eyesabekayo. Omunye wabahlali bakhona uMnuz Thabiso Msezane uthe, inkinga enkulu izindlu zangasese zincane futhi ziyangcola abanye baze bafune ukuyozikhulula ehlathini lapho kuhlala khona le nyoka. “Ihlala ivela nje, abaningi bayayibona ngenhlanhla ayikalimazi muntu kodwa siyesaba ngoba kukhona nezingane la esihleli khona. Kubuye kungangeneki ezindlini zangasese kodwa manje asisakwazi nokuya ehlathini ngoba iyagwinyana ihlwathi,’’ kuchaza uMsezane. Uthe omunye umndeni obuhlala nabo ugcine uthuthile wabaleka emuva kokuthi inyoka yangena yabavimbezela endlini baphuma ngesamagundane bashiya nezimpahla. Uthe bafuna noma yiluphi usizo lokuba isuswe endaweni ngoba bayesaba ukuyisukela bona ingase ibenze isilo sengubo. Enye insizwa ehlala khona uMnuz Phakamani “PK’’ Mbele, ifakaze ngokuthi izinyoka kukubo kwazo lapha ngoba kusehlathini bajwayele ukushaya izimamba nezimfezi kodwa okwenhlwathi kubahlalise lubhojozi impela. UMnuz Nick Evans weReptiles Unlimited ebhekene nokususwa kwezinyoka eThekwini, uthe uyayazi indawo okukhulunywa ngayo kodwa ubengakaze ezwe ngenyoka yakhona. “Kuyamangaza ukuthi kunenhlwathi lapho, ngike ngiye ngakhona. Ngicela ubanike inombolo yami bangithinte uma beyibona ngoba ngeke ngivele ngiyozingela inyoka engingazi ukuthi ikuphi. Uma beyibona ngiyofika ngibasize noma kanjani,’’ kuchaza * -Evans.
IMOTO ebihamba iphoyisa isale imbobombobo lihlaselwa abantu abangaziwa emzini walo ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku IMOTO ebihamba iphoyisa isale imbobombobo lihlaselwa abantu abangaziwa emzini walo ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku BEKULINDELEKE ukuba libuyele enkantolo maduze ukuze kuqale ukuthethwa kwecala elithinteka kulo lokulunyiswa kwabantu ngezinja iphoyisa elidutshulwe ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu lingena emzini walo. UConstable Musawenkosi Khwela ubephuma emsebenzini ngoLwesihlanu ngo-10 ebusuku ngesikhathi ehlaselwa ngabantu abangaziwa emzini wakhe eZwelibomvu ngaKwaNdengezi, bamdubula, walimala kanzima. Ulaliswe egunjini labagula kakhulu esibhedlela. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kwenzeka lokhu nje leli iphoyisa elisebenza ophikweni lwezinja eShongweni belilungiselela ukuba lona nozakwabo ababili, abanecala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza nelokukhwabanisa, babuyele enkantolo ngenyanga ezayo ukuze kuqulwe icala labo. UKhwela uphume ngebheyili ngo-Ephreli nonyaka emuva kokuba bedlulise isicelo sokunikezwa ibheyili enkantolo enkulu eThekwini, ababenqatshelwe yona yiNkantolo yeMantshi ePinetown. Yisicelo sikaKhwela kuphela esaphumelela. Uhlaselwa nje bese ebuyele nasemsebenzini. Basolwa ngokuthi bebefuna imali ebantwini, uma bengenayo babalumise ngezinja. Akukacaci ukuthi ukuhlaselwa kukaKhwela kumayelana nani. NgoMgqibelo ibamba loMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, likugxekile ukuhlaselwa kukaKhwela. “Abahlasela amaphoyisa bazobhekana nolaka lomthetho. Sifisela u-constable olimele ukuba alulame ngokushesha,” kusho uMkhwanazi. Imizamo yokuthola umndeni wephoyisa ayiphumelelanga izolo njengoba abaphathi bamaphoyisa beveze ukuthi ucele ukuba izinombolo zawo zinganikezwa abezindaba ngoba awufisi ukuxoxisana nabo ngokwenzekile.
ABAHOLI be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, Mnuz Kwazi Mshengu noNksz Hlengiwe Mavimbela ophethe ingane kamufi ngesikhathi behleli nomndeni emngcwabeni kaNksz Sindisiwe Ndlovu ABAHOLI be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, Mnuz Kwazi Mshengu noNksz Hlengiwe Mavimbela ophethe ingane kamufi ngesikhathi behleli nomndeni emngcwabeni kaNksz Sindisiwe Ndlovu SEKUVELE isiphakamiso sokuba kushintshwe umphenyi wecala lokubulawa kwelungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Sindisiwe Beauty Ndlovu (34) okusolwa ukuthi udutshulwe yisoka. Umzala kamufi, uNksz Slo Khuzwayo, wenze lesi siphakamiso enkonzweni yomngcwabo enkundleni yezemidlalo eThokozani ngoMgqibelo. UNksz Khuzwayo uyiphoyisa naye njengoba nomufi kusolwa ukuthi ubulawe yisoka eliyiphoyisa okuthiwa limhlabe ngenhlamvu esifubeni washona. UNksz Khuzwayo uthe balibheke ngabomvu icala futhi abeneme ngomphenyi wecala. “Siyezwa ngomuntu ophenya icala sengathi akalungile kahle, yingakho sicela iziphathimandla ukuba ashintshwe uma kungenzeka. Umsolwa (emgagula ngegama) akafanele ukuba semphakathini emuva kwesenzo sakhe,’’ kusho uNksz Khuzwayo ebamba izinyembezi. Uthe akasiboni isizathu sokuthi iphoyisa livele liqhulule umuntu ngenhlamvu ngoba bayadonswa ngendlebe ngendaba yesibhamu nokuziphatha uma beqeqeshwa ekolishi lamaphoyisa. Ukhale nangokuthi amaphoyisa ambalwa abulala abantu athunaza isithunzi sombutho wonke njengoba sebedume kabi nje. Uthe into abeyenziwe wusibali wabo ngeke bayikhohlwe ebulala umzala wabo ngesihluku ekubeni kade ezilungele, engakaze aphoxe muntu. Ugcizelela ukuthi isibhamu asiyona inkinga kodwa kuba wumuntu osiphethe oba yinkinga uma engasiphathanga ngendlela efanele. Umzala kamufi uqede ukukhuluma wehla esiteji wajikela emuva kwetende wakhala kakhulu waze wabhuquza phansi kwasuka ithimba layomsingatha, limphathele amanzi kodwa elokhu eshilo ngesililo. Umnewabo kamufi uMbishobhi Bhekizitha Ndlovu, uthe ufisa ukuthi kuvele kuzwakale ukuthi umsolwa uzibulele ejele ngoba ubashiye nesilonda esingeke siphinde selapheke. Umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi abuyele enkantolo kuleli sonto azofaka isicelo sebheyili.

ISITHOMBE esigciniwe: ER24 ISITHOMBE esigciniwe: ER24 Njengophiko olunakekelayo lukahulumeni, iRoad Accident Fund (RAF) inezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi indlela okudingidwa ngayo izicelo zesinxephezelo azichemile - noma ngabe zifakwe ngummeli noma zifakwe kwaRAF ngqo - nokuthi bonke abafakizicelo bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula esikhungweni. Nokho, njengesikhungo sibone ukuthi kukhona okungaqondwa ngabasuke behlangabezane nezingozi zomgwaqo. Lokho kubandakanya okungezansi: Abameli, ngokwemigomo yokusebenza elawula umkhakha wezomthetho, kumele bahlale bewazisa amakhasimende abo ngokwenzekayo ezicelweni zesinxephezelo zawo, nokuthi baphendule izincwadi nezingcingo zamaklayenti. Ngeshwa, iRAF ayivumelekile ukugxambukela ebudlelwaneni bommeli nekhasimende ngakho ayinakubeluleka abafakizicelo ngezicelo zabo. Nokho, iRAF ikhuthaza abathinteka ezingozini ukuthi kube yibo abazixhumanela neRAF ngqo ukuze zilandeleke izicelo zezinxephezelo zabo, noma ngabe umfakisicelo enommeli noma ezifakele isicelo ngqo eRAF. Abanxenximakhasimende Kuvamile ukuthi abagileke ezingozini banxenxwe abazenza abasebenzi bakwaRAF. Bagcwalise, bathumele imibhalo yokufaka izicelo zesinxephezelo kulaba banxenximaklayenti. Abafakizicelo bakhuthazwa ukuthi baxhumane neRAF ngqo ukuze bagweme ukugilwa abanxenximaklayenti. I-RAF isiza ukuhlumelelisa abafakizicelo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuthi isikhungo sikhiphele umfakisicelo isitifiketi esiyisibopho sokunakekela, esiyisivumelwano esiphakathi kukamfakisicelo neRAF sokuhlinzeka izidingo zokwelashwa zamanje nezakusasa, umfakisicelo angase abe nazo ngenxa yokulimala engozini yomgwaqo, ngesikhathi ingxenye esele yesicelo sesinxephezelo sisasetshenzwa. Abafakizicelo bangathumela ama-invoice, kwaRAF emuva kokubonana nodokotela, noma udokotela angaxhumana nebeRAF ukuze imgunyaze ngaphambi kokwelapha umfakisicelo, bese ethumela i-invoice. Umfakisicelo kumele azise udokotela ukuthi unesitifiketi esiyisibopho sokunakekela. I-RAF ikhokhela okulandelayo kuphela: Ukuthuthwa kwesidumbu, ukuhlinzeka ngebhokisi lomngcwabo noma uhlaka lokungcwaba, ukulungisa isidumbu, ukugcinwa kwesidumbu, ukuhlelela ukukhishwa kwesitifiketi sokushona, ukungcwatshwa noma ukulothiswa kwesidumbu, ukuqashwa kwempahla yokwehlisela ibhokisi lomngcwabo elibeni nezindleko zasemathuneni. Lapho umshayeli noma umnikazi wemoto odale ingozi aziwa, isikhathi sokufaka isicelo sesinxephezelo siphela eminyakeni emithathu emuva kosuku okwehle ngalo ingozi ngaphandle kwalapho kufakwe isicelo esihlukile sesinxephezelo esisemthethweni kwaRAF. Lapho umshayeli noma umnikazi wemoto engaziwa (okubizwa “ngokwenza ingozi ubaleke”), isikhathi sokufaka isicelo sesinxephezelo sizophela eminyakeni emibili kusukela ngosuku okwehle ngalo ingozi yomgwaqo, ngaphandle kwalapho kufakwe isicelo esihlukile esisemthethweni kwaRAF. Lapho umfakisicelo engumntwana, noma umuntu ogcinwe njengongaphilile ngokomqondo noma umuntu onommeli oqokelwe ukumthathela izinqumo ngoba engenakuma phambi komthetho, futhi umshayeli noma umnikazi wemoto onecala aziwa, isicelo sesinxephezelo esisemthethweni singafakwa eRAF eminyakeni emithathu kusukela ngosuku okunqunywa ngalo ukuthi lo muntu obengenamandla usengazimela ngokomthetho. Lapho umshayeli noma umnikazi wemoto onecala engaziwa futhi umfakisicelo ebhekene nesithiyo sokuthi akanamandla okuzimela ngokomthetho, kumele kufakwe isicelo sesinxephezelo eRAF ungakapheli unyaka kusuka kunqunywe ukuthi lowo muntu obengenamandla usengazimela. Ukucazwa kwesinxephezelo Uma umfakisicelo wemoto ebe sephutheni ngokuphelele kwenzeka ingozi, ngeke aphumelele uma efaka isicelo sesinxephezelo kwiRAF. Uma kunenye imoto kuleyo ngozi, umshayeli angakwazi ukufakaza ukuthi omunye umshayeli ube nephutha eliholele engozini. Uma umshayeli naye ebe nephutha ekudalekeni kwengozi, isicelo sesinxephezelo sakhe singase sincishiswe. Lokhu kuncishiswa kususelwa ephesentini lokuba nephutha abe nalo ngokubambisana nomunye umshayeli othintekayo engozini. UNtsoaki Kunene, oyiRegional General Manager yeRAF KwaZulu-Natal. * UNtsoaki Kunene, uyiRegional General Manager yeRAF KwaZulu-Natal
Isithombe: KwaZulu-Natal Sharks Board Isithombe: KwaZulu-Natal Sharks Board ABE-KZN Sharks Board bagqugquzele umphakathi ukuthi ulalele abaxwayisa abantu ngokubhukuda emabhishi njengoba esesusiwe amanethi avimba oshaka emabhishi aseNingizimu yeKwaZulu-Natal, kwazise osayidinsi sebeqalile ukubonakala. UMnuz Mike Anderson-Reade weKZN Sharks Board, esitatimendeni uthe sekuyisikhathi sokufika kosayidinsi kanti amanethi avimbela oshaka ukuthi beze osebeni asusiwe emabhishi ukuze osayidinsi nezinye izilwane ezihambisana nabo njengamahlengethwa zihambe ngokukhululeka. Uma kuza osayidinsi amanethi ayasuswa ngoba uma ehleli izilwane ezihambisana nabo ziyabhajwa emanethini zigcine sezifa kanti nosayidinsi abahambi ngokukhululeka. “ISharks Board izoqhubeka nokuqapha isimo ngokusebenzisana nomasipala abanamabhishi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphephile kanti nosayidinsi bahamba ngokukhululeka,” kusho u-Anderson-Reade. Uthe osayidinsi babonakele eRamsgate, eMthwalume naseMthethweni. Uveze ukuthi amahlengethwa namaCape Gannets okuyizinyoni ezihambisana nosayidinsi nazo ziboniwe ngaseMazeppa Bay yize bezingeziningi. Osayidinsi baheha inqwaba yezivakashi ezisuke zifuna ukubadoba kanti ezinye zisuke zijabulela ukubona amahlengethwa, izinyoni nezinye izilwane ezisuke zijaha osayidinsi. Abanikazi bamahhotela agudle ulwandle nabo sebeqalile ukukhangisa ngezindawo zokuhlala koMargate, Ramsgate, eThekwini, nakwezinye izindawo.

ABAZALI besikole samabanga aphansi eLovu bathi bazoqhubeka nokubhikisha uma uMnyango wezeMfundo ungamxoshi uthishanhloko obambile, abamsola ngokungaphathi kahle isikole. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko abazali base-Andrew Zondo Primary babhikisha ngaphandle kwesango lesikole, bakhala ngokuthi abamfuni uthisha obambe emuva kokushona kukathishanhloko ngo-Ephreli. Lo thisha wesifazane Isolezwe elinalo igama lakhe, kuthiwa ubevele eyiphini likathishanhloko ongasekho uMnuz Sihiya, igama lakhe elingatholakalanga. Kuthiwa lo thisha ongafunwa uke wabamba ngesikhathi kugula uSihiya, abazali abakhala ngokuthi izinga lokuphasa lehla ngaleso sikhathi. Bakhala nangokuthi kuningi osekushintshile kusukela ebambile, okubalwa nokumisa abahlanza isikole. Kuthiwa abafundi yibona asebehlanza ngisho amathoyilethi esikoleni. Izolo abazali baphindelile ukuyoqhinqa emasangweni esikoleni, kwaze kwabizwa amaphoyisa azoqapha isimo. Ongusihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole uMnuz Thami Magubane uthe abakuphaza-misanga ukufunda ngoba babhikisha ngaphandle kwesango. “Kuningi esingakuthandi ngebamba likathishanhloko. Kunamaphepha esikole alahlekile selokhu eqalile ukubamba. Kuduke ngisho amabhuku amasheke esikoleni,” echaza UMagubane uthe akusebenzeki nalo thisha amsola ngokungahloniphi abazali nangendlela akhuluma ngayo. Uveze nokuthi lo thisha usebhalele umnyango ethi akakwazi ukusebenza kahle esikoleni ngoba kudliwe imali. “Naye uke waphatha isikole ngesikhathi ebambile, kumele ngabe uyazi ngokulawulwa kwesikole njengoba esekhala ngokudliwa kwezimali. Sibona ukuthi uyahluleka zisuka nje ukuphatha isikole. Ngeke siyeke ukubhikisha, sifuna abomnyango bamlande bahambe naye,” kusho uMagubane. Uthe bahlakazwe ngamaphoyisa ngoMsombuluko bebhikisha ngaphandle kwesango. NgoMsombuluko kuthiwa ubengekho uthisha obhikishelwayo kodwa izolo ufikile ngoba bekugade amaphoyisa esikoleni. Okhulumela umnyango esifundazweni uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, uthe abahambisani nokugxambukela kwanoma iziphi izinhlaka zomphakathi esikoleni ngoba kuphazamiseka ukufunda. Unxuse ukuthi abanezikhalo balandele imigudu efanele ukuze udaba lulungiswe.
UMHOLI we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema. Isithombe: BHEKI RADEBE UMHOLI we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema. Isithombe: BHEKI RADEBE UMHOLI we-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF), uMnuz Julius Malema usefunge wagomela ukuthi abalandeli baleli qembu bazoqhubeka nokudla umhlaba ongasebenzi njengendlela yokuqinisa ingcindezi kuhulumeni ukuthi abuyisele umhlaba kubantu boHlanga kuleli. UMalema uxwayise uhulumeni ngokuthi intsha yakuleli izizwa inganakiwe selokhu kwaphuma uhulumeni wobandlululo, kwabekwa owentando yeningi ngo-1994. Udaba lomhlaba cishe ngoluhamba phambili ngaphambi kokhetho lukazwelonke ngonyaka ozayo. “Njengamanje kunesizukulwane esisha esiphelelwa ukubekezela,” kusho uMalema ekhuluma ne-AFP. Babalelwa ku-28% abantu abangasebenzi kuleli kanti kwezinye izindawo intsha engasebenzi ibalelwa ngaphezulu kuka-50%. “I-EFF isungulwe ngesikhathi esihle ngoba siyakwazi ukusebenzisa intshisekelo yalesi sizukulwane ukuthi siqinise umzabalazo womnotho. I-EFF yazisa abantu ukuthi indlela yokuthola umhlaba, wukudla umhlaba ongasetshenziswa ukuze sizofakela uhulumeni ingcindezi, futhi sesibonile ukuthi kuyasebenza lokho. Manje uhulumeni nabaphethe umhlaba sebethi ‘mhlawumbe kumele senze okuthile’. UMengameli we-ANC, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa wamemezela ukuthi uhulumeni uzobheka izindlela zokuguqula umthethosisekelo ukuze kudliwe umhlaba ngaphandle kokunxephezela. Lezi zindaba zathakaselwa abaningi, kodwa abanye bazwakalisa ungabazane ngokuthi lokhu kuzokwenzeka ngempela yini. URamaphosa kudingeke ukuthi aqinisekise abatshali zimali kuleli ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngendlela esemthethweni futhi ngeke kuthikameze umnotho wakuleli. Kamuva nje, uqinisekise uNdunankulu wase-United Kingdom, uNkk Theresa May, owazwakalisa ukuleseka uhlelo lokubuyiselwa komhlaba kubantu boHlanga kuleli. UMalema nokho uthe akamethembi uRamaphosa. “UCyril usho lokhu namhlanje, kusasa asho okunye, kuya ngokuthi ukhuluma kuphi. Thina asiguquki kwesikushoyo, baguquka njalo bona. I-EFF ilona qembu elisematheni eNingizimu Afrika namhlanje,” kuqhuba uMalema. UMalema uthe ePolokwane, lapho akhulela khona, sekudliwe inqwaba yomhlaba njengoba kunemindeni ebalelwa ngaphezulu kuka 3000 ehlezi kumhlaba umnikazi wawo ongowaseCanada. “Wabuya esefuna sixoxisane,” kuqhuba uMalema. Uthe ukudliwa komhlaba kuleli ngeke kuhambisane nodlame njengoba kwenzeka eZimbabwe. “Ngeke kube khona udlame ngoba ngicabanga ukuthi abanikazi bamapulazi abamhlophe bazimisele ngokubuyisela umhlaba kubantu abamnyama njengoba izingxoxo phakathi kwabo zisaqhubeka ngokuthi kuzomiswa kanjani ngodaba lomhlaba.” UMalema uthe umhlaba ungaphathwa abamhlophe nabamnyama uzoqala ube ngaphansi kukahulumeni bese uyacazwa phakathi kwabamhlophe nabamnyama. Uqhube waveza nokuthi akukho lula ukuthi abamhlophe bafudukele emazweni ase-Europe njengoba kunabanye asebezwakalise ukuthi bazothutha bahambe. “Ngo-1994 abantu babezitshela ukuthi abamhlophe bazoyifulathela iiNingizimu Afrika. Naba basakhona, bazoyaphi? Abamhlophe bakuleli abanemali bayahlupheka e-Europe. Bajwayele ukunakekelwa, abakwazi ukuzinakekela,” usho kanje.

Isithombe: TUMI PAKKIES KUBE nomunyu ngesikhathi abasebenzi basemakhazeni besusa izidumbu zomndeni wakhwaDube eThornwoo, eMarianhill. Isithombe: TUMI PAKKIES UNINA wowesifazane (24) obulawe yisoka lakhe eThornwood, eMariannhill eduze kwasePinetown uthe kudala ayeyincenga indodakazi yakhe ethi ayibuyele ekhaya kodwa inqaba ithi iyohlukaniswa wukufa nesoka layo. UNkk Sindi MaGumede Njakazi (48) uthe uphatheke kabi ngokubulawa kwendodakazi yakhe ngoba indlela ebulawe ngayo iyakhombisa ukuthi bekukhona okonakele othandweni lwayo. UNkk Njakazi uthe indodakazi yakhe, uNksz Philile Gracia Gumede, ibulawe yisoka layo uMnuz Khulekani Dube (21), obulale unina uNkk Thembi Dube (57), waphinde wabulala nendodana yakhe enezinyanga ezintathu uNhlakanipho Dube, wagwaza nendodakazi yakhe uNonkululeko Dube (2) otholwe encela ibele likanina obeseshonile. UNonkululeko usesimeni esibucayi esibhedlela. UNKSZ Philile Gumede kuthiwa kade ayecelwa ukuthi abuyele ekhaya kodwa ethi uzohlukaniswa wukufa nesoka lakhe “Indodakazi yami ibingashadile noKhulekani kodwa bebezalisene futhi abakwaDube bebegcina ngokuthembisa ukuthi bazolobola kodwa bebengakaze bafike. Ngiphatheke kabi ngokuthi indodakazi yami ibulawe wuKhulekani ngoba bengiyincenga ngithi ayibuye ekhaya ingitshele ukuthi uKhulekani wumuntu onolaka okuthi uma esethukuthele kube iyona kuphela ekwazi ukumehlisa. Ibithi uma ingivakashele ayifonele uKhulekani ayibuze ukuthi ibuya nini ibe iqeda kufika,” kusho uNkk Njakazi. FUNDA: Bashaqekile ngoqothe umndeni Uthe kwala ngisho eseyisabisa ngokuthi uzoyilanda namaphoyisa kwaDube kodwa ayizange ifune ukubuya. UMNUZ Khulekani Dube obulele umndeni wakhe maqede wazikhunga. “UPhilile wangitshela ukuthi yena noKhulekani bayohlukaniswa wukufa, ngiphatheke kabi ngoba sekwenzekile lokhu ayekushilo. Ngiyacela ukuthi izingane zamantombazane zikhulume uma zinezinkinga othandweni lwazo zingafeli ngaphakathi. Ngiyasola ukuthi bekunezinkinga othandweni lwendodakazi yami kodwa ibifela ngaphakathi,” kusho uNkk Njakazi. Uveze ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ibisihlale kwaDube iminyaka eyisithupha kanti kwaNjakazi abasebenzi njengoba beziphilisa ngokudayisa amashidi ombhede. Mayelana nengane yendodakazi yakhe esindile uthe usazoya esibhedlela aphinde akhulume nosonhlalakahle ngoba izodinga ukwelulekwa ngokwengqondo. IMEYA yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede ithi umasipala uzolekela ukuze kufihlwe umndeni wakwaDube oqothwe yindodana yakhona egcine ngokuzihilela. Video: BONISWA MOHALE IMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, ibizifikele mathupha kwaDube yathi siyishaqisile isigameko sokuqothwa kwalo mndeni. “Baningi la bantu besifazane abadlule emhlabeni ngesandla somuntu wesilisa osemncane kakhulu, sithinteke kakhulu ezinhliziyweni. Njengomkhandlu onakekelayo sizoqinisekisa ukuthi umndeni ufihlwa ngesizotha. Sizoqinisekisa ukuthi ingane esele, esesibhedlela njengamanje, ithola ukuhlunyeleliswa kwezengqondo ngoba ihlukumezeke kakhulu, ihlale isonto lonke nabantu abashonile incela ebeleni likanina. Kuyinto ebuhlungu kakhulu. Sizoqinisekisa umndeni ozobe uhleli nayo ukuthi sizoyinakekela ngoba uhulumeni wethu unezinhlelo zonke zokunakekela abantwana abangenabo abazali,” kusho uNkk Gumede. Ugqugquzele amadoda ukuthi avikele abesifazane ayeke izidakamizwa ngoba uKhulekani uchazwe njengomuntu obephuza futhi kutholwe namaphilisi eduze kwakhe. UNKK Thembi Dube obulewe yindodana yakhe uKhulekani Dube emgwazile yaphinde yamnquma. Khonamanjalo uNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNkk Weziwe Thusi, uthe uzothumela osonhlalakahle bayosiza umndeni wakwaDube. Uphinde wacela imindeni ukuthi isheshe icele usizo uma inezinkinga kungaze kube nezigameko ezifuze esakwaDube.
UMNUZ Mthethomusha “Mthetho” Ngubane (38), udutshulwe emgwaqweni uN3 eduze kwaseHammarsdale, izolo ekuseni nomunye odutshulwe ngabo-6.30 ntambama. UMNUZ Mthethomusha “Mthetho” Ngubane (38), udutshulwe emgwaqweni uN3 eduze kwaseHammarsdale, izolo ekuseni nomunye odutshulwe ngabo-6.30 ntambama. AMAPHAPHU aphezulu kosomatekisi abakwiMpumalanga Taxi Owners Association emuva kokubulawa kukaMnuz Mthethomusha “Mthetho” Ngubane (38), odutshulwe emgwaqweni uN3 eduze kwaseHammarsdale, izolo ekuseni nomunye odutshulwe ngabo-6.30 ntambama. Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela lingakatholakali igama likasomatekisi wesibili obulewe kodwa izindaba zokudutshulwa kwakhe ziqinisekiswe nguSihlalo weSantaco eDurban West uMnuz Mathula Mkhize othe sebezwile ukuthi kulimale omunye kodwa basaqoqa imininingwane. Osomatekisi abangathandanga ukudalulwa amagama ngenxa yokusaba ukuthi bangase badutshulwe bathe isimo asisihle kusoseshini waseMpumalanga njengoba ungenabo ubuholi obuphezulu. Baveze ukuthi ngoJulayi nyakenye kudutshulwe iPhini likaSihlalo, uMnuz Dumisani Magwaza kwathi ngoKhisimusi kwabulawa uMnuz Mbhekeni Hlophe odutshulwe ngentululwane yezinhlamvu. UMnuz Mluleki Mntungwa, obhekelele ezokuxhumana eMnyangweni wezokuThutha, ukuPhepha koMphakathi nokuXhumana KwaZulu-Natal, uthe uNgqongqoshe uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda ukhathazekile ngokubulawa kosomatekisi embonini. “Ungqongqoshe uhlela umhlangano namalungu kasoseshini waseMpumalanga nezinye izinhlaka ezithintekayo ukuthola ukuthi kwenzekani. Umhlangano uzoba maduze ngoba ungqongqoshe ufuna siphele isihlava sokubulawa kosomatekisi. Ugqugquzela namaphoyisa ukuthi akuphenyisisie ukubulawa kosomatekisi,” kusho uMntungwa. Imizamo yokuthola umndeni kaNgubane ukuthi uphawule ayiphumelelanga njengoba zingatholakalanga izinombolo zawo. UMkhize, uthe baphatheke kabi ngokuqothana eMpumalanga futhi bazoba nomhlangano namalungu akhona lingakapheli isonto. UCaptain Nqobile Gwala, wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe ngabo-6.50 ekuseni amaphoyisa athole isidumbu sowesilisa (38) sinamanxeba okudutshulwa kwesingenhla. “Amaphoyisa aseHammarsdale aphenya icala lokubulala, ayikakatholakali imbangela yokubulawa kwalona wesilisa. Asikakabophi muntu futhi sicela noma ngubani onemininingwane ngalesi sigameko ukuthi athinte amaphoyisa aseduze naye noma iCrime Stop ku-08600 10111,” kusho uCaptain Gwala.
UMNUZ Mdumiseni Ntuli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal owesekwa yi-ANCYL ekutheni aqokelwe esikhundleni sikanobhala wenhlangano esifundazweni njengoba kulungiselelwa ingqungquthela okulindeleke ukuba isingathwe engakapheli uJulayi UMNUZ Mdumiseni Ntuli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal owesekwa yi-ANCYL ekutheni aqokelwe esikhundleni sikanobhala wenhlangano esifundazweni njengoba kulungiselelwa ingqungquthela okulindeleke ukuba isingathwe engakapheli uJulayi I-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal isiphumele obala yathi ifuna uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli ukuthi akhethwe njengoNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal engqungqutheleni yesifundazwe okulindeleke ukuthi isingathwe ungakapheli uJulayi. Ekhuluma emcimbini wokusonga inyanga yabantu abasha ehholo lomphakathi iMichael Gwala eNtshangwe, uMgcinimafa we-ANCYL uMnuz Thobelani Ncampalala, uthe bafuna ukuthi abantu abasha bangene ezinhlakeni ze-ANC ukuze nabo bahlale etafuleni uma sekuthathwa izinqumo. “Yingakho siyi-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal sithi sifuna uqabane uMdumiseni Ntuli akhethwe njengoNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, asididekile ngalokho esikushoyo, uMdumiseni uke wahola i-ANCYL eKZN futhi uyiqabane ekade lalinethwa zimvula uphinde abeyisibonelo kithina, sifuna ukuba yisifundazwe sokuqala lapho uNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni kungumuntu omusha,” kusho uNcampalala. Uthe i-ANC eKZN idinga umuntu onjengoNtuli kwesikanobhala njengoba isemkhankasweni wokuqeda indaba yezinhlangothi. NoSihlalo we-ANCYL eThekwini uMnuz Thembo Ntuli uhambe emazwini kaNcampalala wathi bangajabula ukubona uNtuli engunobhala wenhlangano esifundazweni. UNtuli uphakanyiselwa esikhundleni obekuhleli kuso uMnuz Super Zuma. Nakuba liphakanyiswa igama likaNtuli kodwa akhona amanye amaqabane afuna kubuye uZuma. UNcampalala uqhube wathi enye into abafuna ukuyibona ukuthi uNobhala-jikelele we-ANCYL, uMnuz Njabulo Nzuza, akhethwe njengelungu lesigungu esihola isifundazwe. “Sifuna ukuthi uNzuza uma esebuya eLuthuli House eseqede ihlandla lakhe abuye KwaZulu-Natal azoba essigungwini esibhekelele ukusebenza kwesifundazwe, iProvincial Working Committee,” kusho uNcampalala. Uthe uNzuza usesebenze ezinhlakeni ezahlukene enhlanganweni waze wafika eLuthuli House. “Omunye umholi esifuna akhethelwe esigungwini esihola inhlangano nguSihlalo wethu esifundazweni uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu,” kusho uNcampalala. Uthe njengobuholi besifundazwe baphinde bavumelana ngokuthi baseke unobhala wabo uMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo kwesikamengameli we-ANCYL njengoba kuyiwa engqungqutheleni ngoSepthemba. Uthe bafuna ukubona abantu abasha babambe iqhaza kuyo yonke imikhakha kubalwa ekuholeni nakwezomnotho. Isolezwe lizamile ukuxhumana noMdumiseni Ntuli ngenhloso yokuthola ukuthi uzamukela kanjani izindaba zokwesekwa wuphiko lwentsha kodwa ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa.
ABESIFAZANE abebesola ukuthi baqolwe uNkk Cabangile Cele-Zikhali bethatha izimpahla emzini wakhe, eChesterville, izolo ABESIFAZANE abebesola ukuthi baqolwe uNkk Cabangile Cele-Zikhali bethatha izimpahla emzini wakhe, eChesterville, izolo BAZITAPELE izimpahla negilosa emzini kamakhelwane wabo abantu baseChesterville abebemsola ngokubakhokhisa imali abethi eyokugwazela umsebenzi wakwaMasipala weTheku. Izolo, labo makhelwane abebegane unwabu bathe umakhelwane wabo uNkk Cabangile Cele-Zikhali, ubebathembise ukuthi bazoqala emsebenzini ngoMsombuluko. Kuthe sekumele baqale wathi abaye emahhovisi ophiko oluqoqa intela kuleli iSouth African Revenue Service (Sars) bayofuna izinombolo zokukhokha intela. UNksz Nomvula Nyathikazi uthe uNkk Cele-Zikhali oke wasebenza ohlelweni obelwaziwa ngeCato Manor Greening, ubethi uqashwe umasipala ophikweni lwamanzi ngemuva kokuphela kwalolu hlelo ngoDisemba. “Uthe ube nenhlanhla waqashwa wuphiko lwamanzi, nathi asisolanga lutho ngoba ubethi uqale ngoJanuwari. Uthe kulolu phiko kunowesifazane abembiza ngokuthi uLulu, okunguyena onikezwa le mali ayiqoqayo. Ubethi uma sebeqashiwe laba bantu nguyena ozoba yimenenja yabo kodwa uzobe esebenza ngaphansi kukaLulu,” kusho yena. Kuvele ukuthi bangu-36 abathi baluthwe nguNkk Cele-Zikhali kanti umuntu ngamunye ubegwaza ngoR2 000. Iningi labo le mali liyiboleke komashonisa ngoba lithembe ukuthi seliwuthole umsebenzi. UNksz Siziphiwe Mfeka uthe ubeyitoho lapho esebenza khona, wesule emsebenzini wakhe ngoLwesine ngoba etshelwe ukuthi uzohola uR9 000 kwamasipala. “Lo mama ungibulele, ngangihamba naye engiqhuba ethi angesule emsebenzini ngoba sizoqala ngoMsombuluko emsebenzini. NgoMsombuluko sivukele kwaSars njengoba kade eshilo, sihlale khona kwaze kwavalwa elokhu ethi asimlinde uyeza uyolanda imifaniswano yethu. Kulapho sibone khona ukuthi sengathi siqoliwe sabuya seza la emzini wakhe. Ingane yakhe isitshele ukuthi ubekhona ufike wathatha isikhwama wahamba. Simthumelele imiyalezo simtshela ukuthi sizothatha izimpahla emzini wakhe, sizozibuyisa uma eselethe imali yethu,” kusho yena. Kuthiwa uNkk Cele-Zikhali uthumele imiyalezo kubagilwa ethi abalande imali yabo ngo-9 ekuseni, izolo. Abanye ubebasabisa ngokuthi uzobathakatha uma bengayeki ukumthuka. Sebefikile uthe le mali ayikho kuye kodwa ikulo wesifazane okuthiwa uLulu. Ingxenye yaleli qulu ihambe naye yaya ophikweni lwamanzi kumasipala lapho kade ethi lo wesifazane usebenza khona, kwalandulwa kwathiwa akekho umuntu onalelo gama. Ngemuva kwaloku ushintshile wathi kunoR40 000 awubekile komunye umuzi eGlenmore. Kuthe kusalungiselelwa ukuya khona washintsha wathi ucela kubizwe amaphoyisa aboshwe. Ebuzwa yileli phephandaba mayelana nalezi zinsolo, uNkk Cele-Zikhali uthe: “Ngicela nike ningiyeke kancane.” Emva kwalokho uhambile wayongena ekamelweni. Kube khona abamlandelayo bamphuca amaphilisi okuthiwa uke wazama ukuwaphuza. Uthe abathathe izimpahla zakhe bazidayise ngoba ayikho imali. Kulamule ukufika kwamaphoyisa umphakathi usho ukumqeda. Umyeni wakhe uMnuz Sanele Zikhali uthe ubazi ukuthi unkosikazi wakhe usebenza kwadokotela. “Ebengikuqaphela ukuthi bese sidla ukudla esingajwayele ukukudla layikhaya. Ngithe uma ngimbuza ubebhoka ngolaka abukise ngami kubangani bakhe ebengihlale ngibafica la ekhaya bephuza. Ngigcine ngizitshela ukuthi kusho ukuthi uwinile e-casino ngoba ungumuntu okhonze ukugembula kodwa akafuni ukungitshela. Ngishayelwe ucingo sengitshelwa ukuthi umuzi wami usengcupheni yokusha. Namhlanje, asinakudla abantu bathathe ngisho igilosa, asinalutho. Uma ngimbuza ngalokhu, akangiphenduli,” kusho yena. ULt Colonel Thulani Zwane, okhulumela amaphoyisa, uthe alikho icala elivuliwe ngalesi sigameko. UNksz Tozi Mthethwa, okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uthe abathi baqoliwe kufanele bavule amacala emaphoyiseni noma bathinte uphiko lwakwamasipala oluphenya ngenkohlakalo iCity Investigation Unit. “Awukho umsebenzi okhokhelwa imali kwamasipala, uma kunomuntu othi udayisa imisebenzi, umphakathi awumbike kulolu phiko,” usho kanje.

INGXENYE yamalungu omphakathi waseMawoti, eNanda, adilizelwa izindlu kusukela ngo-2014 athi asalinde isinxephezelo INGXENYE yamalungu omphakathi waseMawoti, eNanda, adilizelwa izindlu kusukela ngo-2014 athi asalinde isinxephezelo APHAZAMISE ukwakhiwa komgwaqo amalungu omphakathi aseMawoti, eNanda, adilizelwa izindlu kusukela ngo-2014, athenjiswa ukunxeshezelwa ngemali angakayitholi. Abantu, asebehlala ezindlini zomxhaso, bathe sebekhathele ukubanjiswa udonga ngesinxe-phezelo. Zibalelwa ku-34 izindlu okuthiwa zadilizwa kule ndawo ngesikhathi uNkk Zandile Gumede oseyiMeya yeTheku eseyikhansela. Umphakathi uthe wathembisa ukuthi uzonxeshezelwa kodwa azisafezeki izethembiso. UNkk Thomza Mthembu ongomunye wabathintekile uthe batshelwa ukuthi kuzokwakhiwa umgwaqo oxhumanisa iMawoti neTafula ngakho kumele basuswe. “Kwabizwa imihlangano sitshelwa ukuthi sizofakwa ezindlini zomxhaso kodwa sizonxeshezelwa nangemali. Ngenxa yokuthi sasingafuni kube sengathi sivimbela intuthuko savuma ukudilizelwa. Okusiphatha kabi wukuthi sibona sekuya emaphethelweni ukwakhiwa komgwaqo kodwa asikanxeshezelwa. Sizwa kuthiwa abanye sebakhokhelwa,” kusho yena. Uthe ngesonto eledlule bavimbe ogandaganda abalungisa umgwaqo bathenjiswa ukuthi bazobizelwa emhlanganweni nemeya, ogcine ungaphumelelanga. UMnuz Phillip Falithenjwa, othe ukhishwe emzini wakhe ngo-Ephreli nyakenye, uthe batshelwa ukuthi bazonxeshezelwa ngokushesha. "Satshelwa ukuthi siyongena ezindlini zomxhaso sesinikiwe imali yesinxephezelo. Ngamangala ngishayelwa ucingo wumkami ngisedolobheni engitshela ukuthi sekufike abakwamasipala bazodiliza. Bathi uma ngibabambezela ngiyoyithola inconzuliwe imali yesinxephezelo ngoba imishini yokudiliza iyakhokhelwa,” kusho uFalithenjwa. UMnuz Bongani Qhansi oyikhansela uthe imeya iyalwazi udaba futhi izophuma imali yesinxephezelo. “Ngiwance-ngile amalungu omphakathi ukuthi angaphazamisi ukwakhiwa komgwaqo ngoba ngizohlangana nawo nezinhlaka ezithintekayo ukucacisa udaba. Kumele baqonde ukuthi kunemigomo elandelwayo ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwemali. Imeya iyona ebalwelayo ukuthi banxeshezelwe hhayi ngokunikwa izindlu zomxhaso kuphela. Ngesonto eledlule ibizimisele ukuhlangana nabo kwaba yibona abashintsha uhlelo,” kuchaza yena. Uthe okucasule umphakathi wukuthi kukhona asebenxeshezelwe. Kushaye isikhathi sokuloba uMasipala weTheku ungaphendulanga ngalolu daba yize bethunyelelwe i-email ngoMsombuluko. Udaba lokudilizelwa kwabantu izindlu eMawoti lwaba sematheni abaningi bekhala ngendluzula. Ngo-Okthoba 2015 Isolezwe labika ngokukhishwa ngesidlozana kukaNkk Manazile Tekana, ongomunye wabadilizelwa banganikwa indawo yokuhlala. Wakhala waze wabhuquza encenga amaphoyisa nabasebenzi bakamasipala bangawubhidlizi umuzi wakhe.
OMUNYE wofakazi, uNksz Cheryl Zondi, wabasola uMfundisi Timothy Omotoso ngokumdlwengula OMUNYE wofakazi, uNksz Cheryl Zondi, wabasola uMfundisi Timothy Omotoso ngokumdlwengula KUZOQHUBEKA ngo-Okthoba 22 ukuqulwa kwamacala abhekene noMfundisi Timothy Omotoso osolwa ngokudlwengula nokushushumbisa abesifazane. Izolo ufakazi wokuqala kuleli cala, uNksz Cheryl Zondi, ubephekwa ngemibuzo abammeli baka-Omotoso webandla iJesus Dominion International Church. UNksz Zondi (22) ungomunye wabesifazane ababalelwa kwabangaphezulu kuka 30 abasola umfundisi ngokubanukubeza ngokocansi kusuka ngo-2009 kuya ku-2017 okuwunyaka aboshwa ngawo esikhumulweni sezindiza ePort Elizabeth. Zithe zisuka nje ummeli ka-Omotoso, u-Adv Peter Daubermann, wathi akayitholi imibiko yokuhlaziywa kwemiqondo yabamangalele umfundisi. UDaubermann uthe lokhu kuba nomthelela uma esepheka ngemibuzo abantu abafakazayo. Uvezele uNksz Zondi izithombe nama-video akhe esesebandleni lika-Omotoso ebukeka ejabule. UNksz Zondi uthe wayephoqwa ukuthi ahlale ebukeka eneme ngazo zonke izikhathi futhi amoyizele. Uthe ukungakwenzi lokhu kwakuzomenza abukeke njengomuntu ongahambisani no-Omotoso. Uchaze lo mfundisi njengendoda ebinamandla futhi ilawula impilo yabo. UNksz Zondi uthe wayenukubezwa ngokocansi cishe zinsuku zonke esikhathini esingangeminyaka emibili nohhafu. Ngesikhathi echaza ngokubaleka kwakhe endlini ababevalelwe kuyo eMhlanga ubelokhu ekhala kwaze kwadingeka ukuthi kumiswe ukuqulwa kwecala. Uthe wathatha uR300 awunikezwa wumfundisi ngaphambi kwenkonzo enkulu wawugcina ukuze agibele ngawo. “Ngangifuna ukuhamba sebelele bonke endlini kodwa kwakukhona owesifazane owayesekhishini, ngazitshela ukuthi namhlanje ngiyakwenza lokhu noma ngiyafa. Ngathatha ukhiye, ngaphuma ngathatha isikhwama sami ngangena emotweni eyi-cab ngatshela umshayeli ukuthi akalinde” kusho uNksz Zondi echaza ngendlela abaleka ngayo emzini ababehlala kuwona. UNksz Zondi uthe wayesaba ukubikela amaphoyisa ngokunukubezwa ngokocansi ngoba amaphoyisa ayekhona ebandleni lika-Omotoso. “Ngangingenawo amandla anele okumelana nayo yonke le nto ngaleso sikhathi. Ngangingakwazi ukubikela amaphoyisa ngoba ayemphelezela yonke indawo aya kuyo. Ayelahla phansi amajakhethi awo ukuze ahambe phezu kwawo. Ngangingawathemba kanjani amaphoyisa ngemuva kwalokho?” kuchaza uNksz Zondi. UNksz Zondi uqale ukufakaza ngoMsombuluko. Icala limisiwe ukuze abhale izivivinyo. IJaji uMandela Makaula limufisele inhlanhla. Kulindekele ukuthi aqhubeke nokufakaza uma eseqedile ukubhala. Khona manjalo ngaphandle kwenkantolo silokhu sikhule njalo isibalo sabeseka uNksz Zondi njengoba izolo kujoyine ngisho abahleli be#TotalShutDown ne-ANCWL, egxeke abesifazane abebegqoke imifaniswano yayo abebeseka u-Omotoso. Nabesekau-Omotoso abapheli amandla balokhu bekhona ngaphandle enkantolo.

Isithombe esigciniwe Isithombe esigciniwe UHLALELE ovalweni umndeni womfana ona-9 okuthiwa uvinjezelwe ngamalungu omphakathi waseSavannah Park eMariannhill ngoLwesithathu ngeledlule, emsola ngokuthakatha. Uyise womfana (igama lakhe elingeke lidalulwe ukuvikelwe umfana) uthi uthuke kwaphela nasozwaneni ngesikhathi ehla esitobhini ntambama ngoLwesithathu ephuma emsebenzini, elinye ilungu lomphakathi limcela ukuba behlisane baye emzini ongumakhelwane lapho kugcinwe khona indodana yakhe okuthiwa ibanjwe kulo muzi igibele imfene, ekuseni ngabo 9. Uthe ngesikhathi esondela, ugxavunwe kabuhlungu ngamanye amalungu omphakathi abesola yena nonina (uninakhulu womfana) ngokusebenzisa ingane ezenzweni zokuthakatha. “Ngisindele abebengikhuzela ngenkathi abafana bakulo muzi besho ukungiqeda. Kuze kwafika amaphoyisa okuyiwona agcine ekhulume nesixuku ebesingezwa mshini,” kusho yena. Uthi utshelwe ukuthi indodana yakhe ibanjwe bukhoma kulo muzi igibele imfene, imfene yabaleka yangena ehlathini. Uthi amalungu omphakathi abesho ukungena kulo muzi efuna imfene okuthiwa ifuywe nguninakhulu womfana. “Vele lo mndeni okuthiwa indodana yami beyithakatha kuwona, asizwani kahle,” kuqhuba uyise womfana . Uthe sebethuka izanya besaba ukuthi bangase bahlaselwe. Uthe namuhla uya enkantolo ukuyofaka isicelo sencwadi yokuvikelwa komakhelwane. Uthe akusikhona okokuqala indodana yakhe isolwa ngokuthakatha, nyakenye kusatshalaliswe izithombe zayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuthiwa ibanjwe nomuthi ebiyowufaka komunye umuzi nawo oyibangana ukusuka kulona okuthiwa ibanjwe kuwo ngoLwesithathu. Kuthiwa amalungu omphakathi abengena kulo muzi ukuzozibonela ‘umthakathi omncane.’ Kuvele ukuthi umzimba womfana ugcatshwe izinhlanga, uyise uthe yizinhlanga ezigcatshwe wonke umuntu kubo ngenhloso yokubaqinisa uma kugasela izulu. Elinye ilungu lomphakathi lakule ndawo elixoxe neSolezwe elingathandanga ukudalulwa lithe ngesikhathi umfana eboshwele endlini kulo muzi okuthiwa ubanjwe kuwo, kuthiwa uthe ngayizolo ubeye komunye umuzi eyogqiba umuthi. Leli lungu lomphakathi lithe banokwesaba ukuthi amalungu alo mndeni azogcina enzakalisiwe. Ikhansela uMnuz Sibusiso Khwela lithe lizoba nomhlangano nomphakathi ngoMgqibelo ukudingida ngalolu daba.
I-IFP isibize umhlangano ophuthumayo ne-DA ukuze inqande ingozi yokulahlekelwa uMasipala wasebaQulusini nabanye KwaZulu-Natal njengoba bubamuncu ubudlelwane babo. Lokhu kulandela ukuthi umholi weDemocratic Alliance KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango ebhalelwe incwadi iFederal Executive (FedEx) okuyisigungu esiphezulu seqembu imfaka ingcindezi ukuba acacise ngekusasa abanalo ne-IFP njengoba beyisola ngokubadayisa eGauteng nangokwamukela isikhundla seScopa kuzwelonke nesekomiti likaNdunankulu eSishayamthetho saseGoli. USihlalo kazwelonke we-IFP, uMnuz Blessed Gwala uthe lo mhlangano owokuqinisa ubudlelwane abanabo. “Empeleni lo mhlangano okufanele uhlale kuleli sonto kuzoba owokuqinisa ubudlelwane esinabo ne-DA. Ngifisa nokuthi kucace ukuthi azikho izinkinga esinazo ne-DA njengoba senibeka kanjalo,” kusho uGwala. Ukusho lokhu nje amakhansela e-IFP eBaqulusini anovalo lokuthi uma sekuvotwa kukhethwa imeya entsha, ezovala isikhala sikaMnuz Jerry Sibiya kungenzeka i-DA ivote ne-ANC . Nokho ubuholi be-IFP bona buhlela ukufaka uMnuz Mpiyakhe Hlatshwayo oke waba yimeya ye-IFP eDumbe ,waphinde waba eye-NFP eZululand. UGwala uthe izokhethwa imeya kodwa basalungisa amagama kwikhomishini ezimele yokhetho. Uthe uHlatshwayo uzofungiswa njengekhansela labo kungekudala. UMnuz Zwakele Mncwango we-DA uthe lo mhlangano awukwazi ukubakhona ngoba yena akekho kuleli sonto. “Ngaphandle kwalokho mina njengomholi we-DA angiyazi indaba yokuthi ayisekho imeya ebaQulusini. I-IFP ayikaze ingazise ngakho amakhansela ami angavota kanjani engenawo umyalelo azobe ewuthola kimi ekubeni nami ngingabikelwe lutho,” kusho uMncwango. Uthe angeke aphawule indaba ethinta ubudlelwane babo nencwadi ayibhalelwe iFedEx.
USESABA nokuya esikoleni umfundi waseCastle Hill Primary, eNewlands West eThekwini emuva kokuba kuthiwe uhlukunyezwe womunye umfundi oyibhoklolo, omdonse amankwahla waze wavuvukala, wabuya kudokotela. Unina walo mfundi, esingeke simdalule ukuze kuvikelwe isithunzi somfundi, uthe usefisa nokuyikhipha ingane esikoleni ngoba iphoxekile kakhulu. Lo wesifazane ubethukuthele eveva ethi impilo yengane yakhe isengcupheni uma kunezigameko ezinje esikoleni. "Alukho usizo esiluthola esikoleni ngoba lezi zingane zikhonjiwe ziyaziwa, kufanele ngabe kubizwa abazali bazo zijeziswe kodwa akwenziwanga lokho. “Kuthiwa kunamabhoklolo aphuca izingane imiphako yazo kodwa akukho okwenziwayo ngalokho. Inhliziyo yami ibuhlungu, ukube akuwona uJuni ngabe ngiyayikhipha ingane yami kulesi sikole,’’ kubalisa unina wengane. Uthe indodana yakhe iyile kudokotela wayihlola, wathola ukuthi awukho umonakalo otheni. Unina wengane ukhathazeke ngokuthi kungenzeka umonakalo uvele emuva kwesikhathi eside isindala ingane. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, uthe inkinga yezingane eziqonela ezinye ezikoleni idlongile. Ukhale ngokuthi izimpande zayo zisemuva emakhaya lapho izingane zingafundiswa khona ngendlela. “Esimweni esinjalo siyaphenya bese sijezisa lowo mfundi osuke etholakale enecala ngoba ngeke kubekezelelwe ububhoklolo. Yinto embi kabi ukuthi kube nomfundi ohlukunyezwa adonswe ngomphambili esikoleni,’’ kusho uMthethwa. Unina wengane uthe usebuya ngisho kosonhlalakahle ngoba ubonile ukuthi ingane yakhe yethuka izanya, iyesaba ukuya esikoleni ngoba iphenduke inhlekisa ezinganeni efunda nazo. Uthe okumcika kakhulu ukuthi kuthalalisiwe esikoleni sengathi akwenzekanga lutho.
USIHLALO weBhodi yeTransnet, uDkt Popo Molefe, uthi sebeqale uphenyo ngenkohlakalo eyayenzeka ngesikhathi kuthengwa impahla eTransnet USIHLALO weBhodi yeTransnet, uDkt Popo Molefe, uthi sebeqale uphenyo ngenkohlakalo eyayenzeka ngesikhathi kuthengwa impahla eTransnet USIHLALO weBhodi yeTransnet, uDkt Popo Molefe, uthi ezinyangeni ezine ezedlule iTransnet ihlanganise ithimba longoti bomthetho nabaphenya amacala athinta imali ukuze baphenye ngokuphulwa kwemithetho ngesikhathi kuthengwa impahla enkampanini. UMolefe usho lokhu emuva kokuthi uMnyango weziMali uphakamise ukuthi zithathelwe izinyathelo zomthetho izikhulu zakwa-Eskom nezakwaTransnet ngodaba lokuthengwa kwempahla ezinkampanini zikahulumeni phakathi kuka-2012 no-2016. UMnyango weziMali wacela iFundudzi Forensic Services ukuthi iphenye. NgoLwesihlanu kushicilelwe umbiko weFundudzi. Phakathi kwezinto ebeziphenywa yiFundudzi Forensic Services wumsebenzi owenziwa yiMcKinsey eNingizimu Afrika, owenziwa yiRegiments Capital Management neTrillian Capital e-Eskom naseTransnet. UMnyango weziMali ucele oKlebe nophiko oluphenya ngamacala ezimali ukuthi baphenye ukuthi izikhulu zeTransnet neze-Eskom, okuhlanganisa uMnuz Anoj Singh owayephethe ezezimali e-Eskom, baphenywe ukuthi abagwazelwanga yiMcKinsey neRegiments. IFundudzi iphinde yakhala nangohlelo lokuthengwa kwezitimela eziwu-1 064. Esitatimendeni uMolefe uthe selokhu beqale uphenyo ezinyangeni ezine ezedlule banike izikhulu ezithile amaphepha okuthi kufanele zikhokhe imali ebalelwa kuR1.3 billion. Uphinde waveza ukuthi sekumiswe izikhulu eziningi kwaTransnet abale kuzo uMnuz Siyabonga Gama obeyisikhulu esiphezulu oxoshiwe, uMnuz Phetolo Ramosebudi obenguMgcinimafa kwaTransnet oxwayiswe ngokuthi uzomiswa waqoma ukusula emsebenzini, uMnuz Thamsanqa Jiyane, ophethe ezokuthengwa kwempahla eTransnet Engineering osamisiwe, uNkk Lindiwe Mdletshe oyiManager Supply Chain Services omisiwe noMnuz Edward Thomas oyiGeneral Manager of Finance naye umisiwe. UMolefe uthe okwamanje kusaqhubeka uphenyo futhi ngeke bame kuze kube kujeziswa abathintekayo. UMBUZO: Mhla zingu-30 kule nyanga ngizobe ngihlanganisa iminyaka engu-65 kanti kuzobe sekuyisikhathi sokuya empeshenini. Ngizobe ngiqeda iminyaka engu-42 nezinyanga ezinhlanu ngisebenzela uhulumeni. Sonke isikhathi ngisebenza bengikhokha imali nyanga zonke kwi-GEPF - isikhwama sempesheni sabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngishadile kanti umhlomulo wami wempesheni uzoba iholo lesibili. Nginemali engiyilondolozile kodwa ngihlela ukungayikhiphi ingakapheli iminyaka emihlanu emuva kokuya empeshenini. Ngihlela ukusebenza izinsuku ezimbalwa ngesonto, ukuze ngikwazi ukuqhubeka nokuhola. Kubukeka ngingeke ngiwuswele umsebenzi. Ngingakhetha kokubili; ukuya empeshenini noma ukwesula emsebenzini. Kepha iningi lozakwethu likhetha ukwesula emsebenzini, lithathe isamba semali kunokuhola impesheni nyanga zonke. Isizathu salokhu wukuthi kungenzeka imali yesikhwama seGEPF isetshenziswe ukutakula iminyango kahulumeni edonsa kanzima. Ukukhula kwemibono mayelana nenkohlakalo kuleli kubhebhethekisa ungabazane. Impendulo: Ukuze ukwazi ukuthola izeluleko ezigcwele kubalulekile ukuqonda kabanzi ngesimo sakho sezimali. Lokhu kubandakanya impahla, izindleko, iholo lazinyanga zonke, intela, isimo sakho sokutshala imali, uhlelo lwefa nokunye. Kuyaye kuhlelwe ngokwezidingo nesimo sakho. Uma ingekho le mniningwane lesi seluleko sizokubeka esithombeni uma ukhetha ukwesula emsebenzini okanye uthathe impesheni. Ukuya empeshenini: Ibhonasi, phecelezi i-13th cheque, ungayilondoloza ukuze kunyuke isamba semali eminyakeni emihlanu. Kuhle ukuba nomshwalense wokungcwaba wenani lika-R7500 kepha kungenzeka ukuba ungeneli izindleko zomgcwabo, itshe nokunye. Kungamele wengeze imali. Imali ekhokhelwa ikhefu inezindleko zentela kepha awulahlekelwa uma wesula emsebenzini. Isibonelelo somshwalense wezempilo sika-R2 159 ngenyanga, ekhuphuka ngonyaka, sikhokhwa impilo yakho yonke. Uma udlula emhlabeni ingakapheli iminyaka emihlanu, umuntu oshade naye uzoqhubeka nokuthola imali bese kuthi emuva kweminyaka emihlanu ahole * -50% wempesheni yakho. Ezinye izimali ziyacwila. Konke lokhu kutholakala uma ukhetha uhlelo lwempesheni olunozinzo kanti olukhuphuka ngo-7.5% (leli phesenti lingaphezulu kwe-inflation). Isamba semali yempesheni esingu-R500 000, nangaphansi, asikhokhelwa intela. Ngokwemigomo yezomsebenzi, ingxenye yemali yempesheni ngeke ibe nezindleko zentela ngokomgomo ka-31 March 1998. Ukwesula emsebenzini: Uma wesula emsebenzini ngalesi skhathi ulahlekelwa yile mhlomulo elandelayo; Ibhonasi yaminyaka yonke Umshwalense wokungcwaba Isbonelelo somshwalense wezempilo Ukukhokhelwa kwekhefu ngokheshi Umhlomulo wokwesula emsebenzini ungafakwa esikhwameni esiseceleni kanti imali ungayigcina ngokuyitshala kutshalomali ozikhethele lona kuze kube uya empeshenini. Uma wesula emsebenzini, ukukwazi ukukhipha okukodwa kokuthathu kwisamba semali (uma isamba sokuqala singekho ngaphezulu kuka-R500 000 awuyikhokhi intela). Isamba esisalayo ungasitshala kwi-living annuity okanye uthathe i-life annuity ene-life assurer. I-life annuity ehlanganiselwe ingathengwa kumshwalense. Kunezinhlelo ezehlukene ezikhona kanti i-annuity ingahlanganiswa ne-inflation ekhokhwa kuze kube kushona oshade naye. I-living annuity inikeza igunya lokuba uzithathele izinqumo kanye nomeluleki wezezimali. Kulolu hlelo ukukhishwa kwemali kuba kanye ngonyaka (imali elinganiselwa ku- 2.5% wesamba semali esingakhuphuka sibe ku-17.5%) yize singaphakamisa ukuba ibe phakathi kuka- 5 no-6%. Uma udlula emhlabeni, yonke imali idluliselwa kwabasohlwini lwabazohlomula okanye izingane zakho. Bangaqhubeka nokukhipha imali. Okubi ngalolu hlelo lwe-living annuity ngukuthi, ubungozi botshalomali bubheka wena. Izinqumo ezingaphusile nokukhipha imali ngokungenamkhawulo kungaba nomthelela ongemuhle kuwe ngakho-ke kusemqoka ukuba ufune umeluleki uma uya empeshenini. Uthe ngenxa yobucayi becala okunye ngeke bakwazi ukukudalula futhi abantu kumele baqonde ukuthi akayena umphenyi. Okhulumela umndeni, uMnuz Siyabonga Meyiwa, uthe bayakwamukela okushiwo ungqongqoshe futhi bayethemba ukuthi ngelinye ilanga bayolithola iqiniso.
