UMHOLI weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango UMHOLI weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango USEKWA nayiziMeya zomasipala abakhulu eGauteng umholi weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango (osesithombeni), iqembu lakhe elibheke engqungqutheleni yesifundazwe ezoba se-Olive Convention Centre, eThekwini, ngoFebhuwari 3. IMeya yaseJohannesburg, uMnuz Herman Mashaba, neMeya yaseTshwane, uMnuz Solly Msimanga, ngoLwesibili baphumele obala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana baseka uMncwango ekutheni abuyiselwe esikhundleni sakhe. UMashaba noMsimang bathi iDA ikhule kakhulu eKZN iholwa wuMncwango. UMncwango ubanga isikhundla sokuhola iqembu eKZN noMnuz Emmanuel Mhlongo oyikhansela laseThekwini. Oke waba yimbangi kaMncwango enkulu, uMnuz Sizwe Mchunu, akazange awungenele umbango. Esikhundleni sikaSihlalo wenhlangano esifundazweni kubanga uMnuz Francois Rodgers noMnuz Dean Mcpherson. UMncwango ukwamukele ukuphakanyiswa kwakhe. Ilungu leDA esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Hlanganani Gumbi, ngoLwesibili uthe lifisa uMncwango ukuthi aqhubeke nokuhola iqembu esifundazweni. UGumbi uthe iDA ikhulise ukwesekwa kwayo esifundazweni iholwa nguMncwango. “Okokuqala emlandweni iDA inamakhansela uMkhanyakude wonke, namakhansela KwaNongoma nakwezinye izindawo zasekhaya. Konke lokhu sikuzuze ngoMncwango,” kusho uGumbi. Uthe kumanje iDA ihola omasipala abaningi KwaZulu-Natal ngokubambisana ne-IFP. “Uma kusenoMncwango iDA izosuka ekubuseni ngokubambisana ne-IFP igcine sekuyiyona yodwa ebusayo,” kusho uGumbi.

URamaphosa ehambisana nabanye abaholi be-ANC esifundazweni uhambele kule ndawo izolo enxenxa abantu ukuthi batheleke ngobuningi kulo mgubho weqembu. Uphinde wathembisa ukuthi uzothula uhlelo lwakhe lokuthuthukisa izwe. “Kulo nyaka sizokwakha amathuba omsebenzi ngoba sifuna ukukhulisa umnotho wezwe, sithuthukise imfundo yezingane zethu, silethe nezidingo ezizothuthukisa abantu bakithi,” kusho uRamaphosa. Uthe namhlanje uzosika ikhekhe lokugubha iminyaka ewu-107 ye-ANC Ohlange ekhaya likaMengameli wokuqala we-ANC. “Abantu bayayibona imisebenzi ye-ANC futhi lesi sifunda senze okuningi uma kukhuluywa ngokwakhela abantu izindlu size sazuza nezindondo. Kwakhiwe izindlu eziwu-129 futhi kuzokwakhiwa ezinye eziwu-800 Uthe i-ANC yenze isiqiniseko sokuthi isifundazwe sisebenza kahle ngisho emiphumeleni ka-matric. “Ngiyaziqhenya ngomsebenzi omuhle owenziwa wothisha, abazali nezingane KwaZulu-Natal wokuzibophezela ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela ka-matric. Ilokhu ithuthukile njengoba nezinga lokuphasa linyukile. Uma kubhekwa imiphumela ka-matric isifundazwe silale isibili, KwaZulu-Natal nenze kahle kakhulu,” kusho uRamaphosa.

Uma imayini iqhubeka kufanele ihambisane nezolimo, ezokuvakasha nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Umuntu ozonikwa ilayisensi kufanele alandele imithetho yezokumbiwayo. Inhlolovo izoqala emasontweni ambalwa ezayo,” kusho uMantashe.

Nathi Maphumulo Nathi Maphumulo SEZIQALE phansi izinkinga esikoleni samabanga aphezulu eMbumbulu esacishe savalwa ngenxa yokungaziphathi kahle kwabafundi, asebekhala ngesibhaxu kuthishanhloko. Abafundi baseMbambangwe Secondary abafunda u-matric badube amakilasi izolo nangoLwesithathu bekhala ngokuthi abasakwazi ukubekezelela ukushaywa nguthishanhloko, bakhala nangokuthi uyabathuka. Njengoba abafundi abaningi baka-matric bezoqhubeka nokufunda uma kuvalwa izikole namuhla, abaseMbambangwe abacele ukungadalulwa bathe abalubhadi esikoleni. Bathi sekukaningi bekhononda ngokushaywa manje sebenqume ukulusukumela lolu daba. Izolo bathe sebecele ukubonana nothishanhloko bamtshele okokugcina ngezikhalo zabo. Kuke kwavalwa amehlo ngesimo salesi sikole ngo-2014 kukhalwa ngabafundi abangalawuleki. Abanye babesolwa ngokuzihlanganisa namaqembu ezigebengu bese beqhubeka nezimpi zabo esikoleni. Ngo-2015 kwangenelela ikomidi iMbumbulu Education Forum ukulungisa isimo sesikole obesekuhlongozwa ukuthi sivalwe. USihlalo wekomiti inkosi Nathi Maphumulo, uthe bebengakezwa ngezinkinga zabafundi. Uthe uyadumala uma sebeqala olunye uthuthuva phezu kwemizamo yokulungisa isikole. “Uma abafundi bekhala ngokuqiniswa kwesandla nangokushaywa kumele baveze ubufakazi. Asihambisani nokuhlukunyezwa kwabafundi kodwa ngeke sikhulume futhi ngento engenabo ubufakazi. Kuyadumaza lokhu ngoba isimo sesikole bese sibuyela kwesijwayelekile nathi sesigculisekile. Kuningi osekushintshile ngoba nohulumeni uthembise ukulekelela ukuze kunyuke nemiphumela ka-matric,” kusho uMaphumulo. Uthe ungomunye wabanxenxe iMeya yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede ukuthi ivakashele kulesi sikole nonyaka. UNkk Gumede ovakashile lesi sikole ngoFebhuwari, wanikela ngezimpahla zesikole wathembisa nokuqinisekisa ukuthi isikole senza kahle. UMaphumulo uthe konke lokhu bekuyimizamo yokuthi abafundi bakhuthazeke, isikole singabuyeli esimeni sakudala. Uthembise ukuthi bazolulandela udaba nezikhalo zabafundi. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lesi ngesinye sezikole esike sahlupha ngezinkinga phambilini. “Sizocela umbiko kwisekethe ukuze sithole ukuthi sinjani isimo esikoleni. Kudingeka sazi ukuthi yimiphi imizamo eyenziwayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukufunda akuphazamiseki, ikakhulukazi njengoba kuthinteka no-matric,” kusho uMlotshwa. Mayelana nezinsolo ezibhekiswe kuthishanhloko uthe badinga ubufakazi ukuze baphenye.

Okokuqala, ngizobeka kucace ukuthi ngokwenqubo yaleli bandla uma kuzongena imihlangano eyaye yenziwe kathathu onyakeni, okuyinhlangano kaJanuwari, Julayi no-Okthoba kumele kuthethelelwe bonke abebemisiwe ngenxa yokuphambana nomthetho webandla noma ngamacala athile abasuke bewenzile, bephula imithetho kaNkulunkulu. Kodwa lokhu sibona sekushaywa indiva nobaba sengathi uyehluleka ukuphuma nento ecacile njengomholi webandla. Abantu bayazenzela nje, akanendaba futhi uyehluleka ukumela iqiniso njengoba kunguye owokugcina okumele aphume nezwi eliwujuqu. Ngikhuluma nje kunabagcotshwa abayilokhu bamiswa. Manje sekungaphezulu kweminyaka eyisithupha udaba lwabo lungakhulumeki, yena ubaba uthulile nje akabashayi mkhuba noma sebekhalela ukuthi phela abaxolelwe, babuyele esontweni. Ngokwenqubo yebandla lokhu akwenzeki. Siyamangala-ke ngoba lokhu kuyaphambana nomthetho kanti nekomiti elimiselwe ukulungisa izindaba zebandla lizithulele nje. Manje angisazi ukuthi leli bandla libhekephi uma kunjalo. Uma yena engabathetheleli njengomnikazi wesonto kanti ngubani okumele abathethelele? Futhi uma yena engabazweli ngubani kanti ozobazwela ngoba uma bexabene, engabalamuli ngabe ulindele ukuthi kuze kuchitheke igazi yini lapha ebandleni? Yonke le mihlangano engiyibalile iyangena nje bamisiwe laba bantu, abasonti ndawo, abasazazi noma basengamaNazaretha noma sebeyini. Uma belahlwa benganakwa kanti yini lena engaka abayona lapha ebandleni edala bangiyitholi intethelelo? Uma bengahamba manje emhlabeni bengathethelelwe kuyothiwani? Sengisola ukuthi naye ubaba akalinakile ibandla ukuthi abantu bayezwana noma cha. Laba bagcotshwa ngingabala oMfundisi Khanyi, Mavuso, Ngema, Mchunu noMvangeli uMtshali. Angisazi kahle noma bamisiwe noma baxoshiwe yini ebandleni. Ngikhuluma nje lona omunye uMfundisi Richard Mchunu wake wazidela weza mathupha ethi uzozicelela intethelelo kuye ubaba uNyazi kepha wavinjwa ngamanye amalungu ebandla, amfaka induku phambi kwakhe ubaba. Ngelanga ashaywa ngalo kwakuyiSabatha kwakukhona ngisho iSilo Samabandla sivakashile, okungavumelekile-ke emthethweni kaNkulunkulu ukuba kwenzeke. Futhi lokhu kwakumele ubaba njengomholi aphume nezwi eliwujuqu ngaso leso sikhathi, ayilungise yena le ndaba yalaba bagcotshwa abathethelele babuyele esontweni nabo bazikhonzele. Kepha yena wathi laba bantu abaxabene bebodwa, abasale bayilungise le ndaba yokuxabana kwabo wasuka washiya kulenga kunjalo. Le nto eyenzekayo lapha ebandleni isiphethe kabi kakhulu ngoba ihlambalaza ibandla likaNkulunkulu wasekuPhakameni. Angikaze ngiyibone le nto ngoba kuyimanje kukhona abanye abagcotshwa abamisiwe futhi nabo okungezwakali kahle ukuthi benze sono sini. UThingolwenkosazana lwalungahambisani nokushaywa nokuxoshwa kwabantu esontweni noma ngabe benzeni. Lwaluze lusho luthi mina angixoshi muntu ngoba nobaba abazange baxoshe muntu. Kodwa manje lokhu sekuyinsakavukela nje ebandleni. Siyibandla siyamangala ukuthi sekuyisonto elinjani kanti leli uma selinjena. Ngiyafisa ukuthi nesigungu esiphezulu silusukumele ngokukhulu ukushesha lolu daba lwalaba bagcotshwa, babuyiselwe ebandleni nabo bakhonze. Le nto ibuhlungu ngoba laba bantu banezingane namakhosikazi abangazi lutho futhi angone lutho. Nabo bayathinteka abasasonti ndawo ngoba kumiswe oyise nabayeni babo. Ngicela isonto lingaphenduki kube yikwamachanca kwampunzi edla emini lingaphenduki libe yihlathi ekubeni kunomholi nesigungu esimiselwe ukulungisa lezi zindaba. Njengoba nje kuzoba nomhlangano lapha eGoli kuyo lenyanga bengicela babuyiswe laba bagcotshwa, kungadlalwa ngokukholwa kwabo ngoba bengenamkhulumeli. Ngifisa ukuthi kuphele lokhu kuxabana okukhona ngaphansi kobuholi boNyazi nalo alusukume lubonise ubuholi balo luqede le ngxabano ekhona esithathe iminyaka eminingi kangaka. Uma lwehluleka ukulamula le ngxabano ngifisa bamiswe nalaba abanye abagcotshwa abaxabene nalaba abemisiwe baze babuyele esontweni sebebuyisene ngoba basonta kanjani bona bexabene nabanye? Sekwaze kwaba khona omunye umuzi owakheka phezu kwenzondo khona lapha eGoli, okuyaye kuthi uma uNyazi luze kulona omunye umuzi abanye abavumelekile ukungena kuwo ngoba kuxatshenwe. Uma selulethe umhlangano kulona omunye futhi laba abanye abavumelekile ukungena kuwo. Ubaba uyawubuka nje lo msindo uyaqhubeka. Bengilokhu ngithi uzowunaka awulungise njengenhloko. Manje zidla amahlanga phambi kwakhe abantu bayazenzela nje. Iyakhathaza le nto ngoba isisontisa kabi uma sinyonkolozana kabi kangaka ngoba awukwazi ukukhuluma nalaba abanye ngoba uthathwa njengevukela mbuso kulaba abamise, abanye kushiwo lokhu nalokhu. “Wonke amaNazaretha mawabe munye njengebumba likasimende.” Ameni, ngiyabonga. BUCHITHEKE bugayiwe kubhuntsha umngcwabo eMpophomeni, ngaseHowick, ngempelasonto umndeni ungena ushaqa ibhokisi likamufi ngesikhathi kunenkonzo yomlindelo. Umndeni kaMnuz Bhekisisa Msane (62) waseShowe obehlala ekhweni kankosikazi omncane eMpophomeni ufike washaqa ibhokisi nesidumbu ngoMgqibelo ebusuku kulandela ukungaboni ngaso linye nomndeni kaNksz Sandile Ndlovu abehlala naye. UMsane bekumele afihlwe ngeSonto kodwa kugcine kungenzekanga abakubo sebelande isidumbu ekhweni. Omunye obekhona kwenzeka lokhu kodwa ongathandanga ukudalulwa uveze ukuthi uMsane unamakhosikazi amabili aziwa umndeni bese kuba khona noNksz Ndlovu owabhala ngasese naye umndeni ungazi. “Ubehlala ekhweni. Kuthe esegula bamphindisela emakhosikazini akhe. Bekuthi uma esesindile bamlande ngoba kudliwa imali yakhe yempesheni nekhadi lokuhola belihlala kumkhwekazi wakhe. Intombi kuyaziwa ngisho endaweni ukuthi bese ikipitile namanje ushone uMsane ingekho izwe ngoba isishayelwa ucingo,” kusho umthombo. NgoMgqibelo ebusuku ngesikhathi kunomlindelo kuthiwa umndeni kamufi awuzange ukhulume lutho ungene waqonda ebhokisini kugcwele amakholwa ecula. “Ngibone sekushaywana, abebepheka baphuma nokudla kwathelwana ngakho. Amakholwa asale ecula, bathatha ibhokisi bahamba nalo kodwa nakhona bebelandelwa amatshe ngemuva. Abanye bahambe belimele nami ngithole imihuzuko,” kusho umthombo. UNkk Ntombi Msane oyilungu lomndeni kamufi uthe baphoqwe yisimo ngoba bebebona ukuthi uMsane uzongcwatshwa ezintabeni. “Ukuba ubenomuzi besizovuma amngcwabe. Sinqaba ngoba unamakhosikazi amabili asemthethweni futhi nekhaya elikhulu likhona lapho engangcwatshwa khona. Siqale emaphoyiseni eMpophomeni, sadlulela enduneni nasekhanseleni sayobika. Silufakile enkantolo udaba sayobika naseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya kwathiwa awukho emthethweni umshado wabo kodwa kuzothatha izinyanga ezimbili ukuthi usulwe. Sibone kukude kakhulu sayolanda isidumbu yize bebesithuka besishaya,” kusho uNkk Msane. Ethintwa uNksz Ndlovu uthe uMsane wamshada engasathandani namakhosikazi akhe. “Wagula wangena esibhedlela abantu bakubo bengamsizi waze wacela ukuthi sithuthe siyohlala ekhaya alungise nempesheni. Kuyiphutha ukuthi bengikipitile, ngiyasebenza ePinetown. Sebenzela ukudicilela igama lami phansi. Kuyimanje umzimba ubuhlungu ngitubekile ngoba kwase kuliwa. Noma bengimthanda umyeni wami kodwa sesithathe isinqumo sokubayeka nesidumbu. Sengigqoke inzilo yize ngingamngcwabanga umyeni wami,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu ekhihla isililo.
UMKHANDLU weTheku uthi umphakathi ungatatazeli awulinde imiphumela ezocacisa ukuthi ngabe izakhamizi zakuleli dolobha ezigule ngemuva kokudla amaqanda, ziguliswe yisalmonella yini. UMnuz Musawakhe Mayisela okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uthe ngemuva kokuthi odokotela ababone abantu ababalelwa ku-20 ebebegula ngemuva kokudla amaqanda bakuqinisekisile ukuthi iziguli abazibonile ziguliswe yigciwane isalmonella. Ngenxa yalokhu umasipala uyaphenya ukuthi isalmonella okuyigciwane elitholakala ekudleni okungaphekiwe, belisemaqandeni yini nokuthi ngempela lezi zakhamuzi ziguliswe wukudla okunalo yini. “Okwamanje abantu abehlise umoya, baqinisekise ukuthi bageza izandla uma bezothinta ukudla ngoba lesi sifo sisabalaliswa ukungahlanzeki. Ngiyethemba ukuthi lizophela isonto sesiyitholile imiphumela enemininingwane ephelele. Okwamanje bangaphezu kuka-20 abantu ababonwe ngodokotela ebebephalaza behlanjulukelwe nayizisu okungezinye zezimpawu ze-salmonella,” kusho uMayisela. Kuphazamiseke umcintiswano wokupheka endaweni yokudlela, i-Old Town Italy, eMhlanga abebengenele umcintiswano bephalaza ngemuva kokudla ukudla okunye kwakho obekuneqanda. AbakwaSpar obekuthengwe kubo amaqanda bathi basalinde imiphumela yocwaningo ezocacisa ukuthi ngabe amaqanda abo abenegciwane isalmonella ngempela yini. Okwamanje bathe amaqanda asazoqhubeka adayiswe, bazowakhipha uma bethola ukuthi anayo isalmonella. UMnuz Rowan Holt wenkampani ekhiqiza iBarn Eggs ephakela izitolo zakwaSpar uthe uphenyo lwesikhashana luveza ukuthi leli gciwane alikho emaqandeni abo kodwa wathi bazobambisana nabenza ucwaningo. UMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni uthe uzosiqapha isimo, kodwa ucwaningo lwenziwa uphiko lwezempilo lukaMasipala weTheku ngoba zonke lezi zigameko zenzeke eThekwini.

USENKINGENI umfelokazi wasesigodini saKwaNgubo esizweni sabaThembu eMsinga ngaphansi kwenkosi uSiphamandla Mthembu ohlawuliswe inkomo ngecala lokukhumula inzilo ehlobo. UNkk Thandiwe Ndlovu-Makhunga (46) namhlanje ubuyele enkantolo yesizwe ngemuva kokulahlwa yicala ngoJulayi 31, nonyaka, lapho anikwa khona umnqamulajuqu wezinsuku ezingu-14, ukuthi zingapheli angayikhiphile inhlawulo kodwa kuze kube yimanje akakahlawuli. Lo wesifazane uzile izinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela ngoSepthemba nyakenye kushone umyeni wakhe kwaze kwaba nguFebhuwari. Isigungu senkantolo yesizwe kuhlelwe ukuthi namhlanje siphinde sihlangane lapho kulindeleke ukuthi sibhunge ngodaba lukaNkk Ndlovu-Makhunga. UNkk Ndlovu-Makhunga unqabile ukuphawula ngalolu daba izolo. Abantu abasondelene naye abakhulume neSolezwe kodwa bacela ukuthi bangadalulwa ngoba besaba ukuthi bazojeziswa bathi abaneme ngesinqumo senkantolo yesizwe ngoba indaba yenzilo yinto ethinta umndeni. “Asazi ukuthi isizwe nenkosi bangenaphi endabeni yokuthi abantu bazila kanjani ngoba leyo yinto yomndeni,” kusho leli ilungu lomphakathi. Lithe kuyaqala ukuthi kuphume isinqumo esifana nalesi enkantolo yesizwe. “Njengoba isizwe sabaThembu sisikhulu kangaka, manje inkosi isizohamba ibheka ukuthi abantu emindenini yabo bazila kanjani?” kubuza eli lungu lomphakathi. Lithe uNkk Ndlovu-Makhunga wabatshela ukuthi umyeni wakhe esaphila wathi kumele angamzileli isikhathi eside. Ithintwa izolo, inkosi Mthembu ithe iyalwazi udaba lukaNkk Ndlovu-Makhunga, yathi ibona abamlahla ngecala. “Lowo wesifazane simhlawulise inkomo ngoba wenze into engenziwa esizweni sabaThembu, ayilokothwa inzilo ehlobo ebaThenjini ikhunyulwa ebusika kuphela,” kusho uMthembu. Uthe njengoba sekuze kwafika izinsuku ezingu-14 ezazibekiwe, ingakhishiwe inhlawulo, bazophoqoleka ukuthi bathathe ezinye izinyathelo. Isazi samasiko, uSolwazi uJabulani Maphalala, sithe udaba lwenzilo udaba oluthinda umndeni. “Ngokwesiko lakwaZulu kwakuthiwa umfelokazi usuke ezile kahle uma ezile kwaze kwaphela unyaka kodwa asikho isikhathi esibekelwe ukuzila. Kuya ngokuthi inkomo yokumkhumula inzilo ikhona yini,” kusho uMaphalala. Uthe kudala amakhosikazi ayezila ngokuthi akhumule isicholo, asale ngezinwele. “Izingubo ezimnyama lezi ezigqokwayo into yamanje. Kudala amakhosikazi ayekhumula isicholo,” kusho uMaphalala. Uthe uyadideka ukuthi le nto eyenzeka ebaThenjini yenzeka kanjani ngoba abaThembu basebenzisa isiko lakwaZulu. “La baThembu okhuluma ngabo abaNgoza lona owabalekela iLembe uShaka babuya sebenikwa le ndawo abahleli kuyona manje kwathiwa abagadwe uSojiyisa wakwaZulu,” kusho uMaphalala. Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Lennox Mabaso, uthe lolu daba bayaqala ukuzwa ngalo, wathembisa ukuthi bazoluphenya. “Sesijube ihhovisi lethu eMzinyathi ukuba lizilandele lezi zinsolo ukuze sithole umbiko ogcwele,” kusho uMabaso.
UNGOTI wezemfundo uSolwazi Jonathan Jansen ogxeke uhulumeni ngokuthi akanandaba nemfundo yezingane Isithombe:ZANELE ZULU UNGOTI wezemfundo uSolwazi Jonathan Jansen ogxeke uhulumeni ngokuthi akanandaba nemfundo yezingane Isithombe:ZANELE ZULU UNGOTI wezemfundo owaziwayo ngokugxeka uhulumeni angahlonizi ngokuhluleka ukufukula imfundo yakuleli uSolwazi Jonathan Jansen uthi uma uhulumeni ungase ugxile kakhulu emazingeni aphansi ezemfundo ngeke ibe khona inkinga yezinkumbi zabafundi abashiya phakathi ukufunda bengafinyelelanga kwa-matric. UJansen ozinze eNyuvesi yaseStellenbosch oke waba ngumphathi weNyuvesi yaseFree State, ukhwele wadilika kuhulumeni ngokuthi akayikhathalele imfundo ngoba izingane zosopolitiki zifunda ezikoleni ezingcono. “Ukuze uhulumeni alungise inkinga yezemfundo kuleli, kumele kugxilwe emazingeni aphansi ikakhulu ezinkulisa (Grade R). Akungagxilwa emazingeni aphezulu ikakhulu emanyuvesi,” kusho uJansen ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yenyunyana yothisha iNaptosa eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu. Uthe izinto zimapeketwane kwezemfundo yingakho abafundi abawuhhafu wesigidi bengafinyeleli kwa-matric beshiya phakathi izifundo. Usho lokhu nje izinyunyana zothisha zihlale zikhala ngokuthi kumele kuqiniswe emazingeni aphansi ikakhulu uGrade R njengoba othisha bakhona bengaqashiwe ngokugcwele. Imfundo ethathwa njengebalulekile iqala kwaGrade 1. Uthe kukhulu ukwehlukana kwezemfundo njengoba izingane zabacebile zithola engcono. Unxuse othisha ukuthi bangalindeli uhulumeni ukuthi afukule imfundo kodwa babhukule bazenzele. “Ningalindeli uhulumeni ngoba ayikho into azoyenza ngoba izingane zongqongqoshe zifunda ezikoleni ezikahle. Sukumani nenzele izingane zabahlwempu ezidonsa kanzima.” Ukhale kakhulu ngenye yezinyunyana angayidalulanga ukuthi uma iteleka ayifuni kuvalwe izikole zabamhlophe ngoba yilapho kufunda khona izingane zamalungu ayo. Uthe ucwaningo luyaveza ukuthi umfundi ofunde esikoleni esinayo yonke into, noma lezo ezazaziwa njengazabamhlophe kuba negebe uma umqhathanisa nalabo abafunde ezikoleni zabamnyama wathi leli gebe alibe lisavaleka kuze kuphele iminyaka engu-12 yokufunda. Ugqugquzele ukuthi kufundelwe abafundi nezingane izincwadi wancoma nothisha bokufika ukuthi bayawazi umsebenzi wabo. UMnuz Basil Manuel, isikhulu seNaptosa sikhale kakhulu ngokuthi kunenkinga kwiMaths njengoba abafundi beyifeyila. Uthe izinga lokuphasa lesi sifundo liphansi wathi noma bedlulela kwamanye amabanga aphezulu isimo siba sibi kakhulu. UNksz Thirona Moodley, isikhulu sale nyunyana kulesi sifundazwe, uxwayise othisha ukuthi bangabacwasi abafundi noma bafake imizwa yabo uma befundisa. Ukhulume ngesehlakalo sikathisha osulile waseWestville Girls High, osolwa ngokubiza abafundi abamnyama ngegama lokubacwasa eliqala ngo-K.
LIPHUCE iphoyisa isibhamu lazingqokloza ngaso emtholampilo lashona ibhungu (20) laseGamalakhe okuthiwa litakulwe amaphoyisa lishaywa umphakathi emuva kokuba sengozini yemoto eshiye abantu belimele. Kuthiwa uMnuz Vuyo “Boy Boy” Abdolo waseMagogogweni, eGamalakhe, uzidubulele emtholampilo iGamalakhe Community Health Centre ekhanda emuva kokuthi elanyulelwe amaphoyisa eshaywa umphakathi ngeSonto ekuseni. Kuthiwa ibe seyishayisa abantu abathathu balimala baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela. “Abagibeli nomshayeli kuthiwa bazamile ukumumisa ngesikhathi ezama ukubaleka endaweni yesigameko. Kusolakala ukuthi umufi ushaywe amalungu omphakathi ngoba ezama ukubaleka endaweni yesigameko emuva kwengozi. Kusolakala nokuthi ngesikhathi engaphandle komtholampilo endaweni yokupaka umsolwa uhlule iphoyisa ngamandla wathatha isibhamu salo wazidubula ekhanda ngesikhathi elinye lingaphakathi emtholampilo,” kusho uCaptain Gwala. UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini ka-Abdolo athe kuthiwa ubentshontshe imoto yakubo ngesikhathi ebandakanyeka engozini. Uthe batholile ukuthi usizwe amaphoyisa amyisa emtholampilo waseGamalakhe nokuyilapho obekulindeleke ukuthi ahlolwe igazi ukuze kuvele ukuthi ubengaphuzile yini amanzi amponjwana. UDhlomo uchaze lesi sigameko njengesishaqisayo. “Sidabuke kakhulu ngalesi sigameko sokulahlekelwa umphefumulo wumuntu osemusha ngokungenasidingo. Akucabangeki ukuthi abazali bakhe babhekene nobuhlungu obungakanani kulesi sikhathi. Akulula ukubhekana nesimo sokushonelwa yingane ngenxa yento eqale iwukuganga yagcina seyiyinhlekelele enjena,” kusho uDhlomo. Uthe bayazi nokuthi bakhahlamezeke kangakanani abantu abebekhona ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko emtholampilo waseGamalakhe njengoba ethe babafisela ukuthi bathole amandla kuNkulunkulu ukuthi abasize babhekane nalesi simo. Uthe bazobasiza nalabo abadinga ukululekwa ngokomqondo. Unxuse namalungu omphakathi ukuthi akugweme ukuzijezisela abantu. Izolo, umalume ka-Abdolo, uMnuz Phumlani Mdlozini, uthe umndeni usesimeni esingesihle emuva kokwenzekile. Uthe akulula ukuthi bangakhuluma kakhulu ngakho ngoba kuphenywa wuphiko oluphenya amacala enziwa amaphoyisa Independent Police Investigative Directorate. Ngokusho kwakhe, umshana wakhe ube sengozini yemoto wase ehlaselwa amalungu omphakathi nokuyilapho okufike khona amaphoyisa amthatha amuyisa emtholampilo okuyilapho okwenzeke khona lesi sigameko. UMdlozini uthe umshana wakhe ubethathe imoto yakubo eyoyilungisa ngesikhathi kwenzeka ingozi.
INGXENYE yezitshudeni zesikhungo esicija ngamakhono, iMfolozi eGroutville, ezilale emakilasini zicasulwa ukulinda imali yokukhokhela izindawo zokuhlala INGXENYE yezitshudeni zesikhungo esicija ngamakhono, iMfolozi eGroutville, ezilale emakilasini zicasulwa ukulinda imali yokukhokhela izindawo zokuhlala KUSAMILE ukufunda ekolishi eliqeqesha ngamakhono eGroutville emuva kokuba sekuphele izinsuku izitshudeni zilala emakilasini ngoba zingakhokhelwe imali yokuqasha izindawo zokuhlala. Izitshudeni zize zakhishwa ngamaphoyisa ekolishi ngoLwesihlanu. Izitshudeni zaseMfolozi TVET College zicasulwe wukuthi sezibekezele isikhathi eside zingayitholi imali yokukhokhela izindawo zokuhlala ekhishwa yisikhwama iNational Students Financial Aid Scheme (Nsfas). Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ngoMsombuluko odlule bafike emakilasini nezimpahla nezingubo zokulala ngoba abanye sebexoshiwe emiqashweni abebehlala kuyo ngenxa yokungakhokhi. Ukulala kwabo emakilasini kuphazamise nokufunda njengoba kuthiwa othisha bagcine bengasafiki yavalwa ikolishi. Okhulumela isigungu sezitshudeni, uMbali Nxumalo, uthe bagcina ukufunda ngoMsombuluko odlule. “Izitshudeni bezilokhu zibekezele kodwa inkinga iqale sezixoshwa ezindaweni zokuhlala ebeziqashe kuzona. Inselelo enkulu wukuthi zihlala ezindaweni ezikude futhi zizidinga ngempela izindawo zokuhlala. Kumanje ezinye zimpintshiswe abanezindawo zokuhlala, ezinye zaphindela emakhaya,” kusho yena. Uthe izitshudeni azihlangene nokuphazamiseka kokufunda ngoba ukulala kwazo bekungaphazamisi. Uveze ukuthi bamangele uma othisha nabahlanza amakilasi bengasafiki. Bagcina ukulala ngoLwesihlanu emuva kokukhishwa ngamaphoyisa. Kuthiwa le nkinga isiphazamise nezitshudeni ezifunda ngasese njengoba othisha bengasafundisi. Zilinganiselwa ku-80 izitshudeni okuthiwa zithintekile kulolu daba. UMnuz Sam Zungu, ophethe wonke amakhempasi eMfolozi, uthe kuzocaca ngoLwesithathu ukuthi sizovulwa nini isikhungo. Uphikile ukuthi izitshudeni ziqale ukulala emakilasini ngoMsombuluko wathi ziqale ngoLwesithathu. “Okumele sikucacise wukuthi asikwazi ukulawula uhlelo lokukhipha imali yezitshudeni kwaNsfas. Izitshudeni zizifakela izicelo ngqo kwaNsfas thina sithole uhla lwabazoxhaswa emuva kwesikhathi. Inkinga iqale ngokuthi kufike uhla lwamagama abazoxhaswa uNsfas ngesikhathi izitshudeni zisemaholidini ePhasika ngo-Ephreli 4. Bekumele ziqale ukufunda ngoMsombuluko odlule, ngenxa yokuhluleka ukubekezela zacasuka. Besisalindele ukuhlaziya uhla bese siluphindisela kwaNsfas ukuqinisekisa abazoxhaswa,” kusho uZungu. Ekhuluma nephephandaba uMnuz Kagisho Mamabolo okhulumela abakwaNsfas uthe ziyaqhubeka izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa izitshudeni ezizoxhaswa bacela zibekezele.

Lokhu kushiwo uConstable Lihle Mlotshwa woPhiko oluphenya amacala odlame emndenini, oluvikela izingane, luphenye namacala athinta ucansi, iFamily Violence, Child Protection and Sexual Offenses Unit (FCS), ngesikhathi kunemashi yezingane ezifunda ezinkulisa zaKwaNgcolosi, izolo. Izingane bezinxusa umphakathi ukuthi uzivikele okuhambisana nomkhankaso wesonto lokuvikelwa kwezingane, iChild Protection Week. UConstable Mlotshwa uthe umzali akangayizibi ingane uma imtshela ukuthi kubuhlungu esithweni sangasese ngoba kungenzeka ukuthi inukubezwe ngokocansi. “Izingane azikwazi ukukhuluma zichaze konke futhi ziyakhohlwa. Kuyenzeka ikhohlwe uma ingamboni lowo muntu kodwa uma eqhamuka ikhumbule. Uma seyifike emaphoyiseni isho ukuthi yamtshela unina ukuthi kubuhlungu waziba, thina sibopha umzali,” kusho yena. UNksz Sinegugu Ngobese wophiko olukuMasipala weTheku, i-Environment Affairs, olubheka ukuthi izakhiwo nemvelo okuseduze nezinkulisa akuyibeki yini engcupheni impilo yezingane, uthe ukufundisa izingane enkulisa engaphephile kuwukuhlukumeza ilungelo lengane. “Inhloso yophiko ukubheka ukuthi amathoyilethi asesimeni futhi ayisibalo esanele abafundi, ikhishi lisesimeni, isikhotha nezihlahla eziseduze ngabe kunqunyiwe yini ngeke kwenzeke kuqhamuke izilwane ezingalimaza izingane. Konke lokhu kuyingxenye yemithetho elawula idolobha, asikwenzi ngoba sifuna ukuhlukumeza abanikazi bezinkulisa,” kusho yena. UNksz Busi Dladla, osekomitini likasoseshini wezinkulisa wakule ndawo, uthe abazali kumele baqaphele omalume abahambisa izingane ezinkulisa. “Ngaphandle kokubheka ukuthi imoto isesimeni futhi inamaphepha afanele, mzali yiba nesiqiniseko sokuthi umalume akadluli emathaveni nengane ngoba izingane zibuka akwenzayo bese zicabanga ukuthi kuhle,” kusho yena
UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMvelo uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane uthi ngeke aphawule ngezinsolo abekwa zona okwamanje Isithombe:Phill Magakoe UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMvelo uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane uthi ngeke aphawule ngezinsolo abekwa zona okwamanje Isithombe:Phill Magakoe IHHOVISI likaNgqongqoshe wezeMvelo uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane lithi lo ngqongqoshe akakazophawula okwamanje ngezinsolo abekwa zona kwikhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana eholwa yiJaji uRaymond Zondo. Izolo owayeyisikhulu saseBosasa, uMnuz Angelo Agrizzi, uveze ukuthi babegwazela uNkk Mokonyane ngoR50 000 njalo ngenyanga baphinde bamthengele inyama, utshwala obuphambili baphinde bamngcwabele nezihlobo. UMnuz Mlimandlela Ndamase, okhulumela uNkk Mokonyane, uthe ngeke aphawule ungqongqoshe ngezinsolo zeKhomishini kaZondo. Ukhuluma kanjena nje uNdamase izolo ntambama i-eNCA ibike ukuthi abameli bakhe babhalele iKhomishini kaZondo bekhala ngokungahlonishwa kwamalungelo akhe nokuputshuzwa kwemibiko engakaveli kwikhomishini emaphephandabeni angeSonto. U-Agrizzi uthe uNkk Mokonyane waze wacela ukuthi kuqashelwe indodakazi yakhe imoto izinyanga ezintathu ngesikhathi ibuya eChina. “UNkk Mokonyane wayenobudlelwano nesikhulu esiphezulu saseBosasa futhi wayenguMqondisi enamasheya kwiDyambu okwakuyigama leBosasa ngama-2000’s. Kusukela esenguNgqongqoshe wezokuPhepha eGauteng sasimkhokhela imali. Sasithenga nokudla okuzodliwa kuma-rally eSiyanqoba, sifonelwa nasebusuku ukuthi silekelele abalandeli be-ANC,” kusho u-Agrizzi. Uthe bacelwa ukuthi benze ucwaningo lwezokuphepha ezibhedlela zaseGauteng okwakuzodla uR2 million kodwa umbiko walolu cwaningo wanikezwa uMnuz Reggie Nkabinde onguMgcinimafa we-ANC Youth League ukuze athole ithenda. Uphinde waveza ukuthi ngesikhathi uNkk Mokonyane enguNgqongqoshe wezaManzi wacela iBosasa ukuthi yenze ucwaningo ngokuphepha kwamadamu olwadla uR1.3 million. “UNkk Mokonyane kwakufanele akhulume nowayenguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma ukuthi aqinisekise ukuthi asishushiswa ngamacala enkohlakalo. Sasihlala simnika imali njalo ngoba wayenamandla,” kusho u-Agrizzi. Uthe babegwazela noMnuz Vincent Smith owayenguSihlalo wekomidi lezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo ukuze azibe imibuzo yalabo abafuna ukwazi ngezinkontileka zeBosasa nohulumeni. Ngaleso sikhathi u-Agrizzi uthe iBosasa yayinenkontileka noMnyango wezoBulungiswa, ukuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekeko nezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo njengoba yayibhekelele ezokuphepha yenza namabhande alawula ukuhamba kweziboshwa. “Kwathathwa isinqumo ukuthi uSmith, uVincent Magagula noWinnie Ngwenya bazokhokhelwa njalo ngenyanga ukuze banyathele imibuzo ngezinkontileka zeBosasa eyayivela kwabezindaba. USmith wayekhokhelwa uR45 000, uVincent ethola uR30 000 bese uWinnie athole uR20 000,” kusho u-Agrizzi. UMnuz Zizi Kodwa uthe i-ANC iyaziqhelelanisa nemibiko yokuthi ababegwazelwa eBosasa babesebenzisa leyo mali ukuhlomulisa i-ANC esho nokuthi akuyona i-ANC eyayibathumile kodwa babezenzela lokho siqu sabo.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sihle Zikalala. Isithombe: Sigciniwe UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sihle Zikalala. Isithombe: Sigciniwe ULINGANISELWA kuR560 million umonakalo odalwe yizimvula ebezihambisana nomoya onamandla ezihlasele KwaZulu-Natal zashiya inqwaba yemizi, izikole nengqalasizinda kucekeleke phansi. Esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo, uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sihle Zikalala uthe bafisa ukubonga uhulumeni wesifundazwe ngendlela osukume ngayo emuva kwesimo esiphuthumayo esidalwe yisimo sezulu ebesingesihle esisanda kubakhona. “Sibonile ukuthi ngoNovemba, isifundazwe sethu sihlaselwe yizishingishane ezine kwashayeka umasipala waseMshwathi, kwathi ngoNovemba 14 kwashayeka uKhahlamba, sisababaza indaba yaseMshwathi nasoKhahlamba kwashayeka eMahlangeni, uLundi nakwaNongoma,” kusho uZikalala. Uthe bangu-31, abantu okubikwe ukuthi bashonile ngenxa yalezi zimvula kwathi abangu-135 balimala. “Imizi elinganiselwa ku-3 072 icekeleke phansi kwathi abantu abangu-15 540, bakhahlamezeka.” Uthe uR560 million wumonakalo wamanje abasawucwaningile, wengeza ngokuthi kusengenzeka imali inyuke njengoba besaqhubeka nokuhlola umokakalo. “Uhulumeni ngokubambisana nezinhlangano ezizimele basukumele phezulu besiza abantu abathikamezekile ngenxa yalezi zimvula, kumanje sesiqede ukuhlanganisa uhlu lwabantu okumele bathole usizo kanti iminyango ethintekayo ingenelela ngendlela,” kusho uZikalala. Uthe uMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal usuqoke osonkontileka abami ngomumo ukuthi basize ngezimpahla zokwakha nokuthi bavuse imizi ecekeleke phansi. “Umonakalo sisawuhlola kodwa akekho umuntu ongazi ukuthi umonakalo mkhulu njengoba kucekeleke phansi imizi, yizikole nengqalasizinda. Labo abalahlekelwe yizinto zabo ezibalulekile bayasizwa wuMnyango wezaseKhaya neSassa,” kusho uZikalala. Uthe bafuna ukubonga uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu ngokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi labo abakhahlamezekile bayaluthola usizo. UZikalala unxuse umphakathi ukuthi uzilalele izexwayiso ezenziwayo mayelana nesimo sezulu. “Isimo sezulu esibhekene naso esihlale siguquka senza ukuthi sihlale siqaphile, siphinde sifundise abantu bakithi ngokukwazi ukuphatha imvelo ngendlela eyiyo,” kusho uZikalala.
ONOGADA ababili kwabathathu abebegade eKusa High, eHammarsdale ngoLwesithathu ebusuku batholakale beshonile kwelinye lamakilasi alesi sikole izolo, owesithathu uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela. Isithombe: Zanele Zulu/ African News Agengy (ANA) ONOGADA ababili kwabathathu abebegade eKusa High, eHammarsdale ngoLwesithathu ebusuku batholakale beshonile kwelinye lamakilasi alesi sikole izolo, owesithathu uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela. Isithombe: Zanele Zulu/ African News Agengy (ANA) KUMISWE ukufunda esikoleni, Ukusa High, eHammarsdale izolo ngemuva kokubulawa konogada ababili okusolwa ukuthi bashaywe bafa begadile ebusuku bangoLwesithathu esikoleni. Isidumbu sikaMnuz Mncedisi Ntuli (29) okuthiwa bekuwusuku lwakhe lokuqala esebenza esikoleni nesikazakwabo uMnuz Thandazani (46) zitholakale kwelinye lamakilasi esikole izolo ekuseni, uzakwabo wesithathu obesaphila uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela elimele kanzima. Kusolwa ukuthi abahlaseli bebefuna ukhiye wegumbi elihlala ama-laptop nezinye izimpahla ezibalulekile zesikole, ongahlali konogada. Ngokuthola kwaleli phephandaba ngomthombo ongaphakathi esikoleni, unogada ongena ekuseni ufike kukhiyiwe esangweni, wama ngaphandle kwaze kwafika uthishanhloko. “Uthishanhloko uthe unogada makangene ngaphakathi ayobheka ukuthi akukho yini lapho belele khona. Unogada ujombe uthango wangena ngaphakathi wabuya esethi ozakwabo ubafice belele edamini legazi akazi noma kukhona yini kubo osaphila. Uthishanhloko umlandele wangena naye baphuma sebeyofuna abosizo oluphuthumayo,” kusho umthombo. Uyise kaMncedisi, uMnuz Thembinkosi Ntuli, uthe nguye obegqugquzela indodana yakhe ukuthi ingahlali ekhaya isalinde ukuthi kulungiswe okuthile emaphepheni ayo ayigunyaza ukuthi ibe ngunogada ogcwele. “Emasontweni amathathu edlule ungitshele ukuthi uqashwe yinkampani egada ezikoleni, ugada ePhezulu High, bengingazi ukuthi usegada la, eKusa High,” kusho uNtuli. UMfowabo kaThandazani, uMnuz Muntu Majola, uthe akazange asole lutho umfowabo engabuyi emsebenzini ekuseni izolo ngoba kuyenzeka aqale ezindaweni zakhe ngaphambi kokugoduka. “Kuneminyaka egada kulesi sikole akakaze ahlaselwa yize engaphathi lutho oluyisikhali sokuzivikela,” kusho uMajola. UMnuz Mondli Dlamini ongomunye wabanikazi benkampani yonogada iMI Trading ebiqashe labo nogada, uthe sibethuse kakhulu lesi sigameko sokubulawa kwabantu ebebezinikele ekuvikeleni impahla yomphakathi. “Lo msebenzi siwenza ngoba sinothando lomphakathi, akukho nzuzo esiyenzayo yingakho siqasha abantu abangenawo amaphepha ngoba abanamaphepha bazofuna ukukhokhelwa imali esingenayo. Onogada bethu basuke bengahlomile babekelwe ukuthi bafone uma bebona okusolisayo,” kusho uDlamini. Usihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole, uMnuz Aaron Cele, uthe badumele ngalesi sehlakalo, bebezitshela ukuthi ukuba khona komuntu ogadile esikoleni kuzokwenza izigilamkhuba zisabe ukungena. Unobhala weSadtu kulesi sifundazwe uMnuz Bheki Shandu uthe bahlale belugcizelela udaba lokuphepha ezikoleni emnyangweni, wathi ukubulawa kwalabo nogada kuveze ukuthi kumele ukugada kubhekwe ukuthi kwenziwa kanjani. UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu, obezifikele kulesi sikoleni uthe uphoxeke kakhulu. Uthe kukhomba ukuthi kumele kubuyiswe amakomiti emigwaqo ngoba onogada kabanele ukuthi bagade izikole. “Lokhu kusho ukuthi izingane ezifunda emalokishini nasemakhaya ngeke zithuthuke, ngoba uma kufakwe izinsiza zokuthuthukisa izikole izigebengu ziyangena. Uma kungathiwa onogada abahlome nakhona bazoba sengcupheni yokuhlaselwa kufunwa izibhamu,” kusho uMshengu. Izolo abafundi baphindiselwe emakhaya, uMshengu uthe kuzoze kufundwe ngoMsombuluko. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, uthe amaphoyisa athole onogada (29) noneminyaka ewu-46 beshonile ekilasini eceleni kwabo kwatholakala i-crowbar.
USASHAQEKILE umphakathi waKwaSwayimane ngaphandle kwaseMgungundlovu emuva kwesigameko lapho isoka kuthiwa lifike erenki langqokloza intombi yalo ngesibhamu liyisola ngokujola nomunye usomatekisi. Kuthiwa uNksz Khule Buthelezi (24), osebenza kwesinye isitolo sokudla kule renki, izolo udutshulwe yisoka lakhe anengane nalo, okuthiwa bahilizisane nalo kwathi uma ebaleka lamdubula esiphundu. Kuvele ukuthi isoka liyimenenja erenki yaKwaSwayimane eseWartburg. Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ozibonele ukuthi akekho obengasondela kumsolwa ngoba isibhamu ubesiphethe ngesandla elokhu ekhuluma. Kuthiwa ubelokhu eseduze kwesidumbu esinyakazisa ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi umbulele umufi. Ngaphambi kokuba adubule intombi kuthiwa uqale wajaha usomatekisi osekhulile amsola ngokujola nonina wengane. Kuthiwa usomatekisi ubalekile emva kwalokho umsolwa wabuyela kumufi wamdubula. Isolezwe lithole ngomunye umthombo ukuthi isimo bese simuncu erenki. Kuthiwa umsolwa ushiye umufi wathi usayobheka usomatekisi ukuze aqede ngaye bese eyozinikela emaphoyiseni. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko wathi amaphoyisa aKwaSwayimane avule icala lokubulala. “Umsolwa oneminyaka engu-29 uboshelwe icala lokubulala nokutholwa ephethe isibhamu esingekho emthethweni. Uzovela enkantolo yaseNew Hanover kusasa (namhlanje) ngecala lesibhamu aphinde avele ngoLwesine ngelokubulala enkantolo efanayo,” kusho uZwane. Isolezwe lithinte umndeni kamufi, owesifazane ongazidalulanga igama uthe abekho abadala abangakwazi ukukhuluma ngalolu daba. Isolezwe lithole nokuthi bese kunesikhathi umufi ethandana nesoka. Umsolwa kuthiwa ukhulele erenki ngoba waqala ewasha izimoto, waba wumsizi wabashayeli njengoba bese ebheke umsebenzi. Kuthiwa ubelokhu ememeza ethi usomatekisi ojola nentombi yakhe umthathele ngoba enemali enamatekisi.
AMADODAKAZI kaMadikizela-Mandela uZindzi noZenani Mandela. Isithombe: Elmond Jiyane/GCIS (File) AMADODAKAZI kaMadikizela-Mandela uZindzi noZenani Mandela. Isithombe: Elmond Jiyane/GCIS (File) AMADODAKAZI kalowo owayeyinkosikazi kaDkt Nelson Mandela, uWinnie Madikizela-Mandela, asaqhubeka nokulwela ubunikazi bomhlaba kaMandela oseQunu okunesithabathaba somuzi kuwo. Ngokwephephandaba eliphuma ngeSonto, iSunday Times, uZindzi noZenani Mandela, sebefake lolu daba eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ukuphikisa isinqumo senkantolo yokudluliswa kwamacala (Supreme Court of Appeal), esachitha uMdikizela-Mandela ngesikhathi efuna ubunikazi bale ndlu. Encwadini yamafa eyashiywa nguMandela, umuzi waseQunu washiywa ezandleni zeNelson Rolihlahla Mandela Family Trust, ukuze kuhlomule umndeni wakhe wonke ngayo. Umuzi njengamanje uphethwe ngunkosikazi kaMandela, uNkk Graca Machel. Umhlaba ofunwa ngamadodakazi kaMadikizela Mandela wanikezwa uMandela ngeminyaka yama-90, waba ngaphansi kwegama lakhe yedwa. UMadikizela Mandela udlule emhlabeni egqigqa izinkantolo ezama ukuguqula lesi sinqumo. UMadikizela-Mandela wayekholelwa ngukuthi ngokomthetho unelungelo lokuba ngumnikazi walo mhlaba okwakhiwe kuwo lo muzi. Waveza ukuthi lo mhlaba wawunikezwa ngo-1989 kodwa wanaka ngo-2014 ukuthi wawungaphansi kwegama lika-Mandela, nokuyilapho eqale ukuphakamela lolu daba. Inkantolo enkulu e-Eastern Cape ngokunjalo nenkantolo yokudliliselwa kwamacala bamchitha uMadikizela-Mandela. UZindzi noZenani bathi sekuyibo abazoqhuba lolu daba njengoba bekholelwa ukuthi unina kwakumele anikezwe amalungelo obunikazi bomhlaba naye. UMadikizela Mandela udlule emhlabeni nonyaka. Wahlukana noMandela ngo-1996.

ISAZI sezomnotho, ipolitiki nezomthetho kuleli uSolwazi uBonke Dumisa esaboshwa ngesikhathi kubhikisha abafundi belwa nokufundiswa ngolimi lwesiBhunu ngoJuni 16, ngonyaka ka-1976 ISAZI sezomnotho, ipolitiki nezomthetho kuleli uSolwazi uBonke Dumisa esaboshwa ngesikhathi kubhikisha abafundi belwa nokufundiswa ngolimi lwesiBhunu ngoJuni 16, ngonyaka ka-1976 KUSASA, iNingizimu Afrika izobe igubha usuku oluthinta abaningi kuleli, uSuku lweNtsha. Ngokomlando uJuni 16 waba wusuku olubalulekile ngo-1976 eSoweto lapho kwabhikisha khona izinkulungwane zabantu abasha begqoke imifaniswano yabo yezikole belwisana nokufundiswa nge-Afrikaans ezikoleni. Kwabhikisha abafundi ababalelwa ku-20 000. Ngokwezibalo ezivela kwaSA History kwabulawa abafundi ababalelwa ku-176 kulo mbhikisho. Omunye walabo bafundi kwaba nguHector Pieterson (13), isithombe sakhe esasabalala umhlaba wonke esezingalweni zikaMbuyisa Makhubu owayeneminyaka engu-18 ngaleso sikhathi. Lesi sithombe sathathwa uMnuz Sam Nzima, odlule emhlabeni nonyaka. Kubafundi ababoshwa ngaleso sikhathi kubalwa nesazi sezomnotho nezepolitiki kuleli, uSolwazi uBonke Dumisa. UDumisa waboshwa ngoJuni 28, 1976 waze waphuma ejele ngoJulayi 28 ngo-1977. Engxoweni neSolezwe ngokubaluleka kwalolu suku, uthe kuyamjabulisa ukubona ukuthi ukuzinikela kwabo kusathela izithelo. “Kuyangijabulisa ukubona sivuna izithelo ezinhle ngokuzinikela kwethu ngaleso sikhathi. Kwaba yisikhathi esinzima kimina ukuba sejele isikhathi esingaka kodwa ngangiqonda esasikulwela ukuthi kubalulekile.” Ngemuva kokuphuma ejele uDumisa akazithelanga ngabandayo kwezemfundo njengoba namhlanje eneziqu ezihlukene okubalwa kuzo nezeMasters of Laws (LLM). Ngendlela ecishe ifane no-1976, eminyakeni edlule izitshudeni zakuleli beziyigxoba ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi #FeesMustFall, befuna imfundo yamahhala ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni owayengumengameli kuleli uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngoDisemba nyakenye amemezele imfundo yamahhala kuleli, waveza nokuthi izovivinywa eminyakeni emihlanu kusukela nonyaka. Abaningi basithakasela lesi simemezelo, nokho uDumisa uthe asiguqulanga okuningi. “Ngokubona kwami kwenziwa isimemezelo ngento ebesivele ikhona futhi yangabe isalandelelwa. Izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme besezivele zizama ukwamukela izitshudeni ezivela emakhaya ahlwempu ngohlelo lweNSFAS, umehluko ukuthi sebamukela nzivela emakhaya aphila ngemali engaphansi kukaR600 000 ngonyaka. Kodwa into ebalulekile kakhulu wukuthi nalezo zitshudeni kumele zigqugquzelwe ukuthi ziphase kahle uGrade 12 ukuze bezothola amaphuzu anele ukwena izifundo ezinamathuba omsebenzi.” UDumisa uthe intsha kumele igqugquzelwe ukuthi ifundele ukungena emkhakheni wamakhono ashodayo kuleli ukuze ihlomule kahle. “Sesikhathele ukugqokisa izingane zethu amajazi amnyama bese ziyohlala emakhaya zingawutholi umsebenzi. Ukuze zihlomule kahle ngemfundo ephakeme kumele zingene emkhakheni enamakhono adingekayo emnothweni wakuleli.”
LIZODLULELA eNkantolo eNkulu icala lamadoda amabili asolwa ngokubulala umqaphi wowayenguNdunankulu KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, njengoba icala labo lihlehlele unyaka ozayo. UMnuz Dumisani Cebekhulu (26) noNtuthuko Mkhwanazi (24) bebevele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMpangeni kuleli ngecala lokudubula babulale uMnuz Xolani Nkosi owayegada uMchunu. Igama leNkantolo eNkulu bazolazi uma sebezotshelwa ngosuku lwabo lwasenkantolo. Isidumbu sikaNkosi satholakala simbobombobo yizinhlamvu kubo sisemotweni yomsebenzi eDumisani Makhaye Village eMpangeni ngoJulayi 2015. Imantshi itshele laba balisa ukuthi babuyele enkantolo ngoJanuwari 19 sebezozwa usuku lokuya enkantolo enkulu futhi kusekhona amaphepha abasalinde ukuthi alethwe enkantolo. Njengoba kusalindwe usuku lwabo lwasenkantolo enkulu, bona bazobe begqunywe esitokisini kuze kushaye usuku lwabo lokubuyela enkantolo. UNkosi wabulawa ngesikhathi uMchunu esahleli esihlalweni sokuba undunankulu ngaphambi kokuthi akhonjwe indlela ngoMeyi 2016. Njengamanje uMchunu usesebenza ekomkhulu le-ANC eLuthuli House eGoli njengoba esekomitini labagqugquzeli. UMchunu wakugxeka kakhulu ukubulawa kukaNkosi, wanxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi asebenze ngokuzikhandla abophe abasolwa. Ukubulawa kukaNkosi kwadala ukukhuluma okuningi kusolwa izinto ezahlukene nokwamkhathaza kakhulu uMchunu. Ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekhomishini kaMoerane wakuveza ukukhathazeka kwakhe ngokubulawa kukaNkosi. Waze wakhala ngokuthi akanelisekile ngophenyo ngoba kwakukhona izinkomba zomkhondo kodwa kungaboshwa muntu. Ekhala nangokuthi ukhona umuntu owatholwa neselula kamufi nokukhomba ukuthi unolwazi ngokufa kwakhe. Kuvele nokuthi laba balisa ngaphandle kwecala lokubulala uNkosi babhekene nawokubamba inkunzi behlomile nelokuduna imoto. Kuvele nokuthi umsolwa wesithathu usagcwele amathafa kodwa amaphoyisa ayamthungatha njengoba kwavela ukuthi babebathathu abantu ababekhona kubulawa uNkosi.

Lapha uthathwe esalinde usizo oluphuthumayo wagcina elaliswe esibhedlela BAKHALA ngesiteleka esinodlame abaqashi bemboni yocwazi njengoba bethi amalungu eNational Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa) ahlasela ozakwabo abangatelekile acekele phansi nempahla emafemini ahlukene. Siyalugxeka udlame lwamalungu eNumsa ngoba abanye abasebenzi bafuna ukondla imindeni yabo futhi akufanele bahlaselwe abatelekile,” kusho uPieterse. Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba uPieterse uthembise iNumsa nobuholi bayo ukuthi bazoziphenya izigameko zodlame baqinisekise ukuthi abathintekayo bayaboshwa.UNkk Phakamile Hlubi-Majola okhulumela iNumsa uthe bayakuchitha ukuthi amalungu eNumsa ahlasela abantu noma acekela phansi impahla emafemini kacwazi. “Abaqashi bavele basukele amalungu eNumsa bathi anodlame ekubeni kunezinyunyana ezimbili ezitelekile okuyiNumsa neMewusa futhi kukhona nabasebenzi abangewona amalungu ezinyunyana abatelekile. Amalungu ethu ayawuhlonipha umthetho futhi ngisho eqhinqa ngaphandle kwamafemu anokuthula. Kudala sizama ukuxoxisana nabaqashi bemboni kacwazi ukuze kutholakale isixazululo kodwa ababuyeli kuthina,” kusho uNkk Hlubi-Majola.
OKWESOKUNXELE uSandile Shange ongaliphosile ithawula ukuthi umngane wakhe uMhlengi Gwala usazovuka azithathe OKWESOKUNXELE uSandile Shange ongaliphosile ithawula ukuthi umngane wakhe uMhlengi Gwala usazovuka azithathe UKUBUYELA ekudlaleni i-triathlone ngo-2009 ngemuva kokuthi ngo-2005 aba sengozini yemoto eyamphula umlenze wesokunxele, kwenza uSandile Shange, ongumngani kaMhlengi Gwala, aqine idolo ukuthi nozakwabo usazobuyela kulo mdlalo. UGwala (26) waseNdwedwe kodwa osezinze eChesterville kusuke igidigidi emhlabeni wonke ngesonto eledlule kusabalala izindaba zokuhlaselwa kwakhe esahwa imilenze yizigcwelegcwele. Uhlaselwe entathakusa ezivocavoca ngebhayisikili lakhe NgoLwesihlanu uGwala evakashelwe nguNgqongqoshe weZemidlalo, uTokozile Xasa, eSt Augustine Hospital, odokotela bakhe bathi mancane kakhulu amathemba okuthi abuyele ekudlaleni. Nokho uShange unomlando omenza abone ngendlela ehlukile. “Nami kwakushiwo kanje kimi ngo-2005. Ngashayiswa yimoto ngasala ngiphuke izindawo ezimbili emlenzeni. Udokotela wayethi ngeke ngisakwazi ukubuyela ekudlaleni i-triathlone,” kusho uShange waseLamonti. “Wathi imilenze sekungeyokuhamba kuphela. Ngo-2007 kodwa ngabuyela ekudlaleni. Bengishaya imijaho emifishane. Ngo-2009 ngaqala ngashaya i-Ironman. Ngashaya emifushane kwathi ngasekupheleni konyaka ngashaya ephelele. Ngiqhubeke kanjalo-ke, ngishaya emifishane nemide. Ngabuya ngamushiya emangele udokotela ngizomkhombisa izindondo zami,” kusho uShange. Uthe umlenze olimele kakhulu ngowesokudla osahwe esihluzwini kanti owesokunxele usahwe ngaphambili embaleni. Elandisa ngempumelelo kaGwala, uShange uthe: “Isasa likaMhlengi liqale ngo-2013 enqoba i-long run kumaSA Champs eBattery Beach. Ngaqala lapho ukumbona ukuthi uzoba yisilomo. Okwamdalela isasasa kakhulu wukuthi i-long run ibijwayele ukunqotshwa abantu abavela kwezinye izifundazwe. Wafika yena wayijika le nto. “Siqale lapho ukuba abangani, yena wayethathwa yindlela engibhukuda ngayo njengomuntu omnyama nami ngichazwa yindlela agijima ngayo. Ngamtshela ukuthi ngenza i-triathlone. Wangiphendula ngokuthi uyalesaba ibhayisikili, akakaze acabange ukuthi angaze aziwe njengomdlali walo. “Ngamtshela ukuthi sizoncenga kancane sibone sifikaphi. Wavuma kanjalo engazi ukuthi uzogcina eseyisolomo. Wawina izigaba walokhu edlondlobala waze waya phesheya kwezilwandle," kuchaza uShange. UShange uthe ukulimala kukaGwala kuphazamise izingane abezisiza ezilolonga. “Ukulimala kwakhe kuphazamisa abantu abaningi ngoba ungumuntu owusizo. Kunezingane zaseMkhambathini ezika azihlalise kubo azijimise."

USEQEDE iminyaka eyisithupha engayazi indoda uNksz Amanda Ndiki obizwa ngeQueen of Celibacy, othi ukungayi ocansini yisinqumo somuntu esingancikile kuphela ekukholweni Isithombe: FACEBOOK USEQEDE iminyaka eyisithupha engayazi indoda uNksz Amanda Ndiki obizwa ngeQueen of Celibacy, othi ukungayi ocansini yisinqumo somuntu esingancikile kuphela ekukholweni Isithombe: FACEBOOK KUYISITAYELA kwabanye ukuzithathela isinqumo sokungayi ocansini, iningi labo okungabesifazane abathi abazihlanganisi nendoda. Yize lokhu kujwayeleke kwabakholwayo, ukungayi ocansini okubizwa nge-celibacy ngomunye umkhuba osujoyinwe ngisho abangasindisiwe. Umuntu ozibophezela kulo mkhuba ubizwa nge-celibate ngoba usuke ezinqumele ukuthi ngeke aye ocansini. UNksz Amanda Ndiki obizwa ngeQueen of Celibacy njengoba eseneminyaka eyisithupha engayi ocansini, uthe akaluhaleli nhlobo ucansi noma indoda. UNksz Ndiki (38) obuye abe ngumvangeli, uthe ukuba yi-celibate akuhlangene kuphela nenkolo kodwa yisinqumo somuntu. Encwadini yakhe ethi Stepping Into Your True Self, uyachaza ngalesi sinqumo sakhe. Uthe isikhathi esiningi umuntu usuke efuna ukuzithola ukuthi yini emjabulisayo, azinike isikhathi ngokuzazi kabanzi. Yize abanye bethi lo mkhuba ngowabesifazane, uthe bakhona nabesilisa abazinqumela ukuba ngama-celibate. “Kwesinye isikhathi senza izinto ngoba nakhu abanye bezenza njengakho ukuya ocansini. Ngokwabantu uma ujola kumele uye ocansini kanti akumele kube njalo. Uma uzikhethela ukungayi ocansini usuke ufuna ukukhombisa ukuthi awulawulwa yimizwa yakho. Abanye baya ocansini ngisho bengathandi kodwa ngoba kumele kwenzeke,” echaza. Uveze ukuthi ukuzithathela isinqumo sokungayi ocansini usuke ugwema ukugcina ulala nabantu abaningi ngoba kuyenzeka ubudlelwano buphele, udlulele phambili. Uthe ukulala nomuntu kwenza unamathele kuye ngokomoya, yingakho abanye bekhetha ukungayi nhlobo ocansini. Ezinye izizathu athe zenza abanye bathathe lesi sinqumo, ukuthi basuke befuna ukuphola uma kungahambanga kahle ebudlelwaneni bezothando. UNksz Ndiki ucacise ngokuthi kwehlukene ukuzithiba ocansini okubizwa nge-abstinence nesinqumo sokuba yi-celibate. “Ungakwazi ukuzithiba ocansini kodwa usebenzise ezinye izindlela zokujabulisa imizwa yakho. Uma uyi-celibate awuzijabulisi ngalutho kodwa ugwema konke okuhambisana nocansi. Uma uzithiba usuke uzibekele isikhathi esithize kodwa kwi-celibacy kuyenzeka uzibekele lesi sinqumo ingunaphakade,” kusho yena. UNksz Ndiki oke washada wabuye wahlukanisa, uyavuma ukuthi akulula kulesi sinqumo. Uthe uma usaqala ukusithatha kungcono ungajoli nhlobo ukuze ugweme izilingo. Yize abanye abangama-celibate bejola, yena uthe akajoli nhlobo futhi akanasizungu sendoda. Ukugwema izilingo uthe kubalulekile ukungabuki izinhlelo zethelevishini ezizovusa imizwa. Owesifazane ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe wathatha lesi sinqumo eminyakeni emine edlule emuva kokuphoxeka emshadweni. Uthe wayevele ezinqumele ukuthi uyolala nomuntu ayoshada naye kuphela . Kuthe uma behlukana naye wazinqumela ukuthi ngeke aphinde aye ocansini nenye indoda. UNksz Zola Dudeni oyiPscychologist uthe ezinye izizathu ezidala abantu bathathe lesi sinqumo kubalwa ukudlwengulwa, ukulinda umshado nokuhlukumezeka ebudlelwaneni. Uthe abanye basuke bengaluthandi ngokwemvelo ucansi, athe babizwa ngama-asexuals.
IMALI yomnikelo wabazalwane kumele ilondolozwe ngendlela futhi kube nobufakazi ngokusho kwenhlangano ebhekele amabandla esifundazweni saKwaZulu-Natal Isithombe: IMALI yomnikelo wabazalwane kumele ilondolozwe ngendlela futhi kube nobufakazi ngokusho kwenhlangano ebhekele amabandla esifundazweni saKwaZulu-Natal Isithombe: SEKUWUMKHUBA ojwayelekile ukuzwa ukuthi kunomzalwane noma umfundisi osolwa ngokudla umnikelo webandla elithile. Lokhu kugcina kuthela amabandla ngehlazo, ngoba imvamisa yalaba bantu abasolwa ngalokhu, basuke benezikhundla emabandleni abakhonza kuwo nokwenza kungabi lula ukuthi babone abazalwane uma sebexhaphazeka. Inhlangano ebhekele ukusebenza kwamabandla iKwaZulu-Natal Council of Churches nayo ike yakuveza phambilini ukuthi sekukaningi ithola ngalezi zigameko emabandleni ahlukene. UMengameli wale nhlangano uDkt Lucas Ngoetjana, uthi kunanoma yiliphi ibandla kumele kube nekomidi elinabantu ababhekela ukusebenza kwebandla kanjalo nomnikelo walo. UDkt Ngoetjana uthi lokhu kusiza ekutheni ibandla likwazi ukuhlala lihlangane licubungule amabhuku alo ukuthola imali eselinayo esikhwameni kanjalo nesisebenzile. “Kuyenzeka kula mabandla esimanje uthole umfundisi ebhekele zonke izinto ebandleni. Ngisho nomnikelo uthole uqoqwa nguyena kulezi zinkonzo esezigcwele manje. Kodwa ngokomthetho kusungulwa ikomidi ebandleni bese nemali ihlukaniswa ngokwezidingo zayo. “Kuyaye kubhalwe phansi nemali esele emva kokuba ibandla selikhokhele indawo elikhonzela kuyo lenza nezidingo zalo,” kusho uDkt Ngoetjana. Uqhube wathi abazalwane banelungelo lokwaziswa ngomnikelo wabo ukuthi usebenze kanjani. Uthe lokho akusho ukuthi banokholo oluncane kodwa kuyasiza ukugcina nomlando webandla umuhle. Ukuhlala isikhathi eside umuntu engalandelwa ngemali yomnikelo, nakho kungamenza angene esilingweni sokuyisebenzisela izinhloso zakhe. Okunye Okumele ibandla likwenze ukuvikela umnikelo: -Uma kuyibandla elikhulu igatsha ngalinye alibe nomgcinimafa walo. Emabandleni amakhulu akumele kubekwe umuntu oyedwa ozogcina imali yebandla. -Ayibalwe imali yomnikelo bese kubhalwa phansi ngaphambi kokuthi ihlanganiswe nendala. -Uma ifakwa ebhange akube khona ubufakazi obuphathekayo nobuzogcinwa mayelana nokusebenza kwayo. -Kulaba abathengela abazalwane ukudla akube nobufakazi benani legilosa ethengwayo ukuze kwaziwe ukuthi imali yenzeni. -Ikota nekota yonyaka kufanele kube nomhlangano wokuchaza kabanzi ngemali esisebenzile nesalondoloziwe ebhange. -Imali ekhokhela indlu kwabarentayo, ugesi, amanzi, unogada nezinye izidingo eziqondene nebandla, nayo kumele ibe nobufakazi neziliphu eziwubufakazi bokuthi kuyakhokhelwa ngempela.
UMHOLI weDA uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango othi iqembu lakhe lizibophezele ngokunxenxa ivoti lentsha njengoba kuyiwa okhethweni ngonyaka ozayo UMHOLI weDA uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango othi iqembu lakhe lizibophezele ngokunxenxa ivoti lentsha njengoba kuyiwa okhethweni ngonyaka ozayo UMHOLI weDA KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango uthi iqembu labo lizimisele ngokuheha intsha njengoba lisemkhankasweni wokwehlisa amandla kaKhongolose abe ngaphansi kuka-50%, okhethweni lukazwelonke ngonyaka ozayo. Esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo, uMncwango uthe sebejube uNksz Mbali Ntuli ukuthi kube nguyena iNhloko yezemikhankaso eqenjini ngenhloso yokufeza iphupho labo lokudonsa ivoti labantu abasha. “Iqiniso lithi iningi lentsha lintula amathuba emisebenzi futhi abantu abasha abavoti ngokuthi obani ababesemzabalazweni, bavota ngokuthi ubathembisani,” kusho uMncwango. Uthe bayathemba ukuthi uNksz Ntuli uzowenza ngempumelelo umsebeni wakhe. “UNksz Ntuli ungumholi owaziwayo oseke waba yikhansela waphinde wahola intsha yeqembu, ukubeka yena kulesi sikhundla sokuhola imikhankaso kuzoyisiza kakhulu inhlangano,” kusho uMncwango. UNksz Ntuli obeyilungu lesiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal wesulile khona njengoba esenikwe lo msebenzi omusha. Kumanje iqembu limatasa nohlelo lokuvala isikhala sakhe. UMncwango uthe basazobona ukuthi isikhala sikaNksz Ntuli basivala ngobani. UMncwango akazange afune ukuphumela obala ukuthi uzoya yini esiShayamthetho njengoba kulindelekile kulandela ukuthi uphinde wakhethwe kabusha njengomholi wenhlangano esifundazweni. “Uma unguSihlalo weqembu esifundazweni, lokho kukwenza ukuthi kube nguwena ophambili ohlwini lwamagama, kulele kumina ukuthi nginqume ukuthi ngiyaya yini esiShayamthetho noma ngiqhubeka nokuhlala eThekwini kodwa isinqumo engizosithatha sizobe sincike ekutheni ikuphi okuzosiza inhlangano,” kusho uMncwango. Uthe ngemuva kwengqungquthela ka-2015, unqume ukuthi angayi esiShayamthetho ngoba kade efuna ukulungisa isimo saseThekwini aphinde akhulise neqembu khona. “Ngicabanga ukuthi ngikwazile ukukhulisa iqembu eThekwini ngaphinde ngakwazi ukudala uzinzo enhlanganweni eThekwini nakwisifundazwe, uma kwenzeka ngihamba eThekwini anginalo uvalo ngabaholi engingabashiya khona,” kusho uMncwango. Uthe njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni ngonyaka ozayo bazophinde bagxile nakubafundi basemanyuvesi ngenhloso yokunxenxa amavoti abo. “Sifuna ukunxenxa amavolontiya amaningi avela emphakathini ehlukene, emakhaya nasemadolobheni,” kusho uMncwango. Uthe sebesungule umkhankaso weVukuzakhe ngenhloso yokusiza intsha entula imisebenzi. “Siphezu komkhankaso iSakh’ingomso ozogxila ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme ozobe ubhekelele ngqo ukusiza abafundi ezinkingeni zabo ozoba uholwa inhlangano yethu yabafundi iDemocratic Alliance Student Organisation (Daso),” kusho uMncwango. UNksz Ntuli uthe uzizwa ethobekile ngokuthenjwa iqembu ukuthi limnike umsebenzi obaluleke kangaka wokuhola imikhankaso yeqembu. “Ngizimisele ngokuthi lo msebenzi ngiwenze ngempumelelo ukuze ngingabaphoxi abaholi bami,” kusho uNksz Ntuli.
IPHINI likaMengameli we-NFP, uNkk Sindi Maphumulo-Mashinini IPHINI likaMengameli we-NFP, uNkk Sindi Maphumulo-Mashinini IPHINI likaMengameli we-NFP, uNkk Sindi Maphumulo-Mashinini, seliphakamise ukuba ibhekisiswe indaba yokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane basemakhaya ngoba besolwa ngokuthakatha. “Sekufike isikhathi sokuba iNingizimu Afrika isukume manje ivikele abesifazane basemakhaya abahlale besolwa ngokuthakatha ngoba bahlukumezeka ngokomphefumulo nangokwenyama. Uthe lolu hlobo lwezifo lwenza umuntu omdala azibone esezulazula emzini womuntu engazazi ukuthi uyaphi noma akhohlwe nawukuthi ikhaya lingakuphi ngenxa yazo. “Akukwazi ukuthi singaphila ezweni lapho kusanezinkolelo ezicindezela abesifazane baze babulawe ngesihluku. Empeleni ngisho emalokishini akuvamile ukuzwa kunukwa owesilisa ngokuthakatha kodwa kuhlale kunukwa abesifazane. Abanye ibenza le nto yokusolwa bagcine sebezikhipha inyumbazane bengasahlangani nabantu nokugcina sekuphenduka ubufakazi kulabo abamsolayo bokuthi uyathakatha kanti akunjalo yingoba usuke umntanomuntu esehlukumezeke kakhulu emoyeni. Okubi kakhulu nokudabukisayo abesifazane abahluphekayo yibo abathwele lo mthwalo wokuhlukunyezwa ngokusolwa ngokuthi bayathakatha,” kuqhuba uMaphumulo-Mashinini. Uthe okubuhlungu wukuthi akekho owake waba nobufakazi obubambekayo bokuthi umuntu uthakatha ngempela.

Isithombe: ZANELE ZULU/ANA UNKSZ Bonisiwe Dlamini osehlale iminyaka emithathu nomndeni wakhe ehlathini eliseWestville, eThekwini. Isithombe: ZANELE ZULU/ANA WAFIKA eThekwini ezonakekela indodakazi eyashayiswa yimoto owesifazane osehlala nomndeni wakhe ehlathini eWestville, eThekwini. Sekuphele iminyaka emithathu uNksz Bonisiwe Dlamini ehlala ehlathini nezingane eziyisihlanu. Kulezi zingane kukhona indodana uThulebona Dlamini (17) indodana kamfowabo u-Andile Zulu (26), ekamzala wakhe uMbulelo Mdledle, indodakazi uDineo (10) nomzukulu uPrincess (5). Amadodana kaNksz Dlamini okunguSphiwe Dlamini (30) noZamani Dlamini (23) abhadla ejele ngamacala ahlukene, nawo abehlala kuleli hlathi. Umzukulu okuthiwa walaxazwa ngunina, uzalwa ngenye yamadodana asejele. Indlela eya kulo mjondolo osehlathini idlula ezihlahleni eziminyene. Weqa ibhuloho elakhiwe ngezigxobo njengoba kunomfula ngaphansi. Elandisa Isolezwe uNksz Dlamini, uthe wasuka eXobho indodakazi yakhe uSne ishayiswe yimoto. USne owashona ngo-2016 eneminyaka engu-25, kuthiwa wayehlala emjondolo eSydenham eThekwini. “Ngafica isimo sakhe sisibi esibhedlela, onesi bathi akumele ngibe kude naye. Ngaquba isikhashana komunye umjondolo eSydenham ngabuye ngaxoshwa. Kuthe ngizihambela ngabona leli hlathi, ngazobeka umjondolo sahlala sonke nezingane. Bengiya zonke izinsuku esibhedlela futhi yayingekho enye indlela ngaphande kokufuna umjondolo ukusondelela.” Uthe indodakazi yakhe yagcina ishonile njengoba ibigula ehlala nayo kuleli hlathi. Kwahlanganisa ikhansela ukuze ingcwabeke. AKAFUNI ukubalisa ngosizi lwakhe uNksz Bonisiwe Dlamini ohlala ehlathini nomndeni wakhe, othathwe nendodana kamfowabo ahlala nayo u-Andile Zulu Kwehla izinyembezi uma exoxa ngokushona kwendodakazi yakhe, athe kwamhlukumeza kakhulu. Okwamhlukumeza wukuthi bekungasekho nokuphindela ekhaya njengoba athola ukuthi umuzi wakhe washa. Uveze nokuthi bekuvele kungabhekwana emndenini, namanje akukho sihlobo axhumana naso. UNksz Dlamini ongathandi ukugqamisa usizi lwakhe, uziphilisa ngokudayisa amakhalibhothi awaqoqa emgwaqweni. Uphinde abe netafula lokudayisa izithelo eduze kwegaraji ngaseWestwood Mall. Yindodakazi yakhe kuphela ehola isibonelelo sikahulumeni njengoba umzukulu ethe usaholelwa ngunina yize amlaxaza. “Uma ngiyodayisa ngihamba nazo izingane zamantombazane ngoba akuphephile ehlathini. Izingubo nokudla siphiwa ngabantu, nakho kubuye kwebiwe yizigebengu.” UMJONDOLO osehlathini eWestville okuhlala kuwo uNksz Bonisiwe Dlamini nomndeni onezingane eziyisihlanu. Isithombe: Isolezwe lifike izingane zibase phansi zipheka ngamathini amnyama. Lo mndeni ugeza emfuleni oseduze, ubuye ucele amanzi egaraji. UMfundisi Bheki Nxumalo ofundisa eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uthe uqale ngePhasika ukubona uNksz Dlamini obehlala eqhamuka ehlathini nezingane. “Ngathatha inombolo yakhe yocingo ngayobona nalapho ehlala khona. Angikholwanga ukuthi kunabantu abaphila le mpilo,” kusho uNxumalo. UMnuz Warren Burne oyikhansela kule ndawo okuthiwe uyazi ngodaba, akatholakalanga ocingweni, wathunyelelwa iSMS engaphendulwanga.
UJEREMY Acton nabanye babalandeli beDagga Party ngesikhathi bejabulela isinqumo senkantolo yoMthethosisekelo eyanquma ukuthi kungabi yicala ukusebenzisa insangu, inqobo nje uma uyisebenzisela ekhaya Isithombe: JHBLive UJEREMY Acton nabanye babalandeli beDagga Party ngesikhathi bejabulela isinqumo senkantolo yoMthethosisekelo eyanquma ukuthi kungabi yicala ukusebenzisa insangu, inqobo nje uma uyisebenzisela ekhaya Isithombe: JHBLive INHLANGANO ezibiza ngeDagga Party of South Africa, ithi uma ingakwazi ukuthola uR200 000 ofunwa yinhlangano eyengamele ukhetho kuleli ukuze iqembu lezepolitiki likwazi ukungenela ukhetho, kuyobe kuphenduleke imithandazo yabo bonke abantu bakuleli abafisa ukusebenzisa insangu ngokukhululeka. Le nhlangano ithi isikwenze konke okudingekayo njengokubhalisa isiqubulo seqembu nelogo, kodwa njengamanje isasenkingeni yokuhlanganisa imali yokubhalisa. “Ngicela ukuthi ngosuku lokuvota, nizilungiselele ukubungaza isihlahla sensangu,” kusho umholi waleli qembu, uMnuz Jeremy Acton njengoba iqembu lakhe ethi lifuna ukuba yingxenye yabathatha izinqumo ePhalamende ukuthi insangu isetshenziswe kahle ngokukhululeka eNingizimu Afrika. Leli qembu eliphinde laziwe ngokuthi Iqela Lentsango, lithi yize kukhona imithetho esishayiwe ehambisana nensangu, kodwa kuningi okusadinga ukusetshenzwa okumayelana nayo insangu nokuvumeleka kwayo kuleli. Ngonyaka odlule iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yanquma ukuthi kube semthethweni ukusetshenziswa kwensangu, kuphela uma isetshenziswa emakhaya noma itshalwe khona. Njengamanje kuseyicala ukutholakala uyibhema emphakathini, okuyinto abasebenzisi bayo abangayizwa kahle. Leli qembu lithi like lazama ukungenela ukhetho ngo-2014, kodwa imali ekhokhwayo ukuze iqembu libe sohlwini lwamaqembu azovotelwa, yaba ngumqansa. Inkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yanikeza uhulumeni iminyaka emibili ukuthi alungise kahle imithetho okuzohanjwa phezu kwayo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwensangu kuleli. Umholi waleli qembu nozakwabo uMnuz Gareth Prince yibona abaqala ukusukumela udaba lokusetshenziswa kwensangu ngokukhululeka njengoba baya enkantolo enkulu yaseWestern Cape bephonsela inselelo imithetho evimba lokhu. Babefuna nokuthi kube semthethweni ukuthi insangu isetshenziswe njengomuthi owelapha ezinye izifo futhi abantu bakwazi ukuhweba nangayo baziphilise. Ekhasini lakhe likaFacebook, * -Acton unxenxe bonke abantu bakuleli abahambisana nokusetshenziswa kwensangu ukuthi basize leli qembu likwazi ukumeleleka ePhalamende ukuze libe yizwi labantu abahambisana nokusetshenziswa kwensangu kuleli. Usesungule ne #SmokeThemOut #HotboxTheHouse #DaggaParty, ezinkundleni zokuxhumana athi uhlose ngayo ukunxenxa abantu ukuthi balule isandla futhi basebenzise ilungelo labo ukuphumelelisa ukusetshenziswa kwensangu. Kulindeleke ukuthi inhlangano ebhekelele ukhetho kuleli i-IEC, imemezele ukuthi ukubhaliswa kwamaqembu azoba sohlwini lwamaqembu azoba kwi-ballot paper kuzovalwa nini. U-Acton uthi leli qembu selibhalisile ezingeni likazwelonke kodwa kusamele likwazi nokubhalisela ukuthi libe khona nasohlwini olusezingeni lezifundazwe. UMengameli wakuleli uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa kusalindeleke ukuthi amemezele usuku okuzovotwa ngalo kuleli lizwe. UNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Tito Mboweni umemezele ukuthi kunohlelo lokuzama ukwehlisa isabelo ngokuthi bagqugquzele abantu abadala ukuthi basheshe bathathe umhlalaphansi, ikakhulu abaneminyaka engu-55 kuya ku-59. I-SA Gov News ifake i-video kwiTwitter kaNksz Dlodlo, lapho ebechaza kafuphi ngohlelo lokwehlisa isabelo. Uthe imali kumele iye kwezemfundo nakwezempilo njengoba isabelo sezimali sabasebenzi bakahulumeni singesibili ezintweni uhulumeni achitha imali enkulu kuzona. Ngemuva kwesimemezelo sikaMboweni abantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bakhuluma ngaso, ikakhulu abasebenza kuhulumeni. Omunye wabo othe wake walubona lolu hlelo oluzokwenziwa, uthe iSars ngeke iyibambe imali yentela ejwayele ukubanjwa uma umuntu esethatha umhlalaphansi. Uthe lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi asebezothatha umhlalaphansi basheshe bazishiyele. Okunye ngukuthi uma kuhamba umuntu omdala kuzoqashwa umuntu omncane esikhaleni sakhe. Umuntu uthatha umhlalaphansi uma eseneminyaka engu-60 kodwa uvunyelwe ukushesha ayithathe uma eneminyaka engu-55. Uthisha oseneminyaka engu-53, obelinde ngabomvu umhlalaphansi, uthe ubehlaliswe ukuthi iSars itapa imali enkulu uma usheshe wathatha umhlalaphansi. “Kuzosisiza kakhulu ukungathathi imali yethu ngoba kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi ngishiye ngingalokhu ngilula isikhathi ekubeni amandla okusebenza engasekho.”

Lawa magatsha awazange ahlangabezane nemibandela ebekiwe yokuthi akwazi ukuthamela ingqungquthela. Kanjalo nobuholi bezifunda ezintathu okuke kwaba nezehlakalo zokubulawa kwabaholi okuyiHarry Gwala, Moses Mabhida neLower South Coast buhlakaziwe, buzoya kule ngqungquthela kodwa abuvoti. Lokhu kuvezwe nguMxhumanisi wethimba lesikhashana elihola le nhlangano esifundazweni, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, ekhuluma nabezindaba ngamalungiselelo ale ngqungquthela. UZikalala uthe bagculisekile ngoba amagatsha amaningi ahlalile bahlangabezana nokuthi * -70% wamagatsha ukuthi kumele ahlale ukuze kube nengqungquthela. “Angaphezulu kuka-800 amagatsha okuhlolwe ukuthi akulungele yini ukuya engqungqutheleni. Angu-686 aphasile okuyiwona azoya engqungqutheleni. Mabili amalungu igatsha ngalodwa azoya engqungqutheleni.” Uthe ingqungquthela eyamagatsha, wathi sebeyilungele ingqungquthela. Uthe bahlalise izingqungquthela zezifunda eziyisithupha ngempumelelo wathi bese kusele lezi ezintathu ezihlakaziwe. “Wonke amagatsha anikwe ithuba lokuthi alethe izikhalazo zawo. Ubuholi bukazwelonke bebuseMoses Mabhida ibona obuzonquma ukuthi imaphi amagatsha azoya engqungqutheleni.” UNksz Nocawe Mafu, isithunywa sesigungu esiphezulu sale nhlangano kulesi sifundazwe, uthe uyajabula ukuthi iyahlala ingqungquthela, wathi uthemba ukuthi izoba yimpumelelo. Ebuzwa ngezinsolo zalabo okuthiwa kabaneme abazomashela ubuholi obusha ngelizayo, uthe akukho abasakutholile. “Akukho esisakutholile mayelana nabantu abathi bazomasha noma abazoya enkantolo ngoba bengeneme. Uma kwenzeka i-ANC iyobhekana nakho ngendlela efanele,” kusho uNksz Mafu. UZikalala uphawule nangokubulawa kwabaholi wathi ngenye yezinselelo ababhekene nayo. “Lezi zehlakalo zenza kube nokungathembani kumalungu. Sisebenzisana nabezomthetho ukuze kunqandwe lesi sihlava kuboshwe abenzi bobubi. Sikholelwa ngukuthi ezobulungiswa zingazinqanda lezi zehlakalo.” Ubuholi besifundzwe bahlakazwa ngemuva kokuba kukhona uhlangothi olwavunwa yinkantolo yaseMgungundlovu ngokuthatha njengento engekho imiphumela yengqungquthela eyakhetha uZikalala njengoSihlalo ngo-2015 eMgungundlovu noMnuz Super Zuma njengoNobhala. Kule ngqungquthela kulindeleke ukuthi uZikalala abuyele njengokugiya kulesi sikhundla, ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kukhulunywa ekaMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, owayekhulumela ubuholi obahlakazwa ophinde abe yiphini likaSotwebhu le-ANC esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe njengoNobhala wesifundazwe.

BATHWALE kanzima abashayeli bezimoto ezincane ezithutha abantu iTaxify ne-Uber ngesikhathi bevinjezelwe osomatekisi enkundleni yezemidlalo eChesterville, eThekwini, ngoLwesihlanu. Laba bashayeli abebengaphezu kuka-20 kuthiwa bavaleleke kule nkundla usuku lonke, osomatekisi bososeshini bezindawo ezakhele iTheku “bebathumbe” nezimoto zabo, befuna uR5 000 imoto ngayinye ukuze idedelwe. Ngokusho komunye wabashayeli beTaxify, yena nozakwabo bavinjezelwe yizimoto ezincane ezintathu ngesikhathi bepake ngaphandle kwaseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, eHoward College ekuseni. “Kufike osomatekisi abathathu kithina basiphoqa ukuthi sibalandele siye emhlanganweni ophuthumayo. Sifike enkundleni yezemidlalo eChesterville sekukhona ezinye izimoto ezingaphakathi zeTaxify neze-Uber,” kusho lo mshayeli. Uthe lezi zimoto bezihamba zivinjwa ezindaweni ezahlukene, zibizelwa kulo mhlangano mbumbulu. “Ubungekho umhlangano, bebezositshela ukuthi abafuni ukuphinde basibone sisebenza ngoba asinazo izimvume zokuthutha abantu. Bathe imoto ngayinye izodedelwa ngoR5 000. Bagcine sebethi asikhokhe uR500 ngokubona kuqhubeka isikhathi,” kusho lo mshayeli. Omunye umshayeli uthe basizwe ukufika kwamaphoyisa abehlome eyizingovolo, aphoqe labo somatekisi ukuthi babadedele. “Sesihamba sijeqeza ngoba bathe i-hoot yemoto soyishaya ngesiphongo. Izindawo ezisemalokishini sesiyasaba ukuzihambela ngoba asazi siphephe kangakanani,” kusho omunye umshayeli. Uthe abazi lo msindo ususwe yini ngoba bebazi ukuthi iseGoli kuphela lapho abangabafuni khona. NgoMashi nonyaka ePitoli kubulewe ngesihluku isitshudeni saseNanda, uSiyabonga Ngcobo, esasingumshayeli weTaxify. Usihlalo kasoseshini waseChesterville uMnuz Mbongeni Mkhize uthe bangu-12 ososeshini abangaphansi kweTheku abangeneme ngokusebenza kwezimoto zeTaxify ne-Uber. “Sekuphele amasonto amathathu sizama ukuhlangana nezikhulu ze-Uber neTaxify kodwa sihluleka. Sibone kungcono ukuthi sivimbe izimoto zabo ukuze basondele kithina. Abakwazi ukungena emsebenzini wethu sithule nje,” kusho uMkhize. Uthe kuzosiza ukuthi le nkinga isheshe ixazululeke ingaze iphume esandleni. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Thulani Zwane, uthe amaphoyisa aseCato Manor abizelwe kule ndawo ukuyoxazulula isimo, alikho icala elivuliwe.
ABANALO ulwazi ngezinkinga ezidala bangakhulelwa abesifazane abasesigabeni sokuthola izingane, okuthiwa kumele bazihluphe ngolwazi ABANALO ulwazi ngezinkinga ezidala bangakhulelwa abesifazane abasesigabeni sokuthola izingane, okuthiwa kumele bazihluphe ngolwazi ININGI labantu besifazane abasesigabeni sokuthola abantwana abanezinkinga zokukhulelwa, abanalo ulwazi lokuthi banenkinga. Umbhali we-website yezempilo i-healthline echaza ngezifo eziholela ekutheni kube nzima ukuthola izingane, uNkk Stephanie Watson, kule website uthe u-26% wabantu besifazane abasesigabeni sokuthola izingane, unesifo esidalwa ukungasebenzi kwama-hormone esihlasela umgudu wenzalo iPolycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS). Abesifazane abanalesi sifo uthe bajwayele ukuya ezinsukwini zabo isikhathi eside noma babe nezimpawu zokuthi bane-hormone yabesilisa eningi i-androgen. Abanalesi sifo baba nenkinga yokuba noketshezi ezikhwameni ezigcina amaqanda okuholela ekuthini ngesinye isikhathi amaqanda abo angaphumi uma sekuyisikhathi sokuthi aphume. UNkk Watson uthi akwaziwa ukuthi iPCOS idalwa yini kodwa abesifazane abanayo bajwayele ukuba nezimpawu zokopha kakhulu uma besezinsukwini zabo noma beqiwe yizinyanga bangayi esikhathini. Kwesinye isikhathi bamila uboya emzimbeni kakhulukazi emalungeni omzimba afana nasebusweni okuvamise ukuthi kube yihwanqa, intshebe, uboya obusesifubeni nakwezinye izingxenye zomzimba. UNkk Dalene Barton Schuster encwadini yakhe ekhuthaza ukuthi kusetshenziswe amakhambi emvelo uma kwelashwa lesi sifo iNatural Fertility Info uthe lesi sifo kuyenzeka sibe wufuzo uma kukhona oke waba naso emndenini. Ngokolwazi alubhale kule ncwadi uthe kuyenzeka sidalwe ukudla okungafanele, ingcindezi nokuba nokhwantalala kwesinye isikhathi ukusetshenziswa kwemithi yokulawula ama-hormones isikhathi eside. Okunye athe kuba nomthelela ekutheni abesifazane bangakhulelwa wukuvaleka kwamashubhu aziwa ngama-fellopian tubes. Izinkinga zokungabatholi abantwana uthe ziyenzeka nakwabesilisa. Kubona uthe ukuhlolwa kokuqala kuvamise ukuthi kuveze ukuthi inkinga idalwa yini kanti abesifazane kudingeka bahlolwe izikhawu eziningi ngaphambi kokuthi kutholakale ukuthi yini inkinga.
UCAROL Mkhize noDkt Langa Mngoma abebeyizikhulumi emcimbini wabesifazane ohlelwa yiVarsity College minyaka yonke UCAROL Mkhize noDkt Langa Mngoma abebeyizikhulumi emcimbini wabesifazane ohlelwa yiVarsity College minyaka yonke BAPHUME becijeke kuyo yonke imikhakha abesifazane ohlelweni lwaminyaka yonke olwenziwa yi-Independent Institute of Education (IIE) Varsity College, oluhlose ukubathuthukisa kwezomnotho nangokomqondo. Babheme bakholwa abebehambele umcimbi, iLadies to Legends, olwenziwe yilesi sikhungo eThekwini ngaleli sonto. Lo mcimbi waminyaka yonke uhambisana nenkolelo yokuthi kuhlomula sonke isizwe uma kuqeqeshwa kahle ingane yentombazane. Bekuxoxwa ngezinto eziningi zokuthuthukisa abesifazane, ikakhulukazi kwezemfundo. Izikhulumi bekunguCarol Mkhize ongunobuhle nomlingisi. Bekukhona noDkt Langa Mngoma naye obuye amodele noNksz Rowena Singh onguthisha noyimenenja yeLadies to Legends e-IIE’s Varsity College. UDkt Mngoma ongudadewabo kaNandi Madida ongumculi nomlingisi, uyaziwa kwezokumodela ikakhulukazi ekukhangiseni ngezimonyo. Nonyaka uqokwe nabanye abesifazane ababili base-Afrika ekubeni amanxusa okukhangisa ngezinwele zemvelo. Ukhethwe noLee Litumbe waseCameroon noLaurie Frempong waseGhana kulo mkhankaso owenziwe yinkampani yezinwele iMizani. Phakathi kwezihloko obekukhulunywa ngazo kubalwa ezempilo nokuziphatha kwabesifazane besimanje. UCarol ophinde aqeqeshe abazivocavocayo, ukhulume ngengcindezi azithola ehlangabezana nayo ezama ukuzenza umuntu angayena ngesikhathi efika kwezokulingisa. Ufundise abesifazane ngokuthi ukuzivocavoca kungabasiza kanjani ukuze bakwazi ukuphila nasemqondweni. UDkt Mngoma ugcizelele ukuzinakekela umzimba nangendlela yokudla efanele. “Kumele sizifundise umkhuba wokudla ngendlela efanele nenempilo uma sifuna ukuphila kahle. Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi siqale ngokufundisa intsha ngalo mkhuba,” kusho yena. UNkk Singh ugcizelele ukubaluleka kokufundisa izingane zamantombazane, athe owesifazane uyakwazi ukuzikhandla aphumelele uma efundile. Kucelwe nabanye abesifazane abebethamele lo mcimbi ukuthi baxoxe izindaba zabo ezingasiza abanye ukuze basekane. Kugcizelelwe ukuthi akukho abesifazane abangeke baphumelele ukukwenza uma bebambisene. OyiManaging Director ye-IIE Varsity Collge uNkk Louise Wiseman uthe kubalulekile ukuzithuthukisa kwabesifazane yingakho bebiza abemikhakha ehlukene ukukhuthaza nabanye. Uthe ngunyaka wesine kwaqala ukwenziwa lolu hlelo ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa abesifazane abasebasha. Uthe bathokoze kakhulu ngezihloko obekukhulunywa ngazo ezithinta abesifazane umhlaba wonke. Kulo nyaka uthe umkhakha wezamabhizinisi kulesi sikhungo uzokhipha nomfundaze kwabayisishiyagalombili abafuna ukufunda khona.
UMHOLI we-DA uMnuz Mmusi Maimane oseyingxenye yabantu abafuna uhulumeni wehlise izinga lokubiza kukaphethroli kuleli. Isithombe: REUTERS UMHOLI we-DA uMnuz Mmusi Maimane oseyingxenye yabantu abafuna uhulumeni wehlise izinga lokubiza kukaphethroli kuleli. Isithombe: REUTERS IYAQONGA ingcindezi yokuthi uhulumeni ehlise uphethroli njengoba amaqembu epolitiki nezinhlaka zomphakathi nezokuthutha okubalwa kuzo Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP), Democratic Alliance (DA), Organisation Undoing TAX Abuse (OUTA), nePeople Against Petrol and Paraffin Increase (Pappi) ziwufuna wehlile. Esithangamini nabezindaba ebesiseTshwane, umholi weDA, uMnuz Mmusi Maimane, uthe uhulumeni we-ANC ulwa nabantu abampofu eNingizimu Afrika ngoba unyuse intela yezimpahla ebizwa nge-Value Added Tax (VAT) yasuka ku-14% yaya ku-15%, wanyusa intela ekhokhwa kuphethroli, wafaka intela kashukela kanti nophethroli unyuka njalo njengoba kusukela ngo-Ephreli kuze kube manje ubulokhu unyuka. “Ngesikhathi uRamaphosa eba wuMengameli ilitha likaphethroli lalibiza uR14.12 kodwa manje selibiza uR16, okusho ukuthi abantu sebekhokha uR100 owengeziwe uma begcwalisa izimoto zabo. Siphakamisa ukuthi ehlise intela kaphethroli ngoR1 ukuze libize ngaphansi kukaR15,” kusho uMaimane ocele abantu baseMzansi ukuthi bamashe nabo ngoLwesibili oluzayo ngo-10 ekuseni njengoba bezoya emahhovisi oMnyango weziMali eTshwane, ukuze uhulumeni abezwe njengoba befuna kwehle uphethroli. UMnuz Visvan Reddy wePappi umemezele ukuthi bazoba nokhukhulelangoqo wesiteleka ngoLwesihlanu ozomisa yonke into. “NgoLwesihlanu sinxusa abantu bakuleli ukuthi bahlale emakhaya, bangayi emsebenzini, nabafundi bangayi esikoleni ukuze batelekele ukukhuphuka kukaphethroli njengoba ukukhuphuka kukaphethroli kuhlukumeza wonke umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika,” kusho uReddy. Ngakolunye uhlangothi i-IFP ibhalele uRamaphosa incwadi imcela ukuthi angenelele odabeni lokunyuka kukaphethroli ngoba abantu abasakwazi ukuphila. Esitatimendeni esifakwe ekhasini le-IFP uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa okhulumela i-IFP kuzwelonke, uthe encwadini abayibhalile bacela uRamaphosa ukuthi eze namasu okwehlisa uphethroli futhi ayeke ukucasha. “Sekuyisikhathi sokuthi uMengameli Ramaphosa akhulume nabantu baseNingizimu abatshele ukuthi uzothatha ziphi izinyathelo ukwehlisa uphethroli. Unethimba eliqinisekisa ukuthi kunezimpahla ezingakhokhelwa intela iValue Added Tax (VAT) kodwa akanalo elibheka inkinga kaphethroli onyuka njalo,” kusho uHlengwa. Uveze ukuthi incwadi bayithumele ngoMsombuluko ngoba befuna uRamaphosa aphumele obala asho ukuthi yena nohulumeni we-ANC bami kuphi ngalolu daba lukaphethroli. Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuthi uSomlomo wePhalamende, uNksz Baleka Mbete wasichitha isicelo sabo sokuthi kukhulunywe ngodaba lokunyuka kukaphethroli ePhalamende. UHlengwa uthe ukunyuka kukaphethroli kuhlukumeza kakhulu abantu abampofu ngoba akunyuki wona kuphela kodwa kunyuka ukudla, ugesi nezinye izidingongqangi. “Sekuyisikhathi sokuthi uMengameli Ramaphosa ehlise ikhabhinethi yakhe enamalungu amaningi, alwe nenkohlakalo, aqinisekise ukuthi kuboshwa izifociya kuyo yonke iminyango kahulumeni ukuze leyo mali izofakwa kwintela kaphethroli,” kusho uHlengwa. Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaRamaphosa ayiphumelelanga njengoba abehhovisi lakhe bengayiphendulanga imibuzo yeSolezwe.
