Bazobuyela enkantolo ngoMeyi 25 sebehambisana nomsolwa owaboshwa kuqala, uMnuz Phelelani Jojisa (32) waseMayville naye ongaphandle ngebheyili kaR1 000. UJojisa okuthiwa ungumlandeli we-Orlando Pirates, ubhekene necala lokungena enkundleni ngaphandle kwemvume kanti kungenzeka andiswe amacala akhe uma kuvela ubufakazi. Ngaphambilini uNaicker uveze ukuthi bangu-20 abantu ababefakwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bemataniswa nalolu dweshu. Uthe ukuvezwa kwabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kusizile ukuze amaphoyisa alandele uphenyo. Ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi ukuvela kwabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana akubanikezi igunya lokuthi bababophe, kudingeke ukuthi benze uphenyo olunzulu, kutholakale nobufakazi.
IPHIKA eyenkohlakalo ngethenda yamathoyilethi iMeya yaseKurhuleni uMnuz Mzwandile Masina, ethi ngeke isuke esikhundleni IPHIKA eyenkohlakalo ngethenda yamathoyilethi iMeya yaseKurhuleni uMnuz Mzwandile Masina, ethi ngeke isuke esikhundleni IMEYA kaMasipala waseKurhuleni uMnuz Mzwandile Masina, ishaya phansi ngonyawo ukuthi ngeke yehle esikhundleni emuva kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo yethenda yamathoyilethi. UMasina obekhuluma nesiteshi somsakazo iSAfm izolo, uyazichitha izinsolo zethenda kaR1.9bn. UMasina usola ukuthi kunetulo lokumsusa esikhundleni. Uthe kunemiyalezo esabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuthiwa kumele asule. Uveze ukuthi akukho okungahambanga kahle ngesikhathi kukhishwa le thenda. Uthe kwayona ithenda yakhishwa engakangeni esikhundeni ngo-Agasti 2016. “UMasipala wethu ungomunye wabenza kahle kakhulu ngokusebenza nokuyisa intuthuko emphakathini. Angisatshiswa wukuthi abantu bathini futhi ngeke ngisuke esikhundleni. Alikho iphutha elenzekile kodwa kwalandelwa yonke imigomo ngokukhishwa kwethenda,” kuchaza uMasina. Uthe uMasipala wakhe usukhiphe amathoyilethi angu-39 000 kubahlali basemjondolo, okuyisibalo esinyuke kakhulu sisuka ku-9 000 ngo-2014. Ecacisa esitatimendeni asifundele abezindaba esithangamini sangoLwesithathu eGermiston Civic Centre, uMasina uthe wuR872 osetshenziswe kwithenda yamathoyitheli. Uthe phezu kwenkampani eyayiqashelwe ukwenza umsebenzi ngo-2014, baphinde baqasha abanye osonkontileka abangu-16. Kwenzeka lokhu nje kumiswe uMnuz Joe Mojapelo obeyisikhulu esiphezulu kulo Masipala. Uthe uMojapelo umiswe emuva kombiko weSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU), esolwa ngenkohlakalo. UMasina uthe uMojapelo kumele avele phambi kwekomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe, aziphendulele kulezi zinsolo zenkohlakalo. Ephawula ngalezi zinsolo uMajapelo, uthe imeya inephutha ngokuthi kunombiko omsola ngenkohlakalo. Ekhuluma emsakazweni uMojapelo uthe unobufakazi bokuthi awukho umbiko oshiwo yimeya. “Bengivele ngazi ukuthi awukho lo mbiko kodwa bekufanele ngenze ucwaningo ukuqinisekisa. Ngaxoshwa ngoMeyi 2 ngaphambi kokhetho, nakho engingeke ngiphawule kakhulu ngakho ngoba angiyena usopolitiki. Ngaxhumana neSIU ukubuza ngombiko ngathola ukuthi awukho. Ngiwumuntu wenkonzo, izindaba ezifana nalezi zicekela phansi isithunzi sami emphakathi,” kusho uMojapelo. Akacacisanga ukuthi uzovela yini ekomitini lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe njengokusho kwemeya.
USOVALWENI uKhuzani Mpungose ngenxa yabantu abaqola abanye ngegama lakhe Isithombe: FACEBOOK/KHUZANI USOVALWENI uKhuzani Mpungose ngenxa yabantu abaqola abanye ngegama lakhe Isithombe: FACEBOOK/KHUZANI KUPHENYWA isihlabani somculi kamaskandi, uKhuzani Mpungose, ngokunyamalala kwenkosikazi yomuntu, uNkk Lungi MaBiyela Hadebe nezingane zakhe ezimbili, okungeyentombazane neyomfana. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uNkk Hadebe, obeyilungu leqembu lesigekle, unyamalale nezimpahla zokugqoka, isamba semali elinganiselwa kuR70 000. UKhuzani uvumile ukuthi usethintwe kaningi ngabaseshi, bemphenya ngalolu daba. “Wudaba oseludumile impela lapha eNkandla,” kusho uKhuzani. Angisazi ukuthi ngenzenjani,” kusho lo mculi. Isolezwe lithole emithonjeni emithathu ukuthi uNkk Hadebe unyamalala nje wayexhumane ku-facebook nalo muntu ozibiza ngoKhuzani ngemuva kokuba ethole ukuthi kunomcimbi ozokuba kubo kalo maskanda. Kuthiwa lo “Khuzani” wathi uzobasiza labo mama uma bezoshintsha isigqi sibe esikamaskandi futhi wabe esebafuna imali, okuyinto eyabathusa abanye omama kodwa uMaBiyela noHadebe baqhubeka nokuxhumana no“Khuzani’ futhi babaxosha abanye omama ababefuna ukumbona ngamehlo lo “Khuzani.” UHadebe wagcina esekhokhela labantu uR7 000 futhi wabanikeza neveni eyiLong Base, athi lo “Khuzani” izofakwa isithombe nombhalo kaMaBiyela. Kuthiwa “uKhuzani” wenzela uMaBiyela iCD engumbombayi ngoba yayinesithombe sakhe kodwa kucula abanye abaculi besilisa ngaphambi kokuthi athi abalethe le veni. Ngemuva kwalokho, lo “Khuzani” wabe esethumela abantu ababelethe kwakhe uR70 000 maqede bathi akeze eGoli ezolanda ikhumbi enguSiyaya. UHadebe uthe eseya eGoli ngoLwesithathu olwedlule, lo “Khuzani” wangabe esazibamba izingcingo zakhe kanti uzothi ebuyela kwakhe, wafika uMaBiyela nezingane zabo ezimbili bengasekho. Ethintwa uHadebe uthe amaphoyisa amdonse ngendlebe ukuthi angaphawuli ngalolu daba ngoba selusemaphoyiseni. Okhulumela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal uColonel Thembeka Mbhele ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa aseNkandla aphenya icala ngokunyamalala kwabantu abathathu.
Isithombe esigciniwe: Phill Magakoe Isithombe esigciniwe: Phill Magakoe INHLANGANO ebusayo i-ANC ifuna amakhansela aseThekwini athweswe amacala enkohlakalo ayiswe ekomitini layo elimele ukuqondisa ubugwegwe. Lokhu kulandela ukuthi oKlebe bebophe amakhansela amane ngoLwesithathu ngecala lokukhwatshaniswa kwemali yethenda yokuqoqa udoti kaR208 million. Amakhansela athintekayo nasevelile enkantolo yamacala athinta imali eThekwini akhululwa ngebheyili kaR5 000 umuntu emunye ngoNomthandazo Shabalala, Nomusa Mthembu, Sthenjwa Nyawose noThembelihle de Lange. I-ANC ifuna baqale baziphendulele ngaphambi kokuba ithathe isinqumo sokuthi ibhekana kanjani nalolu daba,” kusho uMthembu. Ikomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe uthe yilona elizoba nezincomo ngezinyathelo okumele zithathwe wubuholi baKwaZulu-Natal ngawo. UMthembu uthe i-ANC ithukile futhi yaphoxeka ukuthola ukuthi abaholi abathunywe yiyona baphambane nomthetho wokusebenza kukahulumeni. “Lezi zinsolo zibucayi kakhulu futhi siyaweseka amaphoyisa ngokwenza umsebenzi wawo wokuphenya kanzulu futhi uma kukhona ophambane nomthetho kumele aziphendulele enkantolo.” Ukuboshwa kwala makhansela amane kusho ukuthi asengu-22 aseboshiwe ngezinsolo ezithinta ukukhwabanisa imali yethenda yokuqoqa udoti. Owayeyimeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede waboshwa ngoMeyi nonyaka namakhansela angu-16 nabasebenzi bakamasipala. Badedelwa ngebheyili kaR50 000 umuntu ngamunye. Ngemuva kokuthweswa amacala uNkk Gumede ususiwe esikhundleni sakhe sokuba yimeya kukhalwa ngokuthi akasebenzanga ngendlela obekulindeleke ngayo njengemeya kodwa wagcina eseyikhansela. UMthembu uthe bonke abathweswe amacala obugebengu sebedluliselwe ekomitini eliqondisa ubugwegwe. Uthe leli komiti lisebenza ngokushesha ikakhulukazi uma umuntu esetholakale enecala enkantolo. Okwamanje uNkk Gumede akakatholakali enecala.

AMALUNGU e-ANC ngesikhathi ebhonga emswaneni ngemuva kokubulawa kukaSihlalo wawo ku-ward 12, KwaNdengezi, uMnuz Thulani Nxumalo ngoMsombuluko ebusuku. Isithombe: Gcina Ndwalane AMALUNGU e-ANC ngesikhathi ebhonga emswaneni ngemuva kokubulawa kukaSihlalo wawo ku-ward 12, KwaNdengezi, uMnuz Thulani Nxumalo ngoMsombuluko ebusuku. Isithombe: Gcina Ndwalane KUVELE ukuthi kukhona abebemcathamela uSihlalo wegatsha le-ANC ku-ward 12, KwaNdengezi obulewe ngabantu abebemlalele unyendle egcekeni lakwakhe ngoMsombuluko ebusuku. UMnuz Thulani Nxumalo (53) owake waba nguSihlalo womkhandlu olwa nobugebengu, iCommunity Policing Forum (CPF) iminyaka engaphezu kuka-10, udutshulwe ngabantu abangaziwa ngesikhathi esegcekeni lakwakhe eRockdale KwaNdengezi ngesikhathi ephuma emhlanganweni we-ANC. Kuthiwa ngaphambi kokuthi abulawe uNxumalo, laba abebemfuna bake bazama ukumcuthela kwakhe emasontweni amabili edlule kodwa bangamthola ngoba akazange aphumele emnyango. Abahlaseli kuthiwa babecuthe emnyango, babonwa izingane zikamufi bazijikijela ngamatshe babe sebeyabaleka. Kuthiwa baphinde babuya futhi bangqongqoza ewindini nangaleso sikhathi wangaphuma. UMnuz Thulani Nxumalo obulewe Unkosikazi kamufi, uNkk Makhosi Nxumalo uthe ukhona umuntu obehlale eshayela ucingo umyeni wakhe embuza ukuthi ukuphi ngaso sonke isikhathi. “Ngaphambi kokuthi adutshulwe emasontweni amabili edlule, bakhona abantu abamcuthela lapha ekhaya kodwa wangaphuma, labo bantu babuyile futhi bazongqongqoza ewindini wangaphuma futhi, kanti nangosuku abulawe ngalo abebesemhlanganweni naye bathi ucingo lwakhe belulokho lukhala lona obeshaya ebuza ukuthi ukuphi waze wagcina eseluvala ucingo ngoba lumphazamisa,” kusho uNkk Nxumalo. Uthe nango-2004, umyeni wakhe wake wadutshulwa kodwa wasinda. Isekela likaSihlalo we-ANC ku-ward 12, uMnuz Mbongeni “Killer” Ngwenya uthe basadidekile ukuthi uNxumalo ubulawe ngobani nokuthi ubulaweleni. “Akukho ukungezwani esingathi kukhona ewadini, amaqabane abambisene kanti nekhansela le-ward okuyikhansela lomphakathi nalo asinankinga nalo kuyasetshenziswana kahle.” Uchaze uNxumalo njengomuntu obezilungele engafuni kuthiwe kukhona umuntu angazwani naye. “Uqabane uNxumalo ubelunge kakhulu indlela nesihluku abulawe ngayo bekungamfanele,” kusho uNgwenya. UMnuz Zenzele Thabethe we-ANC eHenry Bona Zone uthe ukubulawa kukaNxumalo yisenzo sobugebengu, akuhlangene nezombusazwe. “Sinxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi enze umsebenzi wawo futhi siyathemba ukuthi abenzi bobubi bazogcina bevelile,” kusho uThabethe. UNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli uthe uKhongolose uyakugxeka ukubulawa ngesihluku kukaNxumalo. “Nakuba imininingwane egcwele mayelana nokubulawa kwakhe kade ingakacaci kodwa kubukeka sengathi ababulali bebecashe egcekeni likamufi base beyamdubula amahlandla amaningi ngesikhathi efika kwakhe ephuma emhlanganweni wegatsha. I-ANC inxusa izinhlaka zezokuphepha ukuba ziphenye kabanzi ngokubulawa kukaNxumalo,” kusho uNtuli.. Uthe uNxumalo bazomkhumbula njengomuntu obewuthanda umphakathi, ewuvikela nasezigebengwini. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke, uBrigadier Vishnu Naidoo uthe ukhona owesilisa odutshuliwe washona ngesikhathi esegcekeni lakwakhe kodwa wathi ngeke akwazi ukukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubeyini emphakathini. “Amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubulala, okwamanje imbangela yokubulala ibingakaziwa bekungakaboshwa muntu,” kusho uNaidoo.
ABAFUNDI abenza u-matric eMavela eJozini befunda iScience njengoba kuyisikhathi samaholidi . Izithombe: MLUNGISI GUMEDE ABAFUNDI abenza u-matric eMavela eJozini befunda iScience njengoba kuyisikhathi samaholidi . Izithombe: MLUNGISI GUMEDE NAKUBA iMavela High iyisikole sasemakhaya eJozini, okungenye yezindawo ezisasalele emuva kwezentuthuko kodwa siyakwazi ukudlisela ogageni izikole zasemalokishini nasemadolobheni njengoba sesikhiqize odokotela abacela ku-20, kusukela sasungulwa ngo-1980. Uma ufika kulesi sikole ubona izindonga zaso ulahlekelwa ithemba ngenxa yokuba sesimeni esingagculisi kodwa ubhema ukholwe uma usuchazelwa ngempumelelo yaso. Lesi sikole singesinye sezikole ezenze kahle ku-matric ngonyaka odlule njengoba sithole u-79.9%, sabalwa nezinye izikole eziphakamise isifunda uMkhanyakude. Isolezwe ngeledlule belikulesi sikole lifuna ukuthola kabanzi ukuthi impumelelo yaso ilele kuphi. Uthishanhloko wakulesi sikole, uMnuz Prudent Thembeka Ndlovu, uthe ukubambisana okuhle phakathi kwazo zonke izinhlaka kubalwa othisha, abazali, isigungu esilawula isikole nomphakathi yikhona okuletha impumelelo. “Kuhle ukusebenzisana kwethu, uma kunezinkinga umphakathi uyeza esikoleni kuboniswane. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi izinto zihambe kahle,” kusho uNdlovu. Uthe bazimisele ngokuthi benze kahle kakhulu kulo nyaka. “Wonke umuntu usuke efuna ukuthi zonke izingane ziphumelele, isikole sithole * -100% kodwa kubuye kungenzeki. Engingakusho ukuthi sizimisele ngokwenza kangcono kakhulu kulo nyaka,” kusho uMnuz Ndlovu. Uthe yize beyisikole sasemakhaya kodwa bayakwazi ukumelana nezikole zasemadolobheni nasemalokishini ngendlela abafundi babo abaphumelela ngayo. “Kusukela isikole sasungulwa ngo-1980, bacela ku-20 abafundi asebengodokotela abaphuma esikoleni sethu. Kule minyaka emithathu nje edlule, kuphume abafundi ababili esikoleni sethu abenza izifundo zobudokotela,” usho njalo. Uthe akayibali eyonjiniyela, othisha, nabahlengikazi ngoba bona baningi kakhulu. “Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi abafundi bethu bayakwazi ukukhipha unyawo kulezi zifundo ezithathwa njengezilukhuni iMaths neScience,” usho kanje. Ubonge inhlangano ezimele, iZisize, ngokulekelela ekutheni isikole senze kahle. “’Le nhlangano isisiza ngezinto eziningi njengoba ikwazi ukusiza izingane ebezikhungethwe izinkinga ezahlukene, iphinde isize nasekuhleleni izinhlelo zokululeka abafundi ngezifundo abangazenza uma sebeqede ukufunda,” kusho uMnuz Ndlovu. Uthe le nkampani iphinde ikhuthaze abafundi ibatshele ukuthi njengoba bephuma emakhaya akusho ukuthi ngeke bakwazi ukwenza kahle uma sebefike emanyuvesi. “Zikhona izinselelo esibhekene nazo njenge sikole esizama ukuzilungisa okubalwa kuzo indaba yokushoda kwamagumbi okufundela njengoba kumanje kukhona nabafundi abafundela eLaboratory ngoba bengenalo ikilasi abangalisebenzisa,” kusho uMnuz Ndlovu. Uthe ukushoda kwamakilasi kudalwe ukwenyuka kwesibalo sabafundi abanabo, njengoba kulo nyaka benezingane ezingu-1 132. “Bakhona abathembisa ukusisiza ngoba sizimisele ngokuthi la bafundi sibakhiphe eLaboratory,” kusho uMnuz Ndlovu. Uthe enye yezingqinamba abayibonayo ukuthi kunabafundi bakaGrade 8 no-9, asebengenwe umkhuba wokusebenzisa izidakamizwa esikoleni sabo. “La bafundi baphuza utshwala okuyinto eyingozi ekusaseni labo, siyacela ukuthi kube khona ukubambisana nabazali ukuze siyinqobe le nto,” kusho uMnuz Ndlovu. Uthe abafundi babo abadala abebenza kahle babuye babacele ukuthi bazofundisa lezi zifundo akade bezazi kakhulu. IPhini likathishanhloko, uMnuz Ndlela Mpontshane, uthe ngaphandle kokuhlabana kwezemfundo, abafundi babo baphinde benze kahle nakwezemidlalo. “Isikole sethu sesithole izindebe eziningi emikhakheni ehlukene kwezemidlalo kubalwa ibhola lezinyawo nesibhakela,” kusho uMpontshane. Ngesikhathi Isolezwe likulesi sikole ngeledlule, lalamela omunye wabafundi abadala, uSphila Dlamini, efundisa abafundi iScience. USphila owathola o-distinction abayisikhombisa, manje wenza unyaka wesithathu ezifundweni zakhe zobudokotela. Uthe uyakujabulela ukubizwa esikoleni ukuthi azosiza ngoba ufisa ukubona abafundi abeza ngemuva kwakhe nabo bephumelela. “Kuyintokozo kimina futhi ngizizwa ngikhethekile ngokuthi isikole singikhethe ukuthi ngibe ingxenye yaso yize noma sengaphuma khona,” kusho uSphila. Uthe ufisa ukuthi ahlale eyisibonelo esihle kubafundi baseMavela. “Okunye engikwenzayo ukuthi ngihlale ngibakhuthaza ukuthi bangaphumelela ezifundweni zabo uma bezimisela,” kusho uSphila. Ilungu lo mphakathi elingumakhelwane nesikole, uMnuz Sanele Mngomezulu, lithe iMavela iyisibusiso emphakathini njengoba ikwazi ukukhiqiza abafundi abasezingeni eliphezulu yize isendaweni yasemakhaya. Asikho isidingo sokuthi izingane zethu sizifunele izikole kwezinye izindawo ngoba nathi sinaso isikole sethu esenza kahle futhi esiziqhenyayo ngaso,” kusho uMngomezulu. UMngomezulu ubonge othisha ngokusebenza ngokuzikhandla okwenza abafundi benze kahle. “Kubalulekile ukuthi sibabonge othisha uma benza kahle emiphakathini,” kusho uMngomezulu.

UMNUZ Philani Msomi othi ushaywe walaliswa esibhedlela ngabalisa ababemsola ngokweba uR50 UMNUZ Philani Msomi othi ushaywe walaliswa esibhedlela ngabalisa ababemsola ngokweba uR50 UFUNA ubulungiswa umndeni womlisa (22) waseBhobhobho eduze kwaseJolivet okuthiwa ushawe walaliswa esibhedlela abalisa abebemsola ngokweba uR50. Kuthiwa uMnuz Philani Msomi uhlaselwe abalisa bangakubo ngeledlule ngoba bemsola ngokuthi ungene endlini wabopha ingane yakhona eneminyaka engu-16 wase ethatha uR50. Umalume wakhe, uMnuz Mpiko Msomi, uthe umshana wakhe uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela emuva kokunenebulwa yilaba balisa okuthiwa bebemshaya ngomphini wepiki bephinde bamshaye nangobhushi ngoba bemsola ngokweba. Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi laba balisa baboshiwe kodwa babuye badedelwa. “Kubuhlungu kuthina siwumndeni wakhe ngoba ulinyaziwe kabuhlungu waze walaliswa esibhedlela kodwa abantu abenze lokhu badedelwa. Asiqondi ukuthi kanti umthetho usebenza kanjani?” kusho uMsomi. Ukhale nangokuthi lesi sigameko senzeke ngoLwesibili ekuseni futhi sabikwa emaphoyiseni kodwa abasolwa baze baboshwa ngoLwesine khona ngeledlule ngoba naye eselandelele ezama ukuthola ukuthi ababoshiwe ngani? Uphinde wakhala ngokuthi ifomu iJ88 eligcwaliswayo elikhombisa amanxeba omuntu osuke elinyaziwe, nalo belingazange ligcwaliswe, wathi ukholwa ngukuthi nakho kube nomthelela ekutheni kugcine kudedelwa abasolwa. UMsomi osanda kudedelwa esibhedlela, uthe akaphathekile kahle njengoba abasolwa eseke wababona becanasa ngaphandle. Uthe akukho okucacile ngokuthi badedelwe kanjani laba balisa. Echaza indlela alinyazwa ngayo, uthe laba balisa bamthatha ngezikhathi zasekuseni ecenta kwamalume wakhe. “Ngesikhathi sebengithathile bangishaya ngenduku kwathi uma iphuka basebenzisa umphini wepiki nobhushi wotshani. Ubhushi babewuphendulile kodwa bewungisika uma bengishaya ngawo. Nginezibazi zawo ezingalweni nasekhanda. Ngase ngichama negazi ngesikhathi ngisanda kulimala. Namanje ngixhume ipayipi lomchamo,” kusho uPhilani. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCol Thembeka Mbele ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa avule icala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza. Uthe kuboshwe abalisa ababili oneminyaka engu-35 noneminyaka engu-27. Uqhube wathi laba balisa bavele enkantolo ngoNovemba 19, wathi akazi ukuthi babuyela nini enkantolo.

UNkk Phikiwe Thandazile Ngobese (Mangeni) ushade noMnuz Bernard Mxoshwa Ngobese kodwa isitifiketi somshado abasinikwa uMnyango wezaseKhaya siveza ukuthi uNkk Ngobese uzishade yena, esikhaleni okufanele ngabe kubhalwe kuso umyeni kubhalwe igama nesibongo sakhe nasesikhaleni sikankosikazi kubhalwe yena. Uthe uma kudingeka ukuthi abhale unkosikazi wakhe emaphepheni akhe abalulekile akakwazi ukumbala njengonkosikazi umbala njengomama wezingane. “Ngokwalo mnyango mina angishadile. Lento iyasikhathaza ngoba iminyaka iyahamba. Ngiyabona ukuthi ngeke sisizakale njengoba kuthiwa ePitoli bathe ngeke leli phutha lilungiseke,” kusho yena UMnuz Siyabulela Qoza, okhulumela uMnyango wezaseKhaya kuleli, uthe ngokwazi kwakhe wonke amaphutha ayalungiseka kodwa ngeke akwazi ukuphawula ngokugcwele ukuthi kulolu daba kwenzekeni ngoba uyaqala ukuzwa ngalo. Wacela ukuthi athunyelelwe imininingwane yalo ukuze aluthumele ophikweni olufanele.

Uthe ufike kushiswe ihhovisi lothisha, kwasha izincwadi nomsebenzi wabafundi nowothisha. “Amanzi asinawo nje, basike amapayipi, amathoyilethi awasebenzi. Kushe nokudla obekuthengiwe, izihlalo namatafula okusha sha. Othisha bayasaba ngoba kunabantu abasonga ngokuthi bazobuya bazoshisa izimoto,” kusho uNkk Sithole. Uthe okubuhlungu wukusha komsebenzi wabafundi okumele baqale phansi bawuqoqe. “Sizoncenga abafundi ukuthi baphinde babhale. Kushe umsebenzi wonyaka wonke wezingane. Nanyakenye kwantshontshwa amakhompyutha kwadingeka siqale phansi umsebenzi. umonakalo owenzekile ungaphezulu kukaR50 000.” Uthe amapayipi amanzi bebesanda kuwalungisa kuleli sonto bekade befike esikiwe. Uqhube wathi bancenge abafundi ukuthi babhale izivivinyo ezandulela ezokugcina njengoba izolo bekubhalwa i-English. Lesi sikole singesinye sezikole ezenza kahle njengoba nyakenye sithole u-99% kwa-matric. “Kulo nyaka besifuna u-100% asazi uma sekwenzeke kanje ukuthi kusazokwenzeka yini. Asibazi laba bantu abenza nje ngoba abakaze beze kuthina.” Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, uthe umphakathi akumele udubele ezikoleni uma ufuna izidingo. “Asisazakhi izikole ezishiswe wumphakathi. Umphakathi uzozibonela ukuthi uzosakha kanjani ngoba siyisidingongqangi. Siyasigxeka lesi senzo ngoba senzeke sekusele inyanga ngaphambi kokubhalwa kwezivivinyo zika-matric,” kusho uMthethwa. Okhulumela amaphoyisa uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuphenywa icala lokucekela phansi impahla elivulwe esiteshini samaphoyisa iCato Manor. Uthe ezintatha zayizolo amalungu omphakathi avale umgwaqo iDunbar ekhala ngokushoda kwezidingo. “Abe eseya esikoleni iWiggins Secondary afike aphihliza amawindi, akukaboshwa muntu.”

African News Agency/ANA BALAHLWE ngamacala oLindokuhle Mchunu (20), uSboniso Khubisa (22) noSabelo Mkhize (28) ababulala amaphoyisa Isithombe: Leon Lestrade. African News Agency/ANA BAGWETSHWE odilikajele abalisa abathathu abalahlwe ngamacala okubulala ngesihluku amaphoyisa esigamekweni esenzeke ngoSepthemba 2015 emijondolo yaseNamibia, eNanda. Ilungu lomndeni womunye wababulali uSipho Mkhize elingafunanga ukudalulwa lithe ibambe ngakho ngokugwetshwa kwakhe ngoba bebefuna ajeze nabo bengumndeni ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi wayengabenza le nto. Kuvele ukuthi lo mlisa uvele unenxanxathela yamacala ake amlahla phambilini.

Bekuwumjaho ongajwayelekile ngoba usheshe zibekwa. Kodwa ngizitshele ukuthi ngizogijima ngendlela ebengihlele ngayo. Ngiyabonga kakhulu emndenini wami nomqeqeshi ngabangenzele kona. Bengingasebenzi izinyanga ezimbili. Uma ungasebenzi uwu-advocate awuholi. Ngiyabonga futhi angizisoli ngesinqumo sami,” kusho u-Ashworth odabuka eKapa kodwa osezinze eGauteng. Ugcine eqede endaweni yesihlanu ngo-6:33:08. “Umjaho wabesifazane ubusezingeni ebelilindelekile. Besingekho isikhathi sokuhlala ngemuva. Leli golide lingena ezindondweni esengizitholile kulo nyaka,” kusho uSteyn. USteyn, oneminyaka ewu-28, uthe akasoze ayeka ukugijima iComrades Marathon yize abanye bemthatha ngokuthi usemncane. UMNUZ Mbongeni Gcabashe noMnuz Thembinkosi Ndlovu abangonogada enkampanini yonogada iTrinity Protection abathi bashaywe ngamaphoyisa abecabanga ukuthi bayizigebengu ezicupha imishini yemali UMNUZ Mbongeni Gcabashe noMnuz Thembinkosi Ndlovu abangonogada enkampanini yonogada iTrinity Protection abathi bashaywe ngamaphoyisa abecabanga ukuthi bayizigebengu ezicupha imishini yemali BABHODLA umlilo onogada, abagada ama-ATM abathi bamuhluzwe ngamaphoyisa abecabanga ukuthi baziyizigebengu ezicupha imishini yemali, eMpangeni. UMnuz Mbongeni Gcabashe noMnuz Thembinkosi Ndlovu abasebenza enkampanini yonogada iTrinity Protection enenkontileka nabakwaStandard Bank bathi behlelwe yilesi sigameko bephuma kolungisa i-ATM yakwaStandard Bank , enxanxatheleni yezitolo i-Assenwood Centre, eseRichards Bay ngoLwesine ebusuku. UGcabashe obehleli esihlalweni somgibeli emotweni, engabhaliwe ukuthi eyenkampani abebehamba ngayo uthe uqaphele ukuthi kunemoto ebihamba ebibasola ngesikhathi besebenza. Lo mshayeli uthi bacabanga ukuthi ubikele amaphoyisa bathi akabuzanga lutho kubona, ubebabukile besebenza emshinini. Balinde kancane baphinde babuyela kuwo beqinisekisa ukuthi ngempela awunankinga yini njengoba ubuchwepheshe ababusebenzisayo bebukhombise ukuthi unenkinga. “Sihambe ibanga elincane singasayiboni le moto sabona kuqhamuka inqwaba yamaveni amaphoyisa ngemuva kwemoto yethu. Ebingaphambili isimisile, sama. Ngiphume kuqala ngaphakamisa izandla, ngiphethe ikhadi lokusebenza, angikwazanga nokubuza kwenzenjani, ngoba kuqhume impama, nebhuzu ngalahleka phansi nalo ikhadi ebengiliphethe,” echaza. Ngesikhathi esalele phansi uthe amanye amaphoyisa ahambe aya kuzakwabo obengumshayeli wabuzwa ukuthi kungani imoto abahamba ngayo ingabhaliwe futhi eqashiwe. UNdlovu uthe uchazile ukuthi inkampani ikwenza ngamabomu lokhu ngoba uma kunzeka behamba ngezimoto ezaziwayo bangaba sengcupheni yokudutshulwa yizigebengu. Ngemuva kwalokho bathi amaphoyisa abashiye kanjalo angachaza lutho futhi angasho ukuthi abaye esiteshini bayoveza bonke ubufakazi bokuthi bayasebenza. “Esiteshini samaphoyisa eMpangeni amaphoyisa abekhona asibuze ukuthi yithi yini ebesihamba ngePolo Vivo ebisolisa, savuma. Sabuza ukuthi kuthiwa siyasolisa ngobani athi kungene ucingo luchaza le moto njengesolisayo. Indaba yonakale uma sesithi sizovula icala ngoba sishayiwe. Amaphoyisa aphika ukuthi lawo maphoyisa abephuma kulesi siteshi, athi kungenzeka ukuthi sishaywe ngonogada abebesebenzisa izimoto zamaphoyisa. Kube umzukuzuku ukuthi sivule icala,” kusho Gcabashe. Uthe kwale noma sekufika umphathi wabo esiteshini ezobuza ukuthi kwenzekeni iphoyisa elithe liwukhomanda lanqaba negama lalo kodwa icala ligcine livuliwe. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uCol Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuvulwe icala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza esiteshini samaphoyisa eMpangeni. “Lolu daba luthunyelwe ophikweni oluphenya amacala athinta amaphoyisa,” kusho uCol Mbele.
USAPHITHENE amakhanda umndeni webhungu (21) okuthiwa liklabhe lalimaza unina, labulala abashana balo ababili libagenca ngobhushu, maqede lashayiswa yiloli lashona, eBhobhoyi. Umndeni kaMnuz Siphamandla Smith awuwuvali umlomo ngesigameko esihlasimulisa umzimba esidlule nemiphefumulo yabashana bakhe uSiyamthanda (3) noThobani (2) okuthiwa bahlaselwe nguye ngobhushu izolo ekuseni, emuva kwehora lesithupha. Kuthiwa unina, uNkk Marry Smith usindile kulesi sigameko kodwa usesimeni esibi esibhedlela. Ngesikhathi leli phephandaba lithinta lo mndeni izolo bewuzwakala ukuthi usakhungathekile futhi udidekile. UNkk Nana Ngcobo uthe basafisa ukuthola ongabachazela ngokwenze indodana kababekazi wakhe ivuke ihlasele unina nabashana bayo. Uthe uthole umbiko ophuthumayo kuthiwa akazobheka lesi sehlakalo. “Sisathukile futhi siphithene amakhanda ngale nto eyenzekile. Okubi wukuthi kwayena uSiphamandla ngeke size sikwazi ukumbuza ngoba ushayiswe yiloli washona emuva kwalesi sigameko. Ngeke ngithi uziphonse ezimotweni noma ushayiseke ethi uyawela kodwa naye ushonile,” kusho uNkk Ngcobo. Kuthiwa uSmith ubebaklabha emakhanda ngobhushu. Abashana bakhe kuthiwa bebeshayeke kabi eziphongweni kwaze kwaphuma ubuchopho. Unina yena kuthiwa umklabhe ekhanda nasengalweni. UNkk Ngcobo uchaze uSmith njengomuntu obethula kakhulu kodwa oqale ukuba nenkinga emuva kokudidekelwa wumqondo nyakenye. Ngokusho kwamalungu omndeni wakhe ukuphazamiseka kwakhe emqondweni bekumenza abuye abe nodlame kodwa akekho obelindele ukuthi angagcina enze lokhu akwenzile. UNksz Zamo Smith uthe ubabekazi wakhe ubehlala noSmith ekhaya nabashana bakhe nezinye izingane zakubo, okubalwa unina womunye wabashana bakhe abashonile ngesikhathi ebahlasela. UNksz Smith uthe unina wenye yezingane ezishonile nguyena ozithele phezu kwezidumbu zezingane nonina obelimele kakhulu kodwa esaphila. Uthe umndeni wonke uphatheke kabuhlungu ngenxa yalesi sigameko. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLt Col Thulani Zwane uthe kuvulwe amacala amabili okubulala nelilodwa lokuzama ukubulala ngenxa yokuhlaselwa kwalaba bobathathu. Uthe kukholakala ukuthi umsolwa ushayiswe yiloli ngesikhathi ebaleka. Uthe kuzovulwa icala lokubulala ngokungenhloso. UZwane uthe akuqondakali ukuthi umsolwa ubezama ukuzibulala yini.

UMXHUMANISI wobuholi besikhashana be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala. Isithombe: Bongani Mbatha UMXHUMANISI wobuholi besikhashana be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala. Isithombe: Bongani Mbatha UMXHUMANISI wobuholi besikhashana be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, ucacise ngenhloso yakhe yokuhambela icala lobengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma osolwa ngenkohlakalo. UZuma ubevele okwesibili eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu lapho kubonakale khona inqwaba yabaholi namalungu e-ANC eyomeseka. UZikalala uthe ukubonakala kwakhe eseka uZuma kungenxa yokuthi usuke efuna ukuqondisa ukukhuluma okungekuhle okusabalele ngabaholi benhlangano. Uthe usuke eziyele njengesakhamuzi sakuleli hhayi njengelungu noma umholi we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal. Uveze nokuthi usazoqhubeka nokuya ngoba akaboni hlazo yena kulokho. “Uma uzoqaphelisisa ngalolo suku lwecala ngangifake ijakhethi ye-ANC kodwa ngayikhumula sengiya ecaleni ngoba bengiya njengomuntu nje bengingayomela i-ANC. Angiyiboni inkinga kulokho ngoba wonke umuntu uvumelekile ukuya enkantolo,’’ kusho uZikalala Esekhuluma nabezindaba eceleni uthinte nendaba yekhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana eholwa iPhini leNhloko yamaJaji uRaymond Zondo. Ikhomishini isiqalile ukwenza umsebenzi wayo njengoba abanolwazi bengaluletha kuyona. UZikalala uthe abantu abangalinge babhule babe yizangoma ngodaba lokulawulwa koMbuso wathi kufanele ikhomishini inikwe ithuba lokwenza umsebenzi wayo ukuze kuvele iqiniso. UZuma ungomunye wabavelayo kwabasolwa ngokuba nesandla ekulawulweni koMbuso yidlanzana. Usolwa ngokuvumela abangani bakhe bakwaGupta ukuzitapela emalini yabakhokhi bentela. UZikalala wesekwe uNkk Nocawe Mafu oyilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kuzwelonke, othe angaya kokweseka uZuma noma nini. “Nami nje ukuba benginaso isikhathi bengingaya ngoba yinto engenankinga ukuya ecaleni likaZuma,’’ kusho uNkk Mafu. UZikalala ugxeke ilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kuzwelonke uMnuz Bheki Cele ngokuhlomekisa amalungu enhlangano. Ukhale kakhulu ngesitatimende sikaCele asenze ngonyaka odlule ngoDisemba lapho athi amalungu awaqhubeke nokuyisa i-ANC ezinkantolo ukuze iqonde ngqo. UZikalala uthe lesi sitatimende siyadukisa asiyisizi inhlangano. Usole nabanye abaholi abasezinhlakeni zikazwelonke ngokuba nesandla ekutshaleni uqhekeko enhlanganweni wathi kuyadinga ukulungiswa lokhu. “Ngesikhathi sixoxa namaqabane kuvelile ukuthi kukhona ukungeneliseki ngezinto ezehlukene kodwa okunye okuvelile kube yinkinga yabaholi bakuzwelonke abaphehla ukungezwani.’’ UCele ethintwa ngalezi zinsolo ezenziwe uZikalala uvele wangaphawula wathi akakwazi ukukhuluma nabezindaba ngalokho.

BEKUVUKA usinga ezitshudenini zaseDUT izolo ngesikhathi zibhikisha ngaphandle kwesikhungo esivaliwe njengoba kufe isitshudeni Isithombe: Doctor Ngcobo/African News Agency(ANA) BEKUVUKA usinga ezitshudenini zaseDUT izolo ngesikhathi zibhikisha ngaphandle kwesikhungo esivaliwe njengoba kufe isitshudeni Isithombe: Doctor Ngcobo/African News Agency(ANA) KUSIZE amaphoyisa kucishe kusuka uthuli lwezichwe izolo phakathi kwenhlangano yezitshudeni iSasco ne-EFF Student Command (EFFSC) eDurban University of Technology ngesikhathi i-EFFSC iphazamisa isithangami seSasco nabezindaba. Usihlalo weSasco, uMqondisi Duma, bese kuphele cishe imizuzu eyishumi eqale ukukhuluma ngesikhathi kuqhamuka isigejana se-EFFSC sangena phakathi kwezintatheli sabuza ukuthi ukhulumelani ngesitshudeni esishonile uMlungisi Madonsela obeyilungu le-EFFSC ngoba abamazi. “Nikhulumelani ngoMlungisi, uyamazi? Yekani le nto eniyenzayo,” kusho esinye sezitshudeni ze-EFFSC sishaya amakhamera simphuca nephepha abefunda kulona. Kube sekungenelela amaphoyisa ahlukanisa isixuku kwahlakazekwa kanjalo. UDuma uqhubekile wakhuluma nezintatheli ezitshela ukuthi abanalo udlame bayahlonipha. Uthe sibi isehlakalo sokubulawa kwesitshudeni ngoba silwela imfundo. “Siyakhala ngendaba yokuqashwa kwenkampani yonogada ezimele ukuqapha izitshudeni. Sifuna inyuvesi ilungise ibathathe bonke abangakabhalisi ukuze babhalise,” kusho uDuma. Umengameli womkhandlu owengamele izitshudeni eDUT, uKhanyisani ‘Godlimpi’ Khambule, ugxeke inyuvesi emuva kokushona kukaMadonsela oshonele esibhedlela esizimele eThekwini. UKhambule uthe basemanzini ngenxa yokwenzeke izolo lapho omunye wonogada obeqashwe yinyuvesi edubule isitshudeni sashona. “Sifuna ukudlulisa umlayezo kubaphathi baseDUT, kuhulumeni nakwabomthetho wokuthi kusiphethe kabi okusehlele. Akusiphathi kahle ukuthi kudutshulwe ilungu le-EFF lashona ngenxa yesiteleka,” kusho uKhambule. Izitshudeni ze-EFF zimashe emgwaqweni odlula kulesi sikhungo izolo kanti amaphoyisa abelokhu eqaphe isimo. UKhambule uthe bavamile ukuteleka enyuvesi futhi kuvamise ukuthi badutshulwe ngezinhlamvu zenjoloba kodwa ngoLwesibili onogada badubule ngezinhlamvu zangempela. “Onogada balandela imiyalelo abayinikwa abaphathi benyuvesi ukuthi abadubule izitshudeni,” kusho yena. Emashini bekukhona namalungu emikhandlu ehlukene okubalwa iSadesmo ye-IFP neBLF. Abengamele izitshudeni enyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal ophikweni i-Edgewood, Westville, Howard kanjalo naseMangosuthu University of Technology bakuqinisekisile ukuthi namabhasi ezitshudeni awasebenzi. Okhulumela i-EFFSC eMUT, uMvuyisi Mavuthulana, uthe inyuvesi izovalwa kuze kufezwe izidingo zezitshudeni. “Sizobhekana ngendlela eyiyo nalesi senzo saseDUT ngoba uma sikhombisa ukwesaba singaphinda senzeke lesi sehlakalo futhi sizoqhubeka nokuphatha bethanda bengathandi,” kusho uMavuthulana.

Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi wathenga isiza ngo-2013 esasibiza uR120 000, wakha nomuzi. Uveze ukuthi walandela konke okwenziwa uma uthenga isiza, wathola nencwadi yetayitela. Ngo-2014 kwafika abazibize ngabanikazi balesi siza, abathe abakaze basidayise. UNkk Mkhwanazi uthe athenga kuyena isiza naye wayesidayiselwe ngomunye okusolakala ukuthi nguyena owakokotela omazisi babanikazi baso. “Angisazi yini engizoyenza yingakho sengibona kungcono ngiwudilize umuzi. Icala selibuya ngisho enkantolo ngo-2015 ngatshelwa ukuthi isiza kumele sibuyele kubanikazi baso. Ngesonto eledlule ngithole ucingo kuthiwa angizosayina ukuthi ngiyavuma ukuthi isiza sibuyele kubanikazi,” kubalisa uNkk Mkhwanazi. Umuzi ongase umlahlekele wambiza uR400 000 ukuwakha, unamakamelo amane okulala, ikamelo lokuphumula, elokudlela, ikhishi, amagaraji amabili nezindlu zokugeza ezimbili ezinamathoyilethi. Ingozi alimala kuyo umyeni wakhe yamshiya engakwazi ukuhamba njengoba esebenzisa isihlalo esinamasondo. UNkk Mkhwanazi uthe uyile kobika udaba kuMasipala waseMhlathuze ngoba isiza siselokishini, bathembisa ukululandela. Okhulumela uMasipala, uMnuz Mdu Ncalane uvumile ukuthi lwafika kubona udaba kodwa akukho abangasiza ngakho. Uthe abakutholile wukuthi indawo okwakhiwe kuyo umuzi ayikho ngaphansi kukamasipala. “Ukungenela kwethu kwakuwukubheka ukuthi isiza esikabani. Ngeke sikwazi ukungenela ngoba lena yindawo ezimele engekho ngaphansi kukaMasipala. Sameluleka uNkk Mkhwanazi ukuthi azame abameli ukuxazulula lolu daba,” kusho uNcalane. Isolezwe lizamile ukuthola umnikazi wesiza, oshayelwe emahhovisi akhe okusebenza ngoMsombuluko kwathiwa usaphumile. Intatheli ishiye umyalezo nenombolo yocingo. Izolo kuthiwe uxinwe umsebenzi futhi ngeke abe khona ehhovisi usuku lonke. Omunye owesilisa osebenza enkampanini yakhe, uthe uyalwazi udaba kodwa kumele kuthintwe ngqo umnikazi walo. Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela engatholakali.

Ungoti uthi iningi labakipitayo ligcina lingashadile, lixabana kubangwa nokuthi abathandanayo badidekile. Owesifazane ugcina engazazi noma uyinkosikazi endodeni akipite nayo, nowesilisa engazazi ukuthi ungumyeni noma isoka kwakipite naye. Kukubi kunjalo, ungoti wezamasiko uthi kukhona okuhlale kweqiwa uma kukhulunywa ngomkhuba abathi mubi wokukipita. Uthi izithandani ezikipita zizale izingane zize zikhule kulowo mnyama, zibanga ezinkulu izinkinga. “Nihleli ndawonye nakha umndeni nomuzi kodwa anihlangene ngokwezibongo. Nihleli nikhulisa izingane ekubeni nibiza izibongo ezihlukene. “Namadlozi enu awaqondi ukuthi niyisima kanjani,” kusho uDkt Nomagugu Ngobese ungoti kwezamasiko. Uthi iningi lezingane ezikhula emkipitweni zigcina zingenzelwanga izimfanelo zesiko ezifana nembeleko nokunye. “Yonke leyo nto igcina iphithanisa izinto. Kuba nzima kakhulu ke uma kwenzeka kuba khona odlulayo emhlabeni kulabo bazali abakipite iminyaka baze bazala inqwaba yezingane,” kusho ungoti. Uthi ilula le nto, abathandanayo uma sebebonile ukuthi bayathandana futhi bathanda ukuchitha isikhathi ndawonye, mabashade. “Inkinga wukuthi abantu kulezi zinsuku basuke bafune ukwenza zonke izinto ezingenamsebenzi ezigcina zingenamthelela esikweni nasendleleni okumele kwenziwe ngayo ngokwesintu”. Ukholwa wukuthi uma abathandanayo bangaqondana ngqo nelobolo nokushada ngokwesintu, bayeke ubukhazikhazi bemishado emhlophe nezingxenye okuthiwa ezokulobola ezingenamsebenzi esikweni, singancipha isibalo sezingane ezigcina zingazazi ukuthi ziyiliphi, ezingazi nokuthi uma zikhomba emakubo zizothi izibongo zakhona kukwabani. UDkt Ngobese ukhuze nomkhuba walabo okuthi ngoba sebeziqalile izinhlelo zokulobolana, bavele bakhethe ukukipita. Nalabo abashade umshado omhlophe kodwa bengachanguzanga ngokwesintu, uthi noma bangagqoka amaringi abiza kangakanani, kodwa nabo bafana nse nabantu abakipitile. “Uma ungakaze ukhishwe ngenyongo kubikelwe idlozi ukuthi usuyogana, kusho ukuthi awushadile. Abantu abayeke ukuholwa yinkanuko. Yinkanuko phela eyenza abantu abaningi baze bahlale ndawonye bengashadile. “Abesifazane nabo abake basukume bawuqede lo mkhuba. Uma kungaqina ngakubona, izinto zingaba ngcono." Uthi abathandanayo abayeke ukuzicabangela bona, abacabangele izingane. Ephetha uthe abazali abangakwazanga ukwenza lolu hlobo lomshado wesintu, abasilungise lesi simo kungakonakali.

IMEYA yeTheku uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda nePhini lakhe uNkk Belinda Scott othi kumele kuphenywe ngemali eyayibekelwe izinhlelo zokukhumbula owayenguMengameli wokuqala wentando yeningi uMnuz Nelson Mandela esetshenziselwe ezinye izinhlelo IMEYA yeTheku uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda nePhini lakhe uNkk Belinda Scott othi kumele kuphenywe ngemali eyayibekelwe izinhlelo zokukhumbula owayenguMengameli wokuqala wentando yeningi uMnuz Nelson Mandela esetshenziselwe ezinye izinhlelo KUSUKE umsindo phakathi kwamaqembu aphikisayo nezikhulu zikaMasipala weTheku mayelana nesinqumo sokususwa kukaR3.5 million, ezinhlelweni zokukhumbula owayengumengameli wokuqala wentando yabantu kuleli uMnuz Nelson Mandela wayiswa emkhankasweni wokulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane ngaphandle kokugunyazwa umasipala. Ikhansela le-IFP uMnuz Mdu Nkosi lithe alingabazi ukuthi le mali isetshenziswe ngaphandle kokugunyazwa umkhandlu. “Ngifisa ukuthola incazelo ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani uR3.5 million, owawabelwe izinhlelo zokukhunjulwa kukaMandela wayiswa kolunye uhlelo ngaphandle kokugunyazwa ngumkhandlu. Uma siqhubeka nokwenza ngeke iphele le nto yokuthi kuthiwe kunezigidi zemali ezisetshenziswe budedengu,” kusho uNkosi. Ikhansela leDA uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, lithe bafuna umuntu othathe lesi sinqumo athathelwe izinyathelo ngoba lokhu akwenzile kuphambene nomthetho wokusetshenziswa kwemali kamasipala. NePhini leMeya uNkk Belinda Scott lithe liyahambisana nesikhalo samaqembu aphikisayo, lengeza ngokuthi kuzomele ajeze umuntu othathe lesi sinqumo. “Kumele siqale sithole ukuthi kuphambene nomthetho yini ukususa imali kolunye uhlelo uyifake kolunye uhlelo, ngolwazi lwami enginalo lokusetshenziswa kwemali kahulumeni kumele kwenziwe isicelo bese kuyagunyazwa,” kusho uNkk Scott. Uthe kumele iphele nya le nto yokusetshenziswa kwemali budedengu. “Umuntu ozotholakala enecala lapho, kuzomele ajeze,” kusho uNkk Scott. IPhini leMenenja oPhikweni lwezoMphakathi nezimo eziphuthumayo uMnuz Vusi Mazibuko okuwuphiko lwakhe oluthathe lesi sinqumo, lithe imali okukhulunywa ngayo ibingakasetshenziswa. UNkk Scott uthe akayikholwa le nto eshiwo nguMazibuko ngoba umkhankaso wokulwa nesihlava sokuhlaselwa kwabesifazane nezingane uqale ngoNovemba 25, uphele ngoDisemba 10. “Akukwazi ukuthi le mali ayikasebenzi ngoba phela uhlelo seluqalile, sizolindela ukuthi sithole umbiko ogcwele emhlanganweni ozayo ukuthi kwenzakalani ngale mali. Embikweni esiwulindeke sifuna le mali icazwe ukuthi izosebenza kanjani,” kusho uNkk Scott. UMgcinimafa eMkhandlwini weTheku uMnuz Krish Kumar, uthe kungenzeka ukuba le mali yasuswa ezinhlelweni zokukhumbula uMandela yayiswa emkhankasweni wokulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane kusetshenziswa isigaba somthetho uRule order 28. URule order 28, ilapho imeya nemenenja bethatha isinqumo ngaphandle komkhandlu ngoba bethi kuyaphuthuma. UNkosi uyichithile indaba kaRule order 28, wathi ayikho ngoba akekho umuntu ongathi bekuphuthuma futhi umkhandlu uhleli awukho ekhefini.

BAKHALA bayazithulisa abadayisi basemgwaqweni ePinetown emuva kokuthi umlilo okusolakala ukuthi uqalwe amaphara ushise impahla abayidayisayo yaba wumlotha ezintatha zayizolo. UNkk Philomena MaMthembu Hlophe ophethe indawo okugcinwa kuyo impahla yabadayisi basemgwaqweni u-Anderson phakathi kwerenke yaKwaNdengezi neyaseClermont, ePinetown uthe ushayelwe ngamaphoyisa amtshela ukuthi kuyasha ngabo-2 ezintatha zayizolo. “Ngishayelwe izicishamlilo safika kanye nazo la ePinetown. Zizamile ukucisha kodwa ngebhadi ayikho impahla esindile njengoba konke kushe kwaba wumlotha. Saqala ngabo-1980 ukudayisa ezitaladini zasePinetown kodwa siyaqala ukubhekana nesimo esinzima kanje. Kusolakala ukuthi umlilo uqalwe yilaba abahlala kujantshi wesitimela kusho ukuthi bebebasile wase umlilo ubhebhetheka ushisa impahla lapha,” kusho uNkk Hlophe. Ucele noma wubani ongaba nosizo ukuba alekelele abadayisi abashelwe yimpahla ikakhulukazi uMasipala weTheku esho nokuthi akukho lapho abadayisi bethatha khona. Sicela uMasipala weTheku usinxephezele ngoba siyarenta ukugcina impahla yethu lapha. Sikhokha uR40 ngesonto noR400 wephemithi yezinyanga eziyisithupha. Siziphilisa ngokudayisa izinkukhu asazi sizokwenzenjani ngoba silahlekelwe yimpahla kaR2 000 umuntu emunye,” kusho uNksz Hadebe. UMnuz Jackson Rooimes owenza izicathulo, azikhande aphinde adayise nezintsha, uthe ulahlekelwe yimpahla kaR80 000 ngoba ubesanda kuthenga impahla yenyanga futhi kunezicathulo zabantu ezibizayo abezozilungisa kodwa ezishile. Kuyimanje angazi ukuthi ngizothathani ngiyihlanganise nani ngoba abantu bazozifuna izicathulo zabo,” kusho uRooimes. Uthe unezingane ezine azondla ngokudayisa emgwaqweni njengoba eyokugcina ineminyaka emibili. Ucele uMasipala weTheku ukuthi ubanxephezele ngoba abanawo umshwalense wosomabhizinisi kwazise basebenzela ukuxosha ikati eziko. Uveze ukuthi ngesonto ubekhokha uR70 ukugcina impahla yakhe kule ndawo eshile bese eba nephemithi kaR139 yezinyanga ezintathu. Uthe kushe amaveji, inyama, iziphuzo, izinkukhu, izingubo zokugqoka nokunye. Yonke into ishe yaba amalahle, ” kusho uNkk Brauteseth. UCaptain Nqobile Gwala wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uthe ukhona umlilo oshise impahla yabadayisi basemgwaqweni, akekho olimele. ISITHOMBE: SIBUSISO NDLOVU/ANA KUTHIWA ubesephila ngokucasha ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa owesifazane waseNanda okusolwa ukuthi ubulawe obeyisoka lakhe elizinikele emaphoyiseni. Usathuthumela umndeni kaNksz Thandazile Hlengwa (40) waseCongo, eNanda, isidumbu sakhe esitholakale namanxeba okugwazwa ngaphansi kombhede ngeSonto. Umufi kuthiwa ubeqashe kwaSkhokhokho khona eNanda okuyilapho ebulawe khona. Umfowabo uMnuz Sipho Njapha, uthe umufi ubengasahlali emqashweni ngoba ebalekela umsolwa athandana naye ngo-2015. “Bese kuhlala amadodana yakhe emqashweni ngenxa yokubalekela umsolwa. Ngesikhathi besathandana umsolwa nguye obevakasha emqashweni. Besazi ukuthi sebenezinyanga ezine behlukene ngoba umsolwa ubemhlukumeza,” kusho uNjapha. Uthe umsolwa ubenodlame emshaya umufi, asabise nangokubulala amadodana akhe aneminyaka engu-15 no-13. UNjapha uthe umufi waqala kubo eCongo ngoMgqibelo ezobona unina ngaphambi kokudlulela emqashweni wakhe. “Ubebuyele ukuzothengela izingane ukudla emqashweni, akhokhe nerenti. Wayezofika alale emqashweni bese eya esontweni ngakusasa,” kusho uNjapha. Umndeni kamufi uthe washayelwa ucingo yindodana endala kamufi nomakhelwane, ibika ngesigameko. UNksz Sphiwe Cele owafika endaweni yesigameko uthe bangena nomakhelwane namadodana kamufi. “Umbhede ubuphakanyisiwe isidumbu singaphansi kwawo sambozwa ngeshidi elimhlophe. Besinenxeba lokugwazwa esiswini nasentanyeni. Sisola ukuthi umsolwa waqale wamdlwengula usisi ngoba iphenti belehlile engagqokile,” kusho UNksz Cele. UNKSZ Sphiwe Cele noMnuz Sipho Njapha umndeni kaNksz Thandazile Hlengwa okusolwa ukuthi ubulawe isoka lakhe lamfihla ngaphansi kombhede. ESIKHATHINI sanamhlanje ukhwantalala (depression) lubalwa phambili ohlwini lwezinto ezikhungethe abantu. Kubantu bohlanga lesi yisifo esiguqula imizwa yakho ngokushesha, nendlela ocabanga ngayo ngempilo, sifana nesisha njengoba abaningi besazifundisa ngaso. Enye yemibuzo evame ukubuzwa abantu abaningi ukuthi umnakekela kanjani umuntu onokhwantalala. Ongoti baveza ukuthi kunzima ukwazi ukuthi ungamlekelela kanjani umuntu ophethwe yilesi sifo nokuthi umeseka kanjani. Uma ungazi ukuthi wenze njani ngomuntu onalesi sifo, nanka amathiphu angakusiza unakekekele umuntu onokhwantalala. Ungakhohlwa ukuzinakekela nawe. - - Uma ungenaso isiqiniseko ngokuthi silwane sini ukhwantalala, kuhle ukuthi uzifundise. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukuthi uqonde kangcono ukuthi umngani noma isihlobo sakho sidlula esimweni esinjani. - Uma ophethwe wukhwantalala edinga umuntu angakhuluma naye, muphe indlebe uzame ukuthola ukuthi uzizwa kanjani. Ungambuza ukuthi yini ongayenza ukumsiza. Uma kunodaba olubucayi ofisa ukubhunga ngalo nomuntu onokhwantalala, kuhle ukhethe isikhathi nendawo lapho bekhululeke khona. Uma enengekile noma ecasukile kungcono ungaluphathi lolu daba kuze kube umoya wabo sewehlile. - Uma umuntu enezimpawu zokhwantalala akukho lula ukuthi avele akhohlwe adlula kukho, noma ukuvele ajabule esithubeni. Uma ukhuluma naye kumele umkhumbuze ukuthi ukhona futhi uzomseka uma ekudinga. Lokho kwenza kube lula kubo ukuthi bavule izifuba zabo kuwe futhi kubenza babone ukuthi uqinisile uma uthi ukuthathela phezulu abadlula kukho. - Uma umngani wakho onokhwantalala esembonile udokotela noma oweluleka ngokomqondo kuhle kakhulu lokho. Ungabeseka ngokubazisa ngolunye usizo abangaluthola njengezinombolo abangazishayela ezimweni eziphuthuymayo. Ikhona nenhlangano elekelela abantu abaphethwe yilesi sifo, iDepression and Anxtiey Group etholakala ku-0800 12 13 14, kanti izingcingo zakhona zihlezi zivuliwe. Ungavakashela ne-website yabo ku: www.sadag.co.za - Akukho lula ukuthi uhlale useduzane nawo wonke umuntu kodwa uma unomngani onalesi sifo, kuhle ukuthi utholakale kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho uma usola ukuthi kunesimo esiphuthumayo akuso, kuhle ube nezinombolo zabantu ongabathinta abangaba seduzane naye. - Kubuye kube nzima futhi kukhandlane ukunakekela umuntu onokhwantalala. Ungakwazi ukumsiza kuphela uma nawe uzinakekela. Qinisekisa ukuthi usaqhubeka nokwenza izinto ezikujabulisayo nokuthi usasithola isikhathi esanele sokuphumula. Cela usizo kwabanye abazimisele ukungenelela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele umazise ophethwe yilesi sifo ukuthi ngeke ukwazi ukumenzela konke, umazise ongamsiza ngakho. - www.reachout.com
ABASEBENZI baseDurban University of Technology (DUT) abatelekele ukwenyuselwa umholo emasontweni amabili edlule Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO ABASEBENZI baseDurban University of Technology (DUT) abatelekele ukwenyuselwa umholo emasontweni amabili edlule Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO INYUNYANA iNational Education, Health and Allied Workers’ Union (Nehawu), ithi zisaqhubeka iziteleka emanyuvesi ahlukene kuleli, ezinye eziqale ngeledlule. INehawu ithumele isitatimende kwabezindaba izolo icacisa ngokwenzeka e-Unisa, DUT, Wits nase-University of Pretoria. Esitatimende kuthiwa abasebenzi base-Unisa abangaphansi kwale nyunyana abasebenzi kuzo zonke izikhungo zenyuvesi kuleli. Lokhu kudalwe ukuthi abaphathi benyuvesi banqume ukuhoxa ezingxoxweni baya enkantolo yabasebenzi ngoba befuna ukuthi isiteleka esiqale ngeledlule sithathwe njengesingekho emthethweni kodwa bahluleka. Isitatimende siveza ukuthi izimfuno zisamile njengoba befuna ukunyuselwa umholo ngo-10% kuzo zonke izigaba. Bafuna kuqashwe ngokugcwele abasebenzi betoho abasemkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe okuthiwa sebebe yitoho iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-15. Le nyunyana ithi i-Unisa icabanga ukuthi ingaphezulu komthetho njengoba ingafuni ukuhlonipha iLabour Relations Act ngokuthi ibaqashe ngokugcwele yize benazo iziqu. Le nyunyana isicele iCCMA ukuthi izame ukulekelela izinhlaka ezithintekayo ukuthi zifinyelele esivumelwaneni ukuze kuqhubeke ukubhaliswa kwabafundi. Inyunyana inxuse amalungu ayo ukuthi angadidiseki, akaqhubeke nesiteleka kuze kube izimfuno zawo ziyabhekelwa. E-DUT nakhona le nyunyana ithe sisazoqhubeka isiteleka kuzo zonke izikhungo njengoba kungakafinyelelwa esivumelwaneni. Le nyunyana isikhabe ngazo zombili isiphakamiso somqashi sika-6%. Isamile ekutheni ifuna kunyuswe ngo-10%, kunyuswe nomhlomulo wezindlu ngoR400 nebhonasi kaR9 000. EWits le nyunyana iqale emasontweni amabili ukuthi njalo ngesikhathi sesidlo sasemini kube nombhikisho ngoba ifuna umqashi ukuthi abuyele etafuleni lezingxoxo. Le nyunyana ithe lesi siteleka sizoba sikhulu namuhla. Ifuna umqashi anyuse umholo ngo 8%, imali ye-medical aid ngo-1%, ukubuyiswa kwemihlomulo yemali kulabo asebesebenze isikhathi eside. Inyunyana ithi abasebenzi base-University of Pretoria bafuna ukunyuselwa umholo ngo-9.5% kanti umqashi uthi uno-6%.
AMALUNGU e-ANC ahambisana nohlangothi lukaMnuz Senzo Mchunu abebhikisha ngaphandle kwamahhovisi enhlangano esifundazwe, ekhala ngokuthi isigungu sesikhashana esihola iKZN sicheme nohlangothi lukaMnuz Sihle Zikalala AMALUNGU e-ANC ahambisana nohlangothi lukaMnuz Senzo Mchunu abebhikisha ngaphandle kwamahhovisi enhlangano esifundazwe, ekhala ngokuthi isigungu sesikhashana esihola iKZN sicheme nohlangothi lukaMnuz Sihle Zikalala SEKUBHEKWE isigungu esiphezulu se-ANC ukuba sinqume ngekusasa lesigungu sesikhashana esihola inhlangano esifundazweni ngemuva kokuqubuka kwezikhalo. Kukhona abathi asihlakazwe. Izolo amalungu e-ANC aseka uMnuz Senzo Mchunu abebhikisha ngaphandle kwamahhovisi ale nhlangano eThekwini efuna kuhlakazwe isigungu sesikhashana esiholwa uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu noMnuz Sihle Zikalala, ekhala ngokuthi sicheme nohlangothi lukaZikalala. Awu-12, amalungu esigungu sikaZikalala asesigungwini sesikhashana ekubeni mane kuphela avela ohlangothini lukaMchunu, ohambisana noMabuyakhulu. Ngesikhathi abalandeli bakaMchunu bebhikisha, amaphoyisa abesiqaphe ngelokhozi isimo. Ababhikishi bebecula izingoma ezeseka uMengameli we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa noMchunu. Bebecula izingoma ezizwakalisa ukungamfuni uNobhala-jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Ace Magashule, bemchapha nangenhlamba. Omunye wabebehola abebebhikisha, uMnuz Mthunzi Dlamini uthe bazokwethula izikhalo zabo ebuholini benhlangano. Uthe kukhona ukungeneliseki ngokubunjwa kwesigungu sesikhashana. “Ubuholi bukazwelonke buyazi ngezikhalo zethu. Siyathemba ukuthi buzozisukumela,” kusho uDlamini. UDlamini ube nomhlangano noMabuyakhulu noZikalala. Esithangamini nabezindaba izolo uMabuyakhulu uthe bayazi ngezikhalo, ubuholi obuphezulu buzozisebenza. UMabuyakhulu uxwayise amalungu ukuthi ayeke ukwenza izinto ezidala ukuthi kube noqhekeko enhlanganweni. “Umbutho usesikhathini lapho uzama ukuzivuselela khona, uzama nokudala ubumbano. Siyakukhuza ukuthi amalungu enze izinto ezingenza ukuthi iphupho lokubumba inhlangano ligcine lingafezekanga,” kusho uMabuyakhulu. Uthe uRamaphosa akayena umengameli wohlangothi oluthile kodwa ungumengameli we-ANC yonke. UZikalala uthe bahlanganile namaqabane abhikishayo, akuveza ukuthi umbhikisho wawo awuqondene ne-ANC esifundazweni kodwa ubhekiswe ebuholi benhlangano kuzwelonke. “La maqabane abhikishayo aphinde aveza nokuthi awakholwa ukuthi ingqungquthela yesifundazwe izokwazi ukuhlala ezinyangeni ezintathu njengoba kusho ubuholi bukazwelonke,” kusho uZikalala. Imizamo yokuthola okhulumela i-ANC kuzwelonke, uNkk Khusela Diko ayiphumelelanga. Ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa nomyalezo athunyelelwe wona kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela engakawuphenduli. UMagashule ekhuluma emgubhweni weminyaka engu-106 kwabunjwa i-ANC, eMgungundlovu ngeSonto, uthe ithimba lesikhashana balikhethe bangabheka ukuthi ngubani oweseka bani. Uthe inhloso yalo wukubumba amagatsha, kube nengqungquthela ngo-Ephreli nonyaka. Uqhube wathi akazange alikhethe eyedwa leli thimba lesifundazwe kodwa lakhethwa wubuholi obuphezulu be-ANC ngokuhlanganyela. UMagashule uthe ngeke asishiye isikhundla sakhe ngoba uyazi kukhona abamzamayo.
Isithombe esigciniwe Isithombe esigciniwe MHLELI: Ngingathokoza uma ungangipha isiqeshana kwelakho kuyinyanga yamadoda nami ngiveze umbono wami noma ulwazi ngendoda ukuthi iyini. Okokuqala indoda iyanakekela inothando. Indoda yilo muntu ozobeka umndeni wakhe phambili, yilo muntu ozothanda umkakhe noma lo athandana naye nezingane. Indoda iyahlonipheka konke ekwenzayo emphakathini akuhlambalazi. Indoda ayigqoki izicathulo ishintshe amapheya angafani ekubeni izingane ekhaya zifunda zingenazicathulo kwezinye izicathulo zitshekile izimpahla zigugile, ifunwa imali yesondlo sezingane ngenkani, cha akuyona indoda leyo wumfana nje osakhula. Asingabi ngamadoda ngemikhaba, izimpandla nezintshebe kepha emindenini siyasatshwa ngoba siphenduka izilwane. Izwe lidunguzela kanjena nje yingoba sekukhona abantu abathi bangamadoda ngoba bangolizwi aliphikiswa yingakho kunje, yingakho sesikwazi ukulala nabantwana bethu, yingakho sesikwazi ukushaya abazali bethu sibabulale, sihlukumeza esithi siyabathanda. Sisebenzisa igama lendoda kabi. Mpha Omnyama Shabalala EMNAMBITHI
ISIDUMBU sikaMnuz Sdu Sithole okusoleka ukuthi akuyena owakuleli uzisakaze ngenhlamvu kwaV eMlaza emarobhothini Isithombe: SIBUSISO NDLOVU ISIDUMBU sikaMnuz Sdu Sithole okusoleka ukuthi akuyena owakuleli uzisakaze ngenhlamvu kwaV eMlaza emarobhothini Isithombe: SIBUSISO NDLOVU INDODA okusolwa ukuthi ibidle izidakamizwa ivulele ngenhlamvu esidlangaleni kunabantu ebebezihambela emarobhothini kwaV, eMlaza, maqede yabhekisa isibhamu kuyo yazidubula yafa izolo. Indoda, eyaziwa ngokuthi ingumakhi wezindlu odabuka kwelinye lamazwe ase-Afrika, kuthiwa inguMnuz Sdu Sithole. Imangaze abaningi ngesikhathi imisa imoto erobhothini kwaV, yaphuma yavulela inhlamvu esidlangaleni, kungaziwa ukuthi idubula bani. Kuthiwa kukhale ubumayemaye abantu bebaleka nxazonke. Kuthiwa ibonakale sengathi iyakujabulela lokhu ngesikhathi ikwenza ngoba ibigibele okhakhayini lwemoto. Ibidubula ibuye igxumele phansi idubule iyizungeze imoto. Kuthe kusenjalo kwaqhamuka amaphoyisa, athe engakafiki nakuyo yabhekisa isibhamu kuyo yazidubula yashonela khona lapho. Omunye ozibonele lokhu kwenzeka kodwa ongathandanga ukuthi igama lakhe lidalulwe, uthe uSithole ubengapheli kwaV futhi uyaziwa khona. Ubejwayele ukuhamba nabantu abakha izindlu emotweni yakhe. “Uyaziwa kule ndawo yize ngingamazi ukuthi uhlala kuphi. Ngiyacabanga ukuthi uhlala khona kwaV, siyazi nokuthi uyaphuza futhi ubuye asebenzise nezidakamizwa kodwa bekungakaze kwenzeke ukuthi akhiphe isibhamu. Bekungathi sibuka ifilimu, angazi noma kukhona yini abekusho ngoba sonke bese sicashile sesaba ukudubuleka. Ngiyasola ukuthi ubedle izidakamizwa, akekho umuntu obengenza le nto edakwe wutshwala kuphela. Ucishe walimaza abantu ngoba le ndawo iyaphithizela,” kusho yena. Kunenqwaba yezitolo, kuphinde kume namatekisi nabantu abanamatafula abadayisayo kuleli robhothi. Kuhlale kuphithizela kulo njengoba uma ungena noma uphuma eMlaza udlula kulona. Ngesikhathi ithimba leSolezwe lifika endaweni izihlobo zikamufi bezidangele, zime eduze kwesidumbu sakhe zisalinde ukuthi sithathwe yimoto ethatha izidumbu. Imoto yakhe iCiti Golf emhlophe ibimi erobhothini emgwaqweni oqhamuka eSiphingo obheke ngakwa E,F&G, isidumbu sakhe siseduze kwayo. Akekho obekhuluma nomunye kulamalungu omndeni bonke bebegobodisile bebheke isidumbu sakhe. Kulezi zihlobo akekho ovume ukukhuluma nabezindaba, zithe kuningi okushayisanayo abezwa kuthiwa kwenzekile, okwamanje kazikazi ukuthi kwenzekeni. Akekho kuzo obefuna ukuzisho ukuthi ungubani. “Sisenezinhliziyo ezibuhlungu, ngeke sikhulume okwamanje ,” esho ehamba. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, ukuqinisekisile okwenzeile wathi indoda yangaphandle kwaleli okuthiwa ibidakiwe, izidubule ngesibhamu sayo yafela emgaqweni. “Kuvulwe idokodo mayelana nokufa kwendoda esiteshini samaphoyisa eMlaza. Ngesikhathi edubula akekho olimele,” kusho uZwane.

UKing Prophet Sazi Ndwandwe Isithombe: KING PROPHET FACEBOOK UKing Prophet Sazi Ndwandwe Isithombe: KING PROPHET FACEBOOK WETHUSE abaningi umfundisi webandla labasindisiwe evuma emsakazweni Ukhozi FM ukuthi unoxhaxha lwezintombi ngaphakathi ebandleni. Unamakhosikazi amabili futhi kulezi zintombi ezikhona, uhlela ukukhetha ezintathu azozishada ngo-Okthoba kulo nyaka. Lo mfundisi odume ngelika King Prophet Sazi Ndwandwe webandla iHealing Hour Emmanuel Global Ministries, ingxoxo yakhe nomsakazi walo msakazo, uNomfundo Mkhize, isisabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kanti abantu abawuvali umlomo, ngisho abangabazalwane baleli bandla. Leli bandla linamagatsha amaningi KwaZulu-Natal okubalwa kuwo KwaNongoma, eThekwini, Mtubatuba, oLundi, Ophongolo naseMnambithi. Ekhuluma neSolezwe ngoMgqibelo, uNdwandwe uzwakale emangala ngabanenkinga ngendlela aziphatha ngayo. Uma ngibagcina bazoqhubeka nokuthintwa ngabanye abafana ngasese.” Echaza ukuthi kungani enesithembu futhi ehlobonga nabanye abantu besifazane ekubeni engumfundisi osindisiwe, uNdwandwe uthe yena akafuni ukuphila impilo yamanga njengabanye abefundisi. “Mina ngiyindoda yomZulu. Abanye bakholelwa ukuthi uNkulunkulu okupha umfazi, mina ngineso lokubona umfazi wami. “Izishimane ezithi ziyaboniswa. Yizo lezi ezijola emakhoneni, zilalane bese kukhishwa nezisu. Mina ngiyinsizwa yomZulu esakhuzela uma ibona intombi eyithandayo.” Uthe nasemandulo kunamadoda kaNkulunkulu ayenenqwaba yezancinza. “Mina angiholwa yizwi kodwa ngilandela umgomo wakwaNdwandwe. Mina nganikezwa izwe kwathiwa angibuse kulo.” UNdwandwe uthe iningi labazalwane liyamjabulela ngoba wenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabo. Kodwa ngesikhathi leli phephandaba likhuluma namanye amalungu aleli bandla, asho okwehlukile. “Abanye bethu abaneme neze ngoba sikhonza namadodakazi ethu. Njengoba siyibandla labasindisiwe nje, akuzwakali kahle ukuthi umfundisi wethu unesithembu futhi aphinde abe noxhaxha lwezintombi.” Ukuthola ukuphawula kwamakhosikazi kaNdwandwe kugcine kungaphumelelanga.
YIZIMO ezithi azifane nalesi ezike zibonakale entsheni ecwile ezinkambeni zikaFaro nokuyingozi empilweni yomuntu osemusha. Muva nje ucwaningo olusanda kwenziwa lukhombe intsha njengephuza yeqise otshwaleni YIZIMO ezithi azifane nalesi ezike zibonakale entsheni ecwile ezinkambeni zikaFaro nokuyingozi empilweni yomuntu osemusha. Muva nje ucwaningo olusanda kwenziwa lukhombe intsha njengephuza yeqise otshwaleni NJENGOBA uJuni uhlonzwa njengenyanga yentsha, sekuvele izibalo ezishaqisayo zentsha yaseNingizimu Afrika yesilisa emnyama okuthiwa iqengqeleza phambili ngokucwila ezinkambeni zikaFaro. Ngo-1976 intsha yakuleli yayilwa namaBhunu ifuna ukuqedwa kokufunda ngesibhunu zonke izifundo, kodwa eyanamuhla enye yayo ingene shi kwizidakamizwa. Ucwaningo olwenziwe ngabomkhankaso oqwashisa ngokucwila otshwalweni i-Aware Organisation. Lolu cwaningo luveza isithombe sokuthi lapha eNingizimu Afrika kuthengwa utshwala buka-R3.8 billion ngonyaka. Kubantu bakuleli balinganiselwa ku-60% abaphuza utshwala kanti kubona bangu-34% abaphuza ngokweqile. Kulesi sibalo isilinganiso sekota ngabesilisa abamnyama abaneminyaka eqala ku-24 kuya ku-35 abazithola becwile kubona ngendlela exakile. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi iningi lentsha yakuleli kuthi ineminyaka engu-12 isuke isilingeka ifise ukuzwa ukuthi utshwala bunambitheka kanjani. Enye iyadikila ingaphide ibuthinte ngenxa yokungathatheki kodwa enye iyabuyela kubona igcine isibujwayele. Ngeshwa enye iyedlulela igcine isiyimulutha yotshwala. Le ntsha isuke inezizathu ezahlukene ezisuke siyiholele kulo mbulalazwe. Phakathi kwezizathu ezibaliwe ezidoba intsha wukuthi iningi layo isuke isiphothule isikole, isanda kuqala umsebenzi futhi isizithathela izinqumo ngemali yayo. Kulapho kwabanye kuqala kube nengcindezi yokufuna ukubukwa, ukudlisela kontanga nakwabobulili obehlukile. Enye intsha ibulawa amahloni, ukuze iwaqede isebenzisa utshwala bese bekwazi ukukhuluma babe nesibindi noma benze okuthile abasuke behlukela ukukwenza bengaphuzile. Ukuhlanganyela nabangani nemindeni emicimbini, nakho kuyabahlohla abanye ukuba bagcine bekhothakhothile kwezikaFaro ngenxa yokungafuni ukusala ezintweni. Inkinga iba lapho uma abanye sebephenduka izigqila zotshwala. Izinqumo nezibopho abanazo empilweni zigcine sezithikamezwa wukuphuza kakhulu. Lapha singabala ukuthi umuntu akhohlwe yinto asuke eyikhulumile, wukuvuka sekudlule isikhathi, wukudala umonakalo njengokushayela ephuzile noma ukuba nenkani angalawuleki. Ngalezi zizathu kuphela imisebenzi, kuchitheka imishado nothando kwabanye ababe besahlonishwa kuphele nokwethenjwa. Kuzona singabala ukuwa nokuhluleka wukuhamba uqonde okungaholela ekulimaleni nokufa imbala. Utshwala obuningi emzimbeni womuntu kungadala ukuthi inhliziyo ime noma umuntu akhingcwe ngumphalazo wakhe ashone. Ukuphuza ngokweqile entsheni kuphinde kusolwe ngokwanda kwezigameko zokuzibulala uma inengcindezi empilweni yayo. Ukuphuza kakhulu kungagcina omunye umuntu esehanjelwa wumqondo nokungadala umonakalo emqondweni, omunye agule ngekhanda. Kwabesifazane abakhulelwe utshwala bulimaza ingane ibe nesifo iFetal Alcohol Syndrome esuke isakhula kuyena. Ucwaningo olwenziwe yi-University of Cape Town ngo-2014 kuya ku-2015 bulinganiselwa ku-4.8 billion utshwala obuthengiwe. Isikhulu esiphezulu kwi-Aware * -Ingrid Louw uthe kubalulekile ukuthi intsha yazi kabanzi ngobungozi botshwala obuphuzwa kakhulu. “Bakhona abantu abaphuzayo kodwa ngendlela ehlelekile nengenabo ubungozi, bese kuba khona labo abacwilile,” usho kanje. Uthe kulabo abacwilayo kubona, kubalulekile ukubazisa ngobungozi obunabo empilweni yabo nakweyabanye abantu. “Ucwaningo lwethu luveze ukuthi abantu bakuleli abasethuki uma bebona izimoto zishayisana kade zigijima ngesivinini esiphezulu nasekuboneni izidumbu zindiza ngenxa yengozi lapho kusuke kudalwe wukushayela imoto komuntu ephuzile. Akukuhle lokhu. Kusitshela ukuthi kukhona lapho singenzi kahle khona, yingakho sizozama ukulungisa isimo ngemikhankaso yethu,” usho kanje. Lo mkhankaso wokuqwashisa ngobubi bokuphuza ngokweqile, unethemba lokuthi uma kungasetshenzwa kubanjiswane kungaphela ukubikwa ngezingozi zemigwaqo ezidalwa abashayela bephuzile, ukuphuza kwezingane nezinye izinto ezimbi ezidalwa wutshwala. Ezinye zezizathu ezoholela entsheni ukuthi iphuze: Ukubona abanye abantu bephuza Ukufoma nokufuna ukuzilawula Ukufuna ukuzama izinto ezintsha empilweni ezizokwenza umuntu avelele Ukungazethembi Ukuhehwa okungelona iqiniso njengezinhlelo zethelevishini nezikhangiso.
