ISIDUMBU sikaMnuz Sdu Sithole okusoleka ukuthi akuyena owakuleli uzisakaze ngenhlamvu kwaV eMlaza emarobhothini Isithombe: SIBUSISO NDLOVU ISIDUMBU sikaMnuz Sdu Sithole okusoleka ukuthi akuyena owakuleli uzisakaze ngenhlamvu kwaV eMlaza emarobhothini Isithombe: SIBUSISO NDLOVU LUSEYINDIDA udaba lowesilisa ongumakhi ozingqokloze ngesibhamu phambi komphakathi emarobhothini kwaV, eMlaza ngeSonto, okusolwa ukuthi ubexabene nowesifazane okuthiwa ubesebenzisana naye obemkweleta imali eningi. UMnuz Sdu Sithole odabuka eMozambique kuvele ukuthi ngaphambi kokuzisakaza ngesibhamu ubhale kuWhatsApp wakhe exolisa kubangani ngokudubula abulale owesifazane othile. Komunye umbhalo wakhe ubethi isibhamu ubengasithengelanga ukubulala owesifazane kodwa ubenzela ukuzigada. Uqhuba athi akazi ukuthi ubengenwe yini kodwa uzozinikela emaphoyiseni. Akubhalile kusabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kodwa umndeni wakhe uthi awazi lutho ngomuntu abexabene naye nokuthi kukhona nomuntu ambulele. Umfowabo, uMnuz Carlos Sithole oficwe yiphephandaba emzini abebehlala kuwo oseMonkey Town, kwaV khona eMlaza, uthe akazi lutho ngalezi zinsolo futhi akazange azibone. Akakwazanga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isithombe esikuWhatsApp okubhalwe kuwo uke wazibona yini zifakwe umfowabo yize ethe iselula kamufi ikhona endlini futhi uke wayibheka efuna ukubona ukuthi ukhona yini abexabene naye. “Besijwayele ukusebenzisana uma enomsebenzi omkhulu, eminye besiyenza ngokwehlukana. Sijwayele ukuthi kube nabantu abasikweleta imali kodwa angazi ukuthi kunowesifazane obemkweleta imali eningi lo okuthiwa umbulele. Besingakezwa lutho nasemaphoyiseni olumhlanganisa nokubulala,” kusho yena. Ngakolunye uhlangothi uNksz Mbali Dlamini, unina wengane kamufi, uthe uyazi ukuthi kunowesifazane waseMgungundlovu obekweleta isoka lakhe imali elinganiselwa kuR60 000 futhi bese kunesikhathi beyibanga le mali. “Ngokwazi kwami owesifazane wambiza ngoMgqibelo emthembisa ukumkhokhela imali yakhe kodwa wamnika uR20 000 baxabana. Umufi ubengeyena umuntu wodlame futhi ubesho ukuthi uyazisola ngakwenzile. Okwamanje angikho esimeni sokuthi ngichaze izinto eziningi ngalolu daba,” esho evala ucingo. Ephinda eshayelwa ucingo uthe akakwazi ukukhuluma ngalolu daba ngoba akakakulungeli ukukhuluma ngalo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, Lt Col Thulani Zwane, uthe abanalwazi lokuthi kunezinsolo zokuthi umufi ubulele wathi kodwa uphenyo olwenziwa ngamaphoyisa aseMlaza yilona oluzocacisa yonke imininingwane.
Ziningi izinhlobo zamakhanda abuhlungu kakhulu ezikhona kodwa namhlanje sizothi qaphu qaphu ngambalwa kulawo anomgudu othile olandelekayo uma ekuhlasela. Ubuchopho abukwazi ukuzwela ubuhlungu ngoba abunazo izinsiza zokubuzwela. Ebuchosheni kunenqwaba yemithambo nemizwa futhi zikhona nezicubu ezizungeze intamo nobuso konke lokhu kuyakwazi ukuzwela ubuhlungu. Ubuhlungu obuzwelwa yilezi zingxenye bugcina buzwele okungathi ubuhlungu osebusuka ebuchosheni uqobo ngenxa yokuthungelana kwemizwa. Namhlanje ngikhethe ukukhuluma ngamakhanda ambalwa alandela imigujwana ejwayelekile. Kunamakhanda anomkhuba wokuqala ukuhlasela emini yasekuseni okanye njalo ntambama. Kuphinde kube namakhanda aqala njalo ebusuku, ngesikhathi cishe esisodwa, ikhanda elikuvusa njalo ngezinhlungu. Kunamakhanda ankenketha uma uya ocansini, avele abhebhetheke kakhulu uma ufika kuvuthondaba. Angikwazi ukushiya ikhanda elibamba lisonte uhlangothi oluthile lobuso, elifika ngezikhawu linkenkethele ukuthi hayiza. Ngikhethe ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinhlobo, sike siziyeke lezi ezinye esizijwayele ngoba sesike sakhuluma nzulu ngazo phambili. Ayikho indlela yokulapha ikhanda ngaphandle kokuthola imbangela yalo bese ulapha yona. Kuba nzima kakhulu uma uthi uya kumsizi wezempilo bese ekutshela ukuthi akasazi isizathu sokuthi ube nezinhlungu ezingaka zekhanda, ube wena ufa ungalali ukuqaqanjelwa. Ekugcineni bazokunikeza okokuthomolalisa izinhlungu uma bengashongo ukuthi hamba uyobona nodokotela woluleko lwezengqondo. Akukho okubi ngokuthi udokotela wakho akuse olulekweni lwezengqondo uma isimo sisho njalo. Engikushoyo ukuthi lokhu makwenzeke sekuhlolwe ngokwanele kufunwa isizathu esiwumsusa wekhanda. Akekho umuntu ongenayo ingcindezi yomqondo kodwa akusiyena wonke umuntu le ngcindezi emphathisa ngekhanda elingalawuleki. Kungumsebenzi kadokotela ukuphanda isizathu esiwumsusa walezi zinhlungu. Abantu bakithi bakhathele ukuzibona bethalaliswa, benyanyalatwa. Ikhanda eliqala emini yasekuseni nantambama Kunamakhanda abangelwa ukushintsha kwamakhemikhali agcwalelene egazini. Isibonelo salapha yikhanda elidalwa utshwala. Ikhemikhali ewutshwala ingena ithontelane egazini bese ichamsela izinhlotshana zamanye amakhemikhali athi angafinyelela ezingeni elithile bese edala ikhanda elibihlungu. Nendlala (ithyroid evuvukele) njengoba yenza ukuthi umzimba usebenze ngokweqile nje lokhu kufukamela kuchumisa amakhemikhali amaningi egazini. Lolu chungechunge lokufukamela kuchamiselwe kuzokwenza izicutshana zemithambo nemizwa kuqale ukusonteka, kugxumagxume, kugcine kwenze ikhanda elibuhlungu. Yingakho izinhlungu zekhanda zalapha ezingaba ngaphambili ekhanda, ngemuva okanye emaceleni ekhanda kwabanye zenza okusankwatshu ekhanda okuba buhlungu kungabekezeleleki. Abanye baze bathi kungathi ushaywa unhlangothi. Leli khanda lizwela kancane emishanguzweni yezinhlungu, uyiphuza uze ukhathale. Isikhathi esiningi ezigulini esizibonayo, imbangela nomsusa wale nhlobo yekhanda, yindlala esuke ivuvukele. Kubalulekile ukuthi omuntu okhala ngaleli khanda, ahlolelwe kubhekwe ukuthi indlala kayivuvukele na, bese kuthi uma kunjalo lowo othintekayo aqale amaphilisi aqondene nalowo msuka. Okunye okumele sikukhumbule ukuthi indlala egula ngale ndlela kuningi engakona ngaphakathi emzimbeni, kugcine ukugula kwakho sekunompele ezindaweni eziningi. Ikhanda eliqala njalo ebusuku Kunenhlobo yekhanda, ubuhlungu balo buqala njalo ebusuku ngesikhathi esisodwa. Leli lona livamise kubantu asebethe ukukhula ngeminyaka ikakhulu. Ubuhlungu bekhanda buvela ebusuku ngesikhathi esisodwa njalo, uvuka nje wena ngaleli khanda eselibuhlungu. Le nhlobo yekhanda ibuya iphindelela, kokunye ize ibalelwe ezikhawini ezingaphezu kuka-10 ngenyanga. Ikhanda locansi Kukhona abantu abaphathwa yikhanda elibuhlungu, libe yinto ekusheshisayo uma uya ocansini, izinhlungu lezi ziya phambili uma ufika kuvuthondaba. Kucatshangelwa ukuthi leli khanda lidalwa ukwehla kwegazi eliya ebuchosheni ngoba phela wena isigubhukane nje usuthe emzimbeni wakho igazi ulidinga kakhulu emazansi nomzimba. Akuyena uwonkewonke oba nalesi simo ocansini. Ubuhlungu obusanyazi esayidini lobuso Kukhona ubuhlungu okuvele kunyazime isayidi lobuso kube sengathi uyashokheka ohlangothini. Iminjunju lena ilandela umuzwa omkhulu olapha ebusweni, kuhlanganisa isimongo nezinhlafuno. Lokhu kuhlaseleka kwalo muzwa kunezikhawu ngezikhawu. Okubalulekile ngazo zonke lezi zinhlotshana zamakhanda ukuthi ziyelapheka. Kumqoka ukuthola isiphethu esiwumsusa bese kulashwe kuliwe nalo mbaseli. Mpilonde!
SEKUQINISWE ezokuphepha kwezePhini likaMengameli weNatu uMnuz Allen Thompson osinde esocongwa ngoLwesihlanu eMhlanga eThekwini Isithombe: MOTSHWARI MOFOKENG SEKUQINISWE ezokuphepha kwezePhini likaMengameli weNatu uMnuz Allen Thompson osinde esocongwa ngoLwesihlanu eMhlanga eThekwini Isithombe: MOTSHWARI MOFOKENG KUQINISWE ezokuphepha zePhini likaMengameli weNatu, uMnuz Allen Thompson, osinde ngokulambisa edutshulwa abesilisa abebehlomile, abashaqe zonke izikhwama zakhe zama-laptop ebezinemiqingo ebalulekile eminye okungeyophenyo oluqhubekayo oluthinta uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal. UThompson ujahwe waze wafika esibhedlela yiBMW emhlophe ebihamba abesilisa abebezifihle ubuso befake nama-gloves ngoLwesihlanu ntambama eMhlanga, eThekwini. UMengameli weNatu uMnuz Siphosethu Ngcobo, uthe baziqinisile ezokuphepha zikaThompson. “Ethanda noma engathandi ngisithathile isinqumo sokuthi ngiqinise ezokuphepha kwakhe. Uma kunje kudingeka ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi uphephile. Yitulo ebelihleliwe leli, asingabazi ngalokho siyiNatu,” kusho uNgcobo. UNgcobo uthe i-video yasesibhedlela ikuveza konke okwenzeka bemjaha bemfaka ngaphakathi, baphuma bashaqa izikhwama emotweni yakhe. “Inhlamvu ibiya ekhanda ngoba ingene maqondana nalo. Sifuna amaphoyisa abambe abenzi bobubi, bagwetshwe. Ngeke sivume ukusatshiswa noma sithuliswe, sizoqhubeka nokulwa ukuze kuphele inkohlakalo,” kusho uNgcobo. Usho lokhu nje le nyunyana iseqhulwini lokufuna ukuthi umnyango wezemfundo esifundazweni ufakwe ngaphansi kokulawulwa ngumnyango wezemfundo kuzwelonke. Le nyunyana yakhala ngokunyuka kwemali eyabelwe uhlelo lwamaqakelo abafundi oseludle uR109 million lusuka kuR20 million onyakeni owodwa. Ingena ingenile imiyalezo yokukufisela ukululama kukaThompson njengoba i-ANC, IFP, NFP kanjalo neSadtu zithi zifuna amaphoyisa aphenye ngalesi sehlakalo. UMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uSihlalo wekomiti lesikhashana le-ANC esifundazweni, uphawule ngokuthi kule mpelasonto kube nezehlakalo zokudutshulwa kwabaholi okubalwa naye uThompson. USihlalo weNFP esifundazweni, uMnuz Vikizitha Mlotshwa, uthe bakhathazekile ngalesi sehlakalo wathi kuyacaca ukuthi yinto ebihleliwe. “Yinto ebihleliwe lena, yingakho sithi akube nophenyo olunzulu ngoba kuthathwe nemiqingo ebalulekile emotweni ethinta nendaba yenkohlakalo yamaqakelo abafundi nokungakhokhelwa kothisha bakwaGrade R,” kusho uMlotshwa. Uthe bafuna uNdunankulu amukele isicelo saleli qembu sokuthi kungenelele iSilo odabeni lokubulawa kwabaholi. UNkk Thembeni Madlopha-Mthethwa omele i-IFP kwezemfundo esiShayamthetho, uthe kumele kusheshiswe uphenyo ukuze kutholakale abathinteka kulesi sehlakalo. Uthe kushiya imibuzo eminingi ukudutshulwa kukaThompson njengoba ebeyingxenye yemashi ebisesiShayamthetho yokukhalaza ngezinkinga ezibhekene nomnyango futhi usekhaleni lokuthi umnyango ufakwe ngaphansi komlawuli. UNobhala jikelele weSadtu uMnuz Mugwena Maluleke, usigxekile lesi senzo wathi amaphoyisa kumele aphenye abambe abenzi bobubi. “Noma engelona ilungu lethu kodwa unathi emzabalazweni wokulwela othisha. INatu neSadtu ibhikishe ngaphandle kwesiShayamthetho bekhala ngothisha bakwaGrade R. Simfisela ukululama okusheshsayo.” Okhulumela amaphoyisa uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe kuphenywa icala lokubamba inkunzi nelokuzama ukubulala, akukaboshwa muntu.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho namaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube nozakwakhe ngesikhathi bekhuluma ngokutshalwa kwensangu eNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre, eThekwini, ngoLwesithathu. Isithombe: Sithunyelwe UNGQONGQOSHE wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho namaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube nozakwakhe ngesikhathi bekhuluma ngokutshalwa kwensangu eNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre, eThekwini, ngoLwesithathu. Isithombe: Sithunyelwe UMNYANGO wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho nobuHoli bezamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uthi usuzimisele ukwelekelela osomabhizinisi abasebancane abafuna ukwenza imikhiqizo yensangu kuleli. Lokhu kuvezwe ngungqongqoshe uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube ngesikhathi ekhuluma kwingqungquthela yensangu, iCannabis Investment Protocol, ebiseNkosi Albert Luthuli International Converntion Centre, eThekwini ngoLwesithathu. Ethula inkulumo yakhe phambi kwezihambeli zalo mcimbi uthe, ngesikhathi benesidlo sasekuseni iKZN Growth Coalition ngo-Agasti bahlongoza ukuthi bewuhulumeni bahlose ukulekelela abalimi abancane njengendlela yokulwa nokwentuleka kwemisebenzi. "Sikholelwa wukuthi, maningi amathuba okusebenzisa insangu ukuze ithuthukise imboni yezolimo neminye imikhakha. Imininingwane ekhona iveza ukuthi imboni yensangu ingenza inzuzo engu-R100 billion. I-United Nations ikholwa ngukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikhiqiza u-2,300 tons wensangu ngonyaka okuyenza ilale isithathu emazweni akhiqiza insangu eningi e-Afrika," kusho uDube-Ncube. Uthe iKwaZulu-Natal isona sifundazwe esisethubeni lokukhiqiza insangu eningi ngenxa yesimo sezulu kulesi sifundazwe esivuna ukukhula kwensangu kalula uma siqhathaniswa nezinye kanye namanye amazwe aphesheya, ikakhulukazi e-Europe. "Siwuhulumeni asifuni ukuthi bantu basemiphakathini yethu abebevele beyitshala insangu bavaleleke ngaphandle. Siwuhulumeni sizogxila ezindaweni ezisemakhaya ngoba zinomlando omude wokutshala nokusebenzisa insangu yize bebekwenza ngokungemthetho. Njengoba uhulumeni esevula amathuba, asifuni ukuthi abantu basale ngaphandle," kusho yena. Umnyango kaDube uphinde waveza ukuthi uyazi kunezinhlangano ezikhokhisa abantu ukuze zisabalalise ulwazi ngemboni yensangu. Uthe bewumnyango basazoqhubeka nezinhlelo zamahhala zokusabalalisa ulwazi ngale mboni.
OBEYILUNGU le-ANC ePhalamende uNkk Vytjie Mentor ngesikhathi efakaza kwikhomishini kaZondo. Isithombe: Nhlanhla Phillips/African News Agency (ANA) OBEYILUNGU le-ANC ePhalamende uNkk Vytjie Mentor ngesikhathi efakaza kwikhomishini kaZondo. Isithombe: Nhlanhla Phillips/African News Agency (ANA) OWAYEYILUNGU lePhalamende, uNkk Vytjie Mentor, izolo ubuze kabanzi ngokwethembeka kwemininingwane yocingo eqoshiwe eyiswe kwiKhomishini ivela kuNkk Lakela Kaunda owayesebenza njengomsizi kaMnuz Jacob Zuma. UNkk Mentor ubethula ubufakazi osukwini lwesibili kwikhomishini lapho ekade ehlohlwa imibuzo. Ngonyaka odlule wabethula ubufakazi kodwa nakulo nyaka uphinde wabizwa ngoba bekukhona izinto obekumele azicacise. Ngonyaka odlule watshela ikhomishini ukuthi uNkk Kaunda wamshayela ucingo wamtshela ukuthi kumele ahlangane noZuma eGoli ukuze bakhulume ngezinto zikahulumeni. UNkk Mentor ngaleso sikhathi wayenguSihlalo wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwamabhizinisi kahulumeni. Uthe ukufika kwakhe eGoli kwaholela ekutheni agcine eseya emzini wakwaGupta lapho athenjiswa khona umsebenzi wokuba nguNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni. UNkk Kaunda uphikile ukuthi washayela uNkk Mentor wakhipha nemininingwane eqoshiwe yocingo eqinisekisa ukuthi akaze amthinte. Ummeli kaNkk Kaunda, * -Adv Henry Cowley, utshele ikhomishini ukuthi akukaze kube khona ukuxhumana phakathi kwamumele noNkk Mentor. UNkk Mentor, izolo ophike nemininingwane yoMnyango wezaseKhaya neyakwa-SAA, nayizolo ubemile ekutheni waxhumana noNkk Kaunda wathi abagcinanga ngokuxhumana kodwa babethumelelana nemiyalezo. “Ngeke ngikhulume ngokwethembeka kwemininingwane ekhishwe nguNkk Kaunda kwiKhomishini, ivela kuyena hhayi kwaVodacom. Ngatshelwa ukuthi izinkampani zamaselula aziyigcini imininingwane ngaphezu kweminyaka emihlanu,” kusho uNkk Mentor.
Isithombe Esigciniwe: Ian Landsberg/African NewsAgency (ANA) Isithombe Esigciniwe: Ian Landsberg/African NewsAgency (ANA) UKUSHISA ithayi noma ukuchela igceke ngoshiboshi akuzibalekisi izinyoka emzini wakho. Lokhu kushiwo uMnuz Jason Arnold owungoti obamba izinyoka eThekwini. Uthe izinyoka eziningi aseke wazibamba emizini yabantu zisuke zikulo lelo gceke okusuke kukade kushiswa kulo ithayi noma elichelwe ngoshibhoshi ngenhloso yokuthi iphume lapho icashe khona. Uthe inyoka iphuma lapho icashe khona kuphela ima ibona sengathi isivalelekile noma izibona sengathi isengozini. “Angazi ukuthi ubani owaqhamuka nesu lokushisa ithayi nokuchela ngamanzi anoshibhoshi egcekeni. Abanye batshala ishaladi noma u-anyanisi eduze kwezindlu ngoba bekholwa ukuthi kuzoqhelisa izinyoka, iqiniso ukuthi lezi zinto azizivimbi izinyoka ukuthi zihambe egcekeni. Uma inyoka izibona ukuthi ivikelekile iyazihlalela noma ngabe lezi zinto zenziwe kulelo gceke,” kusho yena. Uqhube wathi izinyoka zibonakala kakhulu phakathi kulaSepthemba noNovemba ngoba yisikhathi lapho zisuke zimatasa khona zakha imindeni emisha, ngakho ziphuma lapho zisuke zicashe khona ukuze zithole ophathina. Uthe ezinye sezizathu ukuthi entswasahlobo kuba nezimvula bese kuba nezinambuzane namaxoxo adliwa yizo izinyoka, ziyaphuma ziyozingela. Uthe yize indawo ngayinye kungenzeka ibe nezinyoka ezingu-25 ezehlukene kodwa zikhona izinyoka ezivamise ukubonakala ezindaweni eziningi kuleli, njengemamba emnyama, night adder, vino snakes, Boomslang, istilletto neMozambique spitting cobra. Uthe nakuba zonke izinyoka zinobuthi kodwa zikhona ezinobuthi obungabulali kodwa obuholela ekutheni uvuvukale noma ulahlekelwe yilelo lunga lomzimba elilunywe yinyoka njenge-stiletto. Uqhube wathi izinyoka ziluma abantu ngoba zisuke zicabanga ukuthi zisengozini noma ziyahlaselwa kodwa azibahlaseli abantu, uma inyoka ikubone kuqala uthe iyabaleka. Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi ngalesi sikhathi sonyaka ususe zonke izinto ezigaba yikhaya lezinyoka njengezinkuni, uthayela nezinye izinto ezingaba segcekeni. Uthe uma lezi zinto zikhona egcekeni kumele zinganciki enhlabathini ngoba izinyoka yiyathanda ukuhlala endaweni emnyama, azifuni ukuhlala endaweni lapho zizophazanyiswa khona izinja nezinye izilwane. Izihlahla ezinde kanye notshani obude uthe nakho akudingeki ngalesi sikhathi. Uthe uma kwenzeka ulunywa yinyoka kumele ubophe inxeba ngebhandishi, bese uphuthuma esikhungweni sezempilo. Uthe kumele uqaphele ukuthi awuliqinisi kakhulu kuze kuphazamiseke ukuhamba kwegazi ngoba ungagcina uqunywa kanti inyoka ekulumile ayinabo ubuthi. Uqhube wathi kumele wehlise ukwethuka ngoba ukushaya ngamandla kwenhliziyo ngenxa yokwethuka kungaholela ekutheni ubuthi busheshe busabalale emzimbeni. Uthe ukukwazi ukuchaza ukuthi inyoka ekulumile ibinjani kuyabasiza abasesikhungweni sezempilo kodwa abasebenzi bezempilo bayakwazi ukubona ngezimpawu zesiguli, ukuthi silunywe yiyiphi inyoka. Uma kuyingane engakhulumi elunywe yinyoka uthe kunzima ukuba nesiqiniseko sokuthi ilunywe yinyoka kodwa ezinye zezimpawu ongazibona ukuthi ingane iphalaze,noma ihluleke ukuphefumula kahle.
AKHUMZI Jezile AKHUMZI Jezile UBESENDLELENI eyongcwaba ugogo wakhe u-Akhumzi Jezile (29) wodumo lweYOTV futhi obengumdidiyeli wohlelo lomculo kuSABC 1, iLive Amp, okushaqeke iningi kuzwakala ngokudlula kwakhe emhlabeni engozini yemoto, e-Eastern Cape, ngoMgqibelo ekuseni. U-Akhumzi, Siyasanga Kobese owaduma ecula eqenjini iJoyous Celebration, Thobani Mselemu obesezakhele igama ngokubonakala ezikhangisweni zekwithelevishini, uSkhumbuzo Mbuthuma obeyisazi sezobuchwepheshe besimanje nomunye ebelingakaveli igama lakhe, kuvela ukuthi bashone ujuqu imoto abebehamba ngayo ishayisana nenye emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka, uN6 eduzane kwaseQueenstown. ULindelani Mkhize, obesondelene no-Akhumzi futhi owake wasebenza noSiyasanga kwiJoyous, uthe namanje basashaqekile. “Ngesikhathi behamba bangitshelile ukuthi sebeyasuka. U-Akhumzi ubeya emngcwabeni kagogo wakhe ezoya nasemshadweni wesihlobo sakhe. Laba abanye ngoba nabo abakhona e-Eastern Cape bacela ukuhamba naye ukuze baye emakhaya,” kuchaza uLindelani. THOBANI Mselemu “Sisasangene ngempela ngokwenzekile, sisamangele futhi sishaqekile. Ikusasa lika-Akhumzi beliqhakazile njengoba ebengumuntu onekhono elimangalisayo uma kuziwa ekubeni uphrojusa nomqondisi wezinto ezehlukile kwithelevishini. Besisondelene kakhulu futhi into ebisenza sisebenze kakhulu ndawonye wukuthi ubengumuntu okhuthele futhi kukuningi esibona ngaso linye kukhona,” kusho uLindelani. Uthe u-Akhumzi noSiyasanga ubungeke ubahlukanise njengoba bebekuthanda ukuhlala bobabili. “Bobabili bebethanda ukudlala nokuhleka. Bebengabangani abakhulu. IJoyous, kusuka kwabadala kuze kube yilaba abakhona manje basathukile ukuzwa lezi zindaba,” kuchaza uLindelani. UPercy Vilakazi okhulumela umndeni wakwaJezile uthe okwamanje umndeni ushaqekile ngalesi sigameko. “Bangabantu abakholelwa kakhulu kuNkulunkulu njengoba no-Akhumzi bekungumuntu okholwayo. Umthandazo yiyona into abathembele kuyo manje ukuze bakwazi ukwemukela lezi zindaba,” kuchaza uVilakazi. Uthe okwamanje abakazi ukuthi izinhlelo zezinkonzo zalaba zizohlelwa kanjani kodwa bazokhipha konke ekuhambeni kwesonto. UCaptain Namhla Mdleleni okhulumela amaphoyisa ase-Eastern Cape uthe kusaphenywa ngembangela yale ngozi. SIYASANGA Kobese Uthe imizimba yabantu abathathu isihlonziwe kushoda ababili akade bekhona emotweni ebihamba o-Akhumzi Ne-ANC nalo lidlulisele amazwi enduduzo emndenini yalaba ngokudlula kwabo emhlabeni. Okhulumela leli qembu uPule Mabe uthe kubathusile ukuzwa lezi zindaba beyiqembu. “Laba bobathathu bathinte impilo yabantu bakuleli ngezindlela ezihlukene. Sifisa ngathi imindeni yabo ingathola amandla kulesi sikhathi esinzima njengoba besazama ukwamukela lezi zindaba,” kusho uPule. Uthe benguKhongolose bathemba ukuthi imindeni yalaba izothola ukududuzela njengoba kungalinyalelwe bona bodwa kodwa lonke elakuleli.
MHLELI: Thina siyisizwe esifundiswe ukuthi uma umuntu omdala ebona ubugwegwe ekwenzeni komuntu omusha, engezokuba nalo ikusasa eliqhakazile ngenxa yezinyawo zakhe ezinamabatha, umuntu omdala usheshe abone ukuthi ikusasa lakhe alicacile. Ukutshelwa komuntu omusha ukuthi ikusasa lakhe limfiliba kusuke kungasho ukuthi uyaqalekiswa ngalokho. Naba abaholi bombusazwe bamatasa balwa izimpi zabo zezikhundla, ukuze bezohlala bephethe kodwa abakhathalele ukuthi isizwe silimala kangakanani ngokwenza kwabo. Banomgolo ngempela abaholi bombusazwe ngoba into bona abayilwelayo wukuthi bahlale bephethe ngisho sebebona ukuthi bahlulekile ukuyisa izidingo kubavoti. Kunokuba kuthiwe bahlulekile kodwa kunalokho bangamane umunwe bawukhombe engxenye esikhundleni sokuthi umunwe bawubhekise kubona. Into futhi abayinkinga ngayo wukuthi uma kuphethe iqembu elithize, bangancamela ukuthi leyo mali behlale phezu kwayo kunokuba kugcinwe izidingo zabantu. Ingani phela babuye babuswe wukuthi kumele kuvele bona emphakathini khona bezohlala njalo bephethe kuze kubuye uJesu. Lokho njalo kwenziwa yiqembu limbe lezepolitiki. Kubulawa amakhansela ngenxa njalo yawo umgolo. Kubulawa abaholi ngenxa yawo njalo umgolo. Kugxijwana emithonjenei yezindaba yiwo njalo umgolo lowo. Kuhlaselwana mahlanze noma bukhoma ngenxa yayo njalo ipolitiki. Ngesikhathi besahlaselana kumele njalo ukuthi baphinde banikezwe elinye ithuba lokuthi baphathe iminyakanyaka. Sizofikaphi ingempela uma sinihlobo olunjena lwabaholi na? Ngiyazibuza ngiyaziphendula ukuthi ngabe isiphetho kuyoba yini, ngohlobo olunjena lwabaholi. Into engiyibona ngabaholi akukhona ukuthi bakhalela ukuthi bashintshe impilo yabantu njengoba besho. Mhlawumbe kungaba khona lokho kodwa okukhulu nokuhamba phambili, ukuthi kubuse amaqembu abo amanye engabusi. Okunye okubabusayo ukuthi bakhiphe amathenda ngendlela yabo. Kuthi kubantu kulethwe lokhu okumbalwa bese kudunyiswa kumiwe phezu kwendlu. Lokho sikujwayele uma kuzoba nokhetho ngokuhlukana kwalo. Lapho ke intuthuko sisuke siyibona isigeleza njengamanzi. Kunele kungadlula lolo khetho bese kuthi nya. Siqhubeke-ke sithi sinabaholi abasithandayo kwalapho. Mina ngibuye ngisole nabo abavoti ngokuthi beqhube uthando phambili lweqembu noma lwamaqembu, yize kubonakala ukuthi inqola iya eweni ngalo iqembu noma amaqembu. Inkohlakalo idla lubi kwabanye abaholi, hhayi bonke. Ithi noma isitholakele baphikelwe kuthiwa abayenzanga bayasukelwa. Kube sengathi bayaboshwa okungatheni. Uyothi uzwa yena kanye lowo msolwa ongumholi usegixabezwe ngesinonile isikhundla futhi. Ngamafuphi lokho kuyindlela yokumbonga ukuthi ukhwabanise kahle. Abaholi bethu baqokelwa ezikhundleni kwala noma ngisho benganamava azo futhi bengakufundele lokho. Kungenxa yokuthi kuyacatshangelwana ngoba nakhu wawubanjwe ndawonye umzabalazo wenkululeko. Yingakho iminyango ethize kahulumeni ihlala njalo inezinkinga ngenxa yalo uhlolo lukahulumeni olugwenxe. Bona kanye abaholi laba bansondo banolimi olubi uma bekhuluma, okuthi ekugcineni kushe izwe ngenxa yezinkulumo zabo ezingalungile ngisho nakancane. Nabo abavoti mabake beyifakele izibuko le ndaba yohlobo lwabaholi abasibusayo. Yisemkhulu Nzimande EPORT SHEPSTONE
ABANTU besifazane basanenkinga yokuthola usizo oluphephile lokuhushula izisu njengoba namanje kusenesibalo esiphezulu sabesifazane abasahushula izisu ezikhungweni ezingagunyaziwe ukwenza lo msebenzi. Kukholakala ukuthi zilinganiselwa ku-260 000 izigameko zokuhushulwa kwezisu okuthiwa zenziwa ezikhungweni ezingekho emthethweni eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kusanda kuvela engqungqutheleni eyaziwa nge-Abortion and Reproductive Justice: The Unfinished Revolution III ebikuleli ebidingida izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo abantu besifazane uma bezama ukuyothola izinhlelo zokuhushula izisu nokunye. Umbiko we-Amnesty International wango-2017 usanda kuveza ukuthi yize sekuneminyaka engu-21 kwaphasiswa umthetho ovumela abesifazane ukuthi bazithathele bona isinqumo sokuhushula izisu kodwa ziseziningi izinkinga. Ngokusho kwalo mbiko, zingaphansi kuka-7% izikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni ezihlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuhushula izisu ezikhungweni ezingu-3 880. Lesi sibalo singaphansi kakhulu kunesibalo sezikhungo ezingu-505 uhulumeni ahlele ukuthi zenze lo msebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Yize ukuhushulwa kwezisu kusemthethweni kuleli, kukholakala ukuthi izigameko eziphakathi kuka-52% kuya ku-58% zenziwa ezikhungweni ezingekho emthethweni. Ingqungquthela ebingesonto eledlule e-Eastern Cape, obekukhona kuyona abantu abalinganiselwa ku-285 basemazweni angu-26 emhlabeni wonke, ilandela eyayiseCanada ngo-2014. Imibiko yakamuva yoMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal ikuvezile ukuthi abantu besifazane bagcina benezinkinga ngenxa yokuhushula izisu ezikhungweni ezihushula izisu ngokungemthetho. Lokhu kugcina kuholele ekutheni abantu besifazane babe nezinkinga ezehlukene okubalwa kuzo ukulimala kwesibeletho, ukuphuphuma kwezisu nokunye. Umbiko wakuleli weSaving Mothers wango-2012 uveze ukuthi abantu besifazane abangu-186 abaphuphunyelwe yizisu balinyalelwa nayizibeletho ezikhugweni zikahulumeni. UMnuz Jacques van Zuydam, ongumqondisi jikelele wezokuthuthukiswa kwabantu kuMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi kuzwelonke uthe kubajabulisile ukuba yingxenye yengqungquthela. Uthe ngesikhathi bebheka izinhlelo ezifakwe emuva kwengqungquthela i-International Conference on Population and Development Programme of Action ebiseNingizimu Afrika ngo-2014 bathole ukuthi ziningi izingqinamba ezikhona kuleli okufanele babhekane nazo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abantu okuhlela aba yinto ekhona ngempela (awagcini ngokubhalwa phansi). “Izinkinga zokungalingani kwabantu ngokobulili, ngokwezezimali nangokwendlela umphakathi oyiyona ziyaqhubeka nokucindezela amalungelo okuhlela abantu besifazne. Ngo-2015 iKhabhinethi yaseNingizimu Afrika yanquma ukuthi amalungelo abesifazane okuhlela abe kulawo amqoka emigomeni yakuleli,” kusho uVan Zuydam. Uthe la malungelo ayehlanganisa namalungelo entsha okuhlela nokusungulwa kwemithetho ezosiza ekutheni amalungelo afezwe ngendlela kuzo zonke izindawo. Ingqungquthela beyihlelwe yizinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa kuzona uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi kuzwelonke, uphiko olwaziwa ngeCritical Studies in Sexualities and Reproduction Research Programme olusesikhungweni semfundo ephakeme iRhodes University nabanye. USolwazi Cathi Albertyn ongusolwazi kwezomthetho esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme i-University of the Witwatersrand uthe imithetho ehambisana nokuhlela ihambisana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlela. “Abantu besifazane bayadinga ukuthi banikwe indawo yabo emphakathini nakwezezimali nasekutheni bazikhethele izinhlelo zokuhlela. Abesifazane badinga ukunikwa inkululeko yokuthi bazikhethele ngabakwenza emizimbeni yabo,” kusho uSolwazi Albertyn. Ngo-2015 iKhabhinethi yaphasisa uhlelo olubhekele izinhlelo ezithinta amalungelo okuhlela ezibandakanya intsha, iNational Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Healthand Rights Framework Strategy (2014-2019). UVan Zuydam uthe uhulumeni uzimisele ngokuqhubeka nokulwa le mpi nokusabalalisa ivangeli lokulwela amalungelo abantu besifazane okubalwa kuwo amalungelo okuhlela nakwamanye amazwe. Uthe bazimisele ukwenza konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abesifazane okuhlela ayahloniswa.

UTHANDOLWETHU Mathonsi waseNtuzuma oshone ngemuva kokudutshulwa embhiyozweni ngemuva komngcwabo wesigebengu esishone kade sona nabangani baso bedubulana namaphoyisa UTHANDOLWETHU Mathonsi waseNtuzuma oshone ngemuva kokudutshulwa embhiyozweni ngemuva komngcwabo wesigebengu esishone kade sona nabangani baso bedubulana namaphoyisa UKHUNGATHEKILE umndeni wakwaMathonsi kwa-H eNtuzuma okufe indodana yawo edutshulwe kubhiyozwa emuva komngcwabo wendoda ebisolwa ngobugebengu. UThandolwethu Mathonsi (19), okuthiwa ubeyisikhokho ekushayeni isidudla, kuthiwa ufike kubhiyozwa ezokwenza adume ngazo ehamba ngemoto kayise iToyota RunX ebisetshenziswa nguye isikhathi esiningi. Ngesikhathi ethi uyapaka kuqhamuke umuntu wamdubula kabili. Isolezwe linayo i-video ekhombisa uThandolwethu efika embhiyozweni ngemoto yakhe, wathi esapaka kwaqhuma isibhamu. Ikhona indoda ebonakala sengathi iyabaleka ngemuva kokuqhuma kwesibhamu. Okhulumela umndeni wakwaMathonsi, uMnuz Nhlanhla Mathonsi, uthe indodana yomfowabo ibingesona isigebengu kodwa ibize emngcwabeni wesigebengu ngoba kade ibizwe ngabangani bayo abebefuna izoqhudelana nezigebengu ngokushaya izidudla. “Umfana womfowethu ubengesona isigebengu kodwa ufonelwe ngabangani bakhe eseSabatheni njengoba singamaNazaretha lapha ekhaya bathi akeze emngcwabeni wesigebengu sendawo esisale enkundleni ngesikhathi sona nabangani baso bedubulana namaphoyisa eVerulam ngeledlule,” kusho uMathonsi. Ugxeke amaphoyisa ngobudedengu obuholele ekushoneni kwendodana yomfowabo. “Siwumndeni siyakhala ngempela ngamaphoyisa sikholwa wukuthi amaphoyisa ngaphambi kokuthi ahambe emngcwabeni bekumele ahlakaze isixuku. Okunye esikutholile wukuthi asheshe ahamba futhi,” kusho uMathonsi. UMathonsi uthe bafe olwembiza ngokufa kukaThandolwethu ngoba ubeyingane ekhuthele futhi ekhaliphile. Uthe inkonzo yesikhumbuza sikamufi izoba ngoLwesine khona eNtuzuma kuthi inkonzo yomngcwabo ibe khona eNtuzuma kodwa yena uzofihlelwa amathuneni asekhaya eJozini. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Colonel Thulani Zwane, uthe bayakuqinisekisa okwenzeke ngoMgqibelo kwa-E eNtuzuma lapho owesilisa oneminyaka engu-19 edutshulwe ekhanda. “Uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela kodwa washonela endleleni ngenxa yokulimala. Imbangela yokudutshulwa kwakhe ibingakaziwa. Amaphoyisa aseNtuzuma aphenya icala lokubulala kodwa okwamanje bekungakaboshwa muntu,” kusho uZwane. Mayelana nokugxekwa kwamaphoyisa ngobudedengu, uZwane uthe bona bagada umngcwabo hhayi imibhiyozo eyenzeka uma usuphelile. “ Amaphoyisa ayahamba uma ebona ukuthi kuthule,’ kusho uZwane.
UXWAYISA ngokuthi bagadwe ubusuku nemini abanesifo sokuhanjelwa wumqondo iDementia, uNkk Madanda Mabizela ongumnakekeli wabo ngaphansi kweBessi Makatini Foundation Isithombe: LEON LESTRADE/ANA UXWAYISA ngokuthi bagadwe ubusuku nemini abanesifo sokuhanjelwa wumqondo iDementia, uNkk Madanda Mabizela ongumnakekeli wabo ngaphansi kweBessi Makatini Foundation Isithombe: LEON LESTRADE/ANA INHLANGANO ebhekela abanesifo sokuhanjelwa wumqondo esibizwa nge-dementia, ifuna uhulumeni asifake ngaphansi kwezifo zokukhubazeka ukuze kusizakale abanaso. I-Bessie Makatini Foundation (BMF), iveze lokhu izolo esithangamini sokuqwashisa ngalesi sifo eThekwini. UMnuz Stan Chidavanzi ongomunye wabagqugquzeli bale nhlangano ozinze e-England, uthe kusenzima ukusiza abanalesi sifo ngoba nohulumeni akabaxhasi. Uthe ngisho izinhlangano ezisiza abaneDementia azilutholi uxhaso. Uveze ukuthi lesi sifo sesibulala abesifazane ukwedlula ezinye izifo e-England. “Silwela ukuthi uhulumeni asithathe njengokukhubazeka lesi sifo ngoba sibucayi kakhulu. Inkinga esibhekene nayo wukuthi abantu abayazi i-dementia, abayiqondi futhi abafundisekile kahle ngayo. Kusanezinkolelo zokuthi onalesi sifo uyathakatha noma uthakathiwe.” Enaba ngalesi sifo uthe kusuke kufe ama-brain cells. Uveze ukuthi onaso akawuboni umehluko phakathi kobusuku nemini, yingakho abanye bebanjwa bentwayiza emgwaqweni ngisho ebusuku. Ukhale ngokuthi lesi sifo aselapheki kodwa kunemishanguzo edambisa kuphela ukukhohlwa okwesikhashana. Yize lesi sifo kuthiwa sihlasela kakhulu izalukazi, uChidavanzi uthe siyenzeka nakulabo abasebasha. Uthe izidakamizwa nazo zinomthelela kulokhu. UNkk Madanda Mabizela ongumnakekeli wabanalesi sifo, uthe unina ongasekho wayenaso. Uthe uma unalesi sifo udinga ukugadwa ubusuku nemini. Ulinganise ngonina athe wake wazama ukuphuza upharafini. “Kumele bahlale benakiwe, bangasitholi isikhathi eside sokuba bodwa. Kumele kungapheli amahora amabili onalesi sifo engakaze anyakaze. Kufanele bazivocavoce, ngisho elele umuntu ujwayele ukumelula umzimba.” Uthe ukulala isikhathi eside kudala izilonda, ezingakubulala uma zinganakiwe. UNksz Shanice Moodley oyiSpeech Therapist, uthe abanalesi sifo kumele bakhunjuzwe njalo izikhathi osukwini. Uthe lokhu kubalekelela ekutheni kubuye umqondo ngoba bayakhohlwa. Ulinganise ngokuthi bakhonjiswe ikhalenda, bakhunjuzwe ngezinsuku ezibalulekile. Uthe kuyasiza nokuthi ubakhombise izinto kunokubatshela ngomlomo ngoba bayakhohlwa. Kuvele ukuthi uma umuntu esesitejini sokugcina seDementia, akube kusasebenza lutho emzimbeni. Ababethamele lesi sithangami bakhale ngokuthi kudingeke bayeke ngisho umsebenzi ukuze bagade abanalesi sifo emakhaya. Kuvele ukuthi uma sebehanjelwe wumqondo bakhohlwa ngisho amagama abo. I-BMF yasungulwa nguNksz Bessie Makatini waseLamontville osezinze eLondon ngokusebenza. Naye washonelwa ngunina ngenxa yalesi sifo.
MDUDUZI MANANA MDUDUZI MANANA USEKOLUNYE utaku uMnuz Mduduzi Manana osule esikhundleni sokuba yilungu lePhalamende kuleli sonto njengoba amalungu ekomiti ebelizomqondisa ubugwegwe efuna akhokhe izindleko zawo. UManana owayeyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme kodwa wasula ngemuva kokushaya abesifazane endaweni yobumnandi, uzisulele ePhalamende ngoLwesibili wathumela incwadi ehhovisi likaSotswebhu we-ANC izolo emazisa ukuthi useyasula. Izolo amalungu ekomiti lezimilo acele iPhalamende ukuthi liphoqe uManana ukuthi akhokhe izindleko zawo zokusuka lapho abe khona ngoba eze esigungwini sokumqondisa ubugwegwe. Isigungu sokumqondisa ubugwegwe bekufanele sibe izolo kodwa ngenxa yokuthi uye wasula emsebenzini asihlalanga. USihlalo waleli komidi, uMnuz Aumsen Singh, uthe uManana ubazi ukuthi kufanele avele ekomitini lokuqondisa ubugwegwe ngodaba lokushaya abesifazane ngonyaka odlule kodwa wasula emsebenzini. Amanye amalungu ePhalamende athe uManana bekufanele asule ngonyaka odlule emva kokulahlwa yicala lokushaya abesifazane kodwa yena wakhetha ukusula izolo ngaphambi kokuthi aqondiswe ubugwegwe. Amalungu amahlanu ePhalamende aphoqeleke ukuthi asuke ezindaweni ezihlukene aye eCape Town lapho bekuzolalelwa khona udaba lwakhe. Lilodwa ilungu lePhalamende ebeliseKapa, lilinde uManana okunguNksz Liezl van der Merwe we-IFP. USingh usuke eThekwini, uNkk Annelie Lotriet weDA noNkk Sam Matiase we-EFF basuke eBloemfontein baya eKapa. UNkk Rosalia Morutoa we-ANC usuke eGauteng. UMnuz Lemias Mashile we-ANC usuke eMpumalanga ngoba naye ubazi ukuthi kuzoqondiswa uManana ubugwegwe. USingh uthe bazocela usizo lwezomthetho ePhalamende ukuze uManana akhokhe izindleko zabo. Uthe bebephoqelekile ukuthi baye eKapa ngoba bekufanele. “Sicele uSotswebhu we-ANC, uMnuz Jackson Mthembu, ukuthi sibheke icala likaManana ukuze uma sekuqala umsebenzi wePhalamende kungabikho okusiphazamisayo. Asazi ukuthi uManana kungani esule sekusele usuku ukuthi avele ekomitini lethu ngoba kudala aziswa ukuthi uzoqondiswa ubugwegwe,” kusho uSingh. Amalungu eDA ne-IFP athe uManana ubengafuni ukuxoshwa yingakho esule ngomzuzu wokugcina. UNksz van der Merwe uthe bayakwamukela ukusula kukaManana kodwa lokhu akusho ukuthi ubezisola ngesenzo sakhe sokushaya abesifazane ngoba kumthathe unyaka ukusula.
UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo ePhakeme, uNkk Naledi Pandor, uyalele iNSFAS ukuthi imise uhlelo lokuthathwa kwezicelo zonyaka ozayo obekufanele luqale kusasa UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo ePhakeme, uNkk Naledi Pandor, uyalele iNSFAS ukuthi imise uhlelo lokuthathwa kwezicelo zonyaka ozayo obekufanele luqale kusasa UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo ePhakeme useyalele abesikhwama esiboleka izitshudeni imali yokufunda, iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), ukuthi bangaqhubeki nokwamukela izicelo zezitshudeni ezifuna ukuxhaswa ngemali ngonyaka ozayo. Encwadini ebhalwe nguNkk Naledi Pandor, ayibhalele uSihlalo webhodi lakwaNSFAS, uMnuz Sizwe Nxasana, eputshukele kwabezindaba, uthe ukhathazekile ngendlela isikhwama esihlela ngayo izinhlelo zokuxhasa izitshudeni, okubalwa kuzo ukuphuza kwaso ukuphasisa izicelo nokuphuza ukukhokhela izitshudeni eziphasisiwe. Kule ncwadi ukhala ngokuthi lesi sikhungo kubonakala sengathi asikwazi ukulawula izigidi zemali okumele sixhase ngayo izitshudeni. Lesi sikhwama bekumele sivule ithuba lokufakwa kwezicelo zika-2019 kusasa. Kule ncwadi uthe kunenqwaba yezitshudeni ezingakakhokhelwa imali yokufunda kwalo nyaka. Okunye okuvelayo wukuthi ubuchwepheshe obusetshenziswa yisikhwama ezikhungweni zemfundo ezehlukene abusebenzi kahle, okuholela ekutheni ulwazi lwezitshudeni olufakwa kubo lube nezinkinga. Kuvele ukuthi uNkk Pandor uke wabhalela ibhodi lesikhwama phambilini ethi akulungiswe izinkinga ezikhona mayelana nokukhokhelwa kwezitshudeni imali yokufunda. Waphakamisa ukuthi isikhungo masiqhamuke nendlela yokuxhumana yezobuchwepheshe esebenza kahle exhumanisa izicelo ezifakwa ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme nehhovisi elikhulu lalesi sikhwama. Okhulumela iNSFAS, uMnuz Kagisho Mamabolo, uthe ibhodi lesikhwama nabaphathi baso basebenzisana nomnyango namathimba abo asebenza ezikhungweni ukulungisa izinkinga ezikhona. Uthe zilinganiselwa ku-20 000 izicelo zika-2018 ezingakaphothulwa okusamele ukuthi lesi sikhwama sithathe isinqumo sokuthi ngabe izitshudeni ezifake izicelo zizohlomula yini esikhwameni. “Uma iNSFAS inikeza izitshudeni imali engekho amaphepha adingekayo, kuzoholela ekutheni ibukeke njengabantu abangawenzi kahle umsebenzi wabo. Uhlelo lwa-online seluyakuvumela ukuthi izitshudeni zifake amaphepha azo adingekayo zisebenzisa lolu hlelo. UMnuz Zola Saphetha, unobhala weNehawu, uthe izinkinga zakwaNSFAS zidalwa wukuthi lesi sikhungo sisebenza sengathi siyi-spaza, kuqashwa izihlobo. UNkk Pandor uthe kunzima ukuthi asivikele lesi sikhwama ekuhlaselweni wumphakathi nezitshudeni ngenxa yokuthi kusenezitshudeniezingakazi ukuthi ngabe zizohlomula yini kusona ebezifake izicelo zokuhlomula kulo nyaka.

Ijaji lithe, uMthimkhulu angaphinde azibize ngeNgonyama yamaHlubi noma enze umcimbi egameni lobukhosi bamaHlubi ngoba akayona inkosi. Liphinde lamyalela ukuthi kumele akhokhe izindleko zecala ebelifakwe enkantolo. Icala abebhekene nalo alithathanga sikhathi lisenkantolo njengoba kufike kwaphuma isinqumo kwaba sekuphelile njalo ngoMthimkhulu. UMthimkhulu uqale ukuvela ngo-2014 ethi nguye iNgonyama yamaHlubi esemthethweni. Wenza indumezulu yomcimbi wokuzigcoba njengeNgonyama emzini wakhe eShowe. Wayememe umphakathi nosomabhizinisi, abanye ababeqhamuka eGermany. Ngemuva kwalo mcimbi kusuke umsindo kukhala abaseNdlunkulu yamaHlubi ngoMthimkhulu obekuthiwa usegcobe namakhosi angaphansi kwakhe futhi eqhakambisa ukuthi uzobumba isizwe samaHlubi. Ubesezibiza nangoMthimkhulu III. Ngo-2016 umnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nezoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal uxwayise uMthimkhulu uthi makangabizwa ngeNgonyama ngoba abukho ubufakazi balokho. Waphinde wamyalela ukuthi makayeke ukugcoba amakhosi ezindaweni ezihlukene esifundazweni ngoba akanalo ilungelo lokwenza lokho wathi uzobhekana nomthetho uma eqhubeka.
UMNUZ Siphelele Ngobese isidumbu sakhe esitholwe silenga kukhona nesentombi yakhe uBoni Myeni Isithombe: FACEBOOK UMNUZ Siphelele Ngobese isidumbu sakhe esitholwe silenga kukhona nesentombi yakhe uBoni Myeni Isithombe: FACEBOOK BASHAQEKILE onogada kutholwa izidumbu zozakwabo abayizithandani okusolwa ukuthi bazibulale omunye wazilengisa endaweni abasebenzela kuyo. Kuthiwa isidumbu sikaMnuz Siphelele "Ntezimnand" Ngobese waseHluhluwe sitholwe silenga endlini okuhlala kuyo onogada uma begadile enkundleni yezemidlalo eCongela, eThekwini, ngoLwesibili ebusuku kwathi esentombi yakhe ebizithwele, uNksz Boni "Ntezimnandikaz" Myeni waseNanda, satholwa sidindilize eceleni kwesesoka lakhe sinentambo entanyeni. Kuthiwa bebesebenzela inkampani eyodwa yonogada iVusa Isizwe Security esebenzela eThekwini. UMnuz Mboniseni Mdletshe, ongumphathi kule nkampani yonogada elandisa Isolezwe ngokwenzekile, uthe babikelwe ngalesi sigameko omunye unogada obecelwe uNgobese ukuthi ambambele emsebenzini ngoba kukhona okuthile amatasa ngakho. “Lo nogada uthe ngesikhathi esendlini egadile uzwe okuthile okuwayo emnyango okuthe uma ephuma eqalaza wabona izithandani zimi eceleni komnyango. Uthe zithe bezimthusa zifuna ukubona ukuthi uzokwenzenjani zabe sezimnika imali zicela ukuthi ayozithengela i-drink,” kuchaza uMdletshe. Uthe unogada ubatshele ukuthi ngesikhathi esendleleni ubuye washintsha umqondo wajika ngoba esola ukuthi hleze bamthuma nje bafuna ukuya ocansini besendaweni yokusebenzela. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi esebuyela emuva ufice isicabha sesikhiyiwe wangqongqoza kwangaphendula muntu. Unogada uthe kuze kwaphoqeleka ukuthi akhahlele isicabha okuthe uma sivuleka wazithela phezu kwesidumbu sikazakwabo wesilisa silenga, esowesifazane sidindilize eduze nesihlalo okukholakala ukuthi ugibele kusona ngesikhathi ezilengisa. UMdletshe uthe emuva kokuthola umbiko uphuthume endaweni yesehlakalo. “Ngesikhathi ngifika bekunencwadi engisola ukuthi ibhalwe owesilisa ebithi : 'Ngicela ukuxolisa ngesinqumo engisithathile kodwa ngibuye ngingaxolisi ngoba kukhona abanye abafowethu abazokhululeka ngami',” kusho uMdletshe. Uthe uphinde wabona incwadi asola ukuthi ibhalwe ngowesifazane ebithi: 'Ngicela ukuxolisa ngesinqumo engisithathile ngicela nisale ningigadele izingane zami kodwa vele nizokhululeka ngoba beningangidingi.'" Isolezwe libuye labona enye incwadi okuthiwa ibhalwe uNgobese enxusa ozakwabo ethi uma sebeza emngcwabeni wakhe abagqoke izikibha ezinobuso bakhe. UNkk Nomandla Nyawo, ongunina kaNksz Myeni, uthe bebengalazi isoka lendodakazi yakhe futhi nokuthi izithwele ukuzwe sekwenzeke lesi sehlo. Uthe indodakazi yakhe ishiye ezinye izingane ezimbili, eneminyaka emihlanu neneminyaka emithathu. “Okwenzekile kusishaqise kakhulu kodwa siyasamukela isimo. Nathi sitshelwe ukuthi uzibulele kodwa sizolinda uphenyo lwamaphoyisa,” kusho uNkk Nyawo. Imizamo yokuthola umndeni kaNgobese ayiphumelelanga ngenxa yokuthi inombolo Isolezwe ebelinayo ibingangeni. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCol Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuyaphenywa ngokutholwa kwesidumbu sowesilisa oneminyaka engu-23 silenga nesowesifazane oneminyaka engu-24.
THABANG MOSIAKO THABANG MOSIAKO ULULAMELA esibhedlela umpetha ka-5000m uThabang Mosiako ngemuva kokulimala ekhanda ekade ehlaselwa okusolakala ukuthi kungenxa yokucwaswa ngokwebala. Lokhu kuthiwa kwenzeke ePotchefstroom, eNorth West, ngesonto eledlule. Umbiko okhishwe yiPotchefstroom Herald ngempelasonto uveze ukuthi uMosiako ukhahlelwe kanzima ekhanda wagaklazwa phansi yiqeqebana labamhlophe elilinganeselwa ku-10 eNorth West University. UMosiako (22) waphaphama esesesibhedlela ngelanga kwenzeka lokhu (Febhuwari 4). Ngesikhathi kwenzeka wayenabangani bakhe uRantso Mokopane noSandy Londt nabo okuvela ukuthi bahlaselwa. UMokopane ungumpetha wakuleli we-3000m steeplechace kanti nguyena oveze lokhu ekhasini lakhe leFacebook. “Okwesine sihlaselwa endaweni esondelene neNWU lapho uzakwethu esiziqeqesha naye elinyazwe kanzima ekhanda okungenzeka kumenze aphathwe yikhanda impilo yakhe yonke. Ngihlezi ngigwema izinto eziphathelene nebala kodwa kuzona zonke izehlo ezine kuhlezi kungamadoda amhlophe alimaza abamnyama ngaphandle kokuthathelwa izinyathelo. Kungiphatha kabi ukuthi ngisho amaphoyisa nabezokuphepha bayahluleka ukusivikela uma sidinga usizo #Cry_Our_Beloved_Country,” kubhala uMokopane. Uthe indaba iqale eNews Cape ePotschefstroom ngesikhathi abafundi bethuka umsebenzi wasethilini. “Ngingenelile ngabacela ukuthi bayeke ukuthuka lowa sisi. Uma sengiya ngaphandle iqeqebana elilinganiselwa ku-10 elinemizimba eyizidlakela njengabantu be-rugby lisihlaselile. Amaphoyisa afikile ayimisa impi kodwa aqonde thina asishaya engathi yithina ebesisephutheni. Sizizwe sibukeleke phansi. Sibalekile. Endleleni sibone enye imoto yamaphoyisa sacela ukuthi asiphelezele siye ngaphakathi esikhungweni ngoba besazi ukuthi abahlaseli basazobuya. Anqabile amaphoyisa. Ngemuva kwemizuzwana baphinde basihlasela kade becashe efokizini elilapho,” kulandisa uMokopane kwiHerald. Uthe abahlaseli bese bebaningi. Ngesikhathi yena nomunye uzakwabo bebaleka babe sebengenele uMosiako. “Bebemkhahlela ekhanda nasemzimbeni ngesikhathi elele phansi. Babalekile sebebona amaphoyisa eza bamshiya ethule phansi okuyilapho ephuthunyiswe khona esibhedlela.”
UMsizi Mbutho (29) ovele enkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini ngoLwesithathu, usolwa ngokubulala isitshudeni saseDUT uSandile Ndlovu ngokumshaya ngesando ekhanda. Isithombe: Lestrade/African News Agency(ANA). UMsizi Mbutho (29) ovele enkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini ngoLwesithathu, usolwa ngokubulala isitshudeni saseDUT uSandile Ndlovu ngokumshaya ngesando ekhanda. Isithombe: Lestrade/African News Agency(ANA). KUVELE ukuthi sabulawa ngokushaywa ngesando ekhanda emagcekeni esikhungo saseDurban University of Technology (DUT) isitshudeni uSandile Ndlovu oshonele esibhedlela ngoSepthemba ngemuva kokulimala kanzima ekhanda. Umsolwa ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNdlovu (18) uMsizi Mbutho (29), uboshwe ngeledlule kanti uvele okwesibili enkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini ngoLwesithathu. Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo, umsolwa ubhekene namacala amabili, elokubulala nelokubamba inkunzi. UMbutho akakayazisi inkantolo ukuthi uyawavuma noma uyawaphika amacala abekwe wona kanti futhi akasifakanga nesicelo sebheyili. Ngesikhathi esenkantolo kuvele ukuthi uNdlovu, obefundela iziqu ze-Industrial Engineering, wabulawa ngokushaywa kanzima ekhanda. Phambilini bekubikwa ukuthi uNdlovu wabulawa ngokugwazwa. Bekungokokuqala abashushisi beveza ukuthi uNdlovu wabulawa “ngokushaywa ekhanda ngesando, okwaholela ekufeni kwakhe.” Sandile Ndlovu Abashushisi basola uMbutho ngokweba izinto zikaNdlovu okubalwa kuzo iselula etholwe kuyena ngemuva kokumhlasela ngesando ngoSepthemba 9. Ushonele esibhedlela ngoSepthemba 21 esephefumula ngemishini. Abashushisi bathe bafuna uMbutho abhekane nesigwebo esinzima kunazo zonke esigabeni samacala asolwa ngawo. UMbutho kuvela ukuthi akazimisele ngokufaka isicelo sebheyili. Icala lihlehlisiwe njengoba kusalindelwe umbiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu sikaNdlovu. Inkantolo isazonquma ukuthi leli cala lizoqhubeka eNkantolo yeMantshi noma lizodluliselwa eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini.
KUVALWE izitolo eziyisishagalolunye ezidayisa utshwala ngokungemthetho eMatikwe, eNanda, izolo ngenhloso yokunciphisa amacala okuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane enzeka kakhulu kule ndawo. UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha noKongiwa kweMvelo KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, obehambisana nethimba lamaphoyisa nophiko olulawula ukukhishwa kwezimvume zokudayisa utshwala, bagasele ezindaweni ezidayisa utshwala kule ndawo. Bebehlola ukuthi izindawo ezidayisa utshwala ziyayilandela yini imigomo ebekiwe yokudayisa utshwala efana nokuthi kumele umdayisi abe nemvume, indawo yakhe iphinde ibe sesimeni esihle, kubuye kube nendawo yokupaka amakhasimende akhe. Ziyishagalololunye izindawo ezivaliwe izolo okutholakala ukuthi azinazo izimvume zokudayisa utshwala, izitifiketi esikhombisa ukuthi lezi zindawo ziphephile. UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe ukuvalwa kwalezi zindawo kuyingxenye yohlelo lwalo mnyango lokuzama ukwehlisa isibalo samacala odlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane njengoba indawo yaseNanda ihamba phambili ngamacala odlame lobulili. “Kuyavela ukuthi amacala amaningi odlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane kakhulukazi awokudlwengulwa enzeka emuva kokuthi kuphuzwe utshwala. Yingakho sithe sizoqala ngokuthi sivale izindawo ezingekho emthethweni ezidayisa utshwala ukuze sinciphise izinto ezingaba umthethelela ekutheni kwenzeke la macala.” Ezinye zalezi zindawo ezivaliwe kutholakale ukuthi zidayisa ukudla, utshwala kuphinde kulalwe kuzo kanti nabanikazi bezitolo abanazo izimvume zokuba kuleli. Uthe umnyango wakhe ubeke eceleni imali enguR13 million ezosetshenziselwa izinhlelo zokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane kule ndawo. Phakathi kwezinto ezizokwenziwa ngale mali, uthe kuzofakwa amakhamera ezindaweni zokuphuza ezinezimvume nasemigwaqweni.
Isithombe: ON THE MOVE IN ENTERTAINMENT Isithombe: ON THE MOVE IN ENTERTAINMENT MHLELI: Kwelakho eliwela umfula ugcwele ake ngibonge umfo kaNgobe esaphila. Uyisibonelo esihle uTshatha Ngobe kwabasakhula nakubasakazi boKhozi FM. Umfo kaNgobe uyasazisa isiZulu futhi ungomunye wabantu ongancela ulwazi oluningi kuyena ngezithinta izindaba zakwaZulu noma ezazenzeka kudala. Lo msakazi angakushayela izibongo zamakhosi ake aphatha kwaZulu kube sengathi uzifunda phansi. Kwesinye isikhathi kuke kuthi uma exoxa ngomlando wakwaZulu nangezimpi zakudala kuvele kube sengathi wayekhona kwenzeka lokho. Ukuzwa umuntu osemsakazweni ezazi ukuthi uphuma kuphi kwenza nabanye abasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme bawuhalele umlando wakithi ngoba phela cha wona umnandi. Yize-ke okhokho nomkhulu baphangalala ngaleso sikhathi kodwa uma uxoxwa kuvuka uhlevane uzizwe ungumZulu wangempela. Isizukulwane sanamuhla sazi ukuthi uma saze nje ukuthi ubani uyise, mhlawumbe-ke nomkhulu, kuphelile kanti cha bakwethu ayikho into emnandi njengokusho uyihlo okuzalayo uma uqeda ngaye uye kumkhulu wakho uqhubeke njalonjalo nokubabongela kuze kufike kokhokho ongenalo ulwazi oluningi ngabo. Njengoba kuyinyanga yamagugu, intsha esakhula njengathi kuningi engakuncela kumfo kaNgobe uma engase ageqe amagula ngezindaba zakithi. Okunye ngaye, nakuba ngingakaze ngihlangane naye kodwa uzwakala engumuntu ongazithwele nobazisayo abanye abantu. Angizogxila-ke kakhulu lapho ngoba ngike ngasho ukuthi angikaze ngimbone ngamehlo. Sengiphetha, kuhle sikubone ukubaluleka komuntu esaphila kungathi uma eseshonile usizwe sesikhala kakhulu sithi “hheyi wayewazisa umlando wakwaZulu uTshatha”. Ukwazi ngomlando wakithi ngeke kwasusa ubuchule kumuntu futhi ngeke kumphazamise kwenze ukuthi angabe esalukhuluma ulimi lwesiNgisi abanye abalukhonze kakhulu. Jabulani Pho Madlala EGreytown
UMNUZ Phakamani Bukhosini ofe emuva kokuhilizisana nonogada kaMasipala wasoLundi Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE UMNUZ Phakamani Bukhosini ofe emuva kokuhilizisana nonogada kaMasipala wasoLundi Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE BASHAQEKILE abasebenzi bakaMasipala wasoLundi emuva kokuthi indoda eqapha izikhulu zomkhandlu idubule uzakwabo obesebenza kwizicishamlilo wafa endaweni yokucima ukoma ngeSonto. Indoda (35), engeke ize idalulwe ngoba ayikabuzwa ukuthi iyalivuma noma iyaliphika yini icala, izolo bekulindeleke ivele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasoLundi mayelana necala lokubulala uMnuz Phakamani Bukhosini (27). Kuthiwa kube nokulizisana phakathi kokuthiwa udubulile nomufi endaweni yokucima ukoma. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni adonse isibhamu adubule umufi kaningana. Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi umufi uqale wadutshulwa onyaweni, wabe eseyaxolisa, ecela ukuthi angabulawa. Kuthiwa ilapho emdubule khona amahlandla amaningi, waze wasondela eduze ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi usefile. Omunye umthombo ongaphakathi kumasipala uthe umdubuli ubengasasiphathi isibhamu somsebenzi ngenxa yokuba nodlame ekhaya. “Usebenzise isibhamu sakhe okungesona esomsebenzi. Ubaziwa ukuthi unesandla esilula, uma eke waxabana nomuntu uvele asikhiphe, noma adubule. “Unolaka olumangalisayo. Yingakho ubengasanikezwa isibhamu somsebenzi,” kusho umthombo ocele ukungadalulwa. Imenenja yoMkhandlu wasoLundi, uMntwana Nkosenye Zulu, uthe abasebenzi bashaqekile ngokwenzekile. “Sikhungathekile njengomkhandlu nabasebenzi emveni kokuthi sithole izindaba ezithi omunye wabasebenzi bethu ongumqaphi udubule omunye umsebenzi wethu obesebenza kwizicishamlilo wambulala,” kusho uZulu. Uthe bezwe kuthiwa kube nokuhilizisana okuthile phakathi kwabasenzi babo nokugcine ngokuthi kudutshulwe. “Umufi obesebenza kwizicishamlilo ubelindele ukubizwa emsebenzini noma yinini. Umsolwa ubengasebenzi besendaweni yokuzithokozisa babe sebeyaxabana. Asazi ukuthi kubangweni kwagcina ngokuthi lona ongumqaphi adubule abulale lona obeyisicishamlilo,” kusho uZulu. Uthe namhlanje (izolo) bekungasebenzeki kubasebenzi baze babiza izinceku ukuba zizokhuleka. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uBrigader Jay Naicker, uthe indoda (35) ivele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasoLundi namhlanje (izolo) mayelana necala lokubulala. “Kuyasoleka ukuthi ngoNovemba 3, indoda (27) idutshulwe yashona emgwaqweni uBhambatha e-Unit B oLundi. Umufi ubenamanxeba amaningi okudutshulwa, kuvulwe icala lokubulala esiteshini samaphoyisa oLundi ukuze kuphenywe,” kusho uNaicker.

Isithombe: Bongani Mbatha African News Agency (ANA) I-DA kuMasipala weTheku ifuna izimpendulo ukuthi kungani engezi emsebenzini izinyanga ezintathu obeyimeya yomkhandlu uNkk Zandile Gumede, yize eqhubeka nokuhola imali yokuba ikhansela? Emhlanganweni wamakhansela e-ICC zolo, usotswebhu we-DA eThekwini, uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, uthe uNkk Gumede bamgcine ngoSepthemba efika emuva kwesikhathi emcimbini wokugcotshwa kongene ezicathulweni zakhe, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda. “Ucwaningo esilwenzile luveza ukuthi uNkk Gumede akalona ilungu lekomiti kwakhona emkhandlwini futhi akayethameli imihlangano yamakhansela. Uyaqhubeka nokuhola imali yabakhokhi bentela ngaphandle kokwenza umsebenzi wobukhansela njengoba ebhekene namacala enkohlakalo,” kusho uMthethwa. UMthethwa uvuke umbhejazane emuva kokuthi imenenja yomkhandlu, uMnuz Sipho Nzuza, iqeda ukufunda uhlu lwamakhansela angekho emhlanganweni ngenxa yezizathu ezahlukene. Umholi wekhokhasi we-IFP uMnuz Mdu Nkosi uthe bahambe ne-DA ukuthi kumele ludingidwe udaba lokuthi kungani uNkk Gumede namakhansela engezi emsebenzini isikhathi eside? UNkk Gumede, amakhansela amane aboshwe ngoLwesithathu oKlebe nosonkontileka abathathu bathinteka ecaleni lethenda ka-R208 million yokuqoqwa kukadoti eThekwini. I-DA ifuna kuxoshwe emkhandlwini wonke amakhansela angu-62 ethe ayathinteka ecaleni lenkohlakalo ekukhishweni kwethenda kadoti.

Ngizoqwashisa umphakathi ngomthelela wesivuvujikelele ukuze uhlale uqaphile,” kusho uNkk Dube-Ncube esitatimendeni. UNINA wentombazanyana okuthiwa ihayize ubumayemaye emuva kokuthi owesilisa waseMachobeni lapho behlala khona, eyibonise izithombe nama-video ocansi UNINA wentombazanyana okuthiwa ihayize ubumayemaye emuva kokuthi owesilisa waseMachobeni lapho behlala khona, eyibonise izithombe nama-video ocansi UTHELEKELWE wumphakathi ngamabhodlela nangezibhakela owesilisa waseMachobeni ngaseLindelani, ngemuva kokuvela kokuthi uvezele izingane ezisencane izithombe zocansi. Lo wesilisa esingeke silidalule igama lakhe njengoba engakasho ukuthi uyalivuma noma uyaliphika icala, kuthiwa ubebiza izingane zamantombazane ezingomakhelwane athi uyazithuma, agcine ngokuzivalela endlini ezibukisa izithombe zocansi, esebenzisa i-lap top yakhe. Indaba idalulwe yintombazane eneminyaka ewu-13, evele yasho ngengila kwaphuma omakhelwane. Ngokuthola kwaleli phephandaba, umphakathi uphimile kwahlatshwa umkhosi, watitinywa owesilisa ngaphambi kokubizelwa amaphoyisa. Unina wentombazane esho ngengila, uthe indodakazi yakhe imtshele ukuthi into eyimemezisile wukubona into engakaze iyibone. “Udinga ukwelulekwa ngokomqondo ngoba bekumele ayobhala namhlanje esikoleni, sahamba sayokhuluma nothisha ukuthi sibona engakulungele selokhu kwenzeke le nto kuyena,” kusho unina wale wentombazanyana eyenza uGrade 7 kwesinye sezikole eLindelani. Unina ucele ukuba indodakazi yakhe izikhulumele ngokwenzekile. “Bengikha amapentshisi kwesinye sezihlahla...uphumile endlini wangitshela ukuthi nguyena ogade abantshontsha amapetshisi. Ngixolisile mina, wabe esethi angingene endlini yakhe. Ngingene wabe esevala umnyango, wathi angizobuka kwi-lap top yakhe. Kuvele abantu abebenza ucansi,” kusho intombazanyana. Iqhube ithe umsolwa uyibuze iminyaka yayo yobudala, okuthe uma imtshela, wayesethi kuhle-ke ngoba isikhulile. Ngemuva kwalesi sehlakalo, kuvele nezinye izingane ezimbili nazo ezitshele abaphenyi becala ukuthi zike zabukiswa izithombe zocansi nguyena umsolwa. Owesilisa osolwayo kuthiwa uhlala nengane yentombazane eneminyaka emibili. Ngokwelinye ilungu lomphakathi, kuthe uma bembuza ukuthi uphi unina wengane, wabatshela ukuthi uyobeletha esibhedlela. Unina wengane okukhulunywe naye, uthe ubonga uNkulunkulu ngokuthi indodakazi yakhe ayidlwengulwanga. “Siyile kodokotela bafike baqinisekisa ukuthi akakaze adlwengulwe,” kusho unina wentombazanyana. Kunezinsolo zokuthi ziningi nezinye izingane okungenzeka ukuthi zike zabukiswa izithombe zocansi. “Siyasola nokuthi nale ngane yakhe ahlala nayo hleze nayo uyihlukumeza ngokocansi,” kusho umzali ophumele obala. Ugogo wengane ebihlala nowesilisa kuthiwa ufikile khona izolo wazoyilanda. Amanye amalungu omphakathi athe afuna kungenele nenkosi yendawo ukuze umlisa adingiswe nasendaweni. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe amaphoyisa aseNanda abophe owesilisa (33) ngecala lokukhombisa izingane izithombe zocansi. Uthe owesilisa osolwayo uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi eNtuzuma izolo, bekungakacaci ukuthi uyitholile yini ibheyili. “Kuthiwa ngoNovemba 6 umsolwa udobele endlini yakhe owesifazane oneminyaka engu-13 lapho afike khona wamdlalela ama- video ocansi, wamphoqa ukuthi akawabuke,” kusho uCol Thembeka Mbele.
BASAPHILA njengezingane ezisanda kujola uMfundisi Eddie Ngonelo noNkk Thandi Ngonelo abaluleka ngomshado, asebeshade iminyaka ewu-40 Isithombe: ZANELE ZULU/ANA BASAPHILA njengezingane ezisanda kujola uMfundisi Eddie Ngonelo noNkk Thandi Ngonelo abaluleka ngomshado, asebeshade iminyaka ewu-40 Isithombe: ZANELE ZULU/ANA AKUJWAYELEKILE ukuthi abantu abamnyama bakhombise ukuthandana ngisho sebeguga ngoba kwaziwa ukuthi ngabezinye izinhlanga abenza kanjalo. Kuhlukile kuNkk Thandi Ngonelo (65) nomyeni wakhe uMfundisi Eddie Ngonelo (66), abangabeluleki kwezomshado abangofakazi bokuthi uthando alugugi. Bangabaholi be-Act of Obedience Ministries eThekwini kodwa bayaziwa nakwezinye izifundazwe ngomsebenzi wokweluleka. Sixoxe ngokuthandana kwabo emuva kweminyaka ewu-40 beshadile. Bafike behamba ndawonye emotweni kushayela uMfundisi Ngonelo. Wehle kuqala uNkk Ngonelo nengubo ephuzi, izicathulo ezisagolilde, wabopha ngomchilo ophuzi igoda eliyi-afro. Babukana emehlweni uma bexoxa bencikene. “Akukona ukuthi konke bekuhamba kahle emshadweni wethu. Indlela ebesixabana ngayo, kukaningi sibona ukuthi idivosi isifanele. Akukho nento etheni esasiyibanga kodwa sasibanga ngisho izinto ezincane,” kusho uNkk Ngonelo. Uthe bahlangana bengakasindiswa kodwa uNkk Ngonelo yena wayevele esonta. UNgonelo uthe enye yezinto ezazibaxabanisa wukuthi wayengafuni umkakhe asonte futhi babehlukene ngokwesikompilo. “Bekuthi njalo uma umkami ezoya esontweni ngimnqabele, aye ngenkani. Bekungicika nokuthi ubenezihlobo eziningi kanti mina ngikhule emndenini omncane. Kuyena bekumnandi ukuvakashelwa yinqwaba yezihlobo ekubeni kanti mina ngifuna sibe naye nezingane kuphela,” kusho uNgonelo. Bathe basizwa wukumenywa kwenye inkonzo yabashadile lapho bafike babona wonke amaphutha abo. Leyo nkonzo yalandelwa enye lapho bazinikela khona basindiswa. “Kuleyo nkonzo kwaba manzi amaduku sikhala. Kwabashadile ababekhona, yithina okwachithwa nathi isikhathi esiningi ngoba kwakonakele,” kusho uNgonelo. Yize bethe izinselelo aziphelanga emshadweni, bafunda ukubekezelelana nokukhulisana. Yilokhu abathi kuhlula abaningi kulezi zinsuku. “Inkinga wukuthi umuntu uqale ahlanyiswe isiqu somuntu bese egijimela umshado engakalazi ingaphakathi lakhe. Ngeke umthole umuntu ongenasici kodwa kumele uqale uzilungise wena. Kunezinto okumele ungazinaki ngoba ngeke uzishintshe. Umshado ukuze uqine kumele ube nezinselelo, ngale kwalokho akuwona umshado. Inkinga wukuthi abantu bajaha ukuphuma emshadweni bengakawazi,” kusho uNkk Ngonelo. Mayelana nokufundana okwaziwa nge-dating, uNkk Ngonelo uthe akunankinga ngisho kubazalwane. Okubalulekile ukugwema ukuya ocansini. Bebuzwa ngokwenza uthando lwabo lungafi, bavele bahleka babukana. “Engangikwenza ngifika emshadweni namanje ngisakwenza. Ngiyezwana nokuhlanzeka futhi ngiyazibambela ekhishini. Ngino-65 kodwa ngizizwa ngimusha kunalokho,” kusho uNkk Ngonelo. Banezingane ezintathu nabazukulu abayisithupha. Ezinye izeluleko zabo: *Musa ukugxeka owakwakho njalo uma kunezinkinga. *Uma usubazi ubuthaka bakhe, zama ukumsiza. *Ngeke umshintshe umuntu kodwa funda ukumbekezelela. *Hlala umuhle njengoba wawunjalo ningakashadi. *Thoba ekhaya ukhohlwe isikhundla onaso emsebenzini nasemphakathini. *Khumbulani ukuthi kunabantu ababukela kinina abafunda umshado wenu. *Ningazami impilo eniyibona kuthelevishini. *Ungasatshiswa wukuphumelela kowakwakho kodwa yazi ukuthi uphakamisa nelakho igama.

IZINGANE zesikole zihamba emgwaqweni ongakubo kukaThokozani Mvalelwa Isithombe: BONGANI MBATHA /ANA IZINGANE zesikole zihamba emgwaqweni ongakubo kukaThokozani Mvalelwa Isithombe: BONGANI MBATHA /ANA UKUSHODELWA yimali yokuthenga abaqwayizi kuholele ekutheni umfundisi osindisiwe adlwengule izingane zamantombazane ezingaphezu kuka-15, ezineminyaka esukela kwewu-3 kuya kwewu-12, emijondolo yaseLouisiana ePort Shepstone. Lezi zindaba zidalulwe wumndeni walo mfundisi, uThokozani Mvalelwa (34), ogwetshwe yiNkantolo yesiFunda yasePort Shepstone odilikajele abahlanu ngemuva kokuzivumela yena ukuthi ubedlwengula laba bantwana qede ababonge ngamaphakethe ama-chips noR2. Yize uMvalelwa, odabuka eLusikisiki, e-Eastern Cape, etshele inkantolo ukuthi zingaphezu kuka-15 izingane azidlwengula, kodwa kwafakaza ezinhlanu kuphela. Inkantolo ithole ukuthi lo mfundisi wadlwengula lezi zingane ezingomakhelwane phakathi kukaJuni no-Okthoba ka-2016. Imikhuba yalo mfundisi yavela ngesikhathi umzali wengane yentombazane eno-6, ethi uthuma indodakazi yakhe esitolo kanti izohlangana noMvalelwa, wayithatha wayiyisa endlini yakhe yomxhaso lapho ayidlwengulela khona maqede wayivala umlomo ngoR2. Ekhuluma neSolezwe ngoMgqibelo unina wale ntombazane, uthe wathi uma ezwa le mihlola wayobikela ikomiti. “Wafike wazivumela yena ukuthi wayidlwengula ingane yami futhi wathembisa ukuthi uzohlawula ngenkukhu. Waveza nokuthi ziningi izingane abezibiza bese elala nazo,” kusho lo mama elifihliwe igama lakhe ukuvikela ingane. Uthe izingane zonke zayiswa esibhedlela lapho odokotela bafike bakuqinisekisa ukuthi nebala zadlwengulwa. Ilungu leCommunity Policing Forum (CPF), uMnuz Simon Mthembu uthe babe sebebiza amaphoyisa ukuba ambophe uMvalelwa njengoba amanye amalungu omphakathi ayesefuna ukumudla amfele futhi efuna anqunyiswe okwembuzi. “Sathi uma simbuza ukuthi wayezidlwengulelani izingane ezincane kanje, wathi ubeswele imali yokuthenga abaqwayizi,” kusho uMthembu othi uMvalelwa ubaziwa njengekholwa ebelikhonze ukuzidumisela iNkosi kuphela. Le ndaba yaziwa ngisho nayizingane ezincane zaseLouisiana njengoba nasejoyintini lendawo isabhungwa. NoNksz Phumzile Khawula, oyisihlobo sikaMvalelwa, uthe naye wamtshela ukuthi usuke waphelelwa amatoho, wangabe esakwazi ukuthenga abaqwayizi. Eqhuba uNksz Khawula uthe uMvalelwa waqala wasonta eZayoni ngaphambi kokuyothwasa. “Indaba yonakala ngesikhathi esethi usindisiwe ngoba ubesenza nezinto ezingaqondakali. Wazivumela yena kimina ukuthi nonina wayemdlwengula njengoba egcine eshonile. Nezingane zezihlobo zakhe ubezidlwengula nje. Kukhona nje neyakithi ayidlwengula,” kusho uNksz Khawula. Umama (47) wengane eno-10 uthe wubulwane obenziwe nguMvalelwa ezinganeni zabo ngoba eziningi ziphazamisekile engqondweni futhi azisenzi kahle ezifundweni zazo esikoleni sendawo iLouisiana Primary. UMnuz Thozamile Zomba, obengumakhelwane kaMvalelwa, uthe naye waqala wangakholwa esezwa ukuthi uMvalelwa wenze la manyala. “Ngahluleka ngisho esezivumela yena kodwa ngangingakholwa. Uze wagwetshwa nje ngingakholwa ngoba ubewumntwana ohloniphayo obekhonze ukusonta. Ubungaze umfake nasekhukhwini. Ubehlale engungwe yizingane, kungasoli muntu,” kusho uZomba. Onina bezingane bathe nakuba benelesekile yisigwebo kodwa okwenziwa wuMvalelwa ezinganeni zabo kuyisihluku esingefaniswe.
USALE usaphazeke kanje udoti eMlaza ngesikhathi osonkontileka bekhala ngokungakhokhelwa umasipala imali yabo USALE usaphazeke kanje udoti eMlaza ngesikhathi osonkontileka bekhala ngokungakhokhelwa umasipala imali yabo BASABISA ngokuwuvala thaqa uMlaza osomabhizinisi abaqonqa udoti kuleli lokishi abasola uMasipala weTheku ngokungabakhokheli. Osomabhizinisi abangosonkontileka baseMlaza abaqoqa udoti abavale umgwaqo ngodoti izolo bathi kusekuncane lokhu abakwenzile. Bathe uma umasipala ungahlangani nabo, ubakhokhele imali yabo basazoqhubeka nokuvala umgwaqo nanganoma yisiphi isikhathi kuleli lokishi. Lezi zinkampani aziwulandanga udoti futhi zathi ngeke ziwulande. Omunye wosomabhizinisi abangosonkontileka abaqoqa udoti, uMnuz Nathi Sibalukhulu, uthe kusazoba nzima kubantu baseMlaza uma kuqhubeka ukuthi bangakhokhelwa. Uthe bonke bebengakhokhelwe ngoFebhuwari kanti abanye abakhokhelwanga ngoJanuwari nangoDisemba. “Kuqale ngokuthi kube khona osonkontileka abangakhokhelwanga ngoDisemba. Sihlalile salinda sizitshela ukuthi lesi simo sizolunga kodwa kwangenzeka. Sesicele kaningi ukuhlangana nomasipala kodwa kwangenzeka. NgoMsombuluko besisemahhovisi kamasipala ngoba bekuhlelwe umhlangano kodwa saze sahamba singanakwanga muntu,” kusho uSibalukhulu. Uthe bazovimba yonke into ehambayo kuleli lokishi kuze kube umasipala uhlangana nabo ukhokhe nemali obakweleta yona. Kubuhlungu kithi ngoba njengoba singakhokhelwe asikwazi ukukhokhela abasebenzi bethu abaphinde babe ngomakhelwane bethu. Njengoba bengakhokheliwe kusho ukuthi imindeni yabo ayidlile nathi asikwazi ukukhokhela izimoto esisebenza ngazo,” kuqhuba uSibalukhulu. Ukuvalwa komgwaqo kushiye amalungu omphakathi engeneme njengoba abantu bekhale ngokuthi baphazamisekile ezinhlelweni zabo. UMnuz Thulasizwe Gumede (57) oyilungu lomphakathi, uthe bavuke umgwaqo uvalwe ngodoti. Uthe abantu abakwazanga ukuhamba ngoba amatekisi abengahambi kahle. Usole labo abebebhikisha ngokungawucabangeli umphakathi. “Kungcono ukube bebeyobhikisha emahhovisi abaphathi babo labo abangabaholele. Bangaphazamisi umphakathi ngoba lokhu kufana nokuthi bahlukumeza wona,” kusho uGumede. Omunye wosomabhizinisi abadayisa izithelo nenyama, uMnuz Sipho Mbhele, uthe uze waqala emuva kwesikhathi ukusebenza ngoba uthathe isikhathi eside eyothenga impahla ayidayisayo. Uthe namakhasimende abengemaningi njengokujwayelekile izolo ngoba abantu abaphumanga. Uthe bafisa sengathi ingalungiswa le nkinga. Uphiko olubhekele ukuqoqwa kwadoti kuMasipala weTheku luxolisile kubahlali baseMlaza ngokungalandwa kukadoti. “Umasipala unxusa amalungu omphakathi ukuthi agcine udoti emakhaya ukuze kugwemeke ukusabalala kokungcola. Umphakathi uzokwaziswa uma sekuqalile ukuqoqwa kukadoti. Umasipala usebenza kanzima ukulungisa lesi simo. Siyaxolisa ngokuhlukumezeka komphakathi ngokungalandwa kukadoti,” kusho lolu phiko.

Ngokwabazali balezi zingane, umsolwa unguSihlalo weCommunity Policing Forum (CPF) emijondolo yaseManyaleni, e-Unit 2, eChatsworth ngaseThekwini. Kuthiwa uneloli elithutha udoti endaweni, abegibelisa kulona izingane, ebelenza ukuthi izingane zimthande ngoba ubehlale ezipha izinto ezimnandi. Lo msolwa uvele izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi eChatsworth. Umphakathi nabazali bebephume ngobuningi bezothamela icala, bebhikisha nangaphandle kwenkantolo. “Eyami ingane uqale ukuyidlwengula ikade yenza uGrade 1. Ngithole manje seyenza uGrade 3 ukuthi kade aqala ukuyidlwengula,” kusho omunye wabazali. Uthe izingane zabo ubezinunusela ngemali nangamamaswidi. Ngokusho kwabo, umsolwa ungumuntu ozimele kahle endaweni, yingakho izingane zabo bezithanda ukuyodlala nezingane zakwakhe. Bathe emzini kamsolwa kunezinto eziningi zokudlala izingane njengozwingi, amabhayisikili nokunye okuningi okuthandwa izingane. INGXENYE yomphakathi obutheleke eNkantolo yeMantshi eChatsworth eThekwini, uzobhikishela owesilisa osolwa ngokudlwengula izingane zamantombazane emijondolo yaseManyaleni endaweni:Isithombe TUMI PAKKIES “Besiyaye singanaki uma izingane zethu ziyodlala khona ngoba naye unezingane. Bezidlala ndawonye nezakhe kwakhe,” kuchaza omunye wabazali. Njengendoda emi kahle, kuthiwa umsolwa ubenganqeni ukulayisha izingane zomakhelwane azivakashise ebhishi ziyozijabulisana nezakhe. Bathe izingane zabo azisafuni nokuya esikoleni ngoba zihlekwa ngezinye, kwazise sekuyaziwa ukuthi kunezinsolo zokudlwengulwa wumsola. “Ezinye umchamo usuyaziphumela nje, azisakwazi ukuzibamba ngenxa yokudlwengulwa. Abanye babantwana bethu sebehlala bezinwaya amathanga sengathi banotwayi. Badlala le ndoda endala.” Abanye abazali bathe izingane zabo sezihlale zikhala uma kwenzeka zibuka ithelevishini ekhombisa izithombe zabantu ababambanayo ngoba kuba sengathi lokho kwenzeka kuzona. Nakuba abanye babo bethe izingane zabo zithola ukwelulekwa ngokomqondo njalo ngenyanga, abanye bathe ezabo kuselukhuni satshe ukuthola lokho ngoba abazi ukuthi kumele benze njani.
UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Willies Mchunu. Isithombe: ZANELE ZULU.AFRICAN NEWS AGENCY/ANA UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Willies Mchunu. Isithombe: ZANELE ZULU.AFRICAN NEWS AGENCY/ANA UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Willies Mchunu uthi iyabakhuthaza imibono abayithola kubantu uma benza ucwaningo emphakathini, ngenhloso yokuthola ukuthi baphethe kanjani. Ethula inkulumo yakhe mayelana nesimo sesifundazwe, enkundleni yezemidlalo eRoyal Showgrounds eMgungundlovu, ngaphambi kokuthi axinwe ukugula, uMchunu uthe bathatha isinqumo sokuthi benze ucwaningo emphakathini, ukuze bafunde ukuthi ikuphi lapho bengenzi khona kahle. Uthe bakwenza lokhu ngoba bezibophezele ekutheni bashintshe impilo yabantu. “Siqale ukwenza lolu cwaningo ngo-2015. Siyajabula ukubika ukuthi manje sesiqede ucwaningo luka-2018 futhi siyisifundazwe sokuqala esibe nesibindi sathatha igxathu lokuthi siyekele umphakathi ukuba usihlole ukuthi sisebenza kanjani,” kusho uMchunu. Uthe okutholwe ucwaningo ukuthi u-39%, wabantu awugculisekile ngendlela abenza ngayo, wengeza ngokuthi * -61% ugculisekile. “Into abakhala ngayo kakhulu abantu abanxusa ukuthi isukumelwe, yindaba yokudala amathuba emisebenzi, ilandelwe indaba yezindlu, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhona nezemfundo ezisezingeni,” kusho uMchunu. Uvumile ukuthi bewuhulumeni basahluleka ukudala amathuba emisebenzi. “Yize umnotho wethu ukhula kusukela kuqale isigaba sale Khabhinethi ekhona kodwa lokhu kukhula kuphansi uma kuqhathaniswa nokuhanjiswa kwezidingo ngendlela umphakathi olindele ngayo nokudala amathuba emisebenzi,” kusho uMchunu. Uthe okwamanje bangu-2.635 million abantu abangasebenzi eKZN uma kuqhathaniswa nabangu-2.536, abebengasebenzi ngesikhathi esifanayo ngonyaka odlule. UMchunu uthe kuyacaca ukuthi ukudala amathuba emisebenzi esikhathini esedlule akuzange kuhambe kahle. Uthe enye into evelile ocwaningweni abalwenza emphakathini wukuthi abantu bafuna ukuphepha lapho behlala khona. ‘”Mayelana nobugebengu sibone bukhula kakhulu kulesi sikhathi esikuso futhi buphazamisa ezomnotho namabhizinisi, okukhathaza kakhulu ukuthi amacala okubulala aphezulu,’’ kusho uMchunu. Uthe bazishaya isifuba ngohlelo lwabo lwezempilo olwenza abantu baphile isikhathi eside. “Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi isikhathi esiphilwa ngabantu ngokujwayelekile sesisukile eminyakeni engu-56, saya ku-60, phakathi kuka-2015 no-2016.” Uthe babone nempumelelo ekulweni nengculuzi.
UNGQONGQSHE weziMali uMnuz Tito Mboweni obethula isabelo sakhe sokuqala sezimali ePhalamende eKapa lapho ethe ayikho imali ezofakwa ngumgcinimafa ethinta amaholo abasebenzi, iminyango kuyomele yenze izinhlelo zokuthola imali Isithombe: Elmond Jiyane, GCIS UNGQONGQSHE weziMali uMnuz Tito Mboweni obethula isabelo sakhe sokuqala sezimali ePhalamende eKapa lapho ethe ayikho imali ezofakwa ngumgcinimafa ethinta amaholo abasebenzi, iminyango kuyomele yenze izinhlelo zokuthola imali Isithombe: Elmond Jiyane, GCIS PHEZU kokuba uhulumeni elokhu emile ekutheni ngeke badilizwe abasebenzi kodwa kucace bha izolo uNgqongqoshe weziMali uMnuz Tito Mboweni ethula isabelo sezimali samaphakathi nonyaka ukuthi izinto azihambi kahle njengoba ekubeke kwacaca ukuthi ayikho imali ezofakwa yokukhokhela abasebenzi. UMboweni uthe isivumelwano samaholo singaphezulu ngoR30.2 billion kunalokhu obekuhleliwe. Uthe ngenxa yalokhu ngeke kube khona imali ezofakwa ngumgcinimafa. “Ayikho imali ezofakwa okungeyabasebenzi. Ayikho imali yamaholo. Iminyango kuzomele ifune imali ngaphakathi ukuze ikhokhele abasebenzi. Kuzomele ibhekisiswe eyokusebenza isikhathi esengeziwe kanjalo nokukhokhelwa kwabantu amabhonasi ngokwenza kahle." Uhulumeni ubehlele ukuthi uzokhokha uR212.5 billion wamaholo abasebenzi onyakeni wezimali kodwa le mali yanyuka ngemuva kwesivumelwano yaba nguR242.7 billion, yanyuka ngoR30 billion. Imali ekhokhelwa abasebenzi ingu35% wemali echithwa nguhulumeni. Isimemezelo sikaMboweni, oyiphindile le nkulumo yokuthi ngeke ifakwe enye imali kumaholo abasebenzi, sisho ukuthi iminyango kuzomele ithathe imali kwezinye izinhlelo okusho ukuthi kuzothinteka izinhlelo zokuhanjiswa kwezidingo emphakathini. Uhulumeni uqashe abasebenzi ababalelwa ku-1.3 million. ICosatu iyaveva ngesimemezelo sikaMboweni mayelana nokunyuka kakhulu kwesabelo sezimali sabasebenzi bahulumeni. UNobhala weCosaut uMnuz Bheki Ntshalintshali, uthe kuyadumaza ukuthi kugxekwe abasebenzi ngezinkinga ekubeni kungebona abadle imali kwa-Eskom, bakha iNkandla noma bathumela imali eDubai. Uthe abasebenzi abahambi namakhosikazi abo uma beya kwamanye amazwe wathi othisha, abahlengikazi namaphoyisa basebenza kanzima. “Asimzwanga uNgqongqoshe ekhala ngoR2.4 million oholwa oNgqongqoshe okubalwa naye. Uhulumeni akanalo uhlelo lokwehlisa ikhabhinethi eyanda njalo nokulawula izinkampani ezingaphansi kwakhe.” Uthe bamshayela ihlombe ngesimemezelo asenzile sokuthi ngokuvalwa kwezikhala kwezempilo kodwa besifuna ukuzwa ngendaba yamaphoyisa abalelwa ku-56 000 azinze emahhovisi engabe atshalwa ensimini. Ukhale kakhulu ngokungavalwa kwezikhala zothisha, abahlengikazi, ojele, amaphoyisa nodokotela. UNobhala jikelele weSouth African Federation of Trade Unions (Saftu) uMnuz Zwelinzima Vavi, uxwayise uMboweni ngokuthi bazolwa naye uma ediliza abasebenzi. Uthe kumele ehlise ikhabhinethi kungadlalwa ngabasebenzi abazikhandlayo besebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Uqhube wathi agcwele amakilasi, amaphoyisa ayashoda nokutih akumele kwehliswe isibalo sojele. Esithangamini sabezindaba ngaphambi kwesabelo sezimali uMboweni uthe kumele ikhabhinethi ingabi nongqongqoshe abangaphezulu kuka-25 ngoba akuwakhi umqondo. Uthe akuwakhi umqondo ngakwezimali ukuthi kube nongqongqoshe abangu-35, ababa namaphini abo okusho ukuthi ongqongqoshe bangu-70.

USATHUTHUMELA owesifazane osinde ngesikhathi indoda yakhe idutshulwa ngentululwane yezinhlamvu ngamaphoyisa okuthiwa abephenya entathakusa yangoLwesine eNseleni. UNksz Sihle Mdletshe ubesendlini ngesikhathi kuhlaselwa emzini wabo noMnuz Bhekizenzo Msweli (66), odutshulwe amanxeba amathathu esifubeni wadlavazeka nengalo. UNksz Mdletshe uthe bebelele ngezithuba zabo-1 entathakusa ngesikhathi bezwa kukhonkotha inja egcekeni. “Sesake sangenelwa izigebengu phambilini zizogqekeza imoto. Izimoto ezimbili ubesezipaka eduze komnyango wendlu ukuze ezwe uma kukhona okungahambi kahle. Ngesikhathi inja ikhonkotha wavuka wathatha isibhamu sakhe esisemthethweni, wayovula umnyango wasekhishini lapho bekukhonkotha khona inja,” kuchaza uNksz Mdletshe. Uthe umufi ubesawuvula nje umnyango wezwa kuqhuma isibhamu. Uveze ukuthi wesabile ukuphuma, wezwa umufi ekhala ngokuthi uyafa. “Ungene ekamelweni esaphethe isibhamu, opha kakhulu esifubeni, wafike wawa. Ngizwe kukhona okuqhuma sengathi yibhomu ngasemnyango, ngavele ngaphuma sengiphakamise izandla ngizikhalela kuleli qulu lamadoda ebelisegcekeni. Bangiphushele emnyango bangena endlini bebuza ukuthi ngobani abanye abakhona. Ngibatshele ukuthi kunezingane ezilele kwelinye ikamelo,” kuchaza yena. Uthe kuleli qulu lamadoda bekukhona eyodwa egqoke umfaniswano wamaphoyisa. Usola ukuthi lama doda eqe uthango ngesikhathi engena egcekeni ngoba ebehamba ngezinyawo. Ubone kamuva ukuthi nephoyisa lidubulekile. Uthe la madoda acele awavulele isango efuna ukuvulela i-ambulensi. Emuva kwalesi sigameko uNksz Mdletshe uthe kufike amaphoyisa okuyilapho eqinisekise khona ukuthi nguzakwabo odutshuliwe. Uveze ukuthi usamangele ukuthi ubulaweleni uMsweli ngoba nesibhamu besisemthethweni. Umufi, okuthiwa ubethutha izingane zesikole, ushonele esibhedlela ngoLwesine ekuseni. UNksz Mdletshe uthe ngesikhathi behlaselwa yizigebengu ngo-2016 umufi waqhumisa isibhamu wagcina eboshiwe, waphucwa nesibhamu kodwa icala labuye laphela, nesibhamu sabuyiselwa kuye. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe amaphoyisa abelandela uphenyo ngabasolwa abebefuneka ngamacala okuphanga nawokudlwengulwa enziwa ngo-2017. “Amaphoyisa angqongqozile azazisa kodwa kwakhona odubulayo ngaphakathi endlini kwadubuleka iphoyisa ekhandla. Amaphoyisa aphindisele ngenhlamvu kumufi odubuleke esifubeni. “Umufi utholakale nesibhamu ngaphambi kokuthi bayiswe esibhedlela nephoyisa. Kuvulwe icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala, idokodo ladluliselwa kwi-Independent Police Investigative Directorate”.

Isithombe: Thobile Mathonsi Ungqongqoshe wezokuThutha uMnuz Blade Nzimande obethula umbiko ngezingozi ezenzeke ngesikhathi samaholidi. Isithombe: Thobile Mathonsi ZIDLULE nabantu abangu-1612 izingozi ezenzeke emgwaqeni yakuleli ngesikhathi samaholidi kaDisemba nyakenye. Lokhu kudalulwe uNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha uMnuz Blade Nzimande ngesikhathi ethula umbiko ngezokuphepha emgwaqeni ngoLwesithathu. Ngokwalo mbiko obheka izingozi ezenzeke kusukela ngoDisemba 1 kuya kuJanuwari 8, iKwaZulu-Natal ihambe phambili ngesibalo sabantu abafe ezingozini njengoba kudlule abawu-328 kulesi sifundazwe. Ngemuva kwayo kulandele i-Eastern Cape (238) Gauteng (219), Limpopo (178), Mpumalanga (162), Free State (159), Western Cape (149), North West (125) ne-Northern Cape (54). Zimbili kuphela izifundazwe okwehle izinga lokufa ngezingozi kuzo. EGauteng izinga lehle ngo-19%, eNothern Cape lehla ngo-2%. ENorthern Cape izinga linyuke ngo-80% noma isibalo sabafe emigwaqeni sisaphansi kulesi sifundazwe. Kulezi zingozi u-36% wabantu abafa ababengabagibeli, abahamba ngezinyawo (35%) abashayeli (27%) kanye no-2% wababehamba ngamabhayisikili. Lo mbiko ngezinhlekelele ezidlule nabaningi emgwaqeni uphuma nje bekubikwe ukuthi sinyusiwe isibalo samaphoyisa agcwele emgwaqeni kanti nongqongqoshe uphinde waveza ukuthi kuba nama-roablock awu-775. Kulokhu kuboshwe izimoto eziwu-4016, abantu abawu-8057 kwashicilelwa amathikithi awu-765 009 emiqwaqeni yakuleli ngesikhathi samaholidi. UNzimande usole uphuzo oludakayo, ukushayela budedengu, ukukhathala kanye nezimoto ezingekho emthethweni njengomnyombo wezingozi ezenzeka nsuku zonke emgwaqeni yakuleli. Uthe uma lungabonakali uguquko kubashayeli bakuleli iNingizimu Afrika isazoqhubeka ibe nemigwaqo eyingozi.
