KUBE nomunyu ngesikhathi abasebenzi basemakhazeni besusa izidumbu zomndeni wakhwaDube eThornwoo, eMarianhill. USHAQEKILE umphakathi waseThornwood eMariannhill, eduze kwasePinetown emuva kokutholwa kwamalungu amane omndeni ebulewe. Izolo umphakathi ubumi izixongololo ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ephenya kwaDube eThornwood lapho kusolakala ukuthi indodana yakhona uMnuz Khulekani Dube (21) inqume unina, yagwaza unina wezingane zayo ezimbili, yagwaza indodana enezinyanga ezintathu, kwasinda ingane yentombazane eneminyaka emibili nayo yazigwaza yase izikhunga. UMnuz Themba Joseph Makhathini ongumfowabo kaNkk Thembi Dube, uthe bashaqekile ngoba abazi ukuthi dimoni lini elingene umshana wakhe. “Ezinyangeni ezedlule udadewethu wathi indodana yakhe iyamsabisa uma iphuzile ithi izombulala. Ngamcela ukuthi abikele amaphoyisa kodwa wanganaka ngoba umshana ubesho uma ephuzile. Ubephuza ugologo omhlophe ebhema nosikilidi. Angikaze ngizwe ukuthi ubhema izidakamizwa. Kungiphethe kabi ukuthi ubulale udadewethu ngesihluku emnqumisa okwembuzi, isithusile le nto,” kusho uMakhathini. Uthe bathole izolo ekuseni ukuthi udadewabo akasekho emuva kokuthi umfundisi obeyolanda umndeni ukuba uye esontweni ekhale ngokuthi akukho muntu ophendulayo uma engqongqoza futhi kunuka iphunga elibi. “Sithumele uMfanafuthi (omunye umshana) ukuthi ayobheka ngoba sihlala ngaphesheya. Uze wathatha i-crowbar ukuze avule ngayo ngoba akekho obephendula. Uthole izidumbu esisola ukuthi bese zihlale isonto zidindilizile zonakele futhi zinamanxeba okugwazwa,” kusho uMakhathini. UNksz Zodwa Makhathini obiza uNkk Dube ngonina omncane uthe: “Asazi sizothi bekwenzenjani, asimazi ebhema izidakamizwa, siphatheke kabi”. IMEYA uNkk Siphindile ‘Maphindi’ Zondi-Mbhele ushone esesibhedlela ngeSonto. Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE IMEYA uNkk Siphindile ‘Maphindi’ Zondi-Mbhele ushone esesibhedlela ngeSonto. Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE USHAQEKILE umndeni noMkhandlu waseMshwathi ngokudlula emhlabeni ngokuzuma kwemeya uNkk Siphindile “Maphindi” Zondi-Mbhele. UNkk Zondi-Mbhele (44), waseMtulwa, obeyiMeya yaseMshwathi ushone ngeSonto ebusuku kulandela ukugula isikhashana. Ngokusho kokhulumela umndeni, uMnuz Mandla Zondi, iMeya yaya kudokotela ngoLwesihlanu iyobheka isimo sempilo yayo yabe isilaliswa emuva kokuthi udokotela engaboni kahle okuthile ngempilo kamufi. “Udokotela wamlalisa ewumuntu ozohlolwa. Abamvakashela ngoMgqibelo bafike engenankinga, ezikhulumela. NgeSonto ebusuku sithole umyalezo esibhedlela othi umndeni uphuthume njengoba ubengasaphefumuli kahle sengathi uvukwa i-astma obekuyisifo angenaso. Kumenele ngalo iSonto. Kusishaqisile lokhu njengoba ebengaxiniwe ukugula, yize ebengumuntu vele ohlala ngokugula kodwa ubengaxinekile. Silahlekelwe njengoba ubewusizo olukhulu ekhaya, ubengeyona iMeya nje kuphela, ubeyilungu lomndeni eliwukhathelele kakhulu,” kusho uZondi. Iphini leMeya uMnuz Promise “Pro” Dlamini, lithe bewumkhandlu bafe olwembiza ngokuhamba kwalo mholi obenamava. “Ubona nje asazi ukuthi sizamukele kanjani lezi zindaba ngoba besingalindele ukuthi adlule emhlabeni, ubengaguli. NgoLwesine nje sasisonke emsebenzini, usuku lwaze lwaphela. Kuthe ngoLwesihlanu wathi uya kudokotela, wabe eselaliswa. NangoMgqibelo besithumelana imiyalezo emafonini, engumuntu ozophuma noma inini esibhedlela. Ngithukile ngitshelwa umndeni ukuthi akasekho. Silahlekelwe umuntu obewuthanda umphakathi futhi ewusizo olukhulu,” kusho uDlamini. UNkk Zondi-Mbhele ngaphambi kokuba aqokwe ukuba imeya emuva kokhetho luka-2016, ubeyiphini lemeya eMshwathi, amahlandla amabili. Uyaziwa ngabaningi njengomholi we-ANC. UNkk Zondi-Mbhele, umndeni wakhe uthe ubengenabo abantwana.
INHLOKO yamaJaji kuleli uMogoeng Mogoeng ephiwa isipho sesithombe ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yesifundo senkosi Albert Luthuli e-UKZN ngoMgqibelo. Lesi sifundo esenzeka minyaka yonke bekungesika-14 kanti lapha uthathwe nomzukulu kaLuthuli uMnuz Mthunzi Luthuli, uSolwazi Albert Modi wase-UKZN nendodakazi kaLuthuli uNksz Albertina Luthuli INHLOKO yamaJaji kuleli uMogoeng Mogoeng ephiwa isipho sesithombe ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yesifundo senkosi Albert Luthuli e-UKZN ngoMgqibelo. Lesi sifundo esenzeka minyaka yonke bekungesika-14 kanti lapha uthathwe nomzukulu kaLuthuli uMnuz Mthunzi Luthuli, uSolwazi Albert Modi wase-UKZN nendodakazi kaLuthuli uNksz Albertina Luthuli INHLOKO yamaJaji uMogoeng Mogoeng ixwayisa ngokuthi impi ayisona isisombululo ezingqinambeni ezibhekene nezwe kubalwa kuzo udaba lomhlaba nokucwasa. Ethula inkulumo yakhe kade enza isifundo ngowayengumegameli we-ANC ongasekho inkosi Albert Luthuli e-UKZN ngoMgqibelo, uMogoeng uthe udaba lomhlaba akumele lumbambathwe kodwa kumele kubhekwane nalo ukuze kutholakale isisombululo. Uxwayise ngokuthi yize kumele kubhekanwe nalo kodwa akumele luhlukanise phakathi isizwe. “Indaba yomhlaba kumele igcine ixazululiwe ukuze kuphele izilonda ezadaleka ngesikhathi abantu bephucwa umhlaba wabo. INingizimu Afrika iphiwe futhi inabantu abahlakaniphile, ngiyathemba ukuthi izokwazi ukuluxazulula lolu daba ngaphandle kokuthi kusuke impi,” kusho uMogoeng. Uthe kodwa udaba lomhlaba ngeke luze luxazululeke ngaphandle kokuxazulula udaba lokucwasa ngokwebala. “Ngiyabathanda abantu abamhlophe kukubona ukuthi bayakukholwa yini kodwa ngeke ngize ngimbandaze ngithi ukucwasa akukho lapha eNingizimi Afrika,” kusho uMogoeng. Uthe abamhlophe ibona abahamba phambili kwezomnotho, ngesikhathi abantu abamnyama bebhuqwa indlala. “Udaba lomhlaba lungaxazululwa ngokuthula kube nobumbano kodwa abamhlophe kumele bazi ukuthi abazange bafike namhlaba lapha,” kusho uMogoeng. Uthe lolu daba kumele luxazululwe egameni likaLuthuli owalwela isithunzi sabantu abamnyama. UMogoeng uphinde wakhwela wadilika kubaholi bezombusazwe wathi sebengenwe umkhuba wokufuna ukuzicebisa. Umzukulu kaLuthuli, uMnuz Mthunzi Luthuli, uthe bajabule ngoba isicelo sabo sokuthi kuphenywe kabusha ngokushona kukamkhulu wabo sesize savunywa.
ISALE ilimele kanje imoto yelungu lesiShayamthetho leDA KwaZulu-Natal uNksz Mbali Ntuli emva kokushayiswa yiloli emgwaqweni uN3 ngaseMariannhill Toll Plaza ngempelasonto Isithombe: sithunyelwe ISALE ilimele kanje imoto yelungu lesiShayamthetho leDA KwaZulu-Natal uNksz Mbali Ntuli emva kokushayiswa yiloli emgwaqweni uN3 ngaseMariannhill Toll Plaza ngempelasonto Isithombe: sithunyelwe ILUNGU leDA esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal uNksz Mbali Ntuli liphakamisa ukuthi ahlolisiswe amaloli ukuthi asesimeni sokuba semgwaqweni emuva kokusinda engozini yemoto ngempelasonto. UNksz Ntuli usinde ngokulambisa ngesikhathi imoto yakhe ishayiswa yiloli kuN3 ngaseMariannhill Toll Plaza yona yabe isishayisa ezinye izimoto kubalwa eyamaphoyisa neyelungu lePhalamende le-ANC uMnuz Enoch Mthethwa. Abashayeli bezimoto ezintathu ezishayiswe ekaNksz Ntuli kubikwa ukuthi basesibhedlela namanje lapho belashwa khona emva kwengozi. Engxoxweni neSolezwe izolo, uNksz Ntuli uthe usakhungathekile namanje emva kwengozi. “Ngibonga uMdali ngokuthi ngisindile. Leli loli lingene ngemuva emotweni yami layiphusha yabe isiyaphenduka yashayisa ezinye izimoto zabantu kubalwa neyelungu lePhalamende likazwelonke. Iloli liphinde lashayisa nangasesicabheni sami ngesikhathi imoto iphenduka,” kuchaza uNksz Ntuli. Uthe leli loli elimshayisile belihamba emzileni ohamba izimoto ezigijimayo. “Kwakona ukuthi leli loli belihamba emzileni wezimoto ezigijimayo, akukho emthethweni yingakho nje ligcine selenza ingozi ecishe yabulala inqwaba yabantu,” kusho uNksz Ntuli. Uthe uyafisa ukuthi amaloli ahlolisiswe kahle ukuthi asesimeni esikahle ngaphambi kokuthi angene emgwaqweni. “Ngicabanga ukuthi kumele kwenziwe uphenyo olunzulu ngale ngozi ngoba kuyaqapheleka ukuthi izingozi eziningi ikakhulukazi kuN3 zidalwa ngamaloli asuke ephelelwe ngamabhuleki,” kusho uNksz Ntuli. Uthe amaphoyisa ayithathile iloli emuva kwesigameko. UMthethwa we-ANC naye imoto yakhe elimele kulengozi uthe empeleni bayisikhombisa abantu abathintekayo kulesi sehlakalo. “Umshayeli weloli uvumile endaweni yesehlakalo ukuthi iloli lakhe liphelelwe ngamabhuleki,” kusho uMthethwa. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLt Clonel Thulani Zwane, uthe kuvulwe icala lokushayela budedengu esiteshini samaphoyisa eHillcrest emva kwengozi eyenzeke kuN3, ngoLwesihlanu.
Abalingisi boZalo Abalingisi boZalo KUQALILE ukusebenza ngoMsombuluko la kuqoshwa khona umdlalo Uzalo, njengoba kuvela izindaba zokuthi ithimba labaqophi nabalingisi akade bengakhokheliwe beyitholile imali yabo ngoMgqibelo. Lokhu kulandela ukuthi kume nse ukuqopha kwalo mdlalo ngoMsombuluko odlule ngemuva kokuthi ithimba eliqopha lo mdlalo livuke umbhejazane lathi liwabeka phansi amathuluzi njengoba lingaholile. Kulo mdlalo bekunezinkinga zezimali njengoba inkampani eqopha lo mdlalo iStained Glass, ibingenye yezinkampani ebezingakhokheliwe uSABC. UKoketso Phala okhulumela lo mdlalo uthe ngemuva kokuthi akade bengaholile bethole imiholo yabo baphindelile emsebenzini bayoqhubeka la begcine khona. "Kuqalile namhlanje ukusebenza wonke umuntu ukhona emsebenzini. Imiholo ingenile ngoMgqibelo bonke base bazizwa ukuthi kusukela izolo sebengaqala kuzoqhutshekwa nomsebenzi," kuchaza yena. Abaqophi yibona abafike bamisa yonke into njengoba baveza ukuthi imali yabo ayingenile ngakho ngeke bakwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi. UNeo Momodu okhulumela iSABC, uthe basabhekene nezinkinga zezimali kodwa lokho abafuni kuphazamiseke abasebenzi babo nezinkampani abasebenza nazo. "Ngeke sisho ukuthi ukukhokhelana kwezinkampani esisebenza nazo kuhamba kugcinephi uma sesikhokhelana lokho kuphakathi kwethu. Izinkinga zezimali zikhona futhi sisaqhubeka nokuxoxisana nezinye izinkampani ezingaphansi kwethu," kusho uNeo. Ithimba lalo mdlalo liphinde laveza ukuthi bese kusabalale amahebenzi okuthi kuzoba nenhlolokhono yokuthungatha abalingisi abasha nokuyinto engelona iqiniso. UMmamitse Thibedi onguphrojusa walo mdlalo uthe, inhlolokhono obekuthiwa ingoSepthemba 2, abayazi bona. “Uma kukhona esifuna ukukumemezela emphakathini okuthinta inhlolokhono noma yini sisebenzisa izinkundla zethu zokuxhumana bese sikhangisa naseziteshini zakwaSABC. Siyanxusa ukuthi abantu baqaphele uma kunezikhangiso ezifana nalezi," kuchaza yena.
OWAYENGUNGQONGQOSHE kulo mnyango uNkk Bathabile Dlamini. Isithombe: Ntswe Mokoena/GCIS OWAYENGUNGQONGQOSHE kulo mnyango uNkk Bathabile Dlamini. Isithombe: Ntswe Mokoena/GCIS LIFUNA izincazelo ikomiti elibheka ukusebenza kwezimali zomphakathi, iStanding Committee on Public Accounts (Scopa) kwiSassa ngokusebenza kukaR4 million kuhlelwa umcimbi owodwa KwaZulu-Natal. Leli komiti lithi mithathu imicimbi eyahlelwa, uwodwa wabiza uR4 million. USihlalo waleli komiti uMnuz Themba Godi, ugxeke ukungalandelwa kwemigudu efanele ngesikhathi kusebenza imali engaka ngomcimbi owodwa. KuR4 million kuthiwa kwaqashwa itende ngoR485 000, izindlu zangasese ngoR490 000, ukuhlobisa izihlalo ngoR487 000, okokwendlala phansi etendeni ngoR482 000, ukuphekela izicukuthwane kwaba nguR493 000, izinto zokuthutha kwaba nguR493 000, i-sound system yaba nguR492 000, kwathi izipho zaba nguR480 000. Isikhulu seSassa esasibambile uNksz Pearl Bhengu kuthiwa uyagula ngakho akakwazanga ukufika azochazela ikomiti izolo ePhalamende. “UNksz Bhengu waphuthuma ukugunyaza le micimbi, wakwenza lokhu ngaphandle kokufuna ama-quotations amathathu okuyinto edingekayo. Kuyacaca ukuthi kwanyuswa imali kule micimbi,” kusho uGodi. Uthe ibamba lesikhulu esiphezulu uMnuz Abraham Mahlangu, noNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi uNksz Susan Shabangu bazibophezele ekutheni zizothathelwa izinyathelo izikhulu ezithintekayo nemali izobuyiswa uma kunesidingo sokuthi ibuye. “Sinxuse uNkk Mahlangu ukuthi ayibheke indaba yonogada abanikwa uNksz Bhengu kusuka ngo-2012 nemali eyasebenza kulokhu. Sizoyibheka eyokuthi ngelanga esiyophonsa ngayo imibuzo le nhlangano kube nomnyango kamgcinimafa.” UMnuz Tim Brauteseth, okhulumela iDA kwiScopa, uthe bazobhalela uNksz Shabangu ukuze kuthathelwe izinyathelo ngokushesha owayenguNgqongqoshe walo mnyango uNksz Bathabile Dlamini noNksz Bhengu ngokusebenzisa uR16 million ngemicimbi engaqondakali. “Emhlanganweni weScopa kuvele ukuthi uNksz Bhengu wasayina uR16 million ngoDisemba nyakenye ukuze kwenziwe imicimbi yokufundisa kungalandelwanga imigudu efanele. “Baphendula iSassa ibhange labo lokushushumbisa imali ngezinto ezingabasizanga ngalutho abantu abahola imali yempesheni,” kusho uMnuz Brauteseth. Uthe ukususwa kukaNksz Bhengu KwaZulu-Natal akusizi ngoba wenza umonakalo omkhulu wathi kumele amiswe ngokushesha kusenziwa uphenyo, uma etholakala enecala abuyise le mali eyasebenza.
Lesi sitshudeni sesilisa okuthiwa sifunda eDurban University of Technology (DUT), besisuka esitezi sesithupha ophikweni lwaseML Sultan kusona lesi sikhungo Lesi sitshudeni sesilisa okuthiwa sifunda eDurban University of Technology (DUT), besisuka esitezi sesithupha ophikweni lwaseML Sultan kusona lesi sikhungo SEKUQUBUKE indida ngesitshudeni sesikhungo semfundo ephakeme eThekwini, esithanqazeke esitezi sashona ngoLwesihlanu, osekuvele nezinsolo zokweba. Lesi sitshudeni sesilisa okuthiwa sifunda eDurban University of Technology (DUT), besisuka esitezi sesithupha ophikweni lwaseML Sultan kusona lesi sikhungo. Imininingwane yalesi sigameko nekamufi ibingakatholakali kodwa sekuvele imibiko eminingi ngaye njengoba abanye bekuphika ukuthi ubebaleka. Lolu daba belusematheni nayizolo ekhasini likaFacebook lezitshudeni abanye bebemgagula nangegama umufi. Ezinye izitshudeni ziveze ukuthi umufi ubekade ephuca owesifazane iselula, wabaleka. Zithe ubejahwa ngesikhathi eziphonsa esitezi, waphahlazeka kwachitheka ubuchopho. Ezinye izitshudeni kuFacebook zithe ziyamazi umufi futhi ziyakungabaza ukuthi ubentshontsha njengoba zingamazeli okubi. Zisole ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ubezama ukuzibulala ngezinkinga ezithize. Lesi sigameko esishaqise izitshudeni senzeke ngezithuba zabo 4 ntambama. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant-Colonel Thulani Zwane, uthe kuphenywa idokodo lokufa komuntu esiteshini eBerea. Uthe kabanayo eminye imininingwane ngomufi ngaphandle kokuthi uphonseke esitezi kulesi sikhungo. Ongumengameli wesigungu sezitshudeni eDUT, uSphephelo Mthembu, uthe ngeke akwazi ukuphawula ngoba usemngcwabeni wacela ukubuye athintwe. Isitatimende esikhishwe wuphiko lwezokuxhumana nabezindaba eDUT sisiqinisekisile isigameko kodwa yangavela eminye imininingwane futhi sangacacisa ukuthi yisitshudeni esishonile. “Isikhungo sisazama ukuthola eminye imininingwane eqondile ngalesi sigameko, esisabikelwe ukuthi ngesokuzibulala. Uma sesithole yonke imininingwane sizokhipha umbiko ocacisayo,” kusho isitatimende.
ABABHIKISHI abazibiza ngeCitizens In Unity abavale isonto likaMfundisi Timothy Omotoso ePort Elizabeth izolo abathe bazolivala noma lingabekwa kuphi ABABHIKISHI abazibiza ngeCitizens In Unity abavale isonto likaMfundisi Timothy Omotoso ePort Elizabeth izolo abathe bazolivala noma lingabekwa kuphi KUPHELILE ngesonto lomfundisi obhekene namacala okudlwengula ePort Elizabeth (PE), izolo okubhuntshe inkonzo umphakathi ubhikisha ngaphandle. Amalungu ebandla leJesus Dominion International eholwa nguMfundisi Timothy Omotoso, aphume esephelezelwa amaphoyisa ekhishwa ngababhikishi abazibiza ngeCitizens In Unity. Umbhikisho ubuholwa yi-ANC Youth League (ANCYL) ne-ANC Women’s League (ANCWL) kukhona namalungu e-EFF nezinye izinhlaka zomphakathi. Izolo kujikijelwane ngamazwi phakathi kwamalungu ebandla nababhikishi abaqale ukuqhinqa ngaphandle kwesonto ngo-9 ekuseni. UMnuz Luyolo Nqakula okhulumela i-ANCYL kwelinye lamagatsha ePE utshele Isolezwe ukuthi bakujabulele ukuthi umbhikisho wabo ube yimpumelelo. “Sizamile ukukhuluma kahle nobuholi bebandla kodwa basidelela. Sithole ukuthi isonto alinaso isitifiketi futhi ibhilidi akumele liphendulwe isonto. Umyalezo wethu emalungwini ebandla ukuthi leli sonto alinandawo ePE futhi noma bangalibeka kuphi sizolivala,” kusho uNqakula. Uthe sebekhulumile noMasipala wakuqinisekisa ukuthi namuhla uzothumela ikomiti ukuyovala ibhilidi, kususwe nophawu lwebandla. Okhulumela i-EFF uMnuz Luvuyo Ponase uthe banqume ukuhlanganyela kulo mbhikisho ngoba lolu daba luthinta umphakathi. Uthe ibhilidi alikho esimeni sokuthi kube nesonto kodwa yindawo yebhizinisi. Ngesikhathi abazalwane bephuma esontweni abanye bebegxeka ababhikishi bethi ngeke bayeke ukweseka umfundisi abambiza ngendoda kaNkulunkulu. Omunye wabaholi bebandla onqabe negama lakhe utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ngeke aphawule lutho maqede wavala ucingo. UMasipala iNelson Mandela Bay ukuqinisekisile ukuthi ibhillidi lalingakhelwe ukuthi kusontwe kulo. Inhlangano yamabandla esimanje iChurch Leaders Council of South Africa ithe iyazwelana nabo bonke abesifazane abathinteka odabeni lokuhlukunyezwa u-Omotoso. Okhulumela inhlangano uMfundisi Nathi Zondi uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi konke lokhu kwenziwe egameni lesonto. Uthe bayathemba ukuthi kuzokwenzeka ubulungiswa kuleli cala abafuna lithethwe ngenhlonipho nangokuvikela abagilwa. UMFUNDISI Timothy Omotoso osolwa ngamacala okudlwengula. Isithombe: Raahil Sain/African News Agency (ANA) Icala lika-Omotoso elithethwa eNkantolo eNkulu ePE liqale ukushuba uNksz Cheryl Zondi ongomunye wabagilwa ethula ubufakazi. Kulindeleke kuvele abanye ofakazi njengoba icala libuyela enkantolo namuhla. I-Citizens In Unity izobhikisha namuhla enkantolo kanti UMengameli we-ANCWL uNksz Bathabile Dlamini uzobiza izithangami nabezindaba namuhla. U-Omotoso odabuka eNigeria ubhekene namacala angu-63 okubalwa awokudlwengula nokushushumbisa abantu. Uboshwe noNksz Lusanda Sulani NoZukiswa Sitho abasolwa ngokumsiza ekushushumbiseni amantombazane.
UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa. Isithombe: Bheki Radebe / ANA UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa. Isithombe: Bheki Radebe / ANA ABAHLAZIYI bepolitiki bathi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uzama ukugaya amavoti njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo, ngokusheshisa udaba lokuguqula isigatshana u25 soMthethosisekelo othinta udaba lo mhlaba. NgoLwesibili ebusuku uRamaphosa uvele kuSABC ememezela ukuthi i-ANC izovotela ukuthi kuchitshiyelwe lesi sigaba 25 soMthethosisekelo ukuze ithathe umhlaba wabantu abazimele ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo iwunike abawuswele. “Kuyasicacela sonke ukuthi abantu bakithi bafuna umthethosisekelo ucacise udaba lokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Lokhu sikubone kwizithangami zodaba lomhlaba ezenzeka kuzwelonke,” kusho uRamaphosa. Umhlaziyi wepolitiki uMnuz Thabani Khumalo uthe kusobala ukuthi uRamaphosa useqala ukukhankasa ngoba udaba lo mhlaba yilona olunyakazisa abantu kuwo wonke amazinga. “I-ANC isiyaxhamazela, ithatha umkhankaso we-EFF ibe ingazi ukuthi izowenza kanjani. Ayilwenzanga ucwaningo ebantwini, emakhosini nakuzo zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo. URamaphosa wenze isimemezelo yize izithangami zodaba lomhlaba zisaqhubeka, lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi akanazo izinhlelo ezicacile,” kusho uKhumalo. Uthe okokuqala i-ANC yayinohlelo lokubuyiswa komhlaba ngesinxephezelo, engakaze yenze umbiko ngalo, isho nokuthi yimaphi amaphutha enzekile. Omunye umhlaziyi wepolitiki uMnuz Bukani Mngoma uthe kungenzeka ukuthi uRamaphosa ukhulume ngodaba lomhlaba ngoba efuna ukususa amehlo abantu kwi-EFF ebeyigubha iminyaka emihlanu yasungulwa futhi ikhuluma ngodaba lomhlaba. “Kungenzeka ukuthi ufuna ukukhombisa abanye kwi-ANC ukuthi ulusukumele phezulu udaba lo mhlaba ngoba beluvamise ukukhulunywa ngabantu akade beseka uDkt Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma. Asingakhohlwa nokuthi sekusondele ukhetho futhi udaba lomhlaba yilona oluhamba phambili naye useqalile ukugaya ivoti,” kusho uMngoma. Uthe inkulumo kaRamaphosa izodida abatshalizimali ngoba abasaqondi ukuthi uhulumeni umiphi odabeni lomhlaba nokuthi uma sewuwuthatha ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo imali yabo izophepha kangakanani. UKhumalo uthe abatshalizimali bazoba manqika ukuthi bafake imali yabo emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika ngoba abazi ukuthi iphephe kangakanani. UMnuz Omri van Zyl ongoMqondisi we-AgriSA uthe uRamaphosa nesigungu esiphezulu bekufanele balinde imibono yabantu ngaphambi kokwenza isimemezelo. “Ukuchitshiyelwa kwesigaba esithile somthethosisekelo kusho ukuthi usengcupheni wonke umthethosisekelo. Kuzoba nomthelela omubi emnothweni wethu lokhu,” kusho uVan Zyl. Umholi weDA uMnuz Mmusi Maimane usole uRamaphosa ngokungahleleki nokungakhathaleli izwe. “URamaphosa usitshela ukuthi imibono yabantu ngeke bayilalele ngoba sebezokwenza intando yabo beyi-ANC. Sizolwisana nale mizamo yabo yokuwisa umnotho wethu nokuthi umhlaba ube sezandleni zikahulumeni okhohlakele,” kusho uMaimane. USotshwebhu we-IFP ePhalamende, uMnuz Narend Singh uthe abahambisani nokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo ngoba lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bazogcina sebehlala emijondolo ngoba uhulumeni ukhohlakele.

Unina womfana ofunda uGrade 5 uthe kuthiwa indodana yakhe nabangani bayo ababili babefunda iphepha behleka ekilasini ngesikhathi kungena uthisha wababiza wabanciza izindlebe. Ababili wabancinza izindlebe wabayeka kodwa indodana yakhe wayincinza indlebe wayishaya ngenduku nangempama kwaze kwakhuza omunye uthisha. “Ingane ibuye imidwayidwa emhlane ihuzukile nasesiphongweni. Anginankinga nokuthi ingane ijeziswe uma yonile okungiphatha kabi ukuthi uthisha ayishaye ize ilimale,” kusho unina wengane. NgoLwesihlanu uthe uyile esikoleni ethi uyobikela uthishanhloko ngalolu daba wafika engekho. Uthisha osolwa ngokubhaxabula umfundi uthe uvele waba nolaka ngoba umfundi ubelubamba uswazi engafuni ukushaywa. Uthisha nomzali, abaganele ndawonye, kuthiwa ababhekani emva kwengxabano yomndeni. “Kuyiqiniso ukuthi asikhulumisani futhi asingenelani. Angazi noma ulaka akhuluma ngalo luvuswe wukuthi ingane izalwa yizitha zakhe yini ngoba phela ezinye izingane ebezihleka neyami azishaywanga ngenduku, zincinzwe izindlebe kuphela,” kusho yena. Umzali uthe ngempelasonto kufike amanye amalungu esigungu sesikole ethi azoxolisela uthisha. “Bathe uthisha uyaxolisa, uma ngiqhubeka nokubika lolu daba kwabaphethe ngizobe ngibeka umsebenzi kathishanhloko engcupheni. Angimangalelanga uthishanhloko mina, ngimangalele uthisha oshaye ingane yami,” kusho yena. UNkk Alberta Tuswa, oyilungu lesigungu, uzihlangulile kulolu daba wathi umzali akakaze ababikele ngalo futhi abakaze baludingide. “Akukho esingakuphawula ngoba umzali ubone singabalulekile wayovula icala emaphoyiseni waya nakodokotela. Manje sesishayelwa ucingo ngabezindaba angiboni ukuthi kukhona esisengakwenza,” usho kanje. UMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uthe bayadumala ukuthi kusekhona othisha abashaya izingane yize bebona ukuthi ozakwabo abenza lokhu bajeziswa kanjani. “Siyajabula ngoba umzali uvule icala kodwa nathi sizokwenza olwethu uphenyo bese sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele,” kusho yena. ULt Col Thulani Zwane okhulumela amaphoyisa uthe kuvulwe icala lokushaywa komfundi okuthiwa kwenziwe uthisha ekilasini. Uthe icala liphenywa ngamaphoyisa aseNtsikeni, akukaboshwa muntu.

Uthe ngesikhathi eqala iMuvhango, iSABC yayifuna izinhlelo ezikhuluma ngamasiko abantu abamnyama. “Kwaba yinkinga ngoba abantu babengajwayele ukuzibona ngale ndlela kwithelevishini. Kusho ukuthi ngosuku abantu abangu-18 million babuka imidlalo eqalwe yimi. Okwami ukuqeqesha abalingisi abasha futhi ngeke ngime njengoba nale eminye imidlalo isiphethwe ngabantu abasha. Nami ngaqala ngimncane futhi ngiyakholelwa kubantu abasha,” kusho uNdlovu.

UKhumalo uneMasters kwiTourism Development, uke waba ngumqondisi wohlelo oluqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zezokuvakasha ziyenziwa ezifundazweni ezigudle ulwandle, kulezi zinhlelo bekukhona izinhlelo zezokuvakasha ezihlanganisa nemvelo. Kulolu hlelo usebenze iminyaka eyisishagalombili. Uqhube wathi kunamathuba amaningi okukhula emkhakheni wezokuvakasha, wezemvelo kanjalo nasemkhakheni wamasiko nomlando.
USASHAQEKILE umphakathi waseLovu emuva kokuboshwa komthandazi ophinde abe yinyanga (42) osolwa ngokudlwengula indodakazi yakhe (19) nokusolakala ukuthi uyikhulelisile. Lo mlisa obevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNsimbini izolo kuthiwa uboshwe ngeSonto ebusuku emuva kokuthi evulelwe icala yindodakazi yakhe okuthiwa ubeyidlwengula ephindelela. Indodakazi yakhe eyenza uGrade 11 kukholakala ukuthi seyinezinyanga ezintathu ikhulelwe, akukaziwa ukuthi ubani oyikhulelisile phakathi kwakhe nesoka layo abeyiphoqa ukuthi iyolala nalo njalo uma eseyidlwengulile. Unina wale ngane (38) esalaliswe esibhedlela esingadalulwanga njengoba iselashwa nobengahlali nayo njengoba ahlukana noyise isencane uthe uthole ngeSonto ngokudlwengulwa kwayo. “Ngithole * -call back obuvela kwindodakazi yami ngeSonto ekuseni ngayifonela yase idlulisela ucingo komunye umuntu ongitshele ukuthi ngize ngizoyilanda esiteshini samaphoyisa ngokushesha. Ngize ngakwazi ukufika ebusuku ngoba bengisuka kude. Kuthe uma sengisendleleni ngaphinde ngashaya ucingo ngazama ukuthola ukuthi ikuphi yangitshela ukuthi isesibhedlela. Ngishaywe uvalo ngathi ayingitshele ukuthi kwenzekeni ngoba bebelokhu bengasho ngesikhathi beqala ukungifonela. Ibe seyingitshela ukuthi uyise ubeyidlwengula,” kusho unina wale ngane. Uthe ngesikhathi bebonana nendodakazi yakhe imbikele ukuthi uyise ubeyidlwengula bese eyisabisa ngokuthi uzoyithumelela ngezulu. Ubethi uma eseyidlwengulile bese ethi ayiyolala nesoka layo ngenkani ukuze kuthi noma ikhulelwa kube sengathi yilona. Uthe ingane yakhe itshele umngani wayo ukuthi uyise uyayidlwengula base beya kovula icala ngeSonto ekuseni emuva kokuthi egcine ukuyidlwengula ngoMgqibelo ebusuku. “Namanje ikhanda lami lisaphithene ngoba bengingazitsheli ukuthi kunento efana nalena eyenzekayo. Uyise wafika wazomthatha ekhaya ngo-2016. Bekungathi bahleli kahle kodwa kwathi uma ivakasha ngoJuni kulo nyaka ngabona sengathi kukhona okungamphethe kahle. Ngesikhathi ngimbuza uthe ukhathele ngoba ufunda kakhulu. Uthe uqale ukumdlwengula ngoMashi wathi wayesaba ukusho ngoba ubemsabisa,” kusho unina wale ngane. Uthe okumphatha kabi kakhulu ukuthi ugogo wengane ozala uyise uyamfonela amthuke njengoba eboshiwe. Unina wengane uthe ingane ithe ifisa sengathi uyise angayitholi ibheyili ngoba izibona ingaphephile uma engaphumela ngaphandle. Umthombo osondelene nalolu daba uthe umphakathi wakule ndawo usashaqekile mayelana nokuvela kwezinsolo zokudlwengula ezibekwe lo mthandazi okuthiwa ubehlonishwa endaweni. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lo mlisa uboshiwe nokuthi uvele enkantolo ngoLwesibili. Kulindeleke ukuthi umsolwa aphindele enkantolo ngoLwesithathu oluzayo ukuze afake isicelo sebheyili.
BEKUKHALA ibhungane erenki yamatekisi akwaMNR eMlaza ngesonto elidlule ngemuva kokubulawa kwabashayeli ababili ngoLwesibili ntambama. Abashayeli bamatekisi ahamba kulo mzila bathe bazizwa bengaphephile Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng/African News Agency (ANA) BEKUKHALA ibhungane erenki yamatekisi akwaMNR eMlaza ngesonto elidlule ngemuva kokubulawa kwabashayeli ababili ngoLwesibili ntambama. Abashayeli bamatekisi ahamba kulo mzila bathe bazizwa bengaphephile Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng/African News Agency (ANA) KUSAME nse ukusebenza kwamatekisi erenki yaseMlaza, iMNR naseNgonyameni njengoba ososeshini bakulezi zindawo bengavumelananga emhlanganweni kulandela ukubulawa kwabashayeli abangaphansi kwasoseshini uMNR eMlaza. NgoLwesibili ntambama kubulawe abashayeli bamatekisi ababili kwizigameko ezehlukene. Umshayeli oyedwa udutshulwe ka-D kanti omunye udutshulwe kwa-M. Kuthiwa ukubulawa kwalaba bashayeli kulandela ukubangwa kwemizila phakathi kososeshini ababili iMNR Taxi neNgonyameni Taxi. Kuthiwa osomatekisi bakwaMNR banqabele amatekisi aseNgonyameni ukuthi asebenzise umgwaqo odlula eMlaza uma beya eThekwini nokusolwa ukuthi yikho okususe lolu thuthuva. Izolo ososeshini iMNR Taxi neNgonyameni Taxi babe nomhlangano obulawula yisifunda iNingizumu 2. UNobhala weNingizimu 2, uMnuz Mandla Malishe, uthe baphume bedangele kulo mhlangano njengoba kungabanga nokuzwana kulabo soseshini. “UMnyango wezokuThutha usungenelele kulolu daba njengoba uze wasiyalele ngokumele sikwenze ukuze sixazulule lolu daba, kodwa umhlangano awubanga nenqubekela phambili njengoba kugejane amazwi kulabo soseshini,” kusho uMalishe. Isolezwe latshelwa umthombo walo ukuthi usoseshini waseNgonyameni uneminyaka wacela ukuncikiswa owaMNR. “Ubudlelwana bube muncu ngoba usoseshini waseNgonyameni awuyinyusanga imali yokugibela kule nyanga, uMNR uyinyuse ngo50c kubagibeli abaya ngaphakathi eMlaza, kwabaya eThekwini inyuke ngo R1,” kusho umthombo. Umthombo uthe ukunganyuswa kwemali kwamatekisi aseNgonyameni kuthathwe ngendlela yokudla umsebenzi wakwaMNR kwabe sekukhishwa umyalelo wokuthi bengabe besaguduza emzileni ohamba uMNR, bahambe ngoMangosuthu Highway. Amatekisi awabonwa erenki yakuMNR emva kokudutshulwa kosomatekisi, kanti abagibeli bagibela amabhasi, abanye bagibela awakwa-E, F nakwa-G. UMnuz Sifiso Shangase, oyimenenja ehhovisi leSantaco KwaZulu-Natal, ucele labo soseshini ukuthi baxoxisane. “Njengoba siyimboni yamatekisi sikhona ukusiza umphakathi, ngakho uma lungaxazululwa lolu daba umphakathi uyahlukumezeka,” kusho uShangase.
ABANTU sebezokwazi ukubona ukuthi basalelwe yi-data engakanani kumaselula abo futhi izinkampani zokuxhumana ziyalelwe ukuthi zibazise uma isiphelile zingavele zithathe imali yabo. I-Independent Communication Authority of South Africa (Icasa) iyalele izinkampani zokuxhumana ukuthi zazise amakhasimende azo ngokusebenza kwe-data futhi kube yiwona azinika igunya lokuthi zithathe imali uma sekuphele i-data. Njengamanje uma kuphela i-data izinkampani zamaselula zivele zidle imali uma umuntu kade efake i-airtime. I-Icasa ithe ayifuni kushaye uFebhuwari abantu besathathelwa imali. NgoLwesithathu inkampani yezokuxhumana iMTN ithe amakhasimende ayo azokwaziswa nge-data esisele. “Amakhasimende ethu azokwaziswa ukuthi asebenzise i-data engakanani kusukela kwengu-50% kuya phezulu. Sizowacela ukuthi asinike igunya lokuthatha imali uma eseqede i-data,” kusho abakwaMTN esitatimendeni. ITelkom nayo yenza isimemezelo esifana nesikaMTN ngenyanga edlule futhi kulindeleke ukuthi nezinye izinkampani zamaselula ezingakazimemezeli lezi zindaba ukuthi zilandele maduze. I-Icasa ithe izosebenza kanzima ukwehlisa intengo ye-data ekhalisa abantu njengoba isaqhubeka nezingxoxo nezinkampani zamaselula ukuze zehlise izindleko zokuxhumana.
UDANNY Jordaan ongumengameli weSafa uthembise ukuthi izoqala ngonyaka ozayo iligi yabesifazane eNingizimu Afrika Isithombe: BACKPAGEPIX UDANNY Jordaan ongumengameli weSafa uthembise ukuthi izoqala ngonyaka ozayo iligi yabesifazane eNingizimu Afrika Isithombe: BACKPAGEPIX UMENGAMELI weSouth African Football Association (Safa), uDanny Jordaan, ukholwa wukuthi kuzolotha konke obekwenzeka ngombango wesikhundla, kugxilwe emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa ibhola eNingizimu Afrika. UJordaan uphinde waqokelwa kwesokwengamela iSafa ngaphandle kokuphikiswa embuthanweni wokukhetha obukade useSandton Convention Centre eGauteng ngoMgqibelo. Ezinyangeni ezimbalwa bekubukeka uzoshisa phansi umbango wesikhundla kodwa uJordaan ugcine eselungenele yedwa ukhetho. Ukhetho lucishe lwabhuntsha kulandela ukuthi kube khona abafaka incwadi yokulumisa enkontolo kodwa bachithwa. UJordaan uthe ukholwa wukuthi sesidlulile isivunguvungu, wadalula izinhloso zakhe njengoba esethatha elinye ihlandla. “Ngethemba ukuthi konke kuzobuyela esimeni esijwayelekile ebholeni laseMzansi. Ikakhulukazi isikhathi esiphakathi kuka 2018 no-2022. Sifuna ukubheka ukuthi singaliqinisa kanjani ibhola labesifazane ezweni. Sibonile kusukela kwabaphethe imidlalo ukuthi esigungwini sikazwelonke sinabesifazane abathathu kuphela. Kodwa kumaLFA nasezifundeni sinabesifazane abangu-810 abasebenza ebholeni emazingeni aphansi,” kusho uJordaan. UJordaan ubuyela esikhundleni nje, ubhekwe ukuthi afeze izethembiso zakhe ngokuthuthukiswa kwebhola eMzansi. Iningi aliyizwa indaba yakhe. UJordaan uphumele obala ngesifiso sokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ingenele umbango wokusingatha iNdebe yoMhlaba yabesifazane. “Ngokwabadlali sifuna ukwenyusa isibalo sabesifazane nokwethula iligi ngo-2019 nokubheka ukuthi singakwazi yini ukusingatha iNdebe yoMhlaba yabesifazane. Sizoqoka ikomiti elizohlela, uma sekukhona elikhutholile, sizohlala phansi nohulumeni nongqongqoshe wezemidlalo ukuzwa ukuthi uyahambisana yini nathi. Uma ubheka amanye amazwe asingathe iNdebe yoMhlaba, ngo-1994 asingatha eyabesilisa kwathi ngo-1999 asingatha eyabesifazane. Lokho kwasiza ekukhuliseni ibhola labesifazane. “Uma ubheka iFrance yasingatha iNdebe yoMhlaba ngoo-1998 futhi izosingatha eyabesifazane ngonyaka ozayo * -2019. I-Germany yasingatha eyabesilisa ngo-2006, yasingatha eyabesifazane ngo-2011,” kusho uJordaan. “Inselelo wukuthi uyisebenzisa kanjani ingqalasizinga yeNdebe yoMhlaba. Ngo-2010 sadlula kakhulu kokwakulindelwe kithina. Eyabesifazane inamaqembu angu-24, hhayi angu-32 kodwa ngesikhathi siqeda iNdebe yoMhlaba ngo-2010, isidingo sezinkundla sanyuka. Sesihlale iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, akufanele silinde kakhulu.”
ISISHOSHOVU se-ANC uMnuz Mendi Msimang esidlule emhlabeni emuva kokugula isikhathi eside. Abaningi bamchaze njengengqalabutho eyalwela amalungelo abantu ISISHOSHOVU se-ANC uMnuz Mendi Msimang esidlule emhlabeni emuva kokugula isikhathi eside. Abaningi bamchaze njengengqalabutho eyalwela amalungelo abantu KUCHAZWE njengokuwa kwensika ukudlula emhlabeni kwesishoshovu se-ANC, uMnuz Mendi Msimang, odlule emhlabeni izolo ngemuva kokugula isikhathi eside. UMsimang, owayeyiHigh Commissioner yase-United Kingdom (UK), uchazwe njengengqalabutho eyalwela amalungelo abantu. Ungumyeni kaDkt Manto Tshabalala-Msimang, owayenguNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo owadlula emhlabeni ngo-2009. UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa udlulise amazwi endunduzo emndenini, kubangani, izihlobo nakubantu bakuleli ngokudlula emhlabeni kwalesi sishoshovu esamela i-ANC eLondon ngo-1960. Uthe uMsimang wabuya ekumeleni le nhlangano wabe esejutshwa e-UK ngowayengumengameli wezwe uDkt Nelson Mandela. “Sigobisa amakhanda sikhumbula ubaba Mendi Msimang ngoba izwe lilahlekelwe kakhulu ngaleli qhawe. Ukudlula kwakhe kumele kugqugquzele wonke umuntu ukuthi azigqaje ngomlando siphinde sihloniphe nezingqalabutho esezadlula.” URamaphosa uthe imininingwane yomngcwabo izokhishwa uma uhulumeni esebonisene nomndeni kanjalo ne-ANC. UMsimang ubeyilungu lekomiti elibhekela ukuziphatha kwi-ANC futhi esekomitini eliluleka ngokuthi obani okumele bahlonishwe ngumengameli kanti uke waba ngumgcinimafa wale nhlangano. Okhulumela i-ANC, uMnuz Pule Mabe, uthe kuwe insika ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaMsimang. Uthe ubeyilungu lale nhlangano iminyaka eminingi kanti wake waba nayilungu lophiko lwentsha. “Sishaqekile ngokudlula emhlabeni kwalesi sishoshovu ebesaziwa ngomalume Mendi. Wasebenza nezingqalabutho ezingoWalter Sisulu nezinye kwi-ANCYL.” Uthe wasebenza eqeqeshelwa umsebenzi enkampanini yabameli kaNelson Mandela no-Oliver Tambo. Waya ekudingisweni ngo-1961 ngesikhathi i-ANC ivalwa umlomo. Wabuya ezweni waqokelwa esigungwini esiphezulu se-ANC ngo-1991. Waba yilungu lePhalamende ngo-1994 waphinde waba nguSihlalo wekhokhasi ye-ANC ePhalamende. Waqokelwa kwesikamgcinimafa we-ANC ngo-1997 engqungqutheleni yaseMafikeng lapho owayengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Thabo Mbeki aqokelwa kwesikamengameli we-ANC. Waba ngumgcinimafa kwaze kwaba ngu-2007. Ngo-1999 uMsimang wahlonishwa ngendondo yesiliva nguMandela nezinye izishoshovu zomzabalazo. “Siyamhlonipha ngemisebenzi yakhe nokuzinikela ezweni. Sizoqhubeka sigubhe ubuholi namava akhe sigcine negama lakhe emlandweni ukuze izizukulwane zifunde ngaye,” kusho uMabe. Ne-UDM ngomlomo kaMengameli wayo uGeneral Bantu Holomisa ibhonge emswanini yadlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini kaMsimang. “Kumele simhloniphe ngokuthi sithuthukise impilo yabantu. Kumele siqede imijondolo sithuthukise ezempilo ukuze simhloniphe ngendlela ngoba ubengumuntu osezingeni elifanayo noMandela,” kusho uHolomisa. UNobhala jikelele weSaftu, uMnuz Zwelinzima Vavi, naye udlulise amazi enduduzo wathi ubemhlonipha kakhulu uMsimang.
U-Aneliswa noNelisa Mxakaza (22) baseMayville, eThekwini, bakhiphe isitatimende kuFacebook bexolisa ngokuvikela uMfundisi Tim Omotoso ngesikhathi eboshwa emuva kokubekwa amacala ngonyaka odlule U-Aneliswa noNelisa Mxakaza (22) baseMayville, eThekwini, bakhiphe isitatimende kuFacebook bexolisa ngokuvikela uMfundisi Tim Omotoso ngesikhathi eboshwa emuva kokubekwa amacala ngonyaka odlule AMAWELE adume kuma-Idols abuye ahlala isikhathi eside emzini womfundisi waseNigeria obhekene namacala okudlwengulwa, akhulume okokuqala ngakubize ngokuhlukumezeka kwawo ebandleni lakhe. U-Aneliswa noNelisa Mxakaza (22) baseMayville, eThekwini, bakhiphe isitatimende kuFacebook bexolisa ngokuvikela uMfundisi Tim Omotoso ngesikhathi eboshwa emuva kokubekwa amacala ngonyaka odlule. Amawele ahlala unyaka emzini ka-Omotoso eMhlanga engamalungu ebandla lakhe iJesus Dominion International. Ngesikhathi u-Omotoso eboshwa esikhumulweni sezindiza ePort Elizabeth ngo-Ephreli, elinye lamawele lamvikela isidana. U-Omotoso ubhekene noxhaxha lwamacala okubalwa kuwo awokushushumbisa abantu nawokudlwengula. Esitatimendeni amawele athe abefana nabantu abalahlekelwe yingqondo ngenxa yempilo abeyiphila ebandleni. “Siyaxolisa kubo bonke abesifazane ngoba besibukeka sivuna u-Omotoso emacaleni okuya ocansini abhekene nawo. Sithanda ukuxolisa nakulabo abagiliwe ngoba siyabazi bonke bafana nodadewethu. Asizange sibaseke ngesikhathi bebhoboza ithumba ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabo ngoba sasiphoqekile ukuvikela u-Omotoso kwabezindaba,” kusho amawele. Isitatimende siveza ukuthi bebephoqwa ukuthi bangakhulumi okubi ngo-Omotoso. “Besihlala ngokusatshiswa ngoba akukho ebesizenzela kona ngoba sithanda. Izikhulu zebandla zasenza sabaleka emakhaya sayohlala no-Omotoso. Njengoba besiyizingane besitshelwa ukuthi nguyena osondelene noNkulunkulu, okumele sidlule kuyena kuqala. Siyazisola ngokudela abazali bethu salalela umfundisi esingamazi waseNigeria.” UMnuz Mando Makhubela, amawele amjube ukuthi awakhulumele, uthe kusenzima kuwona ukuzikhulumela ngendlela ahlulelwe ngayo ngodaba luka-Omotoso. Uthe basazama ukuthi alulekwe ngokomqondo ukuze impilo ibuyele esimeni ngokuphelele. Uziphikile izinsolo zokuthi amawele, athe aphunyuka engakaze athintwe. “Kuningi ukuhlukumezeka ngokomoya abadlule kuko u-Anele noNeliswa kodwa abazange badlwengulwe. Bebexoxelwa ngamantombazane ngokwenzeka kuwo aze anqume ukubaleka. Bekunzima ukuphumela obala ngoba bebesatshiswa. Bebegadwa usuku lonke bephuma kuphela uma beyothenga futhi bephelezelwa,” kusho uMakhubela. Uthe akuzange kube nokuthula ekhaya kusukela amawele aya kwa-Omotoso, okuyimanje asazama ukubuyisana nomndeni. Uveze nokuthi ngesikhathi eyohlala kwa-Omotoso ayesebhalisele ukuyofunda e-University of KwaZulu-Natal kodwa kulo nyaka abuyele ekolishi ukuyofunda. Okhulumela ibandla, uMfundisi Sanele Myeni, uthe bazwile ngesitatimende kodwa ngeke baphawule ngoba udaba lusenkantolo. U-Omotoso uvele enkantolo ngoMsombuluko icala lahlehliselwa uMashi 6. Kuvele ukuthi sekuboshwe nabesifazane ababili okusolwa ukuthi ubesebenzisana nabo ukushushumbisa abesifazane.

UDKT Bhekisisa Mthabela uthishanhloko waseMandla Mthethwa School of Excellence eNdumo emi egunjini lamakhompyutha Izithombe: SIBANI NGOBESE “Abadwebi babuya bathi kuzodla enkulu imali ukwakha isikole kule ndawo ngoba iphezulu futhi iyiwa. Ngabatshela bahlengezela izinyembezi ukuthi uma behluleka ukusakha kule ndawo engangiyikhombile, ngizobashintsha ngithole abanye ababezosakha lapho ngangifuna khona.” Uthe umbono wakhe wukuthi kube nesikole esizoba sendaweni yasemakhaya esifana nezenza kahle emadolobheni okwakuzofunda wonke umuntu ikakhulu abakule ndawo okuyibo ababencishwe amathuba. “Kuyangijabulisa ukuthi sigcine sivuliwe isikole. Sasifuna ukukhuphula izinga lezemfundo ngokwakha izikole zesimanje. Noma ngingakaze ngiye kosibona kodwa abantu bakhona bayangithinta njalo bafune ukuthi ngize ngizosibona lesi sikole. Nezinye esasizakha ngisasemnyangweni noma zazingeke zifike kulesi saseNdumo kodwa zazizoba sezingeni eliphezulu zifane nalezi ezisemadolobheni ezihlinzeka ngemfundo esezingeni ekubeni zisemakhaya,” kusho uMchunu. Uthe naseMsinga kwakunezinhlelo zokuthi kube nesikole esifuze lesi esasizofaka zonke izinto njengoba kwakuzohlanganyela yonke iminyango kahulumeni njengoba kwenzeka eNdumo kodwa akazi lolu hlelo lwaphelelaphi ngoba waxoshwa njengoNdunankulu. Lesi sikole kumanje sinoGrade 8, ngonyaka ozayo sizoba noGrade 9 kuthi ngo-2022 sigcine sesinawo wonke amabanga kubalwa * -matric. UDkt Bhekisisa Mthabela, uthishanhloko walesi sikole olandwe umnyango esethathe umhlalaphansi, uthe okwamanje bangu-135 abafundi bakwaGrade 8. Othisha bangu-10, amaHead of Department (HOD) mathathu. “Sekuvuliwe ukufakwa kwezicelo zokufunda ngonyaka ozayo kwaGrade 8. Asithathi kwaGrade 9 ngoba sihamba nabafundi abebefunda kulesi sikole. Abafundi sibasusa phansi size sifike nabo kwa-matric. Zingu-150 izikhala zakwGrade 8 ngonyaka ozayo, abeze abasafuna ukuthola izikhala ngoba ziyashesha ukuphela ngoba baningi abafuna izingane zabo zizofunda kulesi sikole.” Lesi sikole sinamagumbi angu-40 okufundela, i-swimming pool, amahhovisi ama-HOD, igumbi lamakhompyutha, izindawo zokukhanda izimoto, isayensi lab nokunye. Sinezindlu ezingu-10, ezinhlanu ezihlala abafana nezinhlanu ezihlala amantombazane. Indlu ngayinye ihlala abafundi abangu-20. “Kunabaqeqeshi bebhola, rugby, tennis, abokubhukuda ne-netball. Asigxilile kuphela ekufundeni kodwa nakwezemidlalo ngoba umfundi kumele kuvele ikhono lakhe bese eya lapho likhona leli khono.” ABAFUNDI baseMandla Mthethwa School of Excellence eNdumo Phezu kokuba kukhokhwa uR12 000 kwabahlala emakhaya noR32 000 kwabahlala ngaphakathi kodwa isikole sikleliswe saba nguQuintile 1 ngoba sisemakhaya futhi nezinga lokungasebenzi kompakathi liphezulu. UMthabela uthe njalo ngemiSombuluko baqeqesha othisha lapho besuke beshoda khona. Nabafundi bahlonyiswa ngemikhakha ehlukene kulandwa abantu abavela emkhakheni ehlukene ukuzokhuluma nabafundi. “Njengoba sisemakhaya nje sifundisa isiNgisi njengolimi lokuqala kanjalo nolimi olwengeziwe. Lokhu sikwenza ngoba uma kukhona umfundi esibonayo ukuthi uzoshayeka ngoba efunde ezikoleni obekungakhulunywa kusona isiNgisi enze lolu limi njengolwengeziwe. Kodwa uma ephuma esikoleni abefunda ngaso isiNgisi engenankinga yokusikhuluma alwenze njengolimi lwasekhaya.” UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane, evula ngokusemthethweni lesi sikole muva nje, uthe esakhula wayengakaze acabange ukuthi kunesikole esisendaweni yasemakhaya esingaba nedamu lokubhukuda. Uthe sakhiwe ngoR298 million wathi sikwelinye izinga. “Ngijabula ngokuthi kumanje lesi sikole sesiqalile siyasebenza. Ngonyaka ozayo sizoqhubeka nokwamukela izingane ezivela kuzo zonke izinkalo, yize sizobe sigxile kakhulu kule miphakathi eseduze.” Uthe bazohlinzekwa ngokudla kwasekuseni nsuku zonke abafundi nantambama kuzoba yiso leso. Abafuna izikhala bangathinta uMthabela ku-0849897711.
BAZOZITHOLA zonke izimfanelo zabo abasebenzi baseVBS Mutual Bank abazodilizwa njengoba umuntu obhekelele leli bhange okwamanje ememezele ukuthi abasebenzi bazokwehliswa besuka ku-126 kusale abawu-26 kuphela. Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba uNkk Louise Brugman obhekelele ezokuxhumana ehhovisi le-curator, uthe abasebenzi batshelwa ukuthi bazodilizwa ngoMeyi 13 ngesikhathi kwenziwa izinhlelo zokuthi abantu abakade belondoloze imali yabo eVBS bayoyikhipha eNedbank. Uthe abasebenzi bacelwa ukuthi bafake izicelo zezikhala eziwu-26 futhi uhlelo luhamba kahle ngoba sebeqokiwe abawu-25. “Esingakuqinisekisa wukuthi kuzodilizwa abasebenzi abawu-100 kusale abawu-25. Abadiliziwe bazozithola zonke izimfanelo zabo,” kusho uNkk Brugman. Mayelana nokuthi omasipala bazoyithola yini imali ababeyifake eVBS, uNkk Brugman uthe uma sekushaqwe impahla yezikhulu zaseVBS nabanye abahlomule ngokungemthetho kuzobuya uR1.5 billion okusho ukuthi omasipala nalabo ababefake imali engaphezu kukaR100 000 bazoyithola imali yabo. Udonse ngendlebe abakweleta iVBS ukuthi baqhubeke nokukhokha ngoba ukungakhokhi kuzobafaka enkingeni. U-Adv Terry Motau oze nombiko oveza ukuthi kunabantu abahlomule ngokungemthetho eVBS uthe akasabi lutho njengoba sekukhona abasabisa ngokumbopha. Ekhuluma ne-IOL uMotau uthe, “Angikhathazekile ngalabo abasabisa ngokungithathela izinyathelo zomthetho ngoba ngiyabona ukuthi abakaze bawufunde umbiko wami. Angikaze ngithi kunomuntu onecala kulo mbiko. Engikushilo wukuthi kunemali eyaphuma ebhange, yakhokhelwa abantu abathile, ngasho nokuthi bathole malini. Akekho engithe unecala.” Khonamanjalo, Isilo samaVenda uToni Mphephu Ramabulana, sithi sizoyikhokha yonke imali okubikwa ukuthi sayithola kutanyuzwa imali yeVBS Mutual Bank ngokungemthetho. Kubikwa ukuthi uMphephu Ramabulana wathola uR17 million kuleli bhange. NgeSonto uMphephu uveze ukuthi uzimisele ukuyikhokha le mali uma kuwukuthi wayithola, okuyinto ayichithayo ukuthi yenzeka. “Kuyishwa ukuthi * -Adv Motau neWerksman Attorneys bakubona kungenasidingo sokuthi nginikezwe ithuba lokuveza olwami uhlangothi. Ngokwazi kwami awukho uR17 million engakhokhelwa wona. Anginakho ukungabaza ukuthi uMotau nabeWerksmans Attorneys bayazi ukuthi ukuvela kwegama lami kulo mbiko kusilimaza kanjani isithunzi sami ngokunjalo nobuKhosi baseVenda. Ngifanelwe ukuphathwa kangcono,” kusho uMphephu Ramabulana encwadini ayibhalele isizwe sakhe. Uphinde waveza ukuthi miningi iminikelo ayithola kubantu abahlukene. Uthe uma kukhona imali ayithola kudliwa imali yaseVBS Mutual Bank, wayithola engazi ukuthi iphume ngomkhonyovu. “Ngiyazibophezela ukukhokha imali uma kunobufakazi bokuthi yaphuma ngezindlela ezingafanele, uma isibaliwe ukuthi malini eyaphuma ngomkhonyovu ngizoyikhokha,” usho kanje. Uzwelane kakhulu nabantu abaphazamisekile ngokudliwa kwemali eVBS Mutual Bank esho nokuthi wayengazi ukuthi kunomkhonyovu kuleli bhange. Namhlanje kulindeleke ukuthi i-EFF iphendule ngezinsolo zokuthi nayo yadla ngesikhathi kwebiwa imali esondele kuR2 billion eVBS. Lolu daba luphinde luthinte abaholi ababili abaphezulu be-ANC eLimpopo. Izolo ubuholi be-ANC kulesi sifundazwe bebuhlangene nobuholi obuphezulu be-ANC eLuthuli House buzocacisa ngokwenzeka eVBS.
UKUZIMISELA emsebenzini kukaNkanyiso Buthelezi sekumphendule isilomo kubadlali abaqeqesha eqenjini laseNanda Seminary Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE UKUZIMISELA emsebenzini kukaNkanyiso Buthelezi sekumphendule isilomo kubadlali abaqeqesha eqenjini laseNanda Seminary Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE USEPHENDUKE isilomo uNkanyiso Buthelezi , ongumqeqeshi we-hockey esikolèni sodumo saseNanda esaziwa ngeNanda Seminary. Lensizwa eneminyaka engu-23, ithi umphakathi awuwuvali umlomo ngamagalelo ayo ekuthuthukiseni izinga lomdlalo we-hockey emphakathini njengoba waziwa ngokuthi ngowabantu bebala elimhlophe. Uthando lwakhe lwalo mdlalo lisuka kude njengoba laqala esenza amabanga aphansi eBonisanani Primary, okuyisikole esiseNtuzuma esigcemeni sakwaG. Akugcinanga lapho njengoba wagcina esethole umfundaze kwezinye zezikole zabadla izambane likapondo saseMhlanga esaziwa ngeNorthwood High nakholelwa ukuthi samsiza kakhulu ngokuthuthukisa izinga lakhe njengomdlali. INanda Seminary izoqala imidlalo yeminyaka yonke ebizwa nge Spar School Girls Hockey Challenge lapho bezobe beqhudelana nezikole eziyisithupha ezisenkabeni yeTheku okubalwa kuzo iDurban Girls High, Durban Girls College, Hoerskool Port Natal, Maris Stella, Ridge Park High neSt Henry. Lo mqhudelwano unamuhla use-3 Schools’ Trust astroturf, eGlenwood. “Ngicabanga ukuthi kumele sikushintshe ukuthi sibukele i-hockey njengomdlalo wabantu abamhlophe. Ngiqala ukuzibandakanya nalo mdlalo ngike ngabhekana nezingqinamba zokubukwa ngelinye iso emphakathini engiwakhele ngenxa yokuthi bebengaqondi kahle. Izinto seziqala ukujika manje njengoba kwezinye izikhathi ngimiswa abantu ubuthaphuthaphu befuna ngibacobelele ngolwazi enginalo nglo mdlalo,” kusho uButhelezi. Uthi yize ewumuntu omatasa ngenxa yomsebenzi njengoba engumabhalane kuMasipala weTheku kodwa akumkhinyabezi ukuthi aphinde adlalele ikilabhu yangakubo i-Ink Hockey Club edlala ngaphansi kwesigaba esiphezulu kwi-Durban Central. Ukumela iqembu lesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal Hockey team, ngonyaka ka-2006 kwezinye zezinto eziyohlezi zimthokozisa kakhulu. Ukumela iqembu lesizwe kuseyiphupho alibona lisazofezeka njengoba ekholelwa kuthi iminyaka isangakuyena nanothando analo lalo mdlalo. Uzibophezele ekuqhubekeni nokutshala ulwazi emphakathini awakhele nawubona usukhombisa olukhulu ugqozi muva nje. Mekubalwa nabanye abantu asebenze lomdlalo wazakhela idumela eNanda alisali igama likaBongi Gabuza oqeqeshwa nguye uButhelezi. Le ntokazi edabuka eStanger KwaDukuza ikholelwa wukuthi kwayisiza kakhulu ukufunda esikoleni zabebala labamhlophe nekwenza yagcina isizibandakanya nalo mdlalo. Uthi waqala lomdlalo esaneminyaka eyisikhombisa esenza amabanga amancane eDarnall Primary School wangaphinda wabheka emuva kusukela lapho. “Uma ngikhuluma iqiniso, ngifike eNanda ngathola liphansi kakhulu izinga le-hockey ngoba besijwayele ukudlala nabantu abasezingeni kakhulu. Ushintsho lukhona impela kodwa kuzothatha isikhathi kuthi libe ngelincomekayo,” kugoqa Gabuza, owenza unyaka wesithathu enyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika ( Unisa) kwiziqu zobuthishela. Ukholelwa wukuthi uhulumeni akenzi lutho ekuxhaseni lolu hlobo lomdlalo ezindaweni zasemalokishini nabona kuyingqinamba eyenza lo mdlalo ungathuthuki ngalendlela elindelekile. Lo mdlali odlala emuva usehlale iminyaka emibili neNanda Seminary Hockey team nanethemba lokuthi libukeka liqhakazile ikusasa lalo mdlalo emphakathini njengoba uthando lwawo luqubuka mihla namalanga. Ngeminye imininingwane ungalandela ikhasi lomqhudelwano le-Facebook .
Isithombe: African News Agency (ANA) Isithombe: African News Agency (ANA) ZINGASE zivalwe ezinye zezikole okuvalwe ngehlahla kwangaphasa ngisho umfundi oyedwa ku-matric KwaZulu-Natal ngo-2018 ngoba ezinye zazo bezinomfundi oyedwa obhalile. UMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni uzobizela esigcawini othishanhloko balezi zikole ukuthi bazochaza ngemiphumela engemihle abayitholile. Sinyukile isibalo sezikole okungaphasanga muntu kuzona ngo-2018 njengoba ziyisishiyagalolunye zisuka kwezintathu ngo-2017. Okhulumela umnyango uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, uthe bazobiza nothishanhloko bezikole ezithole ngaphansi kuka-60% ukuze kucutshungulwe imiphumela yalezi zikole. Uthe kulezi eziyisishiyagalolunye ezithole u-0% asikho esango-2017 okwakungaphasanga muntu kusona, yizikole ezintsha. “Lezi ezintathu ezazithole u-0% azikho kulezi eziyisishiyagalolunye zangonyaka odlule okungaphasanga muntu kuzona. Ezinye zalezi ezithole u-0% bezinesibalo esincane sabafundi ababhalile njengoba kwesinye ubeyedwa kwesinye bebane. Abazali kumele babambisane nathi uma sifuna ukuvala isikole ngoba ezinye zezingqinamba uma sifuna ukuhlanganisa izikole noma sivale ezinye ngukuthi abazali bayanqaba,” kusho uMlotshwa. Uthe basuke befuna ukuzivala ngoba basuke sebenze ucwaningo olunzulu wathi abamane nje bavuke sebevala isikole. “Nakulezi kukhona okubonakalayo ukuthi azisebenzi ngakho kudingeka ukuthi zivalwe, zihlanganiswe nezinye kodwa sizoxoxa nemiphakathi ethintekayo. Sizokwakha uhlelo lokuphucula imiphumela yalezi zikole ngoba sifuna ukuqeda ngezikole ezithola ngaphansi kuka-0%.” UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane, wayethe ufuna ukuqeda ngezikole ezithola u-0% kulesi sifundazwe. Zingu-12 ezweni lonke izikole okungaphasanga muntu kuzona ngo-2018. Esinye sazo yiMpikayizekanye Secondary ebinabafundi abangu-18. Lesi sikole sike sangena ehlazweni lokukopela kwabafundi ngo-2014. Umnyango waqinisa kakhulu ezikoleni ezathinteka ekukopeleni kwabafundi ngokuthi kube nabantu abazozinza kuzona kuze kuqala ukubhala kwezivivinyo zize ziphothulwe.Ezinye zezikole ezithinteka ekukopeleni kubalwa iMaweni High, Mzoniwe High okubhale kuyo abayisishiyagalombili, Ncwecwe Secondary okubhale abafundi ababili, Nende Secondary okubhale abafundi abangu-10, Sbonginhlanhla Secondary okubhale umfundi oyedwa, Groenvlei Combined okubhale abafundi abayisishiyagalombili, Vuleka School for the Deaf okubhale abane naKwaMpunzi Combined okubhale abafundi abayisikhombisa.

Uthe ufuna uZuma aboshwe nabo bonke abantu bakhe abekhohlakele nabo. “Kumele bawashintshe la masudi kanokusho abawagqokayo, bafake umfaniswano wasejele,” kusho uMaimane. UMaimane ubezokhuluma nabantu baseNtuzuma efuna ukubezwa ukuthi bangamphathisani njengoba kuzoba nenkulumo yesizwe ezokwenziwa nguMengameli wezwe.

IMEYA kaMasipala iMpofana, uMnuz Xolani Duma IMEYA kaMasipala iMpofana, uMnuz Xolani Duma UVALE amasango kamasipala, izolo umphakathi waseMooi River othi awusayifuni imeya yawo othi ayizi uma uyibizela emihlanganweni kodwa iphendula ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Lo mphakathi obukhala ngokuthi iMeya kaMasipala iMpofana, uMnuz Xolani Duma iqasha abangani bayo ezikhaleni zemisebenzi ezikhangisiwe, uthi kunomyalezo osabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana okuthiwa ubhalwe ngothile obebonga umsebenzi ekubeni umphakathi usaqhubeka nokuletha ama-CV awo ezikhaleni ezingu-13 zamaGeneral Worker ezikhangisiwe kodwa kube usuku lokuvalwa kokufakwa kwezicelo kungoLwesithathu. Umphakathi okuthiwa ubuholwa yintsha kuthiwa ugasele kwamasipala ngoLwesibili wavala amasango uthi ufuna ukuthi imeya izophendula ngalokhu okubone kuFacebook, iphinde ichaze ukuthi yini eyenze ukuthi lezi zikhala zincishiswe ngoba phambilini bezingu-50. Abantu bathi kwasha amahhovisi akwandabazabantu kulo masipala abantu sebezifakile izicelo zomsebenzi, kwase kuthiwa zizobuye zivulwe kabusha kodwa sezibuya sezingaphansi kwesibalo esasikhishwe. Abasolwa ngokuthi bahola lo mkhankaso wokuvala umasipala baboshiwe ngalo uLwesibili ntambama besolwa ngokulimaza impahla kamasipala, badedelwa ngesexwayiso izolo UMYALEZO okuthiwa ubuthunyelelwe imeya kaMasipala waseMpofana osatshalaliswe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, oholele ekutheni umphakathi uvale umasipala Abangaboshwanga babuyele kuwo lo masipala ekuseni, izolo baphinde bavala umasipala. Elinye ilunga lomphakathi elingathandanga ukudalulwa lithe: “Zishonephi izikhala ezingu-37, njengoba sekukhangiswe ezingu-13? Uneminyaka emithathu ehleli esihlalweni sobumeya kodwa akezi emhlanganweni uma simbiza, ugijima ayobhala kuFacebook.” UDuma akatholakalanga ocingweni lwakhe kodwa kwi-akhawunti kaFacebook okuthiwa eyakhe uphendule wathi: “Izindaba ezingamampunge ziholele ebugebengwini. Umasipala uvulele amacala izigebengu ezingu-17, ezidabule ama-CV abantu emahhovisi alo mkhandlu.” Uqhuba athi uyazi ukuthi lo mkhankaso uqhutshwa ngabantu ababehola imashi eyayithi akaphume esikhundleni nyakenye. Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi ungadidiswa ngabantu abanezinhloso zezepolitiki. Umthombo waleli phephandaba uthe umphakathi awuzange ungene kwamasipala, ubume ngaphandle futhi ubungenalo udlame, kodwa kubonakale imeya isifaka izithombe zama-CV kuFacebook, agcwele phansi ethi kwenziwe ngabebevale umasipala. UNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal uthe abakukhuthazi ukuthi kuqashwe ngobungani. “Ukuvala amasango kamasipala ngento esabalele kuFacebook nakho kuyiphutha. Siyakuphenya ukuthi ngabe kukhona yini asebeqashiwe ekubeni lungakafiki usuku oluwumnqamulajuqu kodwa sithi umphakathi awungathathi izinqumo ngezinto ezisatshalaliswa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.”

Laba bantu abahambisi ngendlela, bawisa amabhizinisi ethu. Sikhathele yibona. Uma uhulumeni engasizi sizobakhipha ezindaweni abadayisela kuzona. KUNGANI nizoze nibakhiphe. Benzeni? Abanye bagcina bewelwe amabhizinisi abeseneminyaka, edonsa ko-40. Thina uma sithi siyothenga sifika sebenikwe konke. NGICELA ungicacisele ephuzwini lokuthi bayaphiwa izimpahla zokudayisa. Bawola amakhasimende ngokubiza kancane. Akupheli sikhathi esingakanani ibhizinisi labo likhule, kuthi laba abafakwe kulona nabo baphume baqale awabo ngokushesha. Uma sesiwile esakho, bafuna ukusirentela kodwa futhi uma unqaba bavele bafake inqwaba yamakhonteyina. KUNGENZEKA yini ukuthi nina nihlulwa wukuncintisana? KUYINI kanti ukuncintisana? Ngoba phela laba bantu abazile ngokuncintisana kodwa bazowisa umsebenzi wethu. Yingakho sinxuse ikhomishini yezokuncintisana ingenelele. NJENGOBA nibeke umnqamlajuqu kuzokwenzekani? UMA kungekho sixazululo sizobakhipha ezindaweni abasebenzela kuzona ngenkani. LOKHU enizokwenza ngeke yini kususe uthuthuva olungaholela ekuhlukunyezweni kwabokufika? Anginendaba nejele uma ngiboshwa, bakhona abazosala benze umsebenzi kodwa mhla ngaphuma kuyonakala.
KUGCWALA kanje emakilasini aseBizimali High njengoba abafundi behlala ngabathathu edeskini elilodwa KUGCWALA kanje emakilasini aseBizimali High njengoba abafundi behlala ngabathathu edeskini elilodwa UKUNGENA ngo-6 ekuseni kuphunywe ngo-10 ebusuku nsuku zonke, ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo ngezimpelasonto ngezinye zezinto ezenza iBizimali High, eNhloshane eNkandla sikhiqize imiphumela emihle kwa-matric. Lesi sikole esigcwele ngokweqile njengoba sinabafundi abevile ku-2 000, amagumbi okufundela angu-21 nothisha ababalelwa ku-60 sesizakhele igama ngokwenza kahle minyaka yonke nakuba sisuke semukele abafundi abasuke sebehlule kwezinye izikole abalethwa kusona ukuze baphume beqondile. Nakuba minyaka yonke senza kahle kodwa sibhekene nengwadla yokushoda kwamanzi nogesi. Ukuze kusetshenziswe izinto ezidinga ugesi kunama-generator amathathu asebenzisa uphethroli obalelwa ku-R6 000 nyanga zonke. Abafundi kudingeka bagwedle ipitsi baziphathele amanzi ngoba kule ndawo okwakhiwe kuyona isikole iyashisa. Ayisithupha amakilasi ka-matric kanti nyakenye bangu-461 abafundi ababhale leli banga, kwaphasa abangu-406 izinga lokuphasa kwaba ngu-88.7%. Uthishanhloko oseneminyaka eyevile ku-20 ebambe izintambo, uMnuz Ntandoyakhe Ntuli (50), uthe ukuzikhandla kothisha nokubamba iqhaza komphakathi esikoleni kubenza benze kahle minyaka yonke. Uthe abanumzane bendawo abalali bahlala kuze kuphume isikole ngo-10 begade abafundi abasuke begoduka. “Iningi lothisha akubona abendawo bahlala emqashweni kubalwa nami. Nginomuzi eThekwini kodwa cishe ngiya kane ngonyaka, isikhathi esiningi sisichitha esikoleni. Siyisikole esithatha abafundi abasuke sebehlule, sibacije baphase ngamalengiso. Uma ubheka ezinye izikole ezenza kahle zihlunga abafundi ezibathathayo ukuze zilokhu zenza kahle,” kusho uNtuli. Uthe abafundi bahlala ngabathathu edeskini cishe kuwona wonke amakilasi ngoba kugcwele. “Besinabafundi abangu-2065, ngokomthetho kumele ngabe sime la ko-1 400 kodwa-ke asikwazi ukunqaba abafundi. Asikwazi nokukhala kakhulu ngoba umnyango uthi yithinta esamukela kakhulu kunokumele sikuthathe. Ngihleli nje nesitifiketi sezempilo esithi kunobungozi bezempilo kodwa ayikho into engingayenza ngoba abazali bayaziletha izingane zabo.” Uthe sekuyisiko nje ukuthi abafundi bakwa-matric baphuma ngo-10 ebusuku, uMgqibelo namaSonto kuyafana. “Kukhona abancintisanayo abaze baphume ngabo-2 ekuseni ngoba bethanda ukufunda. Kuyafundwa akudlalwa, ayikho imfihlo esinayo ngaphandle kwaleyo. Ngezimpelasonto sibhalisa izivivinyo ngakho akukho ukulova kwabafundi ngoba kusuke kubhalwa. Siyashesha ukuphothula isilabhasi bese sibuyekeza.” Uthe lesi sikole sakhiwe ngo-1983 asikaze sibe nogesi uma ama-generator efile basebenzisa amakhandlela. Uthi wafika kulesi sikole singenawo u-matric, sigcina kwaGrade 10 wathi no-100% bake bawuthola ngo-1999 kuya ku-2001. “Sinobudlelwano neWestvile Boys yaseThekwini lapho ngiyisa khona othisha bayothekela ulwazi bafunde nokusetha amaphepha. Ziningi nezinye izikole ezifikayo zizofunda kithina,” kusho uNtuli. Uthe ingxenye enkulu yemali abayithola emnyangweni bathenga ngayo uphethroli wathi ugesi ukhona kwezinye izingxenye kodwa awukho kubona ngoba isikole siphakathi nendawo. “Sibonga umphakathi ukuthi sisebenze kahle nawo. Akugcwelezwa izingane njengoba iningi lazo, nothisha behlala emqashweni. Uma siphuma ebusuku sikhanyisela abafundi amalambu ezimoto ukuze babone indlela uma sebegoduka,” kusho uNtuli.
ABASEBENZI baseDurban University of Technology (DUT) abatelekele ukwenyuselwa umholo izolo bemasha belibangise kumphathi wale nyuvesi, uSolwazi Thandwa Mthembu Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO ABASEBENZI baseDurban University of Technology (DUT) abatelekele ukwenyuselwa umholo izolo bemasha belibangise kumphathi wale nyuvesi, uSolwazi Thandwa Mthembu Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO IYASHUBA eyeziteleka emanyuvesi aKwaZulu-Natal njengoba izolo kuphazamiseke ukubhalisa eDurban University of Technology (DUT) nase-University of South Africa (Unisa) abasebenzi betelekela ukunyuselwa amaholo. Abasebenzi base-Unisa abangaphansi kweNational Education Health and Allied Workers Union (Nehawu) bafuna ukunyuselwa umholo ngo-12% kulo nyaka, umqashi uthi angabanika u-6%, abaseDUT bafuna u-10% umqashi uthi angabanika * -4%. Izinyunyana zabasebenzi baseDUT abangaphansi kweNehawu, iTertiary Education National Union SA (Tenusa) neNational Tertiary Education Union (NTEU) bangenele isiteleka ngoMsombuluko. Ngalolu suku bavule ngemashi ebiqondiswe koyiPhini likaShansela wale nyuvesi, uSolwazi Thandwa Mthembu. Izolo, abasebenzi abebethi babona sengathi umphathi uyabaziba babuyele ehhovisi lakhe befuna ukukhuluma naye. UMnuz Milton Estrice okhulumela lezi zinyunyana uthe kusukela bahambisa uhlu lwezikhalo ngalolu suku kuMthembu akukaze kube khona mpendulo noma umhlangano ohleliwe phakathi kwezinyunyana nomqashi. “Sibona sengathi iphini likaShansela lizishaya indiva izikhalo zethu kungakho namhlanje (izolo) sithe asibuye size ehhovisi lakhe ukuze asichazele ukuthi umi kuphi nodaba lwethu. “Sidinga isixazululo esisheshayo ngalolu daba ngoba sibona sengathi akazimisele ukululungisa,” kusho yena. Abasebenzi bazithele phezu konogada abebevimbile ehhovisi lomphathi, abasebenza kuleli hhovisi abathe akekho. Bathi uthe uzothumela umyalezo nge-email mayelana nomhlangano wokucacisa ngo-4% no-6% umqashi azimisele ukunyusela ngayo abasebenzi. “Thina asiwazi u-6% ngoba sazi ukuthi abasebenzi abaqashwanga ngaphansi kohlelo olwaziwa nge-cost to company, yingakho sitshele abezindaba ukuthi umqashi ufuna ukubenyusela umholo ngo-4%. Sisamile ekutheni ngeke sibuyele emsebenzini lungalungisiwe lolu daba,” kusho yena. Lesi sikhungo siqashe abasebenzi besikhashana abebesebenzela kwenye ingxenye yenyuvesi abebebhalisa abafundi. UNksz Noxolo Memela oyimenenja yezokuxhumana kule nyuvesi, uthe inyuvesi izimisele ukulungisa lesi simo ngokushesha. Uthe abaphathi bazimisele ukuhlangana nezinyunyana kuleli sonto ukuze kuxazululwe udaba lwamaholo, olwaqala ukudingidwa ngoMeyi nyakenye. “Izitshudeni nabanye abantu abangena enyuvesi baphephile,” kusho yena. Khonamanjalo e-Unisa, abasebenzi abangaphansi kweNehawu bamise ukubhalisa befuna ukunyuselwa amaholo ngo-12%. Okhulumela iNehawu, uMnuz Khaya Xaba, uthe umqashi ufuna ukunyusa amaholo ngo-6% wathi bakhathele ukuthathwa kancane ngabakule nyuvesi. “Sifuna kuqashwe ngokugcwele abasebenzi abayitoho kuyekwe ukuxhashazwa kwabo emnyangweni wezobuchwepheshe. “Siyazi inyuvesi ingakwazi ukunyusela abasebenzi umholo ngoba babalelwa ku-400 000 abafundi ababhaliswayo minyaka yonke kanti kunoR400 billion osezinqolobaneni. Sizoteleka baze bahlangabezane nezimfuno zethu.” Imizamo yokuthola okhulumela le nyuvesi uMnuz Matrin Ramotshela ayiphumelelanga, ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa nemibuzo athunyelwe yona akayiphendulanga.
SISALE sishiswe kanjena isikole eBunguni Secondary esiseMuden ngaseGreytown ngoMsombuluko, kusolwa ukuthi sishiswe abafundi bedinwe udaba lokudla esikoleni SISALE sishiswe kanjena isikole eBunguni Secondary esiseMuden ngaseGreytown ngoMsombuluko, kusolwa ukuthi sishiswe abafundi bedinwe udaba lokudla esikoleni KUMISIWE ukufunda okwesikhashana esikoleni eBunguni Secondary kulandela ukuvuka umbhejazane kwabafundi, bashisa isikole bekhala ngokungabibikho kokudla. Izolo akuzange kufundwe kulesi sikole esiseNkanini, eMuden ngaphandle kwaseGreytown, emuva kwesigameko sangoMsombuluko lapho abafundi beqale bashaya khona othisha ngamatshe, baphihliza nezimoto zabo. Kuthiwa othisha baphume sebephelezelwa amaphoyisa. Abafundi basale baphihliza wonke amawindi esikole basokhela ngomlilo sasha sangqongqa. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi lokhu kwenzeke emuva kwesonto abafundi bebhale incwadi bebuza uthishanhloko ukuthi “balamba kangaka ikhona yini inkinga?” Kuthiwa bebefuna izimpendulo ukuthi kungani begcine ukudla ngoMeyi 15 nonyaka. Sekuphele amasonto amathathu kungadliwa namanzi engabonwa. Uthishanhloko kuthiwa wabhala incwadi wayihlohla eMnyangweni wezeMfundo nophakela lesi sikole ukudla emuva kwesikhalo sabafundi. NgoMsombuluko kuthiwa kuqale ngokujwayelekile ukufunda esikoleni kodwa kwathi sekuyisikhathi setiye abafundi bangabuyela emakilasini, kuthiwa yilapho beqale khona ukudedela amatshe bewabhekise kothisha. Othisha kuthiwa babaleke bangena endlini yabo yokuhlangana, amatshe elokhu ebalandela. Kubizwe amaphoyisa nabanye abazali ukuba bazolamula. Othisha bakhishwe amaphoyisa, babaleka. Abazali bafikile esikoleni bezolamula kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya njengoba abafundi bevele bokhela isikole ngomlilo besebenzisa amafutha. USihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole uMnuz Ndoda Manyoni ethintwa izolo, uthe badumele ngalesi sigameko ngoba izingane zabo zizophazamiseka ezifundweni. “Kunzima nokuba ngikhulume ngalento njengoba isikole sishe saphela. Wonke amawindi esikole abulewe, kushe amagumbi okufunda, ihhovisi, indawo egcina impahla yesikole. Esikutholile ukuthi abafundi abazange besabuyela emakilasini beshaya othisha ngamatshe, kubizwe amaphoyisa, bagcina ngokushisa isikole. Asazi noma abafundi noma imidlwembe enza lento. Esikwaziyo ukuthi abafundi bakhala ngendaba yokungabi bikho kokudla namanzi esikoleni. Uthishanhloko ubesalulungisa udaba,” kusho uManyoni. Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi abazi ukufunda kuzoqhubeka nini. “Nginezingane ezintathu kulesi sikole, efunda uGrade 12, 11 no-9. Angazi ngizokwenzenjani uma kuvalwa isikole, izingane ngizozilusisa izinkomo yini njengoba singenayo imali yokuziyisa kwezinye izikole. Namhlanje (izolo) bekumele kubhalwe izivivinyo zika-matric wangonyaka odlule kodwa akwenzekanga njengoba isikole sishisiwe. Kunomhlangano ebesinawo othisha bafike begadwe amaphoyisa ngoba besaba. Akufundwa nje esikoleni, asazi koze kufundwe nini ngoba isikole simoshwe saphela,” kusho uManyoni. Emuva komhlangano wayizolo kuphume umbono womhlangano ophuthumayo nokulindeleke ukuba uhanjelwe ubuholi bendawo okubalwa nenkosi. Lo mhlangano uhlelelwe uLwesihlanu ekuseni. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa uthe bayalwazi loludaba futhi benza konke okusemandleni ukuba isimo sibuyele kwesijwayelekile bese kuyafundwa. Uthe basenza uphenyo ngendaba ethinta ukudla kwabafundi naso isigameko sangoMsombuluko ukuthi senzeke kanjani. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt. Col Thulani Zwane, uthe kuvulwe icala lokucekela phansi impahla. “Kushiswe isikole, kwaphoswa amatshe kwalinyazwa izimoto namakilasi. Izimoto ezine ezilinyaziwe. Amacala avulwe esiteshini eMuden, uphenyo luyaqhubeka kodwa akekho oboshiwe,” kusho uZwane.
UZITHINTELE kubantu umsiki wengqephu waseNgwelezane, eMpangeni ngemuva ngokuhlambalaza amadodakazi akhe amathathu ngokuwamodelisa namaphepha anemibhalo ewathukayo enxanxatheleni yezitolo iSanlam Centre, eMpangeni ngempelasonto edlule. Uyise wezingane esingeke simdalule ngenxa yokuvikela zona, kuthiwa uqhube amadodakazi akhe aneminyaka elinganiselwa ku-13 kuya ku-15 ewanamathisele amaphepha ezifubeni abhalwe ngemibhalo emikhulu egqamile ethi awanaso isimilo, athandana nenqwaba yamadoda, alala nawo. Isenzo salo somabhizinisi owaziwayo endaweni, kuthiwa sibacasulile abantu abebekule ndawo. “Lezi zingane bezigqoke ama-jean nezikibha ezincane zihamba ngezinyawo. Bezibukeka zingcolile sengathi bezingalalanga nasekhaya. “Sithukile ngoba lo somabhinisi ungumuntu owaziwayo endaweni, besingalindele ukuthi angenza into efana nalena. “Amadodakazi akhe abengabukeki eshayiwe kodwa bekubonakala ukuthi ayamesaba ngoba abelokhu ethithibele eduze kwakhe,” kusho umthombo. Uthe abantu basola uyise wamantombazane ngokuba yisahluleki somzali ngesenzo sakhe. “Kukhona ababikele abaphathi balezi zitolo, kwabizwa nonogada ukuthi bamnqande. “Ugcine esexoshwa kwathiwa akakwazi ukuzokwenza into efana nalena ezitolo. “Amaphoyisa afoneliwe kodwa afike ngemuva kwesikhathi esehambile nezingane zakhe,” kusho umthombo. Ethintwa lo somabhizinisi usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko, wathi wayeyothenga kwesinye sezitolo ehamba namadodakazi akhe ayenecala alenzile. Uthe onogada bamvimba namadodakazi akhe bathi abaphume ngoba lokhu abakwenzayo akuvumelekile. “Angikweleti muntu ukuthi ngichaze ukuthi kwakwenzenjani. Sekuyicala yini, ngibe ngingazibulalanga izingane zami. “Abantu abanenkinga nesenzo sami ngiyacabanga ukuthi bayayazi imigudu efanele okumele bayilandele. “Mina ngizophendula kubantu abanegunya lokungihlohla imibuzo,” kusho uyise wamantombazane. Ubhoke ngolaka uma Isolezwe ngeSonto limbuza ukuthi inhloso yakhe kwakuyini ngesenzo sakhe. “Ngiyibhinca mina ngeke ngilokhu ngigijima ezinkantolo ngalolu daba kodwa ngizokuthungatha ngize ngikuthole ngibhekane nawe ngqo,” esabisa intatheli uyise wamantombazane. Okhulumela iSanlam Centre, uNkk Lindiwe Dube usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko, wathi bayalele onogada ukuthi bakhiphele ngaphandle umlisa obehamba nomndeni wakhe enza into ebiphazamisa abathengi nabaninizitolo. Uthe abahambisani nendlela lo mlisa abezama ukuxazulula ngayo inkinga yomndeni wakhe endaweni yabo.
UMHLAZIYI wezepolitiki ozimele, uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, uthi ubuholi be-ANC kuzwelonke kumele bungenelele, buziphathele isifundazwe saKwaZulu-Natal ukuze kuphele umdonsiswano okhona obeka ikusasa leqembu engcupheni. Engxoxweni neSolezwe izolo, uKhumalo uthe zimbili izinto ezingaqeda umdonsiswano okhona eKZN. Ukuthi ubuholi bukazwelonke buziphathele noma bujube umakadebona weqembu othembekile futhi ongekho ezinhlangothini ukuthi kube nguyena oshanelayo. “I-ANC eKZN isiphenduke inhlekisa ngezinto eziqhubeka kuyona ezidalwa ukuthi abukho ubuholi,” kusho uKhumalo. Uthe inkinga ye-ANC eKZN izinhlangothi, “Ngendlela okujule ngayo ukungaboni ngasolinye ngisho nokusebenzisana lokhu okuzanywayo ngeke kuze kulunge ngoba uhlangothi oluthile lungadonsa lubheke lena nolunye lwenze okufanayo,” kusho uKhumalo. Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Xolani Dube, onguMcwaningi kwisikhungo iXubera Institute, uthe i-ANC eKZN isifana nento engekho. “Kumele sivume ukuthi uKhongolose eKZN usufana nento engekho usuziphendukele inkampani eqasha abantu,” kusho uDube. UDube uthe akacabangi ukuthi i-ANC esifundazweni inendaba nokhetho lwangonyaka ozayo. “Kuyimanje amaqabane ayisana ezinkantolo ngenxa yokubanga amandla, angiboni olunye uhlangothi lungakhankasela olunye ukuthi lungene emandleni, ingakho ngithi abanandaba nokhetho,” kusho uDube. Uthe iyodwa into ebangwayo, iphalishi. Ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi obusha esifundazweni imiswe ngumzuzu wokugcina ngamalungu enhlangano anganeme asezifundeni ezintathu iMoses Mabhida, Lower South Coast naseHarry Gwala. Lawa malungu akhala ngokuthi ayancishwa ubulungu benhlangano nokuthi ashiywa ngaphandle ezinhlelweni zombutho emagatsheni. Kungakapholi maseko kumiswe ingqungquthela yesifundazwe, kuleli sonto kube sekumiswa ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi obusha baseMoses Mabhida. Izingqungquthela eKZN zimiswa ngamalungu enhlangano ahambisana noMengameli uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa.

Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng/ African News Agency (ANA) UMengameli we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa inkulumo yakhe yakusasa elindelwe ngabomvu. Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng/ African News Agency (ANA) UBUMBANO, ezemfundo, ukubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, ezempilo, ukufukula ezomnotho, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ngezinye zezinto okulindeleke ukuthi zibe seqhulwini enkulumeni yaminyaka yonke ye-ANC ezothulwa nguMengameli wale nhlangano, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa. Le nkulumo ibhekwe ngabomvu, ikakhulu kulo nyaka wokhetho, njengoba le nhlangano izobe ikhankasela ukuwina ukhetho ukuze igcine amandla okuhola uhulumeni kuleli ngaphandle kwaseWestern Cape lapho kuphethe iDA. Umgubho iJanuwari 8, uzoba senkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida eThekwini kusasa. Le nhlangano imemezele ukuthi ilindele ukugcwalisa le nkundla emumatha abantu abangu-87 000. Abahlaziyi bezombusazwe abakhulume neSolezwe, bathe lezi zinto ezibalwe ngenhla yizona ezizobe zihamba phambili enkulumeni kaRamaphosa. Umhlaziyi, uMnuz Protas Madlala, uthe ucabanga ukuthi inkulumo kamengameli izogxila kakhulu odabeni lokudala amathuba emisebenzi nokufukula ezomnotho. “Angingabazi ukuthi uRamaphosa imkhathaza kakhulu indaba yomnotho wezwe osuhlale isikhathi eside ungasimami yingakho enza konke okusemandleni ukuba kuguqulwe isimo somnotho wezwe,” kusho uMadlala. Uthe ngeke ayishiye ngaphandle indaba yobumbano ikakhulukazi njengoba uhlangothi obeluhamba noDkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, ngesikhathi kuyiwa eNasrec, kade lungamfuni. “Enye into engicabanga ukuthi uzoyikhuza, isihlava sokubulalana kosopolitiki esenzeka kakhulu lapha KwaZulu-Natal,” kusho uMadlala. Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki ozimele, uMnuz Bukani Mngoma, naye uhambe emazwini kaMadlala wathi ubona inkulumo kamengameli izogxila kakhulu ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi nokufukula umnotho. “Udaba lwamathuba emisebenzi nezomnotho kuyahambisana. Enye into engicabanga ukuthi uzoyithinta, wudaba lwezemfundo nodaba lokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwezinxephezelo,” kusho uMngoma. Uthe ezemfundo zibalulekile ngoba ziyisikhali sezwe. Naye uRamaphosa ekhuluma kuleli sonto emgubheni weminyaka engu-107 kwabunjwa i-ANC oHlange, eNanda, ubalule ibanga eselihanjiwe kwezemfundo kuleli. Ubale ukunyuka kwemiphumela ka-matric unyaka nonyaka, isibalo esiphezulu sabafundi ababhala leli banga, ukudla ezikoleni, ukuthuthwa kwabafundi njengezinye zezinto le nhlangano ezenze ngempumelelo selokhu yathatha amandla ombuso. Ukhale ngabafundi abaqala isikole kodwa bangafinyeleli kwa-matric, wathi lokhu kuyabakhathaza. Ubalule nokuthi uhulumeni wandise isibalo sabantu abasebenzayo kuleli. “Sathatha izintambo abantu abangu-8 million ababesebenza kuleli, sengeze ngabanye abangu-7 million asebesebenza manje selokhu sathatha izintambo. “Umhlaba sizowuthatha ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Sizobhekana nokwahlukana, sizobumbana,” kusho uRamaphosa ngamafuphi eNanda. Kuleli sonto, abaholi abahlukene abaphezulu bale nhlangano bankanise isifundazwe sonke benxenxa abantu ukuthi bathamele le nkulumo eMabhida. UMnuz Zizi Kodwa, obhekele ezokuxhumana ehhovisi likaRamaphosa kwi-ANC, uthe abantu bazogcwala nakwenye indawo abazobe behlelelwe kuyona uma sekugcwele eMabhida. “Zintathu kuphela izinhlangano ezikwazi ukugcwalisa izinkundla kuleli. I-ANC, iChiefs uma idlala nePirates nebandla iZCC. Sizoyigcwalisa iMabhida,” kusho uKodwa. Le nhlangano ithe yonke into isimi ngomumo ngalo mgubho.
