USULINDE isinqumo senkantolo umndeni kaMnuz Thabani Mzolo obhekene necala lokubulala owayeyintombi yakhe Isithombe: SIGCINIWE USULINDE isinqumo senkantolo umndeni kaMnuz Thabani Mzolo obhekene necala lokubulala owayeyintombi yakhe Isithombe: SIGCINIWE UYISE wowesilisa osolwa ngokubulala umfundi waseMangosuthu University of Technology, osedume ngokuqhuba intwala ngewisa, uthi kunzima ukukholwa yizinsolo ezibekwe kuMnuz Thabani Mzolo (23). UMnuz Mthembeni Majola oyikhansela le-IFP onguyise kaMzolo ongamzali uthi ubechitha isikhathi esiningi naye njengendodana yakhe. Uthi njengoyise kunzima ukukholwa yonke into eshiwoyo ngaye. “Sizokholwa uma sekuphuma ubufakazi benkantolo obuzoveza ukuthi esikabani isibhamu,” usho kanje. Phambilini kuke kwavela ukuthi uMajola ubegadwa wuMzolo, kodwa uthi lokhu akulona iqiniso. Uthi bebehlale bendawonye ngoba uMzolo eyindodana yakhe yize engamzali. Uthi njengomndeni bamazi njengengane ezithobile futhi ehlale ilubalubela ukufukula abanye. UMzolo usedume ngokuqhuba intwala ngewisa njengoba kuleli sonto kuvele ukuthi ukhombise iMantshi umunwe ophakathi nendawo. Nakubantu abasuke beyothamela icala, usedume ngokuthi avele abakhombe ngophawu lwesibhamu esebenzisa iminwe yakhe. UMajola uthi kwenzeka lokhu nje uMzolo ubesemfundisa inkonzo emvakashisa emathempelini ahlukene ebandla lakaShembe. “Thina njengomndeni wakhe sizokholwa ngesikuzwa ngenkantolo, nakhona kube nobufakazi obuphathekayo. Okunye okushiwo abantu emaceleni ngeke sikulalele kakhulu,” kusho uMajola. Uthe uMzolo ubewusizo ezinganeni eziningi ezifundisa izibalo, sekukhona nezineziqu ngenxa yakhe. Mayelana nokuthi uMzolo ubewunogada, uMajola uthe: “Ubengeke abe ngumfundi aphinde abe ngunogada, ubehlala ehamba nami ngoba sihlobene. "Ukuba unogada kuhambisana nezinto eziningi namalayisensi enziwayo. Akakaze angigade futhi angazi kuqhamuke nobani lokho,” kusho uMajola. UMajola uthe uyazi ukuthi umndeni wakaKhumalo uphatheke kabuhlungu ngokwenzekile, nabo bayazwelana nawo kodwa abafuni ukuhlangana nawo kusenje. “Uma abantu bebhekene nesimo esifana nalesi akumele nibajahe eduze. Sifisa baphole kuqala bese sikwazi ukubavakashela. Nathi sisadidekile kodwa uma enganikezwa abameli abawaziyo umthetho, kuningi okungavela ngaleli cala,” kusho uMajola. Ephetha uthe uma ligcina ngokumlahla icala futhi naye ekuvuma konke okuvezwa yinkantolo bazokwamukela njengomndeni ukuthi kunohlangothi lwakhe abebengalwazi. NgoLwesine iNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini isichithile isicelo sebheyili sikaMzolo kulandela ukuvela kwenkinga yekheli lakhe eliqondile njengoba nezinye zezihlobo zakhe zimuhlangulile.
KUHLUKENE phakathi umndeni umfundisi webandla lamaZayoni eMtshezi ‘enikela’ ngesidumbu sendodakazi yakhe esokeni ngoba ethi lalobola, kodwa izingane zakhe, abafowabo nodadewabo bathi bayakweshwama lokhu. Njengamanje isidumbu sikaNksz Thabile Mpungose (46), sibangwa yilo mndeni nesoka nalo elithi yilona elizomngcwaba ngoba bese lilobole kushoda ngomshado kuphela, kodwa amanye amalungu omndeni awakwazi lokho, abemazi njengomuntu ozijolelayo nje. Lokhu kuvele emuva kokushona kwakhe uMnuz Mbongeni Mathe waKwaNongoma obaziwa njengesoka, eveza ukuthi usengumkhwenyana ngakho uzozingcwabela yena. Omunye wamalungu omndeni utshele leli phephandaba ukuthi uyise kamufi uMnuz Bangumuzi Mpungose wamukela uR30 000 njengelobolo kuMathe nokwenza avumelane naye ngokungcwaba umufi. “Uyanqaba ukuthi angcwatshwe ekhaya eMtshezi ngoba usaba ukuthi uMathe uzofuna ilobolo lakhe. Akekho umuntu obazi ukuthi kukhona osekwakhokhwa ngisho ubhuti kamufi akabizwanga. “Nathi nezingane zakhe besingazi nosisi ubengakaze asitshele lokho. Noma ngabe kukhona abakukhipha kodwa ubengashadile,” kusho leli lungu lomndeni. Indodakazi kamufi uNksz Lungi Mpungose (28) ithe yize umkhulu wabo engafuni kungcwatshwe unina kubo bazoqhubeka nemizamo angcwatshelwe eStanger lapho ebenomuzi khona. UNksz Mpungose uveze ukuthi yena akasebenzi kodwa umfowabo (20) uzozithwala izindleko zomngcwabo. “Ushone kade esezohlala nathi eStanger ebuya KwaNongoma ngenxa yezinkinga ebebhekene nazo. Indaba yamalobolo asiyazi, akakaze akhulume ngayo siyiqabuka manje eseshonile. Siyasihlonipha isinqumo sikamkhulu ngoba uthe akasidingi isidumbu sakhe kwakhe. Sizokwenza imizamo yokuzingcwabela,” kusho uNksz Mpungose ekhathazekile. Ethintwa umkhulu wabo ubhoke wakhahlela waveza ukuthi ngeke alubhade kulowo mngcwabo. “Ngangingeke ngitshele bona. Uma umuntu elotsholelwa ubuza abafowabo. “Kodwa ngoba bayizingane ezingezwa abazibonele, mina uma umkhwenyana ethi akayi emgcwabeni ngizongayi nami. Lo oshonile uyazi ukuthi bese kusele umshado ubesanda kufika ezolanda imali yokwembesa abakhwekazi. Ngabe bese beshadile kulibazise bona,” kusho uMpungose. Eqhuba uvumile ukuthi umufi ubese nazo izinhlelo zokubuyela emzini wakhe eStanger nezingane sezibhaliswe ngakhona kodwa wathi lokho akusho ukuthi ubesehlukana noMathe. “Bebengaxabene lokho sekukhandwa yizo lezi zingane. Umkhwenyana ubemnakekela ngisho egula emhambisa kodokotela,” kusho uMpungose. Leli phephandaba liphinde lathola ukuthi kukhona nokushaya amakhala ngokushona kukamufi njengoba kuthiwa wamilwa iqhubu emlonyeni ngoMsombuluko wakhala ngalo kwaze kube ushonela erenki eMpangeni ngoLwesihlanu esendleleni ebheke eStanger. Ethintwa uMathe ngalolu daba uvele wangena ezintangeni waveza ukuthi naye unemibuzo ayibhekise kwiphephandaba ufuna ukwazi lizithola kanjani izindaba, kwaze kwaba ugcine engaphawulanga ngokugcwele.
IMEYA yoMkhandlu weTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede izokwazi ngekusasa layo namhlanje njengoba i-ANC kulindeleke ukuthi imemezele isinqumo sayo IMEYA yoMkhandlu weTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede izokwazi ngekusasa layo namhlanje njengoba i-ANC kulindeleke ukuthi imemezele isinqumo sayo OKLEBE bathi bayazi ngezinsolo zokuphulwa kwemibandela yebheyili yiMeya yoMkhandlu weTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede emisiwe emsebenzini emva kokuboshwa mayelana namacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa athinta ithenda yezigidi yokuqoqwa kukadoti eThekwini. Okhulumela oKlebe, uBrigadier Hangwani Mulaudzi izolo uthe zikhona izikhalo abazitholile mayelana nokuthi uNkk Gumede uphule eminye yemibandela yakhe yebheyili. “Siyazi ngezikhalo zokuthi iMeya yaseThekwini iphule eminye imibandela yebheyili, ithimba labaphenyi noPhiko lwezokuShushisa kumele baxhumane babikele iMantshi ngalezi zinsolo bese kuba iyona enqumayo ukuthi kuzokwenzekani,” kusho uMaluadzi. Omunye wemibandela yebheyili kaNkk Gumede owawubukeka umnqinda amandla, ilowo owawuthi kumele ame ukuqhuba izinhlelo zikamasipala. UNkk Gumede unikwe ikhefu lezinsuku ezingu-30 yi-ANC ngemuva kokuboshwa mayelana nethenda yokuqoqwa kukadoti. Izolo uNkk Gumede bekulindeleke ukuthi abuyele emsebenzini njengoba ikhefu anikwe lona lenyanga seliphelile. I-ANC izolo bekulindeleke ukuthi yenze isimemezelo mayelana nekusasa lakhe kodwa lize lashona ilanga singekho isimemezelo esenziwayo. Ethintwe uMkhulumeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal uNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu ophinde abe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo esifundazweni, akazange atholakale, ucingo lwakhe lubanjwe ngumkhulumeli wakhe uNkk Thando Nkosi othe bazokwaziswa abezindaba uma sekukhona isinqumo esithathiwe. I-ANC kulindeleke ukuthi imemezele ngekusasa likaNkk Gumede namhlanje. Izolo i-ANC ibibambe umhlangano lapho kade ibhunga khona ngalolu daba. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abalandeli bakaNkk Gumede bahlela ukuthi namhlanje babambe umlindelo bese kuthi kusasa ngoLwesine bayamthatha bamyisa eCity Hall. Okhulumela uMkhandlu weTheku, uMnuz Msawakhe Mayisela, uthe ngeke bakwazi ukuphawula mayelana nodaba lweMeya wacela ukuthi kuthintwe i-ANC esifundazweni. “Siyabanxusa abezindaba ukuthi banikeze ubuholi be-ANC esifundazweni isikhathi sokuthi busebenze lolu daba kodwa mina engingakusho ngasohlangothini lukamasipala, umsebenzi uyaqhubeka siholwa yimenenja yomkhandlu uMnuz Sipho Nzuza nePhini leMeya uNkk Fawzia Peer okuyilo eliyiNhloko yezepolitiki okwamanje,” kusho uMayisela. Uthe bona babheke kakhulu ekutheni umsebenzi wokuhanjiswa kwezidingo kubantu uyaqhubeka, abanendaba kakhulu nokuthi kuqhubekani kwezepolitiki. “Umsebenzi wethu siyawazi futhi akukho okuzosivimba ukuthi siqhubeke nawo,” kusho uMayisela.
Ayiqhubeki impilo kuMnuz Zamokwakhe Mthethwa owalimala, waphuma esibhedlela esebhalwe emagameni abashonile eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya. Usephuthelwe nayimali yokulimala njengoba kuvalwe ne-akhawunti yasebhange Ayiqhubeki impilo kuMnuz Zamokwakhe Mthethwa owalimala, waphuma esibhedlela esebhalwe emagameni abashonile eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya. Usephuthelwe nayimali yokulimala njengoba kuvalwe ne-akhawunti yasebhange SEKUPHELE unyaka engabuyeli emabhukwini abaphilayo owesilisa waseFolweni, owathola ukuthi kubhalwe ukuthi sewashona eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya emuva kokulala ezibhedlela izintathu. UMnuz Zamokwakhe Mthethwa (58), washayiswa yimoto ngo-24 Ephreli 2016 walaliswa esibhedlela, wadedelwa ngoJulayi. Echaza ngengozi eyamehlela uthe wayeshayela iloli, yasha ephakathi. Wayezama ukuphuma ngesikhathi ehlangana nemoto eyamshayisa waqulekela khona lapho. Waze waphaphama emuva kwezinsukwana esibhedlela. “Ngaphuma esibhedlela ngoJulayi kuwona * -2016 ngathi ngiyokhipha imali ebhange ngathola ukuthi i-akhawunti yami yavalwa. Kuthe uma ngilandela ngathola ukuthi yavalwa ngoba ngokwemininingwane yaseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya angisekho emhlabeni,” echaza. Isitifiketi sokushona esibhalwe imininingwane kaMthethwa, sikhomba ukuthi washona ngenxa yokugula eMandeni ngoNovemba 29 ku-2016. Uthe uyamangala ukuthi ngabe lo mkhonyovu wenzeke kanjani ngoba wazi ukuthi umazisi wakhe washa neloli. Uveze ukuthi waya emahhovisi omnyango ngoJanuwari 12 wonyaka odlule, wagcwalisa ifomu okuthiwa izosiza ukuthi abuyiselwe emagameni abaphilayo. Usegqigqe kaningi emahhovisi ethola ukuthi namanje akukalungi. “Okungiphatha kabi ukuthi abangichazeli ukuthi ngizolungiselwa nini le nkinga. Banqaba nokuthi ngishaye umazisi omusha, bathi kusamele ngivuswe kwabafileyo kuqala. Ngabhalisa nemali yokulimala emsebenzini, yaze yaphindela emuva ngoba i-akhawunti yami ivaliwe ebhange. Kumanje angikwazi ukuhamba kahle kumele ngabe sengibhalisa impesheni kodwa ngeke ngikwazi ngenxa yale nkinga,” kusho uMthethwa. Akuqali ukuthi iphephandaba lithole imibiko ngabantu abazithola bebhalwe emagameni abangasekho bebe besadla anhlamvana. Isikhathi esiningi laba bantu basuke belahlekelwe ngomazisi. UMnuz Cyril Mncwabe oyiMenenja yoMnyango wezaseKhaya, KwaZulu-Natal uthe kunzima ukusho ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukulungisa udaba olufana nolukaMthethwa ngoba lusuke seludluliselwe ophikweni lwabaphenyi ehhovisi elikhulu “Kuya ngokuthi olunjani uphenyo olwenziwayo kodwa ngokwesifundazwe, udaba siludlulisela kwiCounter Corruption Unit ukubheka ukuthi akuthinteki yini abasebenzi bethu,” kusho uMncwabe. Uthe uma kukhona abanye abanale nkinga kumele baye emahhovisi omnyango aseduze ukuze kudluliselwe ophikweni lwabaphenyi.
BEKUMINYENE utshumo izolo esitolo esidayisa imifaniswano yesikole iGEM Schoolwear abazali bethenga umfaniswano wesikole belungiselela inamuhla njengoba zivulwa izikole BEKUMINYENE utshumo izolo esitolo esidayisa imifaniswano yesikole iGEM Schoolwear abazali bethenga umfaniswano wesikole belungiselela inamuhla njengoba zivulwa izikole BATHWALE kanzima izolo abasebenzi besitolo sezimpahla zesikole, iGem Schoolwear, ngenxa yesiminyaminya sabebezothenga umfaniswano wesikole ngosuku lokugcina ngaphambi kokuvulwa kwezikole namuhla. Uma uqhamuka eGem, esenkabeni yeTheku, ubukhangwa wulayini omude obheke emnyango waso. Bese kuvulwe intuba eyodwa yokungena, kwabiywa nangothango locingo ukugwema isiminyaminya. Ngasemnyango bekukhona unogada nephoyisa lesifazane, bengenisa kuphela abanokukhubazeka nabakhulelwe. Abanye bebekhonjwa kulayini obusuzungeze lonke ibhilidi lesitolo. Abazali abaningi bebehamba nezingane ukuzolinganisa umfaniswano wesikole. Ngezikhathi zasemini ulayini ubungakanciphi, kunalokho abantu bese bethetha bekhala ngokuhamba kancane kwawo ngenxa yokuthi abasebenzi bebeshintshana ngokuyodla. Ngaphakathi abasebenzi bebetatazela bekhipha imifaniswano yezikole ezehlukene. UNkk Philile Ndlazi waseMlaza obehamba nendodakazi yakhe uthe kukhona ezinye izimpahla zesikole azithenga ngoDisemba kodwa zangaphelela ngoba enezingane ezintathu ezifundayo. Ubeselinde ukuthi ahole ekuqaleni kwaleli sonto nokuthi izingane zibuye emaholidini ukuze aqedele ukuthenga. Abanye abazali bebezoshintsha osayizi bezingane ezazingekho bezithengela. UMnuz Muhammed Salie, omunye wabaphethe kwaGem Schoolwear, uthe nabo bamangele ngoba akusajwayelekile ukuthi kugcwale kangaka sekusondele ukuthi kuvulwe izikole. Baqale ukuba matasa kakhulu ngoMsombuluko, okungenzeka ukuthi abanye abazali bebelinde ukuhola. “Indlela okugcwele ngayo ngeke sivale uma kusekhona abafuna ukuthenga. Olayini kabanciphi ngoba kusukela ekuseni bekugcwele. Besicabanga ukuthi bambalwa abazothenga sekuzovulwa izikole ngoba bathenga nangoDisemba,” kusho uSalie. Uthe bayazama ukusheshisela abathengi ngoba banabasebenzi abangaphezu kuka-100, abanye abaqashelwe itoho ukuze babhekane nomthamo wesikhathi sokuba matasa. “Sandise nonogada ukuze sigweme isiminyaminya. Sicele namaphoyisa ukuthi alekelele ukuqinisa ezokuphepha. Siyazi ukuthi uma kugcwele nezigebengu zithola ithuba lokubamba inkunzi,” kusho uSalie. USalie uthe namuhla bazovula ngaphambi kwesikhathi esijwayelekile ekuseni ukwenzela abazali abazobe bezoqedela ukuthenga njengoba kuvulwa izikole.
Isithombe esigciniwe Isithombe esigciniwe INATIONAL Freedom Party (NFP) isiveze ukuthi iphenya kabanzi ngengxoxo eqoshiwe ngeselula lapho kukhuluma khona umlisa ozibiza ngenkabi edabuka KwaMaphumulo ezishaya isifuba ngokuthi isibaqedile abantu embonini yamatekisi nakwezepolitiki. Kule nkulumo ekuWhatsApp inkabi izwakala ibhadlaza igama lomunye umholi weNFP wesilisa ukuthi isebenza naye. Isolezwe ngeSonto liyizwile le ngxoxo eshaqisayo esabalele kuWhatsApp. Okhulumela iNFP, uMnuz Sabelo Sigudu, uthe bayitholile le ngxoxo bayaphenya ngayo. "Lolu daba lusethimbeni labameli bethu. Sifuna ukuthola kahle umsuka. Ngeke siyithathe kancane le nto ngoba isimo sokubulawa kosopolitiki siyaziwa eKZN. Asazi noma abantu nje abanqonde ukungcolisa igama lenhlangano njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni." Lo mlisa ozibiza ngenkabi ukhuluma nomunye wesilisa amtshela ukuthi ubeqashwe owesifazane ukuthi ambulale futhi usekhokhelwe ingxenye yemali yokumbulala. Inkabi iyazisho igama layo nesibongo, ithi ayesabi kwamaphoyisa yona kade kwasa inethwa zimvula kulo msebenzi. Lo ofonelwayo kuthiwa uyisikhulu enkampanini edumile ekhiqiza ushukela. Inkabi izwakala ithi lo mlisa usesinde izikhawu. Ithi ngelinye ilanga ngesikhathi sebeyombulala baphazanyiswa ukuqhamuka kwamaphoyisa endaweni okwakufanele bamthele othulini kuyo. "Thina sisebenzisana nabamatekisi nosopolitiki, siqashwa ngoR250 000 futhi ubuchopho bendoda asibunqeni sibubamba nangezandla. Ngineminyaka emibili ngiphumile ejele abanye esisebenza nabo bangaphakathi. Empeleni siwu-6 senza lo msebenzi wokushaya abantu,’’ kusho inkabi Lo ofonelwayo uzwakala ehlisa umoya ezwakala ukuthi wethukile, ethi kufanele baxoxisane balungise lolu daba. Iyaqhubeka inkabi ithi lo mlisa usindiswe ukuthi uyisihlobo sayo. "Abazali bethu bayazi ukuthi siphila ngalo msebenzi, sayalwa ukuthi singasibulali isihlobo ngoba sojikelwa nayidlozi. Sisanda kushaya amaphoyisa amabili KwaMashu futhi sisebenzisana no (egagula igama lo munye wabaholi beNFP).’’ Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Thulani Zwane, uthe lowo oshayelwe ucingo kufanele aye emaphoyiseni awalalelise leyo ngxoxo ukuze kuphenywe.
KUSEWUMQANSA emaphoyiseni ukuthola imininingwane mayelana nokubulawa kwesikhulu sikaMasipala waKwaNongoma, esisocongwe singaphansi kohlelo lokuvikelwa kofakazi boMbuso. Ihhovisi likazwelonke emaphoyiseni sekuphele isonto lizama ukuthola ulwazi emaphoyiseni ase-Eastern Cape ngokubulawa kukaMnuz Bonginkosi Shoyisa (45), isidumbu sakhe esatholwa endlini abegcinwe kuyo ePort Elizabeth sesonakele, ekopolotwe amehlo wathelwa nge-acid. UShoyisa ubehlala kule ndlu eseWalmer ethathwa njengephephile ukuze akwazi ukuyofakaza ecaleni lokubulawa kowayenguMcwaningi maBhuku kaMasipala waKwaNongoma, uMnuz Archie Duma owayezodedela umbiko oshaqisayo wenkohlakalo emkhandlwini. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuleli, uColonel Brenda Muridili, uthe namanje basalinde izimpendulo ohlakeni oluqondene nalolu daba lokushona kukaDuma ngemuva kokuba Isolezwe lamthumelela i-email ngeSonto. “Abophiko oluqondene nalolu daba abakasiphenduli kuze kube manje. Sizokwazi ukuphawula uma sebesinikeze yonke imininingwane,” kusho uColonel Muridili. Kulolu daba umndeni ufuna izimpendulo ngoba amaphoyisa awutshela ukuthi ugulile uShoyisa kodwa umbiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu kaDkt Gregory Hanslo ukhomba ukuthi wabulawa wakhishwa namehlo, washiswa nge-acid. Umfowabo kamufi uMnuz Simon Shoyisa uthe okubi ukuthi nonina, uNkk Nompumelelo Shoyisa, usebalekile ekhaya ngoba uyesatshiswa. Icala obekuzofakaza kulo umufi bekumele liqale ukuqulwa ngoMsombuluko eMthunzini ngemuva kokuba lisuswe KwaNongoma kodwa umsolwa, uMnuz Phakamani Innocent Mthembu ushintshe ummeli ngomzuzu wokugcina kanti usuku lokuqulwa kwalo selophuma ngoDisemba 12.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi uphinde unyuke uphethroli ngenyanga ezayo. Isithombe: Thobile Mathonsi/African News Agency/ANA KULINDELEKE ukuthi uphinde unyuke uphethroli ngenyanga ezayo. Isithombe: Thobile Mathonsi/African News Agency/ANA IZAZI zomnotho zigqugquzela abantu ukuthi babophe izifociya futhi bamukele ukuthi intengo kaphethroli izolokhu yehla yenyuka, ngendlela okwenzeka ngayo ngoba uhulumeni akakezi namasu okwehlisa intela kaphethroli. UMnuz Doctor Sangweni oyisazi somnotho enkampanini iDolsden Oracle, uthe uphethroli othengwa kwamanye amazwe uthengwa ngentengo ebekwe ngamazwe awukhiqizayo bese uma ufika kuleli ufakwe intela ehlukene okungekaphethroli nesiza abalimele ezingozini zomgwaqo. Uthe uhulumeni nokuntenga kwerandi kwenza iNingizimu Afrika iwuthenge ngemali eningi uphethroli. “Uhulumeni nguye olawula intengo kaphethroli ngokuthi uma usufike kuleli afake intela. Mhlawumbe ukube intela iyehliswa bese amagaragi eze nentengo yawo yamalitha ngabe kunokuncintisana phakathi kwawo. Akufanele intela imbe eqolo ngoba yilokho okwenza ilitha likaphethroli limbe eqolo,” kusho uSangweni. Mayelana nodaba lokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikhiqiza uphethroli wayo wakwaSasol, umcwaningi wezomnotho, uMnuz Sakhile Dlamini uvumile ukuthi ukhona uphethroli okhiqizwa eNingizimu Afrika osuselwa emalahleni. “Kuyimanje iSasol ihamba phambili ezinkampanini ezikhiqiza uphethroli osuselwa emalahleni emhlabeni jikelele. Lo phethroli ubizwa nge-synthetic fuel futhi kudala waqala ukwenziwa kuleli, ngesikhathi uhulumeni wobandlululo evalwa ukuthi athenge uwoyela emazweni angaphandle. Ube esesungula iSasol okuyiyona ekhiqiza iSasol fuel eminyakeni engu-63 edlule,” kusho uDlamini. Uthe lolu hlobo lukaphethroli lwaqala ukwenziwa eGermany ngabo-1920 futhi uyasetshenziswa emazweni amaningi. UDlamini ucele abantu ukuthi babophe izifociya bathenge lokho okuyizidingo ngoba azikakenziwa izinhlelo zokwehlisa intela kaphethroli eNingizimu Afrika.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu eseSahlumbe High ebivalwe inyanga ngenxa yezimpi zezigodi UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu eseSahlumbe High ebivalwe inyanga ngenxa yezimpi zezigodi SIZOVULWA ngelizayo isikole iSahlumbe High, eWeenen osekuphele inyanga sivaliwe ngenxa yezimpi zezigodi zabafundi ezikapakele esikoleni. Kuthiwa nezidakamizwa zidliwa udede esikoleni kukhalwa nangokushoda kwamakilasi. Izolo uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu ube nomhlangano nomphakathi wakule ndawo kubalwa nenkosi uMthembu lapho kuvunyelwene khona ngokuthi kumele sivulwe isikole. Okhulumela uMshengu, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, uthe kuvunyelwene nomphakathi nazo zonke ezinye izinhlaka ukuthi lesi sikole kumele sivulwe uma sekuvulwa izikole ngoLwesibili oluzayo. Uthe bekungokwesibili bebuyela kulesi sikole enyangeni eyodwa. “Ungqongqoshe uzimisele ngokuthi kulungiswe isimo sesikole yingakho ebuyele kaningi kusona ezama ukuthi kutholakale isixazululo. Ziningi izinto ebezinomthelela wokuthi kuphazamiseke isikole njengokuthi izimpi zezigodi zikapakele esikoleni, kube nokukhala kubazali ngendaba yezinguquko ngohlelo lwezemfundo kanjalo namagumbi angomahamba nendlwana okufundela okusho ukuthi ayashoda ngakho kudinga ukuthi sakhiwe isikole,” kusho uMthethwa. Uthe kuvunyelwene ngokuthi kubanjiswane wathi nendaba yengqalasizinda izolungiswa. UMshengu unxuse umphakathi ukuthi izikole uziphathise okwamagugu ngoba yilapho kwakhiwa khona abantu abazoba wutho ngomuso. Uthe kube nesikhalo ngokuthi isikole asilawuleki kahle ngoba abafundi baningi. “Bese sisezinhlelweni zokuthi sakhe esinye isikole eSahlumbe ukuze sikwazi ukuthatha omunye umthamo wabafundi bafundele khona. Kube nesikhalo ngendaba yezidakamizwa okuthiwa ziba nomthelela ekutheni baxabane balwe.” Uthe kube nesikhalo ngokusebenza kothisha njengoba abazali bethi abazange abafundi bawathole amaripoti kuvalwa izikole. Kumele kwenziwe umsebenzi, uthisha kumele afundise cishe amahora ayisikhombisa ngosuku. Ngesonto elizayo ngoLwesihlanu bonke abafundi kumele bagoduke bephethe amaripoti abo ukuze abazali babone ukuthi basebenze kanjani,” kusho uMshengu. Uthe impahla yesikole icekeleke phansi ngenxa yokulwa kwabafundi. “Besibize nobuholi bezigodi ezehlukene ukuze sibambisane sonke kubuyiselwe ukufunda esimeni esifanele. Sizosebenzisana namaphoyisa ukuze kuseshwe noma yinini ukuze abafundi bangaphathi izikhali,” kusho uMshengu.
UNGQONGQOSHE wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan. Isithombe: Sumaya Hisham Reuters/File UNGQONGQOSHE wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan. Isithombe: Sumaya Hisham Reuters/File UNGQONGQOSHE wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan, uthe akukho okuphambene nomthetho akwenza ngesikhathi evumela owayeyiPhini likaKhomishana wakwaSARS, uMnuz Ivan Pillay, ukuba athathe umhlalaphansi kungafiki isikhathi sakhe. Izolo uGordhan uhambe nommeli wakhe u-Adv Tebogo Malatji emhlanganweni noMvikeli woMphakathi, u-Adv Busisiswe Mkhwebane, okade efuna uGordhan achaze ukuthi kungani avumela uPillay ukuba asheshe athathe umhlalaphansi amsayinele nempesheni. UGordhan utshele i-eNCA ukuthi u-Adv Mkhwebane udlala ngaye. “Sikhombise ngokusobala ukuthi akukho esasikufihlile ngesikhathi ngiwuNgqongqoshe weziMali. Ngangilandela umthetho futhi nokuqashwa kabusha kukaPillay kwakusemthethweni. Ngicabanga ukuthi ngingenza izinto ezingcono ngesikhathi sami kunokuthi ngizochaza le nto,” kusho uGordhan. Uthe u-Adv Mkhwebane uyadlala ngoba konke ayekwenza kucacile. “Akukho engangikufihla, konke kusemthethweni futhi sinabameli esasikhuluma nabo ngaphambi kokuthatha izinqumo. UMvikeli woMphakathi unenzondo.” UMnuz Oupa Segalwe, okhulumela ihhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi umhlangano ube khona esho nokuthi u-Adv Mkhwebane ubefuna ukuthola ukuthi uGordhan wazithatha kanjani izinqumo ezithile. “UNgqongqoshe (Gordhan) uye waziphendulela futhi wanikeza uMvikeli woMphakathi amaphepha azomsiza. Okwenze ukuthi abizelwe emahhovisi oMvikeli woMphakathi wukuthi ubengaphenduli uma ebhalelwa,” kusho uSegalwe. NgoMsombuluko uGordhan kulindeleke ukuthi ayokwenza izethulo zakhe kwikhomishini kaZondo ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana.
ABAHOLI balabo abeseka iMeya yoMkhandlu weTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, basola abaholi abathile kwi-ANC ngokugxambukela ezindabeni zaseThekwini ngenhloso yokufeza izinhloso zabo zezombusazwe. ABAHOLI balabo abeseka iMeya yoMkhandlu weTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, basola abaholi abathile kwi-ANC ngokugxambukela ezindabeni zaseThekwini ngenhloso yokufeza izinhloso zabo zezombusazwe. Esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo, okhulumela abeseka uNkk Gumede, uMnuz Mzomuhle Dube usole uNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli noNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele ngokufaka unyawo lwedada eThekwini. “UNtuli uyagxambukela eThekwini, lokho akusithusi ngoba vele umfowabo uMnuz Bheki Ntuli obenguNobhala eThekwini ukhona embangweni wezikhundla njengoba kuyiwa engqungqutheleni yesifunda, esinye isizathu esenza angabi qotho odabeni lwaseThekwini wukuthi uNkk Gumede wayehola ithimba laseThekwini elaliphikisana nokuthi akhethwe njengoNobhala wesifundazwe,” kusho uDube. Uthe kwabathusa futhi ukuthi ngesikhathi beboshiwe ngeledlule esiteshini samaphoyisa eDurban Central ngemuva kombhikisho, bezwa elinye iphoyisa lithi uthe uCele ufuna inombolo yecala. Omunye wabakhulumela abeseka uNkk Gumede, uMnuz Sduduzo Magwaza uthe uNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni, nomfowabo obenguNobhala waseThekwini baba nomhlangano nemenenja yoMkhandlu weTheku, uMnuz Sipho Nzuza kwathathwa isinqumo sokuthi kwelulwe inkontileka yezinkampani ezine ezithinteka ecaleni mayelana nethenda kadoti okuboshwe ngayo uNkk Gumede, kusetshenziswa isigaba somthetho uSection 36, lapho inkampani inikwa umsebenzi ngaphandle kokulandelwa kwemigudu yokukhishwa kwamathenda. Ukwelulwa kwethenda yokuqoqwa kukadoti kumenyezelwe emhlanganweni wamakhansela alawula umasipala ngoJuni 18, iMeya isinikwe ikhefu lenyanga. Omunye wabeseka imeya, uMnuz Ntando Khuzwayo, uthe: “Singabaholi thina emagatsheni nakuma-zone e-ANC konke lokhu esikwenzayo sikwenza ngoba singahambisani nendlela okusingathwe ngayo udaba lwemeya nekhansela uMondli Mthembu ngoba sikholwa wukuthi ubulungiswa abuzange benziwe, asikwenzi lokhu ngoba kuyiMeya singakwenza kunoma iliphi iqabane uma sibona ukuthi kudlalwa ngalo.” UDube uthe: “Sesibhalele ubuholi bukazwelonke ukuba bungenele, uma singaneme ngokungenela kwabo sizophoqeleka ukuthi siye enkantolo.” Okunye okuvelile wukuthi abeseka uNkk Gumede ngeledlule bavale amahhovisi esifunda eCommercial City ngoba bengahambisani nokuqokwa kwethimba lesikhashana okuthiwa kumele lilungiselele ingqungquthela. OWAYENGU Khomishina kwaSouth African Revenue Services (Sars) uMnuz Tom Moyane usekuqinisekisile ukuthi irogue unit beyikhona futhi isebenza, ummeli wakhe uthe uzimisele ngokufakaza ngalokhu akushoyo. Ummeli kaMoyane uEric Mabuza uthe uma engase inkantolo uMoyane ukuthi avele azofakaza ngakwaziyo, lokho angakwenza ngaphandle kwenkinga kwazise akekho ongaphikisana nomyalelo wenkantolo. “Angabethula ubufakazi uma inkantolo imyalela ukuthi enze njalo,” kusho uMabuza ekhuluma ngoMoyana ngesikhathi ebuzwa i-Independent Media ukuthi angakwazi yini ukukufungela lokhu akushoyo. Kodwa ummeli akakwazanga ukuphendula umbuzo wokuthi uMoyane ucabangani ngesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uPravin Gordhan. Ngesonto eledlule lo mlisa owaxoshwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngoNovemba wonyaka odlule uyena owavula icala evulela i-unit. Uthe ezinye izinto ezathengwa zisebenziselwa ukumpimpa, amakhamera, imishini yokuqopha, ukujenywa kwama cellular, okwakwenziwela ukuphazamisa ezokuxhumana phakathi kwama phone nama cellular. .“Ngavula icala esiteshini samaphoyisa eBrooklyn ngoMeyi 2015, nabasebenzi ababili bafika nabo bavuma ukuthi bazokuba ngofakazi bahulumeni," kuchaza isitatimende esithunyelwe uMoyane. Okhulumela amaHawks uCaptain Llyod Ramovha uthe izolo bebesematasa bebheka izivumelwano bazokwazi ukuqinisekisa konke ngoLwesibili.
UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, uNgqongqoshe walo mnyango kuzwelonke, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi noMnuz Sibusiso Lushaba, weHBM-SA ngesikhathi ongqongqoshe bezobheka ukusebenza kwasikhungo esikhiqiza amakhondomu, ngeledlule UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, uNgqongqoshe walo mnyango kuzwelonke, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi noMnuz Sibusiso Lushaba, weHBM-SA ngesikhathi ongqongqoshe bezobheka ukusebenza kwasikhungo esikhiqiza amakhondomu, ngeledlule UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMpilo kuleli, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi noNgqongqoshe walo mnyango KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, banelisekile ngokusebenza kwenkampani ekhiqiza amakhondomu, eseDube Trade Port. Ngemuva kokuvalwa kwengqungquthela ebidingida izinto ezithinta isifo sofuba, eThekwini, ngesonto eledlule uDhlomo noMotsoaledi bavakashele isikhungo esakhiwe ngokusebenzisana nenkampani yase-United States, iHBM neSA Potection Services. Lesi sikhungo sibizwa ngokuthi iHBM-SA. Lesi sikhungo sikhiqiza amakhondomu angu-700 000 ngosuku. Lawa makhondomu aphakelwa ezikhungweni zezempilo zakuleli, amanye adayiswe emazweni angaphandle. Kulindeleke ukuthi le nkampani yenyuse isibalo somkhiqizo wayo kungekudala njengoba iqhubeka nokunweba ibhilidi esebenzela kulo. Amakhondomu akhiqizwa kulesi sikhungo, iMax Condoms, angene esikhundleni seChoice azosatshalaliswa ezikhungweni zikahulumeni. Le nkampani, eyakhiwe ngoR150 million, iqashe abantu abangu-150 bendawo. Ngaphambi kokuthi kusungulwe le nkampani, uMnyango wezeMpilo bewuwathenga eChina amakhondomu asatshalaliswa ezikhungweni zikahulumeni. Ngemuva kokuthi uhulumeni esungule uphiko oluyisipesheli lokuthuthukiswa komnotho, eDube Trade Port, uthathe isinqumo sokuthi le nkampani ibe kulesi sikhungo esenzelwe ukuthi kube lula ukuthi kuthunyelwe izimpahla kwamanye amazwe. UDkt Dhlomo uthe: “Ungqongqoshe kumjabulisile akubone kulesi sikhungo waze wethembisa ukuthi uzobuya maduze azosivula ngokusemthethweni. Okumjabulise kakhulu ukuthi lesi sikhungo singakwazi ukukhiqiza amakhondomu angu-1.4 million ngosuku. Thina kulesi sifundazwe sishaye izinyoni ezimbili ngetshe elilodwa ngokuvulwa kwalesi sikhungo esifundazweni sethu, ukuba khona kwaso kusho ukuthi ngeke sishodelwe ngamakhondomu njengoba ezobe ekhiqizwa lapha. Kuzoba lula ukuthi athunyelwe ezikhungweni zezempilo kulesi sifundazwe,” usho kanje. Amakhondomu athathwa njengesivikeli esiphephile esingavikela ukukhulelwa okungadingekile nokudluliselana ngezifo socansi. Izibalo zezempilo kuleli zikhombisa ukuthi amantombazane aneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 no-24 kunamathuba amaningi okuthi athole igciwane lengculazi nokuthi akhulelwe engahlelile. Lokhu kunomthelelela wokuthi kube nabafundi abaningi abaphume esikoleni bengaziphothulile izifundo zabo ezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu nasezikhungweni zezemfundo eziphakeme. UDhlomo uthe uhulumeli usaqhubeka nokugqugquzela ukuthi abantu basebenzise uhlelo lokuzivikela oluhlanganisa izindlela ezembili ngesikhathi esisodwa, iDual Protection. Abesilisa basokwe kodwa baqhubeke basebenzise amakhondomu, njalo uma beya ocasini, abesifazane basebenzise amaphilisi noma umjovo wokuhlela nekhondomu, njalo uma beya ocansini.

Isithombe: Bhekikhaya Mabaso Isikhangiso seDA esisuse umsindo ngesikhathi sethulwa umholi waleli qembu uMnuz Mmusi Maimane. Isithombe: Bhekikhaya Mabaso AYAVEVA amalungu omndeni wabantu abashona emuva kokuthuthwa esibhedlela sabagula ngengqondo iLife Esidimeni emuva kokuthi iDA ibhale amagama abo oqwembeni lokukhankasela ukhetho ngaphandle kwemvumo yemindeni. Izolo lolu qwembe olungaseBraamfontein, eGoli, olunemibhalo emikhulu ethi, ANC Is Killling Us luhleshuliwe ngabantu okuthiwa ngamalungu omndeni wabafa emuva kokukhishwa eLife Esidimeni. Kulolu qwembe kukhona namagama abavukuzi abafa esibhicongweni saseMarikana nawezingane ezife emuva kokuwela emathoyilethi omgodi. UNkk Christine Nxumalo owashonelwa yilungu lomndeni elakhishwa eLife Esidimeni ubhale ekhasini lakhe le-twitter ukuthi “Ngidinwe kabi ukuthi uMmusi Maimane uvule isikhangiso esinamagama amalungu ethu omndeni ngaphandle kokucela imvume yethu. Imbi lento ayenzile ngoba efuna amavoti. IDA ayinalo ilungelo lokusebenzisa le nhlekelele nobuhlungu bethu ukuze ithole amavoti,” UMnuz Solly Malatsi okhulumela iDA uthe ukuklejulwa koqwembe lwabo kungcolisa umlando walabo abashone ngaphansi kukahulumeni we-ANC. “Yize singaqondi ukuthi wubani oklebhule uqwembe lwethu kodwa akukhona okokuqala simoshelwa uqwembe olukhuluma iqiniso ngohulumeni we-ANC. Lesi senzo singcolisa umlando walabo abashonile ngoba ukufa kwabantu Esidimeni, Marikana nezingane eziphoseka emathoyilethe omgodi bekungavinjwa ukube uhulumeni ka-ANC uyasebenza,” kusho uMalatsi. UMnuz Zizi Kodwa okhulumela i-ANC uthe iDA ayibuqondi ubuhlungu babantu abashonelwa ngamalungu omndeni Esidimeni, eMarikana nakumathoyilethi omgodi futhi uMalatsi neDA kufanele baxolise ebantwini ngalesi senzo. Umhlaziyi wepolitiki uMnuz Ralph Mathekga uthe iDA inawo umlando wokukhankasa ngokugxibha amanye amaqembu epolitiki okuyinto enganambithisiseki kahle kubavoti baseNingizimu Afrika. “IDA ivamise ukukopela izinto ezenziwa e-United States naseBritain zokukhankasa ngokugxibha abanye abaholi. Lo mkhuba uyasebenza kwamanye amazwe hhayi eNingizimu Afrika,” kusho uMathekga. Uthe lesi sikhangiso sikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi iDA ayibaqondi kahle abantu abamnyama ngokosiko, ngokwendlela yokuphila nangokuthi abahlekisi ngokufa. “IDA ayikakabaqondi abantu abamnyama lokhu kuzoyilahlekisela ngabavoti. Kuyakhombisa ukuthi izinto eziningi zisenziwa ngabamhlophe. Kufanele iDA iqaphele ukuthi ukugxibha i-ANC akuyakheli igama elibi kwabamnyama ngoba kufanele ihloniphe namasiko abo ngesikhathi igxeka,” kusho uMathekga.
UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uthi wonke umuntu kufanele avotele iqembu lakhe ngoba yilo elilwela abantu uma behlukunyezwa noma befuna umhlaba UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, uthi wonke umuntu kufanele avotele iqembu lakhe ngoba yilo elilwela abantu uma behlukunyezwa noma befuna umhlaba UMHOLI we-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF), uMnuz Julius Malema, ugxeke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuseka i-ANC yize bengayethembi ukuthi ingabavikela ezintweni ezibathwalisa ubunzima nsuku zonke. Ethula umkhankaso wayo wokhetho eGoli izolo, uMalema uthe kubhekwe ukuthi ukhetho lwangonyaka ozayo lube nezinga eliphezulu lokuncintisana selokhu kwaba nokhetho lwentando yabantu ngo-1994. UMalema utshele amalungu e-EFF, eStandard Bank Arena, eGoli, ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika baseka i-ANC kodwa bese bethembela kwi-EFF ukuthi ixazulule izinkinga zabo zansuku zonke. “Njalo uma abantu beshaywa ngabelungu batshela i-EFF kutwitter kodwa uma beyovota, bavotela i-ANC.” Uthe i-EFF iyona egcwele abantu abamnyama selokhu yasungulwa eminyakeni emihlanu edlule. “Asikho esinye isixazululo ngaphandle kwe-EFF. Kufanele nivotele i-EFF.” Kule nyanga i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) izobhalisa abantu ukulungiselela ukhetho lwangonyaka ozayo. UMalema uthe izifundiswa ezimnyama ziyazitshwa uma kufanele zikhushulelwe izikhundla ezinkampanini ezizimele kodwa abamhlophe bayavunwa. “Odadewethu abamnyama baholelwa kancane uma kuqhathaniswa nezintokazi ezimhlophe. Odadewethu kabakhushulelwa izikhundla kodwa abamhlophe bakhushulelwa izikhunndla njalo emuva kwezinyanga ezinhlanu. Abamnyama basebenza iminyaka emihlanu bengakhushulelwa izikhundla.” kusho uMalema. I-EFF inhlangano yesithathu ngobukhulu eNingizimu Afrika, ilandela i-ANC ne-DA . Abantu abangakubhaliselanga ukuvotela iqembu lakhe bayizigebengu. “Sithi bonke abantu emagatsheni e-EFF ezweni ababhalisele ukuvota. Uma ungabhalisile kusho ukuthi uyisigebengu. NgoMashi 10 no-11 wonke umuntu kufanele ayobhalisa ikheli lalapho ehlala khona.” Kulabo abangahambisani nokuqedwa kweNgonyama Trust ephethe umhlaba weSilo, uMalema uthe abalwesabi udlame uma abantu befuna ukuluqala ngoba bethi bavikela Ingonyama Trust. “Kungani umbuso wamaZulu kufanele uphathwe ngendlela ehlukile kuneminye, izwe libe liphethwe ngentando yabantu? Kungani kufanele sisabe uma kukhuluma wona? Sibuswa ngentando yabantu, akekho umuntu okufanele asisabise ngodlame. Labo abasisabisa ngodlame bayakhombisa ukuthi abacabangi kodwa-ke asilusabi udlame,” kusho uMalema. Ngo-2016 i-EFF yathola u-8% wamavoti kanti iyona eyaba nomthelela omkhulu komasipala okwakungawinanga amaqembu amakhulu kuwo. Abantu bethu bafuna umhlaba.” Uthe ngeke bavote ne-ANC uma ingafuni ukufaka owayenguNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Mcebisi Jonas, kwesobuMeya eNelson Mandela Bay. “Uma i-ANC iza nomuntu ongafanele ngeke sivote kusho ukuthi uTrollip uzoqhubeka nokuba yiMeya. Akukho okusiphoqayo ukuthi sivote neDA noma ne-ANC. Siseka uJonas ngoba uyindoda engagwazeleki ngoba wanqaba * -R600 000 000 ayewuthenjiswa ngabakwaGupta. Sifuna umuntu ongenagcobho,” kusho uMalema.
Umbuzo: Ngagana indoda engishiya ngeminyaka ewu-22 ubudala kanti mina manje ngineminyaka ewu-34. Sesineminyaka emihlanu sishadile kodwa asitholi bantwana. Noma yena esola ukuthi imina onenkinga, angizange ngimtshele ukuthi ngake ngakhulelwa ingane yenye indoda engangithandana nayo kudala kodwa ngasikhipha isisu. Angikaze ngimtshele ngempilo yami yaphambilini ngoba angifuni angahlulele. Sekunzima ukuphumela obala manje emva kweminyaka engaka sishadile. Ungidlisa amaphilisi azongisiza ngikhulelwe ngokushesha, futhi usefaka nengcindezi yenhlobo yokudla okufanele ngiyidle ukungisiza. Angazi impela ukuthi ngenzenjani, ngoba ngiyazi mina ukuthi anginankinga nhlobo nje. Naye uyaphika ukuthi unenkinga kodwa akafuni ukuthi siye kodokotela. Senzenjani? Mbali, Adams Mission IMPENDULO: Kunzima kakhulu ukungabatholi abantwana uma nishadile. Kodwa ngeke nazi ukuthi ubani ongabatholi ngaphandle kokuthi nibonane nodokotela. Nokukhulelwa kwakho phambilini akusho ukuthi ungaba nenkinga manje. Odokotela kuphela abangakuqinisekisa lokho. Ukubona udokotela kuzokwenza nazi ukuthi nibhekane nani khona nizokwazi ukulwa nento eniyaziyo nobabili. Umbuzo: Sineminyaka emine sashada nonkosikazi wami. Asizange sikhulume ngohlobo lomshado esizowushada ngaphambi komshado. Unkosikazi wami wangena kulo mshado enganalutho manje ayikho into angenayo. Okungiphatha kabi manje ukuthi usekhombise ukungathembeki kumina izikhathi eziningi kodwa ngiyasaba ukumshiya ngoba uzothola zonke izimali zami ayozidla nalabo bhuti athandana nabo. Ngifuna aphume aphele empilweni yami kodwa angazi kuzokwenzakalani ezimalini zami. Angifuni athole lutho. Igama ligodliwe, eMondlo Impendulo: Kubalulekile ukuvumelana ngaphambi kokuthi nishade ngenhlobo yomshado enifuna ukuba nawo. Ngeshwa uma ningakwenzi lokho kuthathwa ngokuthi nifuna lo mshado ohlanganisa amafa. Uma usamthanda unkosikazi wakho zamani ukubonana nabeluleki bezemishado ukuze banisize ukulungisa umshado wenu. Uma senivumelene ngokuthi anisathandi ukuba ndawonye kungcono ubonane nommeli wakho ukuze akuchushise kahle ngendlela ekumele uyithathe ukuze ungakhali ngaphansi ngalo mshado wenu. Umbuzo: Sesinonyaka sihlala ndawonye nesoka lami. Angiganile. Ngiyamthanda kakhulu kodwa ukungabinamsenzi kwakhe sekuqala ukudala inkinga ebudlelwaneni bethu. Ngazi ukuthi indoda kufanele ivuke ekuseni iyosebenza. Kanti yena cha uhlala endlini alinde mina ngibuye nesinkwa ntambama. Lokhu sekuqala ukungenelela ngisho ekamelweni. Ngiyahluleka ukuthatha indawo yami yokuba unkosikazi endodeni engabonisi izimpawu zokuba indoda ekhaya. Khumbuzile, eMadadeni Impendulo: Awuchazanga noma indoda yakho iyawuzama umsebenzi kodwa iwona ongatholakali. Zama nawe ukumsiza lapho ongamsiza khona ukuze athole umsebenzi. Uma ungakaze ulukhulume lolu daba naye, yiso lesi isikhathi sokwenza njalo. Kubalulekile ukuthi azi ukuthi iyakukhathaza le ndlela okwenzeka ngayo. Njengendoda kumele avuke azithathe. Umbuzo: Sineminyaka ewu-20 sithandana nomuntu wami. Sewakhokha ngisho ilobolo waze wembesa. Kusele umshado omkhulu nje kuphela. Ngoba ngibona isimo sethu sezimali ngike ngamcela ukuthi siye kobhala enkantolo. Wakhombisa ukungasithokozeli lesi sinqumo sami kwaze kwagcina sekukhona ukungazwani phakathi kwethu. Ngibona ukuthi yena uzitshela ukuthi mina ngibona ukuthi akanayo imali yokungishada kanti mina bengizama ukumsiza. Manje okungixakayo ukuthi akasayiphathi nhlobo manje eyokushada. Asisesihle ngempela isimo phakathi kwethu kodwa manje akekho ofuna ukuphumela obala ngekusasa lethu. Ngenzenjani? Sengicabanga ngisho nokuphumela ngaphandle ngoba angiyazi into engisayihlalele kuleli khaya. Igama ligodliwe, eThekwini Impendulo: Izinto zoniwa wumlomo ziphinde zilungiswe nguwo. Kungenzeka ngempela ukuthi isoka lakho alikuqondanga kahle ukuthi uchazani ngendaba yokushada enkantolo. Okungenzeka ukuthi naye uzitshela ukuthi ukuyoshada enkantolo kuzokwehlisa isithunzi sakhe njengendoda. Umshado omkhulu ningabuye niwenze uma iphakethe livuma. SBU BUTHELEZI SBU BUTHELEZI IMEYA yaseMgungundlovu, uMnuz Themba Njilo, ithi babonga uNkulunkulu ngokuvikela umsakazi woKhozi FM olimale kabi esigamekweni okusolwa kuso ukuthi ubedunwa imoto. Kushaqise abaningi ukuvela kwezindaba zokuthi uSbu Buthelezi wohlelo lwasemini Indiza Nathi ngo-12 kuya ku-3 ntambama phakathi nezinsuku udutshulwe amahlandla amaningana ngeSonto ebusuku eMbali, eMgungundlovu. UNjilo uthe kubuhlungu okuvelele lo msakazi. “Ngiphuma kuye nje (esho izolo emini), isimo sakhe siyagculisa kakhulu. Siyambonga uNkulunkulu. Uyakhuluma konke kuhamba kahle siyabonga asiqedi,” kuchaza uNjilo ngamafuphi. Umthombo okhulume naleli phephandaba uveze ukuthi uSbu ubekwenye yezindawo afuna ukuqala kuzo ibhizinisi eMgungundlovu. “Kuthiwa ubemile ngaphandle kule ndawo ngesikhathi kuqhamuka abalisa okungaziwa ukuthi bangaki abavele bavulela ngenhlamvu. Isicabha sakhe ungasibona ukuthi silimele kanjani njengoba kwanaye edubuleke esifubeni,” kuchaza umthombo. Uveze ukuthi lo msakazi kuthe ngesikhathi esedubulekile wangena emotweni wahamba wayofuna usizo. “Kuvela ukuthi ungene egaraji nala engalutholanga khona usizo njengoba abantu bevele bathuka babaleka ngisho nabasebenzi. Uphinde waqhubeka wazishayelela nokuthe endleleni waluthola wase ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela,” kuchaza umthombo. LESI ngesinye sezithombe ezilethe ithemba kwabaningi ukuthi uyalulama umsakazi woKhozi FM, uSbu Buthelezi, ngemuva kokuvela kwezindaba zokuthi udutshulwe esigamekweni okusolwa ukuthi ubebanjwa kuso inkunzi eMgungundlovu ngeSonto ebusuku. USbu kulesi sithombe ubehanjelwe umculi wokholo uThobekile Mkhwanazi nabanye ozakwabo Uveze ukuthi esibhedlela ukwazile ukulandisa abafike kuqala konke okwenzekile kodwa isimo sakhe sase siba sibana nokugcine esengeniswa egunjini labagula kakhulu. Abantu abaningi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bazwelane kakhulu noSbu ngokumehlele. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuvulwe icala lokuzama ukubulala ngemuva kwalesi sigameko. Uthe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-47 uhlaselwe ngabesilisa abangaziwa abavele bavulela ngenhlamvu ekhoneni lomgwaqo u-Archie Gumede noMoses Mabhida. UMbele uthe lona wesilisa ulimale esifubeni nasengalweni. Umculi wokholo uThobekile Mkhwanazi wehlise amaphaphu abaningi ngemuva kokuthi efake isithombe enaye lo msakazi esibhedlela. Okhulumela iSABC, uNeo Momodu, uthe abaphathi bakwaSABC nabasebenzi bonke bamfisela ukushesha alulame uSbu ngemuva kwesigameko esimehlele. Uthe lo msakazi uyalulama futhi isimo sakhe sempilo sihle kakhulu.

ODLALELA abaculi abadumile bokholo base-Eastern Cape i-keyboard, okubalwa kubo uBetusile Mcinga noDumi Mkokstad, kusolakala ukuthi uzifake obishini ngokulimaza kabuhlungu obeyintombi yakhe. UNksz Phakamile Mthalane (33) waseWembezi, e-Estcourt, ufuna lo saziwayo abhadle ejele ngokumsakaza ngezimpama, amklinye, amgingqe ngequpha, amgxobe futhi aze amgence ngembazo encane ngesikhathi emvakashele endlini aqashe kuyo eChris Hani Park, eMthatha, e-Eastern Cape, ngoMashi 4. Umgilwa uthi umsolwa wamshaya wacishe wamkhipha umphefumulo beqhathwa yizimpahla zomunye umuntu wesifazane azifica endlini yomsolwa. “Namanje angazi wangishayelani ngoba angimlwisanga. Ngambuza nje ukuthi kwenzakalani ngempahla yowesifazane engayifica endlini yakhe ngoba kimina wathi akathandani namuntu. Ngagcina sengixolisa, ngingazi ukuthi ngixoliselani. “Ngazithulela ngemuva kwalokho walibele ekhuluma, ngingamphenduli esefuna silale ngenkani, nganqaba.” Uthe umsolwa wabe esemshaya ngempama ethi akamphenduli ngani. “Wabe esengikhahlela futhi engigxoba sengilele phansi, engibuza ukuthi angimphenduli ngani uma ekhuluma nami. Wangiklinya ethi angimshaye nami, ngaze ngaphelelwa ngamandla, ngaquleka.” UNksz Mthalane uthi umsolwa wayemshaya sengathi ulwa nomuntu wesilisa obezama ukumbulala. “Ngaphaphama cishe ngemuva kwemizuzu eyishumi, wayesami phezu kwami nembazo ethi ungihlahlela ngayo ngayivika ngaze ngagoqana. Ngaphumelela ukuphulukundlela ngibaleke, ngacishe ngashayiswa imoto engingayazi, ngiyimisa emgwaqweni, ngicela usizo lwasesiteshini samaphoyisa.” Uthe wavula icala esiteshini samaphoyisa saseMgungundlovu kodwa ladluliselwa kwesaseMthatha esiqinisekisile ukuthi likhona icala esiliphenyayo elimayelana nokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza elivulwe wuNksz Mthalane. UBetusile uvumile ukuthi uyamazi umsolwa, futhi uyamdlalela i-keyboard nabanye abaculi abaningi abadumile base-Eastern Cape. “Nodaba ngiyalwazi kodwa ngamtshela lo sisi ukuthi akaxhumane naye lo bhuti noma avule icala ngoba mina angifuni ukufakwa entweni engingahlangene nayo. Akasalungu lebhendi yami kodwa ngiyamqasha uma kukhona lapho ngiyocula khona.” Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukamsolwa ayiphumelelanga ngenxa yokuthi izingcingo zakhe bezingabanjwa kanti nemiyalezo abethunyelelwa yona kuWhatsApp beyifundwa kodwa ingaphendulwa. Umsolwa ugcine eseyibhlokha inamba abethunyelelwa ngayo imiyalezo.
INGXABANO ebe phakathi kukanina nendodana ngempelasonto ngenxa yephathi ebeyisendaweni, iyona okusolwa ukuthi iholele ekuzilengiseni kwendodana ethempelini lamaNazaretha aseBuhleni, Impumelelo, eliseMpumelelo eFrance, eMgungundlovu, nokuyilapho umufi ebekhonza khona nomndeni. Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ngomthombo ongaphakathi kuleli bandla ocele ukungadalulwa, uNduduzo Shezi (19) obefunda uGrade 10 eMzuzo High School kule ndawo, uqale wahilizisana nonina ngoba efuna ukuya ephathini ngenkani ebusuku. “Emva kokuhilizana nonina, wagcina evumile (unina) ukuthi akaye ephathini nakuba kungokokuqala ukuthi aye ephathini,” kusho umthombo. Ngokomthombo, uNduduzo wabuya ngo-11 ebusuku ngempelasonto baphinde bathusana nonina ngoba ebuze ukuthi kungani ebuya sekuhambe isikhathi ngalolu hlobo. “Umfana wathi kunina akamshaye okungcono uma kungukuthi wenze into engafanele kunokuthi amthethise,” kubeka umthombo. Kubikwa ukuthi entathakusa ngo-1 ngalolo suku, uNduduzo waphuma kubo, unina wazitshela ukuthi hleze usaphuthuma kubangani bakhe abekade ehambe nabo ukuya ephathini. Umthombo uthi emva kwesikhathi esithile uNduduzo ehambile, abazali bakhe bathola imilayezo kumaselula abo evela kwindodana ivalelisa futhi ixolisa ngesenzo ehlose ukusenza (sokuzibulala) nakuba ingazange ichaze ukuthi ifuna ukwenzani. Ngakusasa sekubonakala ukuthi indodana ayibuyi, umthombo uthi abazali bayo namalungu ebandla aphuma umkhankaso eyifuna. “Kodwa kuye kwasishaqisa ukuthi agcine etholakele ethempelini, kubonakala intambo emqaleni eduzane nalapho eshonele khona,” kusho umthombo. Uthe okuphinde kube yindida, akucaci kahle-hle ukuthi noma lona wesilisa uzilengisele esihlahleni esisethempelini, noma kukhona abambulele base bemthatha bezombeka esihlahleni esisethempelini bemfake intambo emqaleni. “Okuye kwasidida ukuthi ubenemihuzuko ebusweni, manje sixakwa wukuthi ubelimale kanjani ebusweni ebe ezilengisile,” ubuze kanje umthombo. Okhulumela ibandla laseBuhleni, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe ubengakezwa ngalesi sigameko, nakuba enolwazi ngethempeli elikule ndawo. “Siyazwelana kakhulu nomndeni ngokwenzekile,” kuchaza uMncwabe. Uthe njengebandla banenhlangano yentsha ebizwa ngokuthi INABACHU, lapho beyiyala khona ngezindlela zokuziphatha emakhaya nasebandleni. Uthe ukuya emaphathini ngezinye zezinto abangazikhuthazi njengebandla ngoba akuthandazwa khona, kungenzeka uhlangabezane nezinkinga. “Siphinde futhi sibe nenkonzo ka-23, 25 neka-14 lapho siyala khona bonke abesilisa nabesifazane ngendlela yokuziphatha,” kugcizelela uMncwabe. Uthe njengoba sekwenzeke lesi sigameko nje, sekuzomele umndeni uligeze ngembuzi ithempeli. “Okuzokwenzeka manje ukuthi sibikele inkosi, bese umndeni uthenga imbuzi okuzohlanzwa ngayo ithempeli. Umshumayeli okhona kuleli thempeli uyena okuzomele engamele lowo msebenzi,” kuchaza uMncwabe. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe bebengakezwa ngalolu daba. Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela ungatholakalanga umndeni kamufi ukuthi uphawule ngalolu daba. Kubikwe ukuthi umatasa njengoba ulungiselela umngcwabo wakhe.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi afake isicelo sebheyili ngesonto elizayo amaphoyisa amabili nonogada abasolwa ngokuthumba usomabhizinisi nokusolwa ukuthi kuthinteka amabhizinisi nodaba lwamathenda ngokunyamalala kwakhe. UMnuz Sikhumbuzo Mjwara (41) ulahleke ekupheleni kuka-Agasti nonyaka kade eseNkantolo yaseVerulam ehamba icala lombango phakathi kwakhe nozakwabo ababanga naye ubunikazi bendawo ephambili yokudla eMhlanga, iBarrio. Umndeni wakhe uveze ukuthi wazi ukuthi uzakwabo wakokotela amaphepha amenza kube nguyena ophethe le ndawo yokudla eseMhlanga ekubeni bengalihlanganisele ibhizinisi. Okhulumela amaphoyisa uLt Colonel Thulani Zwane ukuqinisekisile ukuthi babophe abasolwa ababili ngodaba lokuthunjwa kwalo somabhizinisi. “Uphiko lwe-Organised Crime Unit lubophe abasolwa ababili abaneminyaka engu-35 no-37 ngo-Okthoba 3 ngecala lokuthumba. Bavele eNkantolo yaseVerulam, icala lahlehliselwa u-Okthoba 15. Bagcinwe esitokisini. Omunye umsolwa oneminyaka engu-37 uboshwe ngo-Okthoba 4. Uvele enkantolo ngo-Okthoba 5. Naye usatokile,” kusho uZwane. Laba bobathathu bazobuyela enkantolo ngo-Okthoba 15. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi izolo kuboshwe elinye iphoyisa lisemhlanganweni wokuqeqesha abaphenyi ngalo leli cala kodwa lokhu akuzange kuqinisekiswe ngamaphoyisa. Kuboshwa laba nje lo somabhizinisi akakatholakali. Umfowabo walo somabhizinisi uMnuz Philani Bhengu ethintwa yiSolezwe izolo uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi abazi ukuthi umfowabo ukephi. “Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi kukhona ababoshelwe ukuthumba umfowethu, okubuhlungu ukuthi asazi ukuthi ukephi kuze kube manje. Asazi noma uthunjelwe umbango wamabhizinisi akhe noma amathenda. Siyasola nokho ukuthi ukulahleka kwakhe kusondelene nomsebenzi wakhe abewenza wamabhizinisi namathenda. Sisebumnyameni nje. Sesithembe laba ababoshiwe ukuthi bazokhuluma iqiniso,” kusho uBhengu. UMjwara kuthiwa waduka ngelanga athathwa ngalo ngamaphoyisa, phambi kwengoduso yakhe nonogada wakhe eNkantolo yaseVerulam, akaphindange wabonakala. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi bemthatha bathi uyophenywa ngecala elithize elithinta amathenda.
AMALUNGU omndeni kaMnuz Jacob Zuma asembangweni wemali yethenda. Isithombe: Karen Sandison/African News Agency(ANA) AMALUNGU omndeni kaMnuz Jacob Zuma asembangweni wemali yethenda. Isithombe: Karen Sandison/African News Agency(ANA) SEBEXABANE baze bafakana enkantolo abomndeni wowayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma kubangwa imali yethenda yomshini ophakela amanzi, abayifaka eNkandla. UMnuz Zobaphi Zuma, ozalwa ngumfowabo wobengumengameli noNksz Nompumelelo Mhlongo, oyisihlobo esiqavile basembangweni oshubile wemali. UZuma (Zobaphi) ukhala ngoNksz Mhlongo ngokugweva nemali athi babeyithole emuva kokuthola ithenda yokufaka injini yamanzi. UZuma uthi empeleni bebesebenzisana ngaphansi kwenkampani, Ubucebo General Trading. Uthi ngokwazi kwakhe, kufanele ngabe wathola R500 000 ngomsebenzi abawenza kodwa akatholanga ngisho isente. Useze wakhetha ukulufaka enkantolo udaba ngoba usekhathele wukukhuluma nesihlobo sakhe esingafuni nemali. "Ngiqale ngalubika kubaba, umndeni wazama ukumbiza wakhuluma naye. Kodwa kwacaca ukuthi naye uyehluleka. Uthe esuka wathi angithathe noma yisiphi isinyathelo engisifunayo ngoba naye ukhulumile wehluleka. Ngiyayifuna imali yami, kayikho enye indlela engingayikhuluma ngayo le ndaba,’’ kuchaza uZuma Usole uNksz Mhlongo ngokungabi nalo iqiniso njengoba ethi akasamshayeli ngisho ucingo ngalolu daba, sebegcina ngokubonana uma kunemicimbi emndenini, babingelelane kuphele kanjalo. UNksz Mhlongo ethintwa, ukhuze wababaza uma ezwa ukuthi udaba selusenkantolo, wathi ubengakwazi lokho yena ngoba wakhuluma noZuma wamchazela. "Inkinga esahlangabezana nayo wukuthi kasitholanga imali esasilindele ukuyithola ngomsebenzi esawenza ngoba kwaphoqa ukuthi siholele abasebenzi imali elinganayo. Ngiyasola ukuthi uZobaphi wazitshela ukuthi usizi lwakhe seluphelile, uma sithola ithenda kanti sizoba nale nkinga. Kasiyenzanga inzuzo, ngigcine sengingena ezikweletini ngalolu daba,’’ kuchaza uNksz Mhlongo.

UMHOLI we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema eshayela umengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ihlombe ngemuva kwenkulumo yakhe UMHOLI we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema eshayela umengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ihlombe ngemuva kwenkulumo yakhe IQEMBU eselizakhele udumo ngokushubisa izinto ePhalamende, i-EFF, lithuse abaningi izolo lingaphazamisi inkulumo ebhekiswe esizweni kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngoLwesine. I-EFF yafunga yagomela ukuthi kuzoba ncane indawo ePhalamende uma kuphela uJanuwari nonyaka uRamaphosa engacacisile ngodaba lwemali ebalelwa kuR500 000 okuthiwa wayinikelelwa yinkampani iBosasa ngesikhathi ekhankasela ukuba umengameli we-ANC. Ngemuva kwenkulumo kaRamaphosa umholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema uthe bagculisekile ngendlela umengameli aphendule ngayo izinsolo abekwe zona. “Umengameli waya kuMvikeli woMphakathi, ngaphezu kwalokho waphinde wethula umbiko wakhe (ngomnikelo weBosasa) kwi-eNCA, wathumela nesitatimende kwabezindaba. Esikufunayo nje ukuthi umengameli akwazi ukuphendula uma kukhona asolwa ngakho,” kuchaza uMalema. URamaphosa uvule inkulumo yakhe ngamancoko ngesikhathi esandlalela eveza ukuthi bavumelene noMalema ukuthi uzocula iculo elithi ‘Thuma Mina’ uma lo mholi we-EFF eba ngumengameli wezwe ngemuva kokhetho. USotswebhu omkhulu we-EFF uFloyd Shivambu uthe bekungokokugcina uRamaphosa ethula enkulumo yesizwa. Uthe i-ANC izohlulwa okhethweni ngoMeyi.
Mhleli: Ngiyabonga ngokungipha isikhala ephephandabeni lakho. Ake ngibonge yize ngingazi ukuthi abaholi be-ANC eThekwini bafinyelele kanjani esinqumeni abasithathile. Umphakathi waKwaZulu-Natal uyayithanda i-ANC kodwa izinto eziningi ezenziwa wuKhongolose kulesi sifundazwe zenza umphakathi ubone kungafanele uzihlanganise nale nhlangano. Ngifunde ephephandabeni kuthiwa ubuholi be-ANC esifundeni iTheku bufuna ukuxoxa namalungu kaKhongolose akhetha ukuzimela okhethweni ngo-2016. Ake ngilungise lapha, bonke abazimela abakaze bawushiye uKhongolose yizinkinga nenkohlakalo okwenziwa ubuholi besifundazwe nobeTheku ezadala umphakathi uvele uthi abazimele nangempela kwenzeka. Ngenzela ukucacisa lokho. Okunye okumele sikukhulume wukuthi umphakathi omningi waseThekwini owalinyazwa ngokufunzwa amakhansela abaholi besifunda seTheku awujabulile. Namanje umphakathi usadiniwe. Ukukhuluma nabazimela ngeke kwenze mahluko. Nikwenza lokhu ngoba senifuna amavoti noma seniwuqala kabusha umbutho? Uma nilungisa amaphutha kumele nibize wonke amaqabane enawona kuqala ngoba umphakathi wazi wona la maqabane nina buholi besifunda anaziwa emphakathini. Naziwa ngemisebenzi yenu emibi yokufunza umphakathi amakhansela uma nihluleke ukuzithoba emphakathini ivoti ngo-2019 nango-2021 lizoya emakhanseleni azozimela futhi. Inkinga enkulu esibhekene nayo wukuthola ubulungu be-ANC emagatsheni. Kuyaqala lokhu akukaze kwenzeke. Selokhu kwangena lobu buholi ubulungu asibutholi. UNobhala wesifunda seTheku uMnuz Bheki Ntuli usikhomba konobhala emagatsheni. Njengoba onobhala kuyizingane zamakhansela sizobuthola kanjani ubulungu ngoba phela lezi zingane zivikela isinkwa zona ngobulungu? Kungani kumele kuthiwa asiye ehlathini sibhekile? Usho kanjani ukuthi angiye kumuntu ozohlezi engatholakali kodwa ngobusuku unikeza omama abathize ukuthi abayojoyinisa labo ababanike imixhaso kuphela? Miningi imikhuba ebuholini besifunda ngoba bunesandla kule nto eyenzeka. Uma beshayelwa izingcingo sengathi kabazi ngale nkinga kodwa emakhoneni bayahlangana nalaba bantu ababulala umbutho. Siwutholile umyalezo wokuthi emagatsheni aseThekwini wonke ngenyanga edlule bekujoyiniswa ubulungu. Umbuzo wami uthi ngaphambi kwalokho senihlanganile yini namaqabane wonke ama-ward nawachazela ngomyalezo? Njengoba sizokhipha imali yethu sizothemba kanjani ukuthi izokhokhelwa ngoba kade sasigileka sikhokhe bese siyakhishwa uma sekukhethwa ubuholi. Ngizokwenza isibonelo njengaku-ward 78 eMlaza lapho ikhansela lingusihlalo bese kuthi indodakazi yekhansela ibe ngunobhala bese indoda yalo iba kwiBEC. Kuyona leyo BEC kunezalukazi zaku-ward 84 ezinikwe ubulungu ku-ward 78 yini ezolunga? Lolu hlelo lokujoyinisa umphakathi kungani ningalwenzi ngenye indlela? Kungaphela isonto ubufakazi bungabuyile bokuthi ukhokhile nezimfanelo zakhe azithole njengoba zinjalo njengoba kunamakhansela eThekwini axosha noma akhela ababengahambisani nawo amatulo okuthi baxoshwe emisebenzini, kusalungiswa nalapho? Njengoba amalungu ekomiti ye-ward enikezwe umyalelo wokuthi alandele abantu abasebenzayo njengezinduna, kusemthethweni yini lokho baholi be-ANC? Kusemthethweni yini ukuthi ubulungu bethu buhlale ezikhwameni zamakhansela? Sengizovala laba bantu enabalaxaza ngo-2016 yibona abazokwenza ukuthi nikwazi ukungena emphakathini uma ningaxoxanga nabo, khohlwani baholi amavoti. Siyawuthanda impela uKhongolose kodwa uma niqhubeka nale nto yenu amagatsha amaningi azohamba kodwa ithuba lisekhona ngoba akumnandi ukubona iqabane elidala elazabalaza lingenabo ubulungu. Esinye isilwane okumele nibhekane naso yilesi okuthiwa wuhlu lwabazovotelwa ebuholini. Okukhishwa abantu abathandwa wumphakathi kuyona. Unobhala omusha wayichaza kahle sayizwa ukuthi isuke yenziwelani. Asithembe ngeke isenzeka. Unobhala, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, sesithembe wena nomfo kaZikalala ukuthi nizokwazi ukubuyisela uKhongolose ebantwini ngoba eyi uthando emphakathini bese luphelile kodwa nje ukuxolisa ngokuwufunza abantu abangaziwa kuyonisiza bese niyaqinisekisa ukuthi ngokulandelayo ngeke nisawuphinda. Niyobe nisebenzile. Nginifisela inhlanhla, sengathi konke okuhle ebenikucabanga ngombutho kungalunga baholi. Zamani Kheswa EThekwini
UMNUZ Thokozani Malloy waKwaNzimakwe ngasePort Edward ogwetshwe iminyaka ewu-14 ejele laseWestville ugeqa amagula ngokubulala umkakhe. Isithombe: SIBUSISO NDLOVU UMNUZ Thokozani Malloy waKwaNzimakwe ngasePort Edward ogwetshwe iminyaka ewu-14 ejele laseWestville ugeqa amagula ngokubulala umkakhe. Isithombe: SIBUSISO NDLOVU INDODA eyabulala inkosikazi iyisola ngokuthi iqomile, iyala abesilisa ababhekene nesimo esifanayo ukuba bangababulali kodwa bebashiye ukugwema ukubhadla ejele njengaye odonsa iminyaka engu-14. UMnuz Thokozani Malloy (48) waKwaNzimakwe ngasePort Edward ugwetshwe ngoMeyi 2016, wanikezwa iminyaka engu-12 ngecala lokubulala uNkk Ntokozo Malloy neminyaka emibili ngelokusabisa indodana yakhe eyayingufakazi ecaleni lokubulala. UNkk Malloy wabulawa ngo-Disemba 2014. Lezi zithandani ezatholana zisafunda isikole ngo-1992 zase zishada ngo-2000, zaba nabantwana abathathu. UMalloy owayeyiphoyisa lomgwaqo ePort Shepstone esesebenze iminyaka engu-20, eseqedile ngempilo yenkosikazi yakhe naye wazama ukuzibulala ngokuzidubula ekhanda, inhlamvu yaphaphalaza yaphuma neso lakhe. Emuva kokwanda kwezigameko zabesifazane ababulawa abathandana nabo, Isolezwe libe nengxoxo ekhethelekile noMalloy ejele laseWestville lapho egwetshwe khona. “Ngifunde okukhulu ngesinqumo esingesihle engasenza sokubulala inkosikazi wami ngoba ngithola ukuthi uyajola. Engifisa ukukutshela abantu besilisa wukuthi uma bezithola kulesi simo, ukubulala umuntu othandana naye akusona isixazululo ngoba ubulala umuntu uphinde umoshe nempilo yakho neyomndeni wakho. Uma kunzima kungcono umshiye phansi ungaze wenze ozozisola ngakho,” kusho uMalloy. Uthe wayengakaze acabange ukuthi empilweni yakhe angathatha isibhamu abulale umuntu amthandayo. “Sihlalile sithandana nonkosikazi, saze sashada konke kuhamba kahle. Ngo-2010 izinto ziqalile ukungahambi kahle. Ngaphenya ngo-2013 ngigcine ngitholile ukuthi kunomuntu athandana naye. Ngabheka kwiselula yakhe emuva kokuba omunye umngani wakhe wesifazane engitshelile ukuthi impela unesoka. Ngabona izingqoxo nesoka lakhe kuWhatsApp, saxoxa kwaba sengathi kuyadlula,” kusho uMalloy. Uthe ukuba nolaka nenhliziyo encane ehambisana nokudinwa into ayevele enayo kodwa engazitsheli ukuthi kungaze kufike ekubulaleni umuntu. “Izinkinga phakathi kwami nonkosikazi zaqhubeka, ngo-2014 saze sahlala ngokuhlukana. Kwaze kwaba kufika lapho ngihluleka khona ngoDisemba ngaya kubo ngiyoxoxa naye ngendaba yomshado wethu. Saxabana ngavele ngakhipha isibhamu, wabaleka waya emzini kadadewabo lapho engafika ngamdubulela khona nami ngazidubula,” kusho uMalloy. Uthe akazi wasinda kanjani ngoba wayethi uyaqeda ngempilo yakhe. “Namanje kusangimangaza ukuthi ngaphila kanjani ngoba ngangizibulala. Ngaphaphama esibhedlela emuva kwesikhathi kwenzeke lokhu. Abantu abase bengitshela ukuthi kwenzekani endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uMalloy. Ngenxa yesimo sakhe sempilo uze wagwetshwa ngoMeyi 2016, ngemuva kokuphuma engena ezibhedlela. “Ukubulala kwami unkosikazi kwangilahlekisela ngomsebenzi, nomndeni wami njengoba ngingakwazi ukuhlala nezingane zethu ezineminyaka engu-22, 17 neneyisishiyagalombili. Ukuba nenhliziyo encane, nokudinwa akubuyiseli ngalutho. Abantu besilisa kumele bafunde ukulawula imizwa yabo, kungabi iyona ebalawulayo,” kusho uMalloy. Uthe ukungena ejele kuningi okumfundise khona njengoba efunde ngendlela yokulawula ukudinwa nendlela yokuziphatha nje. “Ngesikhathi sengenza lokhu angizange ngicabange ukuthi ngiwubaba ezinganeni zami, ziyangidinga. Angikucabanganga futhi nokuthi uma sengibulele unina, zizosala nobani uma sengiboshiwe njengoba ngisejele manje. Isinqumo osithatha ungacabanganga siyingozi,” kweluleka uMalloy. Uphinde wagcizelela ukuthi amadoda angempela awabahlukumezi abesifazane. “Indoda yangempela ayimhlukumezi umuntu wesifazane. Ayimshayi umuntu wesifazane. Induku ayakhi, ngiyazi sikhule kuthiwa uyakhiwa ngenduku kodwa lokho akusilona iqiniso. Ukuxoxa nokubonisana yikhona okwakhayo uma uthi uyindoda,” kusho uMalloy. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi sewaxolisa kubantwana bakhe yize kwakuyinto enzima kakhulu ngoba babengafuni nokumbona.
UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa, uLT-General Khehla Sitole, noNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uBheki Cele, becobelela abezindaba ngamaqhinga abo amasha okulwa nobugebengu eTshwane Police Academy Isithombe: BONGANI SHILUBANE/ African News Agency (ANA) UKHOMISHANA wamaPhoyisa, uLT-General Khehla Sitole, noNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uBheki Cele, becobelela abezindaba ngamaqhinga abo amasha okulwa nobugebengu eTshwane Police Academy Isithombe: BONGANI SHILUBANE/ African News Agency (ANA) KUZOPHELA ukushaywa umoya emahhovisi kosigaxamabhande bamaphoyisa asebezophakwa emgwaqweni balwe nobugebengu obehlukene, ikakhulukazi ukubanjwa kwenkunzi kwezimoto zemali nokubulala. Izolo ngaphambi kokuthi uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, noKhomishana wamaphoyisa, uLt-General Khehla Sitole, bethule izinhlelo zabo zokulwa nobugebengu esithangamini nabezindaba, kubikwe izenzo ezintathu zokubanjwa kwezimoto zemali eMpumalanga. USitole uthe bazotshala inqwaba yamaphoyisa emgwaqweni khona kungeke kubelula ezigebengwini ukuthi ziqhubeke zenze ubugebengu. “Sizojuba noLt-General ukuthi bahole amathimba ethu esizobe siwaphaka emgwaqweni,” kusho uSitole. Uveze nokuthi bazosebenzisa nezobuchwepheshe angazange adalule okuningi ngazo ukufihlela izigebengu induku emqubeni. “Siyazi ukuthi amanye amaphoyisa ayathinteka ezehlakalweni zobugebengu. Lawo esiwabambayo siyawaxosha embuthweni, siwabeke namacala ayobhadla ejele,” kusho uSitole. Uthe kunoLt- General abathathu ababaxoshile ngoba bebethinteka ezehlakalweni zenkohlakalo. “Siyaluseka futhi uphenyo olwenziwa wuphiko oluphenya amaphoyisa, i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (IPID).Yize luqhuba uphenyo lwalo nathi siyaqhubeka nophenyo lwethu lwangaphakathi,” kusho uSitole. Ephendula mayelana nophenyo olwenziwa yithimba eliphenya ngokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, uCele uvumile ukuthi umsebenzi waleli thimba awujabulisi. Uthe emacaleni cishe awu-40 okubulala mhlawumbe bane abantu ababoshiwe ngawo. “UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wajuba oNgqongqoshe abaphethe izinhlaka zezokuphepha ukuthi bahlanganise amakhanda ukuze balwe nendaba yokubulawa kwabantu eKZN. Ngingasho ukuthi sesiwuhambisile umbiko wethu wokuqala kuMengameli. Ngingakuveza ukuthi akajabule ngokuphelele ngokwenziwayo,” kusho uCele. UMqondisi we-Institute for Security Studies, uSolwazi Johan Burger, ekhuluma nabakwa-eNCA ngemuva kwesithangami sabezindaba sikaCele noSitole, uthe bese belinde isikhathi eside ukuzwa ukuthi iziphathimandla zamaphoyisa zinaziphi izinhlelo zokulwa nobugebengu. UBurger uthe bayakwamukela ukutshalwa kwenqwaba yamaphoyisa emgwaqweni, wengeza ngokuthi wathi naye uyakholwa wukuthi lokhu kuzosiza kunciphise ubelelesi. Uthe kodwa ukutshalwa kwenqwaba yamaphoyisa ngeke kusize ngalutho uma ezobunhloli zingekho bukhali. “Ngisakhala ngithi kumele kubuyiswe uphiko lwamaphoyisa olwavalwa iSerious and Violent Crime Unit. Lolu phiko lwasebenza ngenkulu impumelelo futhi amanye amaphoyisa ayesebenza kulona asekhona embuthweni,” kusho uBurger. Uthe ufisa futhi ukuthi kusungulwe i-Anti Corruption Unit ngaphakathi emaphoyiseni ezobhekana ngqo nenkohlakalo.

Isithombe: SIBUSISO NDLOVU BEKUYIPHUPHO lakhe leminyaka ukuyodlala phesheya umfundi wesikole samabanga aphezulu oqokelwe ukuyodlala kwiNdebe yoMhlaba yeRugby, eMalaysia. Lo mfundi odlala iRugby nasesikoleni, waqala ngo-2016 ukudlalela iqembu lesifundazwe kulo mdlalo osenabamnyama abambalwa. Ngaphandle kokudlalela iqembu lesifundazwe, uphinde aqeqeshe elesikole. “Ngangivele ngibatshelile abazali bami ukuthi ngelinye ilanga ngiyodlala kwindebe yomhlaba. Ngiwumuntu okholelwa ekufezeni wonke amaphupho,” echaza. USange wayevele ekhethiwe ukuyodlala phesheya ngonyala odlule kodwa wabanjwa umdlalo weshashalazi. Uyilungu leYoung KZN Perfomers adlala kulo imidlalo yeshashalazi. “Kwakusele isonto ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umdlalo weshashalazi ngesikhathi ngiqokelwa ukuyodlala phesheya ngonyaka odlule. Ngenxa yokuthi angifuni ukuqala into ngingayiqedi, ngakhetha ukuqhubeka nomdlalo weshashalazi,” kusho uSange. Okumenze wakwazi ukuqokwa ukuyodlala phesheya kulo nyaka ukuthi wabonwa umqeqeshi edlala kwiSenior Inter-Provincial Tournament eqenjini labesifazane. USange usesungule neqembu lakhe leTouch Rugby elibizwa ngamaScorpions. Useqeqesha nomfowabo omncane naye osedlalela iTouch Rugby Under 15 esifundazweni. Unina uNkk Busi Sange uthe uyabamangaza umfutho wendodakazi yakhe. Uthe ubamba kwasani kodwa aphumelele kukho konke. “Kulo nyaka kudingeke ukuthi ayeke ukwenza ezinye izinto ukuze agxile ezifundweni nakwi-Rugby,” kusho yena. USange Matebese (17) ofunda uGrade 12 eDurban Girls High, uqokelwe ukuyodlala eqenjini leTouch Rugby Under 18. Isithombe: SIBUSISO NDLOVU USange osamile ekudlaleni imidlalo yeshashalazi, ungumholi wabafundi ekilasini aphinde abe ngukaputeni weTouch Rugby noweDrama esikoleni. Kuthiwa ukudlala yinto yakhe ngoba ngisho esakhula awukho umdlalo angakaze awenze. Uke wadlala iBasketball wabuye waba ngukaputeni weqembu lokubhukuda nelabagijimi esikoleni. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi uma eseqede * -matric ufuna ukuyokwenza iSport Sciences enyuvesi ukuze afunde kabanzi ngezemidlalo. Kudingeka ukuthi aqokelele uR42 000 ukuze uhambo lokuya eMalaysia lube yimpumelelo njengoba bezikhokhela izindleko. Unina uthe bafisa noma ubani ongabalekelela ukuhlanganisa le mali. Indebe yomhlaba izoba amasonto amabili ngo-Agasti lapho bezodlala namaqembu ahlukene okubalwa iNew Zealand ne-Australia.

Isithombe: Sithunyelwe ABAFUNDI baseZama High nezinye zezindebe zabo njengoba isikole sinezindebe ezingaphezu kuka-900. Isithombe: Sithunyelwe UMA uzwa ngempumelelo yesikole iZama High, yaseManzana, Osizweni, eNewcastle, ungacabanga ukuthi ngesinye salezo zikole zasemalokishini noma emadolobheni kanti ushaye phansi. IZama High eqala kwaGrade 8 iye kwaGrade 12, ngesinye sezikole eziphakamisela phezulu ifulegi lezikole zasemakhaya futhi ezibhukulile zavala igebe ebelikhona phakathi kwalezi nezikole nezasemadolobheni uma kuziwa ngasohlangothini lwemiphumela. Kubhekwe lukhulu nakwimiphumela yalo nyaka ka-matric yeZama High njengoba kusukela ngo-2010, lesi sikole sihlale sithola u-100%. Kusukela ngo-2010, lesi sikole sihlale sikhiqiza iziqengqe zabafundi abamenywa nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ngokwenza kahle kwabo uma kukhishwa imiphumela ka-matric. IZama High ibihlonishwa ngisho nawuMnuz Senzo Mchunu oke waba nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo esifundazweni ngamagalelo ayo kwezemfundo. Lesi sikole esingaphansi kwesiFunda iMajuba siyahloniswa ezweni lonke kanti amagalelo aso aziwa ngisho nawuNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyiSisekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga. Lesi sikole ngesinye sezikole ezamenywa nguNkk Motshekga ukuba zibambe iqhaza ohlelweni lomnyango, iThe Schools That Work, oluhlose ukuzama ukuqeda inkinga yokufeyila kwabafundi ezikoleni kuzwelonke. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, lesi sikole sike sahlonishwa ngomklomelo wokulala isibili kumaNational Matric Excellence Awards. Lesi sikole sachonywa uphaphe legwalagwala inkampani i-ATKV ngokuhlale senza kahle, ukuhlomula kwaso kuholele ekutheni le nkampani igcine isisiza nezinye izikole ezingomakhelwane baso. IZama idumile futhi ngokwenza kahle emculweni njengoba iqembu lomculo lesikole eliphekwa nguthishanhloko uMnuz Oscar Kubheka lihlale lizitamuzela izindondo kusukela ngo-2010. IQEMBU lomculo lesikole iZama High, sasOsizweni eNewcastle elidume ngokwenza kahle emculweni Njalo lesi sikole sihlale simele isifundazwe kumaNational Finals of South African Schools Choral Eisteddfod manje aziwa nge-ABC Motsepe Choral Eisteddfod. Ngo-2017, lesi sikole sawina kwiminxa emine kulo mqhudelwano womculo, umlawuli weqembu lomculo yena wanqoba indondo yeNational Best Conductor. Ngo-2018 seyibe yizingqwele kwiminxa emibili, yalala isibili kweminye iminxa emibili. Lesi sikole sesiqophe amacwecwe amathathu ngosizo lukaDkt Lucky Nkosi woKhozi FM. Iqembu lomculo lalesi sikole selike lamenywa ngisho nobengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma ukuthi lizomculela kweminye yemicimbi yakhe. Engxoxweni neSolezwe, uthishanhloko uKubheka uthe impumelelo yesikole sakhe incike ekubambisaneni okuhle phakathi kwabo bengothisha nabazali. “NoNkulunkulu wangibusisa ngezingane ezifunda lapha esikoleni, ingane uma ifika ingqondo yayo ivele ishintshe izimisele njengezinye izingane,” kusho uKubheka. Uthe abazali babambe iqhaza elikhulu empumelelweni yesikole ngoba bahlale benza isiqiniseko sokuthi yonke into ihamba kahle. UKubheka uphinde wabonga nomholi wesifunda sabo uMnuz Zembethe Nkosi ohlale emgqugquzela ukuthi enze kahle. “Umhloli wethu akathi ngoba izinto zihamba kahle bese eyayekelela kodwa uyaqhubeka angiphushe lokho kusiziza kakhulu isikole,” kusho uKubheka. UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga, uthishanhloko waseZama High uMnuz Oscar Kubheka nePhini likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uMnuz Enver Surty bekweminye yemicimbi yokuklomelisa iZama ngokwenza kahle ku-matric Uphinde wabonga nothishanhloko obekhona ngaphambi kwakhe uNkk Sbongile Mazibuko, wathi nguyena owakhe isisekelo esiqinile sesikole. USihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole uMnuz Nhlanhla Kubheka naye uhambe emazwini kathishanhloko wathi ukubambisana okwenza isikole siphumelele. “Enye into esiza isikole ukuthi siphumelele ukuziphatha nokuhlonipha imithetho yesikole,” kusho uKubheka. Uthe bahlale njalo befuna ukukhiqiza abafundi abazoba abantu abahlonishwayo emphakathini.

Ukhona obethathwe amaphoyisa obehlala kulo muzi ukuze aphoswe imibuzo kodwa wabuya wadedelwa ngoba singakutholi okumhlanganisa namacala. Umsolwa akakaboshwa kodwa silandela umkhondo wakhe. Sinxusa nomphakathi ukuba usilekelele ngolwazi ongaba nalo, uthinte noma yisiphi isiteshi samaphoyisa,” kusho uMasondo. Izidumbu zalaba zitholwe ngoMsombuluko zigqitshwe endlini ngemuva kokuthi abanye abahlala egcekeni lalo muzi bezwe kunephunga elingajwayeleike futhi bengawaboni amalungu alo mndeni.
INGXENYE yabesifazane abebesemashini yokukhuza izihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane eKapa Isithombe: Ayanda Ndamane/ African News Agency (ANA). Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng/African News Agency (ANA) INGXENYE yabesifazane abebesemashini yokukhuza izihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane eKapa Isithombe: Ayanda Ndamane/ African News Agency (ANA). Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng/African News Agency (ANA) IMBOKODO ebiyingxenye yemashi ebizwa nge#Totalshutdown izolo ithi ifuna kubuyekezwe izigwebo zabantu besifazane ababoshelwa ukubulala abantu ababethandana nabo ababebahlukumeza. Laba besifazane abebemasha eThekwini, begqoke imifaniswano ebomvu neminyama, bebemasha nezinhlangano ezihlukene zabantu besifazane okubalwa kuzo i-Agenda Feminist Media, iKZN Network on Violence Against Women, bebezwakalisa ilaka labo ngezigameko zokuhlukunyezwa nokubulawa kwabantu besifazane. Le mashi ibibanjelwe emadolobheni ehlukene kuleli. Imashi yaseThekwini iqale eCurries Fountain yaphela eCity Hall lapho abesifazne bethule khona incwadi yezikhalo zabo. Bekulindeleke ukuthi incwadi yezikhalo bayethule kwiMeya uNkk Zandile Gumede kodwa bagcina beyethule kuMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane ongungqongqoshe wezemfundo eKZN ngoba umphathi wohlelo ethe kumele yamukelwe umuntu wesilisa ngoba ibona abahlukumezayo. UNksz Beverly Mpho Motlabani, onguSihlalo wekomidi ebelihlela imashi yaseThekwini, ethula incwadi yezikhalo uthe bafuna kube noshintsho ezimpilweni zabantu besifazane. “Sifuna uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, wakhe izindlu eziphephile ukuze abantu besifazane nezingane bahlale ezindlini eziphephile. UMnyango wezeMfundo kumele unake izingane, ubone ukuthi azihlukemezekile, futhi azishayani ezikoleni.” Uveze nokuthi uphiko lwezokuphepha alubavikeli abantu besifazane emacaleni okudlwengula. “Kubalulekile ukuthi uma umuntu wesifazane eya esiteshini samaphoyisa ukuthi amaphoyisa amkholwe ummangali emacaleni okudlwengulwa, akufanele ukuthi abesilisa abadlwengulayo bathole ibheyili uma besolwa ngakho.” Uphethe ngokuthi kumele kube nezigwebo ezithe xaxa kubantu abadlwengulawayo, waphinde wathi kumele kubuyekezwe izigwebo zabantu besifazane ababoshelwe ukubulala abantu ababethandana nabo “ababebahlukumeza” ngoba uma babengababulalanga kwakuzofa bona (abesimame). Uthe laba besifazane kumele banikwe ithuba lokuthi bafake isicelo sikashwele ngoba babesuke bezivikela. Lo muntuza naye ubeyingxenye yabesifazane abebemasha eThekwini bezwakalisa ilaka labo ngesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa nokubulawa kwabesifazane nezingane izolo UNkk Lindiwe Thanjekwayo-Mzimela weSouth African Lawyers Association uthe, “Sekwanele ngokubulawa kwabantu besifazane, bafuna nokubona ubulungiswa.” Uthe abantu besifazane kumele bafundiswe ngamalungelo abo ukuze bakwazi ukuzivikela. Uqhube wathi kumele bagqugquzelwe ukuthi basebenze baphinde banikwe amathuba emisebenzi. “Abantu abaningi besifazane abakwazi ukushiya imishado enodlame ngoba sebehlalele ukuthi abasebenzi. Basuke besaba ukuthi uma beshiya abayeni babo ababahlukumezayo abazi ukuthi bazozondla ngani izingane zabo. Yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi abantu besifazane banikwe amakhono okuzithuthukisa ukuze bengeke bahlale emshadweni enodlame ngenxa yokuthi bahlalele imali.” Umbhali wezincwadi obuye abe ngumlingisi, uGcina Mhlophe, ekhuluma neSolezwe ugqugquzele ukuhlonishwa kwembokodo nabantu abadala kuleli. “Ukuze izwe liphephe kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahloniphane. Kumele abantu bazwelane nabantu abasebunzimeni.” Le mashi ibikhona eTshwane, eGoli, eKapa nakwezinye izindawo kanti abesifazane bebephume ngobuningi bethi, Sekwanele ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabo!
THALENTE NGCOBO THALENTE NGCOBO ISISHOSHOVU kwezokuvocavoca umzimba esesizakhele igama KwaZulu-Natal namaphethelo siphonsela inselelo bonke abanesifiso sokuncipha kodwa abalokhu behlehlisa ngenxa yobuvila. UThalente Ngcobo, waKwaMashu, ongumnikazi weVipaji Fitness Gym useqalile ngohlelo alubiza ngeNational Transformation Boot Camp athembisa ngalo ukuthi angenza umuntu afinyelele emzimbeni ahlale ephupha ngawo ngezinyanga ezintathu. Nakuba lokhu kuzwakala kulula kodwa uNgcobo uthe lokhu ngeke kwenzeke uma umuntu ezodembesela ngoba ekhaliswa yizinhlungu azozizwa ngesikhathi kusetshenzwa. UNgcobo ukufundele wagogoda ukubheka nokuvocavoca imizimba yabantu ngokwehlukana kwayo. Ngakhoke uthe umuntu noma ngabe uzimuke kangakanani angaxhumana naye ukuze amsize. Uhlelo lwakhe athi uma eluteketisa athi: “lahla amafutha usondelane nomzimba oqoqekile” luqalile lapha eKZN nasePitoli. “Isifiso sethu wukulishumayela leli vangeli lokugada imizimba yethu kuze kube wonke umuntu esifinyelela kuyena wenza izinqumo ezikhaliphile ngomzimba wakhe. Okubalulekile ngezifiso zemizimba wukuthi lowo nalowo azibophezele ekutheni uzokwenza okufanele futhi ngeke abuvumele ubuvila bumbuse. Indaba yokwakha umzimba isekhishini kakhulu hhayi lapho sijimela khona,” usho kanje uNgcobo ngaphambi kokuqala kwale Boot Camp ngoFebhuwari 1. Njengoba kusaqalwa uNgcobo nabaqeqeshi bakhe emagatsheni ehlukene akhele iTheku nelilodwa elisePitoli, basashumayela ivangeli lokugada umuntu akufaka emlonyeni. Uma ubhalisa uthola izikibha ezimbili bese uthathwa isithombe (okuzoqhathaniswa ngaso ekupheleni kwezinyanga ezintathu). Uzohlolwa ukuthi ukulungele yini ukuzivocavoca ukuze kugwenywe ukuthi ulimala sekuphakathi. Uzonikwa indlela ezokulawula ukuthi udla kanjani. Ngaphambi kokuqala ukuzivocavoca kuzoba nesidlo esiphelezelwa kakhulu yimikhiqizo yakwaHerbalife. Isikhathi sokuziqeqesha ihora ngosuku. Phakathi kwezindawo ongathola kuzo amagatsha okuziqeqesha singabala iKwaMashu, Newlands West, Bester, Inanda, City Centre (DSW), North Beach, Nhlungwane, KwaMakhutha naseNtuzuma. “Inyanga yesibili neyesithathu kulapho sizobe sesingena sigxila khona ekuziqeqesheni. Leli yithuba lawo wonke umuntu, isilisa noma isifazane, onenkinga yokuncipha nalabo abafuna ukugcina imizimba yabo isesimeni esibagculisayo,” kusonga uNgcobo.
