UNGQONGQOSHE wezoLimo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Themba Mthembu, noNgqongqoshe wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNkk Weziwe Thusi, bebuka ingadi kabhontshisi otshalwe ngowesifazane waKwaMachi. Ubhontshisi unothe ngezakhamzimba ezidingekayo UNGQONGQOSHE wezoLimo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Themba Mthembu, noNgqongqoshe wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNkk Weziwe Thusi, bebuka ingadi kabhontshisi otshalwe ngowesifazane waKwaMachi. Ubhontshisi unothe ngezakhamzimba ezidingekayo SIYAKHULA isibalo sabantu abaququdwa yindlala. Izibalo zango-2016 zeStatistics SA, ezicubungula ngemindeni, iGeneral Household Survey, zikhombisa ukuthi abantu abangu-7.4 million babulawa yindlala kanti manje kulinganiselwa ukuthi lesi sibalo sesicishe siphindaphindeke kabili. Yize izibalo zikhomba lokhu kuyavela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isemazweni ayishumi okuthiwa ayakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla okwanele kodwa lokho kudla akufinyeleli kubo bonke abantu ngoba abanye abanayo imali eyenele yokukuthenga. Lezi zibalo ziholela ekutheni uhulumeni asungule izinhlelo eziningi ezizosiza ekutheni abantu abangakwazi ukuzikhiqizela ukudla abazokudla bathole izinsiza ukuze bakukhiqizele imindeni. Uphiko olubhekele ukudla enhlanganweni yezizwe, i-UN Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO), luveze okushaqisayo ocwaningweni lwalo luka-2018. Kulolu cwaningo kuvela ukuthi ngesikhathi abanye abantu bebulawa yindlala, okwenza ukuthi imizimba yabo ingakwazi ukwenza okumele ikwenze, abanye bakhuluphele ngokweqile nakho okubeka impilo yabo engcupheni. IFAO ithe lesi simo sidinga ukusukunyelwa ngokushesha kuqhanyukwe namasu okusiza abantu ukuthi badle ukudla okunezakhamzimba ezidingekayo. Imindeni entulayo kuthiwa kuba nzima ukuthi ithole ukudla okunempilo igcine idla ukudla okungenamsoco ngoba yikhona ekwazi ukukuthenga. UNgqongqoshe wezoLimo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Themba Mthembu, uthe kubantu ababulawa yindlala kuleli abesifazane nezingane yibona abaningi. Uthe lokhu kuholele ekutheni izinhlelo zabo zibabhekelele kakhulu abesifazane ukuze kwehle isibalo. UMthembu ubesho lokhu ngesikhathi kugujwa usuku lokudla iWorld Food Day, KwaMachi, ngoLwesibili. Uthe ngokombiko we-UN bangu-43% abesifazane abasemkhakheni wezolimo emhlabeni kodwa uma sekubhekwa ngasohlangothini lobunini bomhlaba kuvela ukuthi balima emhlabeni ongewona owabo. “Abesifazane kulo mkhakha yibona abahlakula amasimu, batshale imbewu baphinde bavune kodwa umsebenzi wabo awuqhakambiswa. Yingakho lolu suku sibuye silusebenzisele ukuqhakambisa nokubonga abesifazane ngegalelo labo. Siqwashisa ngesimo sendlala esikhona, sisize umphakathi ngezinsiza, siphinde sinxuse amazwe omhlaba ukuthi nawo aphonse esivivaneni ukuze kusizwe abangenako ukudla okwanele,” kusho uMthembu.
USINDE kukubi uthisha wesikole samabanga aphansi eNquthu ngesikhathi ehlaselwa abazali bengane ayifundisayo abamfice efundisa bamshaya ngenduku waba mabokoboko. Lesi sigameko senzeke esikoleni iLuvisi Primary, okwahlaselwa kuso kwabulawa umfundi nephini likathishomkhulu, uMnuz Vusi Ntombela ngo-2015, owayebuye abe nguSomlomo kuMasipala iNquthu owadutshulwa ngentululwane yezinhlamvu kwathinteka nabafundi omunye washona. Kulokhu kuthiwa kutheleke abazali bafica uNkk Mbali Moloi efundisa kwaGrade 3, bamshaya wanaba ngoba bemsola ngokuhlukumeza ingane yabo. “Bekungumama noyise womfundi kaGrade 3 abafike babuza ukuthi uphi umemu Moloi. Kuthe uma besuka baqonda kuyena bamngenela ngenduku. Izingane zikhale ubumayemaye sezithukile. Nathi sithukile ngoba phela besingazi noma bayamdubula yini njengoba kulesi sikole nothisha uNtombela wahlaselwa kanje wadutshulwa phambi kwezingane ayezifundisa. Indlela abamshaye ngayo ubengaboni ngisho emehlweni,” kusho omunye wabasebenzi. Uthe iphutha likaNkk Moloi wukuthi ngoLwesithathu ukhuze ingane efunda uGrade 3 ngoba ibihlupha omunye umfundi. Lo mthombo uthe okubi wukuthi uNkk Moloi uthe uma evula icala amaphoyisa aseNquthu amnqabela athi abantu okumele bavule icala abazali bengane ngakho yena uma elivula azombopha. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe kuzomele uNkk Moloi axhumane nomphathisiteshi waseNquthu ngalolu daba. “Singameluleka ngokuthi abuyele esiteshini acele umphathi wesiteshi ukuze amsize kusukunyelwe udaba lwakhe,” kusho uGwala. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, ushaqekile ngalesi sigameko. “Noma ngabe uthisha ubesephutheni kodwa akekho onelungelo lokumshaya. Laba bazali bekumele baye emaphoyiseni bavule icala ukuze aphenye ukuthi ngabe izinsolo ezibekwa umemu Moloi ziyiqiniso yini. Amaphoyisa aqeqeshiwe ngakho yiwona obekumele abikelwe. Bebezothini ukube bebembulala bese ekugcineni bethola ukuthi umsulwa? Siyasigxeka lesi senzo futhi laba bazali bangaba senkingeni uma uthisha ebavulela icala efaka nabameli bakhe,” kusho uMahlambi.

UMkhathini uthe uNkk van Biljon naye unamava kwezamabhizinisi njengoba ebesebenza kwaDenel ephethe izimali. “Uyena oweza nohlelo lokushintsha izinto kwaDenel. Uthe ukuqokwa kwezikhulu kuzoletha amakhono amasha, kuqinisikise nokuthi ubulili nazo zonke izinhlanga zimelelekile.

USergeant Bhekukwazi Mdweshu (37), Mnuz Vukani Mcobothi (25), Mnuz Khayelihle Mbuthuma (32), Mnuz Wonderboy Mhlope (37), Mnuz Matlala Mdweshu Ntshangase (35), Mnuz Mahliphiza Mkhize (28) noMnuz Mondli Mthethwa (32) bavele enkantolo kaMantshi yaseThekwini izolo. AMABHIZINISI amancane ayaqhubeka nokuba wumgogodla womnotho yize amaningi ewa kungakapheli iminyaka emithathu esunguliwe. Isikhulu esiphezulu senkampani exhasa osomabhizinisi abancane iFinfind, uNkk Darlene Menzies, sithe kubalulekile ukuthi kusungulwe amabhizinisi ngoba kuzodilizwa abantu eminyakeni emithathu ezayo futhi nasezinkampanini ezizimele wu-22% kuphela wezikhulu eziphezulu othi izinkampani zizokhula kulezi zinyanga eziwu-12 ezizayo. UNkk Menzies uthe osomabhizinisi abaningi abanawo amakhono okubheka izinkampani ezixhasana ngemali futhi abakwazi nokuchaza izinhlelo zabo zebhizinisi uma sebenikwe ithuba. “Izicelo eziningi zoxhaso ziyachithwa ngenxa yokuthi osomabhizinisi abanalo ikhono lokuphatha imali futhi abakwazi ukuchaza kahle ukuthi imali bazoyenzani,” kusho uNkk Menzies. Uthe osomabhizinisi kufanele bahlome ngamakhono azoheha abatshalizimali okubalwa kuwo; - Ikhono lokuphatha imali, elokwazi kabanzi ukuchaza ngebhizinisi, elokuchaza ukuthi imali uyidingelani nomlando wokuthi ibhizinisi lizothuthuka kanjani uma lithola uxhaso. UNkk Menzies uthe abatshalimali bafuna ukwazi ukuthi bazofaka imali yabo ebhizinisini elizophumelela ngoba kubalulekile ukuthi ibuye imali abayitshalile. “Kubalulekile ukuthi usomabhizinisi omncane uma efuna uxhaso acacise ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe lizokhula kanjani nokuthi uma ebolekwa imali ibhizinisi lakhe lizokwazi ukwenza inzuzo ukuze akhokhele isikweletu. Kufanele abe nemininingwane yakhe yemali, izitatimende zasebhange nezeVAT. Ngebhadi osomabhizinisi abaningi abakwazi ukuza nale mininingwane uma beyocela uxhaso ngoba abakwazi ukuziphathela amabhuku nemali. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni bangalutholi uxhaso,” kusho uNkk Menzies. Ube esenika osomabhizinisi abafuna uxhaso lawa masu ambalwa athe azobasiza uma beyofuna uxhaso -Yiba nohlelo lwebhizinisi olucacisayo ukuthi imali liyingenisa kanjani. - Zazi isimo sakho sezikweletu ukuze uma kukhona obakweletayo usheshe ubakhokhele ngaphambi kokuyocela uxhaso lwemali. - Khokhela izikweletu zakho nyanga zonke ngoba abaxhasa ngemali bayabheka ukuthi unegama elinjani kwezezikweletu. - Bhala yonke imininingwane yebhizinisi, imali engenayo nephumayo ngoba lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi uzokwazi ukuphatha imali. Yazi isimo sakho sezimali ukuze ufake isicelo soxhaso lwemali kusasele izinyanga ngaphambi kokuthi uludinge, ungaceli uxhaso ngoba ungasenalutho kwi-akhawunti yakho yebhizinisi. - Zichaze zicace izizathu ezenza udinge uxhaso lwemali, ukhombise nokuthi inkampani yakho ibihweba kahle ngaphambi kokuthi ubone isidingo sokucela uxhaso lwemali. - Cela usizo kungoti ozokusiza ukukwenzela amabhuku, akululeke ngolwazi lwemali nolwentela. UNkk Menzies uthe zingaphezu kuka-200 izinkampani ezixhasana ngemali ezinemikhiqizo engaphezu kuka-500 eyenzelwe osomabhizinisi abancane. Ukuthola abaxhasi, osomabhizinisi abancane bangavakashela ku-www.finfind.co.za
ARTHUR ZWANE ARTHUR ZWANE LIGWEME ihlazo lokulandwa yiveni lakhetha ukuzinikela emaphoyiseni ilungu eliqavile le-ANC, elibhekene necala lokukhomba uzakwabo ngesibhamu ngesikhathi betholana phezulu emhlanganweni. UMnuz Arthur Zwane, uzinikele emaphoyiseni kuleli sonto mayelana nezinsolo zokukhomba uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka ngesibhamu ngesikhathi bexabana. UHlomuka uyiPhini likaNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni, uphethe nesokuba nguNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba Zomdabu. Kuthiwa uZwane wangena nezicabha emhlanganweni ongena njalo ngoMsombululo, wacela uHlomuka esitikini batholana phezulu phambi kwabaholi baze balanyulwa. Kwaze kwaphoqa ukuthi ancengwe uZwane abeke phansi isibhamu ngoba wayengezwa lutho, esho ukumqeda uHlomuka. UZwane uke waba sesigungwini esiphezulu se-ANC KwaZulu-Natal waphatha nesikhundla sikaSihlalo we-ANC eMalahleni. Kuthiwa uzinikele emaphoyiseni eDurban Central, ehamba nommeli wakhe wavela eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini wadedelwa ngebheyili kaR10 000. Kulindeleke ukuthi abuyele eNkantolo ngoFebhuwari 18 wonyaka ozayo. Imithombo ithi uZwane ubonile ukuthi uzohlazeka uma elinda amaphoyisa ukuthi azomgaxa ozankosi, wavela waziyela yena. Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ricardo Mthembu uthe ngeke aphawule ngokuzinikela kukaZwane emaphoyiseni ngoba akanayo into ephathekayo kodwa usazothola kahle uma sekunomhlangano. “Umhlangano wethu ojwayelekile uzoba ngoMsombuluko, sizozwa kahle umbiko ophelele ngalolo daba ngoba angazi kahle ngike ngezwa ngenye intatheli ingibuza,’’ kuchaza uMthembu. Uke wacashunwa phambilini ethi indaba kaZwane noHlomuka isetshenzwa wubuholi obuphezulu obuzama ukuthi ixoxwe, kuthelelwane amanzi. Kuthiwa kuke kwaba nomhlangano kwelinye lamahhotela kuxoxwa ngayo le ndaba.
OWAYENGUKHOMISHANA wakwaSars uMnuz Tom Moyane OWAYENGUKHOMISHANA wakwaSars uMnuz Tom Moyane OWAYENGUKHOMISHANA wakwaSars, uMnuz Tom Moyane, uzothola ithuba lokuphonsa ngemibuzo uNgqongqoshe wezamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan, kwiKhomishini ephenya ngokuLawulwa koMbuso yiDlanzana, ngodaba lokwethweswa amacala ngo-2016 ngokusungula uphiko labaphenyi olungekho emthethweni kwaSARS. Sibe yimpumelelo isicelo sikaMoyane sokuphonsa imibuzo uGordhan, njengoba kumemezele izolo uSihlalo wale Khomishini, iJaji uRaymond Zondo. Ummeli kaMoyane, uMnuz Eric Mabuza, uthe umuntu ammele uyajabula ukuthi uzoke athole ubulungiswa. “Ingalo yomthetho ihambe ihambe ithole noma ubani. Sikubheke ngabomvu ukuba uGordhan akwazi ukubhekana nemibuzo. Sizoyalela ummeli omkhulu ukuba aqale alungiselele ukumphonsa ngemibuzo. Ngiyathemba ikhomishini izosheshe ilungise usuku lapho sizokwazi khona ukumphonsa imibuzo. Sekuphele unyaka manje uGordhan afakaza. Ukuhlehliswa kokuba uthole ubulungiswa kufana nokuthi uyancishwa ithuba lokuba uthole ubulungiswa,” kusho uMabuza kwisitatimende. Uqhube wathi: “Ngokwethu ukuvula icala kukaMoyane, kwakungenziwa yinoma imuphi umuntu ongukhomishana yakwaSars, uma ebhekene nezinsolo zokusungula uphiko lwabaphenyi abangekho emthethweni.” UGordhan wethula ubufakazi kwikhomishini ngonyaka odlule nokuyilapho asola khona uMoyane ngokuthi isenzo sakhe sokuba amvulele icala lobugebengu ngokusungula uphiko lwabaphenyi abangekho emthethweni kwaSars, kwakumayelana nokuba avumele ukuba kube khona abathize abavumela ukulawulwa kombuso yindlazana. Ikhomishini iyaqhubeka nokulalela ubufakazi.
UNGQONGQOSHE woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana kuzwelonke, uDkt Zweli Mkhize, umnyango wakhe osolwa ngokusonga izandla odabeni lwaseMabovini eMsinga. MHLELI: Kunento edumazayo ngoMnyango wezobuholi boMdabu KwaZulu-Natal. Ngabe abanye ondabezitha KwaZulu-Natal bayayibona yini indlela amakhosi aphethwe ngayo? Lo mnyango uxova izindlu zasendlunkulu ngenhloso yokuqhatha ukuze kufezeke izinhloso zawo. Thina eMabovini eMsinga sinenkinga yokuphoqwa yilo mnyango ukuba siphathwe ngenkani yinkosi engafunwa yisizwe nengafanele ukubusa. Singabantwana baseMabovini sathatha incwadi eyabhalwa yisizwe yokungayethembi inkosi saze sacela owabe engumengameli ngo-2014 ukuba asitholele uNgqongqoshe uNomusa Dube-Ncube nebala sahlangana naye eThekwini. Wabe esethumela ithimba labameli kwathi ngomhla ka 23 ngoDisemba 2014 kwafika ithimba lakwaCogta laba nomhlangano nathi laphinde laba nomunye eceleni neqeqebana lenkosi basitshela izinto ezehlukene. Kwasikhalisa kakhulu lokho. Kwaba nomunye umhlangano wakwaCogta ngomhla ka-28 Agasti 2015 basitshela ukuthi asivele sikhohlwe ngoba osesikhundleni ngeke asuswe kusona ngoba esakhe sizichithela isikhathi. Kwaze kwakhuza omunye wabo wathi akaxolise owayesho lokho kwasibonisa ngokusobala ukuthi umnyango uchemile. Ngo-2004 mhla ka-29 kuJanuwari owayengumengameli uMnuz Thabo Mbeki wayevakashele eMsinga eTugela Ferry ngambhalela incwadi ngimazisa ngobuqili bukaCogta. Wangeluleka ngeKhomishana kaNhlapho ngo-2005 ngagcwalisa ifomu ngalithumela kuyona maqede kwathula kwathi nya. Kuze kwathi ngo-2015 ngezwa sengithintwa wumasipala waseMsinga, ngithintwa abasesiteshini samaphoyisa ngoba babengenalo ucingo lwami saxhumana nabo base bethi asihlangane esikoleni iSomashi High. Udaba lwahlalelwa phansi izinhlaka zonke zikhona. Sesilinde iminyaka emithathu njengoba u-2018 sekungowesine nawo usuzophela. Umbuzo uthi ngabe kuyasetshenzwa noma kuyadlalwa? Besicela iSilo samaBandla sibambisane noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa bangenelele kulolu daba lwaMabovu ngoba noNdunankulu sesimbhalele sahluleka akasiphenduli. Senzani J Ngubane (Umntwana)
Owayengumengameli kuleli uMnuz Jacob Zuma oqale ukufakaza kwikhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana ngoMsombuluko. Isithombe: Pool Photo via AP Owayengumengameli kuleli uMnuz Jacob Zuma oqale ukufakaza kwikhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana ngoMsombuluko. Isithombe: Pool Photo via AP OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wakuleli uMnuz Jacob Zuma uthi ugqigqa izinkantolo nje futhi usevela kwikhomishini kaZondo yingenxa yetulo elidala lokuthi asuswe ebuholini kuhulumeni. UZuma udalule lokhu ngoMsombuluko ngesikhathi eqala ukufakaza kwikhomishi ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. Ngesikhathi eqala ukufakaza uZuma, ummeli wakhe u-Adv Muzi Sikhakhane uqale wacacisa ngokubhalela kwakhe ikhomishini eyicela ukuthi imthumelele imibuzo ngaphambi kokuthi avele. USikhakhane uveze ukuthi akukho kuhle ukuthi kule khomishini kunabantu asebebukwa njengamaqhawe abanye babukwa njengabasolwa ekubeni yasungulelwa ukuthi ithole iqiniso ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. Eseqala ukufakaza uZuma uqale ngokundlalela umlando ngokuhlaselwa kwakhe athi kwaqala ngonyaka ka-1990 lapho athola khona umbiko wokuthi kunabahlela ukuthi lidicilelwe phansi igama lakhe ngaphambi kwengqungquthela ye-ANC. Uthe ngemuva kokwenza uphenyo lwakhe wathola ukuthi ababefuna ukumhlasela babehlongoza ukwenza lokhu ngoba ‘wayazi lukhulu’ uZuma ngohulumeni wobandlululo. Uthe lokhu kwakuhlelwa izinhlangano ezizimele, eyodwa yakuleli nenye yaphesheya. UZuma uthe lezi zinhlangano zabona ukuthi uyathandwa kwi-ANC, yabe sezihlela ukubhekana naye ngenye indlela. Uthi ngemuva kwenkomfa ye-ANC wasuswa njengenhloko yezobunhloli. Uthi ngenxa yendlela izinto ezenzeka ngayo esuswa kwenza babona ukuthi kunezimpimpi kwi-ANC. UZuma uthe nalabo abahlongoza ukuthi kube khona le khomishini basaqhubeka nemizamo yokulwa nesithunzi sakhe. UZuma uthe ngo-2005 wasuswa njengephini likaMengameli we-ANC ngoba wayesolwa ecaleni lokuthengwa kwezikhali (arms deal). Uthe bonke abanye amagama abo ayevela abakaze baphenywe futhi abakaze basuswe ezikhundleni zabo kwi-ANC. Ngaleso sikhathi uZuma wayephenywa ama-Scorpions. UZuma uthi ngesikhathi eqala ukwaziswa ngalolu daba watshelwa ukuthi alikho icala abekwa lona, uSchabir Schaik nje owafaka igama lakhe kwisitatimende sakhe kodwa kuphelela lapho. Ngemuva kwesonto uZuma uthi waziswa ukuthi empeleni akhona amacala azobekwa wona kodwa anganyamalala uma angase ahoxe esikhundleni sokuba yiPhini likaMengameli. UZuma uthi wathenjiswa uR20 million, kwathiwa akahambe eyohlala eNkandla uzonakekelwa futhi anyamalale namacala ayesolwa ngawo. Uthi kwamuxaka lokhu ngoba wayekade aziswe ukuthi alikho icala azobekwa lona ngokuthengwa kwezikhali. Ngo-2005 uZuma wasuswa njengePhini likaMengali Thabo Mbheki. Uthe uZuma wakwamukela lokhu. Ngemuva kwenkomfa yango-2007, uZuma wabekwa njengomholi omusha we-ANC athi kwenzeka ngaphezu kwetulo lokuthi aboshwe. UZuma uthe ngemuva kwalokho kwabekwa uSchabir Shaik icala eyedwa ukuze uma etholwa enecala, kubekwe yena icala kwazise babesolwa bobabili ngenkohlakalo odabeni lokuthengwa kwezikhali. Ngemuva kwesinqumo sejaji esathola uSchabir Shaik enecala, kwaba nemibiko yokuthi iJaji lathi kunomkhonyovu ohlanganisa uShaik noZuma. UZuma uthe indlela lokhu okwakushiwo ngayo osopolitiki nabamaphephandaba, kwaze kwenza iJaji laphumela obala lasho ukuthi alikaze likusho lokho. UZuma uthi konke lokhu kubeka ngokusobala ukuthi kunezihlangano ezicashile ezilwa nesithunzi sakhe emphakathini futhi ezimufuna engekho ebuholini kuhulumeni ngoba zisabela ukuthi angase aphumele obala ngezimfihlo azaziyo. “Nizokhumbula ukuthi ngesikhathi ngakha umuzi wami eNkandla, kwaba nomsindo ngenkohlakalo. Nizokhumbula ukuthi ngesikhathi kubikwa abezindaba babesho isamba semali eyasetshenziswa kwakhiwa umuzi wami. Kwaphenya iminyango emibili kahulumeni emzini wami, yangathola lutho. Kweza ngisho owayenguMvikeli Womphakathi, wangathola lutho,” kusho uZuma. UZuma uphinde walwa nokubizwa kwale khomishini ngekhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. Uthe leli temu liyihaba ngoba akuzona zonke izinhlaka zombuso ezibhekene nenkohlakalo.
ISILO samabandla, uGoodwill Zwelithini. Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng ISILO samabandla, uGoodwill Zwelithini. Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng AMANYE amakhosi awafuni nakuyizwa indaba yeNgonyama Trust njengoba ethi afuna ukuziphathela wona umhlaba wawo, azilawulele nemali eyenziwa ngawo. Inkosi Mzabane Makhoba yaseKokstad eNingizimu yeKwaZulu-Natal ithe yize yabekwa yiSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu futhi iyawuncoma umsebenzi owenziwa Ingonyama Trust evikela umhlaba wamakhosi ukuthi uthathwe wuhulumeni kodwa amakhosi kufanele aziphathele umhlaba wawo. “INgonyama Trust kufanele inike amakhosi ilungelo lokuthi aziphathele imali ekhokhwa abatshalizimali abasuke besebenzisa umhlaba. Njengamanje yonke imali eyenziwa emhlabeni wamakhosi iya kwiNgonyama Trust. Amakhosi nezizwe zawo awahlomuli ngalutho,” kusho uMakhoba. Uthe amakhosi kufanele aziphathele wona umhlaba wawo nemali eyenziwa kuwona ukuze kuzohlomula izizwe zawo. KwaZulu-Natal angu-303 amakhosi ahambisana nokuthi umhlaba wawo uphathwe iNgonyama Trust futhi awafuni ukuthi uhulumeni asondele kulo mhlaba. INgonyama Trust iphethwe yiSilo, inomhlaba ongu-2.8 million hectares okungumhlaba wasemakhaya omningi kanti ngonyaka iqoqa uR90 million kosomabhizinisi abasebenzisa lo mhlaba. Inkosi Bhungane Hadebe ithe isizwe sayo esise-Estcourt asiyazi iNgonyama Trust ngoba asikaze sithintwe ngesikhathi isungulwa. “Sihambisana neSilo ekutheni umhlaba ngowamakhosi akusiwo okahulumeni kodwa asihambisana neNgonyama Trust ngoba yasungulwa ngaphandle kokwazisa amakhosi,” kusho uHadebe. Umkhankaso wokuvikela iNgonyama Trust uqalwe emuva kokuthi owayenguMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Kgalema Motlanthe ededele umbiko owawuphakamisa ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele ahlakaze Ingonyama Trust ngoba ayihambisani nomthetho sisekelo. Umholi we-IFP, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi ngokubambisana nohulumeni kaMengameli owayephethe ngaleso sikhathi uMnuz FW de Klerk, yasungula Ingonyama Trust ngo-1994. Ngesonto eledlule uButhelezi uthe wasungula iNgonyama Trust ukuvikela umhlaba wabantu basemakhaya. Enye inkosi ecele ukungadalulwa ithe iSilo asinawo umhlaba ngoba ngowokhokho bamakhosi abawudlulisela kwizizukulwane zabo.Asihambisani nokuthi umhlaba wethu uphathwe Ingonyama sifuna ukuziphathela wona njengoba sasiwuphethe kudala,” kusho le nkosi. Enye inkosi ikhale ngokuthi kudala ibizithathela izinqumo ngomhlaba wayo kodwa manje sekufanele ibhalele Ingonyama ngaphambi kokusebenzisa umhlaba wayo. Inkosi Nhlakanipho Maphumulo enguNobhala weCongress of Traditional Leaders of South Africa (Contralesa) ithe wonke amakhosi anelungelo lokuphatha umhlaba wawo kodwa abatshalizimali okufanele basayine isivumelwano sokusebenzisa umhlaba neNgonyama Trust. “Osomabhizinisi bakhokha irenti yokusebenzisa umhlaba kwiNgonyama Trust. Kunama-akhawunti aveza ukuthi umhlaba wenkosi ethile wenza malini ,” kusho uMaphumulo. UMntwana uThulani Zulu okhulumela Isilo walile ukuphawula. UJaji Jerome Ngwenya onguSihlalo weNgonyama Trust Board akawaphendulanga ama-sms nama-emails athunyelelwe wona ngesonto eledlule. Iphephandaba iMail&Guradian libike ukuthi iNgonyama Trust iyiswe enkantolo ngabantu abafuna iyeke ukukhokhisa amasonto, osomabhizinisi nabanye abantu abasebenzisa umhlaba wamakhosi. KwaZulu-Natal ibandla lamaLuthela libalwa nezinhlangano ezihambise Ingonyama Trust enkantolo ngoba likhala ngokuthi abantu bazolahlekelwa wumhlaba uma behluleka wukukhokhela umhlaba. Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula koMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana nezoMdabu ayiphumelelanga.
UMvikeli woMphakathi u-Adv Busisiwe Mkhwebane. Isithombe: Reuters UMvikeli woMphakathi u-Adv Busisiwe Mkhwebane. Isithombe: Reuters ABAHLAZIYI bezombusazwe babona lisengcupheni yokuphelelwa yisithunzi nokuthenjwa ihhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi, u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane, (osesithombeni) emuva kokuchithwa kwakhe yinkantolo ekutheni kumele kusheshiswe izinyathelo azithathela uNgqongqoshe wezamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan ngodaba oluthinta ukusungulwa kophiko lwabaphenyi abangekho emthethweni kwa-SARS. Izolo inkantolo enkulu eNorth Gauteng inqume ukuthi kumele kumiswe konke okuthinta ukuthathelwa izinyathelo kukaGordhan kuze kuphume isinqumo senkantolo. U-Advocate Mkhwebane wayalela noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuthi athathele uGordhan izinyathelo zokumqondisa ubugwegwe. Wayalela nePhalamende ukuthi lithathele izinyathelo uGordhan. Umhlaziyi uMnuz Thabani Khumalo uthe umphakathi ngeke usakwazi ukuthemba ihhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi uma belokhu benza imibiko ekhahlelwa yizinkantolo. “Lisengozini yokuphelelwa yisithunzi ihhovisi lakhe kanti libaluleke kakhulu futhi lenza umsebenzi obucayi. Ukwenzeka kwamaphutha kuzokwenza abantu bengalithembi, uhulumeni ungalithembi nezinkantolo imbala ngeke zisalinaka,” kusho uKhumalo. UMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala, ongummeli nongoti ogxile kwezokusebenza komthethosisekelo, uthe: “Okwakhe wukuthi ethule akutholile bese ekucacisa ukuthi nabanye basengenza olwabo uphenyo hhayi ukuthi abathathelwe izinyathelo.” USolwazi Karthy Govender, ungoti wezomthethosisekelo oke wasebenza enyuvesi yakwaZulu-Nata nakwiHuman Rights Commission, uthe: “Okubalulekile wukuthi akumele abantu basatshiswe ngokuphakamisa ukuthi kumele kwenziwe njani ngoba lokho kungadala ezinye izinkinga.” I-IFP ithe ikhathazekile ngokusebenza kwehhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi njengoba echithwe yinkantolo. IPhalamende lithe ngeke limthathele zinyathelo uGordhan. I-EFF ithe izosidlulisa lesi sinqumo senkantolo. Ngeledule inkantolo yomthethosisekelo ichithe u-Advocate Mkhwebane owayekade edlulise isinqumo mayelana nodaba lwemali eyabolekwa yibhange i-Absa kwibhange lombuso yanquma ukuthi akhokhe yena ezinye zezindleko zabameli. Khonamanjalo, ngoLwesibili inkantolo enkulu eNorth Gauteng ikuhlehlisile ukulalelwa kwesicelo sikaRamaphosa sokuphikisa umbiko kaMkhwebane othinta izigidi zamarandi azithola ngesikhathi ekhankasela ukuba ngumengameli we-ANC.

LUGCINE lugobile uphondo eziphathimandleni zikaMasipala waKwaNongoma, KwaZulu-Natal, mayelana nokuhoxisa esikhundleni ikhansela obekuthiwa lihola imali yabakhokhibentela libe lidonsa iminyaka eyisithupha ejele ngecala lokweba imfuyo esifundazweni iMpumalanga. IMeya yaKwaNongoma, uMnuz Albert Mncwango, ithe sebegcine bemsulile emabhukwini amakhansela omkhandlu wabo uZamani Sibiya ngoba icala ligcine limlahlile ngemuva kokulidlulisela phambili. Uthe lokhu kusho ukuthi sekuzoba nokhetho lokuchibiyela ewadini ebiphethwe uSibiya. “Sitholile njengomkhandlu ukuthi inkantolo isichithihile isicelo sikaSibiya sokuba kubuyekezwe isinqumo saphambilini sokutholwa enecala lokweba imfuyo eVolkrust. Ngenxa yalokho sinqume ukuba simsule ohlwini lwamakhansela ethu. Ngaphandle kwalokho besingeke sikwazi ukufinyelela kulesi sinqumo singakezwa isiphetho semizamo yakhe, okuyilungelo lomthethosisekelo elimgunyazayo ukuba icala alidlulise kuze kube kuphuma isinqumo esingujuqu. Ukube besenzenjalo besizoba senkingeni uma icala elinqoba ngoba bekofanele sibuyisele emuva zonke izinqumo ebesizobe zithathwe ngaphandle kwakhe nebezizobe zithinta yena,” kusho uMncwango. USibiya ubeyikhansela le-IFP ku-ward 20 kanti ubephinde ahlale emkhandlwini kaMasipala waseZululand. Ugwetshwe iminyaka emithathu ngoMeyi 25 yiNkantolo yaseVolkrust kodwa icala walidlulisa. Inkantolo ibe isimengezela ngeminye iminyaka emithathu yabe isiba yisithupha isiyonke. UMncwango ukuphikile ukuthi uSibiya ubeqhubeka nokuhola yize edonsa ejele. Uthe wagcina ukuhola ngoMeyi 25 ngoba wayesebenzile. USihlalo weKhomishini yezoKhetho KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mawethu Mosery, uthe bebengakaziswa ngodaba lukaSibiya ngakho abanazo izinhlelo zokhetho lokuchibiyela ezithinta uNongoma. UMncwango uthe basalungisa imigudu ethile yangaphakathi ukuze bazise ikhomishini ezimele ebhekele ukhetho KwaZulu-Natal ukuze ikwazi ukuhlela usuku lokhetho lokuchibiyela.
AYIKABONI kahle iqembu elifanelwe ivoti layo kulama qembu akhona intsha ezovota okokuqala nonyaka. Lapha uNkk Vuyokazi Nxulu ukhombisa ngamabhayi amaqembu ahlukene aseqalile ukukhankasela ukhetho oluzayo AYIKABONI kahle iqembu elifanelwe ivoti layo kulama qembu akhona intsha ezovota okokuqala nonyaka. Lapha uNkk Vuyokazi Nxulu ukhombisa ngamabhayi amaqembu ahlukene aseqalile ukukhankasela ukhetho oluzayo IMANQIKANQIKA ukuvota intsha ezobe ivota okokuqala okhethweni lukazwelonke kulo nyaka ngenxa yokunganeliseki ngokufakwa kakhulu kwasebekhulile ezinhlakeni zobuholi. Intsha okukhulunywe nayo ithe ifuna ukubona ushintsho ebuholini bezepolitiki, kufakwe abaholi abazoqonda izidingo zayo. Njengoba ngempelasonto ezayo kulindeleke kubhaliselwe ukuvota okokugcina ngaphambi kokhetho oluzoba ngoMeyi, enye intsha ayikaqinisekisi ukuthi izobhalisa. UMsawenkosi Dlamini (23), ofunda e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, uthe yayisimvumela iminyaka yokuthi avote okhethweni loHulumeni baseKhaya ngo-2016 kodwa wangavota. “Ngathola sekuzovotwa ukuthi kwakufanele ngibhalisele ukuvota eThekwini lapho sengihlala khona uma ngifunda. Nokho angizisolanga ngokungavoti ngoba akukho obekungigqugquzela. Namanje akukho okungenza ngilangazelele ukuvota ngoba akekho nosigqugquzelayo emanyuvesi,” echaza. Uthe uzoya kobhalisela ukuvota ngesonto elizayo kodwa usazibuza ukuthi yiliphi iqembu elifanelwe yivoti lakhe. Ukhala ngokuthi amaqembu akhona awagculisi futhi alikho iqiniso. “Ngibona sengathi uma ngivota ngizobe ngifaka imali ephaketheni lomuntu. Sishoda ngabaholi abakhathalele abantu ngokweqiniso. Abanye bayathembisa kodwa bangazifezi izidingo zomphakathi. Neqembu elibonakala linentsha eningi lihlushwa wukuthi abaholi balo abavuthiwe ngokomqondo,” kusho uDlamini. Ukhale nangokuthi akayiboni intsha ebuholini bamaqembu ngisho ePhalamende kugcwele kakhulu abadala okwenza intsha ibone singekho isidingo sokubavotela. UZanele Khambule (19) waKwaMashu uthe wakubhalisela ngonyaka odlule ukuvota futhi uzimisele ukuvota. “Ngibona kungifanele ukuvota ngoba ivoti lami lizoletha ushintsho. Ikusasa lezwe lincike evotini lami,” kusho uZanele. Yize ethe ngeke adalule ukuthi uzovotela liphi iqembu, uthe alikhethile ulibona likhathalele imfundo yabamnyama. UZama Khumalo (19), oyokwenza unyaka wokuqala eDurban University of Technology, uthe akanawo umfutho wokuvota futhi akakabhalisi. Uthe ubengazi nokuthi kuyabhaliswa ngesonto elizayo. Uveze ukuthi abazali bakhe abamkhuthaza ukuthi avote ngoba bamtshela ngesimo abaphuma kuso ngezikhathi zobandlululo. “Kunzima kithina esingazazi lezo zikhathi ngoba esikubona manje yinkohlakalo kuphela. Baningi abantu esibabona besahlupheka nezingane zifunda kanzima kodwa sitshelwa ukuthi sikhululekile. Ngicabanga ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki kusamele aqinise ekushintsheni imiqondo yethu ukuthi yiluphi ushintsho esizolubona uma sivota. Kungasiza nokubona intsha inikwa amathuba ebuholini.” Umbiko wocwaningo lwe-Institute for Security Studies, waveza ukuthi intsha isemanqika ukuvota. Ngo-2014 yayingu-33% intsha eneminyaka ewu-18 no-19 eyavota okhethweni lukazwelonke. Egqugquzela iqembu lakhe ukuthi livote eThekwini, uMntwana wakwaPhindangene, uMangosuthu Buthelezi, ukuphawulile lokhu kungabi nkamunkamu kwentsha ekuvoteni. I-IEC imemezele ukuthi ngoMgqibelo nangeSonto elizayo kuzobhaliselwa ukuvota kuzo zonke izikhungo.
UMSAKAZI u-Alex Mthiyane wohlelo iNdaba kwiGagasi FM UMSAKAZI u-Alex Mthiyane wohlelo iNdaba kwiGagasi FM Sike sathi sizihlalele sixoxa ngobunzima obake basivelela nezinye izinsizwa kwaqhuma izindaba ezihlekisayo abanye baze babalula nokuthi kunjani ukungaholelwa ngumqashi wakho kuze kwedlule usuku lomholo, kwaba khona nophawule indaba yokwephucwa emlonyeni lowo othandana naye. Kuzona zonke lezi zivuvaba ezihlukumeza abanikazi bazo, kube nesisodwa nje namanje engingakasithathi isinqumo sokuthi ukuba kwakuyimi owayebhekene nale mbedumehlwana nganginquma ukuthini. Woza nendlebe-ke (noma iso lakho) ngikuxoxele. Lo mlisa uthi wayevame ukugibela ibhasi lokuqala lasentathakusa njalo ekuseni uma eya emsebenzini. Kuthe langa limbe wavukwa yisisu ebusuku, lesi esiqala ngokubhavumula sikuvuse kube ngathi ushiswe yilahle lomlilo. Ziningi phela izinhlobo zokuphathwa yisisu, lesi akhuluma ngaso uthi uma sesikubambile ungaphambana nenyoka iza kuwe, uqonde ngqo kuyona uphinde uyeqe futhi maqede ungaqalazi emuva ukuthi iyakulandela. Uyaqonda-ke ukuthi bunjani lobunzima akhuluma ngabo. Uthi sam’bamba lesisu simkhipha waze washiywa yibhasi lokuqala ayevame ukulithatha. Ngenhlanhla wakwazi ukulinda waze wathola ibhasi elilandelayo. Ujabula nje kanti akabuzanga elangeni ukuthi kusekukhulu okuzomehlela. Nebala angene ebhasini abe nenhlanhla yokuhlala esihlalweni esingemuva komshayeli webhasi. Noma engakushongo lokhu kodwa ngiyasola indoda yasikhetha ngabomu lesi sihlalo ngoba ibheka ukuthi ukuhlala kwayo kuso kuzoyisiza. Lihambe ibhasi lithi nje lingafika endaweni eyigquma uma nje lithi thuthu lehla egqumeni ibhasi, kwasuka lokho. Ewu sathi isisu ngila, yathi le ndoda iyaziqinisa ibambelela esihlalweni iqinisa imihlathi, sathi isisu cha angenziwa kanjalo. Yaba yinye kuphela into eyayingenziwa yithi sonke, insizwa yaqunga isibindi yasukuma yaqonda ngqo kumshayeli iyomnxusa ukuthi amise ibhasi ukuze ikwazi ukwehla iyobhekana nale ngwadla. Okokuqala nje okwaba luphawu lokuthi idlozi layo liyifulathele, yathi ingakasibeki isicelo sayo, umshayeli washo ngesankahlu ukuthi “Wendoda, njengoba ubona kahle ukuthi akusona istobhi sokuma lesi, ubungelinde ngize ngime ukuze uzobuza ngoshintshi wakho ongaphele." Cabanga njalo ukuthi isisu asinamamenazi, asinanhlonipho. Yazama indoda ukuzikhalela ithi, "Mshayeli, awumise ibhasi ngikhishwa yisisu bo." Umshayeli waphendula ngokuthi kusemnyama ngeke akwazi ukuma esigangeni ngoba kuzobeka yena nabagibeli engozini yokubanjwa yizigilamkhuba. Yaqhubeka le ndoda ikhala ithi umshayeli akame okungenani uzoma maqede angalindi avele ayishiye khona lapho. Kwangathi nomshayeli uthelwe ngezibonkolo, etshela lo mgibeli ukuthi indlela ancenga ngayo sengathi iwubufakazi impela bokuthi kukhona amaqhinga ophezu kwawo, yikho kona kanye-ke, okwenza ayishaye ngamandla ibhasi. Ewu uyabona uma umuntu exoxa ngosizi lwakhe, niqale nonke ninsinsitheka nigcine senibona ethuthumela ukuthi lolo sizi alusadabukisi, kunalokho seluvusa intukuthelo. Akukho noyedwa owaba nesibindi sokumncenga umfo lo ukuthi akaxolele umshayeli. Kwathula kwathi cwaka! Emva kwalokho wonke umuntu wacabanga ukuthi uma kungenza lesi simo sibhekane naye wayengakwazi yini ukuthi avumele ukuthambisa inhliziyo axolele lo mshayeli? Ibuhlungu le ndaba ngendlela yokuthi akekho noyedwa kithi owabe esaqhubeka ebuza ukuthi ukwenqaba komshayeli kwaholela ekutheni yenze njani indoda. Kubili kuphela okunokwenzeka ukuthi kwagcina kwenzekile, okokuqala kungenzeka ukuba indoda yalahla ithemba yabuyela esihlalweni sayo yayobekezela kunzima kunjalo. Okwesibili-ke ngizocela ukuthi ngikushiyele kuwena ukuthi uzame ukucabanga ukuthi konje kwagcina kwenzekeni. Uma usuyitholile impendulo yesibili ngiyocela wenze kanje, ufike ungazise nami bese uqhamuka nesu elibukhali lokuncenga lo mnumzane ukuthi axolele loya mshayeli. Uma nawe wawungumshayeli wawungenze njani ngempela esimweni sokumiswa umgibeli kusempondozankomo sibe sazi ukuthi izwe selaba libi kanjani?
UNKK Muhle Sibisi osemkhakheni wokuqhakambiswa kwezilimi e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, ohlonishwe ngeYoung Liguist Award nonyaka UNKK Muhle Sibisi osemkhakheni wokuqhakambiswa kwezilimi e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, ohlonishwe ngeYoung Liguist Award nonyaka UKHOLELWA ekutheni asikho isifundo nomkhakha ongeke ufundwe ngolimi lwesintu, owesifazane ohlonishwe ngendondo ngamagalelo okuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu. UNkk Muhle Sibisi ofundisa emkhakheni wakwaHumanities e-University of KwaZulu-Natal (UKZN), uhlonishwe ngeYoung Linguist Award emcimbini weminyaka engu-20 we-International Congress of Linguist. Bekuqala ukuthi lo mcimbi ubanjelwe kuleli selokhu wasungulwa njengoba ububanjelwe eKapa. UNkk Sibisi ohola nohlelo lwezilimi kwiSchool of Arts, khona e-UKZN, uthe ukuhlabana kwakhe ngale ndondo kusho ukuthi uyabonakala umkhankaso wokuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu. “Umkhankaso wokuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu akuyona into yakuleli kuphela kodwa eyawo wonke amazwe. Ngisho abe-Unesco bayakukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwalezi zilimi. Ukuthola kwami le ndondo kusho ukuthi nowethu umkhankaso uyabonakala. Izilimi zethu zanyathelwa kakhulu ngenxa yomlando wobandlululo, okuyimanje sizama ukulungisa lowo monakalo,” kusho yena. Uthe zonke izifundo ngisho ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kumele zifundwe ngezilimi zesintu. Uveze ukuthi e-UKZN sebeqalile ukusebenzisa amanye amatemu ezilimi zesintu abaqhamuke nawo. “Awukho umkhakha noma izifundo ezingeke zingafundeki ngezilimi zesintu. Uma sebefuna ukusigxeka laba abangafuni siqhakambise izilimi zethu, basishaya ngokuthi kunamatemu angeke asebenziseke kahle esiZulwini. Okuhle ukuthi ezinye izilimi ziyahambelana, kungabolekwa amagama ukwakha amanye amatemu. Awekho amagama angeke atholakele uma sizimisele, ngisho emkhakheni wezomthetho nowezesayensi,” echaza. UNkk Sibisi osefundise iminyaka emine e-UKZN, kumanje wenza iPhD lapho enza khona ucwaningo ngezilimi zesintu. Ucwaninga ukuthi amatemu esiZulu aseqalile ukusetshenziswa kulesi sikhungo ayazisiza yini izitshudeni ukuthi ziqonde kangcono ezifundiswa kona ngolimi lwazo. Ukuhlabana kwakhe ngendondo kunezelwe nayindlela alwethule kahle ngayo ucwaningo obeluhambisana nokukhuthaza izitshudeni zale nyuvesi ukuthi zihaye izinkondlo zisebenzisa amatemu emikhakha yemfundo ezikuyo. UNkk Sibisi ubonge umphathi wakhe uSolwazi Heike Tappe, athe nguye omkhuthazayo emsebenzini wakhe kulesi sikhungo. I-international Congress of Linguist yasungulwa ngo-1928 kanti izingcithabuchopho zezilimi zamazwe ahlukene ziyahlangana njalo eminyakeni eyisihlanu ukubhunga ngezokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi.
UMNUZ Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate obulewe UMNUZ Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate obulewe UDLAME lwasezikoleni lufinyelele kwelinye izinga ngenkathi umfundi ona-17 egwaza ephindelela uthisha wakhe ngommese wambulala. Lo mfundi owenza uGrade 10 eRamotshere Moiloa High School, eDinokana Village eduze kwaseZeerust, eNorth West, kuthiwa uboshwe amaphoyisa ngezinsolo zokugwaza ngokubulala uMnuz Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate onguthisha wakhe obebhekele ukubhalwa kwesifundo iGeography abafundi abenza uGrade 10 ngoLwesine. UMhlanga uthe ngaleso sikhathi bekukhona othisha ababili abebegade izingane njengoba bezibhala izivivinyo zazo. “Uqonde kuthisha obemkhuze ukuthi angangeneli ngenkathi kade kuphakwa ukudla esikoleni (uMokolobate), wamgwaza esifubeni ephindelela,” kugcizelela uMhlanga. Kubikwa ukuthi emva kokwenza lesi senzo, lo mfundi ubalekile kodwa kwasiza onogada nabanye abafundi bambamba. Ngokwemininingwane yoMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, lo mfundi uke wexwayiswa ngoMashi emva kokuthi eze esikoleni ephethe insangu. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uCaptain Sam Tselanyane, uthe lo mfundi ululekwe abezenhlalakahle, nokuthi uzobekwa icala lokubulala. Kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi eLehurutshe kule ndawo. Kubikwa ukuthi uMokolobate ubeneminyaka engu-24. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, UMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo eGauteng ubusadidekile yisenzo somunye wabafundi okuthiwa uvele wakhipha isibhamu ngoLwesithathu wasabisa ngokudubula omunye wothisha e-Eldorado Park Secondary. Kubikwa ukuthi uthisha obesatshiswa ukwazile ukuphuca lo mfundi isibhamu wasihambisa emaphoyiseni. Umnyango usigxeke kakhulu lesi senzo kulesi sikole esidume ngokuthi yiBlue School. UMnuz Panyaza Lesufi onguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo eGauteng, uthe: “Sicela abafundi bangaziphathi ngendlela engamukelekile ezikoleni,” Unxuse isigungu esibhekele ukusebenza kwesikole ukuthi kube nesinyathelo esisithathayo ngalesi senzo. Uthe umnyango ngeke uzibekezelele izenzo ezifana nalezi. Uthe nanoma ngubani oyotholakala ephambana nomthetho wokuziphatha ezikoleni, kuyobhekanwa naye ngokulandela umthetho olawula ukuziphatha ezikoleni eNingizimu Afrika. * Funda omunye umbiko ngokungaphephi kothisa ekhasini 14.

Basolwa nangokugcina inqwaba yabesifazane okuthiwa bayizigqila zocansi LELI yikhaya lebandla lodumo, iMancoba Seven Angels Ministries, abaholi bakhona abasolwa ngokusoconga amaphoyisa eNgcobo e-Eastern Cape. Basolwa nangokugcina inqwaba yabesifazane okuthiwa bayizigqila zocansi UDABA lwebandla laseNgcobo, iMancoba Seven Angels Ministries, okusolwa amalungu alo nabasolwa ngokuqotha amaphoyisa ngokuyokhosela kulo, lusematheni kulezi zinsuku. Uma kukhulunywa ngaleli bandla, kubalwa abesifazane abalinganiselwa ku-100 okuthiwa bayizigqila zocansi kuleli bandla, abantu okuthiwa badayise imizi yabo, yizimoto zabo nokunye ukuze banike abaholi baleli bandla yonke imali abanayo. Bona bahlezi abanabo omazisi, nezingane azinazitifiketi zokuzalwa, izingane ezineminyaka ewo-12 zikhulelwe ezinye zisanda kubeletha. Lokhu sekuqubule umbuzo wokuthi yibandla elinjani elenza izinto ‘eziwubuSathane’ kanje? Inhlobo yenkolo engachaza kangcono ngeSeven Angels yileyo ebizwa nge-cult. Lolu hlobo lwenkolo yilapho abantu thize abaliholayo, abenza amakholwa abo akholelwe ezintweni ezithize ngendlela yokuthi bangenza noma yini ukufezekisa abakukholwayo. ISeven Angels le kuthiwa inabesilisa abawu 7 abayiholayo, abathi bayizingelosi ezithunywe wuNkulunkulu. NgokukaSihlalo weKhomishini ebhekele ezenkolo namasiko kanye nezilimi kuleli, uNkk Thoko Mkhwanazi-Xaluza, leli bandla bebazi ngalo. “Sakhuluma nabasonta khona ngo-2016 abasitshela ukuthi bafundiswe ukuthi bahlale balinde ukubuya kukaJesu. “Bangabi nalutho kodwa balandele imiyalelo ‘ yezingelosi’ okungabaholi bebandla,” kusho uNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva. NgokuMbhishobhi Vusi Dube, lolu hlobo lwenkolo alukholelwa ekutheni uJesu Krestu uyindodana kaNkulunkulu, futhi aluyisebenzisi iBhayibheli. “Abantu abalandela lolu hlobo lwamabandla likholelwa yizinto ezishiwo umuntu abamlandelayo. Abalifundi iBhayibheli. “Uma kwenzekile balifunda, bakhetha okuzoba yingxenye ebasekelayo ngayo lokho okuthile abafuna ukukwenza ukuze bacashise iqiniso,” kusho uDube. Uthe laba bantu bavamise ukuba yiqeqebana elithile ezlizibiza ngabangcwele elingafuni ukuzihlanganisa nabanye abantu abaningi. “Bayaye bathi bona sebelindele izulu. Banomkhuba wokuzivalela bebodwa benze imikhuba ethile njengokuthi bathi bathandaza ndawonye. Ekugcineni kuyaye kungaqondakali ukuthi kanti ngempela kwenziwani,” usho njalo. “Bavamise ukusebenzisa izisekelo ezingamanga ngenhloso yokudoba abantu. Umholi wabo uvamise ukuthi atshele abamlandelayo ukuthi uboniswe into ethile nguNkulunkulu, bese nabantu bayamlandela,” kuchaza uDube. UDube ukholwa wukuthi kumele izincomo zekhomishini kaNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva, zinakwe ukuze amabandla afuze lawa, angayitholi indawo kuleli lizwe. UFata Smilo Mngadi webandla lamaRoma aKhotholika, uthe igama lawa mabandla abizwa ngawo, asukela esikhathini sobandlululo. Uthi phambilini uma ungumuntu omnyama esungule ibandla, belibizwa ngaleli gama le cult. Uthe nakuba yena ekholelwa wukuthi uJesu uyindodana kaNkulunkulu, ngeke abagxeke abanye abakholelwa kokunye, ngoba konke kungamandla kulabo abakholelwa yikho. Ngokwakhe, uhulumeni wakuleli kwakumele abeke imigomo eshoyo ukuthi abantu kumele bakhonze ngaluphi uhlobo, ukuze akwazi ukubhekana nalabo abaphambana nemithetho esuke ibekiwe. Wenze isibonelo ngodokotela, wathi kunomkhandlu obalawulayo uma kwenzeka benza okuphambene nomthetho. “Kumele amasonto kucace ngawo ukuthi enzani. Noma selibhalisiwe ngokusemthathweni, kumele kwazeke ukuthi yisonto elikhonza amadlozi yini noma okuthile, ukuze kusasa uma selenza okuphambeme nalokho, lithathelwe izinyathelo. NgokukaMbhishobhi Nathi Zondi weTruevine Community Church, abantu bakuleli bayamthanda uNkulunkulu ngendlela yokuthi baze basebenzise izindlela zokuduka bebe bengaqondile. Uthe ukwanda kwalolu hlobo lwalawa mabandla ulubone kahle ukuthi likhona kuleli ngenkathi lizethula phambi kweKhomishini ebhekele ukuvikela amalungelo eNkolo, ezamaSiko neziLimi emphakathini ngenkathi yenza uphenyo lwayo ngendlela abefundisi bamabandla abaziphathayo ngayo. “Lolu hlelo lwamabandla lugcwele umhlaba wonke. Lukhona nase United States of America,” kuchaza yena. Uthe ngokujwayelekile lolu hlobo lwamabandla luvamise ukutshela abalandeli balo ukuthi yonke into ifinyelela esiphethweni, ngakho asikho isidingo sokusebenza nokuya esikoleni uzilungiselele okusasa. “Uma lokho kungenzeki, bayazibulala ngoba laba abantu basuke bebhekene nengcindezi enhlobonhlobo,” usho kanje. Nazi ezinye zezinto ababhishobhi abathe kumele abantu baqaphele ngayo uhlobo lwalawa mabandla: * Uma lelo bandla lingalisebenzisi iBhayibheli futhi lingakholelwa ku-Jesu noNkulunkulu. * Uma ukwenza kwalo kuphambana nezinto ezikumthethosisekelo wezwe, njengokwehlisa abantu isithunzi nokuhluku-meza amalungelo abo. * Uma liqhakambisa izinto eziphathekayo ngaphandle kokuphakamisa ubukhulu bukaNkulunkulu. * Uma kukhonzwa kakhulu umholi webandla, kuthiwa abantu abadayise konke balethe konke abanakho kubaholi.
IGQEMEKE engeqiwa ntwala i-IFP nomkhandlu iZululand kusocongwa ikhansela uMnuz Sibuyiselo Dlamini Izithombe: ZITHUNYELWE IGQEMEKE engeqiwa ntwala i-IFP nomkhandlu iZululand kusocongwa ikhansela uMnuz Sibuyiselo Dlamini Izithombe: ZITHUNYELWE KUBE uLwesihlanu lwegazi KwaZulu-Natal njengoba kubulawe amakhansela amabili amaqembu ehlukene i-ANC ne-IFP ngobusuku obubodwa, behlaselwa ngesibhamu ezigamekweni ezehlukene. UMnuz Sibuyiselo Dlamini (35) waseDlebe khona Olundi, obeyikhansela emkhandlwini iZululand, udutshulwe ngasedolobheni Olundi emzileni uR66 King Dinuzulu Highway ngesikhathi imoto yakhe imiswa amadoda angaziwa avulele ngenhlamvu washonela khona lapho. Kuthiwa lesi sigameko senzeke kuyoshaya u-7 ntambama. IPhini loMkhulumeli we-IFP kuzwelonke uMnuz Joshua Mazibuko, uthe bafe olwembiza ngalo mholi obekhombisa ukukhalipha kodwa esemncane. "Le nsizwa besigadla ngayo njengoba ibibuye ibe umholi wentsha Olundi, silimele kakhulu ngokuhamba kwayo. Asifuni-ke ukuqala sishaye amathambo siqagele ngoba kuyahlupha lokho. Sizodedela amaphoyisa enze umsebenzi wawo ukuze sithole kahle ukuthi bekwenzenjani,’’ kusho uMazibuko. Kwesinye isigameko ikhansela le-ANC emkhandlwini uMsunduzi ebelibuye libe umholi oqavile esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, nalo lisocongwe ngobusuku obufanayo. Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, sivele isimo simanzonzo kulesi sifunda njengoba kuze kwamiswa nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi kwesabelwa ukuphepha kwabantu. UMnuz Musawenkosi ‘Qashana’ Mchunu (45) uthelekelwe amadoda angaziwa ngakwaPata, eMgungundlovu ehamba ngemoto yakhe ngo-7 ntambama. Kuthiwa la madoda avulele ngenhlamvu waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela, kwafika kwamenela. Umxhumanisi ebuholini besikhashana be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, kuthiwa uhlangabezane nembibizane exoshwa kubo kukamufi. "Angixoshwanga nginqume ukuthi ngingangeni ngoba ngibona amaqabane ehlukene phakathi kunezinhlangothi ezimbili. Sithume oyedwa ayosimela emndenini," kusho uZikalala. Uthe kuzofanele amaphoyisa alubeke eqhulwini lolu daba lokubulawa kwekhansela. "Lesi sihlava silokhu siqhubeka sidala kungabibikho uzinzo esifundazweni. Siyacela amaphoyisa kube khona akwenzayo ngempela ayifakele izibuko le nkinga," kusho uZikalala othe bahambele umndeni beyobabaza lo muga. Uthe bayazwelana futhi neqembu i-IFP nayo eyehlelwe yisigameko esifanayo sokusocongwa kwelungu layo. Ibamba lomkhuzi wamaphoyisa esifundazweni uMajor General Bhekinkosi Langa, uzigxekile lezi zigameko zokubulawa kwamakhansela. Uthe amadokodo asedluliselwe ethimbeni eliyisipesheli elizophenya. Unxuse namalungu omphakathi angaba nolwazi ukuthi asize athintane namaphoyisa aseduze nawo.
OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma okulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo ngamacala enkohlakalo kulandela isimemezelo esikhishwe yinhloko yeNational Prosecuting Authority uMnuz Shaun Abrahams izolo ePitoli Isithombe: esigciniwe OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma okulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo ngamacala enkohlakalo kulandela isimemezelo esikhishwe yinhloko yeNational Prosecuting Authority uMnuz Shaun Abrahams izolo ePitoli Isithombe: esigciniwe KUFEZEKE izifiso zamaqembu aphikisayo osekuphele iminyaka zifuna ukuthi obengumengameli wakuleli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ayobhekana namacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa okwavela ukuthi kwaba khona ubushompeshompe obuthinta uZuma kuwona. NgoLwesihlanu oyinhloko yophiko lwezokuShushiswa koMphakathi, uMnuz Shaun Abrahams, umemezele ukuthi uZuma uzoshushiswa ngamacala awu-16 ahlanganisa inkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa nokushushunjiswa kwemali. “Kumele umthetho usebenze. Wonke umuntu uyalingana phambi komthetho. Sinikezwe amandla ukuthi sishushise noma ngabe ubani ngaphandle kokwesaba nokwenzelela,” kusho u-Abrahams izolo. Uthe sekuyinkantolo eyokusho ukuthi leli cala lizoqala nini ukuthethwa. U-Abrahams uthe uzokwazisa ummeli woMbuso ukuthi asenqabele isicelo sokudluliselwa kwalolu daba phambili. “Ngibonga nethimba elikwazile ukuza nobufakazi ngoFebhuwari bokuthi ngikwazi ukufinyelela kulesi sinqumo,” kuchaza yena. Uthe umazisile noZuma ngesinqumo sakhe sokumbizela enkantolo ngokuxhumana nethimba labameli bakhe izolo ekuseni. Ngokuka-Abrahams, abameli bakaZuma abazange babe nayo indlela yokuthi bangaphikisana nalesi sinqumo asesithathile. Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, * -Abrahams ubezinikezwe usuku lwangoLwesine njengelokugcina lokuthi aphothule ngalo lolu daba. NgoLwesithathu iCouncil for the Advancement of the South African Constitution (Casac), yehlulekile ukuvimba * -Abrahams enkantolo ukuthi angasithathi lesi sinqumo. Ibeke isizathu sokuthi akanawo amandla okukwenza lokho ngoba naye ulengelwa yifu elimnyama. Ngonyaka odlule iNkantolo ePhakeme yokuDluliswa kwamaCala, yasiqinisekisa isinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu, sokuthi owayekade eyinhloko kaZwelonke yezokuShushiswa koMphakathi ngaleso sikhathi, * -Advocate Mokotedi Mpshe, wenza iphutha ngokwesula amacala enkohlakalo uZuma ayebhekene nawo. Amacala ayebhekene noZuma ahoxiswa ngemuva kokuthi kuvele ukuthi ukubekwa kwakhe amacala kwakunenhlese yezepolitiki. Kwavela ukuthi owayeyiNhloko yezokuShushiswa koMphakathi * -Adv Bulelani Ngcuka, nowayehola uphiko olwalubizwa ngoFezela, uMnuz Leornard McCarthy, babehlela ngasese itulo lokuba uZuma ashushiswe. Amacala ahoxiswa ngaphambi kokuthi afungiswe njengomengameli wezwe ngo-2009.
UNKK Thandazile Manzini obeyi-Operations Manager ophikweni lokubelethisa esibhedlela eManguzi oshone ngesikhathi imoto abehamba ngayo, ishayisana neloli, ngoMsombuluko Isithombe: Sithunyelwe UNKK Thandazile Manzini obeyi-Operations Manager ophikweni lokubelethisa esibhedlela eManguzi oshone ngesikhathi imoto abehamba ngayo, ishayisana neloli, ngoMsombuluko Isithombe: Sithunyelwe KUSHIYE isililo emnyangweni wezempilo esifundazweni ukushona kwezimenenja ezimbili ebezisebenza ezibhedlela zaKwaZulu-Natal, ngoMsombuluko. UNKK Thandazile Octavia Manzini (55), ungoti wokubelethisa obebuye abe yi-Operations Manager ophikweni lokubelethisa esibhedlela eManguzi, ushone ngesikhathi imoto abehamba ngayo ishayisana neloli kuR33, ngasesiqiwini iSmangaliso, kwathi uMnuz Phathakahle Jali (41) obeyi-Operations Manager ebhekelele imitholampilo engomahamba nendlwana esibhedlela uNtunjambili, ngaseKranskop, wadutshulwa wabulawa, ngamadoda angaziwa esemzini wakhe, ngoMsombuluko. UNkk Manzini kuthiwa ubephuma koqeqesha abanye abahlengikazi emtholampilo KwaMsane ngesikhathi kwenzeka le ngozi. UJali kuthiwa uhlaselwe ngamadoda amabili angaziwa esemzini wakhe ntambama, avulele ngenhlamvu ebhekise kuye, washonela khona lapho. UDkt Siphiwe Vumase isikhulu esiphezulu esibhedlela iManguzi, uthe balahlekelwe kakhulu ngokushona kukaNkk Manzini obesesebenze iminyaka ewu-30 kulesi sibhedlela. “Ubefundisa abanye abahlengikazi lapha eMkhanyakude. Ubesebenza kahle kakhulu ophikweni lokunciphisa ukudlulela kwegciwane lengculazi enganeni ezalwa umama onegciwane onalo, iPrevention of Mother to Child Transmission of HIV. Ngenxa yokuzimisela kwakhe sekuphele iminyaka emithathu singakaze sibe nenkinga yokushona kwengane ngesikhathi unina eyibeletha noma ngemuva kokubeletha.” UMNUZ Phathakahle Jali obeyi-Operations Manager ophikweni lwemitholampilo engomahamba nendlwana, esibhedlela uNtunjabili, odutshulwe wabulawa esemzini wakhe, ngoMsombuluko Isithombe: Sithunyelwe UPastor Klaas Manzini umfowabo kaNkk Manzini uthe bashaqeke kakhulu ngokudlula emhlabeni kukankosikazi kamfowabo. “Namanje kusenzima ukwamukela kodwa kumele samukele ngoba sizifikele mathupha endaweni yesigameko, sibone siqhamuka ukuthi mancane amathuba okuthi usaphila, bekuyinhlekelele yengozi leya,” kuchaza yena. Uthe unkosikazi kamfowabo ubewuthanda umsebenzi bekuthi noma besenkonzweni abashayele ucingo esibhedlela abuze ukuthi ngabe konke kuhamba kahle yini. UJali okuthiwa ubenamakhosikazi amabili, kuthiwa uqale ukusebenza kulo mnyango ngo-2001. Efika kulesi sibhedlela kuthiwa wayengu-staff nurse, waba ngu-professional nurse, waba yi-clinical nurse practitioner wagcina esekulesi sikhundla ashone ekuso. Ushiye amakhosikazi akhe nezingane eziyisikhombisa. UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kulesi sifundazwe, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, uthe kubuhlungu ukushiywa yilaba basebenzi bezempilo abashone kabuhlungu. “Kubuhlungu ukushiywa ngozakwethu ngale ndlela. Kusazoba nzima ukuthola abantu abebezinikele njengabo emsebenzini,” kusho yena. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uCol Thembeka Mbele, usiqinisekisile isigameko sokudutshulwa kukaJali, wathi kuvulwe icala lokubulala, eliphenywa esiteshini samaphoyisa eKranskop.
Sike sizibuze yini umbuzo othi; yini lena entshontsha abantu abaningi bakithi, futhi bashona ngendlela ecishe ifane? Abantu abaningi abashona kungazelele muntu. Kwabaningi esingike ngababona ukudlula kwabo emhlabeni kujikeleza ekuphundulukeni ukusebenza kwenhliziyo uqobo nasekuqhugeleni kwezinye izitho zomzimba ezishesha zizwele enhliziyweni ngenxa yokusebenzisana kwazo nenhliziyo, kuhlanganisa nomzimba wonke nje. Abantu bakithi bahamba emhlabeni beqale bakhale ngovalo olushaya kugubhuzele isifuba, kuphele amandla, iphika nokucinana kuthi ngilapha. Umuntu ahefuzele aze ashone. Lolu valo kwabaningi lusuke lukade lwaqala ukuhlupha kwesinye isikhathi kuze kuphele amandla. Impendulo abantu abayithandayo eyokuthi baye baphuza amanzi bese bethi kuye kwehla kwathi ‘gidi’ emuva kwalokhu. Namhlanje ngicela sikhulume ngalolu valo olungaqala kancane kancane okanye luqale lukusheshise luze lukugojele. Uvalo wumuzwa wokuzizwa ingathi inhliziyo ishaya ngokushesha nangamandla ngokungejwayelekile. Kwesinye isikhathi kuze kube ngathi isifuba lesi siyanyakaza ngenxa yesigqi esizwakala kusona. Lo muzwa wokushesha namandla enhliziyo kuhambisana nesiyezi, umzimba uphelelwe ngamandla, iphika, ukujuluka, umzimba oqhaqhazelayo, ukuqumbelana, ukungakwazi ukulala nekhanda elibuhlungu. Lezi zimpawu akuphoqelekile ukuthi zibe khona zonke ngesikhathi isisodwa. Isikhathi esiningi abantu abafika benalolu valo basitshela ukuthi kade babelubika emitholampilo, ezibhedlela nakodokotela babo kodwa benganakwa ngaphandle ngokutshelwa ukuthi banengcindezi emqondweni. Ziningi izinto ezingabangela umuzwa wovalo; okubalulekile ukwenza umehluko phakathi kovalo oluphelayo noyaziyo imbangela yalo nalolu valo olungafuni ukuphela nembangela ingalandeleki. Kulezi zinsuku zimbili izimbangela engizibonayo zovalo oluyingozi futhi okugcina kuhambe imiphefumulo yabaningi. Okokuqala wuvalo lapho kukhona ukucinana kubenzima ukuphefumula, kuphele amandla. Lapha siyaye sithole ukuthi inhliziyo ishaya kakhulu ngokwedlulele. Inhliziyo eshaya igcina ingakwazi ukukhipha igazi elanele elidingwa wumzimba. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni amandla aphele emzimbeni kube nzima ukuphefumula. Uma umuntu onjengalona umfaka kumshini wenhliziyo okuthiwa yi-ECG uyaye uthole ukuthi inhliziyo isishaya ngokungalawuleki futhi isiphumile esipolweni okumele ihambe kuso. Ezinye zezimbangela lapha kuba yi-Atrial fibrillation ne-Atrial flutter. Lezi yizimo lapho inhliziyo isiphunduleke kakhulu kule ndawo okumele iqale kuyo ukushaya. Ivele ijikeleze kuhle kwesikhwishikazane, ishaye uzungezane ogcina uletha uvalo namandla aphele emzimbeni. Akugcini lapho, abanye bavele baquleke, bacinane kakhulu. Uma usizo olufanele lungaveli, umuntu wakithi lowo uyasishiya emhlabeni. Lezi zifo esiqeda kuzibala ziba yizimo eziphuthuma kakhulu ukuthi zelashwe. Bakhona abantu abaphila behamba nazo kodwa isimo sabo sihlala sibucayi kakhulu. Ukuzelapha kudinga amaphilisi, imijovo nemishini ethile eyisipesheli ekwazi ukuguqula inhliziyo ebisinhlanhlatha ibuyele kundalashe ishaye ngendlela. Enye imbangela enkulu yovalo olungapheli kuba yindlala ehlala lapha emphinjeni eduze kwegilo okuthiwa yiThyroid. Le ndlala iyakwazi ukukhukhumala ibe nomkhuhlane wayo oyisipesheli okanye ivele igcwale izishizi shizi ezigcina zidale ukukhiqiza okukhulu kwamakhemikhali agcina ebange ukugula noma abe ngumdlavuza. Kulezi zinsuku ngibona abaningi abesifazane abanalesi sifo, bafika bekhala kakhulu ngokuncipha emzimbeni, inhliziyo ishaya kakhulu, beshaywa yuvalo, bevevezela, bengakuthandi ukudla. Kokunye umfutho wenhliziyo uba phezulu, ikhanda libe buhlungu baze baphelelwe ngamandla. Kwabanye kuba nokugcwalelana lapha emqaleni, kungagwinyeki kahle. Kuba sengathi kukhona okuthi ngqi lapha emphinjeni kwabanye kuze kuvuvukale nobuso. Abanalesi sifo uyaye uthole nokuthi abayi kahle esikhathini njengokwejwayelekile. Imbangela yaso enkulu kuba ngumzimba ovele ukhiqize amakhemikhali alwa nale ndlala kuwo umzimba. Kwesinye isikhathi igcina ivuvukele indlala ibe yisigaxa lapha entanyeni namehlo kube sengathi ayavuvukala aphumele ngaphandle. Lesi sifo sihlupha ngokudlulele uma vele lowo ogulayo enanesifo senhliziyo. Okubalulekile ukusibamba bese uselapha ngendlela eqondene naso. Kusukumele ukuba novalo olungapheli nolungalandaleki imvelaphi yalo. Udokotela wakho uyokwazi ukukuhlaziyela imbangela yalo ukuze welapheke ngendlela eshaya emhloleni neqondile. Mpilonhle mpilonde!
UMENGAMELI Jacob Zuma okubikwa ukuthi akazimisele ukwehla esikhundleni, Isithombe: INLSA UMENGAMELI Jacob Zuma okubikwa ukuthi akazimisele ukwehla esikhundleni, Isithombe: INLSA UMENGAMELI Jacob Zuma akanabo abamelulekayo noma kungenzeka ukuthi akabalaleli ngoba ukudaza inkani angehli esikhundleni kuzomlahlekisela ngokuningi. Usho kanje umhlaziyi wepolitiki ozimele uMnuz Thabani Khumalo. Uthe ukudaza inkani kukaMengameli aze alibeke ngembaba elokuthi akesabi noma angashaywa ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe nokubekwa icala lokuphula umthethosisekelo kuzokwenza angazitholi izimfanelo zakhe uma esephumile. Uveze ukuthi lusingethwe ngobunono udaba lukaMengameli Jacob Zuma alufani nolukaMengameli Thabo Mbeki owakhishwa kungalindele muntu. “Ukudaza inkani kukaMengameli kukhombisa ukuthi akabalaleli abamelulekayo. Kucacela noma ngubani ukuthi uzophuma esikhundleni kodwa asazi ukuthi uzokhishwa nini noma kanjani,” kusho uKhumalo. NgoLwesithathu ebusuku kusabalale inkulumo kaMgcinimafa we-ANC, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, otshele abatshalizimali kwiMining Indaba, eCape Town, ukuthi uMengameli ubatshele emehlweni ukuthi ngeke asuke futhi uzimisele ukuya ePhalamende ukuze kube nevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe noma kuvele ukuthi uphule umthethosisekelo. UKhumalo uthe uMashatile wehlise amaphaphu kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika nakubatshalizimali ngokuchaza ukuthi i-ANC isithathe isinqumo sokuthi uMengameli kufanele ehle esikhundleni. Uthe ukugxekwa kukaMashatile ngenkulumo yakhe kukhombisa ukuthi kusenamalungu e-ANC angazimisele ukuvuselela le nhlangano. “Uma i-ANC izimisele ngokulungisa isimo kufanele ibhekane nabantu abaphula umthetho bevika ngokuthi kufanele inhlangano ibumbane. Kufanele bakhuzwe abaphambana nehlombe futhi kushushiswe abaholi abanamacala,” kusho uKhumalo. UMashatile uthe beyi-ANC abazimisele ngokuthi uZuma ayoshaywa ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe futhi bamazisile ngalokho. “Umbono wethu wukuthi uma uMengameli engafuni ukusula ngenxa yezizathu ezithile kufanele simsuse esikhundleni. Sinezinkinga eziningi kabi ukuthi singavumela ukuthi kube nelungu lethu elivotelwa ePhalamende bese i-ANC iba nesithombe esibi,” kusho uMashatile. Uphinde waveza ukuthi uZuma ubezokhishwa esikhundleni emva komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC obuzoba ngoLwesithathu kodwa wahoxiswa. Uthe uZuma kufanele adedele ubuholi obusha buphathe angabatsheli ukuthi mabenzeni. Izolo uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Ace Magashule, uthe bahlangene nekhokhasi ye-ANC ePhalamende bedingida izindaba ezibathintayo. Akathandanga ukuphendula imibuzo yokuthi uZuma uphuma nini esikhundleni. USotswebhu we-ANC ePhalamende, uMnuz Jackson Mthembu, uthe ikhokhasi ayinawo amandla okuxosha uMengameli wase evalelisa ezintathelini.
KUKHALWE ngezigameko ezimbi ezenzeke KwaMakhutha, kuvalwa imigubho yokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane izolo, obuholwa iMeya yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede ophakathi nendawo KUKHALWE ngezigameko ezimbi ezenzeke KwaMakhutha, kuvalwa imigubho yokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane izolo, obuholwa iMeya yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede ophakathi nendawo IZIGAMEKO zokugwazana kwabafundi esikoleni samabanga aphezulu KwaMakhutha zenze ukuthi uvalwe khona umkhankaso wokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane izolo. Umcimbi wokuvala imigubho yalo mkhankaso wenziwe yiMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, okhale ngezigameko ezimbi ezenzeke kule ndawo. Yize singashiwongo ngegama isikole kodwa yiseMasakhane High lapho kuke kwagwazana abafundi ababili bashona ngo-Agasti. Imeya iveze izibalo zezigameko ezahlukene ezibikwe esiteshini samaphoyisa KwaMakhutha kusukela ngoSepthemba, ezinye zazo ezinyukile. Ithe ikhethe ukuvala umkhankaso KwaMakhutha ukukhuza umhlola wezigameko ezingezinhle. UNkk Gumede uqale waveza izibalo zokudlwengulwa ezibikwe esiteshini samaphoyisa, athe ngoSeptemba bayisihlanu abadlwenguliwe, ngo-Okthoba bayisishiyagalombili kwathi ngoNovemba balishumi. “Okubi ngalezi zibalo ziyenyuka kunokuba zehle. Lapha sikhuluma ngezibalo zezigameko ezibikiwe kuphela. Kungenzeka ukuthi baningi abanye abadlwenguliwe kodwa bangabika,” echaza. UNkk Gumede uveze nezibalo zokugqekezwa kwemizi ngoSepthemba ezibe u-39, zaba wu-35 ngo-Okthoba zaba u-44 ngoNovemba. Emacaleni okushaya ngoSeptemba abe ngu-34, ngo-Okthoba aba u-28 kwathi ngoNovemba awu-35. Imeya igxeke ukwanda kwamathaveni angekho emthethweni, ethe anomthelela ekubhebhethekiseni ubugebengu. Ezibalweni zamathaveni atholakele engenawo amalayisensi agcine engu-28 ngoNovemba, eqale engu-19 ngoSepthemba. Kwababulewe izibalo zikhomba ukuthi babe yisikhombisa ngoSepthemba bagcina beyisishiyagalolunye ngoNovemba. Kulo mcimbi imeya ibuye yapha ngamaphasela okudla imindeni edonsa kanzima. Ithembise ukuthi nezaguga zizothola izipho ungakashayi uKhisimusi. OnguSihlalo wekomiti leCommunity Service kuMasipala weTheku, uNkk Zama Sokhabase ugcizelele ukuthi kuvalwa kuphela imigubho ehambisana nomkhankaso kodwa abesifazane nezingane kumele bavikelwe unyaka wonke. Naye ukhale ngesigameko sokugwazana kwabafundi esikoleni, athe yikho okwenze ukuthi bawuvale KwaMakhutha umkhankaso. Umkhankaso wavulwa yimeya eSankotshe nakhona okuthiwa bekwande izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabadala. Emcimbini wayizolo kunandise umculi wowokholo uDumi Mkokstad obehambisana noBetusile. Umkhankaso wokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane uba minyaka yonke ngoNovemba 25 kuya kuDisemba 10.

Isithombe: Bongani Mbatha/ Africa News Agency (ANA) UNGAPHANSI kohlelo lokuvikelwa kofakazi owesilisa okusolwa ukuthi wadlelwa umakhelwane wakhe imali yefa eyashiywa wumqashi wakhe ayesemsebenzele iminyaka engaphezulu kweyishumi kwisithabathaba somuzi oseLa Lucia eThekwini. USabelo Mdlovu obesebenza engadini emzini kaNkk Charlotte Davies, umyeni wakhe owayedayisa idayimane (naye ongasekho emhlabeni). Ngokomunye womakhelwane abasondele emzini kaNkk Davies, wayengumuntu othulayo owayekhuluma noMdlovu kuphela isikhathi esiningi. Yingakho uMdlovu nabanye omakhelwane bathuka boma ngoSepthemba ngonyaka ka-2012 kutholakala ukuthi uNkk Davies ushiyele omunye umakhelwane, uNkk Adline Pillay, imali esondele kuR60 million, wabe eseshiyela uMdlovu uR600 000 kuphela. Ukusolisa kwalolu daba kuholele ophenyweni olwenziwa amaphoyisa eminyakeni emine edlule kanti abasolwa okunguPillay, abammeli bakhe ababili uMnuz Rodney Reddy noP. Ramjatham, bavele okokuqala enkantolo yamacala athinta imali ngoLwesine oludlule. Babhekene namacala enkohlakalo, ukukokotela kanye nokushushumbisa imali. Baboshwe kulandele isinqumo se-Assets Forfeiture Unit (AFU) sokugodla umuzi obiza uR5.8 million ngokunjalo nemali engaphezulu kuka R2.3 million ebikwi-akhawunti yakwaStandard Bank kamsolwa. UMdlovu uvulele uPillay icala ngosizo lommeli obengumakhelwane kaNkk Davies, uMnuz Ferdinand Zondagh kanti njengamanje ungaphansi kohlelo lokuvikelwa kofakazi njengoba esabela impilo yakhe. UZondagh uyena owakwazi ukuthola incwadi kaNkk Davies esayiniwe yango-2008, okuyiyo eyakubeka kwacaca ukuthi kukokotelwe ukusayinwa kwencwadi yamafa njengoba izandla zazingafani. Engxoxweni nephephandaba elinguzakwabo weSolezwe, iDaily News, uZondagh uthe uMdlovu waxhumana naye ngo-2014 wamazisa ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngencwadi yamafa kaNkk Davies. Noma aqale elekelela uMdlovu, uZondagh manje usemele abashana bakaNkk Davies, uMnuz Landgraf Pane noNkk Barbara Pane, abahlala eGermany. Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo, lolu daba lwasuka ngoSepthemba ngonyaka ka-2012 uMdlovu efika emzini kaNkk Davies. Wangqongqoza izithuba eziningi engamtholi kwaze kwaba uthinta amaphoyisa afika ashaya phansi isicabha angena. UNkk Davies watholwa esedlulile emhlabeni. Kuvela ukuthi uMdlovu wacela uNksz Pillay ukuthi amlekelele ngamalungiselelo omngcwabo njengoba uNkk Davies wayengenazo izihlobo kuleli. UMdlovu wazisa amaphoyisa noPillay ukuthi kunesisefo (safe) endlini. Sesivuliwe, kwatholwa incwadi yamafa namanye amaphepha ambalwa. “UPillay noMdlovu baya kwaRodney & Reddy Associates, okungabameli ababhalisa uNkk Davies incwadi yakhe yamafa. Incwadi yakhe yokugcina yasayinwa ngoJanuwari 21 ngo-2010,” ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo. Umhlaziyi wezobunhloli (forensic analyst) owaqhathanisa ukusayina kukaNkk Davies encwadini yango-2008 kanye nokusayina okubonakala encwadini yamafama wathola ukuthi kukokotelwe okusencwadini yamafa. Kule ncwadi uPillay uhlabana ngezigidi zikaNkk Davis, uMdlovu usala noR600 000 kuphela. NgoLwesine odlule uPillay, uReddy noRamjathan bathole ibheyili kaR2000. Udaba luzobuyela enkantolo ngoFebruwari 4.
CASTER SEMENYA CASTER SEMENYA ZIYIHAMBELA kahle izinto ingqwele yomhlaba kwi-800m yabesifazane, uCaster Semenya, othole iziqu zakhe kuleli sonto emkhakheni weSports Science eNorth West University. USemenya uveze lezi zindaba ekhasini lakhe le-instagram ngoLwesibili, efaka isithombe sakhe egqoke ijazi lezifundiswa enze uphawu lokucijisa izandla phezu kwamahlombe ajwayele ukulwenza ngemuva kokunqoba imijaho. Lena kubukeka kuyinyanga ezomphatha kahle uSemenya. Ngempelasonto edlule wephule irekhodi leminyaka engu-35 kwi-1000m. Le mpelasonto kungenzeka iphele esasigcinile isicoco sakhe sakuleli kwi-800m nakwi-1500m njengoba kuqhubeka imidlalo ye-ASA National Championship eTuks Stadium, ePitoli. USemenya ufudukele eNorth West ngo-2015 ngemuva kokuhlukana nowayengumqeqeshi wakhe uMaria Mutola. Ngokusho kwale ntokazi yaseLimpopo, lesi kwakuyisiqalo “esisha empilweni” ngemuva kwesigameko sika-2009 lapho yayisolwa ngokuthi ayikufanele ukugijima nabesifazane ngenxa yendlela edaleke ngayo. “Le ndawo ithule. Akukho okuningi ongakwenza kuyona ngaphandle kokujima, ukudla, ukulala nesikole. Ngifunda iSports Science ngoba ngathatha ikhefu ngemuva kuka-2009 ukuze ngilungise impilo yami,” kusho uSemenya kweminye imithombo yabezindaba. Kusukela lapho lo mgijimi akabange esabheka emuva enqoba igolide kuma-Olympic ngo-2016 kwi-800m. Unyaka wonke odlule akekho omehlulile kuleli banga edla ubhedu kwi-IAAF Diamond League nakwi-IAAF World Championship, nethusi kwi-1500m. Kulo nyaka kubhekwe ukuthi aqhubeke nokuphakamisa ifulegi lakuleli kumaCommonwealth Games aseGold Coast, e-Australia ngo-Ephreli. Lolu hlelo lwethulwe ku-ward 2 kwaQwabe. Yinkolelo leyo ebifafazwa abantu abangenalo iqiniso ngomphakathi wakule ndawo,” kusho uNksz Zungu. UNksz Mavimbela uthe impilo yabantu bakwaQwabe ayisophinde ifane ngoba sebezoyeka ukuvuka ekuseni ngovivi beyotheza izinkuni, bashiye izingane zilele ngenxa yokuthi manje sebezofakelwa ugesi emzini yabo. “Kade sihamba lapha sikhuluma nomphakathi ngesikhathi kuza ukhetho. Ngakho izikhalo nosizi lwale ndawo sikuqonda kahle kakhulu njengohulumeni oholwa uKhongolose neniwukhethe kulezi zinyanga ezimbili ezedlule. Namhlanje silapha sihambisana nesikhondlakhondla senkampani kagesi okungu-Eskom, sizothi luyaqala luyashikisha ufudu. Ukufakwa kukagesi kule ndawo kuzokwenza nezinhlelo zamanzi ezenziwayo zisheshe,” kusho uNksz Mavimbela. Uthe bayazi ukuthi udaba lwamanzi lube wuhlupho kakhulu kulo mphakathi ngenxa yezigebengu ebezitshontsha ama-generator aphehla amanzi. Uthe usonkontileka ozofaka ugesi uzoqala kuleli sonto. UNkk Phetheni Mbokazi oyilungu lo mphakathi uthe kubajabulise kakhulu ukuthi ngemuva kweminyaka sebezoba nogesi. Uthe besebefile ukutheza izinkuni kude namadaka ezinkomo abebebasa ngawo.

Isithombe: SIGCINIWE MHLELI: Bengicela kwabohlanga kesibheke emuva lapho sisuka khona ukuthi ngabe sisayibambe ngakho noma isisiphunyukile isidla utshani? Ake sibheke isimo phansi kwalezi zihloko ezilandelayo.(1)imisebenzi (2)ubugebengu (3)ezokuhlaliswa kwabantu.(4)umhlaba.(5)abohlanga. Ngike ngizibuze ukuthi imbangela yokuswela umsebenzi ngabe yini? Ngike ngibone izikhangiso zomsebenzi ziziningi futhi zisho nemiholo emihle bese ngixakeka ukuthi pho kungani izingane zakwethu zihlale zikhala ngokungaqasheki zibe zifundile. Uma ulandelisisa inkinga ngamava. Ngiwufakazi walokho ngoba ngiye ngibone ezikhangisweni kufuneka abanamava eminyaka ewu-3,5,7 alowo msebenzi.Bekunganjani uma uhulumeni wethu ake abhekelele abafowethu nodadewethu abahleli neziqu zabo emakhaya ngenxa yamava angekho adingwa wumsebenzi abawufundele. Imalimboleko ebizwa ngoNSfas boyoyibuyisa nini behleli neziqu emakhaya. Benginombono othi njengoba uhulumeni ekwazi ukunikeza izibonelelo kubantu abahlwempu nabo akazame ukuthi umuntu ngamunye ngokomsebenzi awufundele athole lelo thuba lokusebenza esizana nasebemkantshubomvu ukuze azuze amava awumgoqo ekutheni aqasheke. Ngicabanga ukuthi singabasiza leso sibonelelo sokuthi bakwazi ukuzibheka besafuna amava. Ubugebengu ngicabanga ukuthi imbangela yabo ukusweleka komsebenzi. Yebo singephike ukuthi nokufuna imali esheshayo nobuvila nakho kunomthelela ebugebengwini. Okunye okuyinkinga wukuhlaliswa kwabantu ezindaweni ezingakulungele ukuhlala - ezingahlelekile, ezingenagesi, amanzi ukuthuthwa kwendle nemigwaqo.Uma ngikhumbula kahle indawo ekulungele ukuhlalisa umphakathi iqala ihlolwe wochwepheshe ukuthi kukhonani phansi nokuthi kumele izakhiwo zibe wuhlobo olunjani anduba kuhlaliswe umphakathi.Umhlaba ngane zakwethu ukhona ubanzi inkinga ukuthi siyakwazi yini ukuwusebenzisa? Asingafani nomuntu othenga imoto engakwazi ukushayela bese igcina isisetshenziswa ngabakwaziyo, ingabi nanzuzo kuye. Bengingacela singabohlanga kesihlukane nobuvila nokufuna ukwenzelwa wuhulumeni ngaso sonke isikhathi. Asimlekeleleni ukuze naye asisize kwesikuvezayo. Sasingavoteli ukuhlala sikhangezwa wuhulumeni. Sasivotela ukuba sikhululeke. Uhulumeni ake asilalele uma sikhala kungaze kushiswe izakhiwo zomphakathi kube yima elalela. Lokho kukodwa nje kusiphindisela emuva ngoba kusasa uzothi akanamali yokusisiza usalungisa umonakalo odaleke ngenkathi kubhikishelwa izimfuno zomphakathi.Ngakhoke ngiyacela bafowethu nodadewethu isikhathi sokushisa nokulimaza izinsiza sesadlula. Akusezona ezobandlululo sekungezethu, yimali yabakhokhi bentela esidlala ngayo. Ake sibe nezinye izindlela zokukhononda nohulumeni asheshe ezwe angalindi ukuthi abantu baze baphelelwe yisineke.Asingazitholi sesifana namanye amazwe ase-Afrika ngobuphofu ngoba nawo ayefana nathi ekusukeni. Asiqapheleni ngane zakwethu singazibulali sibhekile. Sesikhululekile manje asiyibambeni ingasiphunyuki, sokhomba bani ngomunwe? Abakuhulumeni abangazinothisi bona nemindeni yabo. Balapho nje bathunywe yithina. Petrus Radebe EMadadeni
KUDUTSHULWE kwashona umshayeli wetekisi emayini KwaSomkhele, KwaMsane, zolo. UMnuz Sthembiso Khumalo (27) obeshayela itekisi ebigcwele abasebenzi bakule mayini ufike kuyo ekuseni ngo-5.30 njengokujwayelekile. Ngesikhathi onogada bematasa becindezela ilayisensi yakhe emshinini othatha imininingwane, omunye emfuthisa emshinini ohlola ukuthi abukho yini utshwala egazini, kuthushuke owesilisa ongaziwa wakhomba umshayeli ngesibhamu. Kuthiwa udubule kwaze kwaba kasithupha ebhekise kumshayeli. Umufi udubuleke ekhanda, esifubeni, engalweni, izinhlamvu ezintathu zangena ohlangothini lwangakwesokudla washonela khona lapho. Uthe ngesikhathi umsolwa evulela ngenhlamvu etekisini kudubuleke nomgibeli enqulwini waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela KwaHlabisa. “Kuvulwe icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala esiteshini samaphoyisa KwaMsane. Okwamanje akukaboshwa muntu,” kusho yena. Uqhube wathi amaphoyisa acela noma ngubani ongawasiza ngolwazi olungaholela ekuboshweni kosolwa ngaleli cala athinte umphenyi wecala uCaptain Nkosinathi Themba Hilton Buthelezi ku-035 551 9008.

UNobhala Jikelele weNehawu uMnuz Zola Saphetha, uthe isiteleka siyaqhubeka futhi akekho umsebenzi wakwaSassa ozoba semsebenzini kusukela namhlanje kuze kube bathola izimfuno zabo. USaphetha uveze ukuthi abasebenzi abazange baqeqeshelwe ukusebenzisa uhlelo olusha lokuholela abantu oluhambisana nokugingqa izithupha olubizwa nge-biometric enrolment. Esitatimendeni uMnuz Paseka Letsatsi obhekelele ezokuxhumana kwaSassa uthe baphoxekile ukuthi iNehawu isabisa ngokuteleka ngenxa ye-biometric enrolment. “Abasebenzi baqeqeshwa ngaphambi kokwethulwa kwalolu hlelo ukuze bakwazi ukulusebenzisa. Uthe ngisho ngoJuni wonyaka odlule ngesikhathi iSassa yethula umbiko enkantolo yomthethosisekelo yasho ukuthi esikhundleni sokugingqa izithupha ephepheni sezizogingqwa kwikhompyutha kusetshenziswa i-biometric enrolment. Uphinde waveza ukuthi babe nomhlangano neNehawu ngoSepthemba 25 lapho babefuna ukukhombisa ukuthi lusebenza kanjani uhlelo olusha lokuhola kanjalo nolwe-biometric enrolment kodwa iNehawu yaphuma kulowo mhlangano. “Sicela iNehawu izoxoxisana nathi ukuze sikwazi ukuthola isisombululo kulolu daba lwe-biometric enrolment siqhubeke nokusiza abantu,” kusho uMahlangu.
UMPHAKATHI waseNtshawini, eStanger, usashaqekile ngesigameko sokubulawa kukaMnuz Thulubheke Thokozani Mdlalose noMnuz Bhekinkosi Mfundeni Msomi abatholakale beklajwe bashiswa eMelville izolo ekuseni: NQOBILE MBONAMBI/AFRICAN NEWS AGENCY(ANA) UMPHAKATHI waseNtshawini, eStanger, usashaqekile ngesigameko sokubulawa kukaMnuz Thulubheke Thokozani Mdlalose noMnuz Bhekinkosi Mfundeni Msomi abatholakale beklajwe bashiswa eMelville izolo ekuseni: NQOBILE MBONAMBI/AFRICAN NEWS AGENCY(ANA) USASHAQEKILE umphakathi waseNtshawini, eStanger, ngokubulawa kwabalisa ababili abaklajwe bashiswa ngamalungu omphakathi abebasola ngokuba yizigebengu ezingena emizini yabantu. Kuthiwa uMnuz Thulubheke Thokozani Mdlalose (29) noMnuz Bhekinkosi Mfundeni Msomi (35) bebephuma emsebenzini nozakwabo ababili ngoLwesithathu ebusuku ngesikhathi bevinjwa abantu abebebasola ngokuba yingxenye yezigebengu okuthiwa zihlalise abantu lubhojozi ngokubangenela ezindlini zibaphuce impahla kokunye zidlwengule nabesifazane. Laba bobabili batholakale eMelville izolo ekuseni beshisiwe. Phezu kwabo bekubekwe amathayi, utshani, amapulangwe noplastiki. Kukholakala ukuthi leli qulu libashayile labaklabha lase libahudulela epaki, iHlalanathi nokuyilapho beshiselwe khona. Ngesikhathi izintatheli zaleli phephandaba zifika epaki bekusashunqa intuthu kodwa izidumbu sezithathiwe. Uma bebuzwa abakhelene nepaki ngokwenzekile bebevele bathi abazi lutho futhi ababonanga lutho. Kuze kwaba ngabantu abebehlala esigcemeni obekuhlala kuso laba ababulewe ababhoboke ngokwenzekile. UNksz Thandazile Zulu (25) obehlala egcekeni noMdlalose okuthiwa ungowaseMlaza kodwa ubeqashe eNtshawini, uthe bangqongqozelwe abantu abasebenza naye ekuseni ngo-4 bebika ukuthi sebevinjwe umphakathi waseMelville. UNksz Zulu uthe Mdlalose noMsomi bebesebenza enkontilekeni ebifaka imithangala emgwaqweni. Uthe uzakwabo ubabikele ukuthi bebephantshelwe yisondo lemoto base behamba ngezinyawo benqamula eMelville ngesikhathi bevinjwa yiqulu labantu ebelingalawuleki. Elinye ilungu lomphakathi, uNksz Sinenhlanhla Xhakaza, lithe namanje basashaqekile ngokubulawa kwalaba njengoba libachaze njengabantu abebesebenza bengahluphi muntu. “Kubuhlungu ukubabona bebulawe ngesihluku esinje. Izandla nezinyawo zabo beziboshiwe, omunye eboshwe ngentambo, omunye ngocingo. Iminwe kaMfundeni beyiklajiwe ilenga, unyawo lukaThokozani nalo lulenga.” Uthe kuleya ndawo usukhona umkhuba wokuthi kubulawe abantu ngoba besolwa ngokwenza izenzo zobugebengu noma bengabanjwanga oqotsheni. Ikhansela lendawo uMnuz Vincent Shezi, lithe belisanda kuzwa ngalesi sigameko. Lithe umphakathi uhlushwa yizigebengu kanti sekuvamile ukuthi abantu balinyazwe, abanye babulawe ngoba besolwa ngobugebengu. “Noma sikuqonda ukuthi umphakathi uhleli lubhojozi ngenxa yobugebengu, siyakugxeka ukuthi abantu bazijezisele abantu. Ukubulawa kwabantu baze bashiswe kuwubulwane nobugebengu,” kusho uShezi. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, uthe amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amabili okubulala emuva kokutholakala kwabalisa ababili bebulewe. Uthe kusolakala ukuthi laba balisa bashaywe ngamalungu omphakathi abashisa.

Umndeni kaNksz Zothile Mthethwa (33) waseMashiwase, eMgababa, ngaphezu kobuhlungu bokuthi uvuke ngeSonto watshelwa ngomuntu olele endleleni eduze komuzi wakhona okuthe uma usufika khona wathola ukuthi ilungu lawo libulewe, usuzwa obunye ubuhlungu bokuthi awazi umufi uzofihlwa ngani. Lo mndeni uphinde washaqeka uma usekuboshwa umkhwenyana kamufi osolwa ngokuthi umklinye wambulala. Umndeni usubhekene nenkinga yokuthi awazi ukuthi uzongcwatshwa kanjani umufi njengoba umkhwenyana wakhe okunguyena obemeseka ngemali esengumsolwa. Umfowabo kamufi uMnuz Banele Mthethwa, uthe uhlukane nodadewabo ngoMgqibelo ntambama bephuma emcimbini wakwamakhelwane. Uthe udadewabo uphume wathatha indlela eya kubo yena ubesafuna ukuya kwenye indawo. Ekuseni akazange anake uma engamboni ngoba ubezitshela ukuthi mhlawumbe ukumkhwenyana wakhe. “Izingane ezingabashana balapha ekhaya ebezihamba endleleni zibone umuntu ebezithi ulele zamemeza. Sisheshe saphuma ngoba kuseduze nasekhaya. Sishaqeke kabi uma sithola ukuthi udadewethu futhi ushonile, emzimbeni ubengenalo inxeba. Sibize omakhelwane nomkhwenyana bafika badangala bebona lesi simo, umuntu okhulelwe eshonile kungaziwa ukuthi ubulelwe yini. Umkhwenyana ubeyingxenye yabantu ebethukile kodwa akuphelanga isikhathi eside amaphoyisa athola intambo ebifakwe udadewethu esinqeni ikuye, waboshwa ngoba kusolwa ukuthi umklinye ngayo.” Uthe ngokwazi kwakhe udadewabo nosbari wakhe odabuka eMalawi bebengenazo izinkinga bebexabana njengabo bonke abantu abathandanayo. “Isigameko senzeka ngeSonto kuze kube manje siyaphuma siyangena sicela usizo lokungcwatshwelwa, akulungi. La ekhaya akekho umuntu osebenzayo naye usisi ubengasebenzi.” Lo mndeni onabantu abadala abane, uphila ngemali yesibonelelo yezingane ezintathu, ezimbili ezikamufi neyodwa eyomunye udadewabo. UMnuz Lungani Mkhathini wophiko lwentsha lwe-ANC kule ndawo, uthe bengabantu abasha bashaqekile ngalesi sigameko esenzeke ngesikhathi lapho kukhuzwa ukubulawa kwabantu besifazane nezingane. “Siyazama ukusiza lo mndeni ngokuwutholela abantu abangawusiza okwamanje akekho osaqhamukile.” Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe kutholakale isidumbu sowesifazane endleleni, eMashiwase, eMgababa, ngeSonto. Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luholele ekutheni kuboshwe indoda eneminyaka engu-36 ngecala lokubulala. Le ndoda ivele enkantolo ngecala lokubulala namahlanje (izolo).”
