AKAFUNI izaguga zibulawe ngenxa yokuthi abantu abayiqondi iDementia, uNksz Zethu Makhathini onenhlangano efundisa ngalesi sifo sokulahleka komqondo kwabadala AKAFUNI izaguga zibulawe ngenxa yokuthi abantu abayiqondi iDementia, uNksz Zethu Makhathini onenhlangano efundisa ngalesi sifo sokulahleka komqondo kwabadala UKUBONA isifo esixakile esahlasela unina, kwenze ukuthi asungule inhlangano aqwashisa ngayo owesifazane waseLamontville, eThekwini, osezinze e-England. UNksz Zethu Makhathini (56), unenhlangano ebizwa ngeBessie Makhathini Foundation efundisa kabanzi ngeDementia. Lesi yisifo esijwayele ukuhlasela asebekhulile, esenza balahlekelwe umqondo. UNksz Makhathini uthe wayengazi ukuthi unina unalesi sifo kodwa nasemndenini babecabanga ukuthi ukuguga. Ukusungula le nhlangano kuyingxenye yokuthi apholise amanxeba njengoba ethi ukushona kukanina kwashiya isilonda. Uchaze unina owayengunesi njengowesifazane obenesibindi, ebakhathalele nabantu. UNksz Makhathini washiya elakuleli waya ekudingisweni ngo-1981 ngenxa yezepolitiki. Uthe kwathatha isikhathi ukuthi unina amazi ukuthi ukuliphi izwe kodwa wamfuna waze wamthola, wamvakashela. “Ngaqala ngaya eTanzania ngesikhathi ngisuka eNingizimu Afrika, ngagcina sengiseSoviet Union. Yilapho engafike ngafundela iPsychology, namanje okuyiyona engisiza ukulekelela abaneDementia,” kusho yena. Yize uNksz Makhathini abuyela kuleli emuva kokhetho lwenkululeko ngo-1994, wanquma ukuyozinza e-England. Inhlangano ayisungulile iwaxhumanisa womabili lawa mazwe njengoba enehhovisi eLamontiville nelinye elise-England. Naye uyabuya ukuzobheka umsebenzi kuleli kodwa uxhumana nehhovisi nsuku zonke ngeSkype. Inhlangano wayisungula ngo-2015 emuva kokushona kukanina ngo-2012. Uveze ukuthi unina watholakala ukuthi unalesi sifo ngo-2009 kodwa ngalesi sikhathi lwalungekho usizo. “Baningi abaphethwe yilesi sifo kodwa kungaziwa. Umphakathi awufundisekile ngaso ngoba uma ugogo ebonakala ehamba ebusuku usolwa ngokuthakatha. Umama watholakala nalesi sifo sesidlondlobele kakhulu yingakho ngisiza abantu ukuze basheshe bathole usizo,” kusho yena. Echaza ezinye izimpawu zaso uthe abanye bayakhohlwa noma bakhulume into engekho. “Kwakuthi uma ngihamba nomama ngemoto ngifuna angiyalele ngoba angilazi iTheku, acishe angiphonse ezimotweni engihambisa ngendlela okungeyona. Omunye kuyenzeka agcine ebiza ngisho amaphoyisa esola umndeni ngokuntshontshelwa imali ngoba esekhohliwe ukuthi uyifihlephi. Omunye ukhohlwa ngisho ukudla noma aphume imoto ihamba,” echaza. UNksz Makhathini osebenzisana nesibhedlela iKing Dinuzulu eThekwini ukusiza abanalesi sifo, uneSupport Group kanti ubuye asebenze ngocingo ukuhlolela iDementia. Ngaphandle kwalo msebenzi, usebenza nesikhungo iNational Health Service emkhakheni wePsycho Education e-England.

Isithombe: Henk Kruger/ANA/African News Agency UHLA LELWE wumsebenzi onzima uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa njengoba yonke iminyakazo yakhe yokuqoka uMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi izoqashwa ngeso lokhozi. Izazi zomthetho zisho lokhu emuva kokuthi iJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga linqume ukuthi ukuqokwa kuka-Adv Shaun Abrahams akukho emthethweni ngoba wangena esikhundleni sika-Adv Mxolisi Oliver Nxasana owaxoshwa ngaphandle kokulandela uMthethosisekelo. IJaji Madlanga lithe u-Abrahams kufanele akhokhe izindleko zecala zabameli bakhe ababili bese uhulumeni ekhokha zonke izindleko zecala. Uyalele uNxasana ukuthi akhokhe uR10.3 million (R10 240 767.47) kuR17.3 million akhokhelwa wona ngesikhathi exoshwa. Uphinde wayalela uRamaphosa ukuthi aqoke uMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi kungakapheli izinsuku ezingu-90. Uthe zonke izinqumo ezithathwe ngu-Abrahams zisemthethweni. USolwazi Pierre De Vos oyisazi soMthethosisekelo esifundisa ezomthetho eNyuvesi yaseCape Town, uthe Ramaphosa kufanele aqoke umuntu ozophatha ezokushushiswa okwesikhashana ngesikhathi esabheka umuntu ofanelwe yilesi sikhundla. “Wonke amehlo azothi njo kuRamaphosa njengoba kufanele aqoke umuntu onesibindi, onesimilo futhi ongahambisani nenhlangano ethile yepolitiki futhi ongahambisana nosomabhizinisi abathile. “Kufanele kube wumuntu ozobeka izidingo zezwe ngoba uma ehambisana nepolitiki uzocabangela inhlangano yakhe futhi uma ehambisana nosomabhizinisi uzocabangela bona angabheki izidingo zesizwe,” kusho uDe Vos. Uthe njengoba ijaji lithe izinqumo zika-Abrahams ngeke zishintshe kusho ukuthi abanamacala ezinkantolo bazoqhubeka nawo kuze kuba yizona ezinquma ukuthi ayabalahla noma ayabathetha. UMnuz Lawson Naidoo weCouncil for Adavancement of the South African Constitution uthe bayasijabulela isinqumo senkantolo yize sifike sekwenzeke umonakalo omkhulu. “Isinqumo senkantolo sizobuyisa uzinzo kwezomthetho eNingizimu Afrika futhi siyasamukela. Sizoqapha ngeso lokhozi ukuthi zonke iziphakamiso zenkantolo ziyenzeka,” kusho uNaidoo. Phakathi kwezinye izinhlangano ebezifake udaba luka-Abrahams enkantolo kubalwa iCorruption Watch neFreedom Under Law. UMnuz David Lewis onguMqondisi weCorruption Watch, uthe inkantolo ithathe isinqumo esifanele ngoba umthetho ubusufile eNingizimu Afrika. “Silindele ukuthi kuqokwe umuntu onesibindi, ongeke asabe ukushushisa izephulamthetho noma ngabe zikuhulumeni. Asifuni umuntu ohambisana nepolitiki noma othanda imali,” kusho uLewis. UNxasana uthe akanankinga nokukhokha uR10.3 million futhi uzolandela okushiwo yinkantolo kodwa uyajabula ukuthi akalahlwanga yicala.
IMILUTHA yezidakamizwa isijike ukwenza njengoba kuthiwa isizitika ngokuphuza amanzi aphuma uma ipheke ama-pads (amaqakelo) abesifazane asesebenzile. Lo mkhuba omusha ubukeka uzobhincisela nxanye abezidakamizwa iwunga nenyaope. Kuthiwa uthandwa yintsha engenayo imali yokuthenge inyaope newunga ngenxa yokuthi imba eqolo. Ukuhlanganisa amaqakelo kulula ngoba bahambela imizi enabantu besifane baketule imigqomo bathathe amaqakelo asesebenzile noma baye lapho kulahlwa khona imfucuza bapequlule ukuze bathole amaqakelo. Kuthiwa uma sebewatholile amaqakelo asesebenzile, bawathatha bawabilise bese amanzi aphuma lapho bawaphuze. La manzi kuthiwa ayadakana, ulala ungazazi negama lakho, okuyinhloso enkulu yemilutha. Umsuka walo mkhuba, kuvela ukuthi ukhonjwa e-Indonesia njengoba ususabalele emazweni amaningi okubalwa neNingizimu Afrika. Ngokolwazi oluvela kweminye yemibiko wumkhuba osuneminyaka engaphezu kwemibili uqalile kodwa eNingizimu Afrika usanda kuqala ukubonakala eGoli. Kuthiwa umuntu ophuze le ‘jusi’ ephuma emaqakelweni, udakwa amakhemikheli asetshenziswe kuwona. Udokotela wabesifazane ongathandanga negama lakhe, uthe uyakweshwama lokhu. “Ngiyakweshwaba lokhu kodwa kunengozi kakhulu empilweni yomuntu,” usho kanje. Uthe okokuqala amaqakelo anekhemikhali i-Absorbent Core esetshenziswe ukubamba igazi kwiqakelo ukuthi lingagelezi. "Lilodwa nje leli khemikhali alikulungele ukungena ngaphakathi liphuzwe ngoba alikudalelwe lokho kodwa lisebenza ukubamba okusaketshezi. Uma seliliningi ngaphakathi egazini lingaba yingozi.” Uqhube wathi i-chlorine nayo etholakala emaqakelweni ingakwenza ukuthi uma umuntu eyiphuzile azizwe esezulwini elincane. Udokotela udalule ukuthi ngokwesayensi uma into isibilisiwe amagciwane ayafa kodwa kukhona adlula aphile okuyiwo angabeka impilo yabaphuza lawo manzi asengcolile impilo yabo ibe sengcupheni. - Isolezwe ngeSonto

INDLU yaseSobantu eMgungundlovu ekoloto umasipala waseMsunduzi uR220 000 wezindleko. Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE INDLU yaseSobantu eMgungundlovu ekoloto umasipala waseMsunduzi uR220 000 wezindleko. Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE USOBISHINI owesifazane waseSobantu, eMgungundlovu, okweleta umasipala waseMsunduzi uR220 000 wezindleko zamanzi, ukuthuthwa kwendle kanye nokuqoqwa kukadoti. UMasipala uveze ukuthi le mali eyeminyaka engu-14 edlule. Umnikazi wendlu, uNksz Nomusa Ngcobo, uthe umndeni wakhe wathenga lo muzi ngo-1999 kodwa itayitela langabhaliswa ngaphansi kwegama lo muntu womndeni, okuyinto abebengayazi. UNksz Ngcobo uvumile ukuthi abakaze bakhokhe ngisho isenti selokhu baqala ukuhlala kule ndawo ngoba abakaze bathole incwadi ebayalela ukuthi bakhokhe. Uthe owayengumnikazi wendawo ubazise ngenyanga edlule sebehlelela ukubhalisa indlu ngaphansi kwabantu bomndeni. Umnikazi wendlu uNksz Nomusa Ngcobo uthe umndeni wakhe wathenga lo muzi ngo-1999 "Ngiye kwamasipala ngafika ngatshelwa ukuthi lesi yisamba engisikweletayo samanzi, ukuthuthwa kwendle kanye nokuqoqwa kuka doti. Ngesikhathi sikhuluma nabo basazise ukuthi udaba seludluliselwe kubammeli. Uma bethi asiyikhokhe le mali angazi ukuthi sizokwenzenjani," kusho uNksz Ngcobo. Ikhansela lewadi uMnuz Sandile Dlamini uthe lo mndeni usumazisile ngalolu daba futhi uhlela ukuhlangana nabomkhandlu kuleli sonto. "Lesi samba angisiqondi ukuthi sivela kuphi ngoba awukho umuzi kuleli lokishi ongakweleta imali engaka, futhi sengiwubonile nomuzi okukhukunywa ngawo," kusho yena. Uthe ikhona neminye imizi kuleli lokishi ekweleta imali eqala kuR80 000 kuya kuR100 000. "Kuyacaca ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ngendlela okubalwa ngayo izindleko ngoba nami bake banginikeza isamba esingesona. Ngemuva kokuxhumana nabo babala kabusha kwavela isamba esiyiso," kusho yena. Uthe kuzobaluleka ukuthi ilungiswe indlela umkhandlu obala ngayo izindleko ezikweletwa abantu. Okhulumela umasipala uThobeka Mafumbatha uthe isamba esikweletwa yilo wesifazane siyiso. "Lesi samba esama-rates, ukuqoqwa kwendle kanye namanzi. Akukaze kukhokhelwe lokhu kusukela ngo-2004 futhi sinakho ubufakazi balokho.Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kulo muzi kuphezulu kakhulu," kusho uMafumbatha.

Bekukuningi ubaba obekumele akulungise, kwabambezela nomshado. Ngajabula ubaba engitshela ukuthi sekukhona uMaKhumalo ngoba bengivele ngigqilazeka. Engingakuthandi ukufihlelwa uma sekukhona olandelayo. Namanje anginankinga ngisho ngingalanywa abangaki ngoba mningi umsebenzi layikhaya. Ubaba uyinyanga usebenza nabantu kakhulu, kudingeka sibuye sibasize, sipheke namakhambi,” kuchaza uKaMakhoba. Uthe akaze abe nenkinga yokuhlala noMakhumalo, abapheka ekhishini elilodwa naye. UMaKhumalo uthe wafika kwaLushozi esazi ukuthi uyoba ngowesibili. “Siphathene kahle noKaMakhoba kungathi udadewethu. Akukho esikwenza singabonisananga. Sihlukana ngoba sekuyolalwa. Umuntu unezinsuku zakhe zokuvakashelwa ubaba futhi asinankinga,” kusho uMaKhumalo. ULushozi obehleka yedwa, uthe ubesalungisa izinto zasemsamo nezomndeni njengoba ebengakwazi ukugcagca. Uthe akaze aganwe phambilini, yingakho enqume ukuthi abashade ngosuku olulodwa ngoba vele bayezwana. “Engikwenzayo ngikutshelwa ngabaphansi engisebenza ngabo, yibona nabangivumele ukuthi amakhosikazi ngiwashade ngosuku olulodwa. Bangibonisa la makhosikazi, yingakho sihleli ngokuthula,” kusho uLushozi. Ebuzwa ngemfihlo yokwenza isithembu sakhe sizwane, uthe ukuthi wasinikwa abaphansi akazenzelanga. ULushozi uthe yize okwamanje emphethe kahle amakhosikazi akhe, ngeke aphike ukuthi ngeke esaganwa. Uthe ukhokho wayenamakhosikazi angu-19. Ugcizelele ukuthi akukho okwakwenziwa uKaMakhoba obekungamanelisi kodwa wathatha uMaKhumalo ngoba kuwumyalelo wabaphansi. Umphakathi ubuphume ngezinkani kule ndawo uzobuka umngcagco.
SIKHULU isililo ngokushona kukaKhensani Maseko obeyisitshudeni eRhodes University okusolwa ukuthi uzibulele ngenxa yokhwantalala SIKHULU isililo ngokushona kukaKhensani Maseko obeyisitshudeni eRhodes University okusolwa ukuthi uzibulele ngenxa yokhwantalala LISHONE elayizolo isematheni indaba yokuzibulala kwesitshudeni ebesiyisishoshovu, okusolwa ukuthi sizibulele. UKhensani Maseko (23), obeyisitshudeni emkhakheni wezomthetho eRhodes University, kusolwa ukuthi uzibulele ngoLwesihlanu emuva kokuphathwa ukhwantalala. Ngokwemiyalezo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kusolwa ukuthi uKhensani ubenokhwantalala ngenxa yokuthi wadlwengulwa yisoka lakhe elikuyona le nyuvesi. Abamaziyo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bathe bezivele zibonakala izimpawu zokuthi uzozibulala. Abaningi bakhale ngokuthi bekumele athole usizo ngoba bekukhombisa ukuthi unengcindezi. Ekhasini lakhe likaTwitter, uKhensani ubesanda kubhala ukuthi ngelinye ilanga uyokhuluma inkulumo eyonyakazisa abaningi. Ubuye wabhala ku-Instagram ukuthi “Kulungile uma kuyintando yakho.” Konke lokhu kuhumushwe ngokuthi ubengekho esimeni esihle emqondweni. Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana abanye bamchaze njengesishoshovu ebesiwakhathalele amalungelo ezitshudeni futhi ehlakaniphile. Kuvele nokuthi ubengomunye wabaholi bohlaka lwezitshudeni olumele i-EFF kule nyuvesi. Kuthintwa uNksz Sixolise Gcilisha, osehhovisini lezokuxhumana kwi-EFF, uvumile ukuthi uKhensani ubephambili emzabalazweni wezitshudeni kuleli qembu. Uthe abangaphawula kahle ngaye yilabo abebesebenza naye ophikweni lwezitshudeni enyuvesi, izolo abangatholakalanga ukuphawula. UKhensani ubephinde abe nguSihlalo weRhodes Independent Electoral Board. Ubephinde abe semkhakheni wezokumodela njengoba ebenguMiss Varsity Shield ophethe isicoco sakulo nyaka. Ngesikhathi sokuloba ibingakaveli eminye imininingwane ngalesi sitshudeni. Kwenzeka lokhu nje ngempelasonto bekungcwatshwa ingcithabuchopho yakuleli, uSolwazi Bongani Mayosi (51). UMayosi obeyiDean yeFaculty of Health Sciences e-University of Cape Town, kuvele ukuthi uzibulele ngenxa yokhwantalala. Umndeni wakhe emngcwabeni uveze ukuthi ukhwantalala lwaqala ngesikhathi kunemibhikisho yeFees Must Fall emanyuvesi. Kuthiwa ubenozwelo, ezikhathalele izitshudeni ezihlwempu. Ukuzibulala kwakhe kuvule amehlo abaningi abathe kumele kuqwashiswe ngendaba yokhwantalala ngoba baningi abanalo kodwa abangasizakali. Sekusungulwe nophenyo ekutholeni ukuthi yini eholele ekutheni azibulale lo solwazi obengungoti emkhakheni wezokuhlinzwa kwezinhliziyo.
UMENGAMELI omusha we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa onethemba ngabatshali zimali kuleli. Isithombe: Reuters UMENGAMELI omusha we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa onethemba ngabatshali zimali kuleli. Isithombe: Reuters IPHINI likaMengameli waseNingizimu Afrika, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa lithembise ukuthi lizoletha abatshalizimali kuleli njengoba lizobacela ukuthi beze kuleli uma seluya emhlanganweni weWorld Economic Forum (WEF), eDavos, eSwitzerland ngesonto elizayo. URamaphosa uzohamba nongqongqoshe ababhekele ezomnotho nosomabhizinisi ngoJanuwari 23 kuya kuJanuwari 26 uma eseyohlangana nabaholi bomhlaba engqungqutheleni yeWEF. “Ngizozikhulumela mathupha nabatshalizimali ngisizwa wosomabhizinisi bakuleli. Angingabazi ukuthi ngizobuya nabantu abazofaka imali emnothweni wethu, badale amathuba omsebezi, kuthuthuke umnotho. Sizolaya labo abazitshela ukuthi izwe lethu ngeke liphumelele, ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi sakha isithombe esihle kubatshalizimali,” kusho uRamaphosa. Amazwi akhe enanelwe nguMnuz Bonang Mohale oyisikhulu esiphezulu kwaShell SA obuye abe yisikhulu seBusiness Leadership South Africa (BLSA) othe bazosebenzisana nohulumeni ukunxenxa abatshalizimali. “Besiphatheke kabi ngoba ukwehliswa kwezwe lethu kwezomnotho kwakhe isithombe esibi kubatshalizimali kodwa sizimisele ukusebenzisana nohulumeni uma eshaya imithetho noma enza izinguquko, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umnotho uyakhula,” kusho uMohale. Uthe umhlangano weWEF uyithuba lokuthi bahlangane nabanye abaholi bamabhizinisi babaqinisekise ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ilindele abatshalizimali futhi umnotho wayo uzokhula. “Abatshalizimali sizobakhombisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika yizwe elilwa nenkohlakalo, elinezinkantolo ezizimele kanjalo namabhange azimele. Wumyalezo esiyowusabalalisa loyo,” kusho uMohale.
AWUKHULULEKILE umndeni womfundi waseMadundube, eMbumbulu, otholakale eshonile ngeSonto egaxwe nentambo entanyeni, ongakholwa wukuthi uzibulele ngempela. Umndeni kaSbahle Ngcongo (13), obefunda uGrade 5 ePhangisa Primary, uthe uzokhululeka usuthole umbiko kadokotela ohlinze isidumbu ukuthi ngempela uzihilele yini njengoba kungacaci ngokushona kwakhe. USbahle kuvele ukuthi uzihilele kuveranda kubo. UNkk Benzani Ngcongo, onguninakhulu kamufi, uthe badidekile kunzima nokukholwa wukuthi umzukulu uzibulele. Uthe babelungiselela ukuya esontweni ngo-10 ekuseni ngesikhathi salesi sehlo. “Savele sabhocobala esithubeni nje nomzukulu sangabe sisaya esontweni. Sasihleli naye nonina, yena waphuma sanganaka ukuthi uyaphi. Unina waphuma eyombheka emuva kwemizuzwana ephumile umzukulu wamfica kuveranda elele phansi. Entanyeni kwakugaxwe intambo ebesiyisebenzisa uma sineka izingubo kuveranda futhi ihusha phansi kungabonakali ukuthi ubelenga kuyo,” kuchaza uNkk Ngcongo. Uthe okubaxakayo wukuthi ubengalengi futhi nentambo ibingamnsinyile entanyeni. Uveze ukuthi ubesashisa kuphuma igazi ngomlomo nangamakhala. “Sabiza amaphoyisa kwaqinisekiswa ukuthi useshonile. Silinde umbiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu ngoba ubezohlinzwa emakhazeni aseScottburgh. Simuncu isimo ekhaya ngoba ngenyanga edlule besingcwaba ingane enonyaka ebanjwe ugesi khona egcekeni,” kusho uNkk Ngcongo. Unina omncane kamufi, uNksz Nunu Ngcongo, uthe akuvumi akholwe wukuthi uSbahle uzibulele. “Ubeyingane ethulayo futhi ephansi. Akukho nobekukhomnbisa ukuthi kukhona okumphethe kabi. NgeSonto wayewotawota ugogo wakhe izinyawo, bekhuluma ngokuya esontweni. Impela siyokholwa sesithole umbiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu ukuthi uzibulele ngoba kuningi okungasicaceli,” kusho yena. Umndeni uthe awuxabene namuntu endaweni ongamsola ngokwenzekile kodwa kunzima ukukholwa wukuthi ingane izibulele. Kuthiwa eduze kwesidumbu bekungekho ngisho into agibele kuyona njengoba kwenzeka uma umuntu ezilengisa. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe amaphoyisa aseMbumbulu avule idokodo lokufa komuntu emuva kokutholakala kwesidumbu sentombazane ezilengisile. Uthe asikaziwa isizathu sokuzibulala kwengane.

UNXUSE abesifazane ukuthi banake izimpawu zokhwantalala ngisho ezinganeni uSolwazi Sma Magwaza obekhuluma emcimbini Imbokodo YeTheku izolo Isithombe:MOTSHWARI MOFOKENG/ANA UNXUSE abesifazane ukuthi banake izimpawu zokhwantalala ngisho ezinganeni uSolwazi Sma Magwaza obekhuluma emcimbini Imbokodo YeTheku izolo Isithombe:MOTSHWARI MOFOKENG/ANA KUQWASHISWE abesifazane ukuthi basheshe bazibheke izimpawu zokhwantalala ezinganeni, ezingagcina ziholele ekutheni zizibulale. Lokhu kushiwo nguSolwazi Sma Magwaza oyiClinical Psychologist e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, obekhuluma izolo emcimbini ohlelwe Imbokodo YeTheku. USolwazi Magwaza uthe ukhwantalala seluyisifo esiyinkinga kakhulu kuleli futhi uma singanakiwe baningi abazophazamiseka ngokomqondo ngenxa yalo. Uveze ukuthi izifo ezithinta umqondo azinakwa kuleli, sekuyinto ejwayelekile ukubona ophazamiseke ngokomqondo emgwaqweni engasizwa. “Ingane ingashaywa esikoleni kuthiwa ayizwa kanti inokhwantalala. Yingakho kumele kunakwe izinguquko emizweni yomuntu nasemicabangweni yakhe. Uma umuntu eseqala ukungathandi lutho, azibone engelutho kusuke sekuyinkinga. Komunye kusuke sekuwumsebenzi omkhulu ngisho ukuvuka nje abhekane nosuku,” echaza. Ugcizelele ukuthi izingane kumele zifundiswe zisencane ukuxazulula izinkinga ukuze zingaboni ukuzibulala kuyisisombululo. Uveze nokuthi ukwanda kwezigameko zokuzibulala kwezingane kwenziwa ukuthi zibona kuyinto enhle ngoba kuvezwa nakwabezindaba. Uthe ezinye zisebenzisa izidakamizwa ngoba ziziba ukhwantalala. Uthe ukugula ngomqondo okubizwa ngeBipolar kuqala ngokhwantalala olunganakiwe. Uveze nokuthi abesifazane bahlaselwa nawukhwantalala emuva kokubeletha, athe luphatha oyedwa kwabathathu. Unxuse ukuthi bangahlulelwa abantu abanokhwantalala ngoba bangagcina bezibulala. “Sibhekene nenkinga kuleli ngoba bangu-23 abazibulala ngosuku okwenza babe * -8 000 ngonyaka. Abangu-17.6% sebeke bacabanga ukuzibulala. Uma umuntu eseke wazama ukuzibulala kumele asheshe asizwe ngoba usengaphinda azame. Inkinga ukuthi siyamehlulela uma ekade ezama ukuzibulala bese ebona ukuthi akekho oqonda isimo sakhe,” kuchaza uSolwazi Magwaza. UMfundisi Ntebo Mohoto obengomunye wezikhulumi, ugxeke umkhuba wokwenzelana phansi kwabesifazane. Uthe ukuhleba nokugxekana akuhambelani nobuntu.Uveze ukuthi kunabesifazane abangazethembi, abajatshuliswa ukudicilela phansi isithunzi somunye. Inhloso yalo mcimbi bekuwukukhulisana kwabesifazane nokukhumbuzana ngokungamagugu njengoba kuyinyanga yawo.

Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO IMITHETHO eyayishaywe yidlanzana labamhlophe elawula isibalo sabantu abasendaweni ethize yize yayingemihle kodwa yayenza ukuthi kwazeke ukuthi bangaki abantu abahlala kuleyo ndawo, kungafani namanje njengoba sekuyikampunzi edla emini. Lokhu kushiwo yisakhamuzi esidala saKwaMashu uMnuz Obede Mbatha (77) obekhuluma emcimbini wokugubha iminyaka ewu-60, kwasungulwa leli lokishi, izolo, othe kuyadumaza ukuthi manje akekho umuntu ozazi kahle izibalo zabantu abahlala kuleli. UMbatha othe wafika eThekwini ngo-1957, uthe abamhlophe bakha indlela yokuthi kube nesidingo sokuthi abantu abahlala ezabelweni abase besusiwe emihlabeni ababehlala kuyo emihle, babuyele emadolobheni bazosebenza, ngokusungula intela, i-poll tax. “Kwase kumele size emadolobheni siyosebenza ukuze sikhokhe intela. Yize kwakunjalo wawungazingeneli nje edolobheni, kwakukhona KwaMuhle lapho kutholakala khona imvume yokuthi usebenzei,” kusho yena. Uthe ngaphambi kokuthi ayohlala KwaMashu wayehlala eMkhumbane kodwa basuswa kabuhlungu balethwa KwaMashu, bakhelwa izindlu zamapulangwe abathi uma bekhishwa kuzo bafakwa ku-4 room owawuhlala imindeni emibili, kule mizi manje sekuyisesigcemeni sakwa L. “Kule ndawo kwakunepulazi lo mlimi uSir Mashall Campell, abantu epulazini lakhe bagcina sebelinqamulela ngokuthi iKwaMarshall, bagcina sebenqamulela ngokuthi iKwaMashu,” kusho yena. Amakhasimende akhe uma ebuza ukuthi lenyama emnandi kangaka eyani, wayewaphendula ngokuthi eyesinqawunqawu. Sizwe ukuthi izimoto ezisiholelayo zibonakele ziya kwesinye isikhungo kaMkhizwane kodwa zangeza kithina. Size satshelwa wumnikazi wesitolo esihola kuso ukuthi izimoto azisezi,” kusho uNksz Gumede. Uthe uphindele ekhaya elambatha, waxolisa nakumnikazi wemoto abeyiqashile asemkweleta ngenxa yokungaholi. UNksz Gumede uthe kufika usuku lomholo evele eselinde wona ngoba kusuke kungasekho lutho nasendlini. Uthe babuye belambatha nomunye umakhelwane wakhe abahola naye. Okhulumela abakwaSouth African Social Security Agency (Sassa) esifundazweni, uMnuz Mbizeni Mdlalose, uvumile ukuthi kuyaholelwa kulesi sikhungo. Uthe ngokwazi kwakhe abantu bayatshelwa uma kunezinguquko kodwa kulokhu okube yinkinga ukushintsha kosuku lokuhola. Uthe lokhu kudalwe wukuthi sekunosonkontileka omusha oholelayo. “Isikhungo siyaqhubeka nokuholela kodwa kushintshe usuku lokuhola kuphela. Kumele baye esikhungweni ngomhlaka 17 kuyona le nyanga ukuze bahole. Kungenzeka ukuthi abezwanga ngalezi zinguquko zezinsuku zokuhola. Kusekhona abanamakhadi amadala akwaCPS okungenzeka ukuthi bebethenjiswe ukuholelwa yibona. Singeke sikwazi-ke ukungena kulokho,” kusho uMdlalose.

BAYAVEVA abenhlangano elwela abathandana nobulili obufanayo ngezinsolo zokuthi amaphoyisa ashaye abesilisa ababili, bavalelwa esiteshini ngoba becwaswa ngobulili. UMnuz Vincent Nkosi (24) waseChesterville ongumfundi eRegent Business School eThekwini, uthi usahlukumezekile ngenxa yalesi sigameko esenzeke ngoLwesine olwedlule ngasebhishi eThekwini. Wayehamba nomngani wakhe wasePitoli uKgotatso obevakashile ngamaholidi eThekwini. Elandisa ngokwenzeka, uNkosi uthe babezihambela ngasebhishi ngesikhathi kuqhamuka amadoda amabili eza kubona sekukhona akukhipha emaphaketheni. “Indawo esasihamba kuyo ayiphephile, yingakho sacabanga ukuthi yizigebengu ezizosibamba inkunzi. Sabaleka ngokuhlukana nomngani wami, omunye wesilisa weza kimina wazibiza ngephoyisa. Wakhipha isibhamu wabuza ukuthi ngibalekelani engibiza ngesitabane, wangidonsa ngebhande lebhulukwe wangishaya. Wangilalisa phansi emgwaqweni esaqhubeka nokungithuka.” Uthe wabona lona omunye wesilisa esebuya nomngani wakhe embambe ngesidlozana, bobabili bafakwa evenini yamaphoyisa. Uthe bahanjiswe esiteshini samaphoyisa esingumahambanendlwana esisebhishi. “Safica kukhona owesifazane osekhulile kuleli gumbi, bamtshela ukuthi akaphume ukuze basiqondise kahle. Umngani wami unezwi elincane njengowesifazane, bekuthi uma ekhuluma bamthethise bathi akakhulume njengendoda. Umngani wami ucele nokushayela unina ucingo, banqaba bathi nguyena omvumele ukuthi abe yisitabane. Bebelokhu bengishaya ngezimpama, bangibuza nangeselula asesikhwameni sami bethi ngiyintshontshile,” kuchaza uNkosi othe lawa maphoyisa abuza ukuthi ngesikabani isithombe sowesilisa esikwiselula yakhe, wabatshela ukuthi ngesomuntu athandana naye. “Bathi bazongibophela kwakona lokho ukuthi indoda yami ngiyibhangqile ngoba ngihamba nenye indoda. Kwale noma ngibatshela ukuthi uphathina wami uyazi ukuthi ngihamba nomngani wami,” kusho uNkosi. Uthe umngani wakhe udedelwe kuqala esiteshini, yena babuye bamdedela kamumva. Bavule icala lokushaywa nelokucwaswa esiteshini samaphoyisa ePhoyinti. Okhulumela iDurban Lesbian and Gay Community and Health Care uMnuz Sbo Khumalo uthe: “Kuyasidumaza ukuthi sigubha inyanga yenkululeko kodwa kusekhona abantu abangawahloniphi amalungelo abanye. Okusithusa kakhulu ukuthi kuthinteka abantu abazi umthetho. Sizolulandela lolu daba futhi sizocela izeluleko kwikhomishini yamalungelo abantu nakwikhomishini yezokulingana ngobulili ngoba sifuna ubulungiswa,” kusho uKhumalo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni uLieutenant Colonel Thulani Zwane uthe kuphenywa icala lokushaya emuva kokuba abesilisa ababili behlaselwa abasolwa ababafaka evenini yamaphoyisa kodwa ababengawugqokile umfaniswano womsebenzi.

Kungenzeka ukuthi leKhomishini yasungulwa ngoba kuhloswe ukuthi kwembulwe izinqe zikaZuma kodwa manje kubukeka sekuvela nezinqe zabantu abaningi. Ngisho ingane ekhasela eziko iyabona ukuthi kule khomishini kuhujwa inyamazane eyodwa enguZuma kodwa kugcina sekulimala nezinye izinyamazane ngenxa yokuthi abazingeli bazingela ngokushisa umlilo. Lezi gubhu ezishawayo kuthiwe uKhongolose ubumbene ngibona ongathi kusiniswa amahleza ngoba le Khomishini ikuveza obala ukuthi uhlakazeke phakathi okwamaqhezu ezinqe. OkaVolos uthi le Khomishini kaZondo ifana nomgangela wezinsizwa nezintokazi zikaKhongolose okufanele umiswe ngokushesha ngoba kuyofikwa okhethweni sekukhishwene amehlo abanye bengasanamazinyo. Kuyishwa ukuthi amalungu ka-ANC abukeka engaboni ukuthi ukuyofakaza kule Khomishini kufana nokuthatha intambo uzikhunge ngoba ugcine usungene wavela ngesicoco. Ubufakazi bale nto engiyishoyo kube yisehlo esehlele uNhlanhla Nene osukwe wusinga wayokwethula ubufakazi kodwa wagcina eselahlekelwa yisikhundla sokuba uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali. UMatamela kufanele ngabe usebonile ukuthi umuntu oyofakaza kule Khomishini usuke eqiqinge umgqomo kadoti eyowuchitha ngenhloso yokungcolisa abathile. Inkinga isekutheni ngesikhathi uchitha udoti uthi ungcolisa abantu ugcina nawe sewungcoliswe yilo doti owuchithayo. Bakwethu, mina nginovalo lokuthi ngelinye ilanga noZuma uyosukwa yikhanda lakhe aqiqinge amanabukeni angcolile kaKhongolose ayowachitha kule Khomishini kaZondo kuhayize abantu. MaSolezwe, ngiyazi uVolos waziwa njengesibhedi kodwa mina angikuboni ukubheda uma kungathiwa le Khomishini kaZondo imiswe okwesikhashana ngenxa yokushoda kwezimali. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi kuyosuka umsindo kube nemibuzo yokuthi imiswe kanjani iKhomishini isanda kuqala umsebenzi wayo. Ngibona ungcono umsindo wokuthi iKhomishini ibanjwe ngophondo kunokuthi idedelwe igabavule, iveze amahlazo kube kubhekwe okhethweni. - Ngeso likaVolovolo
BANGASE babhekane nezimbila zithutha abasolwa ngobutabane abazohambela umhlangano wamaNazaretha, aseBuhleni kaJulayi njengoba sekusabalele amahlebezi okuthi bazothelwa isibhaxu uma beke bafika. Amalungu aleli bandla okuthiwa adinwe ayaveva ngezitabane okuthiwa uma zisemhlanganweni noma entabeni zisuke zize emfuleni wokweshela, noma ziye ocansini nezithandana nabo, ahlanganise uhla lwamalungu lwabasolwa ngokuba yizitabane athi kumele bathelwe induku uma befikile. Abanye kulaba abakulo luhla kuthiwa bathatha amantombazane nabafana babathembise ukuthi bazokwelashwa njengoba kuzobe kuzokhulekwa, uma sebefike babajikele babanukubeze. Kulolu hla kukhona amagama abesilisa nabesifazane, nemininingwane yokuthi baphuma kweziphi izindawo. Lolu hla lubhalwe ukuthi ‘Sikhipha isitabane eBuhleni, ingqikithi kaJulayi” bese kulandela amagama alabo abasolwa ngobutabane. Lolu luhla Isolezwe elinalo lusatshalaliswa emalungeni ebandla ngema-SMS noma ngoWhatsapp kodwa okhulumela leli bandla, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe ubengakezwa ngalo. NgoJanuwari abasolwa ngokuthi bayizitababane bathola isibhaxu, entabeni, iKhenani. Umthombo waleli phephandaba ongaphakathi uthe abasunguli balolu hla badinwe ukuthi cishe wonke amasonto kubikwa izigigaba okuthiwa zenziwe ngabasolwa ngobutabane emathempeleni, abazigqajayo ngokuthi baningi futhi bona banemali. “Abanye abantu abasolwa ngobutabane abakhokheli, abafundisi nabanye abantu abanezikhundla ebandleni. Basolwa ngokuthi basebenzisa izikhundla zabo ukubiza abagilwa,” usho kanje. UMncwabe uthe ibandla labo alibandlululi futhi abababuzi abantu abangalungu abo ngesikhathi bebhabhadiswa ukuthi baphila yiphi impilo. “Uma eyinhlalisuthi simthatha njengomuntu wesilisa kanjalo nowesifazane uma egqoka isiketi simthatha njengowesifazane. Siyazi ukuthi phakathi ebandleni bakhona abaya ocansini nabanobulili obufana nobabo kodwa lokhu akuvunyelwe ukuthi kwenziwe esontweni ngoba nabashadikazi abavunyelwe ukuya ocansini ngesikhathi somhlangano ngoba le ndawo ngeyokuthandaza,” kusho yena. UMnuz Willington Myeni womkhandlu ovikela ukuhlukunyezwa kwamaNazaretha, iNazareth Judiciary Council, uvumile ukuthi lolu hla uke walubona wathi kodwa bayaphenya. “Ukushaywa kwabantu esontweni akuvumelekile, abayitabane kumele bazi ukuthi njengoba besebandleni lamaNazaretha kumele balandele imigomo ebekiwe,” usho kanje.

UYOKHANGISA ngamawashi embukisweni waseLondon uMnuz Lunga Ntuli weLN Watches, obhala nezincwadi zothando Isithombe:SITHUNYELWE UYOKHANGISA ngamawashi embukisweni waseLondon uMnuz Lunga Ntuli weLN Watches, obhala nezincwadi zothando Isithombe:SITHUNYELWE INDODA ehlobisa amawashi ngobuhlau ithole ithuba lokuthi iyokhangisa ngawo embukisweni eLondon. Umbhali wezincwadi, uMnuz Lunga Ntuli, wakwaDukuza, umenywe ukuyokhangisa ngamawashi elebula yakhe ebizwa ngeLN Watches. Umenywe kwi-Africa Fashion Week London (AFWL) ngo-Agasti 9-10. Kulo mbukiso waminyaka yonke kuhlangana abakhangisi bengqephu bamazwe ahlukene bezokhombisa ngethalente labo. Umbukiso usuvulele osomabhizinisi abaningi emkhakheni wemfashini ithuba lokukhula kulo mkhakha. Ukumenywa kukaNtuli kuqhamuke emuva kokuba abohlaka lwezohwebo nokutshalwa kwezimali esifundazweni bebone umsebenzi wakhe. Umsebenzi wakhe bawubona kwezinye zezimakethe ezikhangisa ngomsebenzi esifundazweni. “Ngijabule kakhulu ukuthola ithuba ngoba bekuvele kuyiphupho lami ukuthi umsebenzi wami ufinyelele nakwamanye amazwe. Ukuya kwi-AFWL kuzosiza nokuthi ngazi kabanzi ngomkhakha wemfashini. Umbono omkhulu wukukhulisa ilebula yami, ngingagcini ngamawashi kuphela,” kusho uNtuli. UNtuli, owaqala ilebula ngo-2016, uke wenza nezikhwama kodwa kazihambanga ngendlela abefisa ngayo. Nokho usebona kuyithuba lokuthi abuyele nakuzona njengoba ekholwa wukuthi kuningi azokuthola kulo mbukiso. Uthe icebo lamawashi laqala ngoba uyathanda ukuqhakambisa okwesintu. Usebenzisana nabanye abesifazane abenza umsebenzi wezandla, asebenza nabo. Uzimisele ukwakha ubudlelwano nezitolo zaseLondon, athe ziningi ezidayisa izimpahla zase-Afrika. UNtuli, osebhale izincwadi ezine zothando, uthe ubuhlalu buyindlela yokuxoxa ngezothando. Uthe ubone ukuthi bukhona ubudlelwano phakathi kwezindaba zothando abhala ngazo nobuhlalu ngoba vele nasemandulo bekusetshenziswa bona uma kushelwa. Umbukiso waseLondon wasungulwa nguNkk Ronke Ademiluyi waseNigeria kodwa ozalelwe e-England. Wasungulwa ngo-2011 ukukhombisa ithalente labantu base-Afrika kwezemfashini nokuvulela amathuba abasiki bengqephu nosomabhizinisi base-Afrika kwamanye amazwe. Uphiko lwezohwebo nokutshalwa kwezimali KwaZulu-Natal lwasungulwa ukusiza izinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika nosomabhizinisi abancane ukuthi bazidayise kwamanye amazwe. Luphinde lukhuthaze nokuthuthukiswa komnotho wesifundazwe nokuvulela amathuba osomabhizinisi besifundazwe.

"Ngemuva kokwenza uphenyo ngaphakathi nangaphandle komuzi wakhe, amaphoyisa athole enye imali ewumkokotelo engalinganiselwa ku-R105 900 ifakwe kuplastiki omnyama ifihlwe endlini yangasese," kusho uXuma. Uthe isiyonke imali eshaqwe amaphoyisa ihlanganise u-R107 300. Uthe le ndoda ibhekene necala lokuphatha imali engekho emthethweni kanti kulindeleke ukuthi ivele enkantolo yemantshi yaseBotshabelo maduze. UKhomishana wamaphoyisa eFree State uLieutenant General Moeketsi Sempe unxuse abanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali amakhasimende athenga ngayo isemthethweni.

OWESIFAZANE wasesigodini eNdluzeleni emaChunwini, eMsinga, uthi uxoshiswe okwenja enethile emzini wakhe, ngesikhathi ezozila njengoba eshonelwe wumyeni. UNkz Zandile Mchunu (42) oshadele kwaNgubane kodwa obiza isibongo sakubo, uthi uxoshwe ngesikhathi eyozilela umnyeni wakhe uMnuz Vusi Ngubane (44) oshone emuva kokuzidubula ngoMsumbuluko emzini wabo. Umkamufi uthi wahamba kwakhe ngoJanuwari nezingane zakhe ezimbili waya eGoli. Uthi wayeyophumuza ikhanda ngoba umufi ubemhlukumeza emshaya ngesibhamu. Uveze ukuthi wamazisa u-anti wakhe wasemzini ngokuhlukumezeka kwakhe kodwa waqhubeka nokumhlukumeza. NgokukaNksz Mchunu, ngesikhathi eyopholisa ikhanda eGoli, wayezitshela ukuthi uzoshintsha umyeni wakhe, azisole kodwa lutho. Eseshonile umyeni wakhe uthi ngoLwesibili yena nodadewabo baya kobona emzini, waxoshwa. Uthi isono sakhe esiholele ekutheni axoshwe, wukuthi uveze iqiniso ngomyeni wakhe ukuthi akazalwa kwaNgubane. “Umyeni wami esaphila wacela ukuthi uma eseshonile akothintwa abantu bakwaMbatha, okuyisibongo sakhe sangempela. Badinwe bagana unwabu abakwaNgubane ngibatshela lokhu, bangixosha. “Iningi labo angilazi, bengiqala ukulibona selokhu ngagana kulo muzi,” kusho uNksz Mchunu. Ukhale nangokuthi usephucwa nendodakazi yakhe endala eyahamba ngonyaka odlule iyofunda uGrade 8 ku-anti wayo. “Ayisangifuni nalapho ngihambe khona. Uma ngiqhamuka iyabaleka, ize yajahwa kodwa yangavuma ukuza kimina. “Asazi nokuthi sizoya kanjani emngcwabeni. Sizibona singaphephile uma siya,” esho ekhihla isililo. UMnuz Lucky Ngubane (68) othe unguyise kamufi, uthe basashaqekile ngalesi sigameko futhi akuvumi ngisho akhulume. Uthe umakoti abamxoshanga kodwa uzihambele ngoba bebefuna ukwazi ukuthi ubekuphi ngesikhathi indodana yakhe izibulala. Uthe yena ubazi ukuthi umufi uganiwe. Umngani kamufi ocele ukuthi angadalulwa, uthe umufi ubehlala ekhala ngokuthi umoya wakhe ukhubekile ngokuhamba kwenkosikazi yakhe. Uthi ubesesaba nokuphumela emphakathini, ebona sengathi abantu bayamhleka futhi nemfuyo yakhe izolahleka njengoba naye engahlali ekhaya ehlala emsebenzini. Uqhube wathi umufi wafika ngoLwesihlanu ecele izinsuku ezimbili emsebenzini. Uthi ngoMgqibelo wazivalela endlini belokhu bemduduza. Wagcina ukuxoxa naye ngeSonto, kwathi ngoMsombuluko ngezikhathi zamadina, wayombheka, wamemeza, wangasabela. Uveze ukuthi wazama ukuvula umnyango wamfica esebanda, enenxeba enhliziyweni negazi selomile, kukhona incwadi eceleni kwakhe, echazayo ukuthi kungani ezibulele. Umndeni wakwaMbatha uthe umufi ubeyindodana yawo, wahlatshelwa nembuzi engeniswa ngokusemthethweni kodwa akukho abangakwenza uma abakwaNgubane bethi bazomngcwaba. Bathe umakoti nguyena ozothatha isinqumo sokuthi uzoqhubeka nasiphi isibongo.
ANGASE azithole esobishini uMnuz Albert Mncwango oyiMeya yaKwaNongoma ovulelwe icala lokwesabisa Isithombe:SIGCINIWE ANGASE azithole esobishini uMnuz Albert Mncwango oyiMeya yaKwaNongoma ovulelwe icala lokwesabisa Isithombe:SIGCINIWE IVULELWE icala lokwesabisa iMeya kaMasipala waKwaNongoma uMnuz Albert Mncwango emuva komsindo oqubuke kulo masipala mayelana nethenda yonogada okuthiwa isinikwe enye inkampani. Kuthiwa kunqanyulwe inkontileka yeMighty B Security kwafakwa i-Eros Security. UMnuz Zwelethu Mbhele (49) oyinhloko yonogada abephucwe ithenda usola uMncwango ngokumesabisa nokwenze wagcina esemthathele izinyathelo zomthetho. UMbhele uthi emuva kokuba bephucwe ithenda kwabe sekukhangiswa kabusha naye wahamba ethi uyofaka isicelo senkampani yabo. “Ngafika kwathiwa ugesi awukho, ngeke bakwazi ukugaya amaphepha ngalinda khona emahhovisi kamasipala. Kwaqhamuka izimoto zikaMncwango, wehla waqonda kimi wangisongela wathi ngimthukile uzongikhombisa abantu. Wathi ngeke avume yena ukudlala mina, uzongifundisa isifundo ungowakwaMncwango yena," kusho uMbhele. Ethintwa uMncwango ngalolu daba uvele wafa yinsini, wathi ayikho yonke le nto eshiwo uMbhele. “Lo muntu waqala ngokwesabisa imenenja kamasipala, wangethuka ehamba ethi kubantu ufuna ukungibona. Ngesikhathi ngiya kuye ngangimnika ithuba lokungibona nokukhuza ukuthi ahlukane nokusabisa abasebenzi ngoba sekwake kwabulawa omunye umsebenzi lapha singazi kanjani," kusho uMncwango. Ukhale nangokuthi uMbhele wayefika ephethe isibhamu emahhovisi nokwakubonakala kuyingozi. “Akuvumelekile ukungena nesibhamu emahhovisi kamasipala kodwa yena ubegcaluza nesibhamu esabisa nabasebenzi benkampani entsha ethi uzoke abone ukuthi bazosebenza kanjani. Ngaze ngabikela abaphathi bakhe ngalolu daba," kuqhuba uMncwango Uthe uyabona ukuthi enye into ekhalisa uMbhele ukuphucwa ithenda. UMbhele umile kwelokuthi uMncwango wamesabisa futhi kufanele ashushiswe ngalokho.

UKHALA uyazithulisa owesilisa wasePort Shepstone owayevakashele umngani wakhe eThekwini, othi wabanjwa inkunzi waphucwa uR1 100 nguscabha etekisini yaseSouth Beach. UMnuz Christ Cele, uthe wayeyohlangana nomngani wakhe, wagibela itekisi ngo-5.30 ekuseni, esekhokha kuscabha owayeqoqa imali kwabanye abagibeli wabe esekhonjwa ngommese yilo sicabha, wathatha yonke imali yakhe. “Ngakhipha imali ngithi ngiyakhokha, umfana wayithatha imali kubo bonke abagibeli. Ube esesondela eduze kwami wakhipha ummese wathi angikhiphe yonke imali engiyiphethe. Wathatha uR1 100 obusekhukhwini lami. Bekunabagibeli kule tekisi, kuthe noma ngizama ukukhala ngangasizwa muntu, umshayeli naye wavele wayishaya yazula, wangamnaka. Kuthe uma ima itekisi umfana wehla, wabaleka. Obehlezi eduze kwami wazikhalela ngokuthi naye ubesaba ukuthi uzomphuca eyakhe imali uma engilekelela,” kusho uCele. Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi umshayeli akazange amlekelele, kunalokho waba nezaba wathi akamazi lo scabha, wathi ubehamba yedwa, engenamsizi. “Umshayeli waba umuntu ongayingeni indaba yami, wathi akagadi abagibeli yena. Ngasala dengwane ngingasenalutho, ngihlukumezekile ngalesi sigameko. Ngifuna ubulungiswa,” kusho uCele. UMnuz Vusi Msani, wososeshini baseSouth Beach, uthe babikelwe ngalesi sigameko. “Ngashayelwa ucingo umshayeli engitshela ukuthi kunomgibeli okhala ngokuthi ubanjwe inkunzi esetekisini waphucwa uR1 100, kunabagibeli phakathi. Ngathi abaye esiteshini samaphoyisa bavule icala, baveza ukuthi amaphoyisa anqabile ukulivula icala umshayeli ehamba yedwa, bafuna ophucwe imali. Umgibeli ubevele eseyile kolivula icala. “Sibe sesicela lo mgibeli ukuthi eze ekomitini lethu elibheka izikhalazo zabagibeli, elihlangana njalo ngoLwesine kodwa wangafika lo mgibeli. Besifuna ukuthola okwenzeka njengoba osicabha bengasekho nhlobo lapha eSouth Beach, bamiswa ngoNovemba 1 ngonyaka odlule,” kusho uMsani. Uthe lolu daba bazolulandela. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe baphenya icala lokubanjwa inkunzi komgibeli esetekisini. “Ngokophenyo esilwenzayo umgibeli ngoFebhuwari 16 nonyaka, ngo-5.30 ekuseni wabanjwa inkunzi egibele itekisi, umsolwa wayehlezi ngasemnyango. Wamkhomba ngommese, wathatha imali yakhe. Icala lokubanjwa inkunzi livulwe esiteshini saseDurban Central, uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lusaqhubeka,” kusho uCol. Mbele. Imenenja ehhovisi leSantaco eKZN uMnuz Sfiso Shangase, uthe bayezwelana nalo mgibeli, wanxusa ukuba abagibeli beqikelele uma begibele amatekisi ukuthi bayazigada izimpahla zabo ngoba abanye abasuke begibele nabo basuke bengaziwa. Uthe bazolulandelela lolu daba.
BAFUNA ukuba nefemu yabo esikoleni abafundi baseGratton High eShowe, uMinenhle Morris noNoxolo Mthethwa, abakhiqiza ujamu abawine ngawo emncintiswaneni eGoli. Bathathwe nothisha wabo uNksz Busi Dlamini BAFUNA ukuba nefemu yabo esikoleni abafundi baseGratton High eShowe, uMinenhle Morris noNoxolo Mthethwa, abakhiqiza ujamu abawine ngawo emncintiswaneni eGoli. Bathathwe nothisha wabo uNksz Busi Dlamini Abafundi baseGratton High, babuye nendondo emncintiswaneni ohlelwa ngabakwa-Eskom ne-Education With Enterprise Trust (EWIT) eGoli. Abaphume isibili ezikoleni ezintathu ebezingenele KwaZulu-Natal, bebeyokwethula iSnempilo Jam, okuwujamu abazenzele wona. Lesi sikole besimelwe wuMinenhle Morris noNoxolo Mthethwa abafunda uGrade 11, abenza iBusiness Studies. Uthisha wabo obebaphelezele, uNksz Busi Dlamini, ofundisa zona lezi zifundo, uthe bavele banenhlangano abazisungulele yona esikoleni, enabafundi abangu-16. Inhlangano yabo yakhetha iKing Dinuzulu Pre-School, ukulekelela izingane zakhona ngezidingo. “Isu lokwenza ujamu laqala ngokuthi abafundi bami bebevakashela le nkulisa abayisizayo, bebheka nomphako wezingane. Bathole ukuthi izingane eziningi ziphatha umphako ongenayo impilo ngenxa yokuthi abazali kabanayo imali. Izingane eziningi ziphatha ujamu, ongalungile ngenxa yoshukela omningi,” kuchaza uNksz Dlamini. Uthe baqale ukungenela umncintiswano ekuqaleni konyaka, baphuma isibili ezikoleni zesifundazwe. Emncintiswaneni bekudingeka bakhombise amakhono amabhizinisi ngokuthi benze umkhiqizo ongavula amathuba kulo mkhakha, udale namathuba omsebenzi. UNksz Dlamini uthe bakhethe ukwenza lo jamu abawuxube nenhlaba ne-cucumber. Okwenza uhluke ukuthi wenziwe ngezithako zemvelo futhi kawunawo ushukela omningi. Uthe abafundi yibona abaqhamuke nombono kodwa basizwa ngabanye abantu ngaphandle kwesikole njengoba bekudingeka nolwazi lwezolimo. UNksz Dlamini uthe isikole sakhiwe eduze kwezindlu zomxhaso lapho kunomphakathi oswele. “Asifuni ukuthi sigcine ngokuwina kulo mncintiswano. Isifiso esikhulu wukuthola uxhaso ukuze sibe nefemu yokukhiqiza ujamu wethu, kudaleke namathuba omsebezi emphakathini,” kuchaza uNksz Dlamini. Mayelana nomsebenzi owenziwa ngabafundi abazisungulele inhlangano esikoleni, uthe kule nkulisa abayikhethile bavakashela izingane bazisize ngomsebezi wesikole. Babuye bazenzele amasemishi anempillo, bazihambisele. Umncintiswano uqale ngoDisemba 3 eGoli, abafundi babuya ngoLwesine olwedlule. UNksz Dlamini uncome ukuzikhandla nobuhlakani kubafundi bakhe, athe bakhombisa nogqozi lokuba ngosomabhizinisi.
OWAYEYILUNGU lePhalamende eBritain uLord Peter Hain obefakaza kwikhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. Isithombe: Dimpho Maja African News Agency (ANA) OWAYEYILUNGU lePhalamende eBritain uLord Peter Hain obefakaza kwikhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. Isithombe: Dimpho Maja African News Agency (ANA) OWAYEYILUNGU lePhalamende eBritain uLord Peter Hain, ugxeke izinhlangano zemali ngokuvumela abomndeni wakwaGupta ukuba bafake imali engekho emthethweni emazweni ahlukene okwenza kwaba lula ukulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. Efakaza ngoMsombuluko uHain utshele iKhomishini kaZondo ukuthi ngeke kwagxekwa uhlangothi olulodwa ngoba amabhange nezinkampani zokuxhumanisa umphakathi ezaba nesandla ekutheni umndeni wakwaGupta uthumele imali yawo ezindaweni ezehlukeni ezweni jikelele. “Ukuze kube yimpumelelo ukulawulwa kombuso yindlanzana, kwahlangana izinkampani ezisemazweni ahlukene zezimali nezinye izinhlangano nabanye bohulumeni bamazwe.” Ukugqamisile ukuthi amabhange amazwe angaphandle njengelaseBritain iHSBC neStandard Chartered, asetshenziswa kakhulu oGupta ukusabalalisa imali. UHain akabashiyanga ngaphandle abameli, abacwaningi mabhuku nabadayisa izindlu athi babasiza abakwaGupta ukuba bayigeze imali eyayingekho emthethweni. Wenze isibonelo ngenkampani yabacwaningi mabhuku iKPMG athi yayicwaninga amabhuku akwaGupta. Umshado wakaGupta ongundabuzekwayo owawuse-Sun City ngo-2012, uvela emabhukwini ezimali zalo mndeni ukuthi kwakungumsebenzi webhizinisi ekubeni lokho kwakungelona iqiniso. Uthe umndeni wakwaGupta wasebenzisa imali eyayitholakale ohlelweni lweVrede Dairy Farm ukwenza isiphihli somshado Izinhlangano ezithintekayo zazingasheshe zikubambe ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngendlela okwakungena ngayo nokuphuma kwemali kodwa zathula.
Ernestina Nkabinde Ernestina Nkabinde USENKINGENI owesifazane waseManzimtoti onezincwadi zomshado ezikhomba ukuthi ushade namadoda amabili. UNkk Ernestina Nkabinde owumfelokazi ka-Edward Muziwenkosi Masinga owashona engozini yemoto ngo-1990, usola uMnyango wezaseKhaya ngokuthi ngemuva kokushona komyeni wakhe wanikeza enye indoda enegama, isibongo nosuku lokuzalwa okufanayo nokomyeni wakhe inombolo kamazisi yomyeni wakhe, maqede ‘wamshadisa’ nayo le ndoda, ekubeni yena wabuye washada noMnuz Duncan Themba Nkabinde ngo-1997. Le nkilayitheka uthe uyizwe ngo-2015 ngesikhathi eshayelwa ucingo yibhange lithi uMasinga uyalikweleta njengoba beshade umshado ohlanganisa amafa kanti kumele azokhokha, kungenjalo ibhange lizodla imoto yakhe. “Ngabatshela ukuthi uMasinga washona. Bathi ngokolwazi abanalo uyaphila baze bangikhombisa umazisi afaka ngawo isicelo sokuboleka imali. Kulapho ngabona khona isithombe esifakwe kulo mazisi ngabona ukuthi ngesomunye umuntu.” Uthe waya eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya eSiphingo bamkhomba enhlokohhovisi eMgungundlovu. Kwathiwa akazibhekele ifayela lomyeni wakhe ngoba ngaleso sikhathi izitifiketi zazingakenziwa ngekhompyutha. Walithola ifayela, wafaka isikhalo ecela ukuthi lo mnyango ‘umbulale’ umyeni okuvela ukuthi usadla anhlamvana. “Akekho owake wangishayela ucingo engazisa ukuthi kwenzekani. Kwathuleka ngaze ngabuyela emahhovisi ngonyaka olandelayo. Ngatshelwa ukuthi ngeke bakwazi ukumesula umyeni ngoba inombolo yakhe isetshenziswa ngomunye umuntu ophilayo ohlala eGoli. Uma ngibuza ukuthi kwenziwa yini ukuthi lo Masinga ophilayo naye ashade nami, uma kungabantu abehlukene, abakwazanga ukungiphendula. Ngabuza ukuthi kuzokwenzekani uma kushona oyedwa wethu nakhona ayiphumanga impendulo.” Uthe wanikwa inombolo yasePitoli kwathiwa akashayele khona ucingo abuze ukuthi kwenzekani ngalolu daba. Uma eshaya ucingo bathi akukho abakwenzayo akabuyele lapho afaka khona isikhalo, baqale phansi. Akuchazwa ukuthi yini eyinkinga. “Ehhovisi eliseMgungundlovu nabo bangikhomba ePitoli, angisazi ukuthi kumele ngenze njani. Kwenziwa yini umnyango ungibhalise imishado emibili kodwa wehluleke ukulungisa iphutha? Kanti lo mazisi wadayiswa yini?” Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, uMasinga ophilayo uhlala eKlerksdorp, wafaka isicelo sikamazisi ngo-1992. Akucaci ukuthi washada nini noNkk Nkabinde okubuye kuvele ukuthi ushade noNkabinde ngo-1997. UMnuz Thabo Mokgola wehhovisi lomnyango lezokuxhumana kuzwelonke uthe lolu daba uludlulisela kwimenenja yalo mnyango eKZN uMnuz Cyril Mncwabe ukuthi aluphenye.

Umkhuleko uzoqala ngo-10 ekuseni kanti wonke umuntu uvumelekile.

UNKK Nokubonga Mnyango elele phezu kwezigubhu eziqoqwa emiphakathini zidayiswe ukuze ziphinde zisetshenziswe UNKK Nokubonga Mnyango elele phezu kwezigubhu eziqoqwa emiphakathini zidayiswe ukuze ziphinde zisetshenziswe ABANTU abaningi bayakujabulela ukubizwa ngamagama amahle ahambisana nezikhundla abaziphethe emsebenzini, ikakhulukazi uma beqashwe yizinkampani ezinkulu kodwa owesifazane waseNgwelezane washiya umsebenzi wokuba wumabhalane wakhetha ukuqoqa udoti emigwaqweni. UNkk Nokubonga Mnyango abanye abambiza ngoBabes Kadoti, uthi akumkhathazi lokhu ngoba vele udoti uyawuthanda futhi akaligqizi qakala iphunga elibi elithaphuka kuwo. UNkk Mnyango ungumsunguli wenkampani uThando Recyclers, le nkampani uthi ikhuthaza umphakathi ukuthi ungawulahli budedengu udoti, iphinde ukhuthaze wona umphakathi ukuthi uzenzele imali ngokuqoqa udoti osengabuye usetshenziswe ngokuthi uwudayise. Le nkampani uthi uyisungule ngemuva kokuthi ebone ukuthi kanti udoti uyimali. Lokhu uthi wakubona ngesikhathi ethunywe enkampanini abeyisebenzela ukuthi ayodayisa amaplastiki asesebenzile asetshenziswa yile nkampani ukuhlola ukuthi izingodo ezidayisayo ziswakeme kangakanani, ngo-2014 “Bekungakhethwa ukuthi ngubani othunywa ukuthi ayodayisa oplastiki, ngo-2014 kwathunywa mina, ngathatheka uma ngibona ukuthi kanti udoti unemali ngabuye ngabuza nokuthi kungani bewuthenga bangitshela ukuthi bakwenzela ukuthi kongiwe imvelo. “Uthando lwami lokonga imvelo lwaqala lapho, angibange ngisachitha sikhathi ngaqala ngaqoqa udoti ngawubeka egcekeni lami ngaphambi kokuthi ngiye emsebenzini. Kwabaningi ukuqoqa izigubhu, amabhodlela, amathini namaphepha kwakubukeka njengokuhlanya,” kusho yena. Lo mcabango womakhelwane uthe waqina kakhulu ngesikhathi eseyeka umsebenzi enza lo msebenzi ngokugcwele ngo-2015. Imali ayithola emsebenzini uthe wathenga iveni elidala waliqamba ngokuthi “money maker”. Ngawo lowo nyaka wangenela umncintiswano owawuhlelwe uMkhandlu uMhlathuze, iResponsible Tourism Challenge, emunxeni oqondene nokuqoqwa kukadoti. Wawina isikali asisebenzisela ukukala udoti, okwamsiza ukuthi avule isikhungo esizothenga amabhodlela, izigubhu namaphepha emphakathini. “Ngo-2017 kwavuleka elinye ithuba ngangena ngaphansi kohlelo lwakaCoca-Cola Beverages SA (CCBSA) olukhuthaza ukuthi abafundi baqoqe udoti ikakhulukazi izigubhu, amabhodlela namaphepha. Ngathola izikole ezingu-14 engazifaka kulolu hlelo, zenza umsebenzi oncomekayo okwaholela ekutheni ngichonywe uphaphe lwegwalagwala, emncintiswaneni iBusiness Women of the Year ohlelwa yiyo iCCBSA,” kusho yena.

SIKHULU isililo ngokubulawa kwevolontiya le-ANC laseMfume ebeligqugquzela ukuvota. Kuthiwa uMnuz Nqobizwe Mkhize (46) waseSimahleni, eMfume uhlaselwe abalisa abangaziwa abathathu elele nomkakhe ezintatha kuzosa kube nguMgqibelo. Kuleya ndawo kuphinde kwabulawa abalisa ababili, uMnuz Sibonelo Hlongwane noMnuz Nathi Hlengwa abatholakale bedindilize emgwaqweni buqamama nalapho okuhlala khona uMkhize. Kuthiwa laba balisa bangene batshela umkakhe okhulelwe ukuthi akamboze angababuki base bedubula uMkhize kaningana. Kuthiwa izinhlamvu ezintathu zingene ekhanda. Okhulumela amaphoyisa uCaptain Nqobile Gwala uthe amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amathathu okubulala. “Kukholakala ukuthi kuthe uma kugamanxa ihora lesibili ekuseni kwatheleka abasolwa abathathu abebehlome ngezibhamu, bakhahlela isicabha bangena kwaMkhize bamdubula. Udubuleke amahlandla amaningi kwesingenhla. Isizathu sokubulawa kwakhe asikaziwa,” kusho uCaptain Gwala. Isigameko sesibili kukholakala ukuthi senzeke ngaphambi kwehora lesithathu lapho okuhlaselwe khona uHlongwane noHlengwa abadutshulwe abalisa abangaziwa abebehamba ngemoto. Lesi sigameko senzeke emuva kokubulawa kukaMkhize. UCaptain Gwala uthe laba balisa bashonele endaweni yesigameko. Uthe isizathu sokubulawa kwabo asikaziwa. Ikhansela lakuleya ndawo, uMnuz Ayanda Ndlovu, lichaze uMkhize njengomuntu obezinikele emsebenzini weqembu nasekusizeni umphakathi. Uthe nguye obenikwe umsebenzi wokugqugquzela abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota. “Ubengumuntu obethandwa kakhulu wumphakathi. Silahlekelwe njengeqembu nomphakathi ngoba ubezinikele futhi esebenzisa ngisho imali yakhe ukwenza imisebenzi yeqembu. Kubuhlungu kakhulu okwenzekile. Sishaqekile nangokubulawa kukaHlongwane noHlengwa abatholakale befile. Sinxusa noma ubani ongaba nolwazi ukuthi asebenzisane namaphoyisa ukuze kutholakale izigilamkhuba,” kusho uNdlovu. UNdlovu uthe inkosikazi kaMkhize okulindeleke ukuthi ibelethe kule nyanga isesimeni esingesihle ngokomphefumulo ngenxa yokubulawa komyeni wayo ibhekile. UMxhumanisi wekomiti lesikhashana le-ANC KwaZulu-Natal Mnuz Sihle Zikalala uthe bashaqekile ngesigameko esenzeke kuleya ndawo. Uthe banethemba lokuthi amaphoyisa azosebenza kanzima ukuthola abathintakayo. Izolo uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele uye kuleya ndawo eyokhuluma nomphakathi. UCele uthembise amalungu omphakathi ukuthi amaphoyisa azophenya ngesigameko sokubulawa kwalaba bobathathu. Uqhube wathi amaphoyisa azophenya nangamacala osekunesikhathi engaphothulwa. Elinye lalamacala uthe ngelokubulawa kowayengunozinti wePirates neqembu lesizwe, uSenzo Meyiwa, elisahlalise kabuhlungu izihlobo zakhe nomphakathi wonkana. “Sicele umphakathi ukuthi usebenzisane namaphoyisa uphinde ubike amaphoyisa angenzi kahle kodwa uthi uwabika nawo ube ukhumbula ukuthi akhona amaphoyisa enza kahle nokufanele usebenzisane nawo,” kusho uCele. Uthe uxoxe nenkosi yendawo wathola ukuthi lesi sigameko kungenzeka ukuthi asihlobene nezepolitiki. Noma kunjalo uCele unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi asebenze kanzima ukuthola abenzi bobubi ngisho kungathiwa abantu abaphezulu.

UPHINDE wamemezela ezinye izigidi zokuxhasa intsha engosomabhizinisi uNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, obethula isabelozimali sehhovisi lakhe izolo UPHINDE wamemezela ezinye izigidi zokuxhasa intsha engosomabhizinisi uNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, obethula isabelozimali sehhovisi lakhe izolo SIPHINDE safakelwa ezinye izigidi isikhwama okuhloswe ngaso ukusiza intsha enamabhizinisi KwaZulu-Natal, esethulwa ekuqaleni konyaka. Lesi sikhwama esibizwa ngeKZN Youth Fund sethulwa nguNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Sihle Zikalala ngoJanuwari. Ethula isabelozimali sehhovisi lakhe izolo, undunankulu umemezele ukuthi kuzokwengezwa uR50 million kulesi sikhwama. Ngesikhathi sethulwa ngoJanuwari, uZikalala waveza ukuthi wuR50 million obekelwe lesi sikhwama. Emuva kokwethulwa kwaso kwabuye kwaba nesidlo sasekuseni nabanye osomabhizinisi abanikele ngoR20 million, okwenze isikhwama saba uR70 million. Kumanje isikhwama sesinoR120 million. Ekhuluma eSishayamthetho sesifundazwe izolo uZikalala, uthe basabafuna abanye osomabhizinisi abazimele abazonikela kulesi sikhwama. “Siyazi ukuthi kunokuhlobana phakathi kosomabhizinisi nokudaleka kwamathuba omsebenzi. Lesi sikhwama esesinguR120 million sizosiza intsha engosomabhizinisi, ezovulela nabanye amathuba omsebenzi. Siyakujabulela ukuthi ibhange i-Absa selibeke eceleni uR70 million ozosiza intsha efuna ukuboleka imali noR500 million wamabhizinisi amancane,” kusho uZikalala. Uthe basazibophezele ukuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi esifundazweni nokudala amathuba omsebenzi. Uveze ukuthi kulindeleke ukuthi lesi sikhwama senyuke njengoba kusekhona izingxoxo nabanye osomabhizinisi abazimele. UZikalala uthe ithimba lokuqala lentsha elifake izicelo zokuhlomula kulesi sikhwama, lizokwethulwa ngenyanga ezayo. Ngesikhathi ethula isikhwama ngoJanuwari, undunankulu wagcizelela ukuthi sizohlomulisa kuphela amabhizinisi angeke aphele endleleni. Uthe kuzoxhaswa amabhizinisi azokwazi ukudala amathuba omsebenzi kwenye intsha, ikakhulukazi kwiFranchising nasezimbonini zokukhiqiza. Uveze nokuthi isikhwama senzelwe ukusiza intsha engalutholi uxhasho lokuqala amabhizinisi emabhange, ezosizwa nangokuqeqeshwa.

UMnuz Zwelihle Mkhize umfowabo kamufi, uthe amaphoyisa angena kubo phakathi nobusuku ngoLwesihlanu efuna yena, umufi nomunye umfowabo. Uthe umufi wavula kuqala. Mina bengizwa umfowethu elokhu ekhala ngaphakathi endlini ebivaliwe, ngaphakathi kukhona amaphoyisa naye kuphela, unkosikazi nezingane kuthiwe abaphume ngoba amaphoyisa afuna ukukhuluma naye kuphela. Sithe sizwa kwabe kuthuleka. Asazi bekwenzekani ngaphakathi,” echaza Ngemuva kwalokho uthe kuphume amaphoyisa ayolanda imoto abeyifihlile ngoba abefike ehamba ngezinyawo. Uthe ingene ihlehla yaze yama eduze komnyango wendlu ebinomufi. “Amalunga omndeni athe ayobheka ukuthi sekwenzenjani, amaphoyisa awaxosha athi awahambe ayolala kwezinye izindlu, amthatha amfaka emotweni. Asimbonanga ukuthi ubekusiphi isimo kodwa endlini abeshaywa ekuyo sifice kumanzi umbhede, izingubo naphansi, kusho ukuthi abecabanga ukuthi uqulekile ezama ukumphaphamisa,” kusho umfowabo. Uthe amaphoyisa aseKranskop athi umshayeli wale moto imphunyukile yaphaphalaza yashayisa izinsimbi ezisemgwaqweni, kwavuleka isicabha, umufi wawa, yamphitshiza, washona. “Okusixakayo ukuthi kulesi siteshi sikhonjiswa imoto encane okuthiwa ubekuyo. Kuthiwa bekunamaphoyisa amabili kuyo kodwa asizwa ukuthi wona alimele yini. Siwumndeni wakwaMkhize sihleli kabi endaweni ngoba kuthiwa siyasoleka ekushoneni kwabamatekisi abadutshulwa. Angazi ukuthi thina singena kanjani odabeni lwamatekisi asebenza eGoli. Umfowethi unamatekisi ahambela eGreytown, akanatekisi eGoli,” kusho uMkhize. UCol Thembeka Mbele okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni uthe amaphoyisa abehamba nomsolwa obeyokhomba ukuthi usifihle kuphi isibhamu esingekho ethethweni. “Umshayeli uphunyukwe imoto besemgwaqweni uSambana, yagingqika, amaphoyisa abesemotweni alimele kanzima, umsolwa ushone esendaweni yesehlakalo. Kuvulwe icala lokubulala ngokungenhloso esiteshini samaphoyisa eKranskop,” kusho uCol Mbele. UMnuz Moses Dlamini wophiko oluphenya amacala athinta amaphoyisa, i-Ipid, uthe leli cala lidluliselwe kubo.

Uthe ukuphela kwempilo kaNqobile kuyinto ebuhlungu. “Wayemncane futhi wadutshulwa emhlane. Abukho ubufakazi obukhomba ukuthi wayeyingozi kuwe.” Imantshi ithe ayigculisekile ukuthi uNdlovu ubezisola ngoba ubeqhubeka nokuthi akadubulanga wabhekisa equlwini labantu kodwa wadubula wabhekisa phansi nokushayisanayo nobufakazi bochwepheshe. “Nginomuzwa wokuthi wazama ukusebenzisa ukuthi awubonwanga muntu ngesikhathi udubula. Angiboni ukuthi uyazisola ngokweqiniso ngokwenzeka,” kusho uMaharaj. Uthe uyathemba isigwebo sizonqanda amanye amaphoyisa ukuthi angenzi njengoNdlovu uma ebhekene nezimo ezifanayo. Okhulumela inhlangano yaBahlali baseMjondolo, uMnuz Thapelo Mohapi uthe bayasamukela isigwebo. “Leli cala seliqhubeke isikhathi eside kodwa sibona ukuthi bekufanele agwetshwe okungaphezulu kwalokhu. Impilo yentombazane esencane yathathwa yiphoyisa elibudedengu,” kusho yena. UNdlovu uvunyelwe ukuthi afake isicelo sokuphikisa isinqumo sokumlahla ngecala nesigwebo kodwa wanqatshelwa ukuthi abe ngaphandle ngebheyili esalinde kwenziwe lesi sicelo.
SEKUBALWA izinsuku ngaphambi kokuthi kuvalwe ukuholela impesheni ngamakhadi amadala njengoba kusukela ngoJanuwari kuzobe kusebenza afana naleli elisesithombeni SEKUBALWA izinsuku ngaphambi kokuthi kuvalwe ukuholela impesheni ngamakhadi amadala njengoba kusukela ngoJanuwari kuzobe kusebenza afana naleli elisesithombeni BANGU-62 000 abahola impesheni KwaZulu-Natal okuthiwa abakawenzi amakhadi amasha njengoba sekuzonqanyulwa ukuwasebenzisa maduze. Lokhu kushiwo uMnuz Mbizeni Mdlalose okhulumela abakwaSouth Africa Social Security Agency (Sassa) esifundazweni, onxuse ukuthi njengoba sekuqalile ukuholela abantu basale sebeshaya namakhadi amasha. Phezu kokuba kuvalwa ukuholela impesheni ngoDisemba 14 njengoba kuqale ngoLwesithathu, uMdlalose uthe abahola emabhange nasePosini abaphoqiwe ukukhipha imali ngaphambi kwalolu suku lokuvala. Ukuholela ngalesi sikhathi kwenzelwa ukunqanda isiphithiphithi sikaDisemba njengaminyaka yonke. AbakwaSassa baxwayise ngokuthi umholo olandelayo uyoze ube ngoJanuwari, okusho ukuthi kumele bazicabangele. “Siqalile ukuholela ezikhungweni kodwa imali esekhadini ngeke iye ndawo ngisho sekudlule uDisemba 14. Okusiphatha kabi yilesi sibalo sabantu abasasebenzisa amakhadi amadala ngoba uma bengawenzi amasha bazoba nenkinga ngempela ngoJanuwari. “Kumele kushaye uDisemba 10 sebewashintshile ngoba uma kungenjalo ngeke bahole nhlobo ngoJanuwari. Akusagcwali ePosini futhi kuyashesha nokwenza ikhadi,” echaza. Mayelana nokuvalwa kokuhola ngoDisemba 14, uthe kushiwo kulabo abayithola ezikhungweni kuphela. Uthe ngoJanuwari konke kuzobuyela esimeni esijwayelekile, ukuhola kuzoqala ngomhlaka 1. UMdlalose unxusa abantu ukuthi bavuselele amakhadi nje, kukhona abakhalayo ngokuqolwa izimali zabo ezikhishwa emakhadini bengazi. Isolezwe selibike izikhawu ezimbili ngabakhishelwa imali emakhadini, ekhishwa kwenye indawo. UNksz Nobuhle Njapha okhulumela abePosini eKZN uthe ukuholela kuqalile futhi kuhamba kahle. Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi abahola ePosini imali bangayikhipha noma yinini ngisho sekudlule umnqamulajuqu wokuholela. Kuthiwa babalelwa ku-500 000 kulo lonke elakuleli abangakawashayi amakhadi amasha okuhola. OyiNational Advocacy Manager yeBlack Sash uMnuz Hoodah Abrahams-Fayker ugcizelele ukuthi abantu bawashintshe amakhadi okuhola ukuze bangabi nenkinga ngoJanuwari.

UNksz Khanyiswa Thusi (36) obeseshaya isisindo esingu-180kg, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ubesezame zonke izindlela zokunciphisa isisu kodwa kungalungi. Wabhalela abakwaNetcare ngoDisemba 16 wonyaka odlule ecela usizo. Isikhalo sakhe safinyelelwa kuDkt Gert Du Toit wesibhedlela iNetcare St Augustine’s eThekwini, osebenza ophikweni iMetabolic Centre. UDkt Du Toit wacela nosizo kwiNetcare Foundation ukulekelela ngezindleko zokuhlinzwa. UNksz Thusi uhlinzwe ngoNovemba 27 emuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, ebonana nodokotela abahlukene nongoti bendlela yokudla. Uthe ubesephenduke inhlekisa ngobukhulu bakhe, esehlala egula. “Akukho engingakuzamanga ngizama ukunciphisa isisu, ngizame ngisho ijimu nokushintsha indlela yokudla. Bengingasakwazi nokulima kahle njengoba ngiziphilisa ngakho. Mkhulu umehluko engiwuzwayo emzimbeni wami, ngizizwa ngilula. Sekukhona ukudla engingasakwazi ukukudla, okuvele kubuye uma ngikuphoqa,” echaza. Uthe odokoteka bathe kuzothatha isikhathi esingangonyaka ukuze anciphe ngokuphelele. UDkt Du Toit uthe emuva kwesonto uNksz Thusi ehlinziwe ubesehle ngo-15 kg emzimbeni. Uthe ngaphambi kokuhlinzwa wancipha ngo-7kg. “Silindele ukuthi agcine eshaya isisindo sika-70kg, okuzosiza nokuthi angahlaselwa izifo. Sikujabulele ukwenza ushintsho empilweni kaNksz Thusi futhi usinike isizathu esibalulekile sokubuyisela emphakathini. Siyathemba ukuthi uzolulama ngokuphelele, aqhubeke nomsebenzi wakhe,” kusho uDkt Du Toit. UNkk Mande Toubkin oyiGeneral Manager kwi-Emergency, Trauma, Transplant and Corporate Social Investment kwaNetcare uthe bathinteka ngokubona isimo sikaNksz Thusi, bazibophezela ukuthi bamkhokhele zonke izindleko. UNksz Thusi uthe utshelwe ukuthi ukuhlinzwa kukodwa kubiza uR250 000. Leli phephandaba like labhala ngoNksz Thusi nonyaka, ngomsebenzi wakhe wokulima nokutshala amaButternut. Uthe kumanje usedayisela isitolo sakwaSpar eShowe kodwa usafisa ukufaka nakwezinye.
