Umbhali embonweni wakhe ubona ingozi ngalolu hlelo ezweni elikhungethwe wudlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane MHLELI: Ngivumelana noMnuz Bonginkosi Grey Phungula embonweni wakhe mayelana nohlelo okubikwa ukuthi sekusemome ukuba lukhonjiswe kwithelevishini. Lolu hlelo ngibona sengathi luzokwenyusa izinga nezibalo zokubulawa kwabantu besifazane uma abathandana nabo sebebabambile ukuthi bayabajolela. Ngendlela okwenzeka ngayo, njengoba vele sanda isibalo samadoda azibulalayo ngenxa yezinkinga ezihlukahlukene, kusobala ukuthi eminyakeni emihlanu kusukela manje sizobe sinamadoda ambalwa ingxenye enkulu kuzobe kungabantu besifazane. Ama-mashi nemikhuleko ehlelwayo ngeke kusisize ngalutho kulobu bunzima esibhekene nabo. Okudingekayo wukuhlangana kwamadoda aqoqe nabafana abazofundiswa ngokubaluleka komuntu wesifazane nokuthi uyisidalwa esikhethekile kuMdali kwazise indalo iza ngomuntu wesifazane. Kungaba yinto enhle futhi uma kuzobuye kube khona nezinhlelo kwithelevishini ezizolekelela kulo mkhankaso. Umkhuleko uwodwa ngeke usize ngoba ukukhuleka nje kuphela singenzi lutho kwakha isithombe sokuthi uMdali simenza isisebenzi sethu ngokuthi sizovele simtshele ukuthi sifunani bese esinika lokho esikufunayo. Kumele kube khona esikwenzayo bese kuba yima sikhuleka simnxuse uMdali ukuthi emizameni yethu asivulele izindlebe zalabo esizobe sibafundisa. Ama-mashi ewodwa ngokubona kwami awasizi ngoba kuvele kumashe abantu abangayenzi le nto emashelwayo yingakho kuthi kukade kukhona imashi uzwe ntambama sekukhulunywa eyokuthi sekuhlukunyezwe umuntu wesifazane kumbe ingane. Kunento ehlale ishiwo engelona iqiniso lena yokuthi abantu abenza lezi zinto bafelwe wonembeza. Iqiniso elimsulwa lithi unembeza womuntu awufi. Into eyenzekayo wukuthi umuntu uhlula unembeza wakhe. Unembeza uyamtshela ukuthi lokhu afuna ukukwenza akulungile kodwa yena avele athi pho kunani. Lokho kusho ukuthi usewuhlulile unembeza wakhe ngoba umkhuzile. Umuntu osahlulwa wunembeza wakhe yilowo okuthi uma efuna ukwenza okuphambene umkhuze unembeza bese eyawulalela. Akuqeqeshwe abafana ukuze babe ngamadoda akusasa aqotho bafundiswe ukuvuma ukuhlulwa onembeza babo. Indoda yangempela ehlulwa unembeza wayo okuthi noma ngabe ithukuthele kangakanani kodwa ingenzi into ephambene nentando yoMdali. Thembenkosi Mbuyazi
OSOMATEKISI bakhala ngokugqoza kokukhishwa kwamaphemithi okusebenza abathi abanye babo bafaka izicelo zawo ngo-Ephreli kodwa kuze kube manje abakaze bawathole. UMnuz Bhekisisa Nzuza, okhulumela iNational Taxi Alliance KwaZulu-Natal, uthe iProvincial Regulatory Entity Board (PRE-Board), idlala ngabo ngoba yavula iwindi lokuthi kufakwe izicelo zamaphemithi kodwa awabuyi. “Sahambisa yonke imininingwane eyayidingeka kodwa amaphemithi amatekisi awaphumi. Okusiphatha kabi wukuthi izimoto ziyaboshwa, uShanela awuyingeni indaba yokuthi sisalinde amaphemithi. Siyacela iPRE isinike amaphemithi ethu.” UMnuz Bafana Mhlongo, uNobhala weSouth African Taxi & Transport Alliance, uthe ngoLwesibili iPRE ibihlangene nosomatekisi besifunda iGreater North okukhona kubo iNanda, KwaMashu nezinye izindawo ukuchaza ngezinhlelo zayo. “Sixakekile uma sesimenywa emhlanganweni ekubeni iPRE ingazikhiphi izimvume zethu zokusebenza. Eziphumayo ziyagqoza. Kuthiwa ezinye ziyadayiswa ngoR20 000. Akekho osichazelayo ukuthi izicelo zihamba kanjani. Asihambisani nale mihlangano ngoba ayizi nezixazululo ezinkingeni zemboni yamatekisi. Sinenkinga yamaphemithi, eyokungabikho koxhaso lwabagibeli nokubulawa kwabanikazi bomsebeni. Zonke lezi zinto zidinga ukuxazululwa,” kusho uMhlongo. UMnuz Mluleki Mntungwa obhekelele ezokuXhumana eMnyangweni wezokuThutha nokuPhepha koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uthe iPRE iqale ukuvakashela izifunda ezehlukene zamatekisi ngoJulayi ukuze ixoxe nabasembonini. Uthe kuyenzeka kuthathe isikhathi eside ukukhishwa kwezimvume zokusebenza kodwa lokhu kuya ngokuthi umnikazi wetekisi uyithumele yonke yini imininingwane edingekayo. “Kuningi okulandelwayo ngaphambi kokuthi kukhishwe imvume yokusebenza, njengokuthi kufanele umnikazi wetekisi alethe wonke amaphepha adingwa yiPRE, kufanele sithole ukuphawula kumasipala okusebenza kuwo itekisi, kufanele sithole isitifiketi sentela somnikazi wetekesi. Ngenxa yobuningi bezicelo zezimvume ezitholwe yiPRE kuvulwe amahhovisi azokhipha izimvume ePort Shepstone, Mbazwana, Ladysmith naseMpangeni. Lokhu kuzosiza abanikazi bamatekisi ukuthi bafake izicelo eduze kwalapho besebenzela khona bangayi eMgungundlovu bonke.” Uthe kunezinhlelo zokuvula ihhovisi lePRE eThekwini maduzane. UMntungwa uthe izimvume zokusebenza zinikwa abanikazi bamatekisi hhayi ososeshini babo ngoba kufanele bagcwalise amafomu okucela imvume, kucutshungulwe isicelo sabo, isicelo sibe sesishicilelwa kwiGovernment Gazette okuwuhlelo oluthatha izinsuku eziwu-21. Emuva kwalokhu kuhlalwa phansi kulalelwe isicelo somuntu ofuna imvume yokusebenza. Ithimba elilalela isicelo libe selinquma ukuthi isicelo siyaphumelela noma siyachithwa bese kukhishwa imvume yokusebenza uma isicelo siphumelele. Ugqugquzele osomatekisi abanobufakazi bokuthi amaphemithi ayadayiswa ukuba bathinte uMqondisi Jikelele wePRE, uMnuz SJ Langa, noma uMqondisi, uNkk N Majola, noma uMnuz S Ntuli ku-033 341 9500. Uthe bangathinta nehhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha ku-031 360 6576 noma ku-033 355 8760 nasemaphoyiseni. “Akudingeki ukuthi abantu bazidalule amagama abo kodwa bangacela ukufihlwa uma bevula icala emaphoyiseni noma bebika ehhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal nelikaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha.” Kulabo abathi amaphemithi ayadayiswa benganabo ubufakazi uthe kuyicala ukusola abantu ngenkohlakalo ungenabo ubufakazi.
UBUHOLI obusha be-ANC esifundeni iHarry Gwala uMnuz Les Stuta uMgcinimafa, uSihlalo uMnuz Zamo Nxumalo, iPhini likaSihlalo uMnuz Phumzile Noncanda, uNobhala uNkk Sindi Msomi nePhini likaNobhala uMnuz Zenzele Msomi UBUHOLI obusha be-ANC esifundeni iHarry Gwala uMnuz Les Stuta uMgcinimafa, uSihlalo uMnuz Zamo Nxumalo, iPhini likaSihlalo uMnuz Phumzile Noncanda, uNobhala uNkk Sindi Msomi nePhini likaNobhala uMnuz Zenzele Msomi KUNGENZEKA izifunda ezimbili ze-ANC ezingakabi nezingqungquthela zazo KwaZulu-Natal, okuyiMoses Mabhida neLower South Coast, zibe nazo ngemuva kokhetho lukazwelonke ngonyaka ozayo njengoba udlulile umnqamulajuqu obubekwe yisigungu sikazwelonke sale nhlangano obusekupheleni kuka-Agasti. Lokhu kushiwo nguNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu, okhulumela i-ANC esifundazweni, kulandela ukuthi ibe yimpumelelo ingqungquthela yaseHarry Gwala. Lesi sifunda sibe sematheni kubulawa abaholi abaningi, okubalwa kubona noMnuz Sindiso Magaqa, owake waba nguNobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League. Kule ngqungquthela kukhethwe umngani kaMagaqa esikhundleni sikamgcinimafa walesi sifunda, uMnuz Les Stuta, owageqa amagula ngokufa kwalo mholi ngesikhathi kunomngcwabo wakhe. UNkk Simelane-Zulu uthe konke kulele esigungwini sikazwelonke ngokuthi ngabe sizolivula yini elinye ithuba lokuthi kube nezingqungquthela. “Umnqamulajuqu wokuhlalisa zonke izingqungquthela ubusekupheleni kuka-Agasti ngakho kulele esigungwini esiphezulu se-ANC ukuthi siphinde sihlangane sinqume ukuthi sizolivula yini elinye ithuba. Uma lingavulwa elinye ithuba okusho ukuthi izingqungquthela zizoze zibe ngemuva kokhetho,” kusho uNkk Simelane-Zulu. Mayelana nobuholi obukhethiwe eHarry Gwala, uthe unethemba lokuthi uzoqhubeka umsebenzi obese wenziwe kulesi sifunda wokusibumba. “Sibafisela inhlanhla abaholi abakhethiwe eHarry Gwala. Lobu buholi ngeke sibunike umthwalo ongaphezulu kwamandla. Sinethemba lokuthi luzoqhubeka ubumbano,” kusho uNkk Simelane-Zulu. Uthe ngesikhathi kuqala ingqungquthela yalesi sifunda bathola incwadi eyayivela kwabanganeme bethi bazoya enkantolo kodwa bagcina bengayanga. Mayelana nokubulawa kwabaholi kulesi sifunda uthe wubugebengu lobu wathi izinhlaka zikahulumeni zimatasa zilwa nalesi sihlava.
UNGQONGQOSHE wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uMnuz Pravin Gordhan othi usekhathele uMalema. Isithombe: NHLANHLA PHILIPS/ANA UNGQONGQOSHE wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uMnuz Pravin Gordhan othi usekhathele uMalema. Isithombe: NHLANHLA PHILIPS/ANA UNGQONGQOSHE wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uMnuz Pravin Gordhan usevulele umholi we-Economic Freedom Fighters uMnuz Julius Malema amacala ngokumdicilela phansi isithunzi. UGordhan uvulele uMalema icala lokumhlambalaza, ukudicelela phansi isithunzi sakhe nelokubhebhezela udlame eBrooklyn Police Station, ePitoli. UMalema ngeledlule ukhwele wadilika kuGordhan embiza ngenja esetshenziswa yizicebi ezingabelungu ukuqhwaga amandla oMbuso. Ekhuluma nabezindaba ngephandle kwalesi siteshi samaphoyisa uGordhan uthe sekumumi emphinjeni ukudelwa uMalema. “Esikuvezayo ukuthi ngeke sisakwazi ukumelana nokumbozwa kwenkohlakalo kuleli kusetshenizwa ukucwaswa ngokwebala, ukuhlaselwa kwemindeni kanye nokuhlaselwa kwezombusazwe. Ngakho nginqume ukuthi sekwanele,” kusho uGordhan. “Uma ufuna ukuqophisana nathi ngezombusazwe ayikho inkinga, kodwa uma uzoqamba uhlasele imndeni yabantu uhlukanisa iNingizimu Afrika phakathi. Akwamukelekile neze lokho. Ibala lomuntu isihloko esibucayi kulelizwe,” kuqhuba yena. FUNDA: Uchaphe uGordhan ngenhlamba Ngeledlule uMalema uchaphe ngenhlamba uGordhan ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabalandeli be-EFF ngaphandle kwebhilidi okusingethwe kulo ikhomishini ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. Ngaleso sikhathi uGordhan wayefakaza kule khomishini. “UGordhan uyinja yabelungu abasebenzisa uMbuso. Uma uhlasela kukhala bona, ukhohlakele futhi akahlukile kuloyo owayengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma. BakuWhatsApp ofanayo ophethwe wuCyril Ramaphosa. Bafunda inkohlakalo kwi-ANC. Mina angikhohlakele ngoba angikaze ngivakashele emzini wakwaGupta futhi angikaze ngizwane namalungu akhona,” kusho uMalema. UMHOLI we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema ngesikhathi ekhuluma ngaphandle kwebhilidi okusingethwe kulo ikhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana ngeledlule. Isithombe: Dimpho Maja/African News Agency (ANA) Waphinde waveza nokuthi uGordhan unamasheya ezinkampanini zabacindezeli futhi indodakazi yakhe yathola uR8 million ngokusebenzisana nohulumeni. Ngesonto uMalema uqhubekile nokukhuluma ngendodakazi kaGordhan eveza ukuthi kuyenzelelwa uma kusolwa yona. “Uma kuyindodakazi eyiNdiya, kulungile, udaba luvaliwe, asikho isidingo sokuthi kuphenywe izitatimende zaseBhange,” kusho uMalema. UGordhan uyakuchitha ukuthi akhona amabhizinisi ahlanganisa indodakazi yakhe nohulumeni.
ULAHLWE yicala wagwetshwa izinyanga ezintathu ebhadla ejele owesifazane wase-United Arab Emirates obepequlula iselula yomyeni wakhe ngesikhathi yena esathatha isithongwana. Lo wesifazane kuthiwa unele wabona ukuthi isinqandamathe sakhe sihuqa obudala, wathi ngibonwa yini wayigwexa iselula ethutha izithombe nemiyalezo ekufaka kwenye iselula ukuze akucubungule kahle esenesikhathi. Kuthiwa ubethumela nakumaselula odadewabo imiyalezo ayisolayo. Kuthiwa le ndoda ithe ivuka yabona ukuthi lo wesifazane ubematasa ngeselula yayo yavele yafaka icala enkantolo idinwa ukuthi akazihloniphi izindaba zayo zangasese. Inkantolo yaseRas Al Khaimah ebihlalele lolu daba ithe impela le ndoda ihlukunyeziwe, aphuliwe amalungelo ayo. Lo wesifazane uthe umyeni wakhe wamnika inombolo eyimfihlo yokuvula iselula ngesikhathi ebambe ukuthi kunowesifazane oyishende lakhe abhizi naye. Kuthiwa leli zwe linomthetho oqondile othinta izindaba zobuchwepheshe besimanje namaselula. Abantu kuTwitter bebezwelana nalo wesifazane bethi ukube bekungekho mikhuba ayisolayo, ubengeke ayiguduze iselula yendoda yakhe.
ILUNGU lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC elijutshwe ukuba libheke ukusebenza kwesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Edna Molewa, liyakuchitha ukuthi uKhongolose esifundazweni unezinkinga ezinzima ezingenza ukuthi ingqungquthela yesifundazwe ingabikhona. Ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba eMeander Manor Hotel, eSalt Rock, izolo ngemuva kwengqungquthela yesifunda iGreater KwaDukuza, uNkk Molewa uthe ubuholi bukazwelonke bufike esifundazweni buzohlola isimo samagatsha nezifunda bathola ukuthi iqembu likulungele ukuthi lingaba nengqungquthela yesifundazwe. “Nakuba zikhona izikhalo kodwa ngezamagatsha ambalwa ezifundeni ezehlukene ezingeke zadala ukuthi kumiswe ingqungquthela yesifundazwe,’’ kusho uNkk Molewa. Uthe akukho okuphambene abakwenzile kodwa balandele yonke imigomo ekumthethosisekelo weqembu mayelana nezingqungquthela. “Umgomo weqembu uthi ukuze kube nengqungquthela kumele * -70% wamagatsha ube sesimeni esihle. Cishe zonke izifunda zingaphezu kwalesi sibalo esifunekayo.” Uthe ingqungquthela yesifundazwe izoba khona ngaphambi kokuphela kukaMeyi. “Bekulindeleke ukuthi ingqungquthela ibe ngempelasonto kaMeyi 18-20 kodwa lokho kubukeka kungeke kusenzeka ngoba kukhona izifunda ezizobe zihlangene. Akukwazi ukuthi kungaba nengqungquthela yezifunda kube kuneyesifundazwe.” Uthe noma ngabe kuthiwa kukhona izifunda ezinenkinga lokhu ngeke kuyiphazamise ingqungquthela yesifundazwe. “Izithunywa kaziyi engqungqutheleni yesifundazwe ngoba zithunywe yizifunda zazo kodwa ziya ngoba zithunywe ngamagatsha azo.” Uncome ingqungquthela yaseGreater KwaDukuza wathi ibe yimpumelelo enkulu wanxusa zonke izifunda ezisazokhetha ukuthi zisike iphethini kwaDukuza. Ubongele nobuholi obusha besifunda iGreater KwaDukuza wathi uyathemba ukuthi buzokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ngendlela. Ingqungquthela yaKwaDukuza ikhethe ubuholi obusha ngo-elethu engqungqutheleni ethathe izinsuku ezimbili. UMnuz Ricardo Mthembu obevele enguSihlalo wesifunda uphinde wabuyela esikhundleni sakhe okwesithathu. Uke waba nguSihlalo we-ANCYL esifundeni. UMthembu uthe ujabule ngokuthi amaqabane aphinde amthembe ngokuthi usengakwazi ukuwahola. Uthe uzosebenza kanzima ukuzama ukuqeda ukwehlukana okukhona kumalungu. “Ukwehlukana okukhona enhlanganweni kubhebhethekiswa wubuholi, yithina futhi esisukayo siyoxova amagatsha,” kusho uMthembu. Uthe uzimisele ngokusebenzisana nesigungu sakhe ukuyisa uKhongolose phambili. Ingqungquthela yaKwaDukuza ngeyokuqala KwaZulu-Natal ngemuva kokuthi ubuholi bukazwelonke bathatha isinqumo sokuthi zime kancane. Ngempelasonto ezayo kulindeleke ukuthi kube neyezifunda ezine kanye kanye okukhona kuzo iMusa Dladla, Far North, Emalahleni neNkosi Bhambatha. Ngempelasonto ezolandela kulindeleke ukuba kube neyeMoses Mabhida, Abaqulusi, Harry Gwala neLower South Coast. Ukuphumelela kukaMthembu esifundeni iGreater KwaDukuza kusho ukuthi uhlangothi lukaMnuz Sihle Zikalala lusahamba phambili ngo 1-0, njengoba kulungiselelwa ingqungquthela yesifundazwe. Kodwa akwaziwa ukuthi izozala nkomini kulezi ezinye izifunda eziyisishiyagalombili okusamele zihlangane.
ISITHOMBE se-ID sikaNksz Nompumelelo Mthembu obulawe uyise wezingane zakhe ngoba efuna babuyelane. ISITHOMBE se-ID sikaNksz Nompumelelo Mthembu obulawe uyise wezingane zakhe ngoba efuna babuyelane. KUGCINE kumenele ngoMgqibelo owesifazane waseNkunzani, KwaNongoma, obhunyelwe uyise wezingane ngophethroli wamokhela ngomlilo. UNksz Nompumelelo Mthembu (28) ushone ngoMgqibelo kulandela ukubhunyelwa ngophethilolu nguyise wezingane zakhe, ngoba enqaba ukuba bebuyelane. Umufi onezingane ezintathu nomsolwa, kuthiwa ubesebuyele kubo njengoba ngoMashi wamshaya waze wamdlokodla isitho sangasese ngesagila umsolwa kulandela ingxabano ethinta imali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni yezingane. Wahlala isikhathi esibhedlela uNksz Mthembu ekhishwa isagila njengoba umndeni uthe kwaze kwaphoxeleka ukuba akhishwe nesibeletho... Udaba oluphelele kwiSolezwe ngoLwesine.
BAHLALA bemincile odade abafake izinwele okuthiwa kuyanda ukwebiwa kwazo. UNksz Thobile Ndlovu osebhizinisini lezinwele naye ozifakayo, uthe abesifazane abanankinga yokukhipha imali eshisiwe ngezinwele BAHLALA bemincile odade abafake izinwele okuthiwa kuyanda ukwebiwa kwazo. UNksz Thobile Ndlovu osebhizinisini lezinwele naye ozifakayo, uthe abesifazane abanankinga yokukhipha imali eshisiwe ngezinwele ISEMATHENI indaba yokwebiwa kwezinwele zokufakelwa ezibizwa ngama-weave. Ukwanda kwalo mkhuba sekwenza ukuthi abesifazane abafake lezi zinwele bahambe bejeqeza besaba ukuhlwithwa zona. Ukubiza kwalezi zinwele ezinye okuthiwa zitholakala emazweni aphesheya, yikho okwenza nezigebengu zicuthele odade abazifakile. Kuvele nokuthi eminye imishwalense isinezinhlelo zokukhokhela abantshontshelwe izinwele. Ngokombiko wephephandaba elisesitebeleni esisodwa neSolezwe, iBusiness Report, kuvele ukuthi uhlelo lokukhokhela ukwebiwa kwezinwele lungaphansi kwebhizinisi lezobuhle kweminye imishwanelense. UNksz Natasha Kawulesar oyinhloko yezabathengi kwa-Outsurance utshele iBusiness Report ukuthi bayawakhokhela amakhasimende abo ngokwebiwa kwezinwele. Uthe babone kunesidingo sokuthi nezinwele zibe nomshwalense ngoba ziyabiza futhi ziyebiwa. Sibe sematheni nesigameko sokwebiwa kwezinwele zikaSbahle Mpisane osanda kulimala engozini yemoto. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi ingozi isanda kwenziwa kukhona owangena emotweni wadonsa izinwele wabaleka nazo. UNksz Thobile Ndlovu ongumnikazi we-Ethnic Hair eThekwini, uyavuma ukuthi ziyabiza izinwele. Uveze ukuthi ngenhlanhla ubengakavelelwa umshophi wokuntshontshelwa izinwele. “Abantu bayazi ukuthi izinwele ziyabiza yingakho sezebiwa kangaka. Elinye ikhasimende lami lisanda kuhlwithwa izinwele ezibiza kakhulu. Beliphethe isikhwama kodwa abafana basiyeka bahlwitha izinwele kuphela.” Phezu kwalokhu kwebiwa kwalezi zinwele, uNksz Ndlovu uthe abesifazane abapheli mandla. “Abesifazane abanqeni ukukhipha noma imalini ngezinwele. Ezibiza kancane kunazo zonke zinguR2 400 futhi zimfishane.” Uthe okwenza abesifazane bathande lezi zinwele ukuthi kulula ukuzifaka futhi zihlala isikhathi eside. Idumela lokudayiswa kwezinwele selibonakala nangokuthi babe baningi abazithungela emgwaqweni emadolobheni, bazidayisele abadlulayo. UNkk Getrude Uche ongumcwali wezinwele uthe usedla kakhulu ngokuthunga izinwele ngoba amakhasimende amaningi asefuna zona. Akuqali ukuthi kube nomkhuba wokwebiwa kwezinwele kuleli. Ngesikhathi kusadume ukuluka ama-dreadlocks, izigebengu bezibagunda abanawo, ziwadayise.
UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Ace Magashule ogxekwe wuMnuz Bheki Cele. Isithombe: AYANDA NDAMANE UNOBHALA Jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Ace Magashule ogxekwe wuMnuz Bheki Cele. Isithombe: AYANDA NDAMANE ILUNGU lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC uMnuz Bheki Cele, likhwele ladikila kuNobhala-jikelele kaKhongolose uMnuz Ace Magashule lathi ubulala umbutho ngalezi zinkulumo alokhu ezenza esidlangalaleni. Ekhuluma emgubhweni weminyaka engu-106, i-ANC yasungulwa enkundleni yezemidlalo eLakeside Sport Ground, eVryheid izolo, uCele uthe sebembonile ukuthi uMagashule usemkhankasweni wokucekela phansi uKhongolose. “Awukwazi ungumholi we-ANC uthi ubuholi obukhona nawe oyingxenye yabo uthi buzoba khona iminyaka emihlanu, ngemuva kwalokho inhlangano izobuyela ezandleni ezifanele,” kusho uCele. Uthe phezu kokuthi uMagashule ethi ubuholi bukaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa buzophela ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu, uyaqhubeka uyabhuqa uthi abantu abangathengi kwaMcDonalds ngoba bazokhuluphala. Emcimbini wokubungaza i-ANC obuseMgungundlovu, uMagashule wanxusa amalungu enhlangano ukuba aseke uMengameli Jacob Zuma, wathi ubuholi obukhona buzohlala iminyaka emihlanu bese buyaphuma. “Uthi akungathengwa kwaMcDonalds ngoba uyazi ukuthi uphethwe uRamaphosa. Uma ethi abantu bazokhuluphala abadle ukudla okunempilo, yena ukwaze kwanjani ukuntshontsha imali yabantu abampofu * -R30 million wayowunika umndeni wakwaGupta, washada ngayo?” Uthe bafuna ukwazi ukuthi iziphi lezi zandla ezifanele uMagashule akhuluma ngazo. “Isikhathi sabadayisi sesaphela, ngeke sithule abantu bekhuluma umathanda ngenhlangano, sifuna ukwazi ukuthi kazi uMagashule usebenzela bani njengoba kade sihlangene siyisigungu esiphezulu i-NEC kwathiwa wonke umuntu akazethule, yena wathi wethulwa yi-ANC emndenini wakwaGupta. "Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi uMagashule ubika kubani ngoba sizolokhu sicabanga ukuthi izwe siliphethe kanti kade ladayiswa,” kusho uCele. UCele uthe uMagashule utshelwe ngubani yena ukuthi kuyophela iminyaka emihlanu esakhona kwi-ANC. UCele uphinde wakhwela wadilika kulabo abahlela imashi ephikisana nokukhishwa kukaZuma esikhundleni. Uthe akangabazi ukuthi labo abahlela le mashi, basebenzisa imali yombuso. "Nathi sithi abasimele kancane bayiyeke phansi i-ANC ngoba laba bantu abahlela imashi asibazi, i-ANC kumele iyilungise indaba kamengameli kungaze kumosheke izinto eziningi,” kusho uCele. UCele uthe uzwile ukuthi abakwaGupta banyamelale kulezi zinsuku. Uthe kuzomele babuye bazophendula ngezenzo ezibhekiswe kubo.
INHLOKO yemikhankaso ye-ANC uMnuz Senzo Mchunu noMengameli weNatu uMnuz Allen Thompson ngesikhathi kuvaleliswa obengumengameli wale nyunyana uMnuz Siphosethu Ngcobo INHLOKO yemikhankaso ye-ANC uMnuz Senzo Mchunu noMengameli weNatu uMnuz Allen Thompson ngesikhathi kuvaleliswa obengumengameli wale nyunyana uMnuz Siphosethu Ngcobo OWAYENGUNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, oyinhloko yezinhlelo zemikhankaso ye-ANC nelungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uthe uMengameli we-ANC nezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa unikwe umsebenzi wokuthi agxile ekukhuliseni umnotho wezwe ukuze kwakheke amathuba emisebenzi kukhule nezwe. UMchunu uthe lezi ngezinye zezinto okumele zilungiswe ngokushesha ezweni ukuze abantu baphume ebubheni. Ezinye zezinto athe uRamaphosa uyalelwe yinhlangano ukuthi agxile kuzona kakhulu, ukulwa nenkohlakalo, ukubhekana nendaba yobugebengu nokuqeda indlala. “Siyi-ANC sithe nazi izinto mengameli okufanele ugxile kuzona kakhulu kunakuqala, ezinye zazo zibalulekile njengemfundo nezempilo. Umnotho wethu ubungakhuli, ubukhula ngo-0 bani wamaphesenti kodwa manje sesinethemba ngoba usukhula ngo-1%. Liphezulu izinga lokungasebenzi ikakhulu entsheni, okuyinhlekelele,” kusho uMchunu. Ukusho lokhu ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku ngesikhathi kuvaleliswa obenguMengameli weNatu uMnuz Siphosethu Ngcobo obesehole le nyunyana iminyaka engu-18 eNatu Teacher Development Institute eMadadeni. Uthe isiqalile ukuthela izithelo imizamo yokulwa nenkohlakalo njengoba kukhona iKhomishini yeJaji Zondo ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. “Abantu bayamenyezwa laphaya. Uma ubiziwe yeka ukulokhu uya emaphepheni nakwabezindaba shona khona uyophendula kuyona. Asikwazi ukukusiza kumele ugeze igama lakho kuleya nkundla,” kusho uMchunu. Uthe kumele livalwe igebe elikhona phakathi kwabahluphekayo nabacebile. UMchunu osebenze kakhulu neNatu enguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uthe le nyunyana yiyona ahlangana nayo isikhathi eside uma eqhathanisa nezinye izinyunyana. Uthe kunalabo abacabanga ukuthi othisha abanazwi ezintweni eziqhubeka ezweni wathi lokhu akulona iqiniso ngoba kumele babe nezwi. Muva nje kube nokungqubuzana kwemibono phakathi kukaMchunu nowayeyisikhulu sakwa-Eskom uMnuz Matshela Koko ngezindaba ezithinta le nkampani. UMchunu uthe kukhona abantu abasabukela phansi othisha ngokuthi bona akufanele babe nombono ngoba ngemuva kwenkulumo yakhe ekhuluma nelinye lamaphephandaba aseThohoyandou eLimpopo, waveza ukuthi kumele kugxekwe ombombayi bezimenenja ezimnyama ngezinkinga zakwa-Eskom. I-ANC yamgxeka ngalesi sitatimende kodwa yaphinde yaxolisa kuyena. “Kukhona abacabanga ukuthi othisha akumele babe nombono ngezinto ezithinta izwe. Othisha yibona bantu abakha isizwe, kumele kwesekwe yonke imizamo yokwakha leli lizwe.” UMchunu uthe ufunde lukhulu kuNgcobo nakuMengameli weNatu uMnuz Allen Thompson ngesikhathi engungqongqoshe. Unxuse uThompson ukuthi ahlale ekubantu, angazithwali njengoba esengumengameli. UThompson uthe bazoqhubeka nomkhankaso wokuqoqa lonke ulwazi lothisha bakwaGrade R ukuze bathole iziqu abanazo ukuze bakwazi ukuqashwa ngokugcwele. Uthe bazolwela nomabhalane ezikoleni ngoba ngabantu abahlale benganakwa. “Sizolwela nokuthi kuqashwe onogada, sifuna kuqiniswe ezokuphepha ezikoleni,” kusho uThompson. Lo mcimbi ubuhanjelwe yizikhulu ezehlukene okubalwa umkhandlu wothisha iSace, ezinye izinyunyana zothisha okubalwa iNaptosa, izikhulu zomnyango wezemfundo kuzwelonke nasesifundazweni. UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga akakwazanga ukuphumelela ngoba bekushone umshana wakhe kodwa uthumele abalethe umyalezo wokuhalalisela uNgcobo ngokuhola inyunyana isikhathi eside.
KUBATSHAZWA isihluku somlisa (28) waseNgwavuma okuthiwa uhlahlele unina okwembuzi emuva kokuthi ezame ukumlamula eshaya unina wengane yakhe. Lo mlisa wasOnaleni, eNgwavuma, ongumakhi, kuthiwa uhlahlele unina, uNkk Maponyane Timbane (56) ngocelemba ngoMsombuluko ntambama, emva kokuthi emlamule enengxabano nonina wengane yakhe abesehlale naye iminyaka emzini wakhe. Induna yendawo, uMnuz Ephraim Ndlazi, ithe basashaqekile ngenxa yesehlo esenzeke endaweni. Uthe uthole ucingo ngehora lesithupha ntambama lumbikela ngokubulawa kukaNkk Timbane. “Ngesikhathi ngibikelwa ukuthi u... (emgagula ngegama) useklabhe unina ngocelemba, ngizitshele ukuthi kuthiwa angiphuthume ngizolanda umuntu obedinga ukuyiswa emtholampilo. Ngishaqekile uma ngifika. Ubemhlahlele ngocelemba umzimba wonke kuhle okwembuzi. Bekuyinto obuyibuka kanye kube sengathi ungangaphinde ubuke,” kusho uNdlazi. Uyise omdala kamsolwa uMnuz Zifo Ntimbane oveze ukuthi ubizwe yinduna emuva kokuthi sekwenzeke isigameko uthe umsolwa ubevame ukumsabisa unina abuye amsole nangokuthakatha. “Unina bekungabonakali nokuthi ngabe ubenawo yini amehlo nokuthi ayengakuphi. Nasezingalweni ubemgencile. Bekuyinto engabhekeki,” kusho uNtimbane. UNdlazi uthole ukuthi uNkk Timbane ubehleli nonina wengane kamsolwa ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko. Uchaze ukuthi unina wengane kamsolwa ubezobika ukuthi uyamshaya kanti umsolwa uzotheleka egcekeni esephethe ucelemba esuka kwakhe lapho behlala khona. “Ubuze unina ukuthi uyazi yini ukuthi babangani njengoba bexabana nonina wengane. Ngesikhathi eseqala exabana nonina, unina wengane ubaleke wathatha ingane. Kuyacaca ukuthi ukube akazange abaleke naye ngabe umenze okufanayo,” kusho uNdlazi. Kulesi sigameko kuthiwa ulimaze nomfowabo omncane obezama ukumvimba ngesikhathi ehlasela unina. Amaphoyisa kuthiwa agasele endlini kamsolwa ngoMsombuluko ebusuku amfica elele esekhumule nezingubo ezinegazi abezigqokile ngesikhathi ehlahlela unina. Kuthiwa ubenegazi ezandleni kodwa ephika ukuthi ukwenzile lokhu, ethi ubexabana impela nonina kodwa ubengeke ambulale. Umsolwa kuvele ukuthi ungumuntu obevamile ukuthi ahluphe novame ukuphuza utshwala. UNdlazi uthe namanje umphakathi wonkana uhlukumezekile ngokwenzekile okungangokuthi akazi ukuthi ungamenzani uma kungathiwa uyaphuma njengoba eboshiwe. Uthe umphakathi uthukile ngoba kuyaqala ukuthi kwenzeke isehlo esifana nalesi endaweni, futhi bafisa engathi kungaba ngesokugcina. UNtimbane uthe ufisa ukubona umthetho udlala indawo yawo, aboshwe angadedelwa. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane ukuqinisekisile ukuthi umsolwa uboshiwe nokuthi ubhekene necala lokubulala. Uthe bekulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo izolo.
UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo ePhakeme, ukuQeqeshwa, iSayensi nezobuChwepheshe uDkt Blade Nzimande noNgqongqoshe wezimali KwaZulu-Natal oyibamba likaNdunankulu uMnuz Ravi Pillay, kuvulwa ingqungquthela yokucobelelana ngolwazi iNational Artisan Development Conference izolo UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo ePhakeme, ukuQeqeshwa, iSayensi nezobuChwepheshe uDkt Blade Nzimande noNgqongqoshe wezimali KwaZulu-Natal oyibamba likaNdunankulu uMnuz Ravi Pillay, kuvulwa ingqungquthela yokucobelelana ngolwazi iNational Artisan Development Conference izolo KUNXUSWE othishanhloko bamakolishi amakhono amaTVET ukuthi basebenzisane nabezimboni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izitshudeni ziyathathwa ezimbonini ukuphucula amakhono azo emuva kokuqeqeshwa kulezi zikhungo. UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqeshwa, iSayensi nobuChwepheshe uDkt Blade Nzimande ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi evula ngokusemthethweni ingqungquthela yezinsuku ezimbili iNational Artisan Development eqale izolo, eNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre, eThekwini. “Othishanhloko kumele bazi ukuthi umsebenzi wabo awumuhle uma bengakhi ubudlelwane obuqinile nabezimboni ukuze izitshudeni zithole amathuba okuphucula amakhono azo,” kusho uNzimande. Uthe umsebenzi wabo uzokalwa ngokuthi zingaki izimboni othishanhloko abasebenzisana nazo ezizibophezele ukuthatha izitshudeni. “Uma unguthishanhloko ohlulekayo ukwenza umsebenzi wokunxenxa izimboni kusho ukuthi ulahlekile, akumele ngabe usesikhundleni okuso,” kuqhuba uNzimande. Unxuse abakwaSeta ukuthi baqhamuke nohlelo lokugcina ulwazi lwesitshudeni ngasinye okungenani esenza iziqu zobunjiniyela kuwona wonke amaTVET athe lolo lwazi lungasiza ekwazini isibalo esiqondile sezitshudeni ezidinga ukufakwa ezindaweni zokusebenza ukuze isitshudeni sithole isipiliyoni emkhakheni esiwufundele. UNzimande ugxeke izitshudeni ezingama-artisan ezihleli emakhaya ngoba zikhala ngokuthi aziwutholi umsebenzi noma aziqasheki. “Angiqondi ukuthi kungani kukhona umuntu oyi-artisan othi akaqashiwe ekubeni enekhono lokuzisebenza,” kusho uNzimande. Le ngqungquthela ihanjelwe nayizithunywa ezivela kwamanye amazwe neziphathimandla ezikhungweni zezemfundo ezehlukene. Ibamba likaNdunankulu uMnuz Ravi Pillay lamukele abathamele le ngqungquthela.
USALE nakugqokile kuphela uNksz Anelisa Vezi kusha umjondolo abehlala kuwo okushone kuwo ababili, okusolwa obeyisoka lakhe ngalesi senzo USALE nakugqokile kuphela uNksz Anelisa Vezi kusha umjondolo abehlala kuwo okushone kuwo ababili, okusolwa obeyisoka lakhe ngalesi senzo UBEPHUME kubo eyotadisha umfundi waKwaMshayazafe, eNanda, oshiswe ngempelasonto nesoka lakhe, nokusolwa ukuthi bashiswe obeyisoka lobegadiswe umjondolo okwenzeke kuwo isehlo. UNomasonto Zuma (17) obefunda uGrade 11 eSiyathuthuka High, ushe wangqongqa noMbusiseni Langa (18) ngentathakusa yangeSonto. Lesi sehlo kuthiwa sisuswe yingxabano ebiphakathi kukamsolwa nobeyintombi yakhe ebigada umjondolo oshile. Kuthiwa umsolwa wafika endlini ngezithuba zabo 9 ngoMgqibelo ebusuku ezobona uNksz Anelisa Vezi (24) okuthiwa bebethandana naye, ehlala kulo mjondolo onamakamelo amabili. Ingxabano isuswe wukuthi umsolwa ufice uNksz Vezi enoyise wezingane, kwaliwa. Elandisa Isolezwe uNksz Vezi, uthe ubesenamasonto amabili ehlukene nomsolwa wabuyelana noyise wezingane zakhe ezingamawele anezinyanga ezingu-17. “Bengicabanga ukuthi wamukela uma ngimtshela ukuthi sengibuyelene noyise wezingane. Ubevele engezile ngobuhle ngoba akazange angitshele ukuthi uyeza. Wafika walwisa uyise wezingane, ngaphuma ngabalekela kwamakhelwane. Izingane zami zize zathathwa ubhuti wakwamakhelwane,” echaza. Uthe ingxabano iqhubeke kwaze kwashaya izithuba zabo-11 ebusuku, omakhelwane banquma ukuthi umsolwa asale eselala khona endlini ngoba sekusebusuku. UNksz Vezi uthe yena walala kwamakhelwane nezingane. Kwelinye ikamelo elingaphandle elixhumene nendlu obekuxatshanwa kuyo, bekujwayele ukulala uLanga uma evakashelwe intombi yakhe. UNOMASONTO ZUMA oshe nesoka lakhe kuhlaselwa umjondolo abebelele kuwo Kuthiwa kwezwakala ngezithuba zabo 2 ekuseni kusha endlini, izicishamlilo zafika emuva kwendaba. Kutholakale isidumbu sikaNomasonto nesikaLanga endlini. UMnuz Sthembiso Xulu onguyise kaNomasonto uthe ubengazi ukuthi uyathandana nomufi. Uthe waphuma ephethe ibhuku lesikole kungathi uyofunda. Uveze ukuthi ubehlakaniphile esikoleni futhi ethanda nokubhala izinkondlo. Oyisihlobo sikaLanga, uMnuz Thokozani Ntuli uthe ubenenyanga efike eThekwini ephuma KwaMaphumulo. “Intombi kamfowethu besiyazi ngoba ibijwayele ukumvakashela futhi ibingaqali ukulala. Ngesikhathi kuvalwe izikole yahlala isonto lonke. Umfowethu ubeya kule ndlu ngoba eseyolala ngoba lapho efikele khona indawo ayanele kahle. Sisola ukuthi umsolwa ubengazi ukuthi kunabantu abalele kwelinye ikamelo, ubethi ulaya intombi yakhe,” kusho uNtuli. Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuphenywa amacala amabili okubulala emuva kokutholakala kwezidumbu ezishile eNanda. Uthe umsolwa oneminyaka engu-33 uboshiwe wavela eNkantolo yeMantshi eNtuzuma izolo, kanti kushaye isikhathi sokuloba ingakatholakali imininingwane yasenkantolo yokuthi icala lihambe kanjani.

KUZOSHUBA ezinkampanini eziphula umthetho wokusebenza konogada njengoba iPrivate Security Industry Regulatory Authority (Psira) isimise inkampani edume ngokukhipha abakhe ezindaweni ezingafanele, iRed Ants Security Relocation and Eviction Services. IPsira imise ukusebenza kweRed Ants emuva kwezikhalo zokuthi inesihluku uma yenza umsebenzi wayo futhi ayibaphathi kahle abantu esuke izobakhipha. IRed Ants idume kakhulu eGauteng kwazise muva nje iyona ebikhipha abantu abebakhe imijondolo endaweni engafanele e-Alexandra. Isikhulu esiphezulu sePsira, uMnuz Manabela Chauke sithe iRed Ants inikezwe ithuba lokuthi iziphendulele ngaphambi kokuthi imiswe. Uthe inalo ilungelo lokuphikisa isinqumo sokumiswa kwayo. “Zonke izinkampani zonogada zizoqashwa ngeso lokhozi, ukuthi ziwenza ngokufanele yini umsebenzi wazo. Uma kunezikhalo sizoziphenya, sibamise okufanele bamiswe. Banalo ilungelo lokuphikisa izinqumo zethu kodwa umsebenzi sizowuqapha,” kusho uChauke. Khonamanjalo inhlangano elwela amalungelo abantu, i-AfriForum ithe ayihambisani nomthetho ohlongozwayo wokuthi izinkampani zonogada zingabi nezibhamu ezinkulu ezizishintshayo. UMnuz Marnus Kamfer, obhekele ezomthetho nokuphepha komphakathi kwi-AfriForum uthe akazi ukuthi uhulumeni ufuna onogada bazivikele kanjani uma kuthiwa bangaziphathi izibhamu ezizishintshayo. “Siphakamisa ukuthi uhulumeni ayibuyekeze le mithetho. Siyitshelile nePsira ukuthi asineme ngokuthi kuzoncishiswa izibhamu ezinkulu ezizishintshayo. Bekungafanele uhulumeni achibiyele imithetho ethinta ukusebenza kwalezi zibhamu ngaphandle kokuxoxa nezinkampani zonogada. Uthi sizozivikela kanjani ezigebengwini eziphatha izinhlokohlela zezibhamu?” kusho uKamfer.
KUSALE kumapeketwane eMpolweni ngemuva kwesiphepho esisiphule izihlala sadiliz imizi sacekela phansi ingqalasizinda kagesi. Isithombe: Leon Lestrade/ANA KUSALE kumapeketwane eMpolweni ngemuva kwesiphepho esisiphule izihlala sadiliz imizi sacekela phansi ingqalasizinda kagesi. Isithombe: Leon Lestrade/ANA SEKUSHONE abantu abangu-14 KwaZulu-Natal ngenxa yemvula enamandla okusaminciwe njengoba kuxwayiswe ngokuthi izoqhubeka namuhla nakusasa. Kushone ababili, kwadilika izindlu, kwasiphuka nezihlahla. Isiphepho esihlasele sashiya kukhalwa eMpolweni kuMasipala uMshwathi ngoLwesibili ntambama. Kulimale abantu abangaphezu kuka-20, othayela bemizi eminingi basale beyimifunzane phansi abanye begaxele ezintanjeni zikagesi. Kukhahlamezeke imizi ewu-798. Abashonile bacindezelwe yizindonga nophahla lwezindlu oludilikele kubona. Kwenzeka lesi sehlo eMpolweni nje ngoMsombuluko ebusuku kushone uMnuz Simangaliso Zondo (68) noNksz Nomathemba Nyangule (55) ngenxa yemvula enamandla eMaoti, eNanda. NgeSonto kushone uNksz Sthembile Nothile Zimba (24) oshaywe wumbani kuMasipala uKhahlamba. UNkk Nonhlanhla Buthelezi (44) wasesigodini iThokozani, eMpolweni, ushone ngesikhathi kusiphuka isihlahla esikhulu ebesisegcekeni lakwakhe siwele phezu kwendlu yodaka yamcindezela. Kuthiwa omakhelwane bazamile ukumtakula washona sekufika i-ambulensi. Indodakazi yakhe uNksz Noluthando Buthelezi (19) ithe unina umyalele ukuthi mabayoquba kwamakhelwane nezingane zakwabo ezincane ezimbili ngesikhathi sekuqala isiphepho. “Sithe sesikamakhelwane ngathi uma ngibuka ekhaya ngabona kungasekho lutho. Ngitshele ebengihlezi nabo ukuthi umama usele endlini abasilekelele siyombheka hleze ucindezelekile,” kusho uNksz Buthelezi ngosizi. UNKSZ Velephi Mncube olimale ebusweni kuhlasela isiphepho eMpolweni. Isithombe: Leon Lestrade/ANA Uthe balale komakhelwane kanti abazi bazokwenza njani ngoba kuwe insika yekhaya. “Umama ubengasebenzi, esizamela ngoba besingalali singadlile. Ubenza ngakho konke okusemandleni ukusiphilisa siyizingane zakhe,” kusho uNksz Buthelezi othe usale nakugqokile emuva kwesiphepho. Bude buduze nalo mndeni esigodini eMvundweni kushone uMnuz Siphelele Ndlovu (40). Ngokusho kukanina, uNkk Thunyeliwe Ndlovu (63) bebehleIi bebathathu endlini ngesikhathi bezwa umoya omkhulu uhambisana nemvula enamandla. “Ngisukume ngaqonda ekamelweni ngiyogqoka ijezi. Sengisekamelweni ngizwe umsindo omkhulu wento ewayo obuqhamuka egunjini ebengisuka kulona. Ngibuye ngokushesha ngiyobheka ngafica uphahla nodonga lwendlu sekuwile kwacindezela uSphe kwalimala onyaweni umakhelwane ebesihleli naye,” kusho uNkk Ndlovu. Uthe bazamile ukususa izitini nothayela obekumcindezele umufi kwasho khona ukuthi amandla akanawo walinda isiphepho sadlula wabe eseyocela usizo komakhelwane. Wonke umuzi wakwaNdlovu ongamagumbi amahlanu udilikile. Izolo bebepequlula ezaleni abasengakwazi ukukusebenzisa. UNkk Velephi Mncube ulimale ebusweni ngemuva kokuwelwa yindlu abehleli kuyona nomyeni wakhe uMnuz Velaphi Mncube ohamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo. “Indlu iwe siphakathi. Ngishaywe yinto engingabonanga ukuthi yini ngabona sengopha. Ngiye esibhedlela ngayothungwa ebusweni. Wonke umuzi wethu wamagumbi amathathu uwile. Silale komakhelwane isimo singesihle neze. Asazi sothathani sihlanganise nani ngoba asisenalutho,” kubalisa uNkk Mncube. Kamakhelwane kwaMncube kudilike umuzi wonke obungamagumbi amathathu. UMnuz Andile Ntuli uthe kuqhamuke ifu elikhulu elimnyama lihambisana nomoya onamandla nemvula. Uthe babaleke bangena endlini eyakhiwe ngezitini sekuqala isiphepho. “Sicashe ngetafula kukubi. Sizwe kuqhuma umsindo omkhulu emuva kwalokho kwacima ugesi. Njengamanje asinalutho,” kusho uNtuli. Izolo uNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka nowezeziMali uMnuz Ravi Pillay bahambele le ndawo beyohlola umonakalo odalekile bekhalisana nemindeni eshonelwe nelinyalelwe yizihlobo zayo. Ngokwesitatimende esikhishwe wuMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana, abathintekayo bathuthelwe emahholo nakwezinye izakhiwo zomphakathi okubalwa kuzo namasonto kanti kunamathimba eminyango ehlukene ahlola umonakalo alekelela nabakhahlamezekile. Esitatimendeni abakwa-Eskom baveze ukuthi bangu-3 906 abantu abasale bengenawo ugesi eMpolweni ngemuva kwesiphepho. Bathe basebenza ngokuzikhandla ukulungisa ingqalasizinda ehlinzeka lezi zindawo ugesi ecekeleke phansi. Uthe lokhu kuzothatha isikhashana ngoba bafuna ukwenza isiqiniseko ukuthi izintambo eziphakela ugesi ziphephile ngaphambi kokuthi bawukhanyise.
UMISIWE enhlanganweni uNobhala we-IFP ezikweni Enkululekweni, Osizweni, ngemuva kokuphumela obala wakhalaza mayelana nemiphumela yengqungquthela. Isithombe: Bonile Bam/INLSA UMISIWE enhlanganweni uNobhala we-IFP ezikweni Enkululekweni, Osizweni, ngemuva kokuphumela obala wakhalaza mayelana nemiphumela yengqungquthela. Isithombe: Bonile Bam/INLSA USEMISIWE enhlanganweni uNobhala we-IFP ezikweni Enkululekweni, Osizweni, ngemuva kokuphumela obala wakhalaza mayelana nemiphumela yengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi obusha baKwaZulu-Natal ebisoNdini ngempelasonto. Isinqumo sokumisa uMnuz Siphiwe Zungu sithathwe isiyingi sasoSizweni ngoMsombuluko. UPhini likaNobhala wesiyingi sasoSizweni, uNkk Noxolo Nzuza, uthe lesi sinqumo basithathe emhlanganweni ophuthumayo abawubizile ngoMsombuluko ngemuva kokuzwa uZungu ekhuluma emsakazweni mayelana nengqungquthela nokuyilapho ephinde wangakhuluma kahle ngoMengameli weqembu Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi. “Ngingakuqinisekisa ukuthi yithina esithathe isinqumo sokumumisa uZungu kuze kuba kuphutholwa uhlelo lokuqondiswa kwakhe ubugwegwe ngemuva kokuthi ekhulume ngezindaba zenhlangano kwabezindaba. Isinqumo sokumumisa sisidlulisele kwisigungu esiphezulu,” kusho uNkk Nzuza. UNkk Nzuza akazange athande ukwenaba kakhulu ngalolu daba, wacela ukuthi kuthintwe umkhulumeli weqembu uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa. Imizamo yokuthola uHlengwa ayizange iphumelele. Ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa kanti nomyalezo athunyelelwe wona kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engawuphendulile. Isolezwe linayo ikhophi yencwadi ebhalwe isiyingi sasoSizweni eqinisekisa ukumiswa kukaZungu enhlanganweni. Ethintwa uZungu izolo, uthe ayikho incwadi asayitholile evela esiyingini sabo ekhuluma ngokumumisa enhlanganweni. UZungu uthe isiyingi sasoSizweni asinawo amandla okumumisa enhlanganweni. “Abantu abanamandla okungimisa isigungu esiphezulu kuphela. Into engenziwa isiyingi ukungibizela emhlanganweni sixoxe,” kusho uZungu. UNobala-jikelele we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe ngokulawulwa uMthethosisekelo isiyingi sinawo amandla okuthatha izinqumo bese sibikele izinhlaka eziphezulu. “Okwamanje akukho ebesisakutholile okuvela esiyingini sasoSizweni, mhlawumbe basenza izinhlelo zokusibikela. Uma isinqumo besithathe izolo (ngoMsombuluko) asilindele ukuthi namhlanje (ngoLwesibili) ngabe sekukhona esikutholile,” kusho uHlabisa. UZungu ube sezindabeni ngemuva kokuphumela obala wakhalaza ngemiphumela yengqungquthela yeqembu nokulapho ebhalele ubuholi obuphezulu beqembu kubalwa noButhelezi, wacela ukuthi kwenziwe impinda yengqungquthela. Le ncwadi uyibhale emuva kokuthi amalungu eqembu anganeme wona aqome ukuzifihla ngoba esaba ukuhlukunyezwa ekhalaze kwabezindaba nokuyilapho esole khona uButhelezi ngokukhomba ngentshebe uMnuz Thami Ntuli ogcine ekhethwe njengoSihlalo omusha weqembu equmba phansi imbangi yakhe uMnuz Mbangiseni Yengwa.
UMHLENGI Radebe onethemba lokuyofunda phesheya uma konke kuhamba kahle Isithombe:SITHUNYELWE UMHLENGI Radebe onethemba lokuyofunda phesheya uma konke kuhamba kahle Isithombe:SITHUNYELWE ANGASE aphuthwe yithuba lokuyofunda phesheya umfundi waseMobeni, eThekwini, okumele azigcwalisele imali yokuyofundela ezobuchwepheshe. UMhlengi Radebe (19) obefunda u-matric eGlenwood High, wamukelwe ukuthi ayokwenza izifundo zoLwazi Buchwepheshe eWilliam Penn University, e-United States of America (USA). Ukuthola ithuba lokuyofunda kuhambisana nokuthi uke wamenywa e-USA ukuyomela abafundi. UMhlengi, obekuvele kuyiphupho lakhe ukwenza izifundo zobuchwepheshe, uthe ngonyaka odlule waphasa ngo-A ababili. “Okwenze ngifake isicelo sokuyofunda phesheya wukuthi ziningi izinsiza zokufunda ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Ngifisa ukuthi uma sengiqedile ukufunda khona, ngibuye ngizothuthukisa abanye abafundi ngolwazi lwezobuchwepheshe,” kusho uMhlengi. Isicelo sakhe saphendulwa ngoJuni. Watshelwa ukuthi yize ezozikhokhelwa ezinye izindleko, kumele azikhokhele ezinye izifundo. Lokho kuchaza ukuthi udinga uR300 000 ukuze kufezeke iphupho lakhe. Bekumele ngabe uqale ukufunda ngo-Agasti kodwa wangaphumelela ngoba imali ayikahlangani. Uphinde wabhalela inyuvesi yamzwela, manje sekumele aqale ngoJanuwari. “Sengizamile ukubhalela osomabhizinisi ngicela uxhaso kodwa abekho abathembisayo. Ekhaya ngihlala nomama, ugogo nomkhulu nabo abangenawo amandla okuhlanganisa imali,” kusho uMhlengi. Echaza ngokuya kwakhe phesheya phambilini, uthe wakhethwa uthisha wakhe esafunda uGrade 9. Kwakufuneka abafundi abazokwethamela ingqungquthela yezobuholi ngo-2015 eWashington DC.

UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yesizwe. Isithombe: Phando Jikelo/African News Agency(ANA) UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yesizwe. Isithombe: Phando Jikelo/African News Agency(ANA) PHEZU kokuba izinyunyana zothisha ziyamukela inkulumo kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngendaba yokuthuthukisa imfundo ngokuthi kube nama-tablet kubona bonke abafundi kuleli kodwa ezinye izinto zithi zingagcina zingenzekanga. URamaphosa umemezele izinto eziningi uhulumeni ahlose ukuzenza kwezemfundo njengokuthi uhlelo lwama-tablet luqale ezikoleni ezisemakhaya nasemalokishini, kuguqulwe izikole eziningi zibe ngezamakhono kanjalo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kunezindlu zangasese kuzona zonke izikole. UMengameli weNatu, uMnuz Allen Thompson, uthe noma bekwamukela konke okushiwo nguMengameli ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo ebibhekiswe esizweni ngeledlule kodwa okunye kwakho ngeke kwenzeke. Uthe kumele kuqeqeshwe othisha ngezobuchwepheshe njengoba kuzomele bafundise abafundi abaphethe ama-tablet. Uqhube wathi kunezikole ezingenawo ugesi namanzi, izindlu zangasese, unogada futhi kazibiyiwe. “Uma uletha ubuchwepheshe obunje udinga zonke lezi zinto. Izikole azinikiwe nemali ngumnyango, ezinye azinazo nezincwadi zokufunda. Angiyiphathi eyonogada abakhokhelwa ngumnyango yiphupho ezikoleni eziningi okusho ukuthi uma sebufakiwe lobu buchwepheshe buzokwebiwa. Ezinye zezikole azinazo izindlu ama-strongroom okugcina impahla ebalulekile, kwezinye izicabha nama-buglar guards akukho,” kusho uThompson. Uthe kungathatha isikhathi ukuthi lezi zinto zilungiswe kuzona zonke izikole. “Sifuna ungqongqoshe wezemfundo kuzwelomke abuyise uhlelo lokuthi othisha bathole ama-laptop. Lolu hlelo kwaxoxwa ngalo lwaze lwaya nasePhalamende lwagcina lungafinyelelanga ndawo.” Uthe izinto eziningi uMengameli abekhuluma ngazo zizogcina ezikoleni ezazingama-Model C ezinezinsiza. Okhulumela iSadtu, uNksz Nomusa Cembi, uthe bafuna othisha baqeqeshwe ngezinto ezithinta ubuchwepheshe. Uthe bayakwamukela okushiwo nguRamaphsoa wathi kumele kusheshiswe indaba yezindlu zangasese. “Indaba yezindlu zangasese yinto okumele isheshiswe ngoba kunabafundi abafayo ngoba bephonseka kwingqalasizinda engekho esimeni. Abaqeqeshwe othisha ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezinto ezithinta ubuchwepheshe.” Uthe badumele ukuthi akukho okushiwo ngendaba yekhomishini eyajutshwa ngowayengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma eyayizobhekana namaholo abasebenzi bakahulumeni iqale ngawothisha. “Akushiwo lutho ngale khomishini okunalokho kukhulunywa indaba yokuthi kuzodilizwa. Siyajabula ngenkulumo kaMengameli kodwa ezinye zezinto kusekude ukuthi zenzeke.” URamaphosa umemezele nokuthi kuzoqalwa nezifundo zamakhono nezintsha okubalwa iTechnical Mathematics neTechnical Sciences, Maritime Sciences, Aviation Studies, Mining Sciences neQuaponics.
UNOBHALA omusha we-ANC uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli noMkhulumeli omusha we-ANC eKZN uNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu besesithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo Isithombe: Sithunyelwe UNOBHALA omusha we-ANC uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli noMkhulumeli omusha we-ANC eKZN uNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu besesithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo Isithombe: Sithunyelwe IZOZE ibe ngemuva kokhetho lonyaka ozayo ingqungquthela ye-ANC esifundeni iTheku obekulindeleke ukuthi ibe ngoDisemba kulo nyaka. Esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo, uNobhala omusha we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, uthe yize isinqumo sobuholi obuphezulu kwi-ANC sithi zonke izingqungquthela zezifunda kumele zibe ngaphambi kokuthi kuphele * -Agasti kodwa eyaseThekwini izoze isingathwe ngonyaka ozayo. UNtuli uthe kodwa izingqungquthela ezintathu eyaseMoses Mabhida, Lower South Coast naseHarry Gwala zona zizoba ngaphambi kokuthi kuphele * -Agasti. “Ubuholi besifundazwe buyaxoxisana nalezi zifunda ezintathu ngenhloso yokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi kufika isikhathi sengqunggquthela kukhona umoya wobumbano.”Uphinde waveza ukuthi ubuholi obusha abunazo izinhlelo zokwenza izinguquko kwiKhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal, echitha imibiko eke yasabalala nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana ethi bahlela ukwenza izinguquko. “Noma ngabe kuthiwa umuntu uwenza kanjani emsebenzini ajutshwe kuwona kodwa akuselula ukuthi singenza izinguquko ikakhulukazi njengoba sibheke okhethweni lukazwelonke ngonyaka ozayo.”UNtuli uphawula kanje, sekuphinde kwavuka izindaba ezithi uNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo kumele akhonjwe indlela ngenxa yesimo esingagculisi somnyango wakhe. I-ANCYL eKZN ifuna uDhlomo athathelwe izinyathelo ngodaba lwemishini yokwelapha umdlavuza. “Ngokwazi kwethu umnyango uyazama ukulungisa izinkinga ezikhona emnyangweni,” kusho uNtuli. Uthe ukungalibambi iqhaza kobuholi be-ANC emibuthanweni esuke inobengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma uma evela enkantolo kunikeza osomathuba indawo yokukhankasa besebenzisa igama likaZuma. “Ngenxa yesinqumo sobuholi obuphezulu kuzwelonke, i-ANC iyakwazi ukulawula kule mibuthano, uma engekho umholi noma ngubani uvele asukume azenze umholi,” kusho uNtuli. Uthe bonke osomathuba basebenzisa le mibuthano esuke inoZuma ukuziveza emphakathini. EMgungundlovu uZuma unxuse abantu ukuthi beseke ngevoti uKhongolose okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo, waphinde wathi abavoti bangamkhohlwa nomholi weLand First Black First (BLF) uMnuz Andile Mgxitama. Ebuzwa uNtuli ukuthi ukuphawula kukaZuma lapho ethi akuvotelwe uMgxitama akusikho yini ukuphula umgomo we-ANC, uthe kubalulekile ukuthi abantu babuke izinto ngeso elibanzi futhi elijulile, hhayi ukubuka ngokuphuma iqhubu nento ethile. “Obengumengameli ukhulume kabanzi ngokuthi abantu abavotele i-ANC phezu kwalokho wathi kuyilungelo labo abantu ukuthi bangavotela noma ngubani uma bethanda,” kusho uNtuli. Uthe uZuma ungumholi ohlonishwayo we-ANC futhi bazosebenza naye kakhulu nangesikhathi semikhankaso. Izolo i-ANC iphinde yethula ngokusemthethweni uNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu njengomkhulumeli wayo omusha. Iphinde yamemezela nosihlalo abasha bamakomiti ehlukene ebuholini bayo besifundazwe.
LUYASHUBA udaba lokushona kwesiguli emtholampilo eMzinto, njengoba kuthiwa unesi osolwa ngokungasinaki usenxuswe ukuba asule emsebenzini. Isolezwe lithole ngenhlangano iNurses Forum ukuthi ucelwe ngabaphathi bakhe ukuthi asule unesi wasePhungashe Clinic osolwa ngokuba budedengu okuholele ekushoneni kukaNksz Thobile Phungula (26). Lesi sigameko esenzeke ngoSepthemba 6 sithukuthelise umndeni kamufi, osola ubudedengu ngaso. Kuthiwa umufi wayelethwe emtholampilo ngo-2 ntambama, washona ngabo 10 ebusuku elinde i-ambulensi. UMnuz Bhekithemba Gumbi onguSihlalo weNurses Forum, uthe ngeke bavume ukuthi asule emsebenzini lo nesi ngoba akanacala. “Isiguli sasingaxinekile kodwa ukugula bekuhlasela iziqubu. Unesi wakwenza okwakufanele, kwashaya isikhathi sokuvala umtholampilo ntambama, wagoduka. Wabuyela emtholampilo ukuzobheka isiguli, waphinde washayela ucingo i-ambulensi. Lezi zindaba ezinjena ziqhatha onesi nomphakathi ekubeni kumele kugxekwe ukuphuza kokufika kwe-ambulensi,” echaza. Uthe sebezwile ukuthi uMnyango wezeMpilo uyaphenya, yingakho nabaphathi bamanesi bethe akasule ngoba udaba lwakhe lubucayi. UGumbi uthe bazomeseka unesi futhi bazoluhlonipha uphenyo. Ugxeke uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango onguMholi weDA esifundazweni obekhona emngcwabeni kaNksz Phungula, ogxeke onesi ngesenzo sabo. “Ngeke siphike ukuthi kunezinkinga emnyangweni ngoba onesi bayashoda. Abaholi abanjengoMncwango akumele bagxeke abasebenzi kodwa kumele baqinise ekutheni kulungiswe isimo emnyangweni, bezwe nezinkinga zabasebenzi,” kusho uGumbi. UNobhala wenyunyana yonesi iDenosa eKZN uMnuz Mandla Shabangu, uthe sebekhulumile nonesi. Uthe ngeke baqophisane nosopolitiki kodwa bazolinda umnyango, bayomela unesi. Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana onesi abaningi bagxeke uMncwango ngokugxambukela, basabisa nangokumashela emahhovisi eDA. UMncwango uthe uzwile ngokugxekwa kwakhe kodwa usamile ekutheni kumele baphenywe abangawenzi kahle umsebenzi ekubeni bephethe impilo yabantu. Uthe ulwethulile udaba kuNgqongqoshe uDkt Sbongiseni Dhlomo nasesiShayamthetho. UNksz Ncumisa Mafunda okhulumela umnyango uthe sebeqalile ukucubungula lolu daba futhi bazothatha izinyathelo ezifanele. Uyise kamufi uMnuz Mthethiswa Phungula uthe bathole ucingo kwabomnyango bebatshela ukuthi bayaphenya. Uthe kuke kwafika kabili abaphathi basemtholampilo bezobasayinisa kodwa wanqaba ngoba usola ukuthi bafuna ukushintsha isitatimende. UPhungula uthe umufi owayenenkinga yokuphefumula, washona emgade nonogada, onesi bengamnakile bekwelinye igumbi.
OWAYENGUNGQONGQOSHE wezokuXhuman uNksz Faith Muthambi. Isithombe: Phando Jikelo OWAYENGUNGQONGQOSHE wezokuXhuman uNksz Faith Muthambi. Isithombe: Phando Jikelo OWAYENGUNGQONGQOSHE wezokuXhumana, uNksz Faith Muthambi usole ibamba likaMqondisi Jikelele eMnyangweni wezokuXhumana, uNkk Phumla Williams, ngokuhubhuza amanga aluhlaza ngaye ngesikhathi lifakaza kwiKhomishini ephenya ngokugwamandwa kwamandla ombuso ngoMsombuluko. KuleKhomishini ephethwe iphini likaMengameli wamaJaji uRaymond Zondo, uNkk Williams ukhulume ngobuhlungu ayebuzwa ngaphansi kobuholi bukaNksz Muthambi, nokwaholela ekutheni abe nokhwantalala. Uthe impatho kaNksz Muthambi yamkhumbuza ukuhlukumezeka adlula kukho ngesikhathi eyisishoshovu se-ANC ngeminyaka yobandlululo kuleli. Uthe okwamphatha kabi kakhulu ngalokhu ukuthi uZuma wayazi ngendlela uMuthambi ayemphatha ngayo kodwa wangamthathela izinyathelo. Kwisitatimende asikhiphe ngoLwesibili ekuseni uNksz Muthambi uthe, uNksz Williams uhubhuza amanga ngabekusho efakaza phambi kweKhomishini. “Ngisalulekwa abammeli bami ngamampunge abethulwa uNksz Williams phambi kwekhomishini. Kuzovela elinye iqiniso futhi uzombuleka izinqe kubuka wonke umuntu,” kusho uNksz Muthambi esitatimendeni. FUNDA: Usole uZuma ngokuvikela uMuthambi Uqhube wathi inkulumo kaNkk Williams ifake ungabazane ngobuqiniso beKhomishini eqhubekayo. “UNksz Phumla Williams uwumuntu onamanga kunabo bonke abantu esengike ngabazi,” kusho uNksz Muthambi. UNkk Williams ngoMsombuluko usole uNksz Muthambi ngokungena emnyangweni wezokuxhumana ngezinhloso zokuzokhwabanisa futhi wayevikelwa uZuma. “Ngicabanga ukuthi uZuma wayemvikela uNksz Muthambi, angazi ukuthi kungani ngaphandle kokuthi kukhona imisebeni abayisusa kumina, bebezenzela umathanda lapha, bayazi ukuthi bengingeke ngiyivume lento abebeyenza yingakho banginqinda amandla," kusho uNkk Williams.
BASIZWE wukudayisa amagwinya bawafake ezinye izinto, bayeke ukuwafaka upholoni abadayisi basema-tuck shop kuleli BASIZWE wukudayisa amagwinya bawafake ezinye izinto, bayeke ukuwafaka upholoni abadayisi basema-tuck shop kuleli ABANTU baseNingizimu Afrika abasayingeni eyokudla upholoni nama-vienna okwavela ukuthi sekudlule nenqwaba yemiphefumulo emuva kokuqubuka kwesifo esibulalayo iListeriosis. Kuleli sonto kuvele ukuthi ukuthengwa kwalokhu kudla okusuke sekuphekiwe njengopholoni, amasosishi, amaviyena nokunye, kwehle ngo-75%, kwathi ukuthengwa kwemikhiqizo yenyama yengulube kwehla ngo-50%, okuyinto eseyenze ukuthi izinkampani ezidayisa lokhu kudla zehlelwe yinzuzo ngo-40%. UMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, utshele iPhalamende kuleli sonto ukuthi lesi sifo sidale nokuthi kube nabantu abangaphezu kuka-2 000 abalahlekelwe yimisebenzi. Uthe nabantu abazizamela ngokudayisa ukudla, okubalwa amagwinya nokunye okusheshayo njengamasosishi, bashayeke kakhulu ngenxa yale nkinga. “Ngesikhathi kuqala ukuvela izindaba ngalesi sifo, bashayeke kakhulu abantu abadayisa omagwinya, kodwa abanye bazisizile ngokuthi bayeke ukuwadayisa neminye mikhiqizo, bakudayise kodwa lokhu abasuke bezenzele khona," kusho uMengameli Ramaphosa obephendula imibuzo yelungu lePhalamende leDemocratic Alliance, uLindy Wilson, obefuna umengameli achaze ukuthi sekwenzekeni kuleli selokhu kwaqubuka iListeriosis. URamaphosa uthe umbiko awuthole kwiSouth African Meat Processing Association, okuyiyo esekhaleni lokubheka konke okwenzekayo kule mboni selokhu kwaqubuka lesi sifo, ukhomba nokuthi izinkampani ezithintekayo ezikhiqiza lolu hlobo lokudla, zidla ngamapayipi nakwezezimali. Nokho lezi zinkampani sezinxuswe wuhulumeni ukuthi zingafeli ngaphakathi kodwa azifake izicelo zosizo lwezezimali eMnyangweni wezokuHweba nezeziMboni kuleli. Uthe isicelo ngasinye sizobhekwa, ngeke kuthathwe isinqumo esizofaka uwonke wonke. Umengameli uthe njengamanje lokhu okuvelayo kuwumbiko wesikhashana, ukhona umbiko ozophinde ukhishwe njengoba kusabhekwa nokuthi ungakanani umonakalo owenzeke nasezitolo ezidayisa le mikhiqizo. Selokhu saqubuka lesi sifo ngoJanuwari 2017, bangaphezu kuka-200 abantu asebeshonile okubalwa kubo nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa (ngokombiko wezibalo wangoMeyi nonyaka).
Umbuzo: Sahlangana esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme nomyeni wami. Sibusiswe ngabantwana ababili. Umshado wethu awukaze ube mnandi selokhu kwathi nhlo. Inkinga umyeni ongafuni ukusebenza. Usuka ekhaya elimi kahle futhi ufundile ngakho angazi ngempela ukuthi inkinga ikuphi. Ujika nelanga imini yonke, mina ngimelwe yizo zonke izidingo zekhaya. Umndeni wakhe awenzi lutho ukwenza isimo sibe ngcono phakathi kwethu. Bengizitshela ukuthi umndeni wakhe uzoke ukhulumisane naye ukuze avuke azithathe njengendoda. Okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi akangazi nokuthi ngiyini mina umyeni wami. Sengihlalele izingane nje kuphela ngabe kade ngashiya. Mpho, eGoli Impendulo: Kungenzeka ukuthi umndeni wakhe awazi ngenhlalo yenu. Kuthiwa ingane engakhali ifela embelekweni ngakho alikho iphutha ngokuphumela obala ngobunzima obhekene nabo, ushilo nawe ukuthi umndeni wakhe ume kahle okusho ukuthi ungakwazi ukunisiza okwesikhashana. Kusengenzeka futhi ukuthi uyawuzama umsebenzi kodwa akawutholi, kucabange naloko okuyinto engaphezu kwamandla akhe naye. Umbuzo: Ngisemncane kanti ngishadelwe kuwo lo nyaka, sengishadelwa okwesibili. Okungimangazayo ngonkosikazi wami ukuthi uhleze ekhuluma ngomuntu ayethandana naye ngaphambilini njalo uma enabangani bakhe. Angazi ngempela ukuthi ngisithathe kanjani lesi senzo sakhe. Ngizizwa ngingathandwa kulo mshado ngenxa yokuthi ingathi inhliziyo yakhe isekomunye umuntu. Sandile, eThekwini Kusobala ukuthi unkosikazi wakho akazinikezanga isikhathi esanele sokudlulisa umuntu ayethandana naye ngaphambi kokungena kulomshado. Mazise ukuthi kukuphatha kanjani uma ekhuluma ngesoka lakhe elidala kubangani bakhe ekubeni eseshade nawe. Nginenkinga yomyeni oyingelosi uma engaphuzile kodwa uma eke wathinta utshwala ufana nesilwane. Ufika ekhaya ezinzulwini zobusuku uyosithuka nabantwana asishaye kuze kuse. Ngakusasa ungamphikela ukuthi bekunguyena. Kuvele kube sengathi akwenzakalanga lutho, impilo iqhubeke ngokujwayelekile. Ngiyazi ukuthi wakhula kanzima ekhaya lapho wayehlukunyezwa ngayo yonke indlela ongayicabanga kodwa manje le nto eyayenzeka kuyena useyenza kumina nabantwana. Ubulala konke esesikusebenzele kanzima sikwakha sobabili. Ngingenza kanjani ukuze umyeni wami abhekane nezinkinga zakhe ukuze nempilo yomndeni wethu ibe ngcono? Nozizwe, South Coast Utshwala isikhathi esiningi busetshenziswa ukuvala izinkinga ezithize umuntu asuke ebhekene nazo. Kodwa akhohlwe ukuthi uzokhohlwa izinkinga okwesikhashana ziphinde zibuye. Kubukeka sengathi kukhona nomyeni wakho asuke ezama ukukuvala ngotshwala. Zihamba kanjani izinto phakathi kwenu? Kuhamba kanjani emsebenzini wakhe? Akukho ongakucabanga okungamenza azifake otshwaleni ngale ndlela? Zama nokukhulumisana naye ngales siikhathi engasaphuzile ukuthola ukuthi yini ngempela emenza azilahlele otshwaleni. Umazise futhi ukuthi senihlalele ovalweni nabantwana ngoba anazi ukuthi uzobuya emsebenzini enjani. Okudlula lokho kuzomele umfunele usizo kwa-AA (Alcoholics Anonymous) yangakini ukuze bameluleke ngokufanele uma isimo singashintshi. Ngikhathele indoda engidonsa ngekhala. Ihleze ifuna ukwazi ukuthi ngikuphi ngisho noma yazi ukuthi ngisemsebenzini. Uma ngivakashele abangani ifuna ukwazi ikheli lalapho sikhona ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi ngikhona ngempela yini. Sekuze kwadlulela ngisho ezimpahleni zami zokugqoka, ifuna ukuba nesandla ekutheni ngizogqokani. Uma ngigqoke into engayithandi sizoxabana siyoze sibuye la siye khona. Ngiphila kanjani nomuntu ofuna ukuphatha impilo yami ngale ndlela? Igama ligodliwe Kuyacaca ukuthi umyeni wakho unokuzeya. Akukho ukuhlukumeza okudlula lokhu. Umyeni wakho udinga usizo ukuze akwazi ukuyeka le nto aseyiqalile.Sibona kukuhle ukuthi uqale uxoxisane naye ngokuthi ukwenza kwakhe kukwenza ungakhululeki futhi unovalo lokuthi uma engalutholi usizo kungagcina kunomthelela omubi kakhulu ebudlelwaneni benu. Uma engaliboni iphutha lakhe nangemuva kokuxoxisana naye sibona kungcono ukuthi umufunele usizo okusheshayo kodokotela bengqondo kungaze konakale kakhulu. Kusobala ukuthi zikhona izimo ezenze ukuthi abe kulendawo akuyona lapho engathembi lutho mekuza kumuntu athandana naye. Into enjengalena kukhona la esuka khona. Akekho umuntu ozalwa ezinyeza. SIDALWA yini lesi sifo? ZININGI izinto eziholela ekutheni umuntu abe nalesi sifo. Siphila esikhathini esinzima lapho isimo somnotho sisibi. Osebenzayo kubonakala ngokushintsha kwendlela asebenza ngayo, agcine esesalela ngemuva. ABANTU abanjani abaphathwa yilesi sifo? ASIKHETHI bala lamuntu. Akunjalo kukhona abantu abafundile, abanemali yonke abanaso lesi sifo. Izingane ezincane ezihlukunyezwe ngokocansi noma ekushintsha impilo yazo ngemuva kokudivosa kwabazali, ziba naso lesi sifo. SIYALAPHEKA yini lesi sifo? IPHUTHA elenziwa abantu ukucabanga ukuthi umuntu onalesi sifo unamadimoni, udinga ukuthandazelwa. Umthandazo wodwa awuselaphi lesi sifo. Umuntu kumele ahambe udokotela ozomnika amaphilisi azomsiza ukulapha lesi sifo. UNGAMESEKA kanjani umuntu onalesi sifo? KUMELE umlalele uma ekhuluma. Uthole ukuthi yini inkinga yakhe umeseke ngaso sonke isikhathi. Abanalesi sifo bafela ngaphakathi ngoba abantu abaningi abasiqondi. Akumele umshiye ahlale yedwa isikhathi eside. AMAKHOLWA aseLuthela KwaMashu kwaF afike kulenga izingidi ezintsha, esangweni esontweni, izolo kusolwa ukuthi ukukhiywa kwaleli bandla kuhambisana nomkhankaso wamalungu athile afuna ukuthi umfundisi walo ahambe Isithombe: Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng/African News Agency (ANA) AMAKHOLWA aseLuthela KwaMashu kwaF afike kulenga izingidi ezintsha, esangweni esontweni, izolo kusolwa ukuthi ukukhiywa kwaleli bandla kuhambisana nomkhankaso wamalungu athile afuna ukuthi umfundisi walo ahambe Isithombe: Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng/African News Agency (ANA) ABEVALWE ngezingidi amasango amasonto amabandla amabili aKwaMashu izolo, bekhala ngabefundisi. Izolo amaLuthela akhonza egatsheni laKwaMashu, eSangweni,elikwa-F, elidume ngokuthi yisonto loZalo ngenxa yokuthi umdlalo we-tv, Uzalo lusebenzisa leli sonto uma ludlala indawo yesonto, agcine ebamba umhlangano lapho kupakwa khona izimoto, isango lesonto likhiywe ngezingidi, ezintsha. Esangweni bekunanyathiselwe amaphepha athi umfundisi (KB Maseko) onezinyanga ezintathu engalubhadi kuleli gatsha, uyalixova, futhi unabantu abathandayo nangabathandi. Kuthiwa izinkinga ziqale kuleli gatsha ngesikhathi umfundisi nowakwakhe bekhombisa ukungaseseki isigungu esisha sokuphathwa kwesonto esikhethwe ngoMashi, ngoba kuphume abantu abefuna babuyele kulo mkhandlu behlulwa okhethweni. Kuthiwa isigungu esisha sokuphathwa kwaleli gatsha esiholwa uNkk Nonhlanhla Khanyile asizange sinikwe ngokusemthethweni izintambo obekumele kwenziwe ngoMeyi. Kuthiwa umkhandlu omdala bekumele ubikele ibandla ukuthi ushiye kukhona imali engakanani esikhwameni sebandla, uchaze wenzeni kule minyaka eyisithupha uphethe, uchaze nangezinkontileka zaleli bandla nabathile okubalwa neyoZalo, kodwa alizange likwenze lokho. UNkk Khanyile uvumile ukuthi leli gatsha linezinkinga, wathi umkhandlu awuholayo uhambise uhla lwezikhalo enhlokohhovisi, kodwa kwathiwa abayilandelanga imigomo yokufaka izikhalo. “Namhlanje bekumele sibikele ibandla ukuthi sesihambe sagcina kuphi, sesifika kuvalwe amasango,” kusho yena. USihlalo womkhandlu waseNtuzuma, igatsha laKwaMashu elingaphansi kwaso, uMnuz Thabani Mazibuko, uthe abanalo igunya lokungena bagxile edabeni oselwedluliselwe ezingeni elingaphezulu kwabo, njengoba selubikwe kumphathi wesifunda saseThekwini. Uthe udaba lokungeneliseki kwamanye amalungu ebandla lwadingidwa umkhandlu omusha ngoMeyi asibanga khona isisombululo base bethumela amaminithi alowo mhlangano kwisekethe (eThekwini). Uthe bezwile ukuthi kube nokuphazamiseka kwenkonzo ekuseni, okuyinto ebashaqisile nabo. E-Apostolic Faith Mission, KwaC, KwaMashu ebuye yaziwe ngeMaranatha nakhona amalungu aleli bandla abegcwele ngaphandle, amasango ekhiywe yingxenye yamakholwa aleli bandla abebhikisha ethi umfundisi wawo akayindawo. Abesho kanjena nje ngoba isifunda saleli bandla saseThekwini besizobikela amakholwa ukuthi umfundisi waleli gatsha uzogcina ezinyangeni ezimbili ngoba utholakale enamacala okwephula imithetho yebandla. Abahambisana noPastor Simon Mdletshe bebethi uboshelwe amanqina enyathi wethweswa amacala osekuthiwa utholakale enecala kuwo. Ngaphandle kwesango amakholwa abehlukene kabili amanye ethi akahambe, amanye ethi akayindawo. UPastor Tyrone Goliath wesifunda saseThekwini uthe uMdletshe ubephenywa ngamacala yinhlokohhovisi, okukhona kuwo awokusebenzisa budlabha imali, ukuhlanganisa igatsha laKwaMashu nelaseNanda wakha igatsha elilodwa elaziwa ngeMaranatha engayitholanga imvume kwabamphethe. Uqhube wathi uMdletshe wawavuma amacala ayebekwe wona. Kusukela izolo uthe leli gatsha lizolawulwa yisifunda, uma esehambile kuzolethwa umfundisi omusha. Lezi zindaba zimenyezelwe ngombhobho khona ngaphandle kwesonto.

Ngokuzwa kwami indaba yonakale uma sekufanele bangene kubo kantombi esethi akuyiwe ehlathini engasayingeni eyokuya kubo kwantombi. Ingane yakithi ifele into engekho ngoba intombi ithi ayimazi umuntu okuthiwa uS’bu, isoka eyayihleli nalo ngalelo langa liyayisho.” Uthe okubenza babe novalo ukuthi abalibonile leli soka ngesikhathi lihamba libalekela amaphoyisa bathi lithe liyabuya, akwaziwa ukuthi njengoba libuya nje libuyela bani. “Sonke siyesaba futhi sizwile ukuthi like labonakala ebusuku ngawo uMgqibelo.” UMnuz Prem Balram weReaction Unit South Africa (RUSA), uthe onogada beRUSA bahambe namaphoyisa beyofuna intombi obekusolwa ukuthi ineshende ngenhloso yokuthi iyokhomba lapho kuhlala khona isoka layo, bafike itshe selome inhlama, isoka kuthiwa libonakale liphethe isikhwama lihamba. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-34 udutshulwe washona ngumuntu owaziwayo endaweni ngoMgqibelo. Uthe umufi uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela washonela khona ngoba ubelimele ekhanda emuva kokudutshulwa. “Imbangela yokudutshulwa kwakhe ayaziwa, amaphoyisa asezithendeni zakhe umsolwa," kusho uCaptain Gwala

Isithombe: Phando Jikelo/African News Agency(ANA) UKHUZA ibuya kuhulumeni uNksz Bathabile Dlamini oke waba wungqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi. Isithombe: Phando Jikelo/African News Agency(ANA) OWAYENGUNGQONGQOSHE wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Bathabile Dlamini uthi akanandaba nabamgxekayo bemenza idimoni kodwa ujabulela ukuphinda athole ithuba lokusebenzela abantu ngoba yilokho akwazi kangcono. UNksz Dlamini onguMengameli we-ANCWL, ubephawula emuva kokuqokelwa esikhundleni sokuba nguSihlalo weBhodi elingaphansi koMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwabantu, elibizwa ngeSocial Housing Regulatory Authority (SHRA). Uqokwe nguNgqongqoshe woMnyango uNkk Lindiwe Sisulu ukuba ahole lolu phiko olungaphansi komnyango wakhe. UNksz Dlamini uqokelwe kulesi sikhundla emuva kokuhlala ekhaya isikhashana engabuyiselwanga kwiKhabhinethi. Uke waba sematheni ngezindaba eziningi kukhalwa kakhulu ngendlela asebenza ngayo. Wesula nasesikhundleni sokuba yilungu lePhalamende emuva kokushawa ngesithende ngesikhathi uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ebophela isikimu esisha. “Ngibonga usisi Lindiwe Sisulu ngokwethembela kimi. Kwakunomkhankaso wokungcolisa igama lami kube ngathi ngiyidimoni. Ngizimisele ngokubeka abantu phambili ngaso sonke isikhathi ngoba ngiyathanda ukusebenzela abahlwempu,’’ kuchaza uNksz Dlamini. Echaza ngezivuvaba ake abhekana nazo esengungqongqoshe, uthe yisimo esamhlukumeza kakhulu yena nomndeni wakhe nabazali bakhe asebebadala kakhulu. "Angithi abazali bami basekhona futhi baneminyaka engu-84, manje bebehlukumezeka kakhulu uma ngihlunyezwa nami. Izingane zami zathwala kanzima ngaleso sikhathi. Kungcono manje sengizihlalele ekhaya ngiyakwazi nokunakekela izingane. Lo msebenzi enginikwe wona manje akuwona owansuku zonke,’’ Ebuzwa ngeKhabhinethi, uthe impilo yakhe kayincikile ekungeneni kwiKhabhinethi kodwa incike ekusebenzeleni abantu ngezindlela ezehlukene noma engekho kwiKhabhinethi. Kulindeleke ukuthi aqale maduze emsebenzini omusha njengoba eveze ukuthi useke wavela ehhovisi, kwalungiswa konke okuyimicikilisho watshelwa kabanzi nangomsebenzi wakhe.
KUZOQEDWA uhlelo lokuhambisela umphakathi waseMsinga amanzi ngamaloli ngenxa yokunyuka ngamandla kukaphethroli. Umasipala uthathe isinqumo sokuba kugxilwe ekufakweni amanzi adonswa phansi nasemifuleni ngamapayipi ukuze wonge imali. Lokhu kuvezwe iMeya yaseMsinga uNkk Buyiswa Ngcobo ephawula ngohlelo oluqhubekayo lokufakelwa kwamanzi ezigodini ezahlukene zaseMsinga oluqalwe ngesonto eledlule, oluphethwe uMasipala wesiFunda uMzinyathi. “Ngendlela uphethroli obiza ngayo sesibone kungcono ukuthi amaloli esiwasebenzisayo siwamise nakuba kungeke kwenzeke masishane kodwa yinto esifuna ukuyenza ngoba nakhu umasipala omkhulu ususilekelele wasifakela amanzi adonswayo afinyelela kalula emphakathini esiwakhele. Uphethroli uyinkinga kakhulu kithi njengoba singumasipala obheke imali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni. Izindawo zethu eziningi ezingenamanzi ziningi futhi zikude okwenza sikhokhele kakhulu uphethroli uma kuyiwa kuzo,” kusho uNkk Ngcobo. Uthe bazokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi zonke izigodi zithola amanzi afakwa ngamapayipi ngokushesha ukuze bahlukane nokusebenzisa amaloli. Uthe izizumbulu abazikhokha bethenga uphethroli sebezozisebenzisela ezinye izidingo zomphakathi waseMsinga. UMsinga uyingxenye yezindawo zaKwaZulu-Natal ezakhahlamezwa kakhulu isomiso kusuka ngo-2013. UNkk Ngcobo uveze ukuthi indawo yabo iyodwa yafelwa izinkomo ezingaphezulu kuka-2000 zomphakathi ngenxa yesomiso njengoba kwasekushe notshani namanzi. Yize uNkk Ngcobo ezishaya isifuba ngohlelo lokufakelwa kwabantu amanzi kodwa kukhona amalungu omphakathi akhonondayo ukuthi amapayipi afakiwe ezindaweni zawo awawakhiphi amanzi, okwenza bancamele uhlelo lwamaloli. UNkk Ngcobo uthe isimo lesi abasilungisayo ngoba ezinye izindawo ziyenyukela kodwa basebenza ngamandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyawathola amanzi.

Le nto isitshela ukuthi kusamele sibhukule silwe, silwele amalungelo ethu. Njengamanje kulukhuni satshe ukuthi umuntu wesifazane athole isiza emhlabeni wamakhosi. Uma engenayo indoda kudingeka abe nendodana okuyiyona ezomumela. Njengamanje kukhulunywa ngokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Uma lungekho uhlelo oluqondene nathi singabantu besifazane sizophinde sisale ngemuva futhi nakulona. Sifuna uhulumeni achaze ukuthi ingxenye engakanani yomhlaba ezokwabelwa abesifazane,” kusho yena. Isithombe REUTERS UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa okuvele imibiko yokuthi kukhona abahlela ukumketula esikhundeni sakhe kwi-ANC. Isithombe REUTERS BAVEZE imibono eyehlukene abahlaziyi bezepolitiki mayelana nomhlangano wabaholi abathile be-ANC okubalwa nobengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma lapho kuthiwa bekuboshwa kuwo uzungu lokuketula uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa. Imihlangano ingenye yezindlela zepolitiki kodwa ngenxa yokuthi akukho ukwethembana sekuvela izinsolo ezifana nalezi,” kusho uKhumalo. Ebuzwa ukuthi ngakube izinsolo aziwulimazi yini umkhankaso kaSabelo ogaqele isikhundla sokuba ngumengameli we-ANCYL, uKhumalo uthe ziwushaye phansi ikakhulukazi njengoba imiphumela yezingqungquthela kwi-ANC igqugquzelwa yizimbangi. “Naye uyabona ukuthi izinsolo ziyamlimaza yingakho komunye umthombo wezindaba ethe ufisa kwenziwe uphenyo ukuze kuvele iqiniso,” kusho uKhumalo. Ilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC, uMnuz Zizi Kodwa, lithe abazi lutho ngomhlangano ngoba kwakungesiwo owe-ANC. “i-ANC ayikaze ibe nomhlangano, kukubona abantu okuthiwa babesemhlanganweni ukuthi basho ukuthi babekhuluma ngani,” kusho uKodwa. Kukhona abanye engike ngixoxe nabo abangitshela ukuthi wabafaka nasezidakamizweni ngoba kunguyena obethenga yonke into uma enabo,” kuqhuba uNgane. Okusho ukuthi yena ubezitshela ukuthi yimina othenge utshwala,” kusho uZakwe. Uthe kungenzeka ukuthi uNgane usenesilonda sokuthi washiya enkampanini usafisa abuye. Uthe ngesikhathi ehamba wabhala incwadi esho ukuthi uyayiyeka inkampani ngoba uyabambezeleka emculweni okuyinto engahlangene nezinkinga athi ubenazo. Isolezwe ngeSonto linayo ikhophi yale ncwadi uNgane athi yabhalwa wuZakwe. UZakwe uvumile ukuthi washiya kungekho nkinga kwiSphethu Entertainment. Manje usengaphansi kweMabala Noise engaphansi kwe-Universal Music njengoba esanda kukhipha iCebisa ngaphansi kwayo.
ONGOTI bathi noma ungangeneliseka kanjani ngophathina wakho kodwa kuyabubulala kakhulu ubudlelwane ukukhuluma ngaye kwabanye abantu ONGOTI bathi noma ungangeneliseka kanjani ngophathina wakho kodwa kuyabubulala kakhulu ubudlelwane ukukhuluma ngaye kwabanye abantu IMANGAZE abafundi baleli phephandaba indoda ebhalele ingosi yeZothando muva nje, ikhononda ngobuvila nokungazithandi komkayo. Uzigxekile izenzo zalaba besilisa abagxeka abashade nabo ngoba sebebona okubi. “Okumele kwenzeke ukuthi nabo abesifazane bangashintshi uma sebeshadile. Uma umyeni wakho wakuthanda ngoba uzinakelela, unomzimba okahle, ungaziyekeleli uma usuthole umshado. Ngeke sikuphike nakho ukuthi isikhathi esiningi indoda imgxeka kakhulu umkayo uma isithole omunye. Noma ngabe kubi kanjani okwenziwa uphathina wakho kumele umvikele, ungamgxeki phambi kwabantu,” kusho yena. Yize umama nobaba bebehlale bezikhuluma izilimi zabo isiXhosa nesiShangane/Tsonga uma kuvakashe izihlobo zethu kodwa alikho nelinye ilanga lapho sazibona khona ukuthi singamaShangane kuqala andube sibe ngaMaZulu. Abazali bethu basikhulise ngendlela yokuthi sizibone siyizakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika kuqala andube sizibone imvelaphi yethu engicabanga ukuthi yikho okwenza singazizwa sicwasekile ekukhuleni kwethu. Ngiyakhumbula ukuthi njalo ngeSonto odadewethu babethi uma bebuye esontweni bagqoke imvunulo yesiShangane, ebizwa ngokuthi umtsheko noma iShibhelani, banconywe uma behamba ngaphakathi elokishini abantu bencoma ubaba ngokuziqhenya kwakhe ngemvelaphi yakhe. Ekukhuleni kwami ngifunda ngizazi ukuthi ubuzwe bami ngiliShangane. Ngitholile ukuthi lapha kwelikaMthaniya uma umuntu ekhuluma ulimi olungelona olwesiNguni kuvele kuthiwe uliShangane. Kuhambe kwahamba leli gama lokubiza umuntu ngeShangane lathatha isimo sokuba yindelelo nokuthuka engicabanga ukuthi yiyo imbangela edala intukuthelo kwabanye uma bebizwa ngalo ngenxa yokungazi. Kwabanye bethu, ukubizwa ngento oyiyona akusiyo into esiyithatha ngokuthi yindelelo futhi asiqwashi ngisho ukuqwasha ngoba sivele sibone ukuthi labo abasho njalo yingoba bengazi lutho. Abanye uthi ungabatshela ukuthi unguMshangane usuyobona bekubuza izinto eziyimikhuba abezwa kuthi zezinzwa ngamaShangane, ezinye ezingelona iqiniso. File image: IOL File image: IOL AMAPHOYISA axwayisa umphakathi ukuthi uqaphele imisebenzi esolisayo ekhangiswa emaphephandabeni nakwi-internet, eminye yawo eyingxenye yomkhuba wokushushumbiswa kwabantu. UCaptain Khephu Ndlovu okhulumela amaphoyisa eThekwini, uthe kujwayelekile ukuthi kusukela ngoDisemba ibe miningi imisebenzi ekhangiswayo, abanye abazithola sebegilekile ngenxa yayo. Ugcizelele ukuthi abantu balandelele ukuthola kabanzi ngomsebenzi okhangiswayo, ngaphambi kokwenza izinhlelo zokufaka izicelo. “Esihlale sixwayisa ngakho abantu wukuthi awukwazi ukuvele uthole umsebenzi ungakaze usifake isicelo sawo. Ngokujwayelekile uma ufaka isicelo somsebenzi, ugcwalisa ifomu ubizelwe nakwinhlololwazi. Kubalulekile ukubheka yonke imininingwane ngalowo msebenzi nokuthi amahhovisi awo akuphi,” kuchaza uNdlovu. UNdlovu uxwayisa nangokuthi abantu babuze yonke imibuzo ukuze baneliseke ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo somsebenzi. Ngisho kuwumsebenzi waphesheya uthe ikhona indlela yokuwucubungula. “Ungasheshi ujahe umsebenzi kodwa ungacaciselekile kahle ngawo. Akumele ngisho wenze izinhlelo zokuhlangana nomuntu ongamazi. Okunye abantu abakwenzayo ukuthi bafihlele ngisho imindeni yabo ngoba befuna ukubamangaza uma sebethole amadlelo aluhlaza. Ukwazisa othize kuyasiza uma usuzithola usenkingeni. Uma kuwumsebenzi waphesheya, wonke amazwe anamahhovisi amanxsusa awo, okuyiwona angasiza ukukucacisela ngomsebenzi okhangisiwe,” kusho uNdlovu. Kwenzeka lokhu nje lusematheni udaba lowesifazane oneminyaka engu-22 waseKings William Town e-Eastern Cape, otakulwe oKlebe esezoshushumbiswa. Lo wesifazane oyiBeauty Therapist, kuthiwa wabona kukhangiswa umsebenzi kwi-internet, wenziswa inhlololwazi ngeSkype. Ubeselungiselwe ngisho ithikithi lebhanoyi eliya e-Uganda ngoLwesine olwedlule. Unina usolile ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ngalo msebenzi, waxhumana noKlebe abathole ukuthi ubeyosebenza kwenye indawo yokudla. OKlebe bamjikise esikhumulweni sezindiza e-OR Tambo eGoli, wabuyiselwa kubo ngeSonto. Okhulumela oKlebe e-Eastern Cape uCaptain Anelisa Femi, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lo wesifazane usebuyiselwe ekhaya. “Uphenyo lusaqhubeka emuva kokuba lo wesifazane kutholakale ukuthi ubehlelelwe ukushushumbiswa. Akekho oseboshiwe kodwa sekutholakele ukuthi ubengaqashelwa umsebenzi obukhangisiwe kodwa ubeyosebenza kwenye indawo yokudla. Amaphoyisa aqale uphenyo ngoba umndeni wakhe ubusola ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngalo msebenzi,” kusho uCaptain Femi.
