ISIFO senhliziyo sidlangile kubantu besilisa ikakhulu labo abangobaba abahlala emakhaya. Balinganiselwa ku- 25 961 abantu besilisa abashona ngenxa yalesi sifo. UNksz Nicole Jennings, okhulumela inkampani yemithi egxile ezifweni ezithikameza ukusebenza kwenhliziyo iPharma Dynamics, uthe abantu besilisa abaningi bafisa ukuba nempilo elula yokuhlala ekhaya kodwa abacwaningi bathi ukushintshela ekubeni wubaba ohlala ekhaya kunganomthelela ongemuhle enhliziyweni. Uthe lokhu bakuthathela ocwaningweni olwenzelwe i-US National Institutes for Health obelubheka ukuthi imisebenzi eyenziwa abantu inamthelela muni esimeni sabo sempilo. “Ucwaningo lwalubheka abantu besilisa nabesifazane abangu-3 600 esikhathini esingangeminyaka engu-10 sathola ukuthi abesilisa ababengabayeni abahlala emakhaya esikhathini eside ebudaleni babo bebesemathubeni angu-82% okufa ngenxa yesifo senhliziyo uma beqhathaniswa nabesilisa abasebenza bengekho emakhaya,” kusho uNksz Jennings. Imiphumela etholakele ihambisane nolunye ucwaningo olwenziwe yiNyuvesi iRutgers e-USA eveze ukuthi kubantu abashadile abangu-1 095 ababhekwe iminyaka engu-30 luthole ukuthi abesilisa abahlala emakhaya lapho kungomama abondlayo bebevame ukuthi babe nezinkinga zezempilo okubalwa kuzo izilonda esiswini nesifo senhliziyo nezinye. Uthe okuholela ekutheni abantu besilisa abahlala emakhaya babe nalezi zinkinga kungenxa yokuhluleka ukwamukela ukuthi akusebona abanamandla okondla imindeni yabo. UNksz Jennings uthe obaba abahlala emakhaya kungenzeka bagcine sebebhema kakhulu, bephuza noma bedla ngendlela okungesiyo ngoba bezama ukumelana nesimo sabo sokuzizwa bengasewona amadoda ngenxa yokungakwazi ukondla imindeni yabo. Lokhu kugcina kuholele ekutheni bagcine sebenezifo okubalwa kuzo esenhliziyo, esikashukela nezinye. Uthe yize sekunoshintsho olukhulu olwenza ukuthi abantu besifazane bagcine besebenza, bondla imindeni, abesilisa abaningi basazibona kuyibona abafanele ukondla imindeni yabo. Lokhu kubenza bazizwe behlelwa yisithunzi uma amakhosikazi abo nophathina babo kuyibona abondla imindeni yabo.
UKUBE alifikanga iloli elicisha umlilo livela esikhumulweni iPrince Mangosuthu Buthelezi Airport, ngabe ishe yangqongqa inxanxathela yezitolo Ulundi Plaza ngoba uMasipala wasoLundi awunalo iloli lokucisha umlilo omkhulu. Lokhu kudalulwe yiMenenja kaMasipala wasoLundi, uMntwana uNkosenye Zulu, engxoxweni ekhethekile neSolezwe emuva kokusha kwezitolo ezinhlanu, ikhemisi nezindawo zokusebenzela odokotela ezintathu, oLundi Plaza, ngoLwesibili ntambama. UZulu uthe umlilo uqale esitolo sefenisha i-OK Furniture wase uthungeleka ekhemisi, wadlulela ezitolo zezimpahla nasendaweni kadokotela wamehlo, eyowamazinyo neyowezifo zonke (GP). “Imenenja yakwa-OK ithe umonakalo ubalelwa ngaphezu kuka-R2 million. Abanye abanikazi bezitolo bebesaqoqa impahla engashanga ngoba umlilo uqale kwa-OK kwase kuhanguleka ezinye izitolo. Sibuhlungu ngale nhlekelele evelile futhi sicela umhlonishwa uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube asilekelele sithole iloli lokucisha umlilo,” kusho uZulu. Uthe uma kunomlilo baye basebenzise iveni enethangi lamanzi ukuwucisha kodwa le veni ihlulekile wukucisha owayizolo. “Uma umlilo umkhulu siye sicele usizo kuMasipala waseZululand oneloli lokucisha umlilo elilodwa ukuzisa bonke omasipala abancane. NgoLwesibili, belisayoseviswa ngakho siye saxakeka. Kusize ukungenelela kweMeya yaseZululand, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, osicelele iloli lasePrince Mangosuthu Buthelezi Airport ukuba lizosicishela. Ukube alifikanga ngabe kushe yonke into,” kusho uZulu. Uthe abakwazi ukuzithengela iloli labo lokucisha umlilo ngenxa yokuthi bathola imali encane kwisabelomali sikazwelonke futhi ababaningi abantu abakhokha ama-rates njengoba bengumasipala wasemakhaya. Imeya yasoLundi, uMnuz Mfana Ntshangase, ithe baphatheke kabi ngokusha kwenxanxathela yezitolo ngoba kulapho abantu basemawadini awu-24 asoLundi bethenga khona. “Siyathemba uphenyo luzocacisa ukuthi umlilo uqalwe yini ngoba kuyashaqisa ukusha kwezitolo. Siyacela abantu bakithi bazithibe bangayi ukuyocosha impahla eshile ngoba bangase bawelwe yisakhiwo njengoba sishile,” kusho uNtshangase. Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwabakwa-OK Furnitures ayiphumelelanga ngoba abasekomkhulu labo bengathandanga ukuphawula ngokusha kwesitolo sabo esisoLundi. UCaptain Nqobile Gwala, wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe bawutholile umbiko wokusha kwezitolo Olundi kodwa alikho icala elivuliwe futhi nembangela yomlilo ayakatholakali. UMnuz Lennox Mabaso, ophethe ezokuxhumana eMnyangweni kaNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uthe kusazophenywa ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani ukuthi uMasipala wasoLundi ungabi nezinhlelo zokucisha umlilo. “Umnyango usiza omasipala abawu-54 futhi abathengelwa bonke amaloli okucisha umlilo. Kufanele uMasipala wasoLundi uhlele ukuthi uzozibhekelela kanjani izinhlekelele zomlilo. Akufanele uthathe imali ungenzi lutho,” kusho uMabaso.
UMSOLWA obhekene necala lokubulala isitshudeni saseMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT) esasihlala ezindlini zezitshudeni enkabeni yeTheku uqale ukwethula ubufakazi bakhe ngokutshela iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngothando ayenalo ngomufi. UThabani Mzolo obhekene necala lokubulala uZolile Khumalo, utshele inkantolo ukuthi babengamathe nolimu futhi babezitshela ukuthi bothandana baze bahlukaniswe ukufa. Uthe wayemthanda ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke umufi, naye ngokunjalo wayemtshela ukuthi umthanda okudlula abazali bakhe. UZolile wadutshulwa wabulawa endlini yakhe eLonsdale ngoMeyi 1 nyakenye. UMzolo waboshwa endaweni yesigameko ezintatha ngosuku olulandelayo. Elandisa inkantolo uveze nokuthi ubudlelwano bothando lwabo lwaqala ekuqaleni kuka-2017. “Sasithandana kakhulu. Uthando lwethu lwaluvuseleleka usuku nosuku ngizizwa ngimthanda kabusha. Wayengitshela nokuthi ungithanda okudlula abazali bakhe,” kusho uMzolo. Echaza ngosuku lwesigameko, uthe wanikela endlini yakhe ngoba engamtholi ocingweni. Uveze nokuthi babevele behlele ukubonana, wathi esemshayela ucingo ngenhloso yokumazisa ukuthi useyeza wangatholakala ocingweni uZolile. Yilapho anquma ukunikela endlini yakhe. “Sangqongqoza, uZolile wasivulela. Ngangena endlini ngahlala etafuleni, yena wahlala esihlalweni. Wathi naba abantu ebesingalindele ukuthi singababona. Wangibiza ngo-baby, wangibuza nokuthi nginjani. Ngamphendula ngokuthi angangibizi ngo-baby mina. Ngambuza ukuthi kungani engangishayeli ucingo,” kusho uMzolo. Eqhuba uthe incazelo kaZolile mayelana nokungazibambi izingcingo zakhe wathi wayesaphumile enza umsebenzi wesikole okwasekusondele isikhathi sokuthi awuthumele, neselula wayeyishiye endlini. UMzolo uthe uZolile wathi umthumele umyalezo kwiWhatsapp emazisa ukuthi ukephi. “Ngathi kuye sihlala sithi sohlukaniswa ukufa. Ngeke kodwa kusenzeka ngoba ubudlelwane bethu base buphela ngenxa yesenzo sakhe sokungaziphenduli izingcingo zami,” kusho uMzolo. Uveze ukuthi emuva kwala mazwi wathi uma embuka emehlweni uZolile wambona ukuthi sekunesibhamu phakathi kwamathanga esihlalweni ayehleli kuso. Leli cala liyaqhubeka enkantolo.
MHLELI: Ngithi ake ngizikhalele kade ngibekezela kodwa manje sengiyahluleka sekufike la ngidinwa khona abantu badelela isibongo sasekhaya (Mkhize) ezinkundleni zokuxhuma. Le nto yaqala ngokweyiswa kwendawo engeke ngikwazi ukubiza igama layo. Manje sebengenele esibongweni sakaMkhize. Yonke into engasile isikhonjwa kaMkhize, umuntu wenza into ebhedayo usengowakaMkhize ngisho noSathane imbala sekuthiwa owakaMkhize. Kukhona nalesi siphuzo esibhalwa izibongo. Uzwa esethi umuntu ngiphuze ebesibhalwe ukuthi Mkhize ngavele ngaphathwa yikhanda, udideke ukuthi ubusithengelani esibhalwa uMkhize kwakhona ekuqaleni uma enenkinga noMkhize. Lesi sibongo sikhulu kabi, siyahlonishwa umhlaba wonke futhi siyathandwa kakhulu. Kukhona ngisho namaNdiya, abantu abasuka kwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika ubezwa sebezibiza ngoMkhize ngoba kuyisibongo esithandekayo. Noma yikuphi lapho uhamba khona uma uke wathi ungowakaMkhize abantu bavele bakujabulele ngoba bayathandwa kakhulu abantu bakaMkhize. Yisibongo samaqhawe lesi sihlonipheni ngiyanincenga. Ngiphakamisa izandla zombili ngiyanincenga hlukanani nesibongo sakaMkhize akusona esokudlala. Ngithemba ukuthi kuzwakele nizongilalela.
KUTHIWA ushonele ejele sekusele kancane aphume uThembinkosi Nyathi, umndeni wakhe ongakholwa ukuthi wagwazwa isiboshwa Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE KUTHIWA ushonele ejele sekusele kancane aphume uThembinkosi Nyathi, umndeni wakhe ongakholwa ukuthi wagwazwa isiboshwa Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE USELE nemibuzo ngelungu lawo elishonele ejele umndeni waseMgungundlovu, othi awanelisekile ngencazelo ngokuholele ekushoneni kwalo. Umndeni kaThembinkosi Nyathi (25) waseMpolweni, uthe umngcwabe ungakhululekile ngoba akucaci ukuthi wabulawa yini ejele. Uninalume kamufi uMnuz Sakhephi Nyathi, uthe wayegwetshwe ngo-2013 ngecala lokushaya nokugqekeza kanti bese kusele kancane aphume ejele. Uthe waqala waboshelwa eNew Prison kodwa ushonele eSevontein. “Udadewabo obejwayele ukumvakashela ejele futhi ubengakaze ambikele ukuthi kukhona axabane nabo. Kwafika ojele ekhaya ngoSepthemba 29 bezobika ukuthi uThembinkosi ushone ngayizolo. Basitshela ukuthi bekugwazana iziboshwa ejele, bangacacisa uma sibuza eminye imibuzo ngesigameko. Bathe uma sifuna enye incazelo kumele sikhulume nabaphathi bejele,” kuchaza uNyathi. Uthe isidumbu basilande ejele ngo-Okthoba 1 kodwa baxakeka uma bengawaboni amanxeba okugwazwa. UNyathi uthe umbiko kadokotela ohlole isidumbu uveza ukuthi walimala ekhanda. “Okubuhlungu, besilindele ukuthi aphume noma yinini umshana ngoba ubesewutholile ushwele. Sisola ukuthi ojele banolwazi ngokubulawa kwakhe. Asikholwa ukuthi wagwazwa isiboshwa,” kusho uNyathi. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uCaptain Nqobile Gwala uthe kuvulwe idokodo ngokufa komuntu. “NgoSepthemba 28 kwafika umbiko wesibhedlela ngokufa komuntu, amaphoyisa anikela khona. Ngesikhathi efika esibhedlela amaphoyisa akhonjiswa isidumbu sesiboshwa esineminyaka engu-25 kodwa kungabonakali manxeba emzimbeni. Kusalindwe ukutholakala kombiko ogcwele wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu ukuthola ukuthi umufi wabulawa yini.” UMnuz Thulani Mdluli okhulumela amajele esifundazweni ucele ukuthunyelelwa i-email ngoMsombuluko, ngoLwesibili wathembisa ukuthi bazophendula uma sebecubungule udaba. Kushaye isikhathi sokuloba izolo engakaphenduli.
UNETHEMBA lokuthi lizofezeka iphupho lokuba yiChartered Accountant uSthembele Ngejane oncamele ukulala emgwaqweni eyokwenza inhlolokhono yomfundaze eGoli UNETHEMBA lokuthi lizofezeka iphupho lokuba yiChartered Accountant uSthembele Ngejane oncamele ukulala emgwaqweni eyokwenza inhlolokhono yomfundaze eGoli SINCAMELE ukulala emgwaqweni Siyokwenza inhlolokhono yomfundaze eGoli, isitshudeni sase-University of South Africa (Unisa), osekuphele iminyaka emithathu singayitholi imali yokufunda. USthembele Ngejane (25) waseMount Moriah, uphenduke isilomo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana emuva kwesibindi sakhe asikhombise ngesonto eledlule. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ubengeke aphuthwe yithuba lomfundaze akade ayewudinga. UNgejane ohlala nonina ongasebenzi nodadewabo ababili, waqeda * -matric ngo-2014 eShayamoya High eKokstad, nakhona awufunde esehlale iminyaka emibili ehleli ekhaya ngenxa yokulimala engozini yemoto. Uveze ukuthi sekukaningi impilo yakhe ibambezeleka kodwa akalilahli ithemba. “Ngaqeda esikoleni ngafaka izicelo emanyuvesi ngangazithola izikhala. Ngagcina ngibamba amatoho ezitolo kodwa ngingalilahlile ithemba lokubuyela esikoleni. Ngo-2016 ngamukelwa e-University of Johannesburg ukuyokwenza iHuman Resources Management, ngashoda ngemali yokubhalisa. Ngiphinde ngamukelwa e-Unisa nakhona kwaba nenkinga yemali. Bengifaka ngisho izicelo kuNsfas kodwa ngingaphendulwa,” echaza. Kubuye ithemba kuNgejane kulo nyaka amukelwa e-Unisa ukuyokwenza iNational Diploma in Accounting Sciences. Kuthe esabhalisa ngesonto eledlule wathola ucingo oluqhamuka kwaNYDA ukuyokwenza inhlolokhono yomfundaze abewucelile e-East Rand eGoli. Uthe kwale ngisho ecela ukuthi bamenzisele emahhovisi aseThekwini, bathi udingeka eGoli. “Ngishayele izihlobo ngizama imali, zonke zangichitha. Ngivele ngabhala ibhodi elithi ngiya eGoli ukuyokwenza inhlolokhono yomfundaze, ngama emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka ngoLwesine ebusuku. Bengingenalo ngisho isenti ephaketheni. Emuva kwesikhathi eside ngamelwa owesifazane, naye engangithembi ngoba esola ukuthi ngiyisigebengu. Ugcine engigibelisile wangishiya eGoli, endleleni wangithengela ukudla,” kusho yena. Esefike eGoli ubhale ekhasini likaFacebook lase-Unisa, abantu babheka inombolo yakhe kuFacebook wakhe, bamshayela bamfakela imali. Uthe imali ibingena ubuthaphuthaphu abanye bemfakela i-airtime neyokudla. Ugcine ethengelwe nethikithi lebhasi lokubuyela ekhaya ngoLwesihlanu njengoba ethi ubengazi ukuthi uzobuya kanjani. Kumanje uselinde impendulo yomfundaze kusukela ngenyanga ezayo. Nokho selikhona ithemba lokuthi lizofezeka iphupho lokuba yiChartered Accountant. Uveze ukuthi usebizwe komunye umhlangano ngesinye isikhulu kwezemfundo esimthembise uxhaso.
UMBUZO: Ngishade ngo-2015 nomyeni wami ngenqubo yasesontweni yokuthi akujolwa futhi asibonani size sishade. Iqiniso lithi angazi ngaluthwa yini kulo muntu. Akasiyo nhlobo le nto engangiyifisa empilweni yami. Akanakho nokukodwa nje okungijabulisayo. Lokhu ngaqala ukukuzwa ezinsukwini ezimbalwa nje sishadile, ngabekezela ngoba ngithi mhlambe asikazani kahle. Kodwa kuyangicacela manje ukuthi akusilo ubambo lwami lolu, ngehluleka ngisho ukuzenzisa. Manje useGoli ngokusebenza, uma efikile ngifisa ngabe usehambile. Okubi nje sesinomntwana. Ngifisa ngisho ukuduka nezwe kunokuba kulo mshado kodwa uma ngicabanga ngomntwana wethu ngivele ngihlale. Ngicela ningisize. Igama ligodliwe, eThekwini IMPENDULO: Uma ushada nomuntu, noma ngabe kungaluphi uhlelo, nishada nobabili senikhulile, ninesipiliyoni sempilo ngokwehlukile. Abekho ababili abashada bese bayanamathelana ngokushesha. Kuthatha isikhathi ukunamathela koshade naye. Akekho noyedwa oshadile, oshade ubambo lwakhe. Sonke njengabashadile sifunda ukunamathela omunye komunye nsuku zonke. Uthando akuyona imizwa kodwa ukuthatha isinqumo nsuku zonke ukuthi uzozinikela ngenhliziyo yakho yonke kulo omganile. Bheka ukuthi yini ngempela ongayithandi ngomyeni wakho, bese nihlala phansi nikhulume. Siqinisekile ukuthi kukhona naye angakuthandi ngawe, ngoba sonke njengabantu asimsulwa. Ukuhlala nomuntu nithandane nize nihlukaniswe ukufa isinqumo ozithathela sona wena wedwa kuqala. Uthatha lesi sinqumo wethembise ukuthi uzomthanda lo oshade naye ngaphandle kokunaka amaphutha akhe. Usuke unquma ukuthi ubudlelwano benu bomshado buyobuswa yintethelelo, ukuthula nokwethembana. Ukuthanda umuntu akuzenzekeli, kuyasetshenzwa. UMBUZO: Sesineminyaka cishe ewu-9 sashada. Ngagana indoda emadodeni, sabusiswa nangezingane ezimbili. Akakaze angihluphe ngalutho. Uyena kuphela osebenzayo, njengoba savumelana ukuthi mina nginakekele izingane nomuzi wethu. Wenza konke engicabanga ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe yindoda. Inkinga nje ukuthi nginesizungu emshadweni wami. Ngazinikela kuye nakulo mshado ngale ndlela yokuthi yonke impilo yami ingomyeni nabantwana bami. Anginampilo ngaphandle kwabo. Akukho engingakwenzi ukujabulisa wonke umuntu la ekhaya. Kodwa mina angisenawo awami amaphupho, futhi loku kungiphatha kabi. Ngicela ningisize. Londiwe, eThekwini Akuve kulula ukuzibona usugwinywe umshado unganakile. Loku kwenzeka kakhulu kubantu besifazane ngoba bangabantu abazinikelayo sidalo. Kuyinto enhle ukuthi uyayibona le nkinga kusemanje. Kufanele uzinikele umshadweni wakho ngokuphelele kodwa ungazikhohlwa phela nawe. Qala ngokuthi kube nelanga nje elilodwa lakho esontweni lapho wenza khona noma yini oyithandayo eqondene nawe. Kungaba ukuyozivocavoca noma ukuya ekhaya kini uyobonana nabakini owaziyo ukuthi bayakuthanda. Zijwayeze ukuba nesikhathi esithi wena. Uma wawunabangani ngaphambi kokushada qala uvuselele lobo bungani. Kuyingozi enkulu ukulahlekelwa impilo yakho usesemshadweni ngezinhloso zokujabulisa umyeni wakho. Hlala phansi uvuselele konke okwakuyiphupho lakho. Kungaba ukuqhubeka nezifundo, ukuqala ibhizinisi noma ukubuyela emsebenzini nje. Cabangisisa nokuthi, njengoba ungasasebenzi nje, wawuyingxenye engakanani ekuthatheni leso sinqumo? Hlala phansi nomyeni wakho umtshele inkinga obhekene nayo. Ngineminyaka ewu-38, ngiganwe unkosikazi ona-27 weminyaka. Ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule uqale ukusabisa ngokushiya phansi umshado wethu ngenxa yobudoda bami obungasenamandla. Akukho engingakwenzi ekhaya njengendoda, inkinga yinye nje kuphela, ile yobudoda bami. Sengiyizame yonke imishanguzo nezimbiza ezivusa umlilo kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya. Kwala ngisho sengimthengela imoto kanokusho ukuzama ukumehlisa umoya kodwa lutho akulungi. Umshado wami usengcupheni. Ngenzenjani? Siyazwelana nawe mfowethu. Akulona iphutha lakho ngempela kodwa kumele umzwele noma kunjalo unkosikazi wakho. Kuthatha umuntu oqotho ukuhlala emshadweni ongenalo ucansi, okanye omunye engagculisekile khona ngokocansi. Kona kuyahlaleka, akuyona into engaze inenze nehlukane. Okubalulekile ukuthi nifunde nibe nezinye izindlela zokuzijabulisa. KUNGESIKHATHI izintombi sezihambisa umhlanga eSigodlweni seSilo eNyokeni KwaNongoma lapho ezihlolelwa khona ubuntombi. Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO KUNGESIKHATHI izintombi sezihambisa umhlanga eSigodlweni seSilo eNyokeni KwaNongoma lapho ezihlolelwa khona ubuntombi. Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO Sekujwayelekile ukuthi ngaso sonke isikhathi emuva kokubhala kule ngosi ngokusebenza nokwenziwa wumzimba uma kuyiwa ocansini, bese kuvela izicelo ezithi sikhulume sigcizelele umunxa othile. Kulokhu izicelo bezilokhu zilekanyana ezifisa sizimelele ontwentwesaneni oluyisicutshana esisekungeneni komgudu wesifazane. Lokhu bekuhambisana nesifiso sokuthi sikhulume nangokuya ocansini kusetshenziswa umgudu ongemuva. Nizongivumela ukuthi la mathafa womabili - untwentwesana esilubiza ngokuthi yiso nalolu hlobo lokuya ocansini - ngakunye yingosi ezimele. Iso liyatholakala ezilwaneni ezifana nezindlovu namahhashi. Ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi umsebenzi wami njengodokotela kule ngosi, wukunikeza umumomzimba nokusebenza komzimba, hhayi ukunikeza umbono okanye umcabango othile othinta isiko, inkolo okanye umcabango othile ngengosi noma ngami nomndeni wami. Izibalo zithi sikhula ngesivinini isibalo sabantu abasha nasebekhulile abaya ocansini lomgudu ongemuva. Izizathu zalokhu ziningi, zihlanganisa: Ukulangazelela kwabesifazane abasebancane ukugcina umgudu wezocansi ongaphambili ungabanga yingxenye yokuzithokozisa Ubumnandi obukhethekile obunanelekayo kule nhlobo yocansi Ukulangezelela ukuklama indima engesiye undabuzekwayo Ukuvuleleka ekuphileni ubulili oyibona. Ayiyinye indlela yokuya ocansini kodwa ziningi. Okuhluphayo wukuthi kuyaye kukhulumeke sengathi uluntu luya ocansini emgudwini ongaphambili kuphela kumuntu wesifazane, bese wonke amehlo athi njo ekuziphatheni okuthinta lo mgudu bese kukhohlakala ukuthi kuyayiwa ocansini kusetshenziswa ezinye izindawo zomzimba, kubengathi kwezinye izindawo kuvumelekile. Lokhu kwenza kuyadukisa futhi kuletha ingcindezi enkulu kwezocansi. Kunenkolelo engelona iqiniso eliphelele yokuthi owesifazane osemncane ohlezi ngentombi ubonakala ngokuthi iso lihlale likhona futhi lingakaze ligcobhozwe. Ake sibuke ngqo okuthile ngeso: Akusiyena wonke umuntu wesifazane ozalwa enalo. Ngiyaphinda, uyakwazi ukuzalwa unalo futhi bakhona abazalwa bengenalo nhlobo, ngokwendalo. Abezibalo bathi abazalwa bengenalo balinganiselwa ku-10 kwabangu-100. Kwabesifazane abazalwa benalo, lwakheka lungawuvali ngokugcwele umgudu. Iso lakheka ngokwehlukana; kusukela ekubeni yingqintsanyana kuya ophephesaneni oluncanyana oluthi ne odongeni lomgudu. Zibalelwa esishiyagalolunyeni izinhlobo ezehlukene zokwakheka kweso. Zibalelwa ngaphezu kwamashumi ayisithupha ekhulwini izintokazi ezineso eliba wuphephesana futhi kuzo akubikhona ukuconsaconsa kwegazana uma ziya ocansini okokuqala zisebenzisa lo mgudu ongaphambili kowesifazane. Iso eliwuphephesana liyazishabalalela uma owesifazane ekhula eya eminyakeni engu-25. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iningi lezintombi ezikule minyaka azisenalo iso, hhayi ngoba zingaziphethe kahle kodwa ngoba zizalwe liwuphephesana lwaze lwazinciphela lwaphela okanye lwaba encane intsalelela odongeni lomgudu. Ngabesifazane abazalwe beneso eliwungqintsanyana abaconsisa okusagazana uma beya ocansini okokuqala futhi nabo bayingcosana. Enye inselelo ekhona ngeso wukuthi iningi lezintokazi, nabesifazane nje, abakaze balibone ngamehlo. Abesifazane noma izintokazi kazazi ukuthi zizalwe zinalo iso noma qha. Lokhu kwenziwa wukuthi ubulili besifazane bucashile, abufani nobesilisa. Bambalwa abesifazane abathatha isibuko bazibuke ubulili babo ngokubuqonda okunzulwanyana, angikhulumi eyokububuka ubuphenyaphenye ngalesiya sikhathi useyitshitshi nasebuntombini. Eminye yemibuzo engicabanga seyakhekile eyokuthi, pho sikuqinisekisa kanjani ukuthi intokazi iyintombi nto noma cha? Sithi: Ucansi luyenziwa emlonyeni, emgudwini ongemuva nasemgudwini ongaphambili. Zikhona izintombi ezidalwe zazalwa zingenalo nhlobo leli so Ezintokazini ezizalwe zinalo, eziningi zifika eminyakeni engu-25 selinyamalele. Kunezimo zempilo ezingadabula noma zisheshise ukunyamalala kweso njengokudansa, ukuzilolonga, izimo ozenza uvule imilenze nezinye. Izintokazi eziningi azazi noma zizalwa zinalo iso noma cha ngoba azikaze zilibone ngamehlo. Iso kwabanalo lakhekhe layizinhlobonhlobo, akusiyona inhlobo eyodwa. Enye nje inhlobo yeso ibambobombobo, enye ingaba yimicwi. Akekho umuntu ongama aqiniseke ngobuntombi bomunye ngaphandle kwayo intombi uqobo noMdali wayo. Ngisho sengithanda njengodokotela, ngigcina ngokucabangela kuphela. Ngeke ngime ngithi yebo noma cha. Pho udokotela uthini ngamasiko ezizwe anhlobonhlobo athinta ubulili neso? Amasiko avundisa, anisele, akhulisa adlondlobalise okuthile ngaleso sikhathi ezinganeni zethu nasebantwini. Umsebenzi wami nawe wukuthi uma echumisa okuhle siweseke ngezandla zombili. Mpilonde!
UZOBUYELA ngonyaka ozayo enkantolo uMnuz Duduzane Zuma osolwa ngokuthembisa ukugwazela uMnuz Mcebisi Jonas ngoR600 million UZOBUYELA ngonyaka ozayo enkantolo uMnuz Duduzane Zuma osolwa ngokuthembisa ukugwazela uMnuz Mcebisi Jonas ngoR600 million UMHOLI we-Economic Freedom Fighters, uMnuz Julius Malema, usegxeke impatho etholwe uMnuz Duduzane Zuma ngesikhathi evela enkantolo izolo. UZuma ubevele enkantolo yamacala athinta imali wanikezwa ibheyili kaR100 000 ecaleni lenkohlakalo lapho esolwa ngokuthi wazama ukugwazela owayeyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Mcebisi Jonas, ngoR600 million kodwa uJonas wawunqaba. Izolo uMbuso ubeke uDuduzane icala lenkohlakalo kodwa udaba olube sematheni kakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuvela kwakhe efakwe ozankosi ezinyaweni, okuvame ukwenziwa uma kuvela abasolwa ababhekene namacala abucayi. Umbuzo obuhamba phambili ezinkundleni ngowokuthi ufakelweni ozankosi ngaloluya hlobo ekubeni kunguye ozinikele emaphoyiseni. Ekhuluma nentatheli yeSABC ngoLwesibili uMalema uthe uDuduzane usezoba yiqhawe kuleli ngoba abantu bazozwelana naye ngenxa yendlela aphathwe ngayo. "Akumele senze abantu okungenzeka ukuthi baphule umthetho amaqhawe ngenxa yendlela esibaphatha ngayo. Buka into eyenzeke kuDuduzane. Namhlanje uDuduzane uyiqhawe ngenxa yendlela aphathwe ngayo enkantolo. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayazwelana nabantu ababukeka engathi bayizisulu. Akumele sihlasele abantu okungenzeka ukuthi bayizigebengu ngendlela ezobaphendula amaqhawe," kusho uMalema. Uqhube waveza nokuthi kumele abantu abasolwayo balandelelwe kuphela uma sekunobufakazi obanele ukuthi babhekane nengalo yomthetho enkantolo. "Kunomehluko phakathi kwepolitiki necala elisenkantolo. Enkantolo kumele uveze ubufakazi obungashiyi ungabazane ngezinsolo umsolwa abekwa zona. UMalema ufike abange umsindo abange umsindo, bese beyagxuma abeNPA ngisho bengenabo ubufukazi. Ngakho kumele sikwazi ukukuhlukanisa lokhu kokubili. Sizoqhubeka sibange umsindo ngezinto esizisolayo kodwa oKlebe neNPA akumele badudwe ngabakuzwa ePhalamende. Kumele baqhubeke bona bayofuna ubufakazi, uma sebebutholile kumele baphathe abasolwa ngendlela ngoba ukungakwenzi lokhu kubaphendula amaqhawe," kuphetha uMalema. Icala likaDuduzane lihlehliselwe uJanuwari 24 wonyaka ozayo ngoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo.
OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wakuleli uMnuz Jacob Zuma obefakaza kwiKhomishini kaZondo ngeledlule. Isithombe: AP OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wakuleli uMnuz Jacob Zuma obefakaza kwiKhomishini kaZondo ngeledlule. Isithombe: AP OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma usazolinda uphenyo lweKhomishana kaJaji Raymond Zondo ngezinsongo zokubulawa abhekene nazo ngaphambi kokuba afake isicelo sokuba kwengezwe ezokuPhepha kuye. Lokhu kuvezwe umkhulumeli wakhe, uMnuz Vukile Mathabela emuva kokuba kube nezinhlangano eziphazamise ukuba kuqiniswe ezokuphepha kuZuma, ummeli wakhe u-Advocate Muzi Sikhakhane nomndeni wakhe uZuma. “UJaji uZondo ukucacisile kwikhomishini yakhe ukuthi lolu daba lwezinsongo zokubulawa ezibhekiswe kuZuma zizophenywa abaphenyi bekhomishini ukuze bathole ukuthi ziqhamukaphi. “Kuyothi uma sebesithulele umbiko bese uMengameli Zuma ethatha isinyathelo. Okwamanje lukhona uhlelo lwamaphoyisa ngokuphepha kukaZuma njengoba amaphoyisa ehlale emqaphile,” kuchaza uMathabela obexoxa neSolezwe. NgeSonto eledlule, inhlangano elwisana nezimpi zamatekisi KwaZulu-Natal okuwuBumbano lokuThula Forum, iphakamise ukuthi kuqiniswe ezokuphepha kuZuma. Ikusho lokhu esitatimendeni sayo emuva kokuba uZuma edalule kwiKhomishini kaZondo ukuthi kukhona abasongela ngokumbulala nomndeni wakhe. Usihlalo woBumbano lokuThula, uMnuz Andile Hlatshwayo, uthe babona kuyisikhathi sokuba uZuma avikelwe ngoba sekuyacaca ukuthi impilo yakhe isengozini. “Ngemuva kwezinkulumo ezethulwe uZuma kuKhomishini yokuLawulwa kombuso yiDlanzana ngoLwesibili, kusicacele thina njengoBumbano ukuthi uyakudinga ukuthola ezokuphepha ezengeziwe kulezi anazo. Yingakho sicela kuMengameli wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ukuba alubukisise lolu daba ngoba angeke sibe nokuthula uma kubakhona okwehlela uZuma,” kusho uHlatshwayo. Kule khomishini uZuma uveze ukuthi kuye kwafona umuntu ongaziwa kumsizi wakhe obhekene nezindaba zakhe ku-ANC esabisa ngokuthi bazobulala uZuma nomndeni wakhe kanye nommeli wakhe okungu-Advocate Muzi Sikhakhane. Lezi zinsolo uZuma abeziveza bezilandela nezinye azidalule ngoMsombuluko zokuthi kwakunetulo elaphekwa izinhlaka ezithile lokuba asocongwe emcimbini kaKhuzani owawungoMashi eMoses Mabhida Stadium. Inhlangano eyeseka uZuma, okuyi-Radical Economic Transformation (RET) nayo inanele ikhwelo loBumbano yathi ifuna uZuma avikelwe kuphinde kuqiniswe ezokuphepha kwakhe ngoba ayisathembi lutho. UMnuz Nkosentsha Shezi we-RET, uthe bashaqekile ngezinsongo ezidalulwe uZuma kwiKhomishini kaZondo. “Okwamanje asikalibhaleli ihhovisi likaMengameli nelikaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa ukuze bahlinzeke uZuma ngezokuphepha ezengeziwe kodwa sifuna avikelwe manje nomndeni wakhe ngoba basengozini. Empeleni sekuyacaca ukuthi kade uZuma abasengozini kodwa inkinga ukuthi abafisa ukumsoconga bayehluleka ukuthola ithuba elikahle,” kusho uShezi. Uthe uZuma ungubaba we-Radical Economic Transformation abafisa avikelwe ngakho konke ukuze aphephe. Le nhlangano yiyo eqashe amabhasi abethwele abantu abebesuka KwaZulu-Natal beyokweseka uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngesikhathi evela okokuqala ngoMsombuluko kwiKhomishini kaZondo. Okhulumela uMengameli, uNkk Khusela Diko, ucele ukuba athunyelelwe umyalezo ngalolu daba kodwa ugcine engaphendulanga kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.
UFUNA incazelo yokuthi wadivoswa kanjani engazi uNksz Dumazile Vilakazi, othole lokhu sekushone umyeni wakhe, uMfundisi Vika Mazibuko, osekuphele amasonto amabili engangcwatshiwe ngenxa yombango ISITHOMBE:SITHUNYELWE UFUNA incazelo yokuthi wadivoswa kanjani engazi uNksz Dumazile Vilakazi, othole lokhu sekushone umyeni wakhe, uMfundisi Vika Mazibuko, osekuphele amasonto amabili engangcwatshiwe ngenxa yombango ISITHOMBE:SITHUNYELWE SEKUPHELE amasonto amabili siduve emakhazeni isidumbu somfundisi waseMnambithi umngcwabo wakhe omiswe yinkosikazi endala ethole ukuthi idivoswe ingazi umyeni washada nomunye. UMfundisi Vika Mazibuko (46) webandla lamaZayoni elingatholakalanga igama lalo, washadelwa wuNksz Dumazile Vilakazi (45) ngo-2001. UNksz Vilakazi uthe owesifazane asebebanga naye isidumbu wafika ezokwelashwa, wagcina ehlala iminyaka emithathu ekhaya. “Ngagcina sengimthatha njengengane yami ngoba wazinikela nangokugcwele esontweni. Ngo-2007 umyeni wami wahamba nayo le ntombazane.” Uthe abazange badivose nomyeni wakhe, waqhubeka wahlala emzini wakhe. Uthole ucingo kuninazala wakhe emtshela ukuthi uMazibuko ushonile ngoJuni 24. “Ngaya lapho abehlala khona umyeni wami, umnakwethu wangikhombisa incwadi ekhomba ukuthi ngadivoswa ngo-2009. Ngithole ukuthi umyeni wami uphinde washada nayo le ntombazane ngo-2013,” kusho uNksz Vilakazi. Ngenxa yokumangazwa ukudivosa engazi, uNksz Vilakazi uye enkantolo wavimba ukuthi kudedelwe isidumbu. Uthe akaze awathole amasamanisi edivosi futhi kwakumele kube khona akutholayo uma bedivosa ngoba babehlanganise amafa. Inkantolo inqume ukuthi imindeni ibonisane ngalolu daba. UNksz Vilakazi uthe umnakwabo ugcine evuma ukuthi angcwabe ngesonto eledlule wabuye wajika. “Sigcinana naye enkantolo wathi kulungile ngingcwabe, ngenza namalungiselelo okungcwaba ngeSonto. Kuthe sengiyolanda isidumbu ngoMgqibelo odlule ngathola enye incwadi yasenkantolo ethi ngingangcwabi,” kusho yena. Uthe bekumele baphindele bonke enkantolo ngoMsombuluko kodwa umnakwabo wangafika. Uveze ukuthi kufike amadoda abesonta nomufi, asabise ngokuthi uzophucwa ngisho umuzi ahlala kuwo. UNksz Vilakazi, ongumsebenzi wasezindlini, uthe uke wamzama ummeli ozimele waxakeka ngenxa yemali. Umnakwabo, uNksz Ncamsile Gamede (30), ucingo ulunikeze omunye wesifazane ochaphe intatheli ngenhlamba. Kuthe noma ebuzwa igama lakhe waqhubeka nenhlamba esabisa nangokuthi uzoyilungisa intatheli uma ike yakhipha udaba. Udadewabo kamufi, uNkk Mabaso, elingatholakala igama lakhe, ubhoke ngolaka wathi useganile, akafuni ukufakwa ezindabeni. Ummeli ozimele, uNksz Nolwazi Malimela, weNN and Associates, uthe kungenzeka ukuthi idivosi kaNksz Vilakazi yakhangiswa ephephandabeni ngoba kuyenzeka uma abantu bengasahlali ndawonye. Uthe uma umfundisi ebeseshadile akumele azixake ngokufuna isidumbu, kunalokho kumele ayofaka isicelo sokuthola ingxenye yamafa akhe ngoba babeshade umshado ohlanganisayo.

UMDIDIYELI we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yomhlaba eCoastlands Hotel eThekwini izolo. UMabuyakhulu uthe ngeke baze bawulokothe umhlaba weNgonyama Trust. Isithombe:Motshwari Mofokeng/African News Agency/ANA UMDIDIYELI we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yomhlaba eCoastlands Hotel eThekwini izolo. UMabuyakhulu uthe ngeke baze bawulokothe umhlaba weNgonyama Trust. Isithombe:Motshwari Mofokeng/African News Agency/ANA I-ANC KwaZulu-Natal isiphinde yakugcizelela okushiwo uMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa yathi ngeke iwulokothe umhlaba ongaphansi kweSilo samabandla uGoodwill Zwelithini. Ekhuluma engqungqutheleni ebidingida udaba lomhlaba eCoastlands Hotel, eThekwini, izolo uMdidiyeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uthe umhlaba owu-13% osezandleni zamakhosi awukho ezinhlelweni zabo zomhlaba abazowuthatha ngaphandle kwezinxephezelo. “Akekho umuntu ofuna ukuthatha umhlaba weNgonyama Trust. Umhlaba esifuna ukuwuthatha ngaphandle kwezinxephezelo yilowo owu- 78% osezandleni zabamhlophe,” kusho uMabuyakhulu. Uthe kuyishwa ukuthi ithimba lalowo owake waba ngumengameli, uMnuz Kgalema Motlanthe, elaphakamisa ukuthi umhlaba weNgonyama Trust kumele uthathwe, alikaze lixoxe namakhosi nobuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal. “Kusukela kuqale indaba yethimba likaMotlanthe siyakuqaphela ukuthi sekukhona amaqembu ezombusazwe angosomathuba asedlala ipolitiki eshibhile ngalolo daba ukuze azuze amavoti,” kusho uMabuyakhulu. Uxwayise ngokuthi udaba lomhlaba lubucayi wathi kumele luphathiswe okwezikhali zamaNtungwa. Uthe umbiko wethimba likaMotlanthe ususePhalamende akukathathwa sinqumo ngawo. “Njengoba siqonda ukuthi iPhalamende lisebenza ngendlela eqondile futhi ecacile kusazobhungwa ngombiko nomphakathi unikwe ithuba lokuthi uphawule ngawo ngaphambi kokuthi kuthathwe isinqumo,” kusho uMabuyakhulu. Ethula uhlelo lukaThuma Mina eKZN ngempelasonto uRamaphosa ukugcizelele ukuthi uhulumeni kaKhongolose awunazo izinhlelo zokuthatha umhlaba weSilo. Uphawule kanje ngemuva kokuhlangana neSilo emuva kwembizo kaZulu ebisoLundi lapho iSilo sishaye phansi ngonyawo sathi akekho umuntu ozoke alokothe umhlaba waso inqobo nje uma sisadla amabele. UMHOLI we-ANC, uMnuz Meshack Radebe, noMengameli we-IFP ngokuhlonishwa, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi ngesikhathi kwethulwa ngokusemthethweni isikhwama sikaButhelezi enomngani wakhe owayengusomabhizinisi uMnuz Harry Oppenheimer, esikhumulweni sezindiza esidala ngaseSiphingo izolo Isithombe: Bongani Mbatha /African News Agency (ANA) UMHOLI we-ANC, uMnuz Meshack Radebe, noMengameli we-IFP ngokuhlonishwa, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi ngesikhathi kwethulwa ngokusemthethweni isikhwama sikaButhelezi enomngani wakhe owayengusomabhizinisi uMnuz Harry Oppenheimer, esikhumulweni sezindiza esidala ngaseSiphingo izolo Isithombe: Bongani Mbatha /African News Agency (ANA) UMENGAMELI ngokuhlonishwa we-IFP inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi uthi kuyomphatha kabi uma eze washona lungaqediwe uhlelo lokubuyisana phakathi kweNkatha ne-ANC. Ekhuluma emcimbini wokwethulwa ngokusemthethweni kwesikhwama sakhe nomngani wakhe ongusomabhizinisi ohlonishwayo, uMnuz Harry Oppenheimer esikhumulweni sezindiza esidala ngaseSiphingo izolo, uButhelezi uthe inhliziyo yakhe kayikutholi ukuphumula ngokuthi lolu hlelo kalukaqedwa. “Kuyongiphatha kabi uma ngivala amehlo ami ngishona kodwa kusenezilonda ezingakalashwa phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC,” kusho uButhelezi. Uthe uyajabula ukuthi umholi ohlonishwayo we-ANC, uMnuz Meshack Radebe ukhona emcimbini wakhe. “Kuyintokozo ukuba khona kukaRadebe lapha owaziwa kakhulu ngamagalelo akhe okudala uxolo phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC eHammarsdale ebambisene noDkt Sipho Mlaba ongasekho. Ngisho nangesikhathi uRadebe enze umcimbi wokugubha ukuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-70, wangimema kwakhe eMaqongqo ngaya ngoba ngangazi ukuthi ukungimema kwakhe kwakugqugquzelwa yintshisekelo yakhe yokubona sibuyisana,” kusho uButhelezi. Uthe kade kwasa ethukwa, ebizwa ngawo wonke amagama ngabaholi be-ANC, abanye baze bambize ngomdayisi nangencelebane yabamhlophe. “Noma ngangihlaselwa ngayo yonke indlela kodwa bekungiqinisa kungenze ngime kulokhu engikholelwa kukho ngenxa yokwesekwa enganginikukwa ngumngani wami * -Oppenheimer, wangiseka futhi nangesikhathi ngithatha isinqumo sokunqaba ukuthi isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal sibe nguzimele geqe njengoba ezinye izifundazwe ezine zase zivumile,” kusho uButhelezi. Uthe ngenxa yozimele geqe, abantu abamnyama babenziwa abantu bokufika ezweni labo. “Njengoba ngilapha namhlanje emcimbini wokwethulwa kwalesi sikhwama sami nomngani wami ngizizwa sengathi ngisemngcwabeni wami uqobo,” kusho uButhelezi. Isikhulumi sosuku emcimbini, uMnuz John Kane-Berman, sigeqe amagula sichaza umlando kaButhelezi namagalelo akhe emzabalazweni. “Kuyiqiniso elifihliwe ukuthi uButhelezi nguyena owayephoqa uhulumeni wobandlululo ukuthi akhulule uMengameli wokuqala wentando yeningi kuleli uDkt Nelson Mandela ejele, uButhelezi waze wasabisa ngokuthi ngeke alungenele ukhetho uma uMandela engakhululwa, kuningi akwenza ukuze abamnyama bakhululeke kodwa kufihliwe,” kusho uKane-Berman. Umeluleki kaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Linda Zama, uthe umlando wakuleli kawuphelele ngaphandle kukaButhelezi no-Oppenheimer. UNksz Zama uchaze uButhelezi njengomholi osezingeni lomhlaba ngenxa yamagalelo akhe emzabalazweni “Kakusilo ihaba ukuthi sithi uMntwana waKwaPhindangene uyingqalabutho yomholi wakuleli, osebenze cishe nabo bonke abaholi abahlonishwayo nabadumile hhayi lapha eNingizimu Afrika nasezwenikazi kodwa nasemhlabeni wonke uqobo,” kusho uNksz Zama.
UMNUZ Msizi Jali oyindodana kaMnuz Ndumiso Jali waseMzimkhulu obulawe ngoJanuwari nonkosikazi wakhe UMNUZ Msizi Jali oyindodana kaMnuz Ndumiso Jali waseMzimkhulu obulawe ngoJanuwari nonkosikazi wakhe AYIFUNI nokuyizwa indaba yesonto likayise indodana yomholi wesonto laseMzimkhulu okwahlubuka kulo isonto lase-Eastern Cape, iMancoba Seven Angels Church. UMnuz Msizi Jali uyindodana kaMnuz Ndumiso Jali oke wabambisana noMnuz Siphiwo Mancoba ongumsuguli weCrusade Church. Amadodana kaMancoba ahlubuka kuleli sonto ngemuva kokushona kukayise asungula iMancoba Seven Angels ngo-2015. UJali, othi naye ubengasakwazi ukungena emzini kayise ngemuva kokushiya leli sonto ayesesonte kulo iminyaka eyishumi, uthe bese kunesikhathi engakwazi ukuya kubo. Uthe ubegcina ngokukhuluma noyise ecingweni. “Ngayeka ukufunda kwaGrade 8 ngesikhathi ngisuka kumama sengizohlala nobaba. Ngatshelwa ukuthi inqubo yesonto ayikuvumeli ukuthi sifunde ngoba kunomoya kaSathane ezikoleni. Ngahlala njengoba kwakushiwo. Zaziziningi izingane ezazisesigabeni sokufunda ezazingafundi njengami. Kwakunezinto engangingazizwa kahle njengako ukuthi awuvumelekile ukukhuluma ngenkonzo yethu. Uma ubingelela umuntu awumbuzi impilo nokuthi uyilungu lesonto akabe esahlangana nomndeni wakhe. Ngake ngakhuluma nentsha eyayingangami sibona sengathi amalungelo ethu acindezelekile ngoba ngeke sisebenze imisebenzi ecacile ngoba asifundile. Bonke babebona njengami kodwa bengakaze baphile enye impilo besaba ukuphuma esontweni. Nganquma ukushiya kuleli sonto ngalibangisa eKapa ngiyozama impilo,” kusho yena. Uthe wayazi ukuthi ukuphuma kwakhe kwakusho ukuthi akasakwazi ukuxhumana noyise. Yingakho bekunzima ukuthi avakashe yize uyise engazange asho ukuthi akangamvakasheli. Eseshonile uyise uthe wakhuluma namalungu omndeni wawatshela ukuthi uyise uzongcwatshwa ngendlela ejwayelekile okungcwatshwa ngayo abantu. “Amalungu esonto awazange ayizwe kahle into engangiyisho ngoba ayelindele ukuthi ubaba angcwatshwe emathuneni ethengwayo futhi angcwatshwe amalungu ebandla ambalwa. Iningi lawo lakhombisa ukungahambisani nengangikusho. Ngabacacisela ukuthi kuzoba khona namalungu omndeni azohlanganyela nathi. Sacela ukuthi basidedele sizile ngendlela esiyaziyo. Kwaba ukuhamba kwabo,” kusho uJali. Uthe kuningi okumphatha kabi okukhulunywa ngabantu ngesonto likayise abathi likhonza enkolweni kaSathane. “Ngesikhathi ngisasonta kulo bekuthiwa uSathane ungaphandle. Thina sikhonza uNkulunkulu. Angazi ukuthi yiliphi iBhayibheli elalifundwa ngoba iBhayibheli lalifundwa uMancoba kuphela. Iningi lezingane lalingakwazi ukufunda,” kusho uJali. Uqhube wathi zonke izinsuku uthunyelelwa izithombe ezisabekayo ezisabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuthiwa ngezendlu yakubo emise okwenyoka. Kushiwo nezinto ezisabekayo okuthiwa ziyenzeka kuyo. “Engikwaziyo wukuthi abebesonta kuleli sonto bebenziwa ukuthi bakholwe yilokho okushiwo kulo futhi akekho obeke akhulume ngokwenzeka kulo. Angazi noma leyo ndlela iyona yini okukhonzwa ngayo uSathane. Angazi ukuthi yini le ebiyenza ukuthi abantu bakholwe yilokhu ebebetshelwa kona yize abanye babo befundile,” kusho uJali. Uthe ngeke alivule isonto uzoqhubeka nebhizinisi likayise lokudayisa amabloksi.
Isithombe esigciniwe Isithombe esigciniwe IZONGENISA uR2 billion imigubho ye-ANC emnothweni waKwaZulu-Natal njengoba kutheleke abantu abangaphezu kuka-100 000 kuleli sonto. Lezi zindaba zivezwe nguNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha neMvelo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala osho lokhu emuva kokuthi iPhini leMenenja kaMasipala weTheku uMnuz Phillip Sithole lithe wonke amahhotela amakhulu nagudle ulwandle agcwele njengoba kunemicimbi yemigubho yeminyaka ewu-107 yokusungulwa kwe-ANC. USithole uthe abafuna izindawo zokulala kufanele babheke amaBed and Breakfasts nezinye izindawo ezihlala izivakashi. UZikalala uthe njengoba i-ANC izoba nomgubho omkhulu kusasa eMoses Mabhida izinkampani zokuvakasha zithe konke kuhamba kahle futhi kuhlomule izindawo ezihlukene ezilala izivakashi KwaZulu-Natal ngoba abaholi be-ANC bebethe chithisaka kwisifundazwe sonke. “Siwuqala kahle unyaka ngoba nomkhankaso wethu wokwandisa izivakashi uthela izithelo ezinhle ngoba ucwaningo luveza ukuthi kufike izivakashi eziwu-2 000 zakwamanye amazwe angaphandle ezinyangeni zokuqala ezintathu zika-2018. Sifuna nokunyusa isibalo sezivakashi zangaphakathi, sikhulise nemali engenayo ibe phakathi kukaR65 billion noR98 billion kule minyaka emibili ezayo,” kusho uZikalala. Uthe lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi bayafinyelela ohlelweni lwabo lokwakha amathuba omsebenzi awu-183 000 kwezokuvakasha kule minyaka emibili ezayo bahehe nezivakashi eziwu-3.4 million zakwamanye amazwe ngo-2030.

Isithombe: Zodidi Dano/Cape Argus YIZE ephenduke inhlekisa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana uSotswebhu weDA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, ngokuthi akanazo iziqu zemfundo ephakeme kodwa uthe kufanele ayekwe kulesi sikhundla sakhe ngoba usebenzela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. USteenhuisen ubetinyelwa ngabantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana abanye bemhleka ukuthi wayegxeka umbiko waseNkandla, ethi indlela obhaleke kabi ngayo ngathi ubuwenziwa wumfundi kamatric. Akusiye yedwa uSteenhuisen umholi onesikhundla esibalulekile. I-SABC isike yaphathwa nguMnuz Hlaudi Motsoeneng ongenawo umatric kodwa owayezishaya isifuba ngokwazi umsebenzi ngoba wafika esemncane. Kumanje uMotsoeneng uthe bebengeke badilizwe abasebenzi ukube bekusaphethe yena eSABC ngoba uyawazi umsebenzi. OwayenguSihlalo weBhodi yeSABC, uNkk Ellen Khuzwayo, waphoqeleka ukuthi asule esikhundleni emuva kokuthi inyuvesi ayethi ufunde kuyo yaveza ukuthi akazange athole iziqu kodwa wagcina ngokubhalisa kuphela. Izolo uSolwazi Belinda Bozzoli okhulumela iDA kwezemfundo ePhalamende uthe yize eneziqu zeSociology kodwa ubukela kuSteenhuisen ngoba ungumholi osebenza ngokuzikhandla futhi owuhloniphayo umthetho. Isolezwe libe selenza ucwaningo lathola ukuthi nosotswebhu we-ANC, uMnuz Jackson Mthembu, naye unomatric ngoba waxoshwa eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare ngenxa yokuba yisishoshovu somzabalazo. Osotshwebhu bamaqembu amakhulu abaneziqu zemfundo ePhakeme ngowe-IFP, uMnuz Narend Singh, oneziqu zeBachelor of Commerce azithola eNyuvesi yaseDurban Westville esibizwa ngeNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal noMnuz Floyd Shivambu oneziqu zeMasters in Political Studies and International Relations okwavela ukuthi isicelo sakhe sokwenza iziqu zobudokotela samukelwe kwenye inyuvesi. Kuke kwaba nenkulumompikiswano ngeziqu zikaMnuz Mark Kingon owukhomishana wakwaSARS osabambile, abanye bethi unomatric kuphela kodwa unesikhundla esiphezulu.UKingon usesebenze kwaSARS iminyaka ewu-34. Yize afika enomatric kodwa usenazo iziqu zemfundo ephakeme azenza iminyaka ewu-11. Kumanje uneziqu zeBachelor of Administration azithola e-Unisa.
Sihle Zikalala Sihle Zikalala UKUNGABONI ngaso linye phakathi kwabangcwabi abamnyama nabamhlophe sekuxazululekile. Lokhu kulandela umhlangano okade ukhona phakathi kukaNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho nokuVakasha, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, nabangcwabi kanjalo nalabo abathintekayo kulolu daba, izolo. Laba bahlanganisa iNational Funeral Practitioners Association of South Africa (Nafupa SA) lapho kuvunyelwane khona ngokuthi kusungulwe ikomiti elizobhekana ngqo noguquko emkhakheni wazabangcwabi okuvezwe ngabeNafupa SA. “Ngingakuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkinga ebezenza kungabi nokuthula phakathi kwabangcwabi sezixazululiwe. Sihlangane nabo bonke abathintekayo savumelana ngokuthi kudingeka kuhlanganiswe leli komidi elizobhekana nalezi zinkinga, egqame kakhulu ileyo yoshintsho kule mboni yabangcwabi, nakho konke abakuvezile,” kusho uZikalala. AbeNafupa SA nabo sebeguqukile kulokhu abekade besabisa ngokukwenza, kokuvimba izinkampani zamaNdiya nabelungu ukuthi zingangeni emalokishini ukuzongcwaba, kusukela kule nyanga ezoqala. Leli komiti lihlanganisa izinhlangano ezahlukene okubalwa kuzo iSouth African Social Security Agency, uMnyango wezeMpilo, i-Road Accident Fund noMnyango wezaseKhaya. Leli komiti lizohlangana izikhathi eziningi libe selibikela uZikalala ngomgamo eseliwuhambile ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga eziveziwe.
BUCHITHEKE bugayiwe kubalisa ababili nowesifazane oyedwa ababanjwe oqotsheni, beqeda ukuhlinza inkomo yokwebiwa kodwa babanjwe sebehlukaniselana inyama eMkhumbane, eMondlo, ekuqaleni kwesonto. Isolezwe ngeSonto lithole ukuthi uMnuz Vusumuzi Ngcobo (54) , Mnuz Lindokuhle Xulu (24), noSelby Nonhlanhla Xulu (48), baswele umgodi wokucasha kungena ezakwasidlodlo zingasadle nkobe zamuntu, zabashaqa. Kuthiwa amaphoyisa afike bejuluke bemanzi te, kungakhulumi muntu, kusha ummese nocelemba. Bekhipha izigixagixa zenyama bezibeka amaqoqo ukuze umuntu aphume nengxenye yakhe ayoshaya izoso nomndeni wakhe. Umthombo osondelene nalolu daba uveze ukuthi baboshwa nje bebesanda kufonela emakhaya, betshela imindeni yabo ukuthi ingapheki kodwa ilungise umlilo wokosa. Kuthiwa bengakaligwinyi zatheleka ezikaDalawane, zabahlaba ngemibuzo badla amazambane ashisayo, baphonswa evenini, kwathiwa bayochaza phambili. Ngokomthombo, amaphoyisa alunywe indlebe ukuthi sengathi idubukele kwaXulu, kuhlinzwa inkomo yokwebiwa. “Abuzile amaphoyisa ukuthi iyisima kanjani le nkomo ehlinzwayo babakaza abasolwa bangakwazi ukuchaza nokwenze amaphoyisa abafaka ozankosi, aqoqa nezimbazo nemimese nakho konke akufaka njengobufakazi obuqanda ikhanda ukuthi babanjiwe nale nkomo,’’ kulanda umthombo. Akucacanga kahle ukuthi le nkomo ibiyebiwe kuphi nokuthi ibifike nini njengoba ihlinzelwa endlini nje. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Colonele Thulani Zwane, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kunabantu ababhadanywe bematasa behlinza emuva kokuba bempimpiwe emaphoyiseni. UMNUZ Kwazikwakhe Mfanothi Lushozi obesekuphele isonto aduka ehlaselwa abantu esentombini kutholwe isidumbu sakhe sinamanxeba UMNUZ Kwazikwakhe Mfanothi Lushozi obesekuphele isonto aduka ehlaselwa abantu esentombini kutholwe isidumbu sakhe sinamanxeba ITHOLAKALE ishonile indoda (52) yaseMbongolwane obesekuphele isonto inyamalele emuva kokuthi iphume ngesudi yesele endlini yentombi ibalekela abalisa okuthiwa babeyifuna ngezibhamu. Amaphoyisa akuqinisekisile ukuthi isidumbu sikaMnuz Kwazikwakhe Mfanothi Lushozi onyamalale ekupheleni kwenyanga edlule sitholakele sinamanxeba okungakaqinisekiswa ukuthi ngawani. ULushozi unyamalale ngoJuni 30 eKopokopo lapho okuhlala khona intombi yakhe emuva kokuthi kufike amadoda angaziwa emfuna ngezibhamu. Kuthiwa waphuma endlini enqunu ebalekela la madoda okuthiwa aphinde atshela intombi yakhe ukuthi afuna isibhamu sakhe. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa asevule icala lokubulala mayelana nesigameko sokutholakala kukaLushozi eshonile. “Isidumbu sakhe sitholakele eKopokopo endaweni engakude nala ayebhekwa khona. Isidumbu sakhe bese sonakele futhi sinamanxeba okulimala. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwesidumbu yiyona ezocacisa ngokufa kwakhe,” kusho uZwane. Izolo umndeni kaLushozi awuzange utholakale ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sewuzwile ngokutholakala kwesidumbu sakhe ntambama ngeSonto. Ngesikhathi ebikela leli phephandaba ngokuduka komyeni wakhe, uNkk Lungile Thabisile Lushozi, uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngesigameko sokunyamalala kwakhe kodwa washo ukuthi batholile ukuthi ubesentombini yakhe. UNkk Lushozi uthe wayethole ucingo olwalumexwayisa ukuthi angalali ekhaya ngoba kunabantu abafuna umyeni wakhe abangamenzakalisa. Uthe wambikela umyeni wakhe ngalokhu wathi uyabuya ngoLwesihlanu olwalandulela usuku okuthiwa wanyamalala ngalo. Ngokusho kwakhe bathi uma bezama ukumshayela ucingo bangamthola ocingweni kwathi eseshayelwa ntambama ucingo lwabanjwa yintombi yakhe yababikela ukuthi kufike abantu ekuseni ngehora lesine befuna umyeni wakhe kodwa wakwazi ukuphunyuka wabaleka enqunu. Umkakhe uthe bathi uma beya emaphoyiseni bathola ukuthi intombi yomyeni wakhe ayisibikanga isigameko sokuhlaselwa nokunyamalala kwakhe. Uthe saze sabikwa nguye.
IYAVUTHA ikhokhasi yamakhansela e-ANC kuMasipala waseMtubatuba ikhala ngemeya athi ilaxaze imoto ngoba isaba ukuthi inotokoloshe, yathenga entsha ceke ngemali kamasipala. Amakhansela athi iMeya uMnz Velangenkosi Gumede iyeke imoto iJeep Cheerokee emnyama yaze yadayiswa ngoba isaba ukuthi uma ihamba ngayo ingase ibeke impilo yayo engcupheni ngoba icushwe ngotokoloshe. Amakhansela uma ekhuluma le ndaba kuvele kuthi awazisakaze phansi ngoba asola imeya ngokuchitha imali yomkhandlu entweni engenasidingo. Umthombo uthe le moto eyiJeep neshaya ngezinombolo ezithi Mtuba 1, yayihamba imeya eyakhishwa esikhundleni uMnuz Qhina Mkhwanazi. Yiyona leyo moto okuthiwa imeya ibingafuni nakuyithinta njengoba isihamba ngeToyota Fortuner entsha. Imithombo ithi ngendlela amakhansela e-ANC adinwe ngayo, acebe imeya kuNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube. Kuvele ukuthi uNkk Dube-Ncube ubehambele lo umasipala ngoLwesine ngenxa yokukhungathwa yizinkinga. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi kukhona uNkk Dube-Ncube kusukume elinye lamakhansela lamtshela ukuthi abayizwa le ndaba yemeya esaba otokoloshe. Isitatimende esikhishwe wumnyango siveza ukuthi uNkk Dube-Ncube unike imeya ithuba lokuphendula ngendaba yemoto enotokoloshe yavuma ukuthi yayiyeka imoto kodwa yayichitha eyotokoloshe. Ichaze yathi iyibone ingasaphephile ngoba isihambe yafika ku-110 000 km. Okhulumela ikhokhasi ye-ANC kulo masipala uMnuz Siyabonga Khumalo, uthe ziningi izinto ezingahambi kahle kumasipala futhi bazibikile zonke kungqongqoshe. Uthe udaba lwemoto alusalanga ngaphandle ngoba abahambisani nokuthengwa kwemoto entsha. “Le moto endala isesimeni esihle kabi, siyaxakeka uma kuthiwa ayisafuneki sekuthengwe entsha. Lokhu kukatokoloshe emotweni asikwazi kahle sakuzwa nje kuthiwa kuke kwashiwo yiyona imeya ngesikhathi ikhuluma udaba lwemoto,’’ kusho uKhumalo. Imenenja kamasipala uMnuz Jeconia Mngomezulu ukuqinisekisile ukuthi yashintshwa imoto yemeya ngoba yayindala kakhulu. “Kuyiqiniso ukuthi ayisekho iJeep eyayihamba imeya eyaphuma kodwa ngeke ngiyikhulume eyotokoloshe. Imeya ayikaze isho ukuthi yesaba otokoloshe emotweni kodwa siyishintshele ukuguga kwayo ngoba sifuna ebiza kahle ezokwazi ukusiza uma imeya yenza umsebenzi wayo,” kusho uMngomezulu.

UJABULELA ukululwa kwesikhathi sokubhalisa abafundi e-Unisa, uMnuz Zamokuhle Buthelezi, (ongelona iphara) oqashisa ngezihlalo kubafundi abasuke bemi kulayini UJABULELA ukululwa kwesikhathi sokubhalisa abafundi e-Unisa, uMnuz Zamokuhle Buthelezi, (ongelona iphara) oqashisa ngezihlalo kubafundi abasuke bemi kulayini IHLEKA yodwa imilutha yewunga ehlala edolobheni eThekwini njengoba sekuqalwe phansi ukubhaliswa kwabafundi, e-University of South Africa (Unisa), emuva kokumiswa kwesiteleka sabasebenzi. Kuthiwa le milutha idela ubuthongo ijoyine ulayini wabafundi abalala ngaphandle kwesikhungo sase-Unisa esisemgwaqweni uStalwart Simelane, eThekwini, ukuze idayisele abafundi abafika ekuseni izikhala kulayini. Amaphara alala kolayini, uma umfundi efika ekuseni akhokhele iphara uR50 bese ema lapho kade lime khona. UNksz Sizakele Msweli (25) uthe wethuka ngesikhathi efika kule nyuvesi ngehora lesihlanu ekuseni kodwa waba ngunombolo 391 kulayini. “Ngangizitshela ukuthi ngivuke ngempela uma ngishayelwa * -5 e-Unisa. Ngacela umfowethu ukuthi angihambise ngoba ngibona ukuthi uma ngihamba ngamatekisi ngizofika sekugcwele kakhulu. Ngathi ngisazimele kwaqhamuka iphara lathi liphambili kulayini, lingangidayisela isikhala ngoR200. Ngashaywa ukuthi imali ngangingenayo. Ukube yayikhona ngangizokhokha,” kusho uNksz Msweli. Uthe owayeseduze kwakhe, walikhokhela iphara waba phambili kulayini. Uqhube wathi waze wagoduka ngo-7 ebusuku ebe efike ekuseni ngovivi. Isolezwe ngeSonto lihambele kulesi sikhungo ngoLwesihlanu ukuthola kabanzi ngokushiwoyo. Abafundi abebemi kulayini bakuqinisekisile wukuthi wumkhuba ojwayelekile lo. Omunye wabadayisa ngaphandle kwase-Unisa, ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe kwesinye isikhathi yibo abafundi abasukela imilutha yewunga bayicele ukuthi ibabambele ulayini. “Abasuke benqena ukulala ngaphandle, bacela amaphara ukuthi ababambele olayini. Abanye baze bawaqashele nezihlalo kubhuti oqashisa ngazo ukuze ahlale phansi,” kusho lo mdayisi. Umlutha onqabile ukudalulwa, uthe kusebenzeka kangcono uma kusesekuseni kakhulu bengakafiki abasebenzi base-Unisa ngoba bafike babaxoshe. Uthe uma eme ngasekuqaleni kukalayini ubiza uR150 nangaphezulu kuya ngesivumelwano kodwa uma engasemuva ubiza uR50. UMnuz Zamokuhle Buthelezi (24) oqashisa ngezihlalo kubafundi abasuke bezobhalisa uthe uyazuza. “Ngiqale ngonyaka odlule ngemuva kokubona ukuthi abantu bama baze bakhathale kolayini. Ngibiza uR5 uma umuntu ezohlala ubusuku bonke kanti emini ngibiza uR2. Okwamanje nginezihlalo eziwu-300 ngisafuna ukuzandisa. Ngiphinde ngiqashisele abadayisayo,” kusho uButhelezi.

Isithombe: REUTERS African News Agency (ANA) PHEZU kokuba abahlaziyi bezepolitiki bethi i-ANC izophinde iwudle umhlanganiso okhethweni lukazwelonke okulindeleke ukuthi lube ngoMeyi nonyaka kodwa bathi akukho okusha okuvele kumhlahlandlela wokhetho othulwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa. URamaphosa uthule umqulu obugxile emfundweni yamahhala, ezempilo, ukufukula umnotho, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ukubuyiswa komhlaba, ukulwa nobugebengu, ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane nabakhubazekile, ukwehliswa kokubiza kwe-data, ukwakha izindlu, izikole, amadamu nezinye izethembiso. UMnuz Lukhona Mnguni waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uthe akukho okusha okwethulwe kulo mqulu wokukhankasela ukhetho othulwe yi-ANC enkundleni yemidlalo iMoses Mabhida, eThekwini. Uthe ugxile ezintweni ebezivele zilindelwe okubalwa umhlaba, ezemfundo nezinye izethembiso. “Yizinto ezifanayo ezindala ezivele zikhona ngoba nasekufukulweni komnotho kubalwa indaba yeBhange loMbuso okuyinto esike yavela phambilini. Kwezomhlaba noma engalibekanga ngembaba elokuthi bazolusebenzisa uhlelo lokuthi umuntu adayise umhlaba ngoba ethanda kodwa bazolusebenzisa nakuba kuzochitshiyelwa isigatshana * -25 soMthethosisekelo ukuze kuthathwe umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo,” kusho uMnguni. Uthe nendaba yokuthi kumele kusungulwe isikhungo soMbuso esikhiqiza amaphilisi nemithi akuyona into entsha ngoba nangesikhathi kuyiwa okhethweni lukazwelonke lwango-2014 ngenye yezinto eyayiseqhulwini. “Mayelana nendaba yemisebenzi siyehla isibalo semisebenzi abayithembisile njengoba ngonyaka uRamaphosa ethe kuzokwakhiwa engu-275 000 ngonyaka ekubeni owayengumengameli uJacob Zuma wayethembise engu-500 000 ngonyaka. Kukhulunywa nendaba yokuthi izitshudeni zithole ukuqeqeshwa kanjalo nokuthi singabe sisadingeka isipiliyoni kwizitshudeni ezisuke ziqede iziqu zizongena emazingeni aphansi eminyangweni kahulumeni.” Uthe njengoba i-ANC isiphathe iminyaka engu-25 kuhulumeni abantu abasabheki izethembiso basuke befuna ukwazi ukuthi kungani izethembiso ezindala zingafezwanga. “Kunongqongqoshe asebehlale iminyaka engu-20 kuhulumeni abantu bafuna ukwazi ukuthi kungani ezinye zezinto zingafezwanga. Yona i-ANC izoluwina ukhetho cishe ngaphezulu kuka-60% ngoba kukhona abantu abakholelwa kuRamaphosa siqu sakhe ukuthi angalihola izwe,” kusho uMnguni. USolwazi Bheki Mngomezulu, osophikweni lwezifundo zezepolitiki eNyuvesi yaseWestern Cape, uthe akukho okusha ngoba uMengameli ukhulume ngezinto ebezivele zilindelekile okubalwa umhlaba, amathuba emisebenzi, umnotho nomhlaba. Uthe ugxile kakhulu ekutheni intsha ithuthukiswa kanjani kanjalo nasemabhizinisni amancane. “Zona zizodwa angicabangi ukuthi zingabuyisa uzinzo eqenjni. Uma ubheka i-ANC isenhlanhleni ngoba amaqembu aphikisayo awaqinile kakhulu ukumisa kabi i-ANC,” kusho uMngomezulu. Uthe izokwazi ukuphinde idle umhlanganiso wathi akacabangi ukuthi ingawina ngamalengiso.
ZISALE zinje izimoto ebezibandakanyeka engozini okulimale kuyo abathathu eCrammond ngaphandle kwaseMgungundlovu izolo Isithombe: ER24 ZISALE zinje izimoto ebezibandakanyeka engozini okulimale kuyo abathathu eCrammond ngaphandle kwaseMgungundlovu izolo Isithombe: ER24 BAFUNA kuboshwe umshayeli wetekisi abamsola ngokudala ingozi abomndeni obhubhe ngesikhathi imoto yawo ishayisana netekisi eBhamshela ngempelasonto. Kule ngozi eyenzeke ngoMgqibelo ebusuku kushone uMnuz Sphamandla Madlala, ingoduso yakhe uNksz Banothile Jili nendodana yabo uWandile Madlala, obefunda uGrade 5 nengane yakwamakhelwane eneminyaka emine. Bonke laba ngabaseTrustfeed. Kuthiwa bebephuma ekhweni likaMadlala, beyoshiya izimpahla zesikole zengane yabo ehlala koninalume, bese bebuyela emzini wabo eTrustfeed ngesikhathi kwenzeka le ngozi. UMadlala ubeshayela imoto encane abebehamba ngayo kanti kuthe sebeseBhamshela bashayisana netekisi. Umshayeli wetekisi uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela esesimeni esibi. Ngokusho kukamfowabo kaMadlala omdala uMnuz Thulani “Thu” Madlala, bafuna umshayeli wetekisi eshayisane nemoto kamfowabo aboshwe. “Abafowethu abashayela amatekisi kumele baqikelele emgwaqweni njengoba sithole ukuthi umshayeli wetekisi ubesika endaweni engafanele, ehamba nangesivinini esiphezulu wazithela phezu kwemoto kamfowethu, washona wonke umndeni kamfowethu nengane yakwamakhelwane abebehamba nayo. Njengomndeni sifuna ubulungiswa kuleli cala, sifuna umshayeli wetekisi aboshwe ngokushona kwalaba bantu abane,” kusho uMadlala. Uthe umfowabo naye oshayela amatekisi eVerulam ubewukhonzile kakhulu umndeni wakhe njengoba bebephuma kohambisela enye ingane yakhe yomfana efunda esikoleni esiseduze koninalume izimpahla zesikole. “Sishayelwe ucingo sesitshelwa ukuthi balimale engozini. Bebesanda kusuka ekhweni likamfowethu, kutshelwe bona kuqala ngale ngozi nathi sabe sesibikelwa. Namanje kusenzima ukwamukela ukuthi umfowethu uhambe kabuhlungu kangaka nomndeni wakhe ngosuku olulodwa,” kusho uMadlala. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Thembeka Mbele uthe kuvulwe amacala amane okubulala ngokungenhloso. “Kushayisane imoto encane netekisi ngabo-8 ebusuku, kwashona abane. Umshayeli wetekisi ulimalile wabe esephuthunyiswa esibhedlela. Amaphoyisa aseNsuze aphenya amacala okubulala ngokungenhloso. Imbangela yale ngozi ayaziwa, kusaphenywa,” kusho uCol. Mbele. Khonamanjalo eCrammond ngaphandle kwaseMgungundlovu kulimale abantu abathathu kulandela ukushayisana kwemoto encane neveni. Le ngozi yenzeke emgwaqweni uR33. Abezimo eziphuthumayo baka-ER24 bathe bafike endaweni yesigameko izimoto zisaphazekile zagcwala umgwaqo. Owesilisa oneminyaka engu-50 kuthiwa kade evalelekile emotweni yakhe. Kusetshenziswe izindlawu ukutakula. Abalimele balashiwe, baphuthunyiswa ezibhedlela eziseduze.

Yize lokhu bekujwayeleke emidlalweni yethelevishini, bayanda abamnyama abakholelwa ekuthembisaneni umshado esidlangalaleni. Isikhathi esiningi owesifazane usuke engazi nhlobo ukuthi uzocelwa umshado. Ngesonto eledlule uMnuz Scelo Shelembe waseClermont umangaze isithandwa sakhe uNksz Thobile Ntombela esicela umshado endaweni yobumnandi iViews At Twenty5 eThekwini. Ngo-Ephreli nonyaka waphenduka isilomo uMnuz Thobile Cawana osebenza kwaSA Navy ezothembisa umshado uDkt Vonani Mpangela obeyisitshudeni e-University of KwaZulu-Natal (UKZN). UCawana wasuka emsebenzini ephelezelwa uzakwabo obemphathele izimbali, okuthe sekubizwa uDkt Mpangela esiteji ukuzothweswa umyezane, wamlinda nendandatho. Ngo-2016 kusona lesi sikhungo wenza okufanayo uMnuz Sanele Mhlungu waseMgungundlovu owacela umshado kuNksz Nosipho Nguse ezothweswa iziqu. Lezi zithandani zazihlangane khona e-UKZN futhi uMhlungu wayeselobolile ngesikhathi ecela umshado. Yize lo mkhuba usujwayelekile nakwabamnyama, ihlukene imibono ngawo. Abanye bagxeka laba abathembisana umshado kuthweswa iziqu bathi bafuna ukubukwa. Abanye bakubona kuwukuzifakela ingcindezi emphakathini. UMfundisi Thandi Ngonelo ongumeluleki wezemishado, uthe abesifazane akumele basheshe bajatshuliswe ukucelwa umshado. Uthe kumele umuntu ahluze umqondo ngaphambi kokuthi avume. “Baningi abasanganayo uma umfana eseguqe wakhipha indandatho. Kumele uqale umbuze ukuthi usekhule ngokwanele yini nokuthi unayo yini imali. “Abanye bakwenza lokhu ukujabulisa omunye nje kodwa bengahlelanga,” kusho yena. Ngokombiko weWedding Trends Mag, kuningi okumele ukucabange ngaphambi kokucela umuntu umshado. * Mawube nesiqiniseko sokuthi uzovuma ukuze ungaphoxeki. * Kungenzeka avume ngoba esesaba ukukuphoxa phambi kwabantu. * Uma kungumuntu onamahloni kungcono ukwenze ninobabili. * Makube sendaweni ayithandayo ukuze angalukhohlwa lolu suku. * Zama ukuqala ngokwenza ucwaningo ukuthi angakujabulela yini ukucelwa umshado kugcwele abantu.

NgoLwesithathu, uSotswebhu we-IFP ePhalamende, uMnuz Narend Singh, ubuze uNgqongqoshe wezoLimo, amaHlathi nokuDoba, uMnuz Senzeni Zokwana, ukuthi ngabe useyithintile yini iminyango efanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni uphasisa ukusetshenziswa kwensangu ukulapha izifo ezithile. UZokwana uthe bamatasa nezingxoxo ezizoqinisekisa ukutshalwa kwensangu ukuze ilaphe izifo ezithile kulandelwa umthetho. “Umthetho othinta ukusetshenziswa kwensangu ukulapha izifo ubhekelelwe nguMnyango wezeMpilo nowezoBulungiswa ngokomthetho wemithi wango-1965. Siyithintile le minyango nowezoHwebo neziMboni namaphoyisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukutshalwa kwensangu ngeke kuphule imithetho ethile,” kusho uZokwana. Uthe ucwaningo olwenziwayo lokuthi izokwazi yini ukusebenziseka njengomuthi nokuthi izothengwa ngabantu abangaki luhamba kahle. “Njengamanje umnyango wethu nowezempilo umatasa ubheka imithetho yokulawula ukutshalwa kwensangu nemikhiqizo ezokwenziwa ngayo,” kusho uZokwana. Uthe bayitshelile iminyango ethintekayo ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi insangu ibhekwe ngeso lokwelapha. Basalinde izimpendulo. USingh uthe bazolinda izimpendulo zeminyango ethintekayo njengoba kusathuthukiswa umthetho ozosebenza uma sekudayiswa insangu ezosetshenziselwa ukwelapha. “Sikholwa wukuthi insangu ezosetshenziselwa ukwelapha izifo ezithile ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho nasekudaleni amathuba omsebenzi. Ucwaningo lwethu luveza ukuthi umnotho uzohlomula kakhulu ngalolu hlelo. Kufanele iminyango ethintekayo iluphuthume lolu hlelo ngoba luza nenqwaba yamathuba omsebenzi nempilo engcono kubantu,” kusho uSingh. I-IFP ifake lesi sicelo ngoba iqhubeka ezinyathelweni zelungu layo eselashona uMnuz Mario Ambrosini owaphakamise ukuthi uhulumeni avumele ukusetshenziswa kwensangu ukuthi ilaphe ezinye izifo. U-Ambrosini owazibulala wayenomdlavuza. kanti waphoqeleka ukuthi aye phesheya lapho babemnika amakhambi enziwe ngensangu ayepholisa izinhlungu. U-Ambrosini waphetha ngokuzibulala emzini wakhe oseWestern Cape.
UNKK Patricia De Lille ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngaphandle kweNkantolo eNkulu eWestern Cape. Isithombe:Ayanda Ndamane/African News Agency/ANA UNKK Patricia De Lille ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngaphandle kweNkantolo eNkulu eWestern Cape. Isithombe:Ayanda Ndamane/African News Agency/ANA AKAKATHATHI sinqumo ngekusasa lakhe uNkk Patricia De Lille ngoLwesithathu omemezele ukuthi uzosigcina isinqumo sakhe sokusula njengeMeya yaseKapa. UDe Lille umemezele lezi zindaba engaphandle kweNkantolo eNkulu yaseWesterm Cape lapho afake khona isicelo sokuthi kuchithwe imibiko emibili eyenziwa abameli beBowman Gilfillan ebiphenya ngendlela abephethe ngayo umasipala. Noma udaba lusaqhubeka enkantolo, uDe Lille uthe akaguquki kwisinqumo sakhe sokusula kwesobuMeya wabe esememezela nokuthi uyalishiya iqembu leDA ngemuva kwesikhathi eside ‘ecindezelekile’ kuyona. Usayine incwadi yakhe yokusula njengeMeya emastebhisini khona enkantolo. UDe Lille usula nje usanda kubekwa icala lokukhwabanisa ngemuva kombiko weBowman oveze ukuthi bekwenziwa umkhonyovu ngamabhasi eMyCiTi. Omunye wabaphenywayo ngalezi zinsolo ukhomishina wezokuthutha osamisiwe emsebenzini, uMelissa Whitehead, okusolwa ukuthi uyathinteka ekukhwabanisweni kwethenda likaR286 million lamabhasi ahamba ngogesi. Ngesikhathi kuhlangane umkhandlu ngeledlule kwavunyelwana ngokuthi udaba ludluliselwe emaphoyiseni ukuze kuphenywe bonke abathintekayo. Ngesikhathi uhleli lowo mhlangano kwabamuncu kusula amanye amalungu awu-5 eDA esola le nhlangano ngokucwasa nokucindezela uDe Lille ngalezi zinsolo abathi abukho ubufakazi bazo. UDe Lille uthe uyasola ukuthi abammeli beBowman Gilfillan bebesebenzisana nosopolitiki ukumbhixa ngezinsolo zokuthi ubedla imali yabakhokhi bentela.
File picture: sxc.hu File picture: sxc.hu BAKHATHAZEKILE abazali babafundi baseMlazi Com Tech High eMlaza, okuthiwa sebephuthwa ukufunda ngenxa yenkinga yokucishwa kukagesi. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi sekuphele isonto ugesi ungekho kulesi sikole esinabafundi abahlala ngaphakathi. Phezu kokucishwa kukagesi, kuphinde kwaphela namanzi, okwenza ukuthi izingane ezihlala emakubo zisheshe zigodukiswe. Kuthiwa isikole sikweleta uMasipala weTheku imali elinganiselwa kuR4 million. Okukhathaza abazali ukuthi abakaze batshelwe ngale nkinga yesikweletu. Umzali wengane efunda uGrade 9 kodwa engahlali ngaphakathi esikoleni, uthe isimo simanzonzo. Uthe bezwe ngesonto eledlule ukuthi ugesi uphelile. “Sithole ukuthi izingane ezihlala ngaphakathi sezikhanyisa amakhandlela ebusuku, zilale ngesinkwa ngoba akuphekwa. Bazamile abanye abazali ukuyohlola isimo, bavinjwa onogada esangweni.” Omunye umzali onengane ehlala ngaphakathi esikoleni uthe okumphatha kabi kakhulu ukuthi abazi ngokwenzeka ezinganeni zabo. Uthe njengoba izingane zihlala ngaphakathi azivunyelwe ukuphatha amaselula futhi sikaliwe nesikhathi sokuzivakashela. “Ngiphathwa kabi ukuthi zidlani izingane zethu njengoba ugesi ungekho. Sizwe ukuthi ezinye azisayi emakilasini ngoba namanzi okugeza awekho. Kuqale unyaka sibhalisile sangatshelwa lutho ngenkinga. Inkinga ebesiyazi eyokuphuka kwezicabha okwenzeka ngesikhathi kuhlasele umoya ngonyaka odlule,” kusho umzali. Kuthiwa abazali bathunyelelwe uthishanhloko amaSMS ngoLwesithathu ebabikela ngenkinga kagesi, ebatshela nokuthi bayazama ukuyilungisa. Uxolise nangokungasheshi abatshele abazali ngale nkinga. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, uthe asibaphethe kahle isimo saseComTech. Uthe kukhona abakuhlelayo ukuxazulula le nkinga. UMnuz Mthunzi Gumede, okhulumela ihhovisi leMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, uthe sekubizwe umhlangano ophuthumayo namuhla ukuxoxa ngalolu daba. Lo mhlangano uphakathi kwemeya nobuholi bomnyango wezemfundo nothishanhloko abathintekayo. Uthe akuyona inhloso yabo ukuthi izikole zicishelwe ugesi futhi bazokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuthi izingane zingaphazamiseki. “Zingu-500 izikole ezikweleta umasipala imali elinganiselwa kuR80 million. Imeya isiyalele ukuthi izikole zingacishelwa ugesi singakatholakali isixaxululo sokukhokha isikweletu ngoba iyikhathalele imfundo. Sinxusa ukuthi izikole esezithikamezekile ukuthi zithintane nomasipala ngokushesha,” kusho uGumede.
ABAHOLI be-ANC eLimpopo ngoMsombuluko bazohlangana nabaholi benhlangano eLuthuli House kulandela ukuvela kwe-ANC kulabo abasolwa ngokuhlomula ekuxetshulweni kwezigidigidi zamarandi kwiVBS Mutual Bank. NgeSonto i-ANC ithe ayinaso isiqiniseko ngokuthi yayithola yini imali eyavela ngokukhwabaniswa kwemali ebalelwa ku-R2 billion kuleli bhange. I-ANC ihlangana nje igama layo livezwe owayengusihlalo weVBS Mutual Bank, uMnuz Tshifhiwa Matodzi, obale neDA, SACP ne-EFF kulabo ‘abahlomula’ kwimali eyebiwe. Okhulumela i-ANC kuzwelonke, uMnuz Pule Mabe, uthe uyazi ngezinsolo zokuthi iqembu elibusayo lacela futhi lathola uxhaso kuleli bhange. “Siyazi ngalezi zinsolo futhi sisazama ukuthola kwihhovisi lomgcinimafa ukuthi ziyiqiniso yini. Okwamanje ngeke ngikwazi ukuphawula ngokuthi izinsolo ziyiqiniso noma cha. Ngisalinde ubufakazi. Izinsolo ezibucayi lezi ngakho sidinga ukucophelela,” kusho uMabe. Uthe inhlangano ebusayo ayifisi ukuchitha lezi zinsolo bese kujika kuvele ukuthi bayithola imali kuleli bhange. Okhulumela iDA kuzwelonke uMnuz Solly Malatsi ukukhahlele ngezinyawo zombili ukuthi yake yacela noma yathola uxhaso kwiVBS Mutual Bank. “I-DA ayikaze ithole ngisho isenti kwiVBS. Lezi zinsolo azilona iqiniso,” kusho uMalatsi. NgoLwesine ngesonto eledlule iDA yavula icala ifuna bonke abathintekayo ekudliweni kwemali yeVBS Mutual Bank babhekane nengalo yomthetho. Noma uMatodzi ebalwa njengobhongoza ekudliweni kwemali kwibhange lokuqala ebeliphethwe abantu abamnyama kuphela kuleli, akahlatshwanga ngemibuzo ngesikhathi u-Adv Terry Motau enza uphenyo. UMotau uthe akakhulumanga noMatodzi ngoba ukhombise ukungathembeki ngesikhathi edlelwa impahla yakhe. “Ukuphika kwakhe ukuthi uyingxenye yabantu abadale le nhlekelele ebhange kushayisana nobufakazi obuningi obukhomba ukuthi nguyena obengubhongoza wayo yonke lento. Ngenxa yokuzihlangula kwakhe ngabona ukuthi kuzofana nokumosha isikhathi ukumnikeza ithuba lokuthi abeke uhlangothi lwakhe. Lokho uyokwena kwenye inkundla ngesinye isikhathi,” kusho uMotau. I-EFF ngakolunye uhlangothi ithe izophendula ngalezi zinsolo esithangamini nabezindaba ngoLwesibili.
UMENGAMELI wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa nePhini likamengameli uMnuz David Mabuza bebingelela abantu emcimbini wokwethula umhlahlandlela we-ANC, eMoses Mabhida stadium, eThekwini izolo Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng / African News Agency (ANA) UMENGAMELI wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa nePhini likamengameli uMnuz David Mabuza bebingelela abantu emcimbini wokwethula umhlahlandlela we-ANC, eMoses Mabhida stadium, eThekwini izolo Isithombe: Motshwari Mofokeng / African News Agency (ANA) UMENGAMELI we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa uvumile ukuthi inhlangano yakhe i-ANC yenze inqwaba yamaphutha kule minyaka edlule futhi izimisele ngokuzehlisa phambi kwabantu iwalungise ukuze babuyelwe yithemba kuyona. URamaphosa usho lokhu ngesikhathi ephakathi nenkulumo yakhe emcimbini wokwethula komhlahlandlela wokhetho obusenkundleni iMoses Mabhida eThekwini ebigcwele phama kungekho nendawo yokubeka unyawo. URamaphosa uthi kubalulekile ukuthi bangazikhukhumezi bavume umonakalo bese beqala-ke ukulungisa. “Simatasa sizinuka amakhwapha thina njengenhlangano.Asiphiki ukuthi sishayisile ezintweni eziningi kodwa siyalungisa, wonke umuntu uyakubona lokhu. Sinikeni-ke ithuba sibuyisele izinto ngononina sisebenze siye phambili,” kunxusa uRamaphosa eshela abavoti. Uthe isinyathelo sokuqala ukuthi abavoti baqome uKhongolose okhethweni oluzayo lukazwelonke, bese behlala bethule babuke balinde ukuthi kuye ngamagama enkehli. Uthe abantu abangakhohlwa ukuthi i-ANC isuka kude nabo, ngakho-ke abangayihlinzeli ezibini ngamaphutha ayo. “Sifuna ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi esayiqala ngo-1994 kuze kube yimanje. Sizoyilungisa indaba yamathuba emisebenzi ngoba siyazi sikhulu isililo ngayo. “Umnotho kufanele siwukhulise ngoba yiwona ozolekelela ukudaleka kwemisebenzi," kunxusa uRamaphosa.
